input:
If you decide to eat here, just be aware it is going to take about 2 hours from beginning to end. We have tried it multiple times, because I want to like it! I have been to it's other locations in NJ and never had a bad experience. 

The food is good, but it takes a very long time to come out. The waitstaff is very young, but usually pleasant. We have just had too many experiences where we spent way too long waiting. We usually opt for another diner or restaurant on the weekends, in order to be done quicker.
Refine this for me please: Please note that dining at this establishment typically requires a significant time commitment of approximately 2 hours from start to finish. Despite our repeated attempts to enjoy it, the prolonged waiting times have become a common occurrence. It is worth mentioning that I have visited their other locations in New Jersey and have always had positive experiences. While the food is of good quality, it does take an extensive amount of time to be served. The waitstaff, although quite young, is generally pleasant. However, due to our numerous encounters with extended wait times, we usually choose alternative diners or restaurants on weekends to ensure a more timely dining experience.

input:
I've taken a lot of spin classes over the years, and nothing compares to the classes at Body Cycle. From the nice, clean space and amazing bikes, to the welcoming and motivating instructors, every class is a top notch work out.

For anyone who struggles to fit workouts in, the online scheduling system makes it easy to plan ahead (and there's no need to line up way in advanced like many gyms make you do).

There is no way I can write this review without giving Russell, the owner of Body Cycle, a shout out. Russell's passion for fitness and cycling is so evident, as is his desire for all of his clients to succeed. He is always dropping in to classes to check in/provide encouragement, and is open to ideas and recommendations from anyone. Russell always wears a smile on his face, even when he's kicking your butt in class!
Refine this for me please:
I have been a dedicated spin class participant for several years now, and I must say that nothing compares to the exceptional experiences I've had at Body Cycle. The studio boasts a pristine and inviting atmosphere, accompanied by state-of-the-art bikes that enhance the overall workout.

What truly sets Body Cycle apart from others is the caliber of instructors who never fail to create an inclusive and motivational environment in every class. They wholeheartedly encourage and uplift participants, ensuring that each session is a first-rate fitness journey.

Moreover, one of the most convenient aspects of Body Cycle is their user-friendly online scheduling system. It greatly simplifies planning workouts in advance, eliminating the frustrating need to arrive excessively early as is often required at other fitness establishments.

I simply cannot write this review without extending a special acknowledgment to Russell, the extraordinary owner of Body Cycle. His profound dedication to fitness and cycling permeates every aspect of the studio. Russell's unwavering commitment to the success of his clients is palpable and inspiring. He is frequently present in classes, providing ongoing support and motivation. Furthermore, Russell remains receptive to ideas and suggestions from anyone, fostering a truly collaborative and customer-centric environment. It's worth noting that even while he pushes you to the limits during class, Russell consistently wears a contagious smile on his face.

input: Family diner. Had the buffet. Eclectic assortment: a large chicken leg, fried jalapeño, tamale, two rolled grape leaves, fresh melon. All good. Lots of Mexican choices there. Also has a menu with breakfast served all day long. Friendly, attentive staff. Good place for a casual relaxed meal with no expectations. Next to the Clarion Hotel.
Refine this for me please:
Please help me refine the following description: 

Located next to the Clarion Hotel, the family diner offers a relaxed and casual dining experience with no expectations. We decided to try their buffet which boasted an eclectic assortment of dishes. The options included a mouthwatering large chicken leg, a crispy fried jalapeño, a flavorful tamale, two delicious rolled grape leaves, and refreshing slices of fresh melon. We were pleasantly surprised by the wide variety of Mexican choices available. Additionally, they offer an all-day breakfast menu. The staff was friendly and attentive, making the dining experience even more enjoyable. Overall, this diner is a great spot for a laid-back and satisfying meal.

input: Wow!  Yummy, different,  delicious.   Our favorite is the lamb curry and korma.  With 10 different kinds of naan!!!  Don't let the outside deter you (because we almost changed our minds)...go in and try something new!   You'll be glad you did!
Refine this for me please: Wow! The food at this place is absolutely mouthwatering. We highly recommend trying their lamb curry and korma - they are simply divine. And let's not forget about their incredible variety of naan, with a whopping 10 different kinds to choose from! Trust us, even though the exterior might not be the most appealing, don't let that discourage you. Take a leap of faith and step inside to explore their menu. Trying something new here will definitely leave you with a satisfying and delightful experience. Don't miss out - you'll be grateful you gave it a try!

input: Cute interior and owner (?) gave us tour of upcoming patio/rooftop area which will be great on beautiful days like today. Cheese curds were very good and very filling. Really like that sandwiches come w salad, esp after eating too many curds! Had the onion, gruyere, tomato sandwich. Wasn't too much cheese which I liked. Needed something else...pepper jelly maybe. Would like to see more menu options added such as salads w fun cheeses. Lots of beer and wine as well as limited cocktails. Next time I will try one of the draft wines.
Refine this for me please: The interior of the place was adorable, and the owner kindly gave us a tour of the upcoming patio/rooftop area, which I imagine will be perfect on beautiful days like today. The cheese curds we ordered were not only delicious but also incredibly satisfying. One thing I really appreciate is that the sandwiches are served with a side salad, especially after indulging in those irresistible curds! I opted for the onion, gruyere, and tomato sandwich, which had just the right amount of cheese for my taste. However, I felt like it needed an extra kick, perhaps some pepper jelly would have done the trick. It would be fantastic to see more options added to the menu, such as salads with fun and unique cheeses. On the beverage front, they have an extensive selection of beer and wine, although the cocktail choices are somewhat limited. I'll make sure to try one of their draft wines next time I visit.

input: I am a long term frequent customer of this establishment. I just went in to order take out (3 apps) and was told they're too busy to do it. Really? The place is maybe half full at best. Does your dick reach your ass? Yes? Go fuck yourself! I'm a frequent customer AND great tipper. Glad that Kanella just opened. NEVER going back to dmitris!
Refine this for me please:
I am a long-term and loyal customer of this establishment. Today, I visited to place a takeout order for three appetizers, but unfortunately, I was informed that they were unable to accommodate it due to their current workload. Despite the fact that the restaurant appeared to be only half full at best, I felt quite disappointed by this response. Nevertheless, I value good customer service and understand that busy periods can be challenging.

I would appreciate it if the staff could have handled the situation more professionally. As someone who has been a loyal customer for a considerable time and consistently provides generous tips, I believe I deserve better treatment. Fortunately, there is a new restaurant called Kanella that recently opened, and I'm excited to give it a try. Regrettably, I have decided not to return to Dmitri's.

input: Loved this tour! I grabbed a groupon and the price was great. It was the perfect way to explore New Orleans for someone who'd never been there before and didn't know a lot about the history of the city. Our tour guide had tons of interesting tidbits about the city, and I really enjoyed the experience. Highly recommended tour. I actually thought we were just going to tour through the cemetery, but she took us around the French Quarter for the first hour, and the cemetery for the second half of the tour. You'll meet up in front of a grocery store (seems strange at first, but it's not terribly hard to find, and it'll give you a chance to get some water), and you'll stop at a visitor center part way through the tour for a bathroom break if needed. This tour was one of my favorite parts of my trip!
Refine this for me please: I absolutely loved this tour! I found a great deal on Groupon which made it even better. It was the ideal way for me to discover New Orleans as a first-time visitor with limited knowledge of its history. Our tour guide was incredibly knowledgeable and shared fascinating insights about the city. I had a fantastic experience and highly recommend this tour. Initially, I thought we would only explore the cemetery, but to my surprise, we started off by exploring the French Quarter for the first hour before heading to the cemetery for the second half of the tour. The meeting point in front of a grocery store may seem peculiar, but it's actually quite easy to find. Additionally, the tour includes a stop at a visitor center for a bathroom break if needed. Without a doubt, this tour stands out as one of the highlights of my trip to New Orleans!

input: Amazingly amazing wings and homemade bleu cheese. Had the ribeye: tender, perfectly prepared, delicious. Nice selection of craft beers. Would DEFINITELY recommend checking out this hidden gem.
Refine this for me please: The wings here are truly remarkable, with a homemade bleu cheese dipping sauce that adds a delightful touch. As for the ribeye, it was flawlessly cooked, tender, and simply delectable. The craft beer selection is quite impressive too. Without a doubt, this hidden gem is highly recommended and worth a visit.

input: This easter instead of going to Lopez Lake we went to Los Padres National Forest which is really pretty but if you go to white rock the staff needs to cut down all the dead grass that invades the rock and the water. I would wish the staff would also clean or get rid of the dead grass that's also living by the water. The water is really green and dirty. Los padres national forest staff need to work hard to maintain this forest looking pretty and not like a dumpster. Even Cachuma lake looks like they put a bit more effort.
Refine this for me please: This Easter, instead of our usual trip to Lopez Lake, we decided to explore the scenic Los Padres National Forest. While the forest itself is stunning, it is worth mentioning that at certain areas like white rock, the staff should consider removing the overgrown dead grass that detracts from the natural beauty of the rock and the water. Furthermore, it would be greatly appreciated if they took the time to also clean up any dead grass that may be lining the water, as the otherwise picturesque lake appears green and murky. It is important for the staff at Los Padres National Forest to prioritize the maintenance of this beautiful destination, ensuring it remains an attractive natural setting rather than resembling a neglected area. Comparatively, even Cachuma Lake seems to make more effort in this regard.

input: Had a party of 6 here for hibachi. Our waitress brought our separate sushi orders on one plate so we couldn't really tell who's was who's and forgot several items on an order. I understand making mistakes but the restaraunt was really quiet so we were kind of surprised. Usually hibachi is a fun lively experience and our  cook  said maybe three words, but he cooked very well his name was Francisco. Service was fishy, food was pretty good, and im hoping it was just an off night here. But for the money I wouldn't go back.
Refine this for me please: We had a party of 6 at a hibachi restaurant. However, our experience was not as enjoyable as we had hoped. Our waitress made a mistake by bringing our separate sushi orders on one plate, which made it difficult for us to identify whose was whose. Additionally, she forgot several items from one of our orders. We were surprised by these mishaps as the restaurant was quiet at the time. Usually, hibachi dining is a fun and lively experience, but in this case, our cook, Francisco, barely spoke a few words, although his cooking was excellent. The service seemed questionable, and while the food was decent, we are hoping that it was just an off night for the restaurant. However, considering the amount we paid, we would not choose to return.

input:
My experience with Shalimar was nothing but wonderful. 
I wanted to get my engagement ring sized and was told over the phone that it could probably be done within the day. 
When I brought it by, the team confirmed that the jeweler would be able to accommodate my same-day request and that it would be around $40 (simple band, decrease by three full sizes).
I checked my size one more time, confirmed, and left to let them do their thing.
When I came to pick up later that afternoon, the ring was too small. It's very important to note that Shalimar sized the ring perfectly, but that I made a mistake and should've gone up a half-size.
The Shalimar group were completely understanding and accommodating, even resizing my ring back up and getting it back to me within an hour at no charge! Even though it was my mistake!
The associates' attitudes in dealing with what was a pretty embarrassing situation instantly earned my satisfaction and loyalty as a customer. Very grateful for such a wonderful experience.
Refine this for me please:
I had an exceptional experience with Shalimar. I needed to have my engagement ring resized, and after a phone call, I was informed that it could most likely be done on the same day. When I arrived at the store, the team confirmed the jeweler's ability to fulfill my same-day request, and they quoted a price of approximately $40 for resizing my simple band by three full sizes.

After verifying my size once again, I left the ring in their care. When I returned later in the day to pick it up, I discovered that the ring was too small. It is important to mention that Shalimar had initially sized the ring perfectly, but the mistake was mine for not requesting a half-size larger.

However, the Shalimar group handled the situation with understanding and accommodation. They promptly resized my ring to its original size within an hour, and they did not charge me for the additional service, despite the mistake being entirely my own.

The associates' attitudes throughout the process, despite it being a somewhat embarrassing situation, immediately earned my satisfaction and loyalty as a customer. I am incredibly grateful for the wonderful experience I had with Shalimar.

input: Locals recommended Milktooth, and it's an amazing jewel of Indianapolis. I'm glade I had the chance to experience this.
Refine this for me please: The locals' recommendation of Milktooth is absolutely justified as it truly stands as a remarkable gem in Indianapolis. I am incredibly grateful for the opportunity to have experienced this culinary delight.

input: Love going here for happy hour or dinner!  Great patio with fans to beat the StL heat!   Also...very accomodating at this location.  I like the Veal Milanese but with mixed greens instead of pasta!  they'll modify the menu to suit your taste!
Refine this for me please: I absolutely love going to this place for happy hour or dinner! The patio is fantastic, especially with the fans to keep you cool amid the StL heat. Moreover, the staff at this location is incredibly accommodating. My personal favorite is the Veal Milanese, but instead of pasta, I always request it with mixed greens. The best part is that they're more than willing to modify their menu to suit your taste preferences!

input:
Good food--loved the gnocchi with marinara
the baked eggplant appetizer was very good too

The service was very slow, but despite this, I'd go back, the food is just that good
Refine this for me please: The food was exceptional, particularly the gnocchi with marinara sauce. The baked eggplant appetizer was also delightful. Although the service was notably slow, the food was so outstanding that I would still consider returning.

input:
The bun makes the Sonoran Dog. It's like a snuggie for the pup. A first, it seems ridiculous and almost like it's going to be too much, exactly like everyone's favorite blanket with sleeves. Too much softness, too much smush, too indulgent.  Wrong. It's warm, soft, chewy, fragrant, and it succeeds where other famed Sonoran Dogs fail. 

The hot dog itself is flavorful, but I would prefer that it or the bacon have a little more bite or snap to better hold their own against the dominant mustard and onions. 

I'm with the masses on the carne asada caramelo. Excellent tortilla, salty, melty cheese, and great carne. 

Super cheap and you can drive through.
Refine this for me please:
The Sonoran Dog is perfected by its bun, which serves as a cozy and comforting wrap for the hot dog. Initially, this may seem excessive and reminiscent of everyone's beloved blanket with sleeves - overly soft, excessively indulgent. However, this assumption is swiftly proven wrong. The bun is not only warm and soft, but also chewy and fragrant, surpassing the quality of other notable Sonoran Dogs. 

While the hot dog itself possesses remarkable flavor, it would benefit from a touch more bite or snap, especially when paired with the dominant flavors of mustard and onions. The bacon also shares this desire for a stronger presence.

On the other hand, the carne asada caramelo receives unanimous praise. Wrapped in an exceptional tortilla and combined with salty, melty cheese, the carne asada excels in taste and texture.

Furthermore, this delightful culinary experience is remarkably affordable and conveniently available through drive-through service.

input: Great place for breakfast! I had the waffle, which was fluffy and perfect, and home fries which were nice and smashed and crunchy. Friendly waitstaff. Will definitely be back!
Refine this for me please: Highly recommended breakfast spot! The waffle I ordered was delightfully fluffy and perfectly cooked, complemented by the irresistibly crunchy and nicely smashed home fries. The attentive and friendly waitstaff further enhanced the enjoyable dining experience. I can't wait to return!

input: Tremendous service (Big shout out to Douglas) that complemented the delicious food. Pretty expensive establishment (40-50$ avg for your main course), but its definitely backs that up with an atmosphere that's comparable with any of the top tier restaurants across the country.
Refine this for me please: A remarkable dining experience (kudos to Douglas) with exceptional service that perfectly complemented the delectable cuisine. While the cost of the main course falls on the higher end (averaging $40-50), it is certainly justified by the exquisite atmosphere, on par with the finest restaurants nationwide.

input: The hubby and I have been here on multiple occasions and we have loved every part of the meal, every single time. Everyone from the servers to the bartender is very knowledgable about the menu and was able to immediately recommend items I could eat as-is, substitute or delete to make something safe for this Celiac girl to eat. The wine and cocktail menus are spot on. The food divine.  My only wish is that they would have a gluten-free dessert, we've always had to go elsewhere for something sweet. But that is not a big deal and I still want to go here time and time again.
Refine this for me please: My husband and I have dined here multiple times and each experience has been exceptional. The staff, from servers to bartenders, are incredibly knowledgeable about the menu. They always offer immediate recommendations for items I can enjoy as-is or modify to suit my dietary needs as a person with Celiac disease. The wine and cocktail menus are impeccably curated, and the food itself is divine. The only slight disappointment is the absence of a gluten-free dessert option, which has led us to seek sweets elsewhere. However, this minor inconvenience does not diminish my desire to keep returning to this amazing restaurant.

input: I go to blow bar to get my brows done by natalie (brow specialist) which i highly recommend she is great does a great job on my eyebrows! But then i got a blow by victoria!! Wow i was impress i have thin, straight, dead hair and she left me with the biggest volume ive ever had!!! Tried another girl but didnt like it as much so victoria will be my girl for ever; very beautiful clean place!!!
Refine this for me please: I highly recommend going to Blow Bar to get your eyebrows done by Natalie, a fantastic brow specialist. She does an incredible job on my eyebrows every time! Additionally, I was pleasantly surprised by Victoria when she gave me a blowout. Despite having thin, straight, lifeless hair, she managed to give me the biggest volume I've ever had! Another stylist at the salon didn't impress me as much, but Victoria will definitely be my go-to stylist from now on. The salon itself is beautiful and clean as well.

input: My absolute favorite cafe in the city. Their black and white latte is probably the best I've ever had (not too sweet and just the right amount of foam), soups are always really good (even for non-soup people) and there's just a lot of space to do work. The noise level is perfect, the music is at a perfect level, and I always enjoy when patrons bring their dogs. I'll keep giving them my business for as long as I can.
Refine this for me please: My utmost preferred cafe in the city, hands down. The black and white latte they serve is beyond compare - it strikes the perfect balance between sweetness and foam. Even if you're not particularly fond of soups, their flavorful creations will pleasantly surprise you. Besides, the cafe boasts ample space, making it an ideal environment for work or study. The noise level is just right, and the music is set at an agreeable volume. Moreover, I always derive great joy from seeing patrons accompanied by their furry companions. I intend to remain a loyal and devoted customer for as long as possible.

input:
HOLY SMOKES!

actual pumpkin pie mixed in with the frozen custard......are you kidding me? Why hasn't this become a huge sweep the nation treat. 

The best part was the chunks of pie crust. Like finding a diamond inside another diamond. Super yummy.
Refine this for me please:
This treat is absolutely mind-blowing! Can you believe they actually mix real pumpkin pie into the frozen custard? It's astounding that this hasn't taken the nation by storm yet. 

But here's the real kicker - the chunks of pie crust! They're like stumbling upon a precious treasure within another treasure. The taste is out of this world.

input: Upland is a brewery based out of Bloomington, Indiana that has become popular enough to open up a couple additional locations in central Indiana.  All of their beers are very good, and I am also a fan of their burgers and tenderloins.  Therefore, I was excited to try their pizza, but I don't think it ended up being on par with these other items.  My margherita pizza had a cracker-like crust and was pretty light overall.  The cheese was good, but none of the other toppings added much flavor.  There was no red sauce as is typical for a true margherita pizza.  My opinion is that Upland's pizza might serve as a nice appetizer for a group, but I'll be sticking with their burgers or tenderloins as my meal of choice on future visits.
Refine this for me please: Upland, a popular brewery based in Bloomington, Indiana, has expanded its reach by opening additional locations in central Indiana. Known for its exceptional selection of beers, I have also been impressed with their delicious burgers and tenderloins. Naturally, I was eagerly anticipating trying their pizza offering; however, it didn't quite live up to my expectations compared to their other menu items. The margherita pizza had a thin and crispy crust, reminiscent of a cracker, and overall, was quite light. While the cheese was enjoyable, the toppings lacked flavor, and the absence of a traditional red sauce was a disappointment. In my opinion, Upland's pizza could serve as a decent appetizer for a group, but for my main course, I will continue to opt for their mouthwatering burgers or tenderloins during my future visits.

input: I thoroughly enjoyed the show.  Chill way to spend a Friday night.
Refine this for me please: I had a great time watching the show; it was a relaxing way to spend a Friday night.

input: Yes, this is the only sushi place in town. However, it is great when you're craving sushi and don't have time to go somewhere else. The salmon is probably the best fish they have, so we always order salmon. We also love their spicy edamame, tempura, ocean salad, and cabbage salad. Service has always been friendly and quick!
Refine this for me please: Yes, this is the only sushi place in town, but it is a fantastic option when you're in the mood for sushi and pressed for time. Their salmon is undeniably their standout fish, and we consistently opt for it. Alongside that, we thoroughly enjoy their spicy edamame, tempura, ocean salad, and cabbage salad. The service is consistently friendly and efficient, making the overall experience a pleasant one.

input:
I was really between 3 and 4 stars for this one. I LOVE the 96th street Naked Tchopstix so I was very excited to see this one which is closer to my house.
The vibe is totally different as this is geared more to take out although they do have a decent size dining area. You order at the counter and they deliver it.
My daughter and I tried the sushi bowl. You pick up a piece of paper and  select from a choice of proteins, vegetables, rice and toppings. I like the fact that it is on paper and you don't have to guess what things are or have to shout over the counter to tell the server what you want. The sushi bowl was good but not wonderful. The choices particularly of the vegetables seemed a little too limiting and I felt I had more rice than other food items. The sauces were tasty. My husband ordered the Maui roll which is my favorite roll at the 96th street location and this just was not up that standard. It was good but the quality and consistently was not as good as at 96th street. I would go back though and I think a lot of people would be happy with the sushi bowls. I do want to make a comment about the low reviews that people have given the place because of service. People - it is a sushi place - it isn't McDonalds- so it will be a bit slower. You are not going to order and get out of there in five minutes even though it is called express. As a healthy alternative to fast food in the area, it is worth the wait. Oh and try the bubble tea. I had the strawberry and it was quite yummy. Next time I am going to try the vanilla chai.
Refine this for me please:
I was undecided between giving this place 3 or 4 stars. I am a big fan of the 96th street Naked Tchopstix, so I was excited to try this location closer to my house. The atmosphere here is completely different, as it is more focused on take-out, although they do have a decent-sized dining area. You place your order at the counter and they bring it to you.

My daughter and I opted for the sushi bowl. They provide a piece of paper where you can choose your proteins, vegetables, rice, and toppings. I like that everything is listed on the paper, so there's no confusion about what each item is, and you don't have to shout your order to the server. The sushi bowl was good, but not exceptional. The vegetable options felt a bit limited, and I felt like there was more rice than other food items. The sauces were flavorful. My husband ordered the Maui roll, which is my favorite at the 96th street location, but unfortunately, it didn't meet the same standards. It was decent, but the quality and consistency weren't as good as at the other location. Despite this, I would still consider returning, as I believe many people would be satisfied with the sushi bowls. I do want to address the negative reviews regarding the service. People need to understand that this is a sushi place, not McDonald's, and it may take a little longer. You can't expect to order and be in and out in five minutes, even though it's called "express." As a healthier alternative to fast food in the area, it's worth the wait. Oh, and I highly recommend trying the bubble tea. I had the strawberry flavor, and it was quite delicious. Next time, I'll give the vanilla chai a go.

input: Went for lunch. Beef brisket sandwich was awesome.   So juicy and tender.    Pulled pork was was just as good!
Refine this for me please: I enjoyed a delightful lunch where I had an incredible beef brisket sandwich. The sandwich was truly outstanding - the meat was extraordinarily juicy and tender. I also had the pulled pork, which was equally as delicious!

input: Best thai food in the area.  Everything was authentic and delicious.  Will definitely be back again and again.
Refine this for me please: The area boasts the best Thai food imaginable. Each dish was exceptionally authentic and delicious. I can't help but plan to return countless times in the future.

input: Service was crappy, and food was mediocre.  I wish I would have picked some other place for my last dinner in town.
Refine this for me please: The service at this establishment was very poor, and the quality of the food was only average. I deeply regret choosing this place for my final dinner in town.

input:
I recently had dinner here with my wife over the weekend and could not have been more pleased! 

Our meal was excellent! My wife and I were astounded by how quickly our food came out! Everything tasted fresh and homemade which we both appreciated. 

The only problem was trying to pick something from the menu as there were too many delicious sounding items to choose from. We will definitely be returning to try more items! Can't wait to see what the next chef specials will be!
Refine this for me please:
I had the pleasure of dining at this establishment last weekend with my wife, and it was truly a delightful experience. We were absolutely thrilled with our meal, as it exceeded our expectations in every way. The promptness with which our food was served impressed us greatly, and the flavors were outstandingly fresh and homemade, which added a special touch to our dining experience.

The only slight challenge we faced was deciding on what to order from the extensive menu, as every dish seemed irresistibly tempting. However, this dilemma only gives us more reason to eagerly anticipate our next visit, as we are determined to explore more of their delectable offerings. The anticipation of the upcoming chef specials is enough to amplify our excitement even further. We cannot wait to return and indulge in the culinary delights that await us.

input: I at least have to give this restaurant two stars due to the decent food. But while on a dinner meeting and after spending $100 on entrées and appetizers, I had to flag down the assistant cook, (the guy in bright red baggy pants watching TV), to see if I could get more avocado for my tuna entrée.  He made it very apparent and direct that he could not help me with that situation and I would have to flag down my  waitress so she could bill me for the four dollar avocado.
Refine this for me please: I would rate this restaurant with two stars based on the quality of the food. However, during a dinner meeting where I spent $100 on appetizers and entrées, I had to request additional avocado for my tuna entrée from the assistant cook. It was quite noticeable that this assistant cook, who was wearing bright red baggy pants and watching TV at the time, was unable to assist me with my request. He made it clear that I would need to ask my waitress to bill me separately for the four dollar avocado.

input: First time there and it was excellent!!! It feels like your are entering someone's home. The waiters there funny and nice. The food come out very quickly and it is phenomenal!!! Definitely will be going back to this place.
Refine this for me please: I had an amazing experience at this place for my first visit! The ambience made me feel like I was stepping into someone's cozy home. The waitstaff was not only friendly but also provided some enjoyable moments with their humor. The food was served promptly and surpassed all expectations with its outstanding quality. I am definitely looking forward to going back to this place in the future.

input:

Friendly staff.

Street parking as well as parking lot in the back.

Nestled in a charming location, our restaurant offers serene outdoor seating for a delightful dining experience.

input: Great staff always helps and always nice. Always clean and huge store size. Stays stocked with everything you need. The staff always helps make my custom breakfast bagel
Refine this for me please: The staff at this store consistently delivers exceptional service with their friendly and helpful demeanor. The cleanliness of the store is impeccable, and its generous size creates a pleasant shopping experience. Additionally, the store remains consistently well-stocked with a wide variety of items to fulfill all your needs. The staff's extraordinary effort even extends to making my custom breakfast bagel just the way I like it.

input: Took my vehicle here for some work a few years ago for a manufacturer recall. Problem went away and then started hearing another noise which I thought was related, but turned out was a completely different issue. Kevin and his mechanic lifted my car right up and fixed the issue FREE OF CHARGE even though I told them I'd pay. Outstanding individuals for doing that. Highly recommend!
Refine this for me please: A few years ago, I brought my vehicle to this place to address a manufacturer recall. The initial problem was resolved, but later on, I noticed a different noise which I initially believed was connected to the previous issue. However, it turned out to be a completely separate problem. Kevin and his mechanic kindly took the time to lift my car and fix the issue, without charging me anything, even though I had offered to pay. input: After my ROTD  yesterday of a different Sweet CeCe's location, I realized that I had never reviewed my local source!  Anyway, I love the product.  Love love love. input: We checked in around 2:30 pm.  Check-in was quick and easy with complimentary valet parking (always appreciated).  The Peppermill is huge and reminded us of the Caesars Palace in Las Vegas.  They have around eight restaurants on site offering almost any type of food you could want.  The casino area is huge, rivaling almost anything you could find in Las Vegas.  One thing we noticed is that many of the slot machines were noted as being penny machines, but when you actually started to play them you realized they had minimum bets of anywhere from 30 cents to $5.  Talk about false advertising!  We were in the Tuscany Tower on the 12th floor.  Our room had a nice view of the huge pool area.  Our room was large and featured free WiFi (likewise always appreciated), a huge bathroom area with large shower (with two shower heads), TV, a large jetted bathtub and a phone next to the commode.  There were dual sinks and lots of counter space.  Plenty of towels were supplied.  The roomy main area had a king bed with night stands, closet, TV, mini fridge, dresser with two drawers, a safe, table for computer or writing, complimentary bottles of water, and three nicely upholstered chairs and table.  The thermostat did a good job controlling the temperature and keeping it comfortable.  Staff were all courteous and helpful.  A very nice place and we enjoyed our stay.
Refine this for me please:
We arrived at the Peppermill around 2:30 pm and the check-in process was quick and easy. We were pleased to find complimentary valet parking, which is always a nice perk. The sheer size of the Peppermill reminded us of Caesars Palace in Las Vegas. With around eight restaurants on site, there was a wide variety of food options available to suit any taste. The casino area was also impressive, rivaling the grandeur of Las Vegas establishments. However, we did notice a misleading aspect regarding some of the slot machines. Although labeled as penny machines, the minimum bets ranged from 30 cents to $5, which felt like false advertising. 

Our accommodations were in the Tuscany Tower, specifically on the 12th floor. The room boasted a lovely view of the expansive pool area. It was spacious and well-appointed, offering free WiFi (always appreciated), a generously sized bathroom with a large shower featuring two shower heads, a TV, a luxurious jetted bathtub, and even a phone conveniently placed next to the commode. The bathroom also had dual sinks and ample counter space. We were provided with plenty of towels, ensuring our comfort throughout our stay. 

The main area of the room was well-designed, featuring a comfortable king bed with nightstands, a closet, another TV, a mini fridge, a dresser with two drawers, a safe, a table suitable for computer work or writing, complimentary bottles of water, as well as three tastefully upholstered chairs and a table. The temperature control worked efficiently, making sure the room remained comfortable at all times. 

The staff at the Peppermill were consistently courteous and helpful, enhancing our overall experience. All in all, it was a very pleasant stay at this beautiful establishment.

input:
The only reason I didn't give this restaurant a 5 star rating, is because of one single pretentious waiter. As a 4 night guest at Hotel Palomar, the location of the restaurant is an obvious plus. The first night of my stay, I met a coworker in the restaurant for a cocktail. When we arrived, the host staff were busy and not available, so we just walked in. The restaurant was not too busy, so we just looked at a small table next to the bar and proceeded to take a seat. A waiter came by and I quickly asked if we could have a seat, before sitting down and told him we'd only be having cocktails. He stumbled on his reply, and in an irritated/in-convinced tone, told me "I guess it would be fine" and basically just kept walking mid sentence. My guest and I brushed it off, and started having a conversation while looking at the drink menu. To make a long story short, he was distant and we both got the "couldn't be bothered" vibe from him. When it came to the bill, we asked if it could be split due to company transaction policies, and you would have thought asked him for some inconceivable task. We basically spent the rest of our night and elevator ride to our room in shock of the rudeness we had just experienced. 

Although that situation left a bad taste in our mouth, and the night before we decided to avoid the restaurant, we decided to grab another cocktail and give this place one more try. After looking around and ensuring "last nights waiter" wasn't on shift, we walked over to the bar and started looking over the menu. Instantly, the bartender greeted us with pleasant small talk and made us feel 100% welcome. He asked about our day, recommended cocktails and was a completely genuine person. This guy (I think his name was Ben) is an absolute star! He gave us lessons on Whiskey, described how to make classic cocktails, and was 100% invested in our experience. This is exactly what a bartender at a 4/5 star establishment should be - actually he exceeds that. He was kind, funny, friendly and completely redeemed this restaurant/bar from our terrible experience the night before. 
I also ordered room service last night from this restaurant, and it was amazing. The bacon wrapped dates and chocolate cake are to die for! Great restaurant and amazing bartender(s). Too bad one bad egg could have spoiled this experience.
Refine this for me please:
The only reason I didn't give this restaurant a 5-star rating is because of one pretentious waiter. As a 4-night guest at Hotel Palomar, the location of the restaurant is a definite plus. On the first night of my stay, I went to the restaurant with a coworker for a cocktail. The host staff was busy, so we decided to walk in ourselves. The restaurant wasn't too busy, so we found a small table near the bar and sat down. A waiter approached us, and I quickly asked if we could sit there for cocktails. He stumbled in his response and, with an irritated tone, said, "I guess it would be fine," and walked off mid-sentence. My guest and I brushed it off and started having a conversation while looking at the drink menu. Throughout the evening, the waiter remained distant, and we felt that he couldn't be bothered. When it was time to pay, we asked if the bill could be split due to company policies, and the waiter reacted as if we had asked him to do something inconceivable. We spent the rest of the night and elevator ride to our room in shock over the rudeness we had encountered.

Despite this negative experience, we decided to give the restaurant another chance the following night. We made sure the same waiter wasn't on shift and went to the bar. The bartender instantly greeted us with pleasant small talk and made us feel completely welcome. He asked about our day, recommended cocktails, and was genuinely engaged in making our experience enjoyable. This bartender, who I believe was named Ben, is an absolute star. He even gave us lessons on whiskey and described how to make classic cocktails. 

I also experienced the restaurant's room service last night, and it was amazing. The bacon-wrapped dates and chocolate cake were absolutely delicious. The restaurant itself is great, thanks to the amazing bartender(s). It's unfortunate that one bad waiter almost ruined our experience.

input: Stopped by after a Sunday morning walk in the park - great food, coffee customer service - love the vibe in here

input: In a word... "OVERRATED!".  The food took forever to come out.  The burger was WAY overcooked (Especially when I ordered it Medium Rare) and the Seafood Jumbalaya was Decent.  Not worth the price.  There are better places to eat in the french quarter.  It was not horrible, but for everything that we had heard about this place, I would have expected much better.

input: Comfortable bed, good breakfast, fast internet, great location, and low price. Overall I was really impressed with this place. However, if you stay on the top floors you may be waiting up to 15 minutes for an elevator in the morning.

input: NEVER AGAIN. This is a so called restaurant that does nothing that a restaurant should other than prepare food, because the rest is done by the patron. Want water? Get up and go across the yard to get it. Want a drink, walk up a flight of stairs and pay cash. Want to sit in a dirty yard in dirty lawn chairs, enjoy yourself. The wait staff is mildy helpful in that they bring you your food after you go to the window and pay cash for it...kind of like New Orleans Hamburger and Seafood, but dirty and with live music (which is nice). It's a one in a lifetime experience for me...just once.
Refine this for me please: NEVER AGAIN. This so-called restaurant fails to meet basic expectations of a dining establishment. Apart from preparing food, it lacks all other essential elements of a restaurant experience, leaving everything up to the patrons. Thirsty? You're responsible for fetching water from across the yard. Craving a drink? Climb a flight of stairs and pay cash for it. Seeking a comfortable seat? Settle for dirty yard and lawn chairs. The wait staff offers minimal assistance, merely delivering the food after you've paid for it at the window. It resembles a subpar version of New Orleans Hamburger and Seafood, minus cleanliness and featuring live music (a redeeming quality). For me, this visit was a one-time encounter, a unique experience I don't wish to repeat.

input:
If you want to pay for everything a la carte this is the place for you.  
Food wasn't terrible not impressive.
They brought a basket of chips and some tomato sauce which I asked politely for something spicier and some pico de gallo.  She brought them happily to me and the salsa was much better.  When asked what we would like to drink I asked for a coke and she brought out a bottle which I stated I wanted the fountain drink.  She said "oh that's only Pepsi".  Never mentioned that they only had bottle drinks for coke.  
We ordered our food which was reasonably priced, asked for sour cream and also to put cheese on the taco.  She let us know cheese was extra.  
It was $2.50 extra for another basket of chips.  
When I received the bill we paid more for the condiments then the actual food.  Side of sour cream 2.00, pico de gallo 2.50, salsa 2.00, chips 2.50, cheese 1.00 and the bottled coke that we didn't want 5.00.  
Just a suggestion...when you order anything make sure to ask if there is an extra charge.
Refine this for me please:
If you prefer to choose and pay for individual items, this restaurant offers an a la carte menu. The food was average, nothing exceptional. 

When we requested spicier options than the provided chips and tomato sauce, the server gladly brought us pico de gallo, which greatly improved the salsa. However, when I asked for a fountain drink and received a bottle of Pepsi instead, I realized they only served bottled drinks for Coke without prior mention.

The prices of the food were reasonable, but we were informed that cheese came with an extra charge when we asked for it on our tacos. We were charged an additional $2.50 for another basket of chips.

To our surprise, the condiments ended up costing more than the actual food on our bill. Side of sour cream: $2.00, pico de gallo: $2.50, salsa: $2.00, chips: $2.50, cheese: $1.00, and the unwanted bottled Coke: $5.00.

Just a suggestion: It would be helpful to inquire about any additional charges when placing an order.

input: The cafe was extremely cute. We came at 8am and they even had a jazz band playing at that time. I got the breakfast sandwich and it was delicious. I loved how they rolled the egg and put the bacon pieces inside. Great price for a filling breakfast!
Refine this for me please: The cafe was absolutely charming. We arrived promptly at 8am and were pleasantly surprised to find a jazz band serenading us. As for my breakfast sandwich, it was nothing short of delicious. The way they expertly rolled the egg and tucked in the bacon pieces was a delightful touch. Moreover, the price was incredibly reasonable for such a satisfying breakfast.

input:
On a scale of one to things that are awesome, this place is the bomb. 

I was drawn in by the promise of the duckfat frenchfries. Took the boy for his birthday and put our name in, had a drink around the corner while we waited and were given seats at the bar after about 45 minutes. 

We were waited on by Keith, the bartender, who was congenial, knowledgeable about his whiskeys and an all-around cool guy. We started with 3 cape may salts (two for me, one for the boy) and tater tots, both of which made me happy.

For dinner, I got Kentucky Fried Quail (stellar, though the succotash was not as exciting as I wanted it to be) and the boy got the 24$ Fois Gras burger, which was incredible. Worth every penny. The duckfat fries were pretty yummy, but not even the best part of the meal. I could've done without the cheese sauce, but as it was on the side I wasn't deterred.

I look forward to coming back here, with everyone I know.
Refine this for me please:
This place is absolutely amazing, ranking high on the scale of awesomeness. I was initially enticed by the promise of their duckfat french fries. I decided to bring my son here for his birthday celebration, and after putting our names on the waiting list, we enjoyed a drink at a nearby bar while we waited. After about 45 minutes, we were seated at the bar with Keith, a friendly and knowledgeable bartender who made our experience even better.

We started off with three Cape May salts and tater tots, both of which brought a smile to my face. For our main course, I opted for the Kentucky Fried Quail, which was outstanding, although the succotash fell a bit short of my expectations. My son went for the $24 Fois Gras burger, which was absolutely incredible and worth every penny. Although the duckfat fries were tasty, they weren't the highlight of the meal. I could have done without the cheese sauce, but since it came on the side, it didn't bother me too much.

I am already excited about returning to this place and sharing the experience with everyone I know.

input: We started with the artichoke dip, big mistake. It was cold and the chips were stale. Mentioned to our waitress, but nothing came of it. input: It was my fiance's birthday and he decided he wanted a good, laid back Thai restaurant for dinner. Yelp steered us in the Jasmine Rice direction, and it was definitely a good decision. We wanted the summer rolls, which were on the menu, but apparently will not be available until summer, so we settled on the pan-fried dumplings. The flavor was good, but I don't think we'd order them again. We got the green curry fried rice with duck and chicken pad thai. Both of those dishes were great, but the duck stole the show. That was some the of tastiest duck I've ever had. The pad thai was a bit sweet for us, so I think we'd try a different noodle dish when we return. But it was still very good, especially with some chili sauce mixed in. Our service was good, but other people had issues. One table was rushing to get to a show at the Kimmel Center and waited quite a while for their meal (and were going to be late). Another person who got take-out was missing one of their items (but the owner realized it and called him and walked the dish to his house, which was very nice). Overall, good quality Thai! We would definitely go back.
Refine this for me please: It was my fiance's birthday and he specifically wanted to dine at a relaxed Thai restaurant. After researching on Yelp, we decided to give Jasmine Rice a try, and we were not disappointed. Although we had initially planned to order the summer rolls, they were unfortunately not available, so we opted for the pan-fried dumplings instead. While the flavor was enjoyable, we probably wouldn't choose them again in the future. For our main courses, we ordered the green curry fried rice with duck and chicken pad thai. Both dishes were delightful, but the duck truly stood out with its incredible taste. The pad thai leaned towards the sweeter side for our preference, prompting us to consider trying a different noodle dish during our next visit. Nevertheless, adding some chili sauce elevated the overall experience. We received good service, although we observed some issues faced by other diners. One table, in a rush to make it to a show at the Kimmel Center, experienced a considerable wait for their meal, jeopardizing their timely arrival. Additionally, a customer who ordered take-out discovered that one of their items was missing. The restaurant's owner promptly realized the mishap, contacted the customer and personally delivered the missing dish to their residence, showcasing excellent customer service. Overall, we had a positive experience with Jasmine Rice, appreciating the high-quality Thai cuisine they offer. We would definitely consider returning in the future.

input:
I love the Brewpub for their variety of dishes.  Nachos, pizza and sandwiches.  Variety of beers to choose from crafted right on sight.  

Every time we go, the service is slow.  I think it's just the pace of the restaurant.  It's never a quick beer and a bite of food.  Instead, enjoy the patio and friends, savor that time.  

Kid and dog friendly environment.  Also great for your vegetarian and vegan friends.  

My go to is a half order of the nachos or fish & chips.  

Tried their Pumpkin Seasonal Beer and it's on par with some of my favorite pumpkins.
Refine this for me please:
I absolutely adore the Brewpub for its extensive selection of dishes, including mouthwatering nachos, delicious pizza, and satisfying sandwiches. One of the best parts is that they even brew a variety of beers on site, offering a delightful array of choices.

However, it is worth mentioning that the service at the Brewpub tends to be on the slower side. It seems to be an intentional aspect of the restaurant's ambiance, as it encourages patrons to relax, unwind, and truly savor the experience with friends on their lovely patio.

What sets this place apart is its family and pet-friendly environment, making it a great spot to bring your loved ones along. In addition, they cater to the needs of vegetarian and vegan individuals, ensuring everyone can find something delicious to enjoy.

Personally, I cannot resist indulging in a half order of their scrumptious nachos or their mouthwatering fish & chips. As for their seasonal offerings, I recently had the pleasure of trying their Pumpkin Beer, which pleasantly surprised me as it rivaled some of my favorite pumpkin brews.

input:
My go to menu is coconut soup and pad thai with protein. I tried same menu here. 
Actually really like their coconut soup. They used enough amount of coconut milk that soup was really creamy and wasn't over powering with herb. I am so used to Americanized thai cuisine that I prefer less herb on my dish except cilantro.
Pat thai was great too. Liked the amount of peanut they used, noodle was chewy and perfect and not too sweet. They gave me generous amount of chicken and white meat wasn't dry so I was very happy with my meal.
Refine this for me please:
Here's a refined version:

"My preferred menu consists of coconut soup and pad Thai with protein, which I recently tried at this place. I absolutely loved their coconut soup; it had the perfect creamy consistency with just the right amount of coconut milk, without overwhelming the herbal flavors. Being accustomed to Americanized Thai cuisine, I prefer minimal herbs in my dish, except for cilantro.

The pad Thai was also excellent. I enjoyed the generous amount of peanuts used, and the noodles were cooked to perfection, offering a chewy texture. The sweetness level was just right, and they provided me with a generous portion of chicken, with the white meat being moist and tender. Overall, I was extremely satisfied with my meal."

input: Excellent service! Great diner food and breakfast is served all day. Came here for lunch- they were busy but very friendly and hospitable. Easy to get to off the 295.

input:
