Their food is better than expected. I always get wings and fries. (be careful of the wtf sauce though) Sometimes it takes a real long time to get the bartenders attention, but the place is usually packed. And if you're lucky the always sunny crew will pop in!
Refine this for me please:
My favorite hangout on a Saturday night has always been Lucy's, so I was initially disappointed when it closed down. However, I was pleasantly surprised to come across this bar conveniently located just across the street!
To my delight, their food surpassed my expectations. I've found that their wings and fries are always a reliable choice (although I caution you to be mindful of their fiery wtf sauce). The only drawback is that occasionally it can be challenging to get the bartenders' attention due to the high volume of patrons. Nevertheless, the place is usually bustling with activity. And if you're lucky, you might even catch a glimpse of the always sunny crew popping in!

input:
We were a bit weary about trying the Shellfish Company on the Wharf as more often than not, many places like these (see Cannery Row, Monterey) feast on a captive audience and provide sub-standard fare at high prices.

However, emboldened by the perennial good reviews on Yelp, we suppressed our initial observations and went ahead with the trying it out. The place is small, so definitely plan ahead. You will have to wait, so either you know, just do so, or perhaps try to visit outside of peak hours. Luckily, our wait was only about 20 minutes as the dinner rush was just leveling off.

The special was the local rock crab - $25 for 3 lbs of California Rock Crab, salad, and your choice of soup/chowder. After taking a look at a few trays of rock crab being served out, the wife and I both opted for it, as it looked awesome.  

The salad/chowder combo was great as you actually received hearty portions of each, so it was a good start. As much as I liked the chowder however, the Shrimp Bisque the wife ordered was amazing, so I would recommend that going forward. 

But enough of prattling on about side dishes: the rock crab tasted just as glorious as it looked. Juicy, buttery chunks of white crab meat await you, just a few cracks away. While the rock crab shells are pretty thick, once cracked, they splinter and separate easily, a good sign they are cooked to perfection. The rock crabs provided a great amount of meat for what I felt to be the least amount of work you're going to do for crab, King or otherwise. 

We were thoroughly satisfied with our meal and along with the special being an overall great value, devouring the Rock Crab at SBSC turned out to be one of the favorite meals on the trip. I think ordering crab here is a safe proposition indeed.
Refine this for me please:
We were hesitant about trying the Shellfish Company on the Wharf because places like these often take advantage of a captive audience and offer low-quality food at high prices, as seen in Cannery Row, Monterey.

However, encouraged by the consistently positive reviews on Yelp, we decided to overlook our initial reservations and give it a try. The establishment is quite small, so it's wise to plan ahead. Be prepared to wait, either patience or visiting during off-peak hours is advisable. Fortunately, our wait time was only around 20 minutes since the dinner rush was subsiding.

The featured dish was the local rock crab, priced at $25 for 3 lbs of California Rock Crab, accompanied by a salad and a choice of soup or chowder. After observing several trays of rock crab being served, both my wife and I were enticed by its appearance and decided to give it a go.

The combination of salad and chowder was delightful, as each component was generously portioned. Despite my enjoyment of the chowder, my wife's Shrimp Bisque was absolutely incredible, so I highly recommend trying that in the future.

But enough about the side dishes; the rock crab tasted as fantastic as it looked. Juicy, buttery chunks of white crab meat awaited us, only a few cracks away. Although the shells of the rock crab were thick, they easily splintered and separated once cracked, indicating that they were cooked to perfection. These rock crabs offered a significant amount of meat, requiring minimal effort compared to other types of crab, such as King crab.

We left the restaurant thoroughly satisfied with our meal. Not only was the special a fantastic value, but devouring the rock crab at SBSC turned out to be one of the most memorable meals of our trip. Ordering crab here seems like a safe bet, indeed.

input: I LOVE Weaver's Way and really disagree with some of the content in previous reviews. WW is not necessarily meant for convenience shopping. I am a single woman and I find that I have no trouble shopping at the co-op, during peak times or otherwise. I actually find the co-op to be a great place to shop if you live alone because I can get smaller quantities of items than if I shop at the corporate stores like Acme. I also enjoy the work hours - I've worked throughout the store, but most recently, I have been getting in my hours by participating in the membership committee. I wouldn't say that the community is necessarily made up of "tree huggers" and "earth children", though. The community is made up of a variety of similarly-minded folks from different backgrounds. I enjoy having a place to go to where I can obtain locally grown produce, a place that offers more natural, wholesome, and preservative-free foods than chain stores with prices way below that of Whole Foods. I enjoy interacting with other members and contributing to my local and global community. I don't find the membership fee or the work hours to be prohibitive being a single person vs. a family. I don't think that membership in a co-op is for everyone and, if you aren't single, it's definitely not a solo decision. If you're keen on being committed to the Weaver Way values, you couldn't find a better place to shop. If not, stick to the chain stores or just pay the 10% visitors' fee to pop in once in a while.
Refine this for me please:
I am a big fan of Weaver's Way and strongly disagree with some of the opinions expressed in previous reviews. It's important to note that Weaver's Way is not designed for convenient shopping, but I personally have no trouble shopping there, even during peak times. As a single woman, I find the co-op to be ideal because I can purchase smaller quantities of items compared to corporate stores like Acme. Additionally, I really appreciate the flexible work hours at Weaver's Way. I have worked in various areas of the store, but my recent focus has been on the membership committee, which has been a rewarding experience.

Contrary to popular belief, the community at Weaver's Way isn't solely made up of "tree huggers" and "earth children." It consists of similarly-minded individuals from various backgrounds. What I love most about Weaver's Way is having access to locally grown produce and a wide range of natural, wholesome, and preservative-free foods, all at prices that are much more reasonable than Whole Foods. It's also fulfilling to interact with other members and contribute to both the local and global community.

Let me just address the concerns about the membership fee and work hours. As a single person, I don't find them to be burdensome. However, I understand that co-op membership may not be suitable for everyone, especially if you have a family. It's definitely a decision that should be made together. But if you are committed to the values and principles of Weaver's Way, I truly believe there is no better place to shop. If not, you can always stick to chain stores or pay the 10% visitors' fee to visit occasionally.

input: Honestly the food doesn't knock my socks off but other people seem to love this place. I go because my husband likes it as for me I'd rather go to a different BBQ spot. I guess it also depends on what you order.
Refine this for me please: Personally, I'm not particularly impressed with the food at this place, although it appears to be popular among others. I visit it because my husband enjoys it; however, I personally prefer a different BBQ spot. Additionally, the quality of your experience might also be influenced by the specific dish you choose.

input: The TV shows are $4.99 and they have commercials! What a cheesy way to make money and a sign of a less than classy hotel, particularly when you pay more than $150 a night.  And there is NO complimentary breakfast, just an overpriced buffet, something even the cheapest hotels in California provide.
Refine this for me please: The TV shows at this hotel cost $4.99 and also include commercials, which is disappointing given the price of over $150 per night. It seems like a tacky and somewhat low-class approach to generate revenue. Moreover, the absence of a complimentary breakfast and the presence of an overpriced buffet is quite surprising, considering even budget hotels in California offer this service.

input: I stopped here because it was by the hotel I was staying in. The guys working at the shop were super nice and friendly. I really like the buy one get one deal they do. I also ordered some hot wings and they were pretty good. They had a ton of sauce on them which is awesome. Next time I come back to town I will be sure to stop here for some more pizza!
Refine this for me please: I chose to stop at this place since it was conveniently near the hotel I was staying in. The staff at the shop were extremely friendly and pleasant. What caught my attention was their enticing buy one get one deal. In addition to that, I decided to try their hot wings which turned out to be quite delicious. They were generously covered in sauce, which I found to be delightful. Without a doubt, I will make it a point to visit this establishment for more pizza the next time I'm in town!

input: I've only had the cannolis here but they are awesome! They're freshly filled when ordered and the filling is phenomenal. Not too sweet, it's perfect. If you like cannoli, if you don't think you like cannoli, you should definitely get one from Termini Bros.
Refine this for me please: I've exclusively tried the cannolis at Termini Bros, and they are absolutely incredible! The cannolis are expertly prepared, with the filling being freshly added upon ordering, making them incredibly delicious. The filling itself is beyond amazing, striking the perfect balance of sweetness without being overly sugary. Whether you already love cannolis or have never been a fan, I highly recommend getting one from Termini Bros.

input: Traveling through in our RV, stopped over in Granite City. Found this little gem of a cafe. Upon entering, the staff was very sweet and friendly. This is like home cooking. We ate here twice and all our food choices were fresh, delicious and like we would fix at home. Yum.
Refine this for me please: While traveling in our RV, we had the pleasure of staying in Granite City and discovered a charming little cafe worth mentioning. As soon as we walked in, we were greeted warmly by the sweet and friendly staff. This place exudes the comforting essence of homemade cooking. In fact, we enjoyed our meals here so much that we couldn't resist coming back for seconds. Everything we ordered was incredibly fresh, delicious, and reminiscent of the meals we would make ourselves at home. Simply put, our taste buds were thrilled.

input: After 3 weeks of working in the area I finally found a place off of Magazine that is not overrated. Friendly staff! Y'all know I love Phò so it's pretty damn good!
Refine this for me please: After spending three weeks in the area, I have finally discovered a place on Magazine Street that exceeds expectations. The staff is incredibly friendly, and as someone who loves Phò, I can confidently say that it is absolutely delicious.

input: Our family returned for breakfast again this weekend and the food and service was again impeccable ... Highly recommend
Refine this for me please: Our family returned for breakfast once again this weekend, and we were thrilled to find that the food and service were impeccable yet again. We cannot stress enough how highly we recommend this place.

input: The kayaking tour at the Santa Cruz Island was great.  My husband and I had a wonderful time.  Jen, our tour guide, was helpful and informative.  We had a lot of fun exploring the caves.  We didn't expect much but this tour definitely exceeded our expectation.
Refine this for me please: The kayaking tour at Santa Cruz Island was an amazing experience my husband and I thoroughly enjoyed. Our tour guide, Jen, was not only helpful but also provided us with valuable information throughout the tour. Exploring the caves was incredibly enjoyable, exceeding our initial expectations. Overall, this tour was truly exceptional and exceeded all our expectations.

input: Definitely recommend for anyone looking for a delicious meal at a reasonable price. The shrimp and goat cheese crepes are a must have!
Refine this for me please: Highly recommended for those seeking a delectable meal at an affordable cost. The must-try delicacy is undeniably the scrumptious shrimp and goat cheese crepes.

input:
After living in the STL area for way over 10 years now, I am both ashamed and remorseful to admit that I ate here for the FIRST time just a few weeks ago. I am ashamed because it's a St. Louis tradition and remorseful because I missed out on it for so..many...years! 

This place is amazing. What is not to love! It's a factory where you can get a tour (Friday-Sunday, noon-5pm on the hour), there's a shop, bar, and dining area. They also host many event with live music on the weekends. It's fun to just kind of wander and look around - don't worry, you'll get a chance because there will likely be a wait before you dine. The beer is, of course, amazing. The Hefeweizen is my personal favorite and a great start for anyone who is not a huge beer drinker (like myself). Additionally, the food is homegrown and damn good. I had the pizza (recommendation from my server) and it was really spectacular, though I'm admittedly a pizza connoisseur so I enjoy a good pizza pie more than most probably ;P My date had a bison burger which was also really good. 

More fun info: the service is great! I think they tend to hire more funky and alternative people (like tattoo parlor staff) which I support. The quality is what makes this place stand out along with the emphasis on local food and brewery. 

It is a little on the pricier side but for all the experience you get and the quality, it is worth it. I will go again and again and you probably should, too!
Refine this for me please:
After residing in the STL area for well over a decade, I must confess that I recently dined at this establishment for the very first time, and it fills me with both shame and regret. I feel ashamed because it is considered a St. Louis tradition, and remorseful for having missed out on it for so many years.

I can confidently proclaim that this place is absolutely incredible. Why wouldn't it be? It's a factory that offers guided tours (available Friday to Sunday, from noon to 5 pm, on the hour), boasts a shop, a bar, and a dining area. Moreover, they frequently host events with live music during the weekends. It's an adventure to simply wander around and take it all in. However, be prepared for a wait before you can indulge in their offerings. 

The beer, as expected, is exceptional. My personal favorite is the Hefeweizen, which serves as an excellent introduction for those who aren't avid beer enthusiasts (much like myself). And the food? Well, it's locally sourced and downright delicious. Acting upon my server's recommendation, I tried their pizza, and it was truly extraordinary. Although, I confess to being someone who appreciates a good pizza pie more than most, so take my enthusiasm with a grain of salt. Meanwhile, my companion decided to savor a bison burger, which proved to be equally delightful.

Extra tidbit: The service provided is outstanding! It appears that the staff here leans towards a more unique and alternative aesthetic, akin to those found in tattoo parlors. This is a practice I wholeheartedly support. The combination of their high-quality offerings and their emphasis on local cuisine and brewing sets this place apart.

While it may be a bit pricey, the overall experience and quality justify the cost. I assure you, I will be returning time and time again, and I strongly urge you to do the same!

input:
If I could give it a zero, I would. I order a plain hamburger, and realized they put  bacon in it (which I am allergic to and unable to eat) after two bites. When I went back to the drive-through window to complain (didn't realize the actual restaurant was open--it was almost 2 after all...), the guy took back the burger, said nothing, and disappeared. After 2 minutes of awkwardly making conversation with the next people in line in their car, he came back and rudely told me I had to go inside to get my food. Which I did. And still did not get an apology.

I refuse to go back there after that ordeal, which is a shame, because it's nice to have a variety of places to go to after DT. Guess Freebirds it is!
Refine this for me please:
I would rate it a zero if I could. I specifically ordered a plain hamburger, but to my disappointment, I discovered that it had bacon in it, which I am allergic to and cannot consume. Upon returning to the drive-through window to address the issue, I was taken aback when the staff member took back the burger without saying a word and vanished. I was left awkwardly conversing with the customers in line for about two minutes until he returned, only to rudely inform me that I needed to go inside to retrieve my order. Despite complying, I did not receive any apology for the inconvenience caused.

After that unpleasant experience, I have made the decision to never revisit that establishment. It is regrettable as I value having a range of dining options available after the drive-through. Looks like I will have to settle for Freebirds instead.

input: First time here and they did a great job, very satisfied with the car wash  and the service I received. Thank you
Refine this for me please: I had a great experience during my first visit here. The car wash was excellent, and I am extremely satisfied with the service I received. Thank you so much!

input:
I just started going to Sushi Nara this month (they opened just a short time ago).  I love this place; it is clean, the staff are friendly and acommodating, and the service is fast.  The sushi is always delicious ((I've been here 3 times) and the prices are reasonable. In fact, this week my husband stopped in for take out, bought 4 sushi rolls and the total was $24.  That is amazing.  

I love the freshness of the food and there's a huge selection to choose from.

Everyone on the eastside, check this place out!
Refine this for me please:
I recently started dining at Sushi Nara, a newly opened restaurant, and I must say, I am absolutely impressed. From the moment I walked in, the cleanliness of the place caught my attention, and the staff greeted me warmly, ready to accommodate my needs. The service here is remarkably fast, ensuring that I can enjoy my meal without any unnecessary wait time.

Speaking of the food, every sushi roll I have tried so far has been nothing short of delicious. I have visited this place three times already, and each time the quality and taste of the sushi have been consistently outstanding. What's even better is that the prices are reasonable. As an example, my husband recently purchased four sushi rolls for takeout, and the total bill was just $24. This affordability is truly amazing considering the high quality of the food.

What I appreciate most about Sushi Nara is the freshness of their ingredients. It is evident that they prioritize using the finest and most flavorful ingredients available. Moreover, the menu offers an extensive selection, ensuring that there is something to satisfy every sushi lover's cravings.

I highly recommend everyone on the eastside to check out Sushi Nara. This place is a hidden gem, offering impeccable cleanliness, friendly staff, fast service, delicious sushi, reasonable prices, and an impressive variety of options. Trust me, you won't be disappointed!

input: Awesome little shop.  The owner really knows his stuff and you can tell he loves his work.  They have tires and other parts you won't find anywhere else.
Refine this for me please: This shop is absolutely fantastic. The owner possesses exceptional expertise and a genuine passion for what he does. Not only do they offer an impressive range of tires, but they also carry a variety of hard-to-find parts that are unparalleled in other stores.

input: Been here so many times before and all I can say is the food is really good. A hidden gem in Florissant, it has the best Panang curry around. Haven't been to their sister restaurant yet, but I can't seem to want to move on when I am always so satisfied with their fare here.
Refine this for me please: I have visited this place countless times and I must say, the food is truly excellent. It is a hidden gem located in Florissant and their Panang curry is the absolute best. Although I haven't tried their sister restaurant yet, I find myself unable to explore other options because I am always completely satisfied with the amazing dining experience they offer here.

input: My food only merited maybe two stars but I will give an extra star because I like the menu (and will try more of it) and their design and concept.  Sadly though, my tomato-basil soup tasted kind of like a weak marinara and my tuna melt type sandwich had a very sharp, off-putting flavor.  It was citrusy, for sure, and I love lemon in a tuna melt but perhaps this was lemon zest or something just way too overpowering?  I think next time I will focus on the dishes with cured Italian meats, mortadella and prosciutto.  And also the baked goods, those sounded pretty good, especially the Nutella bruschetta!
Refine this for me please: Although I found my food to be only deserving of perhaps two stars, I am inclined to give an additional star due to my interest in the menu and desire to explore more dishes. The restaurant's design and concept also appeal to me. However, my experience with the tomato-basil soup was disappointing as it resembled a weak marinara rather than a flavorful soup. Similarly, the tuna melt sandwich had an unpleasant sharp taste, possibly due to an overpowering citrus element, perhaps lemon zest. In the future, I plan to try dishes featuring cured Italian meats like mortadella and prosciutto, as well as the enticing selection of baked goods, particularly the Nutella bruschetta.

input: We visited once and were very disappointed in my veggie pizza and my husband's sub sandwich.  The tomato sauce was not tasty, and they did not use enough cheese on my pizza.  The dough looked and tasted like it was prepared by a machine.  Perhaps they have improved, but we are not in any rush to try a second time.
Refine this for me please: During our visit, both my veggie pizza and my husband's sub sandwich turned out to be major disappointments. The tomato sauce was lackluster in terms of flavor, and my pizza was also lacking in sufficient cheese. Additionally, the dough had an artificial texture and flavor, almost as if it were prepared using a machine. While it is possible that the establishment has made improvements since our visit, we have no inclination to give it a second chance in the near future.

input:
A couple friends and I stopped by for some late night milkshakes and found ourselves at More Than Just Ice Cream. Well, we just got ice cream...not fully taking advantage of what the name implies, but maybe next time.

3 milkshakes: 1 coffee, 1 chocolate, and 1 black&white malt. 

All were pretty good. Definitely satisfied the ice cream craving. I thought my coffee milkshake could have been thicker, same goes for the chocolate. The black&white was plenty thick and was probably the best of the three. Unfortunately, I did not order that one so I settled for my not so creamy coffee.

I did sample some ice cream flavors before setting on a milkshake. I tried the pumpkin pie which was AMAZING. I don't know why I didn't just get this. Maybe a milkshake isn't the way to go here.
Refine this for me please:
A few friends and I decided to try out More Than Just Ice Cream for some late night milkshakes. Although the name suggests a variety of options beyond ice cream, we opted for regular ice cream this time, but we'll have to explore the other offerings next time.

We ordered three milkshakes: one coffee, one chocolate, and one black & white malt. Overall, they were good and satisfied our ice cream cravings. However, I felt that my coffee milkshake and the chocolate one could have been thicker in consistency. On the other hand, the black & white malt was perfectly thick and stood out as the best of the three. It was a shame I didn't order that one, as I settled for my less creamy coffee milkshake.

Before settling on a milkshake, I had the chance to sample some ice cream flavors. One that caught my attention was the pumpkin pie, which was absolutely amazing. In hindsight, I should have just gone for that flavor. Perhaps a milkshake wasn't the ideal choice for experiencing the full range of flavors at More Than Just Ice Cream.

input:
My husband and I took my mother here for her 100th birthday!
We can't say enough about the treatment we received: from a great table and view, to delicious "compliments of the chef" extra dishes, to a beautifully decorated cake plate, to the warm and attentive servers. It was much more than we expected, even for this very special occasion. For us, it was a wonderfully memorable experience.
Refine this for me please:
My husband and I decided to take my mother here to celebrate her 100th birthday, and we were absolutely blown away by the incredible treatment we received. From the moment we arrived, we were given a prime table with a breathtaking view. The chef went above and beyond by surprising us with delectable extra dishes, completely on the house. And to top it all off, they presented us with a gorgeously decorated cake plate.

But it wasn't just the extraordinary gestures that made our experience so remarkable; it was also the warm and attentive servers who made us feel like royalty. Every detail was taken care of, and we couldn't have asked for anything more. This was much more than what we had anticipated, especially for such a special occasion.

Needless to say, this evening will forever be etched in our memories. It was a truly unforgettable experience that exceeded all our expectations.

input:
Man. This place is nice. The bartender was awesome. Try the burger. It's fresh with all local ingredients. The plates of food I saw come out looked amazing as well. 

The beer is cold. The drinks are mixed perfectly.  This is not a chain restaurant but a dedicated local place with good employees.
Refine this for me please:
I must say, this place is quite impressive. From the moment I stepped in, I could tell it was something special. The bartender deserves a special mention for being absolutely awesome. I highly recommend trying their burger, as it is prepared with the freshest local ingredients; it's truly a treat for the taste buds. Additionally, the sight of various plates of food being served around me was simply breathtaking. 

Not only is the beer served here refreshingly cold, but the drinks are also meticulously mixed to perfection. It's worth noting that this establishment is not your average chain restaurant; it's a dedicated local spot with genuinely exceptional employees.

input:
I visited this restaurant 4 times during my 5 days stay. Crazy, right? Here are a list of reasons/pros:

- We were staying a nearby hotel.
- The restaurant opens 11 - 10:30 pretty much every day including new year's day so it fits into our schedule.
- If you are a party of two, chances are you get seated right away.
- $9 per dozen of oysters which is a really great deal by any standard!
- They have a seafood shop next door that sells boiled and fresh seafood to- go.
- Our server (same) is very friendly and recognized us every single time.

Now I want to talk about the reasons why I only give it 3 stars.

- We tried a bunch of stuff which are all pretty mediocre. Raw oysters are not cleaned well. So if your schedule is flexible, go to Superior Seafood during their happy hours for their 50 cents/oyster - better quality and cheaper. Turtle soup has a strange taste so I definitely prefer Felix's. A portion of my boiled shrimps are always mushy somhow, maybe boiled for too long?...
- The ambient is inviting but not comfortable so we basically just finished our food and go. 
- Clean the bathroom!!

Will probably visit again if we stay in the area next time or simply just pick up some seafood quickly.
Refine this for me please:
Here is a refined version of your review:

During my five-day stay nearby, I surprisingly found myself dining at this restaurant four times. Sounds crazy, right? Well, here are some reasons that made me keep coming back:

- We had the convenience of staying in a nearby hotel.
- The restaurant's operating hours from 11 am to 10:30 pm, including on New Year's Day, perfectly aligned with our schedule.
- As a party of two, we never had to wait long for a table.
- The price of $9 per dozen oysters was an unbeatable deal of excellent value.
- Adjacent to the restaurant, there is a seafood shop selling delicious boiled and fresh seafood to-go.
- Our dedicated server, who recognized us on each visit, was extremely friendly and attentive.

However, it's time for me to discuss the reasons why I gave this restaurant only three stars:

- Unfortunately, the food options we tried were quite lackluster. The raw oysters were poorly cleaned, leaving much to be desired. For those with flexibility, I recommend stopping by Superior Seafood during their happy hours, where you can enjoy higher quality oysters for just 50 cents each. Additionally, the turtle soup had an off-putting taste, and I would definitely suggest trying the version at Felix's instead. Furthermore, a portion of the boiled shrimp we ordered was consistently mushy, possibly indicating overboiling.
- While the atmosphere of the restaurant was inviting, the seating was not the most comfortable. As a result, we tended to quickly finish our meals and leave.
- Lastly, the cleanliness of the bathroom left much to be desired.

Overall, I would still consider visiting again if I find myself in the area or simply picking up some seafood for a quick meal.

input: Skip this train wreck if you are looking for dinner.  Our server was clueless...like we seriously thought she was lost in the restaurant.  Had to ask for setups, water refills, etc.  Ordered chicken parmesan and got eggplant parmesan instead with a fish bone in it.  The drinks were good.
Refine this for me please: You may want to avoid this particular dining experience if you had plans for a satisfying dinner. Unfortunately, our server seemed completely oblivious to their surroundings, leaving us with the impression that they were wandering aimlessly within the restaurant. We had to repeatedly request basic necessities like utensils, water refills, and other essentials. Furthermore, our order for chicken parmesan resulted in an unexpected serving of eggplant parmesan, complete with an unwelcome fish bone. On the positive side, the beverages were enjoyable.

input: Meh is all I can say for TDS. The restaurant itself is just cold.... not literally, but figuratively. There was no decor, no menu boards, stainless steel prep tables as dining tables, no soda machines, staff EVERYWHERE with no identification (shirts, nametags, etc). The food is reasonably priced and most of it was quite good, but what really irked my party was the fact that they charge for extra salsa!!! We ordered a salsa trio (which included 3 samples of the various salsas, in 2oz glass prep bowls), and when my brother asked for more salsa for his tacos (mind you, we ordered one of ever taco, three burritos and guacamole), he was told he'd have to buy the trio again! Really!!??? We spent over $40 on food, drinks and apps, too. Even though the food was decent, I wouldn't return as the atmosphere is just blah and you can't get extra salsa for your damn tacos!
Refine this for me please:
My experience at TDS was underwhelming. The restaurant had a stark, minimalist vibe with no decor or menu boards. The use of stainless steel prep tables as dining tables added to the overall impersonal atmosphere. Additionally, I found it frustrating that the staff lacked any form of identification, such as shirts or nametags. 

While the food was reasonably priced and mostly tasty, one major disappointment was their policy on salsa. We ordered a salsa trio, which came in small 2oz glass prep bowls, and when my brother asked for more salsa for his tacos, he was informed that he would have to purchase the trio again. This was infuriating, considering the amount of food we had ordered, including a variety of tacos, burritos, and guacamole, which totaled over $40. 

Despite the decent food, I would not consider revisiting TDS due to the uninspiring atmosphere and their ridiculous policy on extra salsa.

input: I'm so incredibly happy with our pictures! Angela Clifton Photography have worked with us 3 times and we have been happy with every single picture that was taken! Not only are the photos fabulous, but we had such a fun experience. The price is extremely reasonable and the pictures will be a keepsake we will cherish forever!
Refine this for me please: I am absolutely thrilled with our pictures! Angela Clifton Photography has provided their exceptional services to us three times, and without fail, every single picture has brought us immense joy. The quality of their work is outstanding, and the photos themselves are truly fabulous. What sets them apart is the incredible experience we had during the sessions. We had an absolute blast and thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. Additionally, the pricing is incredibly reasonable, making it even more worthwhile. These pictures will undoubtedly become cherished keepsakes that will hold a special place in our hearts forever.

input: Enjoyed my fish out at a sidewalk table.  A bit pricey but food was good.  Go to Side street in French quarter if u want quieter dining outside.
Refine this for me please: I had a great time dining on fish at a sidewalk table. Although it was a bit expensive, the food was delicious. If you're looking for a quieter outdoor dining experience, I recommend checking out Side Street in the French Quarter.

input: The court house is very old and the art is great. The spiral staircase is funny. One can get view of entire city from 5th level. The tower clock room is really surprising with all mechanical gears inside!! You need a prior appointment to get into clock room. Worth spending 2 to 3 hours of time here.
Refine this for me please: The courthouse is a splendid testament to its age, showcasing impressive artwork throughout. A highlight is the quirky spiral staircase that adds a touch of humor. From the fifth level, visitors are treated to a breathtaking panoramic view of the entire city. Venturing into the tower clock room is truly astonishing, as it reveals a mesmerizing display of intricate mechanical gears. It's worth noting that access to the clock room requires a prior appointment. Plan to spend a generous 2 to 3 hours immersing yourself in this captivating place.

input: I had the pleasure to meet with Ann today and not only was she extremely helpful and so positive, she went above and beyond to make my 1st experience here amazing and made it a absolute regular customer from this day forward. Thanks girlie!!
Refine this for me please: It was an absolute pleasure meeting with Ann today. She not only provided exceptional assistance but also exuded a positive attitude throughout our interaction. She went above and beyond to ensure that my first experience here was nothing short of amazing, which has undoubtedly made me a loyal customer from this day forward. Thank you, Ann!

input: This is the first time I tried this place and  I was surprisingly surprised. I had a combination dinner pad Thai and coconut soup. The soup was very tasty as I never had coconut soup before. The pad Thai was exactly what I was expecting and it did not disappoint. The restaurant had great Thai decor and music. The staff and service was top notch. For a town with not much selection for food, this was a great change of pace. This may become my go to place in Carp.
Refine this for me please: I recently tried this place for the first time and I was pleasantly surprised. I ordered the combination dinner which included pad Thai and coconut soup. The coconut soup was a delightful surprise, as I had never tasted it before. It had a delicious flavor that I thoroughly enjoyed. The pad Thai lived up to my expectations and I was not disappointed. The restaurant's Thai decor and music created a great atmosphere. The staff provided excellent service, making it even more enjoyable. In a town with limited food options, this place was a refreshing change. It might just become my new favorite spot in Carp.

input: This place was so chill and relaxing. When I come back it'll definitely be in my list if stops. Not to mention the artist performing was fun and eclectic  (I mean really, a country version of "Let It Go", what's not to love?)
Refine this for me please: This place had such a wonderful, laid-back atmosphere that made it incredibly relaxing. Without a doubt, it will be one of my must-visit destinations when I return. I must mention, the artist who performed there was incredibly entertaining and diverse (I mean, seriously, a country rendition of "Let It Go" - how could you not adore that?)

input:
Id you haven't been to the Smoothie King center since it was know as the New Orleans Arena, you are in for a nice surprise. The arena has had a face lift and, while the seats are the same,  everything else has been refreshed.   

Most importantly,  the food options are far more varied and appeal to many tastes.  The quality of the food is very good and significantly improved from a few years back. The drink options are much improved as well and include full service bars, spiked lemonade,  bottled and draft beer and of course, smoothies.  There is even a spot for sweets. You can get funnel cake, cotton candy, and all kinds of delicious things I was too full to take in.  

The venue finally feels a bit swanky and top notch.  We are moving on up!
Refine this for me please:
If you haven't visited the Smoothie King Center since its transformation from the New Orleans Arena, you're in for a delightful surprise. The arena has undergone a complete facelift, refreshing everything except for the seats.

One of the most noteworthy changes is the wide variety of food options now available, catering to diverse tastes. The quality of the food has greatly improved over the years, leaving behind any previous disappointments. Additionally, the selection of beverages has been significantly expanded, including full-service bars, spiked lemonade, bottled and draft beer, and, of course, a wide range of delicious smoothies. For those with a sweet tooth, there is even a dedicated spot offering treats such as funnel cakes, cotton candy, and other delectable goodies that I was too satisfied to sample.

Overall, the venue now exudes an upscale and luxurious atmosphere, truly representing a step up from its previous state. Get ready to experience an upgraded and first-class experience at the Smoothie King Center.

input: Don't know what it is but If my tummy's feeling icky, I can count on Chipotle's stake to fix me up. I just have to remember not to go during full on lunch time. I usually go between 2 & 4 when it's peaceful and calm. Busy or not the service is always friendly and fast!
Refine this for me please: If I ever feel uneasy in my stomach, I can always rely on Chipotle's steak to make me feel better. However, I've learned to avoid going during the busiest lunch hours. Instead, I make sure to visit between 2 and 4 pm for a peaceful and calm dining experience. Regardless of the crowd, the service at Chipotle is consistently friendly and prompt.

input: I must admit, I wasn't expecting much. This place totally blew us away. This has to be one of the best Indian restaurants in the Tampa Bay. The ambience is wonderful including white table linens. The best part was the food, OMG. The chicken 65 was to die for, and the hot sour soup was rich and flavorful. The waitress (Angel) was friendly,  attentive and very pleasant. They opened just a week ago. I'm sure this will soon be the place foodies seek out for real Indian food.
Refine this for me please: I was pleasantly surprised when I visited this place as my expectations were low. It turned out to be an outstanding Indian restaurant in the Tampa Bay area. The ambience, with its white table linens, was delightful. However, the highlight of the experience was the amazing food. The chicken 65 was exceptionally delicious, and the hot sour soup impressed with its rich and flavorful taste. Our waitress, Angel, was friendly, attentive, and made the dining experience even better. Despite being open for only a week, I have no doubt that this restaurant will quickly become a go-to spot for food enthusiasts in search of authentic Indian cuisine.

input:
Had to wait until my third trip to NOLA to actually get in the door.  First two times I tried waiting in line, this time around we got smart and bought reserved seats so we could be on the benches. Well worth the extra $20 to not hassle with waiting in line for an hour. It goes toward the preservation of Jazz so it's a good cause...just splurge.

The show was fantastic.  True musicians and great personalities to boot. I can only imagine that this is what concerts were like 50 years ago. The band members were dapper, engaging and insanely talented.  It's in a tiny hole in the wall space that only holds maybe 200 people? So it's very intimate and nice to see the smiles on the faces of the musicians as they share their craft with you. This is a must do while in NOLA!
Refine this for me please:
After making my third trip to NOLA, I finally managed to get inside the venue. The first two attempts involved waiting in line, but this time we were smart and purchased reserved seats on the benches. The extra $20 was worth it, as it saved us from the hassle of waiting for an hour. Moreover, the money goes towards the preservation of Jazz, making it a good cause to splurge on.

The show itself was absolutely fantastic. The musicians were true professionals with great personalities to match. I couldn't help but imagine that this is exactly what concerts were like half a century ago. Dressed impeccably, the band members captivated the audience with their engaging demeanor and immense talent. The venue itself was a small hole in the wall, probably accommodating no more than 200 people. This intimate setting allowed us to witness the joy on the musicians' faces as they shared their craft with us. Visiting this place is an absolute must while in NOLA!

input: A GREAT EXPERIENCE!!!!!!!!!  I was a completely new customer.  I did not have an appointment because my other plans got rained out and my dealership was too busy to take me.  I needed a PA State & Emissions  inspection which I dread because they can be a total ripoff at some places when they add things on and I just wanted to get it over with.  I saw that this place had much better reviews on Yelp than many other shops in the area.  Keystone Discount Tire took my 2008 Pontiac Torrent in for inspection while I waited and had some free coffee.  I only had to get up once to look at some irregular outer front tire wear on my car when it was on the rack during inspection.  I always appreciate it when the technician lets me look at the problem.   It was nothing major.  Easily correctable with an alignment sometime in the future.  Bill was very friendly, knowledgable, and straightforward with his overall analysis of my car.  My car was fully inspected and stickered in less than an hour without my bill being jacked up with add-ons.   I recommend getting on their mailing list for their coupons!!!!!!!!!!
Refine this for me please:
A Wonderful Experience at Keystone Discount Tire

As a first-time customer, I arrived at Keystone Discount Tire without an appointment due to rainy weather and a busy schedule at my usual dealership. My primary purpose was to obtain a PA State & Emissions inspection, a task I usually dread due to the possibility of additional charges. However, after researching on Yelp, I noticed that this place had excellent reviews compared to other local shops.

Upon my arrival, Keystone Discount Tire promptly accommodated my 2008 Pontiac Torrent for inspection, allowing me to wait comfortably with the offering of free coffee. Throughout the process, I only needed to get up once to examine some irregular outer front tire wear, which the technician kindly showed me. Thankfully, it was a minor issue that could be easily resolved with an alignment in the future.

Bill, the friendly and knowledgeable technician, provided me with a comprehensive analysis of my car. In less than an hour, my vehicle underwent a thorough inspection and received the necessary sticker, all without any unnecessary extra charges. I highly recommend joining their mailing list to avail of their coupons, which can provide great discounts towards future services.

input: Wow! I never thought my sons phone could be repaired after he dropped it but it is and it took less than a half an hour! Very professional and excellent service! I'm thrilled!
Refine this for me please: Wow! I am absolutely amazed that my son's phone could be repaired after he dropped it. Not only that, but the entire process took less than half an hour! The service we received was incredibly professional and the quality of their work is truly excellent. I couldn't be happier with the outcome.

input: Service and management terrible... After messing up all 4 of our orders the waiter got mad and started cursing... The manager offered our drinks to be free.. What a mess. The food was cold and nasty didn't even eat half of it and waited over an hour... I will never dine in any cracker barrel again after this experience...
Refine this for me please: The service and management were extremely disappointing. Not only did they mess up all four of our orders, but our waiter also became angry and resorted to cursing. The manager, as a form of apology, offered to comp our drinks. It was a chaotic situation overall. To make matters worse, the food arrived cold and tasted unpleasant, leaving us unable to finish even half of it. Additionally, we had to endure an excessive wait time of over an hour. This experience has completely soured my opinion of Cracker Barrel, and I have decided never to dine at any of their locations again.

input:
I have been to a number of dog friendly hotels...just not in the city and did not know what to expect. Usually they are motel like.  This one was in the heart of the city.

I walked tentatively into the hotel lobby as i have a labrador/golden mix who is not easy to hide.

We got to the front desk to register and i was still feeling uneasy although my  bf had assured me it was a dog friendly hotel. Reception was so nice immediately putting us at ease. As we checked in an attendant asked if Bentley could have treats which she fullly enjoyed. The Reception person also asked if we would like a welcome kit for Bentley. Holy moly. Of course. Dog dishes, a mat, treats, etc. I was blown away.  

Plus the guests at the hotel all stopped to compliment and pet "queen Bentley". Our room was on the top floor. Awesome!

Even when i went to walk her the car attendants greeted her by name. We were so impressed with the service we decided to come back an extra night. 

Thank you Loews. I didnt realize a hotel could be so dog friendly especially to a big dog.
Refine this for me please:
I have had the opportunity to stay at various dog friendly hotels in the past, but they were typically located outside of the city and offered a more basic motel-like experience. However, this time, I was pleasantly surprised to find a dog friendly hotel right in the heart of the city.

Upon entering the hotel lobby with my Labrador/Golden mix, I felt a bit apprehensive, unsure of what to expect. Considering her size, it's not easy for me to hide her presence. However, the reception staff quickly put my worries to rest with their warm and welcoming demeanor. As we proceeded with the check-in process, one of the attendants even asked if Bentley could have treats, which she absolutely loved. To my delight, they also offered a welcome kit for Bentley, complete with dog dishes, a mat, and treats. I couldn't believe how impressed I was with their generosity and thoughtfulness.

What's more, the other guests at the hotel couldn't resist stopping by to compliment and pet our beloved "queen Bentley." Our room, located on the top floor, offered a fantastic view and added to our overall experience.

Even when I took Bentley for a walk, the car attendants greeted her by name, displaying the same level of hospitality and genuine care. We were so impressed with the exceptional service that we decided to extend our stay for an additional night.

We are incredibly thankful to Loews for creating such a dog friendly environment, especially for accommodating larger breeds like Bentley. Prior to this experience, I never realized that a hotel could be so accommodating and welcoming to our furry friends.

input: Sometimes this food is very very good.  Unfortunately it's not consistent.   Ordered something I've been getting for years and every other time it tastes incredible. It's like they have different people in the kitchen and you don't know who you will get. So 50 % of the time it's excellent.  UGH.
Refine this for me please: Occasionally, this food is exceptionally delicious, but regrettably, its quality is inconsistent. I have been ordering a particular dish for years, and while it tastes incredible on every other occasion, it is like a gamble due to the varying individuals in the kitchen. Consequently, there is a 50% chance of it being excellent, which can be frustrating. UGH.

input:
Been to this location twice and will never go back again!!!!

First time was mediocre, the second time was so very disappointing it beggars belief. I ordered some ribs and had to send them back because one half was warm and the other half was refrigerator cold. They came back and one side was really hot and the other side was still cold, third time it was edible. The manager came over the third time to apologize, never once offered to comp anything. I'm not the kind of guy to cause a fuss to get something comped, but to send something back three times to get it cooked properly and only get an insincere apology really pisses me off, enough for me to write this review.
Refine this for me please:
I have visited this location twice now and unfortunately, I have come to the conclusion that I will not be returning again. The first visit was average, but the second visit was incredibly disappointing to the point where it is hard to fathom.

On my second visit, I decided to order some ribs. However, upon receiving the dish, I discovered that one half of the ribs were warm while the other half was refrigerator cold. Naturally, I had to send them back. To my dismay, when the ribs returned, one side was excessively hot while the other side remained cold. It took a third attempt to finally receive a properly cooked portion. Throughout this process, the manager did come to our table to apologize, but made no effort to compensate us for the inconvenience caused.

I am not typically the type of person who seeks to cause a scene in order to get freebies. However, it truly infuriates me that I had to send back my order three times just to have it cooked properly, and to only receive a half-hearted apology. This experience has left such a negative impression on me that I felt obligated to share my frustrations in this review.

input:
After trying a few ramen places with crazy variety in their selections and stellar broth, I was not too excited about the ramen I got at Cheu.  Maybe it's a matter of taste, but personally, I was not a fan of their thick noodles, and extremely salty broth.  

The service was great, and they had a nice selection of beers!  The friend I went with loved it, and has been many times.  Honestly, I'm just sorry I wasn't a bigger fan.  But I hope others try it for themselves.  I might just be an oddball out on this one.
Refine this for me please:
After trying several ramen places with a wide range of options and excellent broth, I was disappointed by the ramen I had at Cheu. Perhaps it's just a matter of personal preference, but I did not enjoy their thick noodles and overly salty broth.

On a positive note, the service was excellent, and they had a good selection of beers. The friend I went with really liked it and has been there many times. Personally, I just regret not being a bigger fan of Cheu. However, I encourage others to give it a try and form their own opinions. It's possible that I'm just an outlier in this case.

input:
Federal Doughnuts is a new concession at the ballpark -- who doesn't love some doughnuts and fried chicken?  

Also, there is now a concession stand near 136 that is gluten-free dedicated.  They offer pizza, cheesesteaks and even brownies and cookies.
Refine this for me please: Federal Doughnuts is an exciting new addition to the ballpark, offering a delightful combination of doughnuts and fried chicken that is sure to please everyone. Furthermore, for those with dietary restrictions, there is a convenient gluten-free concession stand located near 136. This special concession stand caters specifically to gluten-free customers, providing a delectable range of food options such as pizza, cheesesteaks, brownies, and cookies.

input:
Looks like there is a second Red Kings restaurant in Chinatown and it did not disappoint! Since this place just opened yesterday, I'm not exactly sure if it's replacing the other Red Kings down the street, or if it is just a second helping of spicy, Szechuan food.

We ordered takeout and picked up the Dan Dan Noodles and a shredded Pork in Garlic sauce dish. The spice level in both dishes was perfect.  Extremely mouth-burning, but with delicious flavors that were sweet, earthy, and fresh. The portions were very generous and will make for great leftovers for us. I can't wait to try some of the other dishes and come back here for a sit-down dinner. They also have karaoke rooms upstairs, plus they are BYOB.
Refine this for me please:
I recently discovered another Red Kings restaurant in Chinatown, and it exceeded my expectations! This new location, which just opened yesterday, has me curious whether it's a replacement for the existing one down the street or simply an additional establishment offering spicy, Szechuan cuisine.

For takeout, we decided to try their Dan Dan Noodles and a dish of shredded Pork in Garlic sauce. Both dishes had the perfect level of spiciness. They were incredibly flavorful, with a delightful combination of sweetness, earthiness, and freshness. The portion sizes were quite generous, ensuring we'll have delicious leftovers. I'm already excited to explore their other menu options and return for a sit-down dinner. It's worth noting that they even offer karaoke rooms upstairs, and you can bring your own drinks.

input: This is one of the busiest Chick fil A's I've seen but they always manage to be quick and have exceptional service! I seriously don't know how they can be so quick and great all the time! One of my favorite places!
Refine this for me please: This Chick fil A location is consistently busy, yet they consistently deliver quick and exceptional service. I am consistently amazed by their ability to maintain such efficiency and excellence. This is undoubtedly one of my top favorite places to visit.

input: Best place for salads! I go there every time I'm in town for lunch. It's fast and veggies are always fresh.
Refine this for me please: The best place for salads! I make it a point to visit every time I'm in town for lunch. The service is speedy and the vegetables are consistently fresh.

input: My parents and I took the Oak Alley and Laura Plantation tour on September 26th, 2015.  I forgot the name of our driver-he was very informative on our drive to the plantations.  The schedule is perfect!  We were dropped off where we had time before and after the tour for free time to walk around the properties.  They are very flexible with drop off locations on the return drive.  We got off near Jackson Square and got to enjoy the rest of the afternoon in the French Quarter.
Refine this for me please: On September 26th, 2015, my parents and I embarked on an unforgettable journey as we embarked on the Oak Alley and Laura Plantation tour. While I regrettably forgot the name of our driver, his wealth of knowledge made our drive to the plantations truly captivating. The overall schedule of the tour was impeccable, allowing us ample time to freely explore the properties both before and after the guided tour. Additionally, we appreciated the flexibility offered in choosing our desired drop-off location during the return drive. Choosing to disembark near Jackson Square, we made the most of our afternoon by immersing ourselves in the enchanting ambiance of the French Quarter.

input: We have been here twice for brunch and have enjoyed it immensely. Everything we have tried has been delicious, particularly the grits with scallions and sour cream. But the room is always freezing so be sure to bring a sweater!
Refine this for me please: We have visited this place for brunch twice now and each time has been a delightful experience. The food has consistently amazed us with its deliciousness, and we particularly recommend trying the grits with scallions and sour cream. However, it's worth noting that the ambient temperature in the room tends to be quite cold; we recommend bringing a sweater to ensure your comfort.

input: Love this place...best hot dogs and chili dogs around...i go here as many times as i can..yum
Refine this for me please: I absolutely adore this place! It undeniably offers the most delightful hot dogs and chili dogs in town. I make it a point to visit as often as possible because the taste is simply irresistible. The flavors are so mouthwatering, it's like heaven in every bite.

input: Sweet spot in the Waterline. Came for some live music with friends on Saturday. Very cool. Best local beer in town by far. Seems like the concept is a few notches up from Fig Mountain. Definitely prefer Topa. Even cooler is that you can order incredible food from the Nook Restaurant, and walk two feet into Lama Dog which is part of the Waterline. I love it!!
Refine this for me please:
The Waterline's Sweet Spot is an incredible experience. I visited with friends on a Saturday night to enjoy some live music, and it did not disappoint. The atmosphere was very cool and the best thing about it was the local beer selection, which far surpasses anything offered at Fig Mountain. Topa is definitely my preferred choice here.

What makes this place even more amazing is the fact that you can order delicious food from the Nook Restaurant and conveniently walk just a few feet into Lama Dog, which is also a part of the Waterline. I absolutely loved this aspect of the experience.

input:
Great customer service! We were a little out of their pick up area but they were very accommodating and came and got our group of 7. When we got there we realized we were billed for 8 instead of 7. I called and he refunded my money for the extra ticket in minutes!

The tour itself was SO much fun! We were laughing and smiling and our tour guide was funny! We saw lots of alligators! From babies swimming in the water to full grown ones! We saw turtles and birds too! Our tour guide had a baby alligator we could hold that he's raising until it's a little bigger since it was a late hatch that would have died because of when it was born. The ride back was fun too because we went fast and the guide did some "tricks" with the boat! I highly recommend this tour!!!
Refine this for me please:
Outstanding customer service! Despite being outside their designated pick-up area, they went above and beyond to accommodate our group of 7. Upon arrival, we noticed an error in our billing as we were charged for 8 instead of 7. However, a quick call resulted in an immediate refund for the extra ticket. 

Now, onto the tour itself - an absolute blast! Laughter and smiles were non-stop as our hilarious tour guide kept us entertained. We had the pleasure of observing countless alligators, ranging from tiny babies to majestic adults. The tour also showcased an array of other fascinating wildlife including turtles and birds. To our delight, our guide even offered us the chance to hold a baby alligator he was nurturing until it grew a bit larger. This little one would have perished had he not intervened due to being born late in the season. The return journey was equally enjoyable, with the boat speeding and the guide impressing us with some exciting tricks. I cannot recommend this tour enough!

input: Westfall replaced our roof in April. We could not be more pleased with the entire process. Quality roof, excellent communication and excellent follow up. Very happy we chose this company to replace our roof.
Refine this for me please: In April, Westfall successfully replaced our roof, leaving us extremely satisfied with the entire process. We are delighted with the quality of the new roof, as well as the exceptional communication and follow-up from the company. We are very glad we made the choice to entrust Westfall with our roof replacement.

input: Good food, reasonably priced, and nice staff. Not ideal for eating in, but since they are going for a fast food approach to vegan food, that makes a lot of sense. I know the buffalo bella is the dish that they push the hardest, but for my money the Cheesesteak is the way to go. And pro-tip: Get the sweet potato fries.
Refine this for me please: This place offers good quality food at affordable prices, and the staff is friendly and helpful. While it may not be the best option for dining in, their fast food approach to vegan food is understandable. The buffalo bella is highly recommended, but personally, I believe the Cheesesteak is worth trying. As a pro-tip, don't miss out on their delicious sweet potato fries.

input: The ramen is okay, nothing spectacular. Service is okay. Good place for a quick stop but wouldn't go if there were other choices. Been here twice, will continue to go.
Refine this for me please: The ramen is decent, but not outstanding. The service is average. It's a convenient spot for a quick stop, but if there are other options available, I wouldn't choose to go here. However, I have visited this place twice before and will likely continue to do so.

input: A menu that satisfies everyone's cravings! Clean, trendy, and delicious! I definitely recommend going early (before 9 am) as the wait tends to get longer after 9 am! But honestly, it is soooo worth the wait. You will leave there feeling so incredible satisfied!
Refine this for me please: Experience the ultimate menu that caters to all taste buds! This clean, trendy, and mouthwatering dining option is a must-visit. To avoid longer wait times, we highly recommend arriving before 9 am. Take my word for it, the wait is absolutely worth it! Indulge in the delectable dishes that will leave you feeling incredibly satisfied.

input: Had the brisket sandwich with two sides and a drink for 9.99 - Great barbecue at an affordable price. Wonderful side such as potato casserole cream spinach baked beans green beans
Refine this for me please: I enjoyed a delicious brisket sandwich with two sides and a drink for only $9.99. The barbecue was fantastic, providing both great taste and affordability. The sides were amazing, including options like potato casserole, creamed spinach, baked beans, and green beans.

input: The food and service was amazing! I only wish they had any vegetarian/vegan options. Can't wait to come back!
Refine this for me please: The food and service were exceptional! My only suggestion would be for them to offer more vegetarian/vegan choices. Nevertheless, I am eagerly looking forward to returning!

input: Great food. Terrible customer service. I've been three times and I've had two different older waitresses. Not pleasant to deal with whatsoever. The owner on the other hand is lovely.
Refine this for me please: The food here is outstanding, but unfortunately, the customer service leaves much to be desired. Over my three visits, I encountered two older waitresses who were quite unpleasant to interact with. However, in sharp contrast, the owner of the establishment is incredibly friendly and accommodating.

input: I first heard about this place on the plane ride over from a Franklin local.  He recommended that we brave the line and try one of Nashvilles best breakfast spots.  HE WAS RIGHT.  Holly cow this place kicked butt and we didn't even have to wait in line!! We were lucky to miss the rush said our waitress.   I had this super savory corn pancake with bacon, salsa, and sour cream. So good. This place will always be a stop when I get back to the south~~~
Refine this for me please: I was initially introduced to this incredible place by a local from Franklin during my plane journey. He strongly advised that we endure the queue and experience one of the finest breakfast spots in Nashville. And boy, was he absolutely correct! This place totally blew us away, and the best part was that we didn't have to wait in line at all. Our waitress informed us that we were fortunate to have avoided the bustling period. Personally, I opted for their delectable corn pancake topped with crispy bacon, flavorful salsa, and creamy sour cream. It was an absolute delight. Without a doubt, this establishment will always be on my must-visit list whenever I return to the southern region.

input: OMG!!! I can't believe this kind of service exists!  My husband called to make an appointment for full detailing for next Sat with Michael, he called again to confirm on Fri before we head there since it's a distance from our home.  Michael said he didn't know we wanted to do full detailing thou we specifically mentioned that.  He advised us to come the following sat instead.  We agreed and we reached there at 8am on the following week.  Guess what?  Nobody is at the workshop, it's closed!  We called him and he said he is busy and will call back.. We waited for half an hour in our car and there is still no call from him.  We headed for our breakfast and came back again at 9:30am hoping to give him another chance.  Here comes Alex, his partner opening the shop at 9:30am!  1.5 hours away from our appt time and still no sight of Michael.  Alex tried calling Michael and couldn't get hold of him.  We gave up!!! What a horrendous experience!
Refine this for me please:
I am extremely disappointed and frustrated with the service we received. My husband initially called to schedule a full detailing appointment with Michael for next Saturday. He even called on Friday to confirm the appointment before traveling a long distance to the workshop. Surprisingly, Michael claimed he was unaware that we wanted a full detailing, despite us specifically mentioning it. He suggested rescheduling for the following Saturday, which we agreed to. 

To our dismay, when we arrived at 8am the next week, the workshop was closed and there was no sign of anyone. We called Michael, but he said he was busy and would call us back. After waiting in our car for half an hour, we still hadn't received a call from him. Frustrated, we decided to grab breakfast and returned at 9:30am, giving him another chance. However, it was Alex, Michael's partner, who finally arrived and opened the shop at that time, 1.5 hours after our scheduled appointment. Alex tried calling Michael but couldn't reach him. At this point, we had lost all faith in the service and decided to give up. This entire experience has been absolutely horrendous.

input: I had numerous things happen during my move and required additional services from this office. The guys in this office are top notch and are very trustworthy. I'd say more about how they took great care of me, but they may have gone above and beyond what they should have and afraid to say too much. I would recommend this office to my mother!
Refine this for me please: During my move, I encountered various unexpected circumstances that necessitated additional assistance from this office. The individuals working in this establishment possess exceptional skills and exhibit a high level of trustworthiness. While I would love to elaborate on how they went above and beyond to provide outstanding care, I am slightly apprehensive about praising them excessively. Nevertheless, I wholeheartedly endorse this office and would confidently recommend their services even to my own mother.

input: We stayed at The Saint last year for a girl's trip. The lobby is lovely, they have a cool bar and restaurant that you can't help but to "ohh and ahh" over when you walk in.  All the things I'm accustomed too when I stay at a hotel anywhere...ambiance, a little sexy but not overkill! Everyone is so friendly, etc.  I'm thinking "oh shhhh this is going to be a great weekend!"  I checked in a few hours before my girl arrived because I had a ton of work i needed to do. So I set up my laptop ordered some room service and worked for about 4 hours straight. Left out to buy a bottle and get a mani/pedi.  My girl arrives...its about to be some trouble in NOLA... the two of us and no supervision...we pop out for dinner, come back in giggling as usual and we see it...a HUGH flying roach.  I'm freaked out.  I literally walk right out of the room down to the front desk.  I CANNOT!!!! They tell me they're sending a maintenance worker to handle it.  NOT GOOD ENOUGH! If there's one that's bold enough to show itself, he has other cohorts that prefer to live behind the scenes. They give us another room but tell me they can't do more until 8am.  No the room the move us too also has small spiders and other dead small bugs in the corners of the window. The TV doesn't work and one of the lamps doesn't have bulbs in it! COME ON!  At this point its about 3am and I know I'm not staying here past 8:15am. I dont want to sit my purse let alone my luggage in this hotel! I go online to my normal go to hotel, The W and book us there for the rest of the trip! 8am comes and goes no manager comes to our room. I go down and demand to see someone immediately.  This younger gentlemen comes out and apologizes.  I thank him for his apology and politely request ALL of my money back immediately.   He obliged and asked if  I would consider coming back after changes have been made! Bless his heart. NO dear!
Refine this for me please:
Last year, we stayed at The Saint for a girl's trip. The lobby is beautiful, and they have an impressive bar and restaurant that immediately catch your attention upon arrival. It had all the elements I look for in a hotel - a great ambiance, a touch of sensuality without being excessive, and the staff were all very friendly. I couldn't help but think that this was going to be a fantastic weekend. 

Since I had some work to finish, I arrived a few hours before my friend. I settled into the room, ordered room service, and worked uninterrupted for about four hours. Afterward, I left to buy a bottle and have a mani/pedi done. When my friend arrived, things took a turn. The two of us together in NOLA could only mean mischief. We went out for dinner and returned to the room, giggling as always, and then we saw it - a huge flying roach. I was completely freaked out and immediately walked out of the room and headed straight to the front desk. I couldn't handle it! The staff assured me they would send a maintenance worker to resolve the issue, but that wasn't good enough for me. If one roach was bold enough to appear, there were surely others hiding in the shadows. They provided us with another room but informed me that they couldn't do much more until 8 am. To my dismay, the second room also had small spiders and other dead bugs in the corners of the window. Additionally, the TV didn't work, and one of the lamps was missing bulbs. Really, it was just too much! 

At this point, it was around 3 am, and I knew I couldn't spend another minute in this hotel past 8:15 am. I didn't even feel comfortable leaving my purse, let alone my luggage, in that room. I quickly went online and booked us a room at my usual go-to hotel, The W, for the remainder of our trip. The clock struck 8 am, and still, no manager had come to our room. I marched down to the front desk and demanded to see someone immediately. A young gentleman came out and apologized. I graciously accepted his apology but insisted on a full refund without delay. He complied and even asked if we would consider returning once improvements had been made. Bless his heart, but my answer was a resounding no.

Strike one - we shared an artichoke to start - and clearly it had been prepared beforehand (eg, cold on the inside - but the flesh was cooked through)  Strike two - my wife had a Greek salad - and it clearly all came from a bag and was extremely overdressed with tasteless dressing.  Strike three - I had grilled yellowtail which was basically execrable - could not even finish it (overcooked and an inferior-frozen piece of fish - unacceptable for SB). 

In short - great setting, good service - but with such horrible food - not worth the visit. This place really needs to up the quality of food - or it's going to end up just another lower State dive for the tourists.
Refine this for me please:
I am extremely disappointed on various levels. I have been a regular customer here for years, but the quality of the food has drastically declined. Firstly, we ordered a shared artichoke as an appetizer which clearly was prepared beforehand, resulting in a cold interior and overcooked flesh. Secondly, my wife's Greek salad appeared to be store-bought and was excessively dressed with a tasteless dressing. Thirdly, my grilled yellowtail was simply awful - it was overcooked and clearly a low-quality frozen piece of fish. This kind of quality is unacceptable for a restaurant in Santa Barbara.

Despite the pleasant atmosphere and good service, the subpar food makes it hard to justify a visit to this place. If they don't improve the quality of their food, it will become just another tourist trap in the lower State area.

input:
Milktooth is the place to go if you want a good breakfast cocktail and a twist on traditional brunch. At first glance of the menu, you may think you've never heard of any of these foods for breakfast, and you may be right. I guarantee no matter what you order, you're going to enjoy it. 

Milktooth is one of the most popular brunch places in Indy, which means you will typically have a wait. Trust me, it's worth the usual 30 minute wait (on weekends). To make it go by a little faster, they've got a walk up bar for their coffee drinks and pastries. Snack on one of those to give you a preview of the amazing meal you're about to have.

Their menu changes from time to time but they have a few things that stay one the menu but change ingredients. I love all of their variations on a Dutch pancake, and their raclette grilled cheese is to die for.  If you're making this a boozy breakfast, don't pass up on the michelada. And sit outside if it's warm enough!
Refine this for me please:
If you're looking for a breakfast cocktail with a unique twist on traditional brunch, Milktooth is the place to be. Their menu may introduce unfamiliar breakfast items, but I assure you that every dish is a delight. 

As one of Indy's most popular brunch spots, a wait of around 30 minutes is common (especially on weekends). Luckily, they have a walk-up bar where you can enjoy their delicious coffee drinks and pastries while waiting. These tasty treats will give you a glimpse of the incredible meal that awaits you.

While Milktooth's menu changes periodically, they have a few signature items that remain, though with different ingredients. Personally, I recommend trying their various Dutch pancake renditions or indulging in their delectable raclette grilled cheese. For those wanting to enjoy a boozy breakfast, the michelada is not to be missed. And if the weather permits, sitting outside adds an extra touch to your experience.
