input:
Oh Chickie's and Pete's, you are the perfect place to watch some sports and indulge. 

No doubt this is not the best food I've ever had but, if you can get a seat, grab some beer with mussels red and crab fries, there's no way not to thoroughly enjoy this place during a game or any time you're down by the stadiums. 

My favs are the crab fries, mussels red (white is overloaded with garlic that I can't always take it), the spicy pull and peel shrimp, steamers, and if the mood is right the blue crabs (it's a lot of work but tasty). This place also makes getting down and dirty with your food easy. There are sinks all over so you can rinse the mess off your hands once you're done....good touch.

To sum it up, Chickie's and Pete's is a Philadelphia institution and always a good time. I strongly suggest going at least once to enjoy the experience. 

Please note: Make sure to remember two things before coming during major sporting events. 1. You'll never get a table and 2. You'll deal with a ton of drunk people. I've absolutely been one of these people before and we can get annoying unless you're in the right frame of mind. :)
Refine this for me please:
Oh Chickie's and Pete's, you are the ultimate destination for sports enthusiasts and indulgent food lovers. Although the cuisine may not be the absolute best, the atmosphere and offerings make it impossible not to have a fantastic time, especially during a game or whenever you find yourself near the stadiums.

My personal favorites include the delectable crab fries, mouthwatering mussels red (avoiding the overly garlicky white version), the spicy pull and peel shrimp, steamed clams, and, if you're up for the challenge, the flavorful blue crabs (though they require some effort to crack open). Additionally, Chickie's and Pete's excels in providing a hands-on dining experience, conveniently offering sinks throughout the restaurant to rinse off any mess once you've finished.

In essence, Chickie's and Pete's is not just a dining establishment, but a beloved Philadelphia institution that guarantees a fantastic time. I highly recommend visiting at least once to fully immerse yourself in this extraordinary experience.

However, it is important to keep two things in mind when visiting during major sporting events. Firstly, securing a table can be an arduous task, so be prepared. Secondly, the presence of inebriated patrons may be overwhelming at times. I must admit, I've been one of those individuals before, and unless you're in the right mindset, it can be a little bothersome. But do not let this deter you, as the overall experience is well worth it.

input: Truly, I cannot say enough good things about this tiny, authentic, perfectly delicious eatery! input:
I'm giving this joint 4 stars because they have earned it, but they are definitely 5 star material, if they work out a few kinks. Granted, they just opened, so some of the errors I've experienced (I work in the area, so I've been there several times) will probably get worked out and they are more than willing to make corrections and accommodations when they mess up. 

But over all, the food is REALLY good. Unlike my fellow Yelp-ers, I would say that ther pizza is not their strong suit - its kinds greasy and not sure if they use 100% mozzarella - tastes like its cut with something cheaper. However, so far I've had:  

The Quaker (Chicken version) - Delicious. They make their chicken steaks with the chunky chicken, which I like much more than the shredded version. They could season the chicken more, but the cheese was melted perfectly and the veggies were fresh. 

The fries - crisp and flavorful. I didn't even need ketchup, and I always eat ketchup on my fries

The onion rings - a little greasy, but very tasty and crisp. The onions stayed in the breading and didn't slide out when you bit them (which I hate). 

Spanakopita - mine was a little over cooked, but the flavors were really good

Baklava - VERY GOOD! 

Signature Salad - The veggies they use are very fresh which will make or break a salad. Their balsamic is great too!

The (turkey) Greek Burger - one of the best turkey burgers I've ever had! The patty was moist and flavorful all on its own, but then they top it with what must be homemade tzatziki. I could eat a bowl of that stuff! My burger had romaine instead of the advertised arugula, but it was very fresh, so I didn't mind as much. I also asked for feta, which I didn't get, but that sauce made me forget all about it. 

Overall, this place is great! Provided they don't stray from the high quality standard they are setting, I will keep going back.
Refine this for me please:
I am rating this joint with 4 stars because they have earned it, but I believe they have the potential to be 5-star material if they work out a few flaws. Considering that they have just opened, it is expected that they have some errors, as I have experienced during my several visits (I work in the area). However, they are willing to make corrections and accommodations when they make mistakes.

Overall, the food is really good. Unlike other Yelp reviewers, I would say that their pizza is not their strong point. It tends to be greasy, and I suspect they do not use 100% mozzarella as it tastes like it may be mixed with a cheaper cheese. However, I have enjoyed the following dishes so far:

- The Quaker (Chicken version) - It is delicious. They use chunky chicken, which I prefer over the shredded version. The chicken could use more seasoning, but the cheese is perfectly melted, and the vegetables are fresh.

- The fries - They are crisp and flavorful. Surprisingly, they did not even need ketchup, and I always eat ketchup with my fries.

- The onion rings - They are slightly greasy, but very tasty and crispy. The onions stay in the breading and do not slide out when you take a bite, which I appreciate.

- Spanakopita - Mine was slightly overcooked, but the flavors were really good.

- Baklava - It is very good!

- Signature Salad - The vegetables they use are very fresh, which is crucial for a good salad. Their balsamic dressing is also great!

- The (turkey) Greek Burger - It is one of the best turkey burgers I have ever had! The patty is moist and flavorful on its own, and they top it with what I believe is homemade tzatziki. I could eat a bowl of that sauce! My burger had romaine instead of the advertised arugula, but the romaine was very fresh, so I did not mind as much. I also asked for feta, which I did not receive, but the sauce made me forget all about it.

Overall, this place is great! As long as they maintain the high-quality standard they are setting, I will continue going back.

input:
Planet fitness gets four stars just because it is open 24 hours. If you are looking at cheapest it's cheapest best bang for your buck . Not much motivation since bodybuilders don't go there much mostly big women . No pun intended . No discrimination I myself used to be big, although I changed that . 
Tanning bed and massage chairs and a sculpt machine and everything. Else for 20.00 a month . 9.99 - the massage and stuff and can't bring friends . All the employees are polite and helpful .
Refine this for me please: Planet Fitness is a convenient option for those seeking a 24-hour gym, earning a four-star rating. It offers great value for the price, making it the most affordable and cost-effective choice. However, it may lack motivation for bodybuilders as it primarily attracts larger women. This is not meant to be discriminatory, as I personally have experienced a positive transformation. The facility provides additional amenities such as tanning beds, massage chairs, and a sculpt machine, all included in the $20 monthly fee. The basic membership at $9.99 does not include access to the massage services and prohibits bringing friends along. The staff at Planet Fitness are friendly and helpful, demonstrating good customer service.

input:
Very disappointed. We went to eat  at 2:15 on Saturday and were told the kitchen closed at 2. Their website says: Sat & Sun all day. Their website claims that they are open until 5.
I'm always a bit suspect of places that can't manage simple details like their hours on their website. It makes me wonder about the awareness to quality and other "small" items.
Refine this for me please: I was extremely disappointed when we arrived to eat at 2:15 on Saturday, only to be informed that the kitchen had closed at 2. This was highly contradictory to their website's claim of being open all day on Saturdays and Sundays until 5. Personally, I tend to question establishments that cannot handle basic details like updating their hours on their website. It leaves me doubting their attention to quality and other seemingly "insignificant" matters.

input: These guys do good work, on time, and warranty their work.  I would highly recommend them!
Refine this for me please: I highly recommend these guys as they consistently deliver excellent work, always meet deadlines, and provide warranties for their services.

input: Eat here at least 2 times a week. Servers are always friendly and the food is amazing. I never leave disappointed & always leave with a full stomach
Refine this for me please: We highly recommend dining at this establishment at least twice a week. The servers consistently provide exceptional and friendly service, while the food itself is truly remarkable. It is rare to have a meal here without feeling thoroughly satisfied, both in terms of quality and portion size.

input:
A truly delightful find! This is the transformed Carrow's Restaurant on Plumb and Kietzke that was saved by the wrecking ball by its beautiful redwood beams and fascia. The food was fantastic. My wife had the tri-tip salad -- greens on one side of the plate with a balsamic vinagrette balanced by four good-sized slices of medium-rare tri-tip and potato "croutons" --
little heavenly bits of crunchy potatoes. I had the tri/tip/chicken combo, selecting the fresh corn salad and potato salad as my two sides. It was so good that we ordered dessert as well (not something I do regularly). The offering was lemon meringue, mudd pie, apple pie, and ice cream. We shared the first -- again delicious, with real, perfectly set and browned meringue. The prices were very reasonable for the quality of food and the experience. We've already recommended to family and friends locally, and expect to return soon. Well done!
Refine this for me please: I had a wonderful experience at Carrow's Restaurant on Plumb and Kietzke. The restaurant was beautifully preserved with its redwood beams and fascia, making it a truly delightful find. The food surpassed my expectations. My wife tried the tri-tip salad, which had a perfect balance of greens and balsamic vinaigrette. The plate also included four generous slices of medium-rare tri-tip and potato "croutons" that were heavenly bites of crunchy goodness. I opted for the tri-tip and chicken combo, and chose fresh corn salad and potato salad as my sides. It was so delicious that we couldn't resist trying their desserts, which included options like lemon meringue, mud pie, apple pie, and ice cream. We decided to share the lemon meringue, and it was absolutely delicious. The meringue was perfectly set and beautifully browned. Considering the quality of the food and the overall experience, the prices were very reasonable. We were so impressed that we've already recommended Carrow's to our family and friends in the area, and we can't wait to go back ourselves. Bravo to Carrow's for a job well done!

input:
Rebecca didn't Doula my birth.  BUT, she was our nanny to our first born daughter.  Over the months of her being in my home, I realized that I looked forward to talking to her before & after work.  I was big & pregnant with Baby #2, and her information & suggestions hit home with this expectant Momma!  She was always easy to talk with, yet honest and extremely truthful!  (A trait I LOVE!!!).  She loves the special role she plays as Doula to laboring woman!!  She finds beauty and strength in that magical time.
Bec would be a great addition to your support team!!!
Refine this for me please: Rebecca may not have been my birth Doula, but she was an amazing nanny to our first-born daughter. As she spent more time in my home, I realized how much I enjoyed our conversations before and after work. Being heavily pregnant with our second baby, her advice and suggestions resonated deeply with me as an expectant mother. I appreciated her honesty and straightforwardness, which is a quality I truly admire. It is evident that she cherishes her role as a Doula for laboring women and finds beauty and strength in that transformative period. I believe Rebecca would be an incredible asset to your support team.

input: Recently had my car tinted by Orange Tint and Tune and had fantastic service.  They offer a car pick up service if you live within 4 miles of their shop which is extremely convenient.  Carlos was my technician and went over all the tint options with me and even adjusted the grade of the tint after I expressed the look that I was trying to achieve.  That's the kind of customer care that deserves 5 stars.  In addition, the receptionist was very pleasant and the owner Dustin even followed up to see how my service was.
Refine this for me please:
I recently had my car tinted by Orange Tint and Tune, and I must say, the service was truly fantastic. One of the most convenient aspects of their service is the car pick-up option for customers living within 4 miles of their shop. It made the whole process much more hassle-free.

My technician, Carlos, was exceptional. He took the time to go over all the available tint options with me and listened attentively when I explained the desired look I wanted to achieve. He even adjusted the grade of the tint accordingly, ensuring I was fully satisfied with the result. This level of customer care truly deserves 5 stars.

I was also impressed by the friendly and pleasant receptionist. It's always a pleasure to encounter such welcoming staff members. Moreover, even the owner, Dustin, took the time to follow up and inquire about my satisfaction with the service provided. This attention to detail and customer satisfaction further highlights the exceptional service at Orange Tint and Tune.

input: Stayed here three nights on business.  The property is located very close to the airport but you really don't hear it.  The rooms are standard TownePlace Suite rooms with a refrigerator, stove, etc..  The area in which the hotel is located is quiet with a combination of other hotels and office buildings.  It's about a 20 minute drive to the downtown or university area.  About 5-10 minutes from Pima Air Museum.  There are not too many restaurants close by but there are some fast food options and a sandwich place called Baggins that was really good and within walking distance.  The staff of the hotel was really friendly and helpful.  The breakfast is standard continental with a couple of hot options. They also have a reception on weekday evenings.  My only complaint is that the food and drink go quickly so get there early.  You could use this as a dinner if you wanted.  I got there about 45 minutes after it started and although there was food left there were very few soft drinks left (no diet).  They could improve by keeping the area stocked throughout the period.  Anyway, the rooms are nice, beds are comfortable and area is safe.
Refine this for me please:
I stayed at this hotel for three nights on a business trip and had a pleasant experience. Despite its close proximity to the airport, the noise level was surprisingly low. The rooms themselves were your standard TownePlace Suite rooms, equipped with a refrigerator, stove, and other necessary amenities.

The hotel is located in a tranquil area, which is a combination of other hotels and office buildings. Although it's about a 20-minute drive from the downtown or university area, it is conveniently only 5-10 minutes away from the Pima Air Museum. While there may not be many restaurant options nearby, there are several fast food choices and a fantastic sandwich place called Baggins within convenient walking distance.

I found the hotel staff to be exceptionally friendly and helpful. The breakfast provided was your typical continental spread, with a couple of hot options available. Additionally, the hotel holds a reception on weekday evenings, which could even serve as a dinner option. However, I was a bit disappointed that the food and drink at the reception ran out quickly, so arriving early is advisable. When I arrived 45 minutes after the start, there was still some food left but very few soft drinks, and no diet options were available. It would be beneficial for the hotel to ensure that the area is consistently stocked throughout the entire duration of the reception.

Overall, the rooms were comfortable, the beds were cozy, and I felt safe in the area.

input:
We got diverted to Tampa and decided to make the drive to Orlando but first we needed somewhere to eat. Wanting to avoid chain restaurants, yelp steered us towards this little local gem!

The ladies had the 7 oz. Tampa strip and the gents both had a 14 oz. ribeye. They grill their steaks over oak and citrus Wood and the smoky flavor is to die for! We are big fans of our smoker back home and cook our steaks this way as well, it's rare to find steak cooked over woodsmoke in most places and this was worth the side trip!  Sides were veggies and sweet potatoes. The wines on offer were so reasonably priced- most under $20 a bottle but a decent selection. They just don't mark them up 5x like most places! 

Our waitress Lisa also made great recommendations and her service was welcoming, friendly, and excellent. We are so glad we went local instead of to a chain. Bookmarking this place for a return trip next time I am in Tampa for sure!
Refine this for me please:
We were originally rerouted to Tampa but decided to drive to Orlando instead. However, before we embarked on our journey, we needed to find a place to eat. Instead of opting for generic chain restaurants, we turned to Yelp for recommendations and stumbled upon a hidden gem.

Our group consisted of ladies who ordered the 7 oz. Tampa strip and gentlemen who both indulged in the 14 oz. ribeye. These succulent steaks were expertly prepared over oak and citrus wood, resulting in a delightful smoky flavor. As avid fans of woodsmoked cooking ourselves, it was a rare treat to find such perfectly grilled steaks outside of our own kitchen. Alongside the mouthwatering main dishes, we savored the delectable sides of veggies and sweet potatoes. 

To our surprise, the selection of wines offered at this local establishment was not only reasonably priced but also impressive. Most bottles were priced under $20, which was a pleasant deviation from the typical 5x markups found elsewhere. The combination of delicious food and affordable beverages made for an even more enjoyable dining experience.

What truly elevated our visit was the exceptional service provided by our waitress, Lisa. She not only provided us with excellent recommendations but also exhibited a warm and friendly demeanor throughout the evening. Choosing to support a local business instead of resorting to a chain restaurant truly paid off, and we are already planning to return to this charming location on our next visit to Tampa.

input: The owner of this location (and two others including Southampton) reached out to me after my previous review. We ended up talking for half an hour and I was very impressed with his approach to business... he's definitely the type of person I want to do business with. I returned to Saladworks on two separate occasions and the service had vastly improved. The new summer salads are wonderful!
Refine this for me please: The owner of this establishment, along with two other locations including Southampton, personally contacted me in response to my previous review. We engaged in a captivating conversation for about thirty minutes, during which I was greatly impressed with his exceptional business expertise and approach. As a result, I am highly inclined to engage in business with him. I recently revisited Saladworks on two different occasions and noticed a remarkable improvement in their service. Moreover, their new selection of summer salads is absolutely delightful!

input: By far the best deli I have ever been to in the US. YEP, the US. Lots of crazy choices and oh it is hard to pick!! The Muffalata is so big 4 people can share. It is so tasty and amazing! Go on Saturday or Thursday night when they have live music! The special is always a good pick and don't worry there are plenty of sides to choose from. Great Chili, potato salad and of course chips. GO NOW...
Refine this for me please: This deli is undoubtedly the best I have ever visited in the entire United States. The plethora of unique options makes it a baffling task to choose just one. Notably, the Muffalata sandwich is exceptionally massive, serving up to four individuals and leaving them completely satisfied with its deliciousness. For an even more delightful experience, I recommend attending on Saturday or Thursday nights when live music fills the air. The daily special never disappoints, and rest assured, there is an abundance of delectable side dishes including outstanding chili, delectable potato salad, and, of course, a variety of chips. Don't waste another moment, head over there now and indulge in their incredible offerings.

input:
My dad and I are on a cross country trip and one of our first stops was Saguaro National Park. 
We did a quick tour with Park Ranger Carolyn and loved it. She was incredibly enthusiastic and passionate about her studies on the saguaro and she was very knowledgeable. Definitely recommend both the tour and Carolyn.
Refine this for me please: During our cross-country trip, my dad and I had the opportunity to visit Saguaro National Park as one of our first stops. And let me tell you, it was an exceptional experience. Our exploration of the park began with a tour guided by the ever-enthusiastic and remarkable Park Ranger Carolyn. We were instantly captivated by her boundless passion for studying the saguaro, as well as her extensive knowledge in the subject. Not only did she provide us with fascinating information about the area, but she also infused the tour with her infectious energy, making every moment truly enjoyable. I wholeheartedly recommend both the tour and the remarkable Carolyn to anyone seeking a memorable adventure in Saguaro National Park.

input: Came here after my husband bought home their lemon pepper wings. They have plenty of flavors. Ranging from ones you've heard of (lemon pepper, mild) to New Orleans flavors (yaka mein, noonie bird). They also have their drinks. The watermelon is to die for. I don't know what they put in it but lord help them. The location isn't the best but they're trying to put something back in the community. It's in the same section with the daiquiri shop so it's really not that bad during the day. I probably wouldn't come at night by myself. Definitely give this place a try. Hey you might even see Skip.
Refine this for me please:
After my husband brought home their mouthwatering lemon pepper wings, I found myself drawn to this place. The array of flavors they offer is truly impressive, ranging from familiar ones like lemon pepper and mild, to more unique offerings like yaka mein and noonie bird, inspired by the vibrant tastes of New Orleans. And let's not forget to mention their delightful drinks; their watermelon concoction is simply irresistible - I can't quite figure out their secret ingredient, but it's absolutely heavenly. 

Admittedly, the location isn't the most ideal, but I appreciate their efforts to give something back to the community. Being situated in the same area as the daiquiri shop, it's really not that sketchy during the day. However, I would exercise caution about visiting at night alone. Nevertheless, I highly recommend giving this place a shot; who knows, you might even bump into Skip while you're there!

input:
Back to Tom Jones and time to update my review. I didn't see that odd ATM type machine that only lets you withdraw money to apply to your check. It's no longer there-used to be next to restrooms. There is still a payphone back there which I love. There are now ATM's at front entrance.
  The blue ribbon is now $3.79, but still a bargain since it includes everything: pancakes, 2 eggs, toast, sausage, bacon,juice & coffee. I ate here with my kids. My daughter's choice. Says she "loves Tom Jones". Our meals included blue ribbons, french toast, chicken, club sandwich & baked potato . Everyone gets what they like. 
   I don't smell stale smoke and would not call it dirty.  I like the "loud" orange booths. I feel like I went back in time with these and the payphone. Service is always fast and I always seem to get a different waitress. Don't know where they find these young ladies but they're good. I've seen different managers there and they are all quick and on top of things-which makes a good manager.
   Since it's my daughter's fave I'm bumping it up from 4 to 5 stars.
Refine this for me please:
I revisited Tom Jones recently and wanted to update my review. I noticed that the odd ATM-type machine, which only allowed withdrawals to be applied to checks, is no longer there. It used to be located next to the restrooms. However, there is still a payphone at the back, which I personally love. Additionally, there are now ATMs available at the front entrance.

The price for the blue ribbon meal has increased to $3.79, but it is still a great deal considering it includes pancakes, 2 eggs, toast, sausage, bacon, juice, and coffee. During my visit, I dined with my kids, and it was my daughter's choice to eat at Tom Jones because she "loves it." We ordered a variety of meals, including blue ribbons, french toast, chicken, club sandwiches, and baked potatoes. Everyone got exactly what they wanted.

I didn't notice any smells of stale smoke during my visit, and I wouldn't consider the place dirty. Personally, I enjoy the nostalgic feeling of the old-fashioned, "loud" orange booths and the presence of the payphone. The service was consistently fast, and I had a different waitress each time, but they were all competent. It's interesting to see different managers at Tom Jones, but they all seem to be efficient and on top of things, which is a sign of good management.

Since my daughter loves Tom Jones so much, I have decided to give it a higher rating, bumping it up from 4 to 5 stars.

input: I am an amateur athlete. I first met Dr. Ferrel when I was playing softball. He was watching my game when I was severely injured.  He treated me on the field by relocating my ankle and then told me to come to his office for treatment. I told him I could not afford that as a single mom on a teacher's salary. Instead, I saw a physician. He said it would be months before I would play again. Depressed and without much hope, I reached out to Dr. Ferrel again. He did treat me as he promised. Not only did he treat me, he healed me within weeks instead of months. Over the years Dr. Ferrel has worked on me with amazing results each time. He will always be my hero...
Refine this for me please:
I am an amateur athlete who had the fortunate opportunity to meet Dr. Ferrel during a softball game where I sustained a severe injury. Observing the incident, Dr. Ferrel promptly provided on-field treatment by skillfully relocating my ankle. Recognizing the seriousness of the injury, he advised me to visit his office for further treatment. However, as a single mother relying on a teacher's salary, I expressed my financial constraints and decided to seek medical assistance elsewhere.

Following the advice of another physician, I began a long and disheartening journey towards recovery, being informed that it would take several months before I could resume playing. Faced with such a discouraging prognosis, I found myself reaching out to Dr. Ferrel once again, despite my initial concerns. Thankfully, he stayed true to his word and provided the treatment he had promised.

To my astonishment and delight, Dr. Ferrel not only treated me but managed to expedite my healing process, enabling me to recover within weeks rather than months. This experience marked the beginning of a longstanding relationship with Dr. Ferrel, who has consistently produced remarkable results in every subsequent encounter. Without a doubt, he has become my ultimate hero, forever admired and appreciated for his exceptional skills and unwavering commitment to my well-being.

input: Always fun to go to their shows.  Entertaining and relaxed atmosphere. For a good time and good food at a fair price this is the place to go.
Refine this for me please: Their shows are consistently enjoyable, with an enticing and laid-back atmosphere. Whether you're craving a delightful experience or a scrumptious meal at an affordable price, this is undoubtedly the ideal destination.

input:
Love in n out. There's just a mood for in n out that you have to fulfill sometimes.

What can I say. 4 patties animal style bruh
Refine this for me please: I have an undeniable love for In-N-Out. There are moments when you simply crave the unique atmosphere and taste it offers. What can I say? Occasionally, I find myself needing to indulge in four juicy patties, animal style.

input: Cindy is the best! Great food and service. Food is authentic and so is the staff. Everything is made fresh and you can taste the difference from other Mexican restaurants at first bite. I would recommend to anyone that enjoys Mexican cuisine.
Refine this for me please: Cindy is absolutely the best! The food and service at her restaurant are outstanding. Not only is the food delicious, but it is also authentic, just like the staff. Every dish is made fresh, and you can immediately taste the difference between Cindy's restaurant and other Mexican establishments. I highly recommend it to anyone who appreciates Mexican cuisine.

input:
I've been wanting to try Trust Me BBQ for over a year now.  I stopped in there about 3 months ago and waited in line for 10 minutes with no service and left.  After reading reviews, I figured I'd give it a chance again just to see what all the fuss is about.  The food was 50/50 but the service was horrible so I'll likely never return.  The gentleman behind the counter didn't speak, smile or engage with us at all, I felt like I was at a vending machine.  Once we finally ordered, he didn't even listen to the order and put the wrong sides in our meals, we had to correct him while he was serving.  All in all, I will just stick with Down to the Bone BBQ

Pros:  BBQ Sauce is delicious, macaroni salad was different and interesting, "pulled" pork was moist.

Cons:  Chicken was more dry than a sheet of paper, inedible even with the BBQ Sauce.  Mac & Cheese was served from a pan that has probably been on the steam table for 2-3 days.  Collard Greens were very mildly flavored.
Refine this for me please:
I've been eagerly anticipating trying Trust Me BBQ for over a year now. However, my previous visit about 3 months ago left me disappointed. Despite waiting in line for 10 minutes, I received no service and decided to leave. Nevertheless, I recently decided to give it another chance due to positive reviews and to see what all the fuss is about. Unfortunately, my experience was still subpar. While the food was a mixed bag, the service was absolutely terrible, which has dissuaded me from ever returning.

The gentleman behind the counter showed no interest in engaging with us, making the whole experience feel impersonal and robotic. His lack of communication made me feel like I was interacting with a vending machine rather than a human being. Moreover, he even got our order wrong, necessitating corrections while he was serving us.

Despite some positive aspects, such as the delectable BBQ sauce, an intriguingly different macaroni salad, and moist pulled pork, the negatives heavily outweighed the positives. The chicken, in particular, was incredibly dry, even when paired with the BBQ sauce, rendering it inedible. Additionally, the mac and cheese seemed to have been sitting in a pan on the steam table for an extended period, resulting in a stale taste. Lastly, the collard greens were disappointingly lacking in flavor.

Overall, my experience at Trust Me BBQ was underwhelming, and I have decided to stick with Down to the Bone BBQ instead.

input: Was in town for a week and came by this little hole in the wall.  The pa nang chicken was excellent.  I ordered one star spicy and it came quick.  Will definitely return.
Refine this for me please: I visited this small establishment in town for a week, stumbling upon a hidden gem. I had the pleasure of trying their delightful pa nang chicken, which surpassed my expectations. I specifically requested a one-star spicy level, and it was promptly served. Without a doubt, I plan on revisiting this place again in the future.

input: Cinco de mayo means margaritas and sangria and all things fried... this great place does a nice job with combining flavors of several different ethnicities and backgrounds and develops recipes that are unique.  Although not touted as a "Mexican" destination they know how to rock the rock salt and pour that tequila.  They also just opened a wine bar a couple doors down for overflow and specialty bottles.  A high five for the on the rocks margaritas and house made white or red sangria - definitely worth the trip!
Refine this for me please: Cinco de Mayo is synonymous with margaritas, sangria, and indulging in delicious fried treats. This fantastic establishment excels at combining flavors from various ethnicities and backgrounds, resulting in unique and tantalizing recipes. While not specifically marketed as a "Mexican" destination, they certainly know how to expertly blend rock salt and tequila. In addition, they have recently opened a wine bar a few doors down, catering to overflow and offering specialty bottles. The on the rocks margaritas and the house-made white or red sangria are truly outstanding, making a visit unquestionably worthwhile.

input:
This small little donut bakery is located in one of Hermitage's oldest shopping centers! 

I can imagine baking donuts is a hard job, let alone running the business...it's one of those jobs that starts in the wee hours of the morning so that the donuts are freshly made daily!

Yeu, the owner, serves not only your common popular donuts, but he also serves donuts with bacon on top, apple fritters, pigs in a blanket, breakfast pastries, and  kolaches....in addition to these yummy treats...he makes doughssants....they are what seems to be a scandalous marriage of a donut and a croissant...!!!!!!!! Need I say more? Yeah...you heard me. A doughssant! Worth the trip just to eat one of these! 

Prices are considerably cheap! The doughssants are only $1.99 each! The regular donuts are about $.60 each! 

These sweet donuts are my favorite treats to buy for my kid's school teachers...and they love them! 

Coffee also served here!
Refine this for me please:
Refined version: This charming donut bakery is nestled in one of the oldest shopping centers in Hermitage. The owners, Yeu, embarks on the challenging task of baking donuts and managing the business, beginning their day in the early hours to ensure the donuts are freshly made each day.

Yeu not only offers popular donut flavors but also unique creations like bacon-topped donuts, apple fritters, pigs in a blanket, breakfast pastries, and kolaches. However, the showstopper is undeniably their doughssants – a sinful combination of a croissant and a donut. Once you try a doughssant, you'll understand the hype surrounding these delicacies. Remarkably, these indulgences are extremely affordable, with each doughssant priced at just $1.99, and regular donuts costing around $0.60 each.

These delectable treats have become my go-to gift for my children's teachers who always appreciate the gesture. Don't forget to complement your donut experience with a cup of freshly brewed coffee, expertly served at this delightful bakery.

input: We have had a blast to each event we've been to.  We've been to concerts and basketball games and other were a lot of fun.  The food is really good, also.  A lot of local favorites are offered.
Refine this for me please: We have thoroughly enjoyed every event we've attended, from concerts to basketball games and more. The food offered has been exceptional, with a variety of delightful local favorites to choose from.

input: Excellent food. We tried three appetizers and five entries and all of them were a hit. This prices are reasonable and the service is good. I'd go back again and again.
Refine this for me please: The food is excellent - we had the pleasure of trying three appetizers and five entrees, all of which were exceptional. The prices are reasonable and the service provided is also commendable. I am highly inclined to revisit this place repeatedly.

input: The service here has gone down. We used to go here a lot but now we go to another one. The service was slow and forgotten about.
Refine this for me please: The service quality at this establishment has significantly declined over time. Despite being regular patrons in the past, we have now shifted our loyalty to another place. We experienced slow service and instances where our needs were often overlooked or forgotten.

input: Hands down the worst chicken and rice plate I've ever had. When I ordered I was told there was no sauce on the chicken (as I wanted, healthy). I ordered to go, by the time I reached the car the bag was full of oil spilling out of the container. There was easily 5-7 tablespoons of oil on the dish. Not what I was told and not what anyone would ever want to eat. Horrible.   Their slogan even has the word healthy in it. What a joke.
Refine this for me please: Without a doubt, this chicken and rice plate was the absolute worst I have ever encountered. Despite explicitly requesting no sauce on the chicken in an effort to maintain a healthy choice, my order was a complete disaster. When I picked up the food to-go, the bag was drenched in oil, which was overflowing from the container. The dish itself was swimming in at least 5-7 tablespoons of oil, far from what I was promised and certainly not something anyone would desire to consume. It was an incredibly disappointing experience, especially considering their slogan boasted about being healthy. It's nothing short of a mockery.

input: Great experience purchasing a washer and dryer.  I just bought a new home and needed all new appliances. Iam so glad I decided to go even though the reviews were not great which I don't understand since I had no issues whatsoever. There was an excellent selection, knowledgeable salespeople and timely delivery. The level of service we received was beyond expected! input: The food here is great. They're quick and the staff is so nice, seriously. I always feel welcome when I place my order here.

input: I finally got to try them. Wow..they did a great job with the remodle. I loved the mushroom cheese steak

input: The espresso here is excellent. My favorite place to come for an Americano. The staff is polite and friendly and vibes are mellow. It is important to know that there is no access to power outlets, but unlimited wifi access. The bathrooms and the rest of the establishment are always clean.
Refine this for me please: The espresso here is truly exceptional, making it my go-to spot for a delicious Americano. The staff is consistently polite and friendly, creating a welcoming atmosphere that exudes relaxed vibes. While it's worth noting that power outlets are not available, they do offer unlimited wifi access for your convenience. Additionally, you can always count on the cleanliness of the bathrooms and the rest of the establishment.

input:
Went here based on the high ratings and raves from people.  The entire experience was underwhelming from start to finish.  Their website which is fairly useless if you want to figure out the menu before going, you have to pick your location choice out of 3 locations and then drill down to the bottom to see the weak descriptions of their menu offering, no explanations and no price, just this

    Roast Beef
    Roast Beef Combo
    Roast Pork
    Roast Pork Combo
    Baked Ham
    Baked Ham Combo
    Roast Turkey
    Roast Turkey Combo
    Broccoli Rabe
    Broccoli Rabe Combo


No explanation of whats in a combo (its just where they add cheese by the way)

The table placecard (instead of menu) had a more detailed description than the website.  

When I walked in, its more bar than restaurant, no big deal, but there were tables.  Since I couldnt decide and the sandwiches werent too expensive at $6.85, I got the roast beef and roast port combos.

I got my two sandwiches fast enough, but the roast beef was cold and the roast pork was hot.  Not sure how a cook (for lack of a better word) could serve 2 things at the same time with such a temperature differential, one was obviously sitting for awhile.  I asked the waitress to reheat the roast beef while I finished the roast pork, and supposedly it was reheated, since it was warmer, but it was still cold-ish compared to my roast pork I had just finished.  The waitress did offer to replace it when she inquired, but I was in a hurry and didnt really care for a hot version of this sandwich.

The sandwiches were very skimpy on meat, but they "made up for it" by adding too much gravy to make it overly messy and the bread was disintegrating.  The menu place card mentions the "wet meat" option where you get less gravy, I strongly recommend you get it that style, especially if the gravy overpower the meat and structural integrity of the sandwich.
Refine this for me please:
I decided to visit this place based on the highly positive ratings and recommendations from others. However, my entire experience turned out to be disappointing from start to finish. Before going, I tried to check their menu on their website, but it was quite useless. I had to select one out of three locations and navigate to the bottom of the page to find weak descriptions of their menu items without any explanations or prices. Here's what they showed:

- Roast Beef
- Roast Beef Combo
- Roast Pork
- Roast Pork Combo
- Baked Ham
- Baked Ham Combo
- Roast Turkey
- Roast Turkey Combo
- Broccoli Rabe
- Broccoli Rabe Combo

They didn't even provide any information about what a combo includes (it turns out they simply add cheese). Surprisingly, the table place card had more detailed descriptions than the website.

When I entered, I realized the place looked more like a bar than a restaurant, which wasn't a big deal. However, there were tables available. Since I couldn't decide, and considering the sandwiches were reasonably priced at $6.85, I ended up ordering the roast beef and roast pork combos.

My two sandwiches were delivered relatively quickly, but there was a stark temperature difference between them. The roast beef was cold, while the roast pork was hot. I couldn't understand how the kitchen could serve two items with such a temperature disparity. It was obvious that one had been sitting for a while. I asked the waitress to reheat the roast beef while I finished the roast pork. Although it became slightly warmer after reheating, it was still colder compared to the roast pork that I had just finished. The waitress did offer to replace it when she asked about it, but I was in a hurry and didn't want a hot version of the same sandwich.

Furthermore, the sandwiches were disappointingly sparse with meat. To compensate for this, they drowned them in an excessive amount of gravy which made the sandwiches overly messy, and the bread started falling apart. Interestingly, the menu place card mentioned an option to have "less gravy" called the "wet meat" style. I strongly advise ordering it that way, particularly if you want to taste more of the meat and ensure the sandwich holds together structurally.

input: Picked up takeout from Village Whiskey (so I can't review the actual restaurant). The Whiskey Burger is pricy ($26) but is amazing if you're ok with a greasier burger. Super tender, the bacon is awesome and it's pretty big. If you can get past the price then highly recommend it. The Duck Fat fries are also rich and delicious.
Refine this for me please: I recently picked up takeout from Village Whiskey, so unfortunately I cannot provide a review of the actual restaurant experience. However, I must say that the Whiskey Burger, despite being a bit expensive at $26, is absolutely incredible if you don't mind indulging in a slightly greasier burger. The patty is exceptionally tender, complemented by delicious bacon and served in a generous portion size. Although it might be a splurge, I highly recommend giving it a try. Additionally, the Duck Fat fries are both decadently rich and delicious, making them a delightful accompaniment to your meal.

input: Blew $80 on food for the family was worth it food was hot and orange chicken best I've tasted in a awhile..now it will be the place we get Asian food!!
Refine this for me please: I spent $80 on food for the family, and it was definitely worth it. The food was served hot, and the orange chicken was the best I've tasted in a while. From now on, this will be our go-to place for Asian food!

input:
I typically do my laundry at my boyfriend's house, but I had family who recently stayed with me and had a bunch of towels, sheets, and comforters to wash.  I was searching for a laundry mat that would be safe, clean and not full of questionable people.  I was so happy to find this facility.  It is clean, well-lit, and the staff is so friendly and helpful.  I was amazed at the speed of the laundry and dryer.  I completed 4 oversize loads ( probably equal to 8 regular loads) in just under 2 hours!

This place has security cameras, flat screen T.V's, magazines, wi-fi, clean bathrooms, vending machines.  It is a wonderful atmosphere to do your laundry.  It was not overly busy, there are plenty of washers and dryers.  I am so happy that I found this place.  Thank you LAUNDROMAT!!!
Refine this for me please:
I typically do my laundry at my boyfriend's house, but recently, I had family staying with me who brought along a lot of towels, sheets, and comforters that needed to be washed. I needed to find a laundry facility that was safe, clean, and didn't have a questionable crowd. Luckily, I stumbled upon this amazing place. Thank you, LAUNDROMAT, for making my laundry experience so pleasant!

input:
We ran in for a late night dinner last night. The prices are definitely high. Both couples decided to split a plate (you could tell the annoyed our server), and the food was good- but not worth the price for sure.
I will say the garlic bread they bring out before the meal was AH-MAZING! I could have probably eaten my weight in just the bread. 

Overall - I probably wouldn't eat there again myself. But it could have been an off night. There is just too much competition in the food world around St Louis!
Refine this for me please:
Last night, we hastily entered the restaurant for a late dinner, only to be taken aback by the exorbitant prices. In an attempt to save some money, both couples agreed to split a single plate, which clearly irritated our server. Although the food was decent, it certainly didn't justify the steep cost.

I must admit, the garlic bread they served before the main course was absolutely sensational! I could have easily devoured an excessive amount of bread alone.

All in all, I personally wouldn't choose to dine there again. Perhaps it was just an off night, but considering the multitude of competing dining options in St. Louis, there are simply too many superior choices available.

input:
Stopped by to munch a burger during today's Seahawks/Saints game, and the place was, unsurprisingly, packed. For good reason, too: the Haven burger I ordered was fantastic.

I sat right next to the door, so I didn't get the chance to get more than six feet into the place; as soon as I got my meal, the place started getting busier and busier until I had to work my way through the World's Shortest People Maze to get out. Guess that means I wasn't the first person to hear about the place.

I will be going back to the Haven. Might go for, say lunch on a Tuesday, so it's less busy.
Refine this for me please:
I stopped by to grab a burger during the Seahawks/Saints game today and, as expected, the place was packed. However, it was well worth it because the Haven burger I ordered was absolutely fantastic.

Unfortunately, I ended up sitting right next to the door, so I couldn't even make it six feet into the place. As soon as I received my meal, it started getting increasingly crowded, to the point where I had to navigate through a maze of people to leave. Apparently, I wasn't the only one who had heard of this spot.

Despite the crowd, I definitely plan on returning to the Haven. Perhaps next time, I'll opt for a less busy time like a Tuesday lunch.

input:

The vermicelli are a decent size and a fair price. Conveniently located if you live in the Alberta Ave neighbourhood, my orders have always been ready in 15 minutes - even on a Friday night.
Refine this for me please: I can only provide feedback on the vermicelli bowls as I have yet to try the Pho. The vermicelli portions are reasonably sized and reasonably priced. Additionally, their location is convenient for residents of the Alberta Ave neighbourhood. It's worth mentioning that I have always found my orders ready within just 15 minutes, even on busy Friday nights.

input: I had the Chicken Marsala recommended by our waiter. The chicken was very thin, tough, and dry. The pasta was under cooked and stuck together. There was absolutely no flavor. My friend ordered the lasagne and did not like it all. There was only a thin layer of pasta and no flavor. My other friend was still eating her dinner and they cleared her plate when she went to the restroom, after she told the waiter she was not finished. They did bring her a new meal in a doggie bag. The positives are a Great atmosphere and live music. I enjoyed dancing with my husband. However, very expensive for awful food.
Refine this for me please:
I was recommended the Chicken Marsala by our waiter, but unfortunately, it turned out to be a disappointment. The chicken was extremely thin, tough, and dry, and the pasta was undercooked and clumped together. Moreover, both dishes lacked any discernible flavor. Similarly, my friend ordered the lasagne and found it equally unsatisfying, as it only had a thin layer of pasta and lacked any flavor as well.

To add to our dissatisfaction, while my other friend was still enjoying her meal, the waitstaff inexplicably cleared her plate when she briefly left to use the restroom, despite informing the waiter that she wasn't finished yet. Eventually, they did bring her a replacement meal in a doggie bag, but the whole incident was disconcerting.

On a positive note, the restaurant did have a great atmosphere and live music, which added to the enjoyment of the evening. I particularly enjoyed dancing with my husband. However, despite these positive aspects, the overall experience was marred by the exorbitant prices and the disappointing quality of the food.

input: This place is a gem.Attractive space, great location near Broad Street line, plenty on street parking. BYOB. I've been twice and enjoyed every dish. Highlights were the chaats, beef short ribs, lamb vindaloo, beet salad, breads/pickles, and chai. We got the chocolate cake for the table to share each time and everyone loved it. Can get takeout beer at the corner bar. We'll be back.
Refine this for me please: This place is a hidden gem. It offers an inviting atmosphere, conveniently located near the Broad Street line, with ample on-street parking available. A major plus is that it allows you to bring your own beverages. I've had the pleasure of visiting twice and have savored every dish I ordered. The standout items for me were the exquisite chaats, succulent beef short ribs, flavorful lamb vindaloo, refreshing beet salad, delectable breads and pickles, and the irresistible chai. Furthermore, the chocolate cake we ordered to share among the table was an absolute hit both times. In addition, there's a nearby corner bar where you can easily grab some takeout beer. Needless to say, we are excited to return in the future.

input: This is my favorite restaurant!  I always order their ceviche, which is delicious.  The atmosphere is fun, and the service is great.  Alex was our server, and he was friendly, attentive and thoughtful.
Refine this for me please: This restaurant is absolutely my favorite! Without fail, I always make sure to order their delightful ceviche, which truly never disappoints. The atmosphere is delightful and exudes a sense of enjoyment, while the service is exceptional. During our visit, we had the pleasure of being served by Alex, who proved to be a phenomenal server, radiating friendliness, attentiveness, and thoughtfulness throughout our dining experience.

input: Love this store!  Who doesn't!  The salad bar is fresh and they have all types of ethnic food to try.  N-JOY

input: Called in a Mediterranean chicken shawarma. Good flavor and they were generous with the amount of chicken in the pita. The food was ready to go when I arrived. Good service. I would revisit the next time I am in the area.

The food was prepared quickly, as it was ready for me when I arrived. The service was excellent. I would definitely consider coming back again when I'm in the area.

input: I love this place.  The food is great and the space and staff are very pleasant.  Highly recommended for vegetarians and non-vegetarians alike.
Refine this for me please: I absolutely adore this place. Not only is the food exceptional, but the atmosphere and staff are incredibly delightful. It's a true gem that I highly recommend to both vegetarians and non-vegetarians.

input: Took a while to get actual service but once we did I was happy. The gumbo was awesome and loved the chicken & waffles. Friendly staff and right on Bourbon St for good people watching!
Refine this for me please: After a delayed start, we finally received attentive service, which made me satisfied. The gumbo exceeded expectations, and the chicken & waffles were exceptional. The staff was friendly, and the location on Bourbon St provided great opportunities for people watching.

input:
As airport grab-and-go restaurants are, Earl does a decent job with a variety of sandwich options including turkey, tuna and even a Hawaiian. But today I could smell the roast beef and so I got that one. Yum. Good portion of sliced beef that was beyond medium cooked with cheddar cheese and a yummy horseradish sauce. Nope, don't get lettuce or tomatoes on it. It's perfect the way it is.

And since it's right between the security station and the top of the D gates (right near the Delta SkyClub!), it's easy to get and eat at the gate or on board.
Refine this for me please:
Earl, an airport grab-and-go restaurant, offers a decent selection of sandwiches including turkey, tuna, and Hawaiian options. However, today I was enticed by the aroma of the roast beef, so I opted for that one. It was a delightful choice. The sandwich consisted of a generous portion of sliced beef cooked beyond medium, complemented by cheddar cheese and a flavorful horseradish sauce. I personally prefer it without lettuce or tomatoes, as it is perfect just the way it is.

Conveniently located between the security station and the top of the D gates (adjacent to the Delta SkyClub!), it is effortless to grab a sandwich and enjoy it at the gate or even on board the plane.

input: WOW!  What a fantastic place!  Food A+, Service A+++  We started with an appetizer of cheese curds served with a red pepper jelly.  LOVED IT!  I ordered the fish tacos and the wife ordered a beer brat for dinner.  We both thoroughly enjoyed what we ordered!  The portions were huge and priced just right for the portion size.  Our server was on it!  Very attentive and was very knowledgeable about the menu and made us feel very welcomed.  The manager stopped by and asked how everything was.  I let him know that I am pretty sure I have found a cool new place to hang out, have a beer and watch football.  He said they have great deals on game days and let us know about their brunch on the weekends.  Everyone said goodbye as we walked out and reminded us to grab a rootbeer candy on our way out.  I will be back!
Refine this for me please:
Wow, what an incredible experience! The food at this place is outstanding, with an A+ rating for taste and an A+++ for service. To start, we had the cheese curds appetizer served with a delicious red pepper jelly – it was absolutely fantastic and left us wanting more. For our main courses, I ordered the fish tacos and my wife had the beer brat, both of which were thoroughly enjoyed. The portion sizes were generous and the prices were just right for what we received.

Our server was exceptional – always attentive and had an extensive knowledge of the menu. They made us feel incredibly welcome throughout our meal. The manager even took the time to ask us how everything was going, and I couldn't help but mention that I had discovered a new favorite spot for hanging out, having a beer, and watching football. The manager informed us about their great deals on game days and also mentioned their enjoyable brunch available on weekends.

As we left, the staff bid us farewell and kindly reminded us to grab a root beer candy on our way out. It was a nice touch and left a lasting impression. Without a doubt, I will be returning to this place in the future.

input:

.
Refine this for me please: I had a great experience when I stopped by for dinner and a drink. Normally, I don't order burgers when I eat out because I can easily make them at home. However, this time I couldn't resist and I'll definitely have a hard time not getting another burger when I go back. Additionally, they had a good variety of beers to choose from and the staff made me feel extremely welcome. The food was prepared exactly the way I wanted it and was served promptly. The restaurant had a pleasant atmosphere and the restrooms were clean. Overall, I was extremely satisfied with my visit.

input:
Too big, too expensive and too far from Downtown.  

I was here for a conference, which seemed like an awesome idea. It wasn't.  I'm in Direct Sales and (like most people at this conference) don't have tons of extra money to spend on mediocre meals when I'm traveling.  $10 for a slice of generic pizza, small side salad and a soda for lunch.   I understand it's a hotel but there weren't any options close by.  Just getting your car from valet was a hassle and took a lot of time.  Being such a big property, it made getting to restaurants off the property really time intensive.  Since you're so far out of Nashville (out near the airport), the good little holes you find when you're in a city are pretty nonexistent.  

The property itself was great.  The hotel is HUGE but really pretty.  I enjoyed walking around but was really happy when I found what I didn't know existed...a shortcut between my room and the Convention Center.  It took my 10-15 minute walk down to about 3 minutes!  BONUS!  Like I said, this place is ginormous.  

Room: Our room was great.  I shared a wonderful suite in the Garden Conservatory with 2 other girls.  We were under a group rate and my friend was quoted $200/night, which is awesome for the space we had.  We had a large room (probably used as a hospitality suite for groups) for socializing.  It had a great bar area set-up and a nice big fridge and lots of drawer space.  Our bedroom was separated by doors that could be locked from either side (like an adjoining room), so it looked like the hospitality suite could be reserved without reserving the room.  It was different than what I was expecting, but whatevs.  It was fine.  So, I wasn't there at check-in.  The girl who reserved the room checked in a couple days earlier than my friend and I.  So, Sunday comes, and the bill was waiting for us when we woke up.  Our friend was charged $1200 for one room (I'm guessing the suite) and $1400 for the other room.  YEP.  She reserved what she thought was a 2 room suite for $200.  The bedroom door was closed when she got there and she asked them to open it up. It was all arranged by the bellman.  She was never told that the bedroom wasn't included....kind of necessary if you're staying over for 6 nights, dontcha think???  So, she's being charged $2600 for what was supposed to be $1200.  Last I heard, the Gaylord's legal department was investigating what she was told, what she wasn't told and if they should charge her the entire amount.  

Checkout:  A FREAKING NIGHTMARE.  Between the money situation, which was not resolved as of late this week, and the 45 minute wait for a cart (in a hotel that holds thousands of people, you'd think they'd be plentiful and they aren't) and a 25 minute wait for the car, my friend and I decided to sweat it out and schlep our goods to the door where our car would be delivered to us.  It was not a short walk and we had a TON of stuff, which meant multiple trips.  UGH.

I'm sure I'll be back for another conference (I am pretty sure my company has booked this for at least one more year....) but I'm not going to be happy about it.  I might even consider driving down, staying in a hotel somewhere downtown and driving out to the Conference stuff.
Refine this for me please:
Here's a refined version:

The hotel I stayed at for a conference was not a great experience. It was too big, too expensive, and located too far from Downtown. Being in Direct Sales, I didn't have much extra money to spend on overpriced meals during travel. Paying $10 for a slice of generic pizza, a small side salad, and a soda for lunch was disappointing. Although it's a hotel, there were no convenient dining options nearby. Even retrieving my car from valet was a hassle and took a lot of time due to the size of the property. The distance from Nashville's city center also made it time-consuming to find good local restaurants.

On a positive note, the property itself was impressive. The hotel was huge and visually appealing. I enjoyed exploring the vast space, and I was thrilled to stumble upon a shortcut between my room and the Convention Center, reducing my 10-15 minute walk to just 3 minutes. It was a pleasant surprise. However, due to the hotel's sheer size, finding hidden gems within the city was nearly impossible.

Regarding the rooms, we were fortunate to share a lovely suite in the Garden Conservatory with two other girls. The group rate of $200 per night was a great deal considering the spaciousness of the suite. We had a generously-sized room, which was likely intended for group socializing, equipped with a well-stocked bar area, a large fridge, and ample drawer space. Our bedroom had doors that could be locked from either side, creating a separate space similar to an adjoining room. It was not exactly what I had anticipated, but it served its purpose. Unfortunately, I wasn't present during check-in. Our friend, who was in charge of reserving the room, had checked in a couple of days earlier. However, upon checking out, we discovered that our friend was charged $1200 for one room and $1400 for the other. She believed she had reserved a two-room suite for $200, but the bedroom was closed off upon her arrival and had to be opened by the bellman. It was never made clear to her that the bedroom was not included, which is essential when staying for six nights. As a result, she was facing a total charge of $2600 instead of the expected $1200. As of my last knowledge, the Gaylord's legal department was investigating the situation to determine the truthful information provided and whether they should charge her the full amount.

Checkout was an absolute nightmare. Between the unresolved billing issue and the lengthy waits for a luggage cart (despite the hotel accommodating thousands of guests) and for our car (25 minutes), my friend and I decided to endure the physical exertion of carrying our belongings to the door, where our car was supposed to be delivered. It was a long and arduous walk, and we had a substantial amount of items, necessitating multiple trips. It was an overall frustrating experience.

Although I anticipate attending another conference at this hotel, as my company has likely booked it for at least another year, I am not looking forward to it. I might even consider staying at a downtown hotel and commuting to the conference events to avoid the dissatisfaction.

input:
This was my first time dining at Ava and I enjoyed most of it. We ordered the Ricotta cheese & toasted bread and although the flavor was excellent, I thought the bread to cheese ratio was off quite a bit. The ricotta came in a tiny ramekin typically reserved for flavored butters, so I expected more for an appetizer. 

The two pizzas split among a couple of people were the sausage and the potato with rosemary. They were both tasty but I think they forgot the Rosemary on ours. Still yummy, tho! Another entree was the grouper w/Israeli couscous. Scrumptious!

Dessert was a must and the zeppoles, or sugared donuts, were amazing. The cherry tart a little less so, but one person at our table loved it, so maybe it was just not my cup of tea. The cherries were a sort of candied cherry-interesting, but sweet with a very dense crust. Again, just not my personal fave. 

I will definitely return to try other menu items that looked great-like the pastas made in-house daily...that's next!!
Refine this for me please:
This was my first experience dining at Ava and overall, I really enjoyed it. One appetizer we ordered was the Ricotta cheese & toasted bread. Although the flavor was excellent, I found the bread to cheese ratio to be a bit skewed. The ricotta came in a tiny ramekin typically used for flavored butters, so I was expecting a larger portion for an appetizer.

Among the two pizzas we tried, the sausage and the potato with rosemary, both were delicious. However, it seemed like they forgot to include the rosemary on ours. Nevertheless, they were still enjoyable. Another dish we tried was the grouper with Israeli couscous, which was absolutely scrumptious.

For dessert, we couldn't resist the zeppoles, also known as sugared donuts, and they were amazing. On the other hand, the cherry tart was not as impressive for me, but a person at our table really loved it, so it might just be a matter of preference. The cherries in the tart had a candied flavor, which was interesting, but the crust was very dense. It just didn't personally appeal to my taste.

I definitely plan on returning to Ava to try other items from their menu, especially the pastas made in-house daily. That's definitely something I'm looking forward to trying next time.

input: 1st time eating here. Very clean, nice folks and very good sushi.  Would and will go back. Service was spot on, sushi was very fresh and reasonably priced .
Refine this for me please: This was my first time dining here and I had a wonderful experience. The restaurant was exceptionally clean and the staff was friendly and accommodating. The sushi was absolutely delicious and I will definitely be returning in the future. The service received was impeccable and the sushi was incredibly fresh and reasonably priced.

input: This place is just the best. If you really have to ask why it's all in the name itself. If u don't like chicken then don't come here bc their birds are fly! Don't forget to try their fried corn on the cobs. It's dank!
Refine this for me please: This place is undeniably amazing, and it's evident in its name alone. If chicken isn't your thing, I'd advise skipping a visit because their chicken dishes are truly remarkable. Additionally, make sure not to miss out on their delicious fried corn on the cob, as it is absolutely fantastic.

input: REALLY below average food.  Akin to waffle house.  I wanted this to be good based on the reviews but not so.  The pancakes tasted like a frozen processed version, "homemade" maple syrup was watery/sugary with fake flavoring.  Trees make authentic syrup, not people.  The hash browns were greasy and fairly tasteless. The bacon overcooked, hard and chewy.  Obviously had been sitting awhile. Overall, very uninspired food.  Unfortunately, this is one of those places that is living on an outdated "must go" reputation.  There are much better offerings in Nashville.
Refine this for me please: Extremely below average food. Comparable to Waffle House. Despite positive reviews, this place was disappointing. The pancakes tasted like they came straight out of a frozen package, and the "homemade" maple syrup was thin, overly sweet, and had an artificial taste. Real maple syrup is made by trees, not humans. The hash browns were greasy and lacked flavor, while the bacon was overcooked, tough, and chewy, indicating it had been sitting for a while. Overall, the food lacked creativity and inspiration. Unfortunately, this restaurant relies on an outdated "must go" reputation that it no longer deserves. Without a doubt, there are far superior dining options available in Nashville.

input: Excellent.  Went there for lunch (the budget option).  Prix fixe menu was tempting.  Wife had the prime rib po'boy with the soup of the day (tomato fennel).  Both were excellent (the po'boy being an upscale interpretation, with gruyere and a really good horseradish sauce).  I had the seafood jamabalaya and seafood gumbo, also excellent (probably the best I've had).
Refine this for me please: I had an excellent experience at this place for lunch, specifically choosing the budget option. The prix fixe menu caught my attention. My wife opted for the prime rib po'boy paired with the soup of the day, which was a delightful tomato fennel. Both dishes were outstanding, especially the po'boy that added a sophisticated twist with gruyere and a flavorful horseradish sauce. As for me, I thoroughly enjoyed the seafood jambalaya and seafood gumbo, which were hands down the best I have ever tasted.

input:
We recently used Pure Design for a large event in a nearby hotel. Pure staff met with me to discuss my budget and offered beautiful, unique flower and arrangement selections. Their estimate came in well within my budget. Their staff was always professional and their expertise was obvious. The day of the event, they created such a gorgeous space with all the beautiful arrangements - our guests raved about them, even days after the event was over! I was also able to take home/give away the arrangements, which is not always the case with other florists. And the flowers lasted several days after the event.

I would highly recommend Pure for a large event.
Refine this for me please:
We recently engaged the services of Pure Design for a significant event held at a nearby hotel. From the beginning, the staff at Pure demonstrated their commitment to understanding and working within our budget while offering an impressive range of distinctive and stunning flower arrangements. Notably, their estimate was not only affordable but also aligned perfectly with our financial limitations.

Throughout our engagement, the professionalism of the Pure staff was evident, and their extensive knowledge of floral design was palpable. On the day of the event, they transformed the venue into a truly enchanting space, thanks to their exquisite arrangements. The compliments from our guests kept pouring in long after the event was over, a testament to the exceptional quality delivered by Pure Design.

Another standout aspect of our experience with Pure was their flexibility in allowing me to not only take home but also gift the arrangements. This level of accommodation is not always a norm with other florists, making Pure Design truly stand out.

Even beyond the event, the longevity of the flowers was remarkable, as they lasted for several days post-celebration, further solidifying our trust in Pure Design's commitment to excellence.

In conclusion, without any hesitation, I wholeheartedly recommend Pure Design for any large-scale event. Their professionalism, artistic abilities, and willingness to work within your budget make them a top choice for unforgettable floral experiences.

input: My husband and I are not "spring chickens", but we love to Par-Tee. The server immediately welcomed us and asked about our drink preferences.  He was very knowledgeable and helpful. The beer selection was wonderful, the liquor selection divine.  The bar food, even though it was a small selection, was excellent. I had never wanted to try pork bellies (the name turned me off.) Dan ordered it, I tried it,and we now have a convert.  WE highly recommend their pork belly sliders! I hope they continue to add a few more delicious tapas.  These folks have it together and are very engaging.  We'll be back often.
Refine this for me please: My husband and I may not be young, but we still enjoy a good time. We recently decided to visit a place called Par-Tee, and we were pleasantly surprised from the moment we stepped in. The server welcomed us warmly and wasted no time in asking for our drink preferences. They proved to be very knowledgeable and helpful in guiding us through their impressive beer and liquor selections. Despite the limited options, the bar food exceeded our expectations. One dish that particularly caught us off guard was the pork belly sliders. Although hesitant initially due to the name, I took a leap of faith and tried them at my husband's insistence. Needless to say, we both loved them and highly recommend them to others. We do hope that Par-Tee will consider expanding their tapas selection in the future, as we believe they have a knack for creating delicious dishes. The staff at Par-Tee are not only efficient but also engaging, making our experience all the more enjoyable. We're already planning our next visit, as this place has truly impressed us.

input:
Average or slightly above, despite the hype.  On the expensive side.  For $10 or $12 you should get fries with your burger, not a large to share for $8.  I had a bison burger. that was the only reason I went there.  Seems we had 1 beer, 1 iced tea, 1 burger, 1 bison burger and split a large fry, for about $37.  Rather ridiculous. And they try to hard to be different or interesting, but ruin a good meal.  The bison burger was tainted with unnecessary slaw and BBQ on it to call it a Carolina bison burger.  Not worth $12 on its own.

Been there.  Done that.  No reason to go back.  Next...
Refine this for me please: Average or slightly above, despite the hype. On the expensive side, as $10 or $12 should get you fries with your burger, not a large to share for $8. The only reason I went there was for the bison burger. However, the prices were rather ridiculous, considering we only had 1 beer, 1 iced tea, 1 regular burger, 1 bison burger, and split a large fry, which cost us about $37. They try too hard to be different or interesting, but end up ruining the meal. The unnecessary slaw and BBQ on the Carolina bison burger made it less enjoyable and not worth the $12 price. Been there, done that. No reason to go back. Next...

input:
Before I share the main issue, I want to share the reason I give any stars is because of our awesome server, LaToya. She was thoughtful and engaging! 

The black bean burger was dry. Sweet potato fries were good. 

Today while at lunch with a group of colleagues the most disturbing thing happened. I noticed the manager in a green sweater lingering around the entrance and then two cop cars with lights flashing pulled up and 3 officers rushed in walked to the table next to us that the manager was pointing to and one of the officer's proceeded to pull out their handcuffs and tell the guy delivering food to put food down at the table and hands behind his back. They escorted him near the front door and had him sit down for a moment before taking him outside in freeZing cold with no jacket where he stood for a few minutes while cops came in and out of restaurant. 

This entire thing was poorly handled, disturbing and unsettling not only to the customers but the other staff. They should have had the cops walk back away from where customers were and deal with it there. Then all the managers disappeared not available to talk to any of the customers let alone apologize or acknowledge people being unsettled. 

No one needs to know why the arrest happened but there needed to be more care for customers and staff in how it was handled. 

Not ok!!!
Refine this for me please:
Before addressing the main issue, I feel it is important to acknowledge the exceptional service provided by our server, LaToya. She was considerate and engaging, and she deserves recognition for her excellent work.

However, I must express my disappointment with certain aspects of my recent lunch experience. While the sweet potato fries were enjoyable, the black bean burger was noticeably dry.

That being said, I would like to discuss a more disturbing incident that occurred during our meal. While dining with my colleagues, I observed the restaurant manager, wearing a green sweater, acting suspiciously near the entrance. Suddenly, two police cars with flashing lights arrived, and three officers hastily entered the premises. They approached a nearby table that the manager had pointed to and proceeded to arrest the individual delivering food. The officer handcuffed him, instructing him to place the food on the table and put his hands behind his back. The delivery person was then escorted near the front door where he was made to sit momentarily before being taken outside into the freezing cold, without a jacket. Throughout this ordeal, the police continued to enter and exit the restaurant, causing a sense of unease among the customers and staff.

The handling of this situation was both distressing and unsettling. It would have been more appropriate for the officers to conduct their business away from the customers, ensuring their comfort and peace of mind. Additionally, the absence of any available managers to address the concerns of customers or even offer an apology was disappointing.

While it is not necessary to disclose the details of the arrest, it is essential that greater care is taken in the future to ensure the well-being and satisfaction of both customers and staff. This incident was simply not acceptable.

input: Fantastic sliders!! Perfect size that you can try more than one!  Fried chicken slider, BLT slider, monte cristo and Cuban were all fantastic!  Now for Donuts to go!!
Refine this for me please: These sliders are absolutely fantastic! The size is just perfect, allowing you to indulge in more than one. From the mouthwatering fried chicken slider to the delightful BLT slider, the flavors are truly outstanding. The monte cristo and Cuban sliders were equally impressive. And now, it's time for some delectable donuts to go!

input:
They reopened up derived new management.. this was our 3rd time there. They have daily specials, which is a pretty good price, $7.95 for a plate, ice-tea and soup. Todays (Friday)special, they had Carne Asada with rice n beans, fried fish plate and 2 chicken enchiladas with rice n beans, all come with tea n soup.
