We both had the Carne asada plate but they let me substitute my rice n beans for a salad. Steak was pretty good. 

I think their specials are different everyday. So for the most part it was good all around. Oh service was good n attentive.
Refine this for me please:
They recently reopened under new management, and this was our third visit to the restaurant. They offer daily specials at a reasonable price of $7.95, which includes a plate, ice tea, and soup. Today's (Friday) specials included options like Carne Asada with rice and beans, a fried fish plate, and 2 chicken enchiladas with rice and beans, all served with tea and soup.

We both decided to try the Carne Asada plate, but they kindly allowed me to substitute my rice and beans for a salad. The steak was quite delicious.

It seems like their specials change every day, which adds variety to the menu. Overall, it was a great experience and the service was attentive.

input: Love this little shop so much for so many reasons. First off, whenever I'm on my way to Sweet Divas, I can smell the spices wafting from this little, inviting shop. Second, they have such a large range of spices that you can smell, taste a little, and purchase. Yes, there's a large overwhelming variety of spices, but fear not! Their knowledgeable staff is available and more than happy to assist you in finding the right spice you are looking for all your cooking needs. Over the years I've purchased many items from here and I can attest that they do last a long time (about a year, year and a half, including some stuff I use often!). I see all kind of specialty salts for example (onion salt, celery salt) as well as sugars and powders (lavender vanilla sugar, vanilla bean powder). Their products even seem to taste fresher (I can taste a difference between their cinnamon and nutmeg and what I can get at a dollar store, for example). The prices aren't too bad and they last long. My three bottles pictured cost about $19, but that will last a good year, so its worth it to me.
Refine this for me please: I absolutely adore this charming little shop for numerous reasons. Firstly, as I approach Sweet Divas, the delightful aroma of spices fills the air, emanating from this inviting establishment. Secondly, they offer an extensive range of spices that not only tantalize your senses but also allow you to sample and purchase them. While the assortment may seem overwhelming, their knowledgeable staff are always on hand to assist you in selecting the perfect spice for all your culinary desires. With numerous purchases made over the years, I can confidently affirm the longevity of their products, as they typically last about a year to a year and a half, even with frequent use. Specializing in various salts, such as onion salt and celery salt, as well as sugars and powders like lavender vanilla sugar and vanilla bean powder, this shop takes pride in providing fresher and superior-tasting goods. Comparing their cinnamon and nutmeg to those found in a dollar store, I can distinguish a significant difference in quality. Although the prices are fairly reasonable, what truly sets this shop apart is the longevity of their products. The three bottles shown in the picture only cost me approximately $19, but they will undoubtedly last me a good year, making the investment worthwhile.

input: Steve & his partner are the best! Love that he'll do a bunch of demo racquets! Great prices with lots to choose from. If you're a player this is the place to go!
Refine this for me please: Steve and his partner are absolutely fantastic! I can't get enough of how amazing they are at providing demo racquets. In addition to their remarkable services, the prices are incredibly reasonable and they offer a wide variety of options to choose from. If you're a player looking for the perfect racquet, look no further than this place!

input: We went around 6 and it was more packed than I expected. I knew it would be busy but I was surprised. The staff was amazing. We waited in line for about 8 minutes regardless of it being a huge line going out side. Found a table and had our food in less than five minutes. Even with the amount of people they had, it ran so smoothly. One sandwich was messed up but it was very loud in there so I don't think she heard me correctly but someone came to our table and had a new correct sandwich almost immediately. I love that they made time to go around asking if we needed refills and how the food was. So glad to have a chick fil a in Reno. They upheld the chick fil a standards even with all the chaos of opening day.
Refine this for me please: We arrived at around 6 and to my surprise, the place was more crowded than I had anticipated. Despite the massive line stretching outside, we only waited for about 8 minutes. The efficiency of the staff was exceptional, as we were seated and had our food within five minutes. Despite the large number of customers, everything ran smoothly. Although one of our sandwiches was incorrect, the noisy atmosphere may have contributed to the miscommunication. However, a team member promptly noticed the mistake and brought us a new sandwich without delay. I was impressed by the level of service provided, as they checked in with us for refills and to ensure our satisfaction with the food. Having a Chick-fil-A in Reno is a delight, and it is a testament to their commitment to upholding their high standards even amidst the chaos of opening day.

input: Great, beautiful spot to do wine tasting. I loved all the wines I tried, great prices as well as service. I had a good
Refine this for me please: time and would highly recommend it to others. Overall, a fantastic experience for wine lovers.

input:
A wee bit pricey for the portions they serve. I come to Beck's for their gator gumbo over jambalaya. The whole thing is just so savory and the spices are just right. It's not overly spicy and not too salty as well. It's a great meal. The gator is in a sausage form. All chopped up into the gumbo. During this visit, I had to order their pasta. Chicken alfredo, for my 2 year old son. It was alright. The whole pasta tasted a bit dry. It's something I wouldn't get twice.

Verdict - Gator gumbo, end of story.
Refine this for me please: Overall, Beck's serves delicious but slightly overpriced portions. The standout dish is definitely their gator gumbo, which is perfectly balanced in terms of spices and flavor. The gator meat is prepared in sausage form and adds a unique twist to the gumbo. However, on this particular visit, I also ordered the chicken alfredo pasta for my young son, and it was not as impressive. The pasta was dry and lacked flavor, making it a dish I would not order again. In conclusion, if you visit Beck's, go for the gator gumbo without hesitation.

input: I was a little worried about seeing the reviews but everything. Was great! Not long wait time. Staff was nice from walking in the lobby and asking which way to the office, to the office staff.
Refine this for me please: Despite my initial concerns about the reviews, my experience turned out to be excellent. The wait time was short, and the staff was extremely pleasant. From the moment I walked into the lobby and asked for directions to the office, to my interaction with the office staff, everyone was helpful and friendly.

input: Hipsters unite!  I've never had a good time at The Taint, despite several people's attempts top tell me otherwise.  I'm not impressed by the apathy here, or the dirty-headed Garden District crapfest of regular clientele.  Boo.
Refine this for me please: Calling all hipsters! Despite what some people may say, I have yet to enjoy my time at The Taint. The lack of enthusiasm and the grungy Garden District scene of the usual crowd fails to impress me. Disappointing, to say the least.

input:
Yea! Another Chick-fil-A!

Just happened to be driving down (up?) Bloomingdale looking for a new spot to eat, and saw this. OK, it's not new food, but it is a new location (opened yesterday).

The parking lot is crazy, like many in FL, but the staff outside kept the drive-thru lanes flowing. I was in line for less than ten minutes. *Every* last employee I talked to, and I talked to six, were pleasant and welcoming, just like every Chick-fil-A I've ever been to.

The food was good of course, although the fries could have been cooked a bit longer. Chick-fil-A sandwhcih was on poojnt, and so was the sweet tea.

Welcome to Bloomingdale CFA!
Refine this for me please:
Yay! Another Chick-fil-A location has just opened in Bloomingdale! 

While driving down (up?) Bloomingdale in search of a new dining spot, I stumbled upon this newly opened Chick-fil-A. Although it may not offer new food options, it does offer a fresh location since it just opened yesterday.

As expected, the parking lot was chaotic, which seems to be the case with many places in Florida. However, the staff outside did an excellent job of keeping the drive-thru lanes flowing smoothly. Surprisingly, I only waited in line for less than ten minutes. I had the opportunity to interact with six different employees, and each one of them was pleasant and welcoming, maintaining the high standard of customer service that Chick-fil-A is known for.

The food, as always, was delicious. However, the only improvement that could have been made was cooking the fries a little longer. Nevertheless, the Chick-fil-A sandwich was on point, and so was the sweet tea.

A warm welcome to the new Chick-fil-A in Bloomingdale!

input: Cute lil spot on Germantown Ave. I came in craving something sweet and they did not disappoint. There was an array of cookies and bars to choose from, if my memory serves me right. Behind the display of goodies there was a table with clear plastic cups filled with yumminess, labeled "cake scrapple" I was intrigued. They were different kinds of cakes and icings, most likely left over from a bake. There were about 5 different flavors to choose from and I went with my favorite Red Velvet with cream cheese frosting. I also ended up with an M&M cookie, my other fave! It was a nice day so I sat outside on their bench and had a couple bites of goodness! The cookie was great, soft & chewy with those hard candies for texture. The cake was also delicious and moist!
Refine this for me please: This charming little spot on Germantown Ave exceeded my expectations when I had a sudden craving for something sweet. Upon entering, I was greeted with an enticing assortment of cookies and bars to satisfy my sweet tooth. Intrigued by a table adorned with clear plastic cups labeled "cake scrapple," I discovered various flavors of cake and icing, seemingly leftovers from a recent bake. With five tempting options to choose from, I couldn't resist indulging in my all-time favorite Red Velvet cake with cream cheese frosting. Additionally, I couldn't resist grabbing an M&M cookie, another personal favorite. Opting to enjoy the beautiful weather, I found a seat on their inviting bench and savored a few blissful bites. The M&M cookie delivered on its promise, offering a perfect balance of soft and chewy textures with a satisfying crunch from the candies. As for the cake, it was divine, boasting a delightful moistness that left me craving for more.

input: Lots of improvements to this place. Much more comfortable environment now.  The chairs could be a bit more comfortable as it'd be nice to sit through an entire football game. Otherwise, this place has really improved.
Refine this for me please: This place has seen numerous improvements, resulting in a much more comfortable environment. However, it would be beneficial if the chairs were more comfortable to enhance the experience of sitting through an entire football game. Apart from that, the overall improvements in this place are truly commendable.

input: Three stars not because of food, the food is good but, the service is slow. I think they need 1 or 2 more people up front when placing an order if your waiting and not using the kiosk to order.
Refine this for me please: I would rate it three stars, primarily due to slow service rather than the food quality. Although the food itself is good, the service could be improved. In my opinion, they should consider adding one or two more staff members to assist customers when placing orders, especially for those who choose to wait instead of using the kiosk to order.

input:
Went here when they first opened. They only had one flavor... it wasn't that great. Everything was overpriced and we left spending about 70-80 dollars for three people and it wasn't filling. 
*it is not Cajun style seafood. The sauce tastes like a mixture between buffet style sauces with fish sauce. 
Giving them a solid three because there are better places to eat at
Refine this for me please: When I visited this place soon after their opening, I was disappointed. They had only one flavor available and it didn't meet my expectations. Moreover, I found everything to be overpriced and left feeling unsatisfied despite spending around $70-80 for three people. It's important to note that this place does not offer Cajun style seafood; instead, its sauce tasted like a combination of buffet-style sauces mixed with fish sauce. While I wouldn't highly recommend this place, I would give them a three-star rating since there are other dining options that offer better experiences.

input:
My mother, aunt and myself went on this walking tour of Ybor with stops for good food.  What a nice time!  Our guide,  Raymond was very knowledgeable and friendly.  
It was about 3 hrs long,  we passed that 3 hr mark because we were sidetracked a few times and chit chatted quite a bit, lol. 
We learned great details and background about the early days of tampa, the culture, people and ybor in general,  very informative! Along the way we stopped for food tastings . Everything was great,  especially the stone soup company Cuban sandwich!  I would recommend everyone to go on this tour,  visiting or lived here for years this is a fun adventure.  And for the step counters we chalked up over 5000 steps ! It will help offset all the wonderful calories you take in on the tour haha
Refine this for me please: My mother, aunt, and I had a fantastic time on the walking tour of Ybor, which included stops for delicious food. Our guide, Raymond, was not only knowledgeable but also very friendly. Although the tour was supposed to last about 3 hours, we ended up spending more time due to being sidetracked a few times and engaging in enjoyable chit chat. It was well worth it though because we learned fascinating details and a rich background about the early days of Tampa, the culture, people, and Ybor itself – truly informative! Throughout the tour, we had the opportunity to savor various food tastings, and everything was amazing, especially the Cuban sandwich from the Stone Soup Company. I highly recommend this tour to everyone, regardless of whether you are visiting or have lived here for years – it's a fun adventure. In addition, for those who keep track of their steps, we accumulated over 5000 steps during the tour, which is helpful in offsetting the wonderful calories consumed along the way, haha.

input: Love the sweet spiral plain pies at Franzones.  Can't go wrong with plain.  I tried the white pizza with onions in addition and it was a pleasant surprise.  The onions were a great addition to the pizza.  Same Franzone's as the Bridgeport one I grew up with.
Refine this for me please: I absolutely adore the irresistible spiral plain pies at Franzones. You simply can't go wrong with their classic plain pie option. However, I recently decided to experiment and added onions to my white pizza, and it turned out to be a delightful surprise. The onions truly elevated the flavors of the already amazing pizza. It's the same beloved Franzone's that I grew up with in Bridgeport.

input: My18 year old daughter had a severe soar throat. We had seen another fast clinic in a CVS. A few days earlier and recieved a miss diagnosis of a fungus infection. She was prescribed an oral medication that made the condition much worse. We were the only patients at this clinic the entire visit and it took us over 1 hour. The staff were very robotic like in there behavior. I tried to ask a question on the way out and was told I was not aloud to be there. Very strange since I was already there. It felt like I was being hurried out the door. Keeping in mind there were no other patients in the facility during our visit I was confuses about the wait time and gruf  behaviour. I found the experience to be very unfriendly. It is best to have a good primary care physician and avoid these places at all cost.
Refine this for me please: My 18-year-old daughter recently had a severe sore throat. Prior to this, we visited a fast clinic in a CVS store where she was wrongly diagnosed with a fungal infection. Unfortunately, the oral medication prescribed worsened her condition. During our visit to this clinic, we were the only patients present, yet it took us over an hour to be attended to. The staff exhibited robotic behavior and seemed uninterested. On our way out, when I asked a question, I was informed that I shouldn't be there, despite having already been treated. This interaction felt abrupt, as if I was being rushed out the door. Considering the absence of other patients, I was confused by the long wait time and the staff's unfriendly demeanor. In my opinion, it is advisable to have a reliable primary care physician and avoid visiting such clinics whenever possible.

input: The chicken sandwich was phenomenal. Great food for a very industrial area.
Refine this for me please: The chicken sandwich was absolutely exceptional, offering a remarkable dining experience in a distinctly industrial area.

input: We set up an online appt, meeting and transaction was very simple and painless. We opted for a 2hr side by side ride where we had a four-seater with our guide Matt (who by the way was super awesome and informative).  Throughly enjoyed our ride with some superb views.
Refine this for me please: We had a seamless online appointment process for our meeting and transaction, making it incredibly straightforward and hassle-free. We decided on a two-hour side by side ride, accompanied by our fantastic and knowledgeable guide, Matt. The ride was truly enjoyable, offering breathtaking views that we appreciated immensely.

input: Great bar Happy Hour 4-7 every day. Wine & Drafts $3, $5 pizza, $4.50 apps. To-go Dinners and lunches are very reasonable and fast. Staff are as friendly as it gets.
Refine this for me please: Join us at our exceptional bar for an incredible Happy Hour experience happening every day from 4-7pm! Indulge in our delightful selection of wines and drafts, each priced at a pocket-friendly $3. Delight in our mouthwatering $5 pizzas and savor our delectable appetizers for just $4.50. Whether you're taking a meal to-go or enjoying it here, our reasonably priced dinners and lunches will satisfy your cravings in no time. Expect exceptional service from our friendly and welcoming staff who go above and beyond to ensure you have an amazing time.

input:
I had a horrible experience here. The waiter was great but as I got my appetizer, there was it has a hair in it.
Next the noodles came out mine was fine but my friend has a huge hair in his. I thought he was joking until he told me. After that it ruined my appetite, I gave the noodles back and they didn't even give me a new one, I thought I should've got the food for free at that point.. never eating here again
Refine this for me please: I had an extremely unpleasant experience at this place. While the waiter provided great service, my appetizer was served with a hair in it. Similarly, my friend's noodles also had a large hair in them, which initially seemed like a joke but turned out to be true. This incident completely ruined my appetite, so I returned the noodles, expecting a replacement. However, the restaurant staff did not offer me a fresh dish. Considering the situation, I believe I should have received complimentary food. As a result of this disappointing experience, I have made up my mind never to dine at this establishment again.

input: Went here with a friend after having an incredible experience at Laurel and was hoping for more of the same at a slightly less bulgy pricepoint, and oh my, is it worth it...    ITV is the kind of place that i dream about, beautiful small room, dimly lit but you can see ( as opposed to some places) and you want to see everything.  Everything in the room is beautiful including a lot of the staff, (im trying to give you the full picture here).   First thing to hit the table (or bar in this case) was a three dollar beef fat biscuit that was the best thing ive eaten in this city all year.  I verbally communicated that message to Chef Nick Elmi who graced us with his presence in the dining room (just as before at Laurel).    We went on to eat many more things which i will try to name now... Stars were Foie with Apricot Miso, Pork Cheeks with some insanely good vegetables, trout pumpernickel soldiers and one of the best cocktails ive had in a damn long time, the ouroboros.   The are playing around with cold smoking things in there and on their BAR MENU!   Honestly, place is just terrific and i meant to write this review sooner but hey... better late than never.  Now that i think of it, im getting hungry... maybe ill head to East Passyunk for some of the best this city has to offer!
Refine this for me please:
After having an amazing experience at Laurel, my friend and I decided to visit ITV, hoping for a similar experience at a more affordable price. And let me tell you, it did not disappoint. ITV is like something out of my dreams - a beautifully small room, dimly lit but still allowing you to see everything. The ambiance is just perfect. 

Not only is the setting gorgeous, but the staff is extraordinary too. They are all beautiful and add to the overall experience. 

As we sat down, we were immediately greeted with a three-dollar beef fat biscuit that quickly became the highlight of my year in terms of food. I couldn't help but express my gratitude to Chef Nick Elmi, who made an appearance in the dining room, just as he had done at Laurel. 

Throughout the evening, we indulged in several more dishes, each as delicious as the last. Some standouts were the Foie with Apricot Miso, the Pork Cheeks with incredibly flavorful vegetables, and the trout pumpernickel soldiers. And let's not forget about the outstanding cocktail, the ouroboros - one of the best I've had in a long time. 

What impressed me even more was that they are experimenting with cold smoking, even on their bar menu. The creativity and innovation in this place are simply amazing. 

I'm kicking myself for not writing this review sooner, but better late than never. I must mention that just thinking about this place is making me hungry. I might have to make a trip to East Passyunk soon to enjoy some of the best food this city has to offer.

input:
I absolutely love this place!

Great hours, impeccably clean, so relaxing.
Refine this for me please: I have an absolute adoration for this place! The hours are wonderful, it is flawlessly clean, and the ambiance is incredibly soothing.

input: Buckingham Pizza makes the best pizza around, particularly its plain pizza and a few of its specialities -- try the cool ranch pizza. This is a pizza parlor. Don't get fancy....order the pizzas and maybe some sides. While some of the entrees are good (chicken piccata), stay with the pizza and you'll love it.
Refine this for me please: Buckingham Pizza is renowned for serving the finest pizzas in the area, especially their mouthwatering plain pizza and a selection of delightful specialties. One must-try item is their delectable cool ranch pizza. As a dedicated pizza parlor, Buckingham Pizza thrives on simplicity, focusing on perfecting their pizzas and offering a limited variety of sides. Although they also serve commendable entrees like the chicken piccata, sticking to their pizzas is highly recommended if you want an exceptional dining experience. Rest assured, their pizza offerings are bound to capture your heart and palate.

input: Best iced latte and beignet we tried. The live music also creates a great atmosphere. We also visited Cafe du Monde but in our opinion Cafe Beignet is much better. The service is also very good and there are hardly ever lines.
Refine this for me please: The best iced latte and beignet we've tried so far is definitely at Cafe Beignet. Not only does their live music add a delightful atmosphere, but the service is exceptional too. In comparison to Cafe du Monde, we found Cafe Beignet to be far superior. Additionally, the absence of long queues at Cafe Beignet is a pleasant surprise.

input:
Fun, no-frills atmosphere, right on the water, where you can watch passersby and dolphins alike, while enjoying great food and accommodating service.

Members of our dining party ranged from a picky 7 year old, to two 40 somethings and a 72 year old grandmother. Captain Bill's had menu choices for everyone in our party, and they even made some ingredient substitutions for us. 

The food arrived hot, fresh, and exactly to our specifications. Wait service and wait time were on point, and we all left the restaurant satisfied and having enjoyed the experience. We'll be back to Captain Bill's next time we visit John's pass. I hope you consider it too!
Refine this for me please:
Come experience the vibrant and laid-back ambiance of Captain Bill's, a delightful waterfront eatery. Situated by the water, this no-frills location offers a fun atmosphere where you can relish in the sight of both passersby and playful dolphins. Indulge in delectable food and relish in exceptional service throughout your visit.

Our dining party consisted of individuals spanning different ages and preferences – a choosy 7-year-old, two young adults in their forties, and a sprightly 72-year-old grandmother. Captain Bill's met the expectations of each member, providing an extensive menu that catered to all our preferences. The staff even accommodated ingredient substitutions upon request.

The food, served promptly and steaming hot, surpassed our expectations. Each dish was prepared with utmost freshness and met our precise specifications. The service was exemplary – our wait staff were attentive and efficient, ensuring that our wait time was minimal. The entire dining experience left us utterly content and satisfied with our choice.

For our next visit to John's pass, we will unquestionably return to Captain Bill's, and we genuinely recommend that you consider it as well. Join us in relishing the delights of this establishment and create lasting memories in its welcoming atmosphere.

input: Very good sushi. The peanut avocado roll is a must try. Delicious! I ordered the Volcano roll as well and it was amazing. The service was also great, very friendly customer service. I will definitely visit again even though it's far from where I live. If you find yourself near Valrico, then definitely visit this restaurant. You will not regret it.
Refine this for me please: The sushi at this restaurant is outstanding, particularly the peanut avocado roll which is an absolute must-try. It is simply delicious! I also had the pleasure of trying the Volcano roll and it was truly amazing. The customer service was top-notch as well, with friendly staff that made the dining experience even better. Despite the distance from my home, I will definitely make the effort to visit again in the future. If you happen to be in the Valrico area, I highly recommend visiting this restaurant – it's an experience you won't regret.

input: It's really a run of the middle as far as Cuban food goes. Not bad but not great either. I work close by so I end up there for lunch quite a bit. It's definitely worth checking out for lunch as their specials change every day and prepared freshly.
Refine this for me please: The Cuban cuisine at this place falls somewhere in the middle. It's not exceptional, but it's not terrible either. Since I work nearby, I often find myself going there for lunch. One great thing about it is that their lunch specials are constantly changing, offering freshly prepared options. So, it's definitely worth giving it a try for a midday meal.

input: My husband had the 6 oz pepperloin meal and was very happy with it. I had the shrimp kabob meal. There were only 4 shrimp and they were more then well done and very small.  The service was good. The restaurant was not busy.
Refine this for me please: My husband thoroughly enjoyed his 6 oz pepperloin meal and had a positive experience with it. However, I was slightly disappointed with my shrimp kabob meal as it only consisted of four shrimp, which were overcooked and smaller in size. On the bright side, the service at the restaurant was commendable and the overall ambiance was not crowded.

input:
The line was out the door, but I had a sandwich in my hands 7 minutes later, and I'm guessing it took longer because I didn't know what I wanted right away.  In fact, I felt a little rushed.  All the locals were running in, saying hi to the owner and ordering up their usual's.  No place for a rookie, but they were extremely patient with us and a few others that wandered in not knowing what they were doing either.

As soon as you cross the threshold, you know you have made a good choice, the smell makes your mouth water.  The Punk agreed so we decided to sit inside (everyone else was outside).

Typically, I would never ever order pastrami, but the menu said it was lean, so I tried something different for me.  Lean indeed.  Best pastrami I have had in a very long time.  In fact, maybe ever.  

The punk was amazed at all the bottle caps glued to every surface in the place.  It is a visual feast to keep you busy and entertained while you eat, if you choose to eat inside.  You cannot see the walls for all the nostalgic fodder.

She was especially thrilled when they brought out her sandwich. When he set it down she exclaimed with delight, "He knew exactly what I wanted!"
Refine this for me please:
Here's a refined version:

Despite the long line, I managed to get my hands on a sandwich within seven minutes. Perhaps it took a bit longer because I couldn't make up my mind right away, leaving me feeling a tad rushed. Unlike the seasoned locals confidently greeting the owner and ordering their usuals, I felt like a novice. However, they showed exceptional patience towards us and a few other clueless wanderers.

Upon entering, the delightful aroma instantly assured me of my wise decision. The Punk shared my sentiment, prompting us to opt for indoor seating while everyone else sat outside.

Normally, I would never consider ordering pastrami, but the menu boasted its leanness, compelling me to try something different. And it didn't disappoint. It turned out to be the best pastrami I've had in ages, quite possibly the best ever.

The Punk was captivated by the plethora of bottle caps adorning every surface in the place. It was a visually stimulating feast that kept us entertained throughout the meal, particularly if you chose to dine indoors. The nostalgia-filled surroundings made it impossible to distinguish the walls.

Her excitement reached its peak when her sandwich arrived. With sheer delight, she exclaimed, "He knew exactly what I wanted!"

input: Can't tell you how happy I was to see see Heather finally open a shop...I've followed her as a client for years. She is a color wizard, a genius at crafting a look with flair just for you, and can make a tasteful and creative suggestion if you're stumped, or roll with your personal vision. On top of that, Heather has created a shop vibe that is unstuffy, chill, and totally comfortable. I trust her and the staff she hires when I recommend friends and family, and love that she's made a home in the heart of E. Passyunk. Ask her for tips on caring for cactus houseplants, or chat about vintage bikes when you visit.
Refine this for me please:
I was absolutely thrilled to witness Heather finally open her own shop. As a long-standing client, I have been following her for years, and I must say she is a true master of color. Her ability to create a unique and stylish look just for you is unparalleled. Whether you're in need of inspiration or already have a vision in mind, Heather is a genius at providing tasteful and creative suggestions.

What sets Heather apart is not only her exceptional skills but also the delightful atmosphere she has cultivated in her shop. It is a relaxed and comfortable space, free from any stuffiness. Whenever I recommend Heather to my friends and family, I have complete trust in her and the staff she hires.

Furthermore, I admire the location she has chosen for her shop in the heart of E. Passyunk. It truly feels like a home away from home.

During your visit, don't hesitate to ask Heather for tips on caring for cactus houseplants or engage in a conversation about vintage bikes. These are just a few examples of the delightful experiences you can have when visiting her shop.

input: I like that Sally's has more options for hair supplies than any other beauty store in the area. The staff is nice and friendly and everything is usually well stocked. Sally's is my go to when I feel like experimenting with my hair due to the wide array of products they carry. I do wish the staff was a little more knowledgable on what they carry but I understand that that's a lot to ask. I also wish that the store was bigger, brighter and cleaner. The cramped aisles, dust bunnies and flickering, yellow fluorescent lights don't exactly give that same "beauty/trendy" feeling that other beauty stores have. If I could give one piece of advice to management it would be to work on the appearance of the store, other than that I'm pretty happy with Sally's.
Refine this for me please: I appreciate the abundant options for hair supplies available at Sally's compared to other local beauty stores. The staff at Sally's is pleasant and amiable, and the store is usually well-stocked. Whenever I have the urge to experiment with my hair, Sally's is my first choice because they offer a wide range of products. However, it would be beneficial if the staff were more knowledgeable about the items they carry, although I understand that this may be a tall order. Additionally, I believe the store could greatly benefit from being larger, brighter, and cleaner. The cramped aisles, presence of dust bunnies, and flickering, yellow fluorescent lights fail to create the desired "beauty/trendy" environment that other beauty stores successfully achieve. If I were to offer one piece of advice to the management, it would be to prioritize the store's appearance. Nonetheless, aside from this factor, I am generally satisfied with Sally's.

input:
Let me preface by saying that I have been getting my hair cut by a guy in Austin for seven years, even though I've lived in other cities for half that time. He is that good. The couple of times that I've strayed, I have been severely disappointed in the outcome. But I wasn't planning a trip back to Austin for a while and badly needed a cut, so I decided to bite the bullet.

My friend walks in a few weeks ago with *srsly* the cutest short hair cut. And so I ask her who and where, and she says Rodney Mitchell. I figured that this place would be too expensive, but she corrected my thinking on the matter. So I called to make an appointment with her guy (whose name I sadly cannot remember at the moment) and Rodney answered the phone. Turns out the guy my friend had seen didn't do morning appointments and all my afternoons were filled, so Rodney said "look, I'm the owner, I can absolutely vouch for Allison who has several openings in the next few days." So I thought, alright, he's the owner so he knows his stuff--I'll do it.

Allison absolutely did not disappoint. First off, she's a total sweetheart, but not super chatty (I appreciate stylists who can be content to both hold and not hold a convo while working) so there was no pressure there. I came in with my laptop and several photos I'd found that approximated what I wanted in a haircut, as I couldn't find exactly the right one. We talked about it a bit, discussed front and back length, bangs, etc. and she said alright and went to it. What she gave me was the cutest damn shaggy bob that I never thought possible. I seriously can't wait to go back.

One of the other awesome things about RMS is that they give you a discount for your first visit and I believe they have some kind of discount for students and teachers. They also will give you *another* discount when you refer people. So I got my friend a discount, and then referred a friend, so I'll get another discount when I go back for my next cut. All good things when you're trying your best to be a frugal  grad student.
Refine this for me please:
Let me start by saying that I have been going to the same hair stylist in Austin for seven years, even though I have lived in other cities for half of that time. He is truly remarkable. However, since I wasn't planning a trip back to Austin anytime soon, I reluctantly decided to try a new hair salon.

A few weeks ago, my friend walked in with the most adorable short haircut. Intrigued, I asked her where she got it done, and she mentioned Rodney Mitchell. Initially, I assumed it must be an expensive place, but she assured me otherwise. Encouraged by her recommendation, I called to book an appointment with my friend's stylist, whose name unfortunately escapes me at the moment. Surprisingly, Rodney himself answered the phone and explained that the stylist my friend had seen didn't do morning appointments, and all my afternoons were booked. He then suggested I try Allison, one of his stylists, who had several openings in the next few days. I thought to myself, well, if Rodney, who is the owner, can vouch for her, she must be talented. So I decided to give it a shot.

Allison did not disappoint. Not only is she kind-hearted, but she also knows when to engage in conversation and when to let her work speak for itself. I brought in my laptop along with a few photos that resembled the haircut I desired, although I couldn't find the exact one. We discussed the desired length for the front and back, as well as the possibility of bangs. Once we had a clear understanding, she got to work. To my surprise, she gave me the most adorable shaggy bob that I never thought possible. I am genuinely excited to go back to her for my next haircut.

Another great aspect of RMS (Rodney Mitchell Salon) is their generous discounts. As a first-time customer, I received a discount, and I believe they also offer discounts for students and teachers. Additionally, they provide another discount when you refer someone to their salon. So, not only did I get my friend a discount for her visit, but I also referred another friend, which means I will receive another discount for my next haircut. These perks are especially appreciated when you're a frugal graduate student trying to save money.

input:
So much to like about this place--the beautiful Mercer Building location, the spaciousness, the lovely, friendly baristas. But there are a couple of important cons for me. Biggest being, the music is constant and too loud, ruining everything you go to a coffee shop to do: read, work, reflect, or enjoy a good conversation. When I asked for it to be turned down, they told me they can't--it just plays at one level all the time, and the speakers  are everywhere so you can't get away from it. It sucks.

Secondly, if you're a tea drinker, you're out of luck. They don't serve the tea in pots, but huge, sloppy individual filters--it makes your beverage totally ungainly, hard to drink and is really off putting.

Pros: gluten free goodies and yummy Italian sodas. I'd love to spend more time here, but the music usually drives me out after 10 minutes.
Refine this for me please:
I really appreciate many aspects of this place, from its stunning location in the Mercer Building to the spaciousness and the genuinely friendly baristas. However, there are a few significant drawbacks that I cannot overlook. The biggest issue for me is the constant and excessively loud music, which completely disrupts the very activities I typically engage in at a coffee shop - reading, working, reflecting, and even having a pleasant conversation. Despite my request for the volume to be turned down, I was informed that it cannot be adjusted as it plays at the same level continuously. Moreover, the speakers are positioned throughout the premises, leaving no escape from the overwhelming sound. This aspect is truly disappointing and ruins my experience.

Additionally, for those who prefer tea over coffee, this place is not a suitable option. Instead of serving tea in traditional pots, they provide massive and messy individual filters, making the whole drinking experience cumbersome and unappealing.

On a more positive note, they do offer gluten-free treats and delicious Italian sodas, which are certainly enjoyable. I would genuinely like to spend more time here, but unfortunately, the persistently loud music usually forces me to leave after just ten minutes.

input:
Spice n Grill has the best Indian food in St. Louis. We had the beef nihari, palak paneer, and naan. The palak and beef were perfectly spiced, adequately spicy, and crave-worthy. I've never had a nihari dish before and I will be sure to try it again. 

The restaurant doesn't have great seating  in the store, so I will take food to go next time. The owner served us and he was very nice, but I don't think people eat in the restaurant very often. 

I was so excited to see that the previous owners of 'Indian Food' have opened a new restaurant and I would recommend it if you're in the mood for delicious take-out.
Refine this for me please:
Spice n Grill is undoubtedly the top spot in St. Louis for authentic and flavor-packed Indian cuisine. Our dining experience was nothing short of delightful as we indulged in their delectable beef nihari, palak paneer, and naan. The palak and beef dishes truly stood out with their perfectly balanced and tantalizing spices, leaving us with an irresistible craving for more. This was my first encounter with the nihari dish, and it definitely won't be my last.

While the seating arrangements within the restaurant might not be its strongest suit, I have decided that my next visit will be a takeaway affair. However, despite the seating limitations, the owner provided exceptional service, demonstrating great kindness and attentiveness. It seems that most patrons opt to take their meals to go rather than dine in.

My excitement was palpable when I discovered that the former proprietors of 'Indian Food' have resurfaced with this new establishment. Without hesitation, I wholeheartedly recommend Spice n Grill for an unforgettable and scrumptious take-out experience.

input:
I've come from Cali where boba is very common there. However I was thinking this place would have had the same feel. After being told this place branched off from California, I was disappointed. 

I'm more of a natural person. I enjoy real flavor, real fruits, and of course the perfect boba. I notice that some flavors were used by real fruits but others were just powder which I could definitely taste the different. Especially the taro flavor, being one of my favorites. 

But, if you're not too concern about natural vs powder flavor then this place could be good for you. They ask what level you would like you sweetness and any additional add-ons you would like. I always get boba but sometimes the grass jelly is pretty good too! I'd recommend you try. 

This is also a good place to catch up, talk, play board, card games and even do homework. I know it's always busy with students from the U of A and being told from them it's a nice area to just hang out, that's a pretty good sign. 

Maybe I'm just too picky, but I think it could be better. 

"See it, taste it, Yelp it"
Refine this for me please:
I moved from California, where boba is very popular. I had hoped that this place would have a similar vibe since it originated from California, but I was disappointed.

Personally, I prefer natural flavors, real fruit, and a perfect boba. Some of their flavors were made with real fruit, but others tasted like they were made from powder. This was especially noticeable with the taro flavor, which happens to be one of my favorites.

However, if you're not too concerned about the natural vs. powder flavor distinction, then this place could be good for you. They give you the option to choose your sweetness level and add-ons, and I always get boba. The grass jelly can be quite good too, so I recommend trying it.

It's also a great place for hanging out, catching up, and engaging in activities like board games, card games, or even doing homework. It's always busy with University of Arizona students, who have mentioned that it's a nice spot to just relax and spend time together. That's definitely a good sign.

Perhaps I am just overly particular, but I believe there is room for improvement.

"See it, taste it, Yelp it"

input: This is an updated review. I've been ordering from silver mine's at the same location for the last 4-5 years and they have only gotten progressively worse. Don't ask for anything to be added to your soup or chili; they'll charge you for the additions but will not include them in the order. They'll also most likely to include the free side such as the bread. It literally takes at least an hour to get your food delivered, maybe they should call Jimmy Johns and ask the what their secret is. This business is in major trouble with all of the other options available. The service is worse than if you had a bunch of kindergarteners running the business, at least they would be nice. You guys are right next to Eller Business School, why don't you ask them how you can improve??? Currently, this place is an embarrassment to their industry, and a waste of space on University Blvd. NEVER ORDERING FROM THIS PLACE AGAIN.
Refine this for me please: This review highlights ongoing dissatisfaction with the quality of service and food at Silver Mine's. Over the past 4-5 years, the experience has deteriorated consistently. Requests for additions to soups or chili result in additional charges without the items being included. Even the complimentary side items, such as bread, are often left out of the orders. Delivery times are unreasonably long, and the suggestion is made that the business could learn from Jimmy John's speedy service. Given the abundance of other dining options, Silver Mine's is deemed to be in significant trouble. The level of service is compared unfavorably to that of kindergarteners running a business, as at least they would be polite. It is suggested that Eller Business School, located nearby, could potentially offer insight on improvement strategies. Overall, the current state of Silver Mine's is described as an embarrassment to its industry and a waste of space on University Blvd. The reviewer vows to never order from this establishment again.

input:
Bought my beautiful new bike from this shop a few weeks ago then promptly crashed it (curse you, trolley tracks!). I brought it back to the shop this afternoon to see if there was any way they could try to fix the front basket, which was pretty mangled, and to give the bike a once-over to make sure it was safe to ride. I was expecting to have to leave the bike with them for a few days, but the whole process took less than a half hour. Not only did they fix the basket (not perfect, but pretty damn close), but they also fixed the gear shifter that was a little out of whack... FOR FREE.  I couldn't believe it. 

I also want to note that everyone in the shop- from the owners, to the sales people on the floor, to the mechanics, to the dog that greets you at the door- is so friendly and welcoming. I am so happy I found them.
Refine this for me please:
I purchased a new bike from this shop a few weeks ago and unfortunately, I had an accident (thanks to the trolley tracks!). Today, I brought the bike back to the shop hoping they could fix the front basket, which was severely damaged, and give the bike a thorough inspection to ensure it was safe to ride. I anticipated having to leave the bike with them for several days, but to my surprise, the entire process took less than thirty minutes. Not only did they successfully repair the basket (it might not be perfect, but it's pretty close), but they also fixed the misaligned gear shifter at no charge. I was astonished.

Moreover, I would like to highlight the exceptional friendliness and welcoming attitude of everyone at the shop, from the owners to the salespeople and mechanics. Even their dog at the door contributes to the warm atmosphere. I am absolutely thrilled to have discovered them.

input: I love going in there just to look around. The prices are a bit high, but the store is like a Disneyland for adults. I LOVE IT!
Refine this for me please: I thoroughly enjoy visiting that place solely to explore its offerings. Although the pricing might be on the higher side, the store is akin to a Disneyland for grown-ups. My enthusiasm for it knows no bounds!

input:
Underrated burger alert!!

Randomly came into Pag's during a stroll around Doylestown. The menu wasn't super appealing, actually, so I just went with a cheeseburger. Legitimately, one of the best cheeseburgers I've had in a while! Tasted like a quality Big Mac! Patty wasn't too thick, bun didn't overshadow the burger and whatever sauce they used - YUM.

We were in the wine bar section - ambiance is really nice; def not very kid friendly (we had our son with us.) but staff was friendly and accommodating.

We will totally be back next time we are in the mood for a good burger!
Refine this for me please:
Hidden gem alert!! We stumbled upon Pag's during a leisurely stroll in Doylestown, and boy, were we pleasantly surprised. Despite the unassuming menu, we decided to go for the cheeseburger, and it turned out to be one of the best we've had in ages! The taste was reminiscent of a top-notch Big Mac, with the perfect balance of flavors - not too much patty, and the bun didn't overpower the burger. Let's not forget about the sauce - it was irresistibly delicious!

We ended up in the wine bar section, which had a wonderful ambiance. However, I must say that it may not be the most ideal place for families with young kids (we brought our son along). Nevertheless, the staff was warm and accommodating.

No doubt about it, we will definitely make a return visit to Pag's whenever we're craving an incredible burger!

input: Absolutely wonderful food & service! Go there for lunch/dinner with my boyfriend at least once every two weeks. Prices are very much reasonable. Weekends get pretty packed so may have to wait a little bit but that's never an issue for us. Always get the Indian Pancake & the Hainanese Chicken or Curry Chicken. Other dishes are delicious as well. Never get tired of it!
Refine this for me please: The food and service at this place are absolutely wonderful! My boyfriend and I make it a point to have lunch or dinner here at least once every two weeks. The prices are very reasonable, making it even more appealing. While weekends tend to get crowded, we don't mind waiting a bit because the experience is always worth it. Our go-to dishes are the Indian Pancake, Hainanese Chicken, and Curry Chicken, but we've also tried other options which have all been delicious. We never get tired of dining here!

input: Pretty slow service and the waitresses aren't very kind. I guess I was expecting something different at a diner with high ratings but I understand it's in the middle of a tourist area. However, service should be a priority. Something that really bothered me was how much trash was left on the floor of the outside deck- it all has the potential to blow right into the ocean. NOT OKAY. I had to stand up several times to grab straw wrappers and napkins before they blew into the water. If you're going to have a waterfront/beach front business, be responsible about it. It would be a very easy fix-just a screen on the bottom of the fence. The food was good but I won't be back.
Refine this for me please: The service at this diner is disappointingly slow and the waitresses lack friendliness. Given its high ratings, I had higher expectations. Considering its location in a tourist area, I understand some limitations, but prioritizing service should still be a focus. Something that particularly bothered me was the excessive trash on the outside deck, which poses a threat to the ocean. This is absolutely unacceptable. I had to repeatedly get up to prevent straw wrappers and napkins from blowing into the water. If you choose to operate a waterfront or beachfront business, it's crucial to take responsibility for maintaining cleanliness. A simple solution would be to install a screen on the bottom of the fence. While the food was satisfactory, I won't be returning to this establishment.

input:
I recently had the pre fixe meal for $22 and I enjoyed the combination of tastes on my plate. The chicken was moist my veggies were tasty but a little too greasy....overall is was a great meal. 

I also use them for take out/delivery. I have always enjoyed the way the package their food, in plastic containers that I use over and over again until they look too worn out and I recycle them. I hate take out places that use so much boxes and cups and card board - it's extremely eco-unfriendly. 

The food here is never spectacular but is a good standby you will always come away enjoying. The prices seem a little steep but the restaurant atmosphere is contemporary, the service has always been splendid and the food is dependable.
Refine this for me please:
I recently enjoyed a pre fixe meal for $22, and I was pleased with the combination of flavors on my plate. The chicken was moist, and while the veggies were tasty, they were slightly greasy. Overall, it was a great meal.

In addition to dining in, I also utilize their take-out and delivery services. I appreciate the way they package their food in reusable plastic containers, which I continue to use until they become too worn out, at which point I recycle them. It's refreshing to see a establishment that avoids excessive use of boxes, cups, and cardboard, as it is not eco-friendly.

Although the food is never exceptional, it serves as a reliable option that one can always enjoy. The prices may be a bit high, but the contemporary restaurant atmosphere, consistently splendid service, and dependable food make up for it.

input: It's no different than any other Chinese place. Same menu, etc. this place does have some good lunch specials though, and the food is always ready when I go to pick it up.
Refine this for me please: This Chinese restaurant offers a similar experience to other establishments of its kind, featuring a menu and overall ambiance that is comparable. However, it stands out due to its enticing lunch specials, which are worth trying. One of its notable strengths is the promptness in having the food ready when you arrive for pick-up.

input: Finally got to eat here last night. Eclectic foodie menu. I had their onion tart as an app and Kerry had the veal meatballs with sauce on polenta, very delicious. The red gravy tasted like my own. We both ordered the special of citrus short ribs with fat noodles and brussel sprouts, peas. couldn't finish we will be back to try other interesting items. Small crowded but great friendly atmosphere
Refine this for me please:
I had the opportunity to dine at this restaurant last night and I must say, it was worth the wait. The menu offered a delightful mix of flavors, appealing to even the most discerning food enthusiasts. As an appetizer, I indulged in their delectable onion tart, while my companion, Kerry, thoroughly enjoyed the veal meatballs served on a bed of polenta, accompanied by a flavorful sauce.

The richness and authenticity of the red gravy truly impressed me, as it reminded me of my own homemade culinary creations. For our main course, we both decided to try the citrus-infused short ribs, which were accompanied by generous portions of fat noodles, brussel sprouts, and peas. The combination of these ingredients resulted in a harmonious blend of textures and flavors, one that left us wanting more.

Although we couldn't quite finish our plates due to the generous portions, we left feeling satisfied and eager to return to explore the other intriguing options on the menu. Despite the small and crowded setting, the restaurant exuded a welcoming and friendly atmosphere that greatly added to our overall dining experience.

Overall, if you're looking for a unique and satisfying dining experience, I highly recommend checking out this establishment. Its eclectic foodie menu and inviting ambiance are sure to leave a lasting impression.

input: Last night we tried to get into the oldest Italian Restaurant in South Philly. Thankfully, they couldn't fit us in, so our son said lets try Angelina's  so we walked around the corner and into a small Italian Restaurant.  Immediatly we felt at home.  Angelina is cooking in the front of the resaurant and her husband is servicing. There were 3 of us and we started off with Eggplant and roasted pepper appetizer.  One bite and we were hooked.  We ordered the Veal Osso Bocca, Carbonara and lasagna.  Everything was absolutly DELISH!!  Can't wait to go back!!!
Refine this for me please: Last night, we had our hearts set on dining at the oldest Italian Restaurant in South Philly. However, luck worked in our favor as they were unable to accommodate us. Our son then suggested trying Angelina's, so we strolled around the corner and stumbled upon a charming, cozy Italian restaurant. As soon as we entered, an overwhelming sense of comfort washed over us. Angelina herself was stationed in the front of the establishment, skillfully preparing the dishes, while her husband tended to the customers. With a party of three, we decided to commence our culinary journey with an irresistible Eggplant and roasted pepper appetizer. One mouthwatering bite was all it took for us to become completely enchanted. We proceeded to order the Veal Osso Bocca, Carbonara, and lasagna, all of which turned out to be absolutely divine. Each dish was bursting with flavor and left us longing for more. Needless to say, we are eagerly anticipating our next visit to this hidden gem.

input: great food, great view. Try the lobster mac and cheese
Refine this for me please: Experience the epitome of culinary delight with an awe-inspiring view. Indulge in an unparalleled combination of flavors by savoring our exquisite lobster mac and cheese.

input: Super tasty and enormous portions. Some unique flavors too. Not much else to say but an amazing ice cream store that others should try to emulate.
Refine this for me please: Delight your taste buds with an exceptional ice cream adventure, as this store offers a delectable assortment of flavors alongside generously satisfying portions. With a plethora of unique flavors to satiate your cravings, this establishment stands as an epitome of excellence that others should strive to replicate.

input: The food is average. Drink specials are great but the place is rarely crowded. Last time I was there it was a Friday night at 10 pm. There were maybe 3 other parties at the bar. About 5 minutes after ordering our first drink, they announced it was last call...at 10:15 PM on a Friday night! Needless to say we left for a different bar in the area and have removed it from our options of places to go past 6 pm for drinks.
Refine this for me please: The food is mediocre at best, but they do have excellent drink specials. However, the lack of crowd is quite noticeable and off-putting. On my last visit, a Friday night at 10 pm, there were only three other parties at the bar. To add to the disappointment, our experience worsened when, just five minutes after ordering our first drink, the staff announced last call - at 10:15 pm on a Friday night! Needless to say, we promptly left and have decided to remove it from our list of potential after 6 pm drink destinations in the area.

input: A good place to order from when its late and you have the muchies... for whatever reason ;-)
Refine this for me please: An excellent late-night option to satisfy your cravings, regardless of the cause, is to order from a reliable establishment.

input:
You think Value City, you think cheap value, right? Wrong! 

Think Rothman prices with Ashley Furniture pieces. Not a Broyhill in sight. 

Negatives:
- Entertainment centers and TV stand selection is small, and over priced selection.
-Their "Clearance" section is laughable and not much of a sale. No one is going to pay $299 for a nicked up coffee table that was originally $350. Go lower. 
- Sectionals by themselves average around $1,000 by brands I've never heard of. 
- The staff hangs out like a clique chatting in the middle of the store rather than helping customers. 
-Dining sets are nothing special and overpriced as well. I've seen the same selection everywhere else at a lower price. 
-5% military discount? Ooooh you're going to knock $20 off my sofa! 

Only Positive:
-They have a few modern pieces. 

Overall:

I think they're high for low quality-mediocre furniture. Shop around town. Or if you do find something you must have here, wait for a holiday sale.
Refine this for me please:
Refined version:

When you hear the name Value City, you may expect affordable bargains, but that's not the case. Think along the lines of Rothman prices combined with Ashley Furniture quality. Forget about finding any Broyhill items here.

Negatives:
- The selection of entertainment centers and TV stands is disappointingly small, with prices that are overly inflated.
- Their "Clearance" section is hardly worthy of the name. Who would pay $299 for a damaged coffee table that originally cost $350? Lower those prices.
- Sectionals from unfamiliar brands average around $1,000 each, leaving potential buyers skeptical.
- The staff seems more focused on their own conversations and socializing than assisting customers.
- Dining sets are lackluster and overpriced; you can find the same options elsewhere for less.
- Their 5% military discount amounts to a mere $20 off on a sofa.

Only Positive:
- They do offer a limited selection of modern pieces.

Overall:
In my opinion, Value City offers mediocre furniture at high prices. It's worth checking out other stores around town, or waiting for a holiday sale if you happen to find something you love here.

input: I really like Franzone's. The owner is typically around, super friendly, and seems to really care about the product. While I'm not a big fan of sweet sauce, they also do a decent cheesesteak, fries, etc. Honestly, they may have been closer to a 4 if not that it's always just a really pleasant experience going in, which boosts their rating for me.
Refine this for me please: I have a strong preference for Franzone's due to their exceptional service and genuine enthusiasm for their products. The owner, who is often present, is incredibly friendly and genuinely passionate about offering a great experience. Although I am not particularly fond of sweet sauce, they do serve decent cheesesteaks and fries, among other menu items. Their overall rating may have hovered around a 4, but the consistently pleasant experience I have every time I visit significantly elevates their rating in my eyes.

input:
Finally had the chance to stop by Bab Cafe...what took us so long!  Both of us being Asian food fanatics, we are so happy to have Bab Cafe part of our ever expanding culinary experience here in Reno.

With the guidance of the very friendly and knowledgeable staff, we quickly got a hang of what to order, though there will be many more choices on our future visits.  Liking things a little spicy, we both ordered the Jeyuk Top-Bab (spicy pork).  What incredible flavor!  There is nothing that compares to this place in Reno.  The sauce bar gives you the opportunity to mix things up and the included miso soup is a definite bonus.  Great value for such a fresh, enjoyable meal.  Convenient downtown location to take away, dine in or have it delivered via UberEats.
Refine this for me please:
Finally had the opportunity to visit Bab Cafe and it was truly worth the wait! As avid Asian food enthusiasts, we couldn't be happier to have Bab Cafe as part of our growing culinary journey in Reno.

With the assistance of the extremely friendly and knowledgeable staff, we quickly grasped the menu and made our selections, although we know there are plenty more dishes to try on our future visits. Both of us, fond of some spice, opted for the Jeyuk Top-Bab (spicy pork) and were blown away by its incredible flavor. There is simply no comparison to any other place in Reno. The sauce bar provided us with the chance to experiment and the complimentary miso soup was a delightful addition. We were pleasantly surprised by the excellent value offered for such a fresh and enjoyable meal. Bab Cafe's downtown location allows for take-out, dine-in, or convenient delivery via UberEats.

input: First meal in New Orleans. I had the $15 lunch special, a seafood stew (with oyster meat, crab claws, shrimp, and redfish) that came with a surprisingly thoughtful salad. Yeah, it's weird: I'm not even a fan of seafood and, to be honest, I wasn't even really that hungry. Still, before I knew what I was doing I had wolfed down the entire thing. The spice, consistency, tenderness of the meat -- all was precisely just right. Well worth your while.
Refine this for me please: First meal in New Orleans. I indulged in the delicious $15 lunch special which included a flavorful seafood stew comprised of oyster meat, crab claws, shrimp, and redfish. Surprisingly, it also came with a well-crafted salad, showcasing the thoughtfulness of the offering. Despite not being a seafood enthusiast and not particularly hungry at the time, I found myself devouring the entire dish without hesitation. The perfectly balanced spice, delightful consistency, and succulent tenderness of the seafood made it a truly satisfying experience. Highly recommended and definitely worth trying.

input: Totally worth the wait despite the heat!  I had the Vegan grits with a biscuit on the side. OMG!  So good. My 3 sisters each enjoyed their choices as well. Caution, the bloody Mary's are spicy!  The service was excellent. Really considering the wait was 45 mins, the line moved fast and then there was no long wait for our food. They have their process perfected!  Thanks Biscuit Love for a Delish breakfast!!!
Refine this for me please: Despite the scorching heat, the wait was completely worthwhile! I opt for the Vegan grits which came with a delicious biscuit on the side - OMG, it was incredible! My three sisters were equally delighted with their choices. Just a heads up, the bloody Mary's pack quite the spicy punch! The service was top-notch, especially considering we only waited 45 minutes and our food arrived promptly. Biscuit Love has truly perfected their operations! A big thank you to them for providing us with a delightfully tasty breakfast!

input:
Ichicoro Ane gets lots of things right and the best part about it is the combination of the ambiance with the food choices and whiskey selection. I'm very happy with this location and the servers I have encountered so far have been helpful and pleasant.

The katsu is great and I highly recommend it to people looking for a more filling dish on the menu. The bao buns were also good for a lighter fish. I haven't had anything I really regretted trying, but definitely ask your server about the portion sizes of each dish since they vary across the menu.

The cocktail selection is excellent. I even had a special Japanese Old Fashioned last time which was a little expensive, but well worth it for some quality Japanese whiskey. 

I'm looking forward to exploring the menu little by little. The best way to experience this is in a group setting so you can try more things and it really reminds me of Izakayas or Japanese pubs I visited in Japan and Korea.
Refine this for me please:
Ichicoro Ane excels in many areas, especially the seamless fusion of its ambiance, delectable food choices, and extensive whiskey selection. I am thoroughly satisfied with this establishment, as the servers I have encountered thus far have been attentive and amiable.

One standout dish that I highly recommend is the katsu, perfect for those seeking a more satisfying option from the menu. Additionally, the bao buns offer a lighter alternative that is equally pleasing. I have yet to try anything that I regretted, but it is advisable to consult your server regarding portion sizes, as they differ throughout the menu.

The cocktail selection is superb, and on my last visit, I indulged in a special Japanese Old Fashioned, albeit a bit pricey, it was undoubtedly worth it for the exceptional quality of Japanese whiskey.

The prospect of gradually exploring the menu fills me with anticipation. The best way to fully immerse oneself in this experience is in the company of a group, allowing for the opportunity to sample a wider assortment of dishes. It truly brings back fond memories of the Izakayas and Japanese pubs I frequented in Japan and Korea.

input: Love this bakery!! Great breakfast sandwiches, coffee, and donuts! My friend and I love coming on weekend mornings
Refine this for me please: I absolutely adore this bakery! They serve the most delicious breakfast sandwiches, coffee, and donuts. It has become a weekend morning ritual for me and my friend to visit this place and indulge in their amazing offerings.

input: There is a great selection of whiskey/bourbon to suit anyone's taste. We had burgers with the fried egg on it and it was soo good and probably one of the best burgers I've ever had. The duck fries are a MUST if you come here. It is a cute atmosphere although we went with a party of 4 and it was a tad awkward the way our seating was and made it difficult to have conversation with everyone at our table. Overall, a nice place to go. We will be going back.
Refine this for me please: The establishment offers a fantastic variety of whiskey and bourbon that caters to every individual's preferences. We indulged in burgers topped with a fried egg, and they surpassed our expectations, making it one of the most memorable burgers we have ever savored. Additionally, the duck fries are an absolute must-try when visiting this venue. The atmosphere exudes charm and coziness; however, our party of four encountered a slight inconvenience with the seating arrangement, hindering our ability to engage in a smooth conversation with everyone at the table. Nevertheless, despite this minor setback, it remains a pleasant destination worth revisiting.

input: A++ for ambience. Very cozy English pub feel. Great drinks too - the bartenders here know how to mix 'em. That being said, the prices are steep (I paid $7 for a standard mixed drink) and the seating is limited.
Refine this for me please: The ambience is outstanding, earning an A++ rating. The cozy English pub atmosphere creates a welcoming feel. Furthermore, the bartenders excel at mixing drinks, offering a great selection. However, it's worth noting that the prices are on the higher side, with a standard mixed drink costing me $7. Additionally, due to limited seating, finding a spot may be a challenge.

input: Very cozy place to have a drink with friends.  The drinks were tasty and were served in very pretty glasses reminiscent of those some of our grandmothers had in their china cabinets. On the downside, all of the drinks seemed to have some combination of ginger, lime, and honey with the main difference being the kind of liquor you wanted in your drink.  So the choices felt limited.  I ordered the bacon wrapped dates, and have to admit that I was choking them down because I was hungry.  They tasted like they were double dipped in sugar.  Also, once another 10 or so people came in, it was very hard to hear each other because the noise level skyrocketed, which is surprising with so much fabric in the room.  The servers were nice and left us alone except to check on us every so often.  I don't recall being offered a second drink when my glass was taken away.
Refine this for me please: A charming and inviting spot to socialize with friends, offering delightful drinks served in exquisite vintage-inspired glasses. However, the drink menu heavily leaned towards combinations of ginger, lime, and honey, limiting the options available. I opted for the bacon wrapped dates, but found them to be overly sweet and difficult to enjoy as a result. As the crowd grew, the noise level became increasingly disruptive, despite the presence of fabric in the room. The servers were pleasant and gave us space, although I did not receive an offer for a second drink when my glass was taken away.

input: This place always delivers. Yet another great year with hayrides, pumpkin picking, and lots of other activities.
Refine this for me please: Consistently exceptional, this place continues to exceed expectations. Once again, another remarkable year filled with delightful hayrides, exciting pumpkin picking, and an extensive array of activities to indulge in.

input: Called in to get service information on my 2015 $110K AMG. Was told since I didn't purchase the vehicle at their dealership that I would have to pay for a loaner car for warranty work. Will be staying far away from here.
Refine this for me please: I contacted the dealership to inquire about service details for my 2015 $110K AMG. However, I was informed that because I didn't buy the vehicle from their dealership, I would need to pay for a loaner car during warranty work. This experience has left me with the decision to steer clear of this particular dealership in the future.

input: Like wholefoods but much smaller. They have all sorts of stuff from Salad bar, to a small selection of fresh fruits, juice bar. Great lil grocery store. Couldn't really find any other in the city. They have a parking lot. Great walking, just a couple blocks from clothing stores
Refine this for me please: This place is like a miniature version of Whole Foods. Despite its size, it offers an impressive range of options including a salad bar, a small selection of fresh fruits, and a juice bar. It is a fantastic little grocery store, which is quite hard to find elsewhere in the city. Additionally, there is a convenient parking lot available. The location is great for walking, as it is only a few blocks away from various clothing stores.

input: I absolutely love coming here. Great outdoor place with a wine selection you can't find anywhere else (not your typical wines you find in the grocery). The live music today was fabulous - and on a Thursday afternoon! Come here, get a few cheeses and wine and you will be satisfied. Oh, and the regular menu is crafty and artistic. It's a beautiful place with ambiance and on the palate.
Refine this for me please: I thoroughly enjoy visiting this establishment. It offers a wonderful outdoor setting accompanied by an exquisite wine selection that sets it apart from any other place, featuring unique options rarely found in grocery stores. The live music during my recent visit was absolutely fantastic, especially considering it was a Thursday afternoon. When you visit, make sure to indulge in their delectable cheese assortment accompanied by their exceptional wine offerings for a truly satisfying experience. Additionally, their regular menu is skillfully crafted and artistically presented, further adding to the allure of this beautiful establishment. The ambiance and the flavors it delivers are truly a treat for all the senses.

input: I love coming here to do my smog on my cars great service and chipper then most!!! I totally recommend this place.
Refine this for me please: I absolutely love coming to this place to get my smog done on my cars. The service here is consistently excellent, and the staff is always cheerful and friendly. I highly recommend this place to everyone.

input: Outstanding! They have great gluten-free and vegan options too. The salad, pizza, and root beer were just perfect.
Refine this for me please: Excellent! They offer a fantastic selection of gluten-free and vegan choices as well. The salad, pizza, and root beer were absolutely flawless.

input: My group of 6 all got burgers and were very satisfied. Very clean and nice place. Sweet potato tots are a must.
Refine this for me please: My group of six thoroughly enjoyed our burgers at this exceptional establishment. The restaurant was impeccably clean and had a pleasant ambiance. Additionally, we highly recommend indulging in their must-try sweet potato tots.
