input: This is a convenience store deli, so don't expect a neat restaurant setting or drink service (that's the only reason I give 4 stars instead of 5). I've had a Cuban press one time, and a breakfast sandwich at another time. Sandwiches are prepared upon your order and I was very happy with the food. Delicious! There are some tables inside and some outside on the dock, overlooking ocean. There is a more popular breakfast place (Maggie Mae's) in the same strip mall but taste-wise I must say I like this deli much better.
Refine this for me please: This convenience store deli provides a relaxed setting and does not offer table service or drinks, which is the only reason I give it 4 stars instead of 5. However, I have tried their Cuban press sandwich and breakfast sandwich on separate occasions, and both were made to order and incredibly delicious. The deli offers both indoor and outdoor seating options, with the outdoor tables providing a wonderful view of the ocean from the dock. While there is a more well-known breakfast spot (Maggie Mae's) in the same strip mall, I personally find the taste of this deli to be far superior.

input:
My 2nd experience here was even better than the first.  I do believe there were some kinks during the grand opening.  This time around they seemed to have more than 1 beer bottle opener, and the portion size of the garlic noodle did improve.  
The place still looked like it would get drafty at certain tables but we were seated at a better table this time around and I was not bothered by it.  Food was amazing as ever and I am looking forward to my next visit!
We had no problem getting seated on a sat evening at 5pm.  So glad to have these guys in the local neighborhood.  :D
Refine this for me please:
My second experience here surpassed my initial visit. During the grand opening, there were some minor issues, but this time they seemed to have resolved them. They now have multiple beer bottle openers, and the portion size of the garlic noodle has improved.

Although the place still appeared to have potential drafts at certain tables, we were fortunate to be seated at a better table this time, and it didn't bother me. The food was as amazing as ever, and I am eagerly anticipating my next visit.

We had no difficulties getting a table on a Saturday evening at 5pm. I am delighted to have these guys in the local neighborhood. :D

input:
I love Skyline Chili.  I first had this stuff in Cincinnati, and I was thrilled to when a location opened in Clearwater. 

This particular Skyline, however, is not great.  The service is generally poor, and the food comes out very slowly.   It seems like every time that I go, they are "out" of something, or some equipment isn't working.  Sometimes it's baked potatoes, sometimes it is french fries, sometimes it is something else.

Love the cheese coney hot dogs all the way!

I hope this location can get their act together.
Refine this for me please: I have a strong fondness for Skyline Chili, initially discovering it in Cincinnati and later finding joy in a new location in Clearwater. Unfortunately, this specific Skyline restaurant is lacking in several areas. The service is consistently subpar and their efficiency in delivering meals is quite slow. It is frustrating to encounter frequent instances of them running out of ingredients or having malfunctioning equipment. This disruption in availability varies from baked potatoes to french fries and other food items. Despite these shortcomings, my love for their cheese coney hot dogs remains unwavering. Nevertheless, I sincerely hope that this particular location can improve their overall performance and provide a more satisfactory experience for customers.

input:
So I no longer go here which is a shame because The eyebrow waxing here is fantastic. I am giving this 2 stars because when I have contacted for an appointment via the phone, it usually has taken days for me to get a response. The online booking is useless because I rarely have found appointments within 2 weeks of when I need it (and I'm very flexible with time of day). 

I give up on this place. Unless you book out weeks in advance, you will not get an appointment. I'm now paying $10 more elsewhere which sucks but I'm able to get seen when I need to be seen.
Refine this for me please: Unfortunately, I no longer frequent this establishment, which is a shame because their eyebrow waxing service is fantastic. However, I can only give it a two-star rating due to the significant delay in receiving a response when contacting them for an appointment via phone. Even their online booking system is ineffective as it rarely offers appointments within a two-week timeframe, despite my flexibility with the timing. Consequently, I have decided to give up on this place. Unless you plan weeks ahead, securing an appointment here is virtually impossible. As a result, I have resorted to paying $10 more elsewhere, which is unfortunate, but at least I can get an appointment when I need one.

input: great taco's, nacho's, atmosphere and margarita's.  wednesday is triple special day.
Refine this for me please: Refine this for me, please: Experience exceptional tacos, nachos, and a vibrant atmosphere, complemented by delectable margaritas. Don't miss out on our unbeatable Triple Special Day every Wednesday.

input:
Thanks yelp reviewers...you didn't let me down!  And neither did Todd and Roberta!  They just left my house and I am in awe of what an amazing job they did!  Carpet and couch looks great...spots where my dog a some accidents the other day are all gone! Everything just smells fresh...no chemicals to inhale and nothing has that "wet" smell.  And I can't believe how dry it all is so soon after!  Plus they are the
NICEST people with tons of knowledge and tips on how to care for your home.  Worth every penny and not only recommending them but definitely will be using them in the future!!!
Refine this for me please: Thank you, Yelp reviewers, for not disappointing me! I am extremely impressed with the outstanding service provided by Todd and Roberta. Just after they left my house, I was amazed by the remarkable job they did. Both my carpet and couch look fantastic, with no trace of the spots caused by my dog's accidents the other day. The freshness in the air without any chemical odors or dampness is unbelievable. Furthermore, I can't believe how quickly everything has dried up. Todd and Roberta are not only incredibly nice individuals but also possess a wealth of knowledge and valuable tips on home maintenance. Every penny spent was worth it, and I highly recommend their services. I will definitely be reaching out to them again in the future.

input: Love it here! Their sips mocha is my go-to. Staff has always been so nice! Absolutely love that they have a drive thru too, helps not to unload my kiddos. Oh and their cakes are amazing too!
Refine this for me please: I absolutely adore this place! Whenever I come here, I always go for their delicious mocha - it's become my favourite. The staff members are consistently friendly and welcoming, which adds to the overall wonderful experience. One of the things I truly appreciate is that they have a convenient drive-thru option, as it makes it much easier for me to bring my kids along without any hassle. Also, I must mention that their cakes are absolutely amazing - it's another reason why I love visiting this place.

input: I have been a fan of Chateau La Vin for a few years. It has been fun to watch the place evolve. At first it was more of a wine store with only a few tables. Now it has been transformed into a wine bar. He offers cheese and crackers and people order from the local restaurants and some of them even deliver. He had two guys playing music. He offers so many different wines and is willing to share his knowledge. My friend is a beer drinker and he has a nice variety for them as well. He does have a few tables out in front. This is a great place.....
Refine this for me please:
I have been an avid fan of Chateau La Vin for several years, and it has been such a joy to witness its remarkable transformation. Initially, it merely functioned as a wine store, with only a handful of tables available. However, it has since evolved into an exceptional wine bar that offers so much more. 

Nowadays, the owner has extended his offerings beyond wine, incorporating an assortment of delectable cheese and crackers. Moreover, he has established connections with numerous local restaurants, enabling patrons to order food from these establishments, some even offering convenient delivery options. Additionally, the ambiance is enhanced with the delightful live music performances by two talented individuals.

What truly sets Chateau La Vin apart is its vast selection of wines curated with meticulous care, accompanied by the owner's willingness to share his extensive knowledge. Even my beer-loving friend feels at home here, as the bar offers a splendid variety of beers catering to different preferences. And to top it off, a few outdoor tables are available, allowing guests to relish their experience even further.

In summary, Chateau La Vin is undeniably a marvelous place that has truly come into its own.

input:
We used The Hollander Hotel for our wedding hotel and it was an absolutely incredible experience.  I will never get tired of raving about our experience.  We were honored to use the Hollander not only for our room block and wedding night suite, but we also used the Tap Room as our after-party location and we hosted a brunch for our guests on the beautiful patio on Sunday morning after the wedding.  Everything was perfection and if we could do it all over again, we wouldn't change a thing!

The hotel property is absolutely charming.  The décor in the lobby is beautiful, eclectic, and very welcoming.  The Tap Room is a great place for people to gather with intimate booths and large tables for bigger parties.  The Bar has an amazing selection of local and craft beers and the servers and bartenders are all professional and fast! We were able to use the Lobby and Tap Room for some of our wedding photographs too, and they all look wonderful!

The rooms are very pleasant and quaint and our guests all complimented on how clean and cozy they were.  The prices were also wonderful and our guests were able to enjoy downtown St. Pete because of the great location.  The shuttle is also very convenient and a great experience for guests!

The brunch was perfect.  Not only was the price great for an all-you-can-enjoy feast, but the food is delicious and homemade.  The wonderful gentleman who makes the omelets is friendly, fast, and takes great pride in his work.  He is also a talented baker and I couldn't get enough of the chocolate muffins he made!  The service at the new coffee/dessert café was wonderful!  The Patio was a great place to visit with our guests and enjoy the beautiful St. Pete weather. We look forward to many more brunches there in the future! 

Finally, the best part of all is the management and team at the Hollander.  Nick and Will treated us like their own family.  They went above and beyond to ensure that each of our guests felt like they were at home and comfortable.  Zach at the front desk was so friendly and patient with me as I called checking on our room block.  The entire team was just a delight and so very accommodating.  They take great pride in ensuring that every guest has a wonderful experience.  We just adore everyone there!  I absolutely loved working with them and would recommend this beautiful hotel to anyone!
Refine this for me please:
We had an amazing experience at The Hollander Hotel for our wedding. From the room block and wedding night suite to the after-party at the Tap Room and Sunday brunch on the patio, everything was perfect. The hotel property is charming, with a beautiful and welcoming lobby. The Tap Room provided a great gathering space, with intimate booths and large tables. The bar had an impressive selection of local and craft beers, and the service was professional and fast. We even took some wedding photographs in the lobby and Tap Room, and they turned out wonderful.

The rooms were pleasant and cozy, and our guests were impressed with how clean they were. The affordable prices allowed our guests to enjoy downtown St. Pete, and the convenient shuttle service added to their experience.

The brunch was a highlight, with delicious homemade food at a great price. The omelet chef was friendly, fast, and took pride in his work. The coffee/dessert café had excellent service, and the patio was the perfect place to enjoy St. Pete's beautiful weather. We can't wait to have more brunches there in the future.

The Hollander's management and team truly made our stay memorable. Nick and Will treated us like family, going above and beyond to ensure our guests felt at home. Zach at the front desk was friendly and patient, and the entire team was accommodating and attentive. They take pride in providing a wonderful experience for every guest. Working with them was a pleasure, and we highly recommend this beautiful hotel to anyone.

input: I got the gyro "platter" for lunch, which was dry, uninspired, and nothing like a deconstructed gyro. Worst of all, it came with "vegetables" which looked more like poop. Tasted that way, too. There are better places in Fairmount for lunch, and they won't serve you poop, either.
Refine this for me please: I ordered the gyro platter for lunch, but unfortunately, it failed to meet my expectations. It was incredibly dry, lacking any inspiration, and hardly resembled a deconstructed gyro. To make matters worse, the dish came with a serving of "vegetables" that resembled unpleasant objects. Not only did they look unappetizing, but they also tasted horrendous. Thankfully, there are superior lunch options available in Fairmount, where you won't have to worry about being served distasteful ingredients.

input: I went there for drinks and found the environment really nice with the brewery right there. The beer was good and the waiter was very knowledgable and kind
Refine this for me please: I visited the place specifically for drinks and was pleasantly surprised by the charming environment, complete with the brewery on-site. The quality of the beer exceeded my expectations, and to top it off, the waiter was not only friendly but also impressively knowledgeable about the selection.

input: OMG! What an amazing dinner experience. A friend recommended this place and it was incredible. We had two of their signature dishes -- the BBQ shrimp and bread pudding. input: Very impressed with this place! The food was amazing. Quick service chipotle style line ordering but with high-quality Indian food. Also the staff was super helpful in helping me decide what to get since I'm an Indian food newbie. Can't wait to eat there again!

input:
Although there are countless little Mexican places below Washington Avenue, I never get sick of them and always look forward to trying the new kid on the block. This time it was El Sabor Poblano on Federal, which could not look less special if it tried.

I liked that there were 3 fish tacos on the menu.  I picked the fried and battered version, though the tortilla chip covered fish could have been awesome. I was instantly impressed when I opened one of my three and found that El Sabor puts an entire filet of fish in each taco! The flakey meat had no fishy taste. These tacos came with the more American toppings of lettuce and, tomato, and cheese. I bet I could have gotten cilantro and onion if I asked. The sole staff member in the place seemed happy to accommodate us- well, we were the only ones dining in.

Another taco filling option that comes with more traditional toppings is the super crispy chorizo, only $8 for 3. There was no detectable gristle here, something I have often come across at this little places.

As unassuming as it looks, this particular South Philly Mexican place is worth stopping by.
Refine this for me please:
Although there are numerous Mexican eateries below Washington Avenue, I never tire of them and always anticipate trying the latest addition. This time, it was El Sabor Poblano on Federal, which doesn't make much of an impression at first glance.

One aspect I appreciated about their menu was the availability of three fish taco options. I opted for the fried and battered version, although the tortilla chip coated fish had potential. Upon opening one of the three tacos, I was instantly impressed to discover that El Sabor Poblano includes a whole filet of fish in each taco. The flaky meat had no unpleasant fishy flavor. These tacos were served with the more Americanized toppings of lettuce, tomato, and cheese, and I suspect I could have requested cilantro and onion if desired. The sole staff member, who seemed content to accommodate us, as we were the only diners present.

Another filling option for tacos, which comes with more traditional toppings, is the superbly crispy chorizo, priced at a reasonable $8 for three tacos. Unlike some other places, I encountered no gristle in this offering.

Despite its unassuming appearance, this South Philly Mexican spot is definitely worth a visit.

input: I met a buddy mine at this spot that I have always wanted to go to, but have never had the time. I walked in and sat at the bar. The police were investigating a burglary from the overnight it seemed some dirt bags broke in on a side door and stole a bunch of liquor from the bar. The bartender was great and service was prompt. I ordered a pint  of dark ale and my buddy and I split a order of wings. The beer was cold and the wings were very tasty. I remembered meeting the owners of the establishment at the last Italian Fest at the Farmers Market so I really wanted to like this place as they were very friendly folks. I will continue to patronize this spot as it was a great spot close to home and work. I also like the locally non franchised making it work attitude that this place gives. I really was very comfortable at this establishment and well tell the rest of fellow Yelpers to hit this spot!!!
Refine this for me please: I met up with a friend of mine at a place I had always wanted to visit but never found the time for. As I walked in, I noticed that the police were investigating a burglary that had occurred overnight. It appeared that some thieves had broken in through a side door and stolen a large amount of liquor from the bar. Despite this unfortunate incident, the bartender was attentive and provided excellent service. I decided to order a pint of dark ale and my friend and I shared a plate of wings. The beer was refreshingly cold and the wings were absolutely delicious. I recalled meeting the friendly owners of the establishment at the last Italian Fest at the Farmers Market, which made me want to support this place even more. It's conveniently close to both my home and workplace, and I appreciate that it's a locally-owned establishment rather than a franchise. I felt incredibly comfortable in this establishment and will definitely recommend it to other fellow Yelpers.

input: Found this place on Yelp. The reviews speak for themselves and are so true. The sandwiches are really tasty. Definitely worth the wait in line. Fast and friendly service. We waited about 15 minutes in line, ordered 4 different sandwiches, filled up our sodas, walked out to our table, and our sandwiches were delivered to us as we say down. We enjoyed our meal.
Refine this for me please: I discovered this place on Yelp, and the glowing reviews truly reflect its excellence. The sandwiches here are unbelievably delicious, making the wait in line worth it. input: By far some of the most comfy theater recliners. My only complaint is that you have to put your feet down if someone wants to pass by you on the aisle. Refine this for me please:
This theater offers incredibly comfortable recliners, making for a great movie-watching experience. However, one drawback is that you have to put your feet down to allow others to pass by in the aisle. On a positive note, the bartender at the adjacent lounge is delightful, and the option to enjoy a drink in the theater is a welcomed bonus.

Unfortunately, the concessions experience leaves much to be desired. Despite having 5-6 employees working during a busy Saturday time, there was a noticeable lack of organization and urgency. Additionally, the popcorn was burnt, which was disappointing. In the future, I plan to eat beforehand and stick to the bar for refreshments.

input: This is one of the best hotels I have ever stayed at.  Clean, polite staff, nice pool and grand entrance.   I can't wait until next year to come back.
Refine this for me please: I had an exceptional experience at this hotel, making it one of the best I've stayed at. The cleanliness was impeccable, and the staff was incredibly polite. input:

No worries, we just wanted a couple of beers.  We sampled several varieties, all of which were average.  Nothing memorable about any of the six styles we tried.

On a quiet Sunday afternoon, we visited this establishment and found it to be sparsely populated. Opting to sit at the bar, we were greeted by a bartender who promptly informed us that most of their food items were unavailable. Undeterred, we decided to just grab a few beers instead. Although we tried several varieties, none of the six styles stood out as particularly memorable - all seemed rather average.

Regrettably, the staff seemed to be in a sour mood due to their colleague's tardiness. This was evident by their heated discussion behind the bar, audible to all patrons. This unpleasant atmosphere put a damper on our overall experience.

Despite its desirable location and appealing ambiance, we are hesitant to return based on this particular visit, as there are superior options nearby.

input: I've been to many art museums and was surprised to see a museum this beautiful with such a great collection to be FREE! I was so happy to have had discovered this museum in my short time in Indianapolis. I loved the African Art and the Modern Art sections (although I did make a mistake taking out my camera for the Modern Art museums.. that's a no no). The outdoor sculpture garden and gift shop was awesome as well. Highly recommended!
Refine this for me please: I was pleasantly surprised by the extraordinary beauty of this art museum and its impressive collection, especially considering the fact that admission was free. During my brief visit to Indianapolis, I stumbled upon this hidden gem and couldn't be happier about the discovery. The African Art and Modern Art sections were particularly captivating, although I did make a regrettable mistake of taking out my camera in the Modern Art section, which was prohibited. Additionally, the outdoor sculpture garden and gift shop were equally delightful. I highly recommend visiting this museum.

input:
You would think from the size of the place it would be good for groups, but in my experience with 9 people on Saturday at 11am it was about a very hungry, tiring wait to get a seat. 

We tried to make reservations, but they do not take them. And I think we were too small to be put in the side meeting room. So hangry we stood, hoping for just the right table to leave.

The manager was nice enough to offer to fill cups of coffee for us while we waited. But I thought it was odd that they just didn't refill the pot for everyone who was waiting. 

Now for the food...They have these 1/2 and 1/2 combos. Which I love! I got a turkey Reuben and salad. I asked for lots of sauerkraut, and they charged $0.50 for it.. Which is no biggie but I'd expect a lot of kraut. Sadly there was not a lot of it.. But it was still a delicious sandwhich.  :) My friend got the sunrise chile rellenos. If I come back with a smaller party, that is what I would get.
Refine this for me please:
Despite its size, the restaurant did not adequately accommodate our group of 9 people on a Saturday morning at 11 am. Despite attempting to make reservations, they do not accept them, and we were deemed too small to be seated in the side meeting room. As a result, we had to endure a long and frustrating wait for a table.

To their credit, the manager kindly offered to fill our cups with coffee while we waited. However, it was odd that they did not simply refill the pot for all the individuals waiting.

Moving on to the food, the restaurant offers enticing 1/2 and 1/2 combos, which I personally enjoyed. I ordered a turkey Reuben sandwich with a side salad and requested extra sauerkraut, which incurred an additional charge of $0.50. Unfortunately, the amount of sauerkraut provided was disappointingly small. Nonetheless, the sandwich itself was still delicious. On the other hand, my friend ordered the sunrise chile rellenos, which I would definitely choose if I were to return with a smaller party.

input: The Shop is an amazing space! Their attention to detail and services are unbelievable. Plenty of places to have private meetings as well as post up and get work done.

input: Terrace Lounge appears to want to have a great cocktail venue, but they fall short.  One bartender didn't even know there was a new cocktail menu.  The cocktail was weak and watery, and the liquors they have here and throughout Peppermill are the most unfortunate corporate types.  The service is also very spotty.  It confounded me how four bartenders could not seem to handle about 45 customers.  They didn't have any bar areas, so they all floated around the circle, but then they'd stop, often just short of me and go to the waitress stations to fill their orders.  You can't really build up any rapport with four bartenders floating around trying to serve everyone.  I also hated the people there.  Sorry, but many were your run-of-the-mill casino gamblers.  Why don't you just sit at a machine and play?  You didn't come here for the drinks or to smooze with the bartenders, so seriously, go sit at a machine.  One just sat next to me and lite up a cancer stick and the smoke just blew in my face.  Look, if I walk into a bar and sit next to someone, it's their turf.  They can smoke, fart, vomit on themselves, if I don't like it I can leave.  But if I'm there, it's my turf.  Don't come sit next to me and smoke, fart, or vomit all over yourself.  Or at least be frickin thoughtful and if you see your smoke wafting in my face, put your cancer stick and tray on the other side of the bar so it wafts in your face.  Oh, you don't like smoke in your face???  Me neither moron.  Your life revovles around throwing away your pension money in a mindless electronic game of cards and killing yourself with carcinogens and toxins, well go kill yourself in private, seriously.  You don't see me walking up to a bar and slitting my wrists and burning my money.  It's gross.  I probably just realized this, but I really enjoy Cin Cin not only because they have the best cocktails in town, but they have no machines at the bar.  Peppermill, if you want to create a cool cocktail bar, ditch the machines, train your staff, or hire bartenders with better service skills, and buy some independent liquors.
Refine this for me please: The Terrace Lounge falls short of being a great cocktail venue. One of the bartenders was unaware of the new cocktail menu, resulting in a weak and watery drink. The selection of liquors throughout Peppermill, including the lounge, is disappointing and lacks diversity. Additionally, the service is inconsistent and inefficient. Despite having four bartenders, they struggled to handle a relatively small number of customers. The lack of designated bar areas led to a scattered and impersonal interaction with the staff. Furthermore, the clientele at the lounge consists mainly of typical casino gamblers, making the atmosphere less appealing. It is frustrating when individuals choose to smoke next to others without considering their preferences or personal space. If someone chooses to engage in harmful habits, it is best for them to do so privately. As a contrast, I have come to appreciate Cin Cin because they not only serve the best cocktails in town but also have a bar free from gaming machines. For the Terrace Lounge to improve and establish itself as a quality cocktail bar, it should consider removing the machines, providing proper training for the staff, and sourcing a selection of independent liquors.

input:
Thank you for a lovely morning!  I was in NJ early and decided to stop in for a delicious diner breakfast.  I got a taylor ham, egg, and cheese and a short stack of blueberry pancakes (I simply couldn't decide between sweet or savory, plus leftovers are never a bad thing).  

The egg sandwich was fantastic.  I was nervous when they said they didn't have kaiser rolls so I went with a hamburger roll.  It was an excellent decision.  The roll was excellent - not just an average cheap hamburger roll.  They layered the cheese on the sandwich, which to me is a must for a true egg sandwich.  It was served with home fries, which were sauteed with large slices of peppers and onions.  I'm not the biggest breakfast potatoes fan, but these were great and I appreciated that they didn't clearly just scoop some food from a huge pile of pre-cooked home fries.

The pancakes were great and fluffy.  My one gripe was their use of smuckers pre-packaged syrup.  I realize that if they put syrup in a container, it probably wouldn't be real maple syrup, but I sort of wish I didn't know that they were giving me sub-par syrup.

The server was friendly and very attentive.  The coffee refills were constant, and the coffee was actually good (so many diners fail at coffee).  Bonus points for the server agreeing not to judge my decision to get two breakfasts.

All around, I loved this place and hope to go back soon.  Long live the Jersey diners!
Refine this for me please:
Thank you for a wonderful morning! I had the opportunity to stop by a delightful diner in NJ for breakfast and it was truly a treat. I decided to indulge in a Taylor ham, egg, and cheese sandwich, along with a short stack of mouthwatering blueberry pancakes. The choice between sweet and savory was a tough one, but I couldn't resist trying both, especially since leftovers are always a welcome bonus.

The egg sandwich exceeded my expectations. Initially worried when I learned they didn't have kaiser rolls, I opted for a hamburger roll and it turned out to be an excellent decision. The roll itself was far from average, demonstrating their attention to quality. Moreover, they generously layered the cheese in the sandwich, which for me is an essential element of a truly satisfying egg sandwich. The dish was complemented by their delicious home fries, sautéed with large slices of flavorful peppers and onions. As someone who isn't the biggest fan of breakfast potatoes, I was pleasantly surprised by how great they tasted. It was evident that their home fries were made with care, rather than simply scooped from a mass-produced pile of pre-cooked potatoes.

The pancakes were another highlight, being perfectly fluffy and delicious. The only disappointment was their choice of Smuckers pre-packaged syrup. While I understand that containerized syrup may not be real maple syrup, I couldn't help but wish they had opted for a higher quality option.

In addition to the fantastic food, the service at the diner was top-notch. The server was friendly, attentive, and ensured that my coffee cup was consistently refilled. I was particularly impressed by the coffee, as many diners tend to fall short in that department. I also greatly appreciated the server's agreement to not judge my decision to indulge in two breakfasts.

Overall, I absolutely loved this place and can't wait to return. Long live the Jersey diners!

We paid 35 dollars for the "piano guys" to sing a song to the birthday girl. We had 3 options of songs that we wanted to hear. They called our birthday girl on stage and began to sing a rendition of Aladins whole new world. (Which was not one of the songs we had picked) The song quickly turned to a absolutely disgusting remake. Also for 35 dollars we paid we only heard 1 of the songs which they only sang  part of.
Refine this for me please: Our overall dining experience was primarily influenced by our exceptional server who was attentive and very friendly. Additionally, the maple wings were delicious, contributing to our positive impression of the place. However, we did encounter some significant issues. We paid $35 for the "piano guys" to serenade the birthday girl with a song of our choice, choosing from three provided options. To our surprise, they performed a rendition of Aladdin's "A Whole New World," which was not on our list. Unfortunately, the performance quickly deviated into an inappropriately explicit remake. The piano guy sang explicit and offensive lyrics involving the birthday girl, such as explicit references to physical intimacy and inappropriate acts. Not only was this highly offensive, but it also made the situation extremely uncomfortable, especially considering her husband, family, and even her parents were present in the audience, albeit with some difficulty hearing due to poor sound system quality. Despite our group's reasonable thresholds for humor, this performance crossed a line beyond acceptability. It completely marred our experience and prompted an immediate departure from the establishment. input:
The new Han Dynasty took over the spot where the old Mid-Atlantic restaurant (with the unchanging menu) was. I like the Han Dynasty here a lot more than the one in Olde City even if I give both 4*. Maybe I'm biased, because I love the service here. They've always been very nice, and came over to check in with me and just make some small conversation when they heard I had a peanut allergy (even though they had no peanuts in any of the dishes I ordered; I think it was Han's sister?). I've been to this Han Dynasty more times in a month than the number of times I've been to the other.

Note though, that the different branches have different specialties. I heard the dan dan mian in Olde City is the best, but the one in UC isn't so good (I wouldn't know since it has peanuts). Overall, I think it;s okay food wise, still not spicy enough as with the other branch. But I like the layout and atmosphere a lot more.

Next, if you go during lunch, you can ask for lunch portions, that are smaller than the dinner portions, and half the menu price! So it's a great lunch place too, alone, or in a group of 2 or 3.
Refine this for me please:
The new Han Dynasty has replaced the old Mid-Atlantic restaurant, which had a stagnant menu. Personally, I prefer this Han Dynasty location over the one in Olde City, even though I would rate both establishments with 4 stars. Perhaps I am biased because I really appreciate the excellent service here. The staff has always been kind and attentive, going the extra mile to check in on me and engage in small talk when they learned about my peanut allergy (even though none of the dishes I ordered contained peanuts; I believe it was Han's sister who did so). I have visited this Han Dynasty location more frequently in a month than I have visited the other one.

However, it's worth noting that each branch has its own specialties. I have heard that the dan dan mian in Olde City is the best, but unfortunately, I cannot confirm since the dish contains peanuts and I am unable to try it. Overall, I find the food quality satisfactory, although it could be spicier like the other branch. Nevertheless, I find the restaurant's layout and atmosphere much more appealing.

Additionally, if you visit during lunchtime, you have the option to request lunch portions, which are smaller in size and half the price of the dinner portions. This makes it a great choice for a solo lunch or a small group of 2 or 3 people.

input:
We went to Carisma Restaurante again tonight. It has become our "go to" spot. The food is excellent and the service was great. The owner Jose is very friendly and tries to visit every table to make sure everyone is satisfied.  Tonight we had 2 Paellas, salmon and a filet mignon. Everything was made to order, cooked to perfection and came out hot.  

The family also opened a cafe in front of the restaurant. Jose gave us a tour and introduced us to his daughter that runs the cafe. The baked goods and coffees at the cafe are just as good as the meals at Carisma. Good, fresh food prepared and served by nice people. Try Carisma, it's so much more than just the normal tacos and burritos. You wont be disappointed!
Refine this for me please:
We once again dined at Carisma Restaurante tonight, solidifying it as our preferred restaurant. The food remains consistently excellent, and the service was outstanding. The owner, Jose, goes out of his way to ensure the satisfaction of every patron by personally visiting each table. 

For our meal this evening, we indulged in 2 beautifully prepared Paellas, alongside a delectable salmon and a perfectly cooked filet mignon. Each dish was crafted to order, cooked flawlessly, and served piping hot.

Moreover, the family behind Carisma has recently expanded their enterprise by opening a café in front of the restaurant. During our visit, Jose kindly provided us with a tour of the café and introduced us to his daughter, who manages its operations. The café impressively offers a selection of baked goods and coffees that are on par with the culinary excellence found at Carisma.

Carisma is an extraordinary establishment, where you can enjoy a remarkable dining experience accompanied by warm and friendly service. They offer more than just the expected tacos and burritos. We wholeheartedly recommend giving Carisma a try and assuring you that disappointment will not be on the menu.

input: This is a small hole in the wall in the African section of Woodland Avenue.  Though it might not look like much, there is some good food coming out of its kitchen representing Senegal and West Africa.  I enjoyed the national dish of Senegal - Thiboudienne - although note that here they do a version without the usual tomato sauce.  I also took home a Jollof Rice which is often called the mother dish of Jambalaya.  There are a few hightop tables inside for dining or you can order the food to-go.  Either way, service is friendly.
Refine this for me please: Located on Woodland Avenue in the African section, this unassuming eatery might be easy to overlook. However, don't be fooled by its modest appearance, as it serves up delectable dishes representing Senegal and West Africa. One must-try item is the Thiboudienne, Senegal's national dish, albeit without the traditional tomato sauce. Additionally, I highly recommend taking home a serving of Jollof Rice, often referred to as the "mother dish" of Jambalaya. Whether you choose to dine in at one of the few hightop tables or opt for takeout, you can expect friendly service.

input: Had a falafel wrap here a few years ago. Not bad, so tried it again today. No flavor, except extreme saltiness! The falafels & pita = no flavor. I was hoping the tzatziki sauce would pull it all together, nope! It had no flavor either. It wasn't like the sauce you'd imagine, but more like a thin tasteless glue. Only good part about the wrap were the fresh diced cucumber & tomato, too bad that was underneath the icky white sauce that doesn't even deserve to be called tzatziki : (
Refine this for me please: A few years ago, I had a falafel wrap here and it was decent. However, when I tried it again today, it lacked any flavor except for an overwhelming saltiness. Both the falafels and pita were tasteless. I had hoped that the tzatziki sauce would bring some taste to the wrap, but unfortunately, it was also bland. It didn't resemble the flavorful sauce I had anticipated; instead, it was like a thin, tasteless glue. The only redeeming aspect of the wrap was the fresh diced cucumber and tomato; unfortunately, they were buried under the disappointing white sauce that does not even deserve to be called tzatziki : (

input: Exactly as bougie and casual at the same time as you need it to be. Come with your Gucci bag or in your yoga pants and slam a delicious cocktail or three.
Refine this for me please: Perfectly balancing sophistication and laid-back vibes, our venue offers the ideal blend of bougie and casual. Feel free to rock your Gucci bag for a touch of luxury or simply slip into your comfy yoga pants. Indulge in our mouthwatering cocktails, savoring one, or even three, as you please.

input:
Our group of 6 decided to try something different.  So,  we gave this place a shot.   Very happy with our decision. 

The wife and I shared the special,  which was a massive amount of food for the two of us.   It was a great sampling of all their food options. 

The chicken, steak and rice/beans were pretty amazing.  I could do without the egg,  but it was easy enough to push over to the side.   I'm not a fan of Yuca, but this wasn't bad.   The plantains were delicious.   I didn't try the salad... Just wasn't in the mood for it. 

All in all,  the place is a must visit if you are up for trying something new.
Refine this for me please:
Our group of six decided to venture outside of our comfort zone and give this place a try, and we were extremely satisfied with our choice. 

My wife and I decided to share the special, which turned out to be a generous portion of food that offered a great variety of their menu items. 

The chicken, steak, and rice/beans were absolutely amazing. Personally, I could have done without the egg, but it was easy enough to simply move it to the side. I'm not typically a fan of Yuca, but it wasn't too bad at this place. The plantains, on the other hand, were absolutely delicious. I didn't have the chance to try the salad as I just wasn't in the mood for it at the time. 

All things considered, this place is definitely worth visiting if you're open to trying something new.

input: Out lunch today was pulled pork, smokehouse bowl, and delicious sides of sweet potato casserole and red beans and rice.   Red beans and rice was spicy but good. Sweet potato casserole yummy and meat was smoky juicy and plentiful. Definitely a must.
Refine this for me please: For lunch today, we enjoyed a delightful spread consisting of pulled pork, a flavorful smokehouse bowl, and delectable sides of sweet potato casserole and red beans and rice. The red beans and rice had a pleasant spicy kick that added to its overall appeal, while the sweet potato casserole was absolutely delicious. The meat, with its smoky flavor, was succulent, juicy, and generously portioned, making it an undeniable highlight of the meal. This entire meal is undoubtedly a must-try for anyone seeking a satisfying and mouthwatering dining experience.

input: Awesome detailing job. My car was DIRTY. Hadn't washed it in months. Got the executive detailing option now look at me.
Refine this for me please: The detailing job for my car was absolutely exceptional. It was in an extremely dirty condition as I had neglected washing it for several months. However, after opting for the executive detailing package, the results surpassed my expectations. The transformation is simply remarkable.

input: We belong to lifetime in another state and were visitingvisiting from Colorado to buy a potential second-home in the area. First Jen The front desk person was so nice and very helpful.   She speaks so highly of the club and all of the amenities that it offers.    I also met Joe the general manager what a terrific guy.     The club is much smaller than other lifetimes however very full service for those who want The next level and service.    The bathrooms are fantastic and for the men fully stocked with shavers, shaving cream and lotions.   You need absolutely no toiletries all provided.  Great location next to the mall.  Highly recommend.
Refine this for me please: During our visit from Colorado to potentially purchase a second home in the area, we had the pleasure of belonging to the lifetime club. Our first interaction was with Jen, the friendly and helpful front desk person who spoke highly of the club and its impressive amenities. We also had the opportunity to meet Joe, the general manager, who left a great impression on us. Although the club is smaller in size compared to other lifetimes, it offers a comprehensive range of services for those seeking an elevated experience. Particular attention must be given to the fantastic bathrooms, which are fully stocked with shavers, shaving cream, and lotions for men, eliminating the need to bring your own toiletries. Moreover, its prime location next to the mall further adds to its appeal. Without hesitation, we highly recommend this club.

input: Tried the pulled pork, green beans, Mac n cheese and cornbread. It was all pretty mediocre barbecue. Not bad, not great. The pork was a little overdone/dry, but had a nice smoky flavor. The original bbq sauce is pretty sweet/syrupy. Ill probably go back, but I wouldn't if there was a better option as close to my house.
Refine this for me please: I sampled the pulled pork, green beans, Mac n cheese, and cornbread. Unfortunately, I found the overall barbecue experience to be rather mediocre. It wasn't necessarily bad, but it definitely didn't impress either. The pulled pork was slightly overcooked and dry, although it did have a pleasant smoky taste. The original BBQ sauce provided was on the sweeter and syrupy side. While I might consider revisiting the place in the future, I wouldn't hesitate to try a different establishment if there were any superior options conveniently located near my house.

input: Husband and I made a mistake and came here on a Lenten Friday. The wait was forever. But since we were already there, might as well suck it up and see what's it all about. We ordered the blackened alligator and oysters for appetizers, the alligator came out within 15 minutes, and it was alright. A bit too greasy. Then another 15 minutes later, our raw oysters came out, I wanted mine char grilled but the waitress didn't mention they don't have char grilled oysters and still took my order, so I thought I was waiting for mine to be cooked the entire time. When she brought out the two half-dozen raw oyster trays, that's when she told me they only have raw oysters there. SMH. I have sensitive stomach so I only had 3 then gave the rest to my husband. Regardless, the oysters were really fresh. We waited for at least another 20 minutes later for our entrees to come out. At this point, I was really hungry and had hoped we were at home eating ramen noodles instead. My husband had the roast beef po-boy, and I had the tuna and shrimp kabob. My husband told me his roast beef was really salty and while ironically, my kabob was very bland. The kabob came with exactly 3 pieces of cubed tuna, 2 medium size shrimp with plenty of bell peppers and onions in between, and baby shrimp creole with rice. For the ok price, I shouldn't complain too much about this place. Didn't try their seafood boil, but it looked like that would have been a better choice.
Refine this for me please: My husband and I accidentally visited this place on a busy Lenten Friday, which meant a long wait. However, since we were already there, we decided to tough it out and give it a try. We started with the blackened alligator and oysters for appetizers. The alligator arrived in 15 minutes, but it was a bit too greasy for our liking. Another 15 minutes later, our raw oysters were served. I had ordered mine char-grilled, but the waitress took my order without mentioning that they only serve raw oysters. I ended up waiting for nothing. I have a sensitive stomach, so I only had three oysters and gave the rest to my husband. Despite that, the oysters were fresh. We waited for another 20 minutes for our entrees. At this point, I was really hungry and wished we were at home eating ramen noodles instead. My husband had the roast beef po-boy, which he found to be overly salty. Ironically, my tuna and shrimp kabob was disappointingly bland. The kabob consisted of three cubes of tuna, two medium-sized shrimp, bell peppers, onions, and baby shrimp creole with rice. Considering the price, I shouldn't complain too much about this place. We didn't try their seafood boil, but it seemed like a better choice.

input:
im going to have to give this place one star for its horrible customer service:

i called in to ask about the 50% off for tulane students they were advertising, the woman assured me if i came with an id it would be half off and made an appointment for me, only once i got there did they tell me it's only on certain days, "it says it right on the sign," i was perturbed by the inconvenience and said so you're not going to honor it even though you just made an appointment with me and told me it would be 50% off, they said no flat out at first even though the error was blatantly on their side, after my nagging, she eventually called john jay himself and he told the woman that he would not honor what i was told even though i had been inconvenienced by someone in HIS staff because it might cause a 'domino effect,' i said how will there be a domino effect unless you continue to give people incorrect information, there will be no other 'dominoes' as long as you remember what day it is from now on... they began to treat me somewhat patronizingly as i explained that usually businesses make concessions when they are the one at fault, that the customer is supposed to always be right, yadda yadda yadda, i left pretty upset and with ~45 minutes of my life having been wasted - empty handed but for a lame excuse from someone who owns at least 3 businesses over 10 dollars...

i have not received a haircut from them so if you're one of those people who ONLY cares about the product and you think you'll get a good cut go right on ahead, but if you're like me (principled) and you don't like handing profits to people who care nothing about their customers this is a good place to skip next time you need a cut
Refine this for me please:
I am giving this place a one-star rating due to their terrible customer service. I called to inquire about the 50% off promotion for Tulane students that they were advertising. The woman on the phone confirmed that if I showed my ID, I would receive the discount and made an appointment for me. However, upon arriving at the location, I was informed that the promotion only applied on specific days, which was clearly stated on their sign. I was frustrated by the inconvenience and expressed my displeasure, questioning why they would make an appointment and promise me the discount if they couldn't honor it. Initially, they flatly refused to honor it despite their mistake. After persistently complaining, the woman called the owner, John Jay, who also refused to honor what I was told, citing a potential "domino effect" as the reason. I pointed out that there would be no such effect if they simply provided accurate information in the future. They began treating me condescendingly as I tried to explain that businesses typically make concessions when they are at fault, and that the customer is supposed to always be right. This interaction left me upset and feeling like I had wasted approximately 45 minutes of my time to leave empty-handed, apart from a weak excuse from someone who owns multiple businesses and had inconvenienced me over just $10.

Please note that I have not received a haircut from them, so if you prioritize solely the quality of the product and believe you'll receive a good cut, feel free to go ahead. However, if you, like me, value principles and dislike supporting businesses that disregard their customers, I recommend avoiding this place the next time you need a haircut.

input: Awesome food, great place to split a bunch of delicious spicy, ultra flavorful dishes with a large group. It's the Chinese restaurant a lot of people know about for good reason - I haven't had a single bad dish here, and it's always a crowd-pleaser.
Refine this for me please: This Chinese restaurant is a perfect spot to gather with a large group and indulge in an array of mouthwatering, spicy dishes that are bursting with flavor. It has gained widespread recognition for a good reason - the food is simply outstanding. Every dish I've tried here has been exceptional, leaving me with no complaints. It never fails to please the entire crowd.

input:
My friend and I visited Tampa for a concert, and about ten minutes away from the Atlanta airport he realized that he had purchased tickets for the wrong day. We had already made hotel reservations and bought the concert tickets, so he just had to pay same-day price for airfare: all in all about $800 more. "It was totally worth it," he later told me, "Because I got to have the best sandwich of my entire life."

All because we randomly picked the Bricks of Ybor from Yelp. I can't vouch for the peanut butter or meatless menu, but the meat sandwiches that we bought were absolutely phenomenal. I had the pulled pork, which was flavored with ponzu and served on Hawaiian sweet bread. It was one of the best meals I've had in a long time. We spent a few hours hanging out and drinking, during which time Brian, the owner, came out and talked to us, comped us a drink, let us try new appetizers he was developing (all for free) and generally made us feel really welcome. 

I kept my eyes open to the kind of crowd that came in and out of the restaurant. It seemed to draw everything from hipsters to geriatrics and strait-laced families with young kids. I think it speaks to both the diversity of the menu and the pleasant environment. We went back for drinks before and after the concert. It got very crowded but we still received excellent food, drinks and service. I give this restaurant my strongest recommendation, and it's the first place I'm going when I next visit Tampa.
Refine this for me please:
During our trip to Tampa for a concert, my friend made an unfortunate realization that he had purchased tickets for the wrong day, just minutes away from the Atlanta airport. Despite the inconvenience, we decided to go ahead with our plans as we had already booked our hotel and purchased concert tickets. Consequently, he had to pay a hefty same-day price for airfare, costing us an extra $800. Surprisingly, my friend later admitted, "It was totally worth it," and attributed it to having the most amazing sandwich of his life.

By some stroke of luck, we randomly chose Bricks of Ybor from Yelp, which turned out to be an excellent decision. I cannot personally vouch for their peanut butter or meatless menu options, but the meat sandwiches we ordered were truly phenomenal. The pulled pork sandwich, flavored with ponzu and served on Hawaiian sweet bread, was one of the most delightful meals I have had in a long time. We spent a few hours at the restaurant, thoroughly enjoying ourselves and indulging in drinks. To our surprise, Brian, the owner, came out to chat with us. He generously comped us a drink and offered us a taste of his new appetizers he was experimenting with, all on the house. His hospitality made us feel incredibly welcomed.

Observing the clientele that frequented the restaurant, I noticed a diverse mix of individuals ranging from hipsters to older adults and families with young children. This serves as a testament to the varied menu options and the pleasant ambiance of the place. We returned to Bricks of Ybor both before and after the concert, even though it became quite crowded. Despite the crowd, we continued to receive outstanding service, delicious food, and excellent drinks. I wholeheartedly recommend this restaurant, and it will be the first place I visit when I return to Tampa.

input: So worth the wait! The crepes are amazing! I also loved the grits, which is rare. Tried my hubby's pancakes....awesome!
Refine this for me please: Absolutely worth the wait! The crepes are incredibly delicious, and even the grits exceeded my expectations. I also had a chance to taste my husband's pancakes, and they were simply awesome!

input: My sister-in-law and I visited this restaurant on 8/28/15 mid afternoon.  We were seated after requested 3 times that the hostess speak a little louder because we couldn't even hear her with the background music.  We were seated in a booth with a never ending Larry King vitamin commercial on the TV - really?  Our waitress introduced herself and a new trainee and then we never saw her again.  Two other wait staff seemed to be sharing our table, but no idea who was responsible for our table.  We got our drinks and ordered, but food took forever considering there was not more than 15-20 filled tables in the entire restaurant.  Burgers were not bad - I ordered the blue cheese burger and it would have been better with less blue cheese, way too much!  Fries and onion sticks were very good.  But no one came to see if we were satisfied, needing anything, etc and took two requests and waiting to get a carry out box.  There was a family seated across the aisle from us when we arrived and we assumed they had finished their meal and were "hanging out".  Only after we received our food did we understand they had already ordered and still did not have their food!  I doubt I will return to this restaurant in the future.
Refine this for me please:
My sister-in-law and I visited this restaurant on 8/28/15 in the mid-afternoon. However, our experience was less than satisfactory. We had to ask the hostess three times to speak louder as the background music made it impossible to hear her. Finally, we were seated in a booth where a never-ending Larry King vitamin commercial was playing on the TV, which left us quite bemused.

Our waitress introduced herself along with a trainee, but unfortunately, that was the last we saw of her. Two other waitstaff seemed to be sharing our table, but it was unclear who was actually responsible for serving us. Despite the relatively low number of filled tables (approximately 15-20 in the entire restaurant), our food took an unusually long time to arrive.

The burgers we ordered were not bad. Personally, I opted for the blue cheese burger, but it would have been much better if there was a lesser amount of blue cheese. The fries and onion sticks, on the other hand, were quite tasty. However, throughout our meal, no one bothered to check if we were satisfied or needed anything, and it took two requests and a considerable wait to receive a carryout box.

To make matters worse, there was a family seated across the aisle from us when we arrived. Initially, we assumed they had finished their meal and were simply lingering. However, it became apparent only after we received our food that they had actually ordered before us and were still waiting for their food to arrive!

Considering the disappointing service and lack of organization, I highly doubt I will be returning to this restaurant in the future.

input:
In short, the food was decently good, but completely overpriced.  The guacamole and my Mojito were probably the highlight of the meal. I had the peach pork medallions, which were nicely cooked, but lacked flavor. I tried the corn cakes with Barbacoa and that was pretty good.  

The atmosphere was inviting with a hip feel if that's what you're looking for.  What was really annoying was the parking situation. For a place with price points such as these and limited parking spaces, a valet service should be provided either at a cost or complimentary.  Don't even try and park in the back of the building, it's tight and dangerous even getting there and back.  I ended up parking three blocks away and broke a sweat walking in the dead of summer to the front entrance.
Refine this for me please:
Overall, the food at the restaurant was decently good, but it was definitely overpriced. The guacamole and my Mojito were the standout items of the meal. However, the peach pork medallions, while cooked nicely, lacked in flavor. On the other hand, the corn cakes with Barbacoa were pretty good.

The atmosphere of the restaurant had an inviting and hip feel, which might appeal to some. However, the parking situation was extremely frustrating. Given the high prices and limited parking spaces, the restaurant should consider providing a valet service, either at a cost or complimentary. Trying to park in the back of the building is not recommended as it is tight and dangerous. I had to park three blocks away and ended up sweating while walking to the front entrance in the heat of summer.

input: Had dinner Saturday night for the first time at rusty pelican. Called ahead and made a reservation and requested a table next to the window overlooking the water. Hostess went to seat us away from the window, when we questioned her she huffed off and left us staying in the middle of the dining room!! She did return and sat us by the window. The rest of the evening was great, drinks, food and wait staff was excellent. Liz was our server and went above and beyond. Still have to say the hostess was very disappointing!
Refine this for me please:
On Saturday night, I had the opportunity to dine at the Rusty Pelican for the first time. Prior to our arrival, I made a reservation and specifically requested a table positioned near the window with a scenic view of the water. Unfortunately, upon our arrival, the hostess attempted to seat us away from the desired window area. When we inquired about our requested seating, she appeared dismissive and walked off, leaving us standing in the middle of the dining room. Eventually, she did return and accommodated our seating request by placing us by the window.

Thankfully, the remainder of the evening proved to be delightful. The drinks, food, and overall service from the wait staff were excellent. Liz, our server, went above and beyond, delivering exceptional service throughout the night. Despite the positive experience overall, I must express my disappointment with the initial behavior of the hostess.

input:
This was a tough one!   On the merits of the wine, fairly average... I understand that the winery has more than one lable and other label is their premium wines.  I look forward to when that is available (I went two weeks ago so maybe it already is)     Location..   what's not to like?  On the pier!  A wonderful outdoor patio,  couldn't have a nicer setting to enjoy your tasting....   The staff were super, super nice,  I would give them an A+!  

So why only three stars?  It is because of the wine club!  Very expensive for the quality of the wines and stingy as HELL with the benefits to the members..   Most wine clubs will give you a free tasting every time you come in (after all, we are your best customers... we are the ones who buy your wine time and time again).  Some wineries will give their members a complimentary glass in leau of a tasting (Carr).   Most wineries allow you to bring guests which is how you get new wine club members.   This system works folks!  The way this wine club works is that you are given a very limited number of passes per quarter, five as I recall.   If I come with my wife once a month we wouldn't even be covered... let alone if we bring a guest!   

So go to this winery if you want to enjoy a tasting in one of the most beautiful settings on earth.   But avoid the wine club!  For that you can pretty much go to any of the other wine tasting rooms on the Urban wine trail.
Refine this for me please:
Refined: This was a challenging experience. In terms of the wine quality, it was fairly average. I learned that the winery offers multiple labels, with one being their premium selection. I am looking forward to trying that out (unless it already became available since my last visit two weeks ago). 

The location, however, is fantastic! It's located on the pier and has a lovely outdoor patio. It provides a perfect setting to enjoy your wine tasting. The staff were exceptionally friendly and I would give them an A+ for their service. 

So why only three stars? It's because of their wine club. It's quite expensive considering the quality of the wines, and the benefits for members are disappointingly limited. Most wine clubs offer free tastings for members each visit, as we are their loyal customers who continually purchase their wines. Some wineries even offer a complimentary glass in lieu of a tasting (e.g., Carr). Additionally, many wineries allow members to bring guests, which helps attract new wine club members. This system has proven effective. However, this particular wine club only provides a very limited number of passes per quarter, typically five. This wouldn't even cover monthly visits with my wife, let alone if we wanted to bring a guest. 

So, I recommend visiting this winery if you want to enjoy a tasting in one of the most beautiful settings on earth. However, I suggest avoiding their wine club. Instead, you can find more accommodating options at any of the other wine tasting rooms on the Urban wine trail.

input:

I'd give it a 4, but it was a little pricy for my taste, but I look human again. Don't know what you guys in Philly normally pay for a haircut.
Refine this for me please:
I recently got a haircut in New York for a very affordable price, but unfortunately, the result was not ideal. It seemed as though my hair was chewed up by a crazy chimp and then placed back on my scalp. 

However, since I have several job interviews coming up, I decided to improve my appearance and opted for Domenick's salon. I had the pleasure of being attended by Robert, who did an exceptional job giving me a clean haircut. The cost amounted to $35, which I found slightly expensive considering my personal preferences, but it was worth it as I now look presentable again. I am unsure about the usual haircut prices in Philadelphia, so I would appreciate if you could share any insights on that.

input: Very unhappy, you lost a valued customer. We had a problem where Monro Muffler underfilled our engine by 3 quarts of oil and caused damage to the engine. Monro's insurance company said they would pay for damages if we brought to the dealer, we were frequent customers of Bergeys so we brought it here. They discovered the timing chain needed to be replaced, a chain that lasts the life of the car unless you don't change the oil or have low oil pressure the tensioner can lock and stretch the chain. Joe the service associate that took the car in specifically said I told the insurance company as little as possible and told them he couldn't tell if it was from the oil and there was no way to tell. And on top of that, was extremely rude and unprofessional to my wife bringing her to tears the way he spoke to her. My wife and I just bought a house in the area, only 26 years old and you lost a life long customer. Over the past year we spent about $7000 in repairs here, and Joe went out of his way to be unhelpful and leave us in a terrible spot. I brought it to another mechanic who was able to help us prove more it was from the oil and do what Joe told us and the insurance company they could not do. So on top of losing a service customer, I'm on the market for a new car and can tell you for sure where I will not be getting it.
Refine this for me please: We are extremely dissatisfied with the service we received from Monro Muffler, resulting in the loss of a valued customer. Our engine was underfilled with 3 quarts of oil by Monro, causing significant damage. Although Monro's insurance company promised to cover the damages if we took the car to a dealership, we chose Bergeys, a dealership we had frequented in the past. Upon inspection, the dealership discovered that the timing chain needed replacement. Normally, this chain lasts the lifetime of the car, unless the oil is not changed regularly or the oil pressure is low, which can cause the tensioner to lock and stretch the chain. Surprisingly, Joe, the service associate who assisted us, deliberately provided as little information as possible to the insurance company and implied that it was impossible to determine whether the damage was caused by the underfilled oil. Moreover, Joe's rude and unprofessional behavior towards my wife left her in tears. As loyal customers who recently purchased a house nearby, we are deeply disappointed in the poor treatment we received. Over the past year, we spent approximately $7000 on repairs at this dealership, and Joe's unhelpfulness has left us in an extremely difficult situation. Fortunately, we sought the assistance of another mechanic who was able to provide evidence linking the damage to the oil issue, contradicting both Joe's claims and what the insurance company was initially led to believe. As a result of this experience, not only have we decided to seek alternative automotive services, but we are also actively looking for a new car, and it is certain that we will not be purchasing it from this dealership.

input:

I will definitely be returning and will confidently recommend it to others.

input: Definitely get in line before 8:30am. We waited about 30 minutes. Pancakes were fine. My friends got the raspberry pancakes, the sweet potato pancakes and the san antonio. I got the sugar and spice pancakes. All were well and fine, a bit dry. I don't understand the hype, but if the line isn't too long it's not bad for normal breakfast food. If the line is longer I would highly recommend skipping this place and heading down the street to Fido - insanely good coffee and great breakfast food.
Refine this for me please: I recommend getting in line before 8:30am at this place. As we waited for about 30 minutes, I tried the sugar and spice pancakes while my friends opted for the raspberry pancakes, sweet potato pancakes, and the san antonio. Overall, the pancakes were decent, although a bit dry. I personally didn't understand the hype surrounding this place, but if the line isn't too long, it's an okay option for a regular breakfast. However, if the line is longer, I highly suggest skipping this place and going to Fido down the street instead. They offer incredibly good coffee and excellent breakfast food there.

input: They have the WORST service advisors! Used to be good before Kelly and her team left. Unfortunately, it's convenient to work if I need oil change before I can make it to another Honda dealer.
Refine this for me please: The service advisors at this place are absolutely terrible! It's such a shame because they used to be great when Kelly and her team were here. Sadly, I'm stuck going here whenever I need an oil change before I can get to a different Honda dealer.

input:
The best soon-dubu in the city!  This place is tucked away and once you walk in, it's like you've stepped into a Korean home.  Very welcoming, warm and inviting.

It's very vegetarian friendly!  The soft tofu is stewed and put into the dol sot pots which each and every stew feels like it's custom made for you. 

You can select from beef, seafood or mixed meats (seafood & beef), mushroom, and just plain.  They can adjust the spice as needed too.  I always get the extra hot with the hot temperature, can't beat it.  The rice also comes in a dol-sot which is great if you leave it in for a while, it burns the rice into a nice crispy shell.  DROOL.

Just thinking about this place makes my mouth salivate!  

If you're not into tofu, they also offer korean bbq meats (cooked in the back), with other soup/stew items.

Love this place!!!
Refine this for me please:
I highly recommend trying the best soon-dubu in the city at this hidden gem. As soon as you step inside, you'll feel like you've been transported to a cozy Korean home. The friendly and inviting atmosphere adds to the overall experience.

One of the great things about this place is that it's very vegetarian-friendly. Their soft tofu is stewed and served in dol sot pots, making each stew feel like it's personalized just for you.

They offer a variety of options such as beef, seafood, mixed meats, mushroom, and plain. You can also request the spice level to be adjusted according to your preference. Personally, I always go for the extra hot with the hot temperature because it's unbeatable. They even serve the rice in a dol-sot, which creates a delightful crispy shell when left for a while. It's simply mouthwatering.

Apart from the delicious tofu dishes, they also have an array of Korean BBQ meats cooked in the back, along with other soup and stew items.

This place is absolutely amazing! Just the thought of it makes my mouth water.

input:
As motels go this one is very nice for the rate. Clean, comfortable and well-managed. You get what you pay for so the breakfast buffet is just OK. The pool is too small to swim laps (disappointing). The lobby area is spacious and comportable. 

If you are looking for a moderately priced place to sleep that is clean and comforable this will suit you just fine.
Refine this for me please: This motel is a great choice considering the rate, as it offers a clean, comfortable, and well-managed experience. However, the breakfast buffet is only satisfactory, keeping in mind the price paid. It's worth noting that the pool is not ideal for swimming laps, which might be disappointing for some. On a positive note, the lobby area is spacious and comfortable. If you're seeking a moderately priced accommodation that prioritizes cleanliness and comfort, this place will perfectly suit your needs.

input:
