input:
Great atmosphere and decor. Super friendly staff seat you right away. I stopped once for lunch and one time for dinner. They have some lunch specials one of which was Pad Thai. I order with chicken as the protein but they have the typical options for this .  The portion was good for lunch and had good flavor.

For dinner I ordered the chicken satay to start and the Panang Curry with chicken for main course. I was very disappointed in the satay being that you only get two small skewers. The flavor and peanut dipping sauce were very good but they give a few more skewers.  The Panang was good and you get a good size portion of rice.

On a side note, I was disappointed they do not have Pad See Ew. Still some other options on the menu I will return to try.

The staff and manager really know customer service.  Look forward to returning soon!
Refine this for me please:
The restaurant has a great atmosphere and stylish decor. The staff is incredibly friendly and seats you immediately upon arrival. I visited the restaurant for both lunch and dinner. During lunch, they offer a variety of specials, including the delicious Pad Thai, which I ordered with chicken. They have the usual protein options available. The portion size was perfect for lunch, and the dish had a satisfying flavor.

For dinner, I decided to start with the chicken satay and chose the Panang Curry with chicken as my main course. Unfortunately, the chicken satay was a letdown as you only receive two small skewers. However, the flavor and peanut dipping sauce were exceptional, though I would have appreciated a few more skewers. The Panang Curry, on the other hand, was delightful, and the portion size of rice provided was generous.

On a side note, I was slightly disappointed that they do not offer Pad See Ew on their menu. Despite that, there are still plenty of other options that I look forward to trying during my future visits.

The staff and manager of the restaurant truly excel at providing exceptional customer service. I can't wait to come back again soon!

input: We randomly decided to look for middle eastern food. Came up with Petra Restaurant near our home. Tried it with my family and liked it quite a bit. Try their Friday and Saturday special rice (it actually test like Indian fried rice) with lamb. Really tasty. Other things are very good too. Don't be discouraged with the location of the place, but food is good and inside of the restaurant is quite nice. Service is good too.
Refine this for me please: We spontaneously decided to search for Middle Eastern cuisine and stumbled upon Petra Restaurant, conveniently located near our home. Intrigued, my family and I decided to give it a try and were pleasantly surprised. The standout dish for us was their Friday and Saturday special rice, which remarkably resembled Indian fried rice, paired with succulent lamb. It was incredibly flavorful and left us wanting more. In addition to this delightful dish, the rest of the menu offered equally satisfying options. Although the restaurant's location may appear unassuming, the interior ambiance is surprisingly pleasant. Furthermore, the service provided was notable for its attentiveness and promptness.

input: I went to the pearl for my birthday and every detail of the experience was awesome!  The food, the wine and the service were all impeccable!  We didn't realize the time and were chatting away after closing time and the staff never made us feel rushed.
Refine this for me please: I had an incredible birthday experience at The Pearl. From the moment I stepped in, every detail was truly remarkable. The food was exquisite, the wine selection was impeccable, and the service was top-notch. Despite our unawareness of the time, the staff remained incredibly accommodating, allowing us to continue chatting long after closing time without ever making us feel rushed.

input: I stopped in because I was hungry for some snacks.  Browsed the store since I had some spare time and found it to be clean and well stocked.  Wide isles, good selection of bakery stuff, flowers and all your usual groceries. I like that they had some locally made snacks too like California Kettle Corn and Taco Works (out of SLO).  Found the semi-unusual chips I wanted that other stores don't always carry, grabbed a Diet Coke by the checkout and I was happy.  Convenient parking lot and the staff was friendly and helpful.  Thanks Albertsons!
Refine this for me please: I stopped by the store because I was feeling hungry and wanted to grab some snacks. While I had some spare time, I decided to browse around and was pleasantly surprised to find that it was clean and well stocked. The aisles were wide, offering a good selection of bakery items, flowers, and all the usual groceries you would expect. I particularly appreciated that they carried locally made snacks like California Kettle Corn and Taco Works from SLO. They even had the semi-unusual chips that I've been looking for, which can be hard to find at other stores. To complete my snack run, I picked up a Diet Coke at the checkout and left feeling satisfied. The parking lot was convenient, and the staff were friendly and helpful. Thank you, Albertsons!

input: New owners turned it into a double threat: Bad food AND bad service. Shame. I loved this place.
Refine this for me please: The new owners managed to transform this place into a disappointing double threat: both the food and service have taken a nosedive. It's such a shame, considering how much I used to adore this restaurant.

input:
We see Dr. Gloudemans, and she's a wonderful doctor. Friendly, upbeat, up on the most recent research, and pro-vaxx (hooray!!). She's proactive about problems after making sure things are worth worrying about-- "let's keep an eye on this, and if there's still a problem in a month or two, come back in and we'll see about a referral to a specialist."

As others have mentioned, we've had a few billing hiccups. We received a bill saying we were past due on 3 appointments' fees, despite paying all copays in the office. Luckily it was all straightened out after a phone call, but it's been frustrating on that front.
Refine this for me please:
We have had the pleasure of seeing Dr. Gloudemans, who is an exceptional doctor. She is not only friendly and upbeat but also well-informed about the latest research, and strongly supportive of vaccinations (which we greatly appreciate). Dr. Gloudemans takes a proactive approach by carefully assessing potential problems and suggesting monitoring before considering a specialist referral.

However, it is important to note that, like others have mentioned, we have encountered a few issues with billing. Specifically, we received a bill indicating that we were behind on payment for three appointments, despite having already paid all copays during our visits. Thankfully, this matter was resolved promptly through a phone call. Nevertheless, it has been quite frustrating to deal with these billing hiccups.

input: I attended a meeting for the homebuilders Association of New Orleans here. The food was good and they took good care of the patrons. I had a mimosa which was good. I had a small cup of corn and crab soup which is fantastic but the portion was quite small. I had the grits and grillades and it was fantastic! The portion same grade on this one. The price was around $10. I've included a photo of the menu for your convenience. I didn't get a chance to test the Wi-Fi but I would say given the ambience and the quality of the food it's a repeat
Refine this for me please: I recently attended a meeting at the well-regarded Homebuilders Association of New Orleans. The event was quite enjoyable, with delicious food and attentive service provided to the attendees. I particularly enjoyed the quality of the cuisine, starting with a satisfying mimosa and a small but fantastic cup of corn and crab soup. Although the portion size of the soup was a bit on the smaller side, it did not detract from the overall experience. Moving on to the main course, the grits and grillades dish was absolutely fantastic, matching the high standards set by the previous dishes. Priced at around $10, it offered great value for the quality provided. I have also attached a photo of the menu for your convenience. Although I did not have the opportunity to test the Wi-Fi, based on the ambient atmosphere and the exceptional food, I would highly recommend this venue for future meetings or gatherings.

input: I work at the Frist and I don't eat at the cafe much, since I like to leave the building and go home for lunch. But once in a blue moon on a really dreary day like today, I stay in and have the Cobb Salad. It's a go-to for gluten free noshers like me. Add an extra egg for extra protein punch (as if all the meat wasn't enough already) and oil and vinegar dressing and i'm doing ok. A lot of museum visitors and local employees come for the cheap prices and quick bites. Beware of Senior Mondays (every 3rd Monday of the month) and weekends at lunchtime- it's usually busiest at 1130-noon.
Refine this for me please:
I work at the Frist, but I rarely eat at the cafe. I usually prefer going home for lunch, but occasionally, on days like today when the weather is dreary, I stay in and indulge in the delicious Cobb Salad. It's my go-to option as someone who follows a gluten-free diet. To enhance the protein content, I add an extra egg to the salad, alongside the abundance of meat. Topping it off with oil and vinegar dressing, it becomes a satisfying meal for me. 

The cafe at the Frist is popular among museum visitors and local employees due to its affordable prices and fast service. However, I would caution against visiting on Senior Mondays (every 3rd Monday of the month) and weekends during lunchtime, as those tend to be the busiest periods. The rush is usually highest between 11:30 am and noon.

input:
The food at Ghini's is just delicious. Everything for French breakfast imaginable, and more. I highly recommend the eggs provencale, not something you can get anywhere else. Two eggs basted with a sliced hot house tomato, thyme, garlic and herbs de provance. Get the baguette toast and add the great hashbrowns for a mere dollar.
My personal favorite are all the crepes, both sweet and savory. Especially recommend the spinach and swiss.
Refine this for me please:
Ghini's offers an exquisite dining experience with mouth-watering food. They have an extensive French breakfast menu that surpasses all expectations. One dish that stands out is the eggs provencale - a unique delicacy that cannot be found elsewhere. This delightful dish consists of two eggs basted with a sliced hot house tomato, complemented by thyme, garlic, and herbs de provance. To enhance your breakfast experience, I suggest adding the baguette toast and delectable hashbrowns for just a dollar.

Furthermore, Ghini's serves a variety of delectable crepes, both sweet and savory, which are my personal favorites. Among them, I highly recommend the spinach and swiss crepe.

input: This was such a unique spot, from the graffiti style art on the walls to the delicious food options and special hummus flavors. Good prices, great portion size. I had the greek steak pita with guac hummus. Will definitely be back!
Refine this for me please: This spot was truly one-of-a-kind, offering a combination of unique graffiti-style art on the walls, delectable food options, and a variety of special hummus flavors. Not only were the prices reasonable, but the portion sizes were also generous. Personally, I ordered the Greek steak pita with guacamole hummus, which was absolutely delicious. This experience has left me with no doubt that I will return in the future.

input:
I really like Prep & Pastry - we have been twice in the last two months on a Sunday.  The best trick I learned is to put your name on the waitlist BEFORE YOU ARRIVE.  As long as you are within 5 miles of the restaurant, you can be added.  It is a great service.

I have tried a number of things for brunch and all have been excellent - even their sweets. I think my favorite is the breakfast sandwich.  I am not a big drinker, so I usually order the ice team and it really is better than almost anything else I have tried. 

Staff is really, really nice.  I highly recommend a visit if you are in town.
Refine this for me please:
I absolutely love going to Prep & Pastry! In the past two months, I've had the chance to visit this place twice on Sundays. One amazing trick that I discovered is to join their waitlist before actually arriving. The best part is that they'll add you to the list as long as you're within a 5-mile radius of the restaurant. This feature has been an absolute game-changer, and their service is top-notch.

When it comes to brunch options, I've sampled quite a few, and every single one of them has been exceptional. Even their sweets are on another level! However, I must admit that my favorite has to be their mouthwatering breakfast sandwich. Additionally, since I'm not much of a drinker, I always opt for their iced tea, which is hands down better than anything else I've ever had.

The staff at Prep & Pastry is incredibly friendly and welcoming. I can't recommend this place enough if you happen to be in town. It's definitely worth a visit!

input:
Another great annual festival Edmonton has to offer.

The Fringe is over two weekends and the joining week full of performances. There's a variety of venues and plays to watch, street performers and musicians. There's a schedule online to find show times, buy tickets and learn more about the artists. 

Half of 104th closes down to add space for a variety of food vendors and artisan vendors (art, jewelry, clothing, etc.).

Good tip: there's a gourmet mini donut truck off behind the farmers market a bit tucked away. Amazing!

It's nice to take an hour or two before or after a show to walk around and casually stumble on other street performances. Or even go without seeing a play just to snack and shop at the vendors.

The location is absolutely fabulous.
Refine this for me please: The Fringe is a vibrant annual festival in Edmonton that spans over two weekends, with a joining week full of captivating performances. With numerous venues and a diverse selection of plays, as well as talented street performers and musicians, there is something for everyone to enjoy. Conveniently, a schedule is available online to assist in finding show times, purchasing tickets, and learning more about the artists. Additionally, a portion of 104th street is closed off to accommodate a wide array of food and artisan vendors, offering unique items such as art, jewelry, and clothing. As a pro tip, there is a hidden gem of a gourmet mini donut truck located near the farmers market that shouldn't be missed. Whether attending a show or simply exploring, it is delightful to stroll around and serendipitously stumble upon other street performances. The festival's location is truly fabulous, adding to the overall charm and appeal of this remarkable event.

input:
Wow have things changed at this location. I used to come here on a regular basis with a friend. I haven't been back in over a year and so couldn't wait to have lunch today. I was surprised at the deterioration in customer service...,.our server didn't smile, was unwilling to give a recommendation and didn't offer us a tea to go. When I used to come, every server was friendly, gave suggestions and always offered a tea to go. 

The food was okay and probably would have been better if we had been treated better.  I noticed there was tape on the benches where the leather/vinyl is wearing out; this looks tacky.

This used to be my favorite lunch spot; this is no longer the case. I will not be back.
Refine this for me please:
I was really disappointed to see how things have changed at this location. I used to visit here regularly with a friend, but after over a year of not coming here, I was excited to have lunch today. However, the deterioration in customer service was quite surprising. Our server didn't even smile, showed no willingness to give recommendations, and didn't offer us a tea to go. It was completely different from how it used to be, as every server was friendly, provided suggestions, and always offered a tea to go.

While the food was decent, it probably would have tasted better if we had received better treatment. Additionally, I couldn't help but notice tape on the benches where the leather/vinyl is wearing out, which made the overall appearance quite tacky.

This place used to be my absolute favorite for lunch, but sadly, that is no longer the case. Regrettably, I won't be returning here.

input:
Got an estimate but went with another plumber as this was the highest quote of the 3 plumbers we interviewed for the job.
Very prompt communication though.

Will re-consider for future jobs.  Seems reliable (and often you get what you pay for!)
Refine this for me please: We received an estimate from this plumber, but ultimately decided to hire another plumber as their quote was the highest among the three we interviewed. However, we appreciated their prompt and efficient communication. We will definitely keep them in mind for future projects, as they seem reliable and it is often worth investing in quality service.

input: Only the best Mexican food in Florida!!!!  Since the first day I tried it I love it I keep coming back!!!
Refine this for me please: Experience the finest Mexican cuisine in all of Florida! From the very first bite, I fell head over heels in love with it and found myself constantly drawn back for more!

input: Real Thai food and they'll make it spicy if you ask for it pet pet. I really like both their soups. The curries have excellent flavor but they can seem runny if you're not used to Thai curries. I'm not super thrilled with the eggrolls but my girlfriend always gets the veggie ones. Perhaps the meat ones are better.
Refine this for me please: Real Thai food is offered at this place and they are happy to make it spicy upon request. Personally, I thoroughly enjoy their soups. The curries are packed with incredible flavors, although they may appear a bit thin if you're not accustomed to Thai curries. While the eggrolls are not my favorite, my girlfriend always opts for the veggie ones. It's possible that the meat ones could be more satisfying.

input:
Last May, my wife and I used Jump on the School Bus to take our wedding guests on a winery and brewery tour. They were just amazing, the perfect choice for our pre-wedding wine and beer tour and for wedding transportation between Goleta and the Circle Bar-B Ranch for our guests who stayed in town. Darin and Sierra did a wonderful job communicating with us in Washington, DC as we planned our wedding itinerary. They were flexible about trip times and made last minute adjustments when the number of in-town guests changed suddenly. 

Darin and Sierra have such attention to detail and quality that Darin even stopped by one of the wineries to meet us and to ensure that everything was as expected. Our driver was also extremely knowledgeable about the area and had many good suggestions throughout the day.

We couldn't have picked a better choice for a winery, brewery day tour and wedding day transportation than Jump on the School Bus! I highly recommend them to everyone!
Refine this for me please:
In May, my wife and I had the pleasure of using Jump on the School Bus for our wedding guests' winery and brewery tour. They were absolutely amazing and turned out to be the perfect choice for our pre-wedding wine and beer extravaganza, as well as for transporting our guests between Goleta and the Circle Bar-B Ranch.

Darin and Sierra, the owners and operators of Jump on the School Bus, were an absolute delight to work with. Despite being located in Washington, DC, they communicated flawlessly with us as we planned our wedding itinerary. They were accommodating and flexible when it came to trip times, and willingly made last-minute adjustments when the number of in-town guests unexpectedly changed.

What impressed us even more was their attention to detail and commitment to providing top-notch service. Darin went above and beyond by personally visiting one of the wineries to meet us and ensure that everything was up to our expectations. Our driver, who was incredibly knowledgeable about the area, also added to the overall experience with his insightful suggestions throughout the day.

Without a doubt, we couldn't have made a better choice for our winery, brewery tour, and wedding transportation than Jump on the School Bus. I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone in need of similar services.

input:
A great spot to take out-of-town guests. I take all my Chicago friends here and they fall in love. The burgers are incredible and the boozy shakes are like no other. The first time I had horchata shake I honestly had dreams about it for like a week. It's also super centrally located, a quick walk from Wash Ave and other downtown attractions. Great vibe, although I always prefer to get a table upstairs than sit at the community tables on the ground floor.

The burger selection is really, really great. You can pretty much get whatever your heart desires. I've had mac n cheese patties on my burger, you can get a bison burger, turkey burger, literally anything. I have tried a ton and have never been let down by the flavor combinations. The waiters are always super honest, in a good way. If you ask them what's better, X or Y, they're not going to jerk you around and say they're equally good. They'll give you their honest opinion. LOVE that. 

Another unique aspect about Bailey's Range is that they have a burger showdown (can't remember their technical term for it) where last week's featured burger goes up against a new burger recipe. It's a cool call-out that you don't see at a lot of other restaurants. 

The only reason I gave it a 4/5 star instead of 5/5 is because I've had a couple of instances (out of MANY visits, so it's really not alarming or anything) where I requested my burger medium or medium-rare and it turned out a little well done. I still ate it, but it wasn't really what I expected.
Refine this for me please:
Bailey's Range is an exceptional destination to bring out-of-town guests and has become a favorite among my Chicago friends for good reason. The mouthwatering burgers are truly unparalleled, and the boozy shakes are a one-of-a-kind experience. I can't exaggerate how much I adored the horchata shake - it even invaded my dreams for a whole week. Conveniently located in a central area, it's just a short stroll away from Wash Ave and other downtown attractions. The atmosphere is fantastic, although I personally prefer the more intimate upstairs seating rather than the communal tables on the ground floor.

The variety of burger options is simply outstanding, catering to every craving imaginable. From mac n cheese patties to bison or turkey burgers, Bailey's Range has it all. I've sampled an extensive range and have never been disappointed by the creative flavor combinations. The waitstaff also deserves a special mention - they are refreshingly honest and genuinely helpful. If you're torn between two choices, they won't beat around the bush; they'll provide their sincere recommendation. I absolutely adore this aspect of their service.

Additionally, Bailey's Range sets itself apart with their burger showdown, where last week's featured burger goes head-to-head with the new recipe. This unique event is something you won't find in many other restaurants and adds an extra fun element to the dining experience.

The only reason I'm deducting a star and giving Bailey's Range a 4/5 rating instead of a perfect score is because, on a few occasions (though they have been rare compared to the numerous times I've visited), my request for a medium or medium-rare burger resulted in a slightly overcooked patty. It didn't ruin the meal, but it definitely fell short of my expectations.

input: Possibly the best breakfast sandwich EVER.  On a biscuit!  Oh my gosh, it was so good!
Refine this for me please: This breakfast sandwich on a biscuit is quite possibly the most delicious one I've ever had. It was beyond amazing!

input:
This place sucks! The one up on oracle and wetmore is where I usually go, however, I moved and the university location is closer. Sorry Silver mine you have lost my business forever.

First, I ordered two sandwiches a large homesteak  with no green onions. I accidentally typed onions instead of peppers that come on the sandwich. These bozos still proceed to put the greens on it and the manager laughs it off like no big deal. 
Second, my hot homesteak sandwich was as cold as if had been sitting out for an hour. You guessed right it took an hour to get my food and then the hot sandwich was not wrapped in the proper wrapping to keep it warm.
Lastly, the employee got rude with me when I was checking to see what time my order would be done. He proceeded to scold me about how he only got it two minutes ago and it will be done when its done. Not how you talk to a customer buddy!

Goodbye Silver mine!
Refine this for me please:
I am extremely unsatisfied with this place, specifically referring to the location on Oracle and Wetmore. Despite the convenience of the university location being closer to me, Silver mine has permanently lost my business.

To start, I placed an order for two sandwiches, specifically requesting a large homesteak without green onions. Unfortunately, I accidentally typed "onions" instead of "peppers" that are supposed to be included in the sandwich. Despite this mistake, the staff still added the green onions and the manager nonchalantly brushed it off, finding it amusing. This lack of attention to detail is unacceptable.

Furthermore, when I finally received my order after an excruciatingly long wait of one hour, my hot homesteak sandwich was disappointingly cold. It was as if it had been left out sitting for an hour. Additionally, the sandwich was not wrapped properly to maintain its temperature, which further worsened the situation.

Lastly, an employee had the audacity to be rude to me when I inquired about the estimated completion time of my order. Instead of providing a polite response, he proceeded to scold me, claiming that he had only received my order two minutes ago and it would be ready when it's ready. This kind of disrespectful behavior towards a customer is unacceptable and a clear indication of their poor customer service.

Considering these frustrating experiences, I have decided to bid farewell to Silver mine.

input: My first time here! Grace did my hair....and it's FABULOUS! (And my hair is very difficult---super long and super thick). Great atmosphere, too--modern and clean, and no snobbiness.  Totally reasonable pricing! Highly recommend!
Refine this for me please:
This was my first visit to this salon, and I had the pleasure of having Grace do my hair. I must say, the results were absolutely fabulous! With my hair being super long and super thick, it can often be a challenge to handle, but Grace worked wonders. 

Not only was the quality of the hair service exceptional, but the atmosphere of the salon was also impressive. It had a modern and clean aesthetic without any hint of snobbiness. 

Furthermore, I was pleasantly surprised by the reasonable pricing. It's not always easy to find a salon that offers such excellent service at such a fair cost. 

Overall, I highly recommend this salon. Whether you have difficult hair like mine or not, you're sure to have a positive experience.

input: Food was good, we took advantage of the Sunday Buffet it included fried chicken, greens, smother steak, corn, cabbage.  It was so much more  It was very,very cozy. You would actually think you were eating at your grandmother's house.  This is not a fine dining establishment.  The price was fair, was highly recommended by locals. It's was worth any wait. This place exceeded my expectations.
Refine this for me please: The food at this place was absolutely delicious, especially when we decided to indulge in their Sunday Buffet. The buffet spread included mouthwatering fried chicken, delectable greens, irresistible smothered steak, flavorful corn, and savory cabbage. The cozy atmosphere of the restaurant made it feel just like dining at your own grandmother's house. It's important to note that this isn't a fancy fine dining establishment, but the prices were fair, and it came highly recommended by locals. Trust me, any wait you might have to endure will be well worth it because this place truly exceeded all of my expectations.

input: Ordered a Passion Passport, I love the name! It contains Passion Fruit Juice Blend, Bananas, Pineapple Mango Juice Blend, Papaya Juice Blend, and Raw Cane Sugar. It was delicious and refreshing!
Refine this for me please: I ordered a Passion Passport, and I absolutely love the name! This delightful beverage is made with a blend of Passion Fruit Juice, Bananas, Pineapple Mango Juice, Papaya Juice, and a touch of Raw Cane Sugar. Trust me, it was not only delicious but also incredibly refreshing.

input: Thoroughly enjoyed our private tour today with Carrie (it was very rainy so not too many visitors).  Her knowledge and passion about the Civil War was captivating. The Battle of Franklin deserves such a memorial.
Refine this for me please: I had an amazing private tour today with Carrie, despite the rainy weather that kept the number of visitors to a minimum. Her extensive knowledge and genuine passion for the Civil War were truly captivating. The Battle of Franklin is undeniably deserving of a memorial like no other.

input: Best service in town and best prices. Even the phone call just felt good. I called fast glass and they wanted to charge me 200$! About 80$ more than last time. So i looked around and found these guys. Called them and from the moment someone picked up i was treated wonderfully, they charged 165$ and it was worth the price too. I chip in my windshield spidered out and i was worried about a ticket, they fit me in that day. They vaccumed, wiped down the inside of my car and washed the windows. Waiting area is cozy and has tea, water and free suckers. They all treated me like a person, not a dumb girl like fast glass does. Ill definitely be going back.
Refine this for me please:
I had the best experience with this service, not only because of their affordable prices but also for the exceptional customer service I received during my phone call and visit. Initially, I contacted Fast Glass, but they quoted me $200, which was $80 more than the last time. Determined to find a better deal, I began searching for alternatives and came across these guys. I called them and right from the moment someone answered the phone, I was treated wonderfully. They gave me a fair price of $165, which I believed was worth it. 

My windshield had a chip that was starting to spider, and I was worried about getting a ticket. These guys managed to fit me in the same day. Not only did they fix the chip, but they also went above and beyond by vacuuming and wiping down the inside of my car, as well as washing the windows. Their waiting area is cozy, offering tea, water, and free suckers. What stood out the most was how they treated me like a person, rather than dismissing me as a dumb girl like Fast Glass did. Without a doubt, I will definitely be returning to them for any future needs.

input:
I am positively LIVID.

I went to check my account balance and what do I see? An overdraft fee of $220.
How could this happen? My card was never declined and there are two large fees deducted from my account.

I called TD and sat on hold for 45 MINUTES. I don't have that kind of time. Granted, the guy that was with me was nice and helpful, but never mentioned anything about the wait time until I brought it up. I asked about these fees and he said "Just so you are aware, TD Bank's new policy is that when you have insufficient funds, your card will not be declined. It will be run through, and you will be charged an overdraft fee."
OH THANK YOU FOR TELLING ME NOW, JERK.

I have too many salty words that are unacceptable in the public domain, so I'll stop now.

Needless to say, I am switching banks.

Sort of UPDATE:
I thought you Yelpers would like to know that last night, when I was depositing the cash that I didn't have into my account via ATM, I flipped off the cameras.
TAKE THAT, TD.
Refine this for me please:
I am extremely angry and frustrated.
I checked my account balance and discovered an unexpected overdraft fee of $220.
I am confused as to how this occurred, as my card was never declined and two large fees were deducted from my account.

I contacted TD customer service and endured a 45-minute hold time, which was inconvenient for me. Although the representative I eventually spoke with was friendly and helpful, I was disappointed that he did not inform me about the wait time until I mentioned it. When I asked about the fees, he informed me that TD Bank's new policy states that when there are insufficient funds, the card will not be declined, but rather processed, resulting in an overdraft fee.
I find it frustrating that this policy was not transparently communicated earlier.

I have many expletives and negative remarks, but they are not suitable for public discussion, so I will refrain.

As a result of this experience, I have decided to switch banks.

Update: I wanted to update the Yelp community by sharing that last night, while depositing cash that I didn't have into my account via the ATM, I expressed my frustration by gesturing rudely towards the cameras.
This was my way of expressing my discontent with TD Bank.

input:
We stayed at the Four Points for 3 nights in November, while here on business.  Nice hotel, and a good experience. 

Check in was a breeze.  We had a good price on the room via my Sheraton/SPG member and AAA discount, which included the free breakfast.  The hotel is literally 5 minutes from the airport, and there are several other hotels right on the same block.

Staff was friendly and helpful.  Room was fine, parking easy, quiet at night.
Refine this for me please:
During our business trip in November, we had a pleasant stay at the Four Points hotel for three nights. The hotel, conveniently located just five minutes away from the airport, offered a great experience. Checking in was quick and hassle-free. We were able to secure a good deal on the room with my Sheraton/SPG membership and the AAA discount, which also included complimentary breakfast.

The staff at the hotel was friendly and always ready to assist. Our room was comfortable, and we had no issues with parking. Despite being close to other hotels, it remained peaceful and quiet at night. Overall, our stay at the Four Points was enjoyable and we would recommend it.

input: Located right at the Union Station Metro stop (walking distance to all of downtown but metro-able too), this place was a good deal on the weekend.  Prices spike during the week when business-peeps fly in and their companies are paying the bill.  The room was clean, the bed was super comfy with TONS of pillows (one sure way to my heart).  The bathroom was large with a tub and too many white towels for two people.  Subtracted one star cause the coffee machine in our room sucked and the door was thin so you could hear people/children in the hall at WAY too early in the morning.  The main lobby is really a cool place tho.  Definitely worth checking out if you're in the area.
Refine this for me please: This place is conveniently located right at the Union Station Metro stop, making it within walking distance to downtown attractions while also easily accessible by metro. It offers a great deal on the weekends, although prices tend to rise during the week when business travelers are in town on company expenses. The room was clean and the bed was exceptionally comfortable, adorned with plenty of pillows that won me over. The bathroom was spacious, featuring a tub and an abundance of white towels, although it seemed excessive for just two people. I deducted one star due to the inadequate coffee machine in our room and the thin door that allowed sounds from the hallway, including early morning noise from other guests or children, to disturb our sleep. However, the main lobby itself was impressive and worth exploring. If you find yourself in the area, it's definitely worth considering a visit.

input:
Some of the finest Mexican food I've had. The fried fish taco is WONDERFUL, as is all of the other food. My biggest regret is not buying their red sauce and birria to take home. 

Also-there is no air conditioning. They do have ceiling fans, but we all know those aren't necessarily helpful in the monsoon season. The food is definitely worth the trip though!
Refine this for me please:
The Mexican food here is truly exceptional. I highly recommend trying their fried fish taco, it is absolutely wonderful. In fact, all the dishes I've tried are truly delicious. My only regret is not purchasing their flavorful red sauce and delicious birria to enjoy at home. 

Keep in mind that there is no air conditioning, but despite that, they do have ceiling fans. However, during the monsoon season, they may not provide much relief. Nonetheless, the incredible food definitely makes the visit worthwhile.

input: As an active runner my shoes are my life force. Endurance House has a fantastic selection of shoes for all runners.  The staff are always nice and helpful. What sets them apart from other stores is how they check for what shoe will best suit your stride and reduce injury.  I will happily keep coming back and know that I will get a good price, a great pair of shoes, and have personalized help.
Refine this for me please: As an avid runner, finding the right shoes is essential to my performance. That's where Endurance House comes in. This store offers an outstanding range of shoes for every type of runner. What truly sets them apart from other stores is their personalized approach to shoe selection, aimed at finding the perfect fit for your unique stride to minimize the risk of injury. The staff at Endurance House is always friendly and incredibly helpful, ensuring a pleasant shopping experience. Whenever I visit, I can trust that I will not only receive a great price and excellent quality shoes, but also receive tailored assistance that truly meets my needs. This combination of outstanding selection, personalized attention, and exceptional service makes Endurance House my go-to destination for all my running shoe needs.

input:
Super lunch option
Watch out for the yoga mats
You won't miss the meat

Lunch has been very strange for me since HipCity opened. Because here's the thing: I am a meat eater. I mean like my last meal on earth would be a burger. Or, just maybe, the fajita wrap. Because it's that good.

Haven't had everything on the menu yet, but everything I have had has been great. The buffalo bella and crispy hipcity ranch are amazing sandwich alternatives, especially paired with the green lemonade. The groothie is also delicious, and can stand on its own to get you through an afternoon if you only want to spend a few bucks.

Okay suffice it to say that the food is great. The staff is also very friendly, and when they get busy someone will come out along the line and take orders so congestion doesn't get too bad at the register itself.

My only issue with HipCity is that it is at times nearly impossible to figure out where to stand when you're waiting to order or waiting for your food. People kind of convene everywhere and it can get awkward when there's a line out the door. In such a small space it's hard to rectify, but if I see a line out the door I tend to walk on by not because it's a long wait (they're really efficient), it's just difficult to navigate the interior.
Refine this for me please:
HipCity has completely changed my lunch routine, but in a good way. As a meat lover, I was skeptical at first, but their options have completely won me over. From the buffalo bella to the crispy hipcity ranch, their sandwich alternatives are a delicious delight. And let's not forget about the fajita wrap - it's pure perfection.

While I haven't tried everything on the menu, everything I have tried has surpassed my expectations. The green lemonade is the perfect complement to any meal, and the groothie is a tasty and affordable pick-me-up for those afternoon slumps.

Aside from the amazing food, the staff at HipCity is incredibly friendly. To avoid congestion at the register, they even come out along the line to take orders when it gets busy.

However, my only gripe with HipCity is the lack of clear order and waiting areas. It can get confusing to figure out where to stand, especially when the place is packed. Despite their efficiency, it's hard to navigate such a small space. If I see a long line, I usually pass by not because of the wait time, but because of the difficulty in moving around inside.

All in all, HipCity is definitely worth a visit for a super lunch option. Just make sure to keep an eye out for the crowd and yoga mats!

input:
This place's posted hours include a 10PM closing time. 

I walked in at 8:30 and, as soon as I got to the counter, the guy said to me "kitchen's closed." The grill, fryers, etc were all being covered up. 

First of all, if your kitchen is closed, why is the door to your restaurant unlocked? 

Secondly, I could see this being the case if I walked in at, say, 9:55PM. But 8:30? That's ridiculous.
Refine this for me please:
Please revise the paragraph below to make it more concise and clear:

The posted hours of this place indicate a closing time of 10 PM. However, when I walked in at 8:30 PM, the guy at the counter informed me that the kitchen was closed. This left me confused as to why the restaurant's door was still unlocked if the kitchen wasn't serving. Furthermore, it seems unreasonable for the kitchen to be closed at such an early hour like 8:30 PM, unlike if it was closer to closing time at 9:55 PM.

input: no contest best Chinese good in the area. owners are incredibly nice and the wontons while you wait for take out are a treat.
Refine this for me please: This Chinese restaurant takes the crown without a doubt. Not only is their food the best in the area, but the owners are extremely friendly. They go above and beyond to ensure a pleasant dining experience. Additionally, the complimentary wontons they provide while you wait for your takeout are an absolute delight.

input:
Rosemary's Grill is my favorite resaurant.  My wife and I take my Mother in law to Rosemary's Grill often for many reasons.  Their menu is extensive.  You can get Classic American food in many categories prepared fresh and delicious with great care and attention to detail that is lacking in common chain restaurants.  You can also get traditional Turkish cuisine that is the very best kebab that I ever had.  Rosemary's is a family owned business and they treat you like you are part of that family.  We are making Rosemary's our Saturday night place.  last weekend my wife and I took my. Mother in law to Rosemary's Grill for dinner.  It was even better that the time before.  I tried the Mixed grill kebab platter.  Lamb, Chicken, Adana, and gyro kebab meats, so tender and expertly spiced and grilled, along with a shepherds salad, grilled half tomatoes, rice, and of course flat bread.  The Adana kebab was particularly tender, juicy, and tasty.  I had never had Adana kebab before and will be ordering it again.  I shared a taste with my Mother in law and she loved it too!  mom in law had crab cakes and she enjoyed them very much.  My wife had the French onion soup, which she raves about and always orders.  She also had the roast turkey, mashed potatoes, cranberry sauce, and corn.  She loved everything on that platter.  She commented that the gravy was especially good.  The portion sizes are huge and we love to have the left overs again at home.  I have honestly not been to a restaurant in the area that has such good quality in all there entrees, sides, salad bar, and drinks, and you have to try the rice pudding.  We have eaten a few times here for breakfast, lunch, and dinner and it continues to be our very favorite place.  The waitstaff and owners make you feel right at home and are warm, welcoming, and friendly.  I can not say enough good things.  

Sent from my iPad
Refine this for me please:
Rosemary's Grill is our favorite restaurant, especially when we want to take my Mother-in-law out. One of the main reasons we love it is because of their extensive menu, offering a wide selection of delicious Classic American dishes, each prepared with care and attention to detail that is lacking in common chain restaurants. Additionally, their traditional Turkish cuisine, especially their kebabs, are simply the best I've ever had.

Being a family-owned business, Rosemary's Grill manages to create a warm, welcoming atmosphere that makes you feel like part of their family. It has become our go-to spot for our Saturday night outings. During our last visit, my wife and I were pleasantly surprised by the improvement from our previous experience. I decided to try their Mixed Grill Kebab Platter, which consisted of tender and expertly spiced lamb, chicken, Adana, and gyro kebab meats. The platter also included a shepherds salad, grilled half tomatoes, rice, and flatbread. I was particularly impressed with the tenderness and juiciness of the Adana kebab, a dish I had never tried before. My Mother-in-law also enjoyed a taste, and she loved it too!

My wife, on the other hand, had the French onion soup, a dish she always raves about and never fails to order. She also opted for the roast turkey, mashed potatoes, cranberry sauce, and corn. She enjoyed every element of her platter, especially complimenting the exceptional gravy. The portion sizes at Rosemary's Grill are generous, allowing us to have leftovers to enjoy at home.

Consistently, I have not found any other restaurants in the area that can match the quality of Rosemary's Grill in terms of their entrees, sides, salad bar, and drinks. I highly recommend trying their rice pudding as well. Whether it's breakfast, lunch, or dinner, we have had nothing but positive experiences at Rosemary's Grill, making it our ultimate favorite place to dine.

Last but not least, the waitstaff and owners at Rosemary's Grill contribute to the overall positive experience by making us feel right at home. They are warm, welcoming, and friendly, and their top-notch service truly completes the exceptional dining experience. I can't praise this place enough.

input: Very friendly staff and nice environment although the crowd was light surprisingly the both times I went there. Get yourself a $3.50 margarita after 4 on Tuesdays, they are pretty good.
Refine this for me please: The staff at this establishment is exceptionally friendly, creating a welcoming environment. Although the crowd was unexpectedly light during both of my visits, it did not detract from the positive atmosphere. I highly recommend trying their $3.50 margarita specials on Tuesdays after 4 PM; they are quite delightful.

input: I can walk here and won't go back even if they were the only place open at 2am.  I got the basic general tso's and it didn't come close to passing the test.  Go to East Cuisine.
Refine this for me please: Even if this were the only place open at 2am, I would still choose not to return here as I can easily walk to other options. I recently tried their basic General Tso's dish and it was far from satisfactory. My recommendation would be to go to East Cuisine instead.

input: If not for the pretentious, haughty, superior attitude of our waiter, I would have given this place four stars or possibly more... Seriously. That kind of attitude is exactly why I left New York. We wanted to order a bottle of wine, asked for his suggestion, and he answers with, "How much do you want to spend?" Ummm... Excuse me? How about, "I'm happy to make some recommendations. Let's find a price point you're comfortable with..." He didn't smile ONCE during the meal service and also found it necessary to correct us on several points of preference. Snob. The food is GOOD. The only thing that was great was the blueberry lasagna. And it is superb. So was the chocolate confection for dessert. I'd say go. And I hope you don't get that waiter.
Refine this for me please: If it weren't for the arrogant and condescending attitude of our waiter, I would have given this place a much higher rating. This type of behavior is exactly what I hoped to escape when leaving New York. We were looking for a recommendation on a bottle of wine and instead of providing helpful suggestions, he curtly asked us about our budget. It would have been more appropriate for him to say, "I'm happy to offer some recommendations based on your preferences and price range." Throughout the entire meal, he never once smiled and felt the need to correct us on our personal preferences, displaying a snobbish demeanor. However, the food itself is quite good, with the standout dishes being the blueberry lasagna and the delightful chocolate confection for dessert. Despite my negative experience with the waiter, I would still recommend giving this place a try, but I sincerely hope you do not encounter the same snobbish waiter.

input: The flavors continue to surprise me. I had Bananas Foster, Pear Champagne Sorbet, Blueberry Fig Sorbet, and Cassis sorbet. All flavors were good but the Cassis started off quite subtly and then the flavor gradually made itself known; the more I ate of it the better it tasted. It was well worth coming back with another group of friends to sample some frozen happiness.
Refine this for me please: I continue to be pleasantly surprised by the flavors. I had the pleasure of trying Bananas Foster, Pear Champagne Sorbet, Blueberry Fig Sorbet, and Cassis sorbet. While all the flavors were delicious, the Cassis stood out in its subtlety, gradually revealing its unique taste. The more I indulged in it, the better it became. It was undeniably worth revisiting with another group of friends to share the joy of this frozen delight.

input:
Best pizza ever... hands down.

Love the peeps running the place - former hockey player (ask him to pop his nose) and adorable, but tough as nails wife... very funny.

They make their own sausage and mozzarella here.  And God help you if you mispronounce Ricotta!!

Any of the pizzas are fab... we even eat the crusts - which is a rarity in our family.  Just dab it in the olive oil, and mayb ask for some of their viniagrette to dip too!
Refine this for me please:
This place undoubtedly serves the best pizza you'll ever taste. The owners are incredible, with the husband being a former hockey player (feel free to ask him about his broken nose) and his adorable but resilient wife, who always brings a good laugh.

Their homemade sausage and mozzarella are simply divine. And be warned, mispronouncing Ricotta will land you in some serious trouble!

Every pizza on their menu is outstanding, so delicious that even the crusts are devoured - a rare occurrence in our family. For an extra touch, dip the crusts in their flavorful olive oil, and consider requesting some of their delightful vinaigrette too!

input: Friendly sales staff ; ) mike was very helpful ! Took us for a ride in one if the Razors ; ) never know we might get 1 ; )
Refine this for me please: The sales staff at the store was extremely friendly! Mike, in particular, provided excellent assistance. He even took us for a fun ride in one of the Razors! Who knows, we might even end up getting one for ourselves!

input: I actually eat here at least once a month . The food is good and the service compliments it. You will fall in love with there zucchini muffins. I always leave with some stashed in my purse, you know for later. The prices are cheap and they have a fantastic frozen yogurt bar . with unlimited toppings. Have fun !! yum yum
Refine this for me please: I frequent this place at least once a month due to the delicious food and top-notch service. Their zucchini muffins are to die for, and I always make sure to grab a few extra to enjoy later. The prices are affordable, and they also offer a fantastic frozen yogurt bar with unlimited toppings. Get ready to indulge in a delightful dining experience!

input:
Came for all-you-can-eat, and ended up waiting for over half an hour to get our order in. The servers completely ignored us, while taking orders from the tables around us. And on top of that, all of the rolls contain "extras" not listed on the menu. One roll surprised us by having sweet mustard sauce on it, which did NOT taste very good....
On the bright side, once we actually got our orders in they didn't take all that long to make them.
Refine this for me please: Although we initially came for the all-you-can-eat option, our dining experience was marred by a lengthy wait of over half an hour just to place our order. The servers seemed to disregard our table while attentively serving those around us. Furthermore, we were disappointed to discover that all of the rolls included additional ingredients that were not specified on the menu. One roll in particular caught us off guard with its unappetizing sweet mustard sauce. However, once our orders were finally taken, they were promptly prepared, which was a saving grace in an otherwise unfavorable experience.

input: The restaurant was very nicely decorated , and clean. There were six of us and everyone enjoyed their meals . I had the fried green tomatoes. They were perfectly seasoned and the sauce served with them was delicious. The down side is they arrived after everyone else had their meals . My friends had the chicken salad , the fried bologna sandwich and a cheeseburger. We shared the peach cobbler dessert and were not disappointed, get it with the ice cream !!
Refine this for me please: The restaurant had a beautiful decor and was exceptionally clean. Our party of six had a great dining experience as everyone thoroughly enjoyed their meals. Personally, I ordered the fried green tomatoes, which were expertly seasoned and accompanied by a delightful sauce. However, a slight downside was that my dish arrived after everyone else's meals. Among my friends, they ordered the chicken salad, the fried bologna sandwich, and a cheeseburger. To top off our meal, we shared a peach cobbler dessert and were extremely satisfied. Don't forget to try it with a side of ice cream!

input: Food is good, but the cafe itself is extremely dirty. I will probably not return unless they clean the place up.
Refine this for me please: The food is delicious, however, the cafe itself is incredibly unclean. Unless they improve the cleanliness, I am unlikely to visit again.

input: We really liked this place. Everything we had was delicious. Portions were big. Chicken parm was so yummy. Can't wait to go back and try more stuff !
Refine this for me please: We thoroughly enjoyed our experience at this place. Every dish we ordered was absolutely delicious, and the portion sizes were impressively generous. The chicken parm in particular was exceptionally yummy. We can't wait to return and explore more of their menu!

input: not a bad little burger joint. i got the bacon cheeseburger. bacon was cooked perfect and had the perfect thickness. bun had a really great toasted crust. fries were good, as well as the chocolate shake I had. 3 complaints, i wish the burger was more juicy, I wish I wasn't paying so much for the tiny burger portion I was served, and I wish I didn't leave the place smelling like burger grease.
Refine this for me please: This burger joint isn't bad at all. I tried their bacon cheeseburger and the bacon was cooked to perfection with just the right thickness. The bun had a wonderfully toasted crust, adding to the overall taste. I also enjoyed their tasty fries and the chocolate shake was delightful. However, I do have a few complaints. I wish the burger itself had been juicier, as that would have enhanced the experience. Additionally, I found the portion size of the burger to be too small considering the price I paid. Lastly, I didn't appreciate leaving the place smelling like burger grease.

input: So I decided to give this place a shot after reading all the reviews on yelp. The place was dead but I have it a shot. The food was okay at best. I actually left there and went across the street to Charlie's. The place was packed and one bite of the redtop pizza and I cursed myself for not coming here first. If you want a sit down meal this place is nice. If you want good pizza go to Charlie's.
Refine this for me please: After reading all the reviews on Yelp, I decided to give this place a try even though it seemed deserted. The food turned out to be average at best, so I left and headed across the street to Charlie's. Unlike the previous place, Charlie's was bustling, and the moment I took a bite of their delicious redtop pizza, I regretted not choosing it first. While the current place is decent for a sit-down meal, if you're craving great pizza, I highly recommend going to Charlie's instead.

input:
We've been shopping here since this location was a Wild Oats. Perhaps I'm just imagining things, but I'd swear it has gotten better since the merger of these two chains.

I love the produce, seafood and cheese here. But it's the personal care section with tons o' natural cosmetics, handmade soaps and the like that brings us in most often. Well, that and the salad bar. In the cooler months, nothing beats hitting Whole Foods for a post-yoga lunch of soup and salad or the deli salad sampler plate. The Carrot Ginger, Split Pea and Corn Chowder soups are the best! Other sure bets: the curried tofu salad (or pretty much any of the deli-made tofu items), sushi to-go boxes and the everything cookies. My most recent find: lavender soda - kinda' dry and really does relax you :-)
Refine this for me please:
We have been loyal customers of this store since it was a Wild Oats, and I have a feeling that the quality has even improved since the merger of these two chains. 

What keeps us coming back are the amazing selection of produce, seafood, and cheese. However, the personal care section is what really grabs our attention, with its wide range of natural cosmetics and handmade soaps. And of course, the salad bar is a favorite too. Especially during the colder months, there is nothing better than grabbing a post-yoga lunch of soup and salad, or indulging in the deli salad sampler plate. Trust me, the Carrot Ginger, Split Pea, and Corn Chowder soups are absolute winners! 

Other guaranteed winners from their deli include the curried tofu salad, any of their tofu creations, to-go sushi boxes, and the everything cookies. And let me tell you about my recent discovery - lavender soda. It has a unique dry taste and has the power to genuinely relax you.

input: OMG the Mediterranean chicken quesadillas what awesome sauce. Definitely recommend to anyone who enjoys fresh Greek food

input: So this is what you need to know. Everything taste great, well at least what I had. input: Only had one experience with this place and it will be my last. I called in the night before to ask if they sell deboned duck and the man on the phone said they could but I would have to request it the day of. I called the following morning to ask to pick up a plain deboned duck and whoever the incompetent girl who answered had trouble getting my order clear. I picked up my order and came home to find that not only did they gave a whole duck with stuffing I never asked for. I called the place back and thy never offered any compensation of any sort except a trade in right as it's a hour before dinner time and the butcher shop is more than thirty minutes away for me. Shame that food from this place is overshadowed by their terrible customer service.

input:
Visited the preserve today based on reviews and was VERY pleased.  

The hikes are great! Lots of wildlife and nature to see on clearly marked paths. 
The birds of prey aviary is wonderful and the learning center not only presents educational information in a beautiful manner, but the AC was a nice break after the hike.  

If you make your way over in the mid afternoon you may be lucky enough to see the birds up close with the handlers. 

All the staff and volunteers are friendly and helpful.
Refine this for me please:
Today, I had the pleasure of visiting the preserve, which I found based on positive reviews, and I must say I was extremely pleased with my experience. The hiking trails offered exceptional opportunities to witness an abundance of wildlife and immerse oneself in nature. The paths were clearly marked, making navigation a breeze.

A highlight of my visit was the captivating birds of prey aviary. The assortment of magnificent birds was truly awe-inspiring. Moreover, the learning center not only provided educational information in a visually appealing manner but also offered a cool respite from the outdoor adventure.

If you plan your visit for the mid-afternoon, you might have the fortunate chance to observe the birds up close during their interaction sessions with the handlers, an experience not to be missed.

I found the entire staff and volunteers to be immensely friendly and helpful throughout my time at the preserve.

input: One of the few diners in North Wilmington, and the only one that probably isn't really bad. I've had totally ordinary diner fare here, and used to come by after swim meets. Nothing particularly good or bad about this place.
Refine this for me please: Located in North Wilmington, this diner stands out among the limited dining options in the area. Unlike its counterparts, it manages to avoid being labeled as subpar. While the food is undeniably ordinary, it served as a convenient post-swim meet hangout in the past. It doesn't boast any particularly exceptional dishes, nor does it fall into the realm of culinary disappointments.

input: We loved the food, service and decor! The minute we walked in for a late lunch we were greeted with a huge smile and a warm welcome from the manager. Our server, Christina (i think that was her name) was delightful. The beer selection was great. We had the chicken rabe sandwhich and pepperoni pizza. The sandwhich was very good, on tasty foccacia bread. The pizza was superb!  We love the "well done" taste. We will definately be back. One problem we may have is our 7 year old is very picky and we didn't see a chidren's menu.
Refine this for me please: We thoroughly enjoyed our experience at this restaurant, from the fantastic food to the attentive service and charming decor. As soon as we arrived for a late lunch, the manager greeted us warmly with a beaming smile. Our server, Christina (if I recall correctly), was a delight throughout our meal. The beer selection impressed us, and we particularly relished the chicken rabe sandwich and pepperoni pizza. The sandwich stood out with its flavorful focaccia bread, while the pizza surpassed our expectations with its perfectly cooked taste. We wholeheartedly intend to return in the future. However, one issue we encountered was the absence of a children's menu, which may pose a challenge for our selective 7-year-old.

input:
I regularly go to student salons for hair cuts and styling. 

I have long, fine, mostly straight Asian hair, and have had mixed results from the Aveda Institute -- to be expected considering I had a different stylist in every case.

Just know that if you haven't had a student stylist before, don't expect perfection. Do expect the cut to take an inordinately long time compared to a seasoned professional -- most of my cuts/styles have taken around 2 hours. The basic cut price includes massaging wash, cut, and blowdry style, plus the stylists do take the time to check in with their teachers and make sure the cut is going the way you want it to. Another plus: all of the stylists I've had at the Aveda Institute have been professional and committed to their service, which isn't always the case at other schools. And the prices are right.
Refine this for me please:
I regularly visit student salons for haircuts and styling. My hair is long, fine, and mostly straight due to my Asian heritage. However, I have experienced mixed results from the Aveda Institute since I have had a different stylist each time.

It's important to understand that perfection may not be achievable when working with student stylists. The process of getting a haircut or style can be quite time-consuming as compared to an experienced professional. On average, my cuts and styles have taken around 2 hours. The basic price includes a relaxing wash, cut, and blowdry style. Additionally, the stylists make sure to consult their instructors and ensure that the haircut meets your expectations.

One positive aspect is that all the stylists I've encountered at the Aveda Institute have been professional and dedicated to providing quality service. This is not always the case at other beauty schools. Furthermore, the prices at the Aveda Institute are affordable and reasonable.

input:
A nice alternative to Cafe du Monde, the beignets were as good if not better. But the real kicker was NO line! 

It was a calm little oasis on Bourbon St. Granted at 8:30 am the street is empty besides garbage men & street washers.

We were there early on a holiday, so we didn't get to experience any live music, sadly.

We did have a full breakfast as well, sharing a crawfish omelet & Cajun hashbrowns. Neither was anything to write home about, but really when your name has Beignet in it, does the other stuff really matter?

A delightful alternative to Cafe du Monde, the beignets at this place were just as good if not better. And the best part? There was no line to wait in!

Located on Bourbon St., this hidden gem offered a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle. Although the street was mostly deserted at 8:30 am, with only garbage men and street washers in sight, it created a serene atmosphere.

Unfortunately, since we visited on a holiday, we missed out on live music, which is usually a highlight of the area.

In addition to the amazing beignets, we also indulged in a full breakfast. We shared a delicious crawfish omelet and Cajun hashbrowns. While they weren't outstanding, let's be honest – when your name has "Beignet" in it, who really cares about the other dishes?

input: Not the best prepared sushi inthe city by a longshot, but for quick (and I mean quick), cheap sushi with a long menu, Mixx is great.
Refine this for me please: While Mixx may not offer the best prepared sushi in the city, it excels in providing quick and affordable sushi options with a diverse menu selection.

input: Completely unprofessional and pathetic. I called last week to get price quotes on a battery and brakes. input:
I would NOT recommend this place to anyone. Their biggest mistake is not having a customer service department. They rely on their sales team to provide customer service meaning every time you call in to try and get something done, you get put into a voicemail because the sales guy is out selling - which should be their only job. This left me on numerous occassions incredibly frustrated that I could not get an answer. I even left the manager a voicemail (big surprise I couldn't get them to answer) and they never had the decency to call me back - Just made my sales person call me back.

I purchased my car last July and was promised numerous things would be done to the car before I purchased it. One of which being the tint on the rear window would be removed as the view out of the back was blurry. Somehow, that passed thru inspection and when I came to sign the papers, I noticed that it was still on the back windshield. I was told that they would have it removed by the time we were done the paperwork. Also, I was told that the price was going to be higher than the original agreement because the sales manager did the math wrong the previous day when we ran numbers. I told him that wasn't my fault and I would only pay the agreed upon amount and he spoke with the manager and got it sorted out. 

After sitting in the office for 2.5 hours, they finally told me that they were unable to even start taking off the tint and I would have to bring the car back. I dropped it off that Friday and let them keep it for the weekend. My sales guy called me on Saturday night to tell me that they never got to finish it and I would have to bring it back again and leave it. I live 45 minutes from the dealership so this isn't something I can easily do. I insisted on them giving me a loaner car for whatever day they would do this as I was sure this wouldn't be a one day process from my previous experience. 2.5 weeks later they were able to provide me with said car and I dropped off my vehicle. When I went to pick up my "finished car" there was still tint left on the bottom of the windshield. 

After all of that I knew I would never bring my car back for service there if that's the kind of service they provide. Now with all the rain we've been having, my trunk is leaking and when I called to check with the service department to see if it would be covered under warranty, I got the same run around with the service department who just said "I don't know" - OK well give me someone who will be able to tell me. Once they forwarded me to the correct person, I again got "I don't know". We need you to bring it in and look at it then submit to our warranty company to see if it gets accepted. No thanks after my previous experience of bringing my car in there to get "serviced". 

Invest in a customer service department to handle complaints in a professional and timely matter. This should not in any way be left upon the sales department to do. My sales guy did the best he could and I appreciated the help he gave me, but no one else would help me throughout the entire process. Not a good look on managements part.
Refine this for me please:
I would strongly discourage anyone from visiting this establishment due to their lack of customer service. Their primary error is the absence of a dedicated customer service department. Instead, they rely on their sales team to handle customer inquiries. Unfortunately, every time I called seeking assistance, I was directed to voicemail as the sales staff was occupied with selling vehicles, which should be their sole responsibility. This resulted in numerous instances of frustration as I was unable to obtain a resolution. Even when I left a voicemail for the manager (unsurprisingly, they did not answer), they failed to return my call and instead instructed my salesperson to contact me.

In July of last year, I purchased a car from this establishment with the understanding that certain modifications would be made prior to my purchase. One such modification was the removal of the tint on the rear window, as it obstructed visibility. However, despite the car passing inspection, I discovered during the signing of the paperwork that the tint was still present. Assurances were given that it would be removed promptly, but after spending 2.5 hours in their office, I was informed that the tint removal had not even commenced and I would need to bring the car back at a later date. Reluctantly, I dropped off the vehicle the following Friday and allowed them to keep it for the weekend. To my disappointment, my salesperson called me on Saturday night to inform me that they had been unable to complete the removal process and I would need to bring it back yet again and leave it with them. Given that I live 45 minutes away, this cause additional inconvenience. I insisted on a loaner car for the day they eventually removed the tint, as I predicted it would not be a one-day process based on prior experiences. After waiting for 2.5 weeks, they finally provided me with a loaner car and I dropped off my vehicle. When I arrived to collect my "finished car," I discovered that there was still tint remaining on the bottom of the windshield.

At this point, I made the decision to never bring my car back for service at this establishment, given the quality of service I had received. Unfortunately, my trunk is now leaking due to recent heavy rainfall, and when I called the service department to inquire whether this issue would be covered under warranty, I encountered the same lack of knowledge and assistance. Their response was simply, "I don't know." I requested to be connected with someone who could provide me with the necessary information, only to be met with a repeat of the same response. They insisted that I bring my car in so they could assess the issue and submit a claim to the warranty company for potential coverage. After my previous experiences with their service, I declined their offer and chose not to pursue further assistance from them.

It is imperative that this establishment invests in a separate customer service department to handle complaints in a professional and timely manner. It is unacceptable for the responsibility of addressing customer concerns to fall solely on the sales team. While my salesperson did their best to assist me, I received no support or assistance from anyone else throughout the entire process. This lack of accountability on the part of management reflects poorly on the establishment as a whole.

input: I love this restaurant. The owners are the nicest family. The food is delicious!!. My favorite is bacon pizza. I love that there is a play room for my kids to play while we wait for our food.

input:
Harry's blue bell is a nice spot. We stopped a few days ago for a quick dinner. It's tucked in the corner of a shopping center and it's very easy to miss. It was packed and seemed like the place to be for locals. The inside is nice but small, only a few tables in the entire place. The service was just okay. 

The beer selection is very good as are the prices on the beer. The food menu was a bit limited with you're basic bar food. The wife went with the bbq pulled pork and I went with the chicken and honey mustard wrap. The bbq pork was good, the bun was nicely toasted but the sauce was overly sweet for our liking. The wrap was fresh and good but nothing spectacular. The fries were hot and crispy. The kale slaw was fantastic but a very small portion.

Overall it was a decent meal. I wouldn't go out of my way to go back. If I were in the area I'd stop though. Solid 3 stars.
Refine this for me please:
Harry's Blue Bell is a charming hidden gem tucked away in a corner of a shopping center, making it easy to miss. During our visit a few days ago, we stopped for a quick dinner and found the place to be bustling with locals, clearly the go-to spot in town. While the interior of the restaurant is small, it still manages to exude a pleasant atmosphere.

The service we received was satisfactory, though not exceptional. However, what truly impressed us was the impressive selection of beers, which boasted both quality and reasonable prices. On the other hand, the food menu was somewhat limited, offering your typical bar food options. My wife opted for the BBQ pulled pork, which had a nicely toasted bun but unfortunately, the sauce was overly sweet for our taste. As for me, I went with the chicken and honey mustard wrap, which was fresh and enjoyable but lacked that wow factor. To accompany our meals, we were served hot and crispy fries, while the kale slaw, albeit delicious, was disappointingly served in a very small portion.

Overall, our dining experience at Harry's Blue Bell was decent, but not enough to tempt us into making a special trip to return. However, if we were in the area again, we would certainly consider stopping by. Thus, we would rate our experience a solid 3 stars.

input: Just an update regarding the only complaint in my first review of Kajuns: the smoke. I must admit that my clothes still retain the smell of smoke when I leave, but I am willing to accept this compromise. input:

input:
Freedom toast = check, freedom fries = check, awesome breakfast food = check.

The is a greek owned pancake house (hence the over doing it on naming the food) and is a great alternative to your larger chain pancake houses such as Robert Evans, IHopity hop, and Mr. Dennys. 

We eat here every new years day, typically around 2 pm when we drag ourselves out of a drunken slumber to brave the bitter cold. They never have a problem seating our group of about 12-15 and are pleasant and quick service. 

The energetic owner likes to roam around making sure everything is going well. In my opinion, the food is also better than the chains. The secret ingredient is love.

Every New Year's Day, around 2 pm, our group of about 12-15 friends gathers at this place. Despite feeling groggy and braving the bitter cold, we always manage to find seating without any trouble. The staff is pleasant, providing quick service.

The passionate owner actively ensures that everything runs smoothly, making rounds to check on guests. Personally, I believe the food here is superior to that of chain restaurants. There's a secret ingredient in their dishes - love.

input:

input:
We have big group of 12 for the office outing lunch. I would said for the number of people we have, the service is not the best but good enough. Only one of our members get the food late. The close out may need to work on it. Tip was added since we have large group which may my bill easy. 

I have order the lamb kebab (Shish Kebab) plate. It come with two choices of side. I got the rice and the babaghanoush. The rice was well cook and nice aroma. The babaghanoush was well prepared and great with extra olive oil. The presentation of the dish is pleasant. However, the meat did not measured up. It was too dry and the marinated is not over the top. They need to improve on this area. 

I have been here several time. My previous experience is better. During the month of Ramadan, they serve the buffet that are plenty of choices and attractive. I would said try them during this time. The buffet of Ramadan usually start at 8:30. Go early because is a lot of customers.

We had a large group of 12 people for our office outing lunch. Overall, the service was satisfactory given the number of people, although one of our members did receive their food late. The closeout process could use some improvement. Since we were a large group, the tip was automatically added, which made splitting the bill easier.

I ordered the lamb kebab (Shish Kebab) plate, which came with two side choices. I chose rice and babaghanoush. The rice was cooked perfectly and had a nice aroma. The babaghanoush was well-prepared and tasted great with the extra olive oil. The presentation of the dish was pleasing. However, the meat fell short. It was dry and the marination was lacking. I have visited this restaurant multiple times before, and my previous experiences were better. During the month of Ramadan, they offer a buffet with plenty of choices that are quite appealing. I would recommend trying their buffet during this time. It typically starts at 8:30, but it's advisable to go early to avoid the large crowds.
