input:
This review is mainly chicken talk as Cuenelli's Peruvian Style Rotisserie Chicken brings to the table. Pollo a la brasa.... Rotisserie chicken.... Whatever you wanna call it.... I call it a technique done here with love and pride. Lets be clear, you will find no comparison coming from your grocer deli section or at the checkout isle.

Why do I think this chicken have some TLC put into it? On biting down of this chicken you can note seasoning flavors down to the bone. This is an inclination that prior to even getting into the rotisserie oven, these birds spend some time in some form of marinating process. Building flavor, the chicken also has a seasoning rub all over the skin.

Lets go to this rotisserie oven. Another unique element is this oven has a charcoal or grill like component. This gives the chicken a smoky element in the flavor build. As these birds turn in this oven, they keep moist from the natural drippings dropping from bird to bird as they rotate through this oven. In turn, this a reason why some people may note some pieces the skin end up dry and crispy and others get moist or soggy skin on their chicken In the end, you end up with this tender, smoky, well seasoned, fall off the bone goodness. Wait.... how can they add more flavor? Cuenelli's serves it with two dipping sauces, a chimichurri  which gives a herbaceous and slightly spicy flavor, and an aioli which has a garlicky - lemony element.

Round out this meal with some solid sides. Must haves for me would be the cilantro rice. Another herbaceous addition that works well with this meal. I got to use the word herbaceous a few times in this review, it has reflects such great imagery for food talk:) Must have beans with rice no? I pick the spicy pinto beans over the black beans at this establishment but lets be clear these beans are pretty spicy. I also love the maduros here. These sweet plantatains are cooked to perfection where the outsides has this caramelization from the natural sugar of the sweet plantain, leaving you with this toffee-like, stick to your tooth exterior and soft and sweet interior. 

Wash all down with Inca cola or a bottle of chicha limena.  Inca cola is almost like a cola champagne or a cream soda type of drink. Chicha Limena I say is Christmas in a bottle. This juice has a floral base blended with cinnamon and cloves.

Though Cuenelli's Peruvian Style Rotisserie Chicken have many other notable Latin dishes, the one thing that comes to mind to me is this chicken made with love. This chicken gives new meaning to all who thought they knew what rotisserie chicken is. I say, go to Cuenelli's and taste again for the very first time.
Refine this for me please:
This review focuses primarily on the chicken at Cuenelli's Peruvian Style Rotisserie Chicken. It is clear that this chicken is prepared with love and pride, and cannot be compared to deli or grocery store rotisserie chicken.

The chicken is marinated before being cooked in the rotisserie oven, resulting in flavors that penetrate down to the bone. Additionally, the chicken is seasoned with a rub that covers the skin. One unique aspect of the rotisserie oven is the charcoal or grill component, which adds a smoky element to the flavor. As the birds rotate in the oven, the natural drippings keep them moist. This can lead to some pieces having dry and crispy skin, while others have moist or soggy skin. Overall, the chicken is tender, smoky, well-seasoned, and falls off the bone. 

To enhance the flavor even further, Cuenelli's serves the chicken with two dipping sauces: chimichurri for an herbaceous and slightly spicy flavor, and aioli for a garlicky and lemony element.

The meal can be rounded out with delicious sides. The cilantro rice is a must-have, complementing the meal well. Spicy pinto beans are recommended over black beans, but they should be noted as being quite spicy. The maduros, which are sweet plantains, are cooked perfectly with a caramelized exterior and a soft and sweet interior.

To accompany the meal, Inca cola or chicha limena are suggested. Inca cola is compared to cola champagne or cream soda, while chicha limena is described as Christmas in a bottle, with a floral base blended with cinnamon and cloves.

While Cuenelli's Peruvian Style Rotisserie Chicken offers other notable Latin dishes, the chicken is what stands out the most. It challenges preconceived notions of rotisserie chicken and should be experienced again for the first time at Cuenelli's.

input: fuck yes. meat, bourbon libations, and a salad (to round things out aka make myself feel better about ingesting the aforementioned two items.) i took myself on an early birthday date with myself and was not disappointed (neither in the food nor the company). i had a medium rare plain burger to see if it was worth all the fuss...no cheese, bacon, dressing, etc to disguise the quality of the meat. (of course, no bread either since i'm gluten free.) the burger was great - perfectly cooked and seasoned... though, i felt like a bit of a freak sitting at the bar eating my burger with a knife and a fork. i'd like to come back to try a fancypants burger since the extras look pretty tasty.  the salad was so-so; it was no frills with the perfect amount of dressing. the bartender-cum-waiter was super attentive but not cloyingly so. he made delicious sazeracs to accompany my repast.
Refine this for me please: Absolutely! I thoroughly enjoyed my early birthday date with myself. The meal consisted of a delightful combination of meat, bourbon libations, and a salad to balance out the indulgence. In order to truly savor the quality of the meat, I opted for a plain medium rare burger without any cheese, bacon, or dressing to distract from its natural flavors. Being gluten-free, I had to forgo the bread as well. I must confess, dining alone at the bar with a knife and fork made me feel slightly peculiar, but the burger itself was beyond satisfying - perfectly cooked and expertly seasoned. In the future, I would love to return and sample one of their fancypants burgers, as the additional toppings looked absolutely delectable. As for the salad, it was decent, with a simple yet tasteful dressing. The bartender, who also doubled as my waiter, provided attentive service without being too overbearing. To accompany my meal, the bartender skillfully crafted sazeracs, which were absolutely delicious.

input:

input:
The long and the short of it: A romantic little BYOB in Newtown Square that hits the mark in several areas. Big portions at decent prices. You won't leave hungry!

And now for a full review:

I have been to this Fellini's Cafe and the one in Bryn Mawr several times and each time I've visited there have been some memorable moments...and there have been speed bumps that keep this place from reaching its full potential.

On my latest visit this past Friday night, I made reservations for 730. My beautiful wife and I arrived right at 730. Although there were two vacant tables available, it took them at least 10 minutes or so to seat us. And when they did, they broke up a table for 6 instead of putting us at the 2 seater. Odd.

Being out and away from the kids for a few hours, we wanted at least a little bit of privacy, instead of sitting next to (pretty much connected to) a table of four. We asked the manager if we could be moved to the 2 seater...he said fine. Another 5-10 minutes (too long!) later a member of the wait staff came and, without any indication as to his intentions, whisked up our bottle of wine and silverware and ran off to the other table. Not a problem, but some eye contact and a simple 'follow me please' with even a hint of a smile would have been lovely. We shrugged and just rolled with it.

The interior is quaint, and the lighting is dim. It's a nice place for a romantic meal. But it is LOUD. So loud I would say this place is kid friendly despite being in such close quarters with your neighbors. Not sure if we'd ever try taking our four kids there (actually I'm certain we won't) but one or two can be done without much trouble.

Our waitress was extremely polite and offered the energy and enthusiasm that our other friend lacked.

For dinner, we ordered a caesar salad to share and for our main courses my wife opted for her usual tagliatelli with mushroom cream sauce and i had what i always have, the tortellini pasticiatti.

Complimentary with the meal were two pieces of bruschetta (very nice) and a small loaf of crusty Italian bread, which is served with butter packets (which perhaps only I find strange for an Italian restaurant?). 

Overall the food was delicious, except for a few somewhat minor hiccups: 

1. The caesar salad was served on a warm plate. The salad was excellent and would have been legendary had it been served on a chilled (or at least not warm!) plate.

2. I am pretty sure they used frozen peas in the tortellini dish, which is fine with me as long as you make sure the peas are thawed before you serve it! Only a few peas were not quite thawed, but it marred what was otherwise a perfectly crafted masterpiece of a dish.

When we paid, the manager allowed us to use an expired gift card. That was a very nice gesture and one that required no push from us to induce.

All in all, I'll keep visiting Fellini because it's relatively inexpensive and they do most everything well.
Refine this for me please:
Overall, Fellini's Cafe in Newtown Square is a romantic BYOB that excels in several areas. The generous portions and reasonable prices ensure you won't leave hungry. However, there are some areas that prevent it from reaching its full potential.

During my recent visit, despite making a reservation for 7:30pm, my wife and I had to wait around 10 minutes to be seated, despite there being available tables. Additionally, when we were finally seated, they chose to break up a table for 6 instead of seating us in a more intimate 2-seater table.

The atmosphere is quaint with dim lighting, perfect for a romantic dinner. However, it is quite loud, making it less suitable for families with children. The service staff was friendly, with our waitress being particularly polite and attentive.

For dinner, we shared a delicious caesar salad, although it was served on a warm plate, which detracted slightly from its quality. For our main courses, my wife enjoyed her usual tagliatelli with mushroom cream sauce, and I had the tortellini pasticiatti. The food was overall delicious, although there were a few minor hiccups. The tortellini dish seemed to include frozen peas, which were not completely thawed when served, slightly affecting the quality. However, the complimentary bruschetta and crusty Italian bread served with butter were a nice touch.

When it came time to pay, the manager kindly allowed us to use an expired gift card without us even needing to ask. This gesture was greatly appreciated.

Despite some minor flaws, I will continue to visit Fellini's because of its affordability and overall good quality in most aspects.

input:
Pretty bummed I didn't try out the Catbird Seat, because this place was totes underwhelming. When you enter, there is a large, awkward entrance and you have to go upstairs to be seated. It was probably only half full, but since it was strange weather, we decided to sit indoors. I'll just say again, walking up towards the hostess as she watches you approach just feels....weird. 

Our server was nice, and we joked with him about the silly flower in a very knock-over-able vase. We got two drinks--julep and one of their other ones with gin, both of which were utterly average to bad. 

The crowd was sort of stuffy. The bread was blah. The food was pretty forgettable. The tenderloin was good because it was a good cut of meat. The Amish chicken was pretty average, with a not so flavorful and slightly MSG-y twang jus. Their signature grits was underwhelming as well. 

All in all, stuffy and so overpriced. Bummed out!
Refine this for me please:
I'm disappointed that I didn't try out the Catbird Seat because my experience there was quite underwhelming. The entrance was large and awkward, requiring us to go upstairs to be seated. Despite the place being only half full, we decided to sit indoors due to the strange weather. Approaching the hostess while being watched felt uncomfortable. 

Our server was pleasant and we had a light-hearted exchange about the easily tipped over flower in a vase. However, the two drinks we ordered - a julep and one with gin - were mediocre to poor in quality. 

The crowd had an air of pretentiousness. The bread was unremarkable and the food itself was forgettable. While the tenderloin was decent due to its good cut of meat, the Amish chicken was average and its jus had a slightly unpleasant MSG-like taste. Even their signature grits were underwhelming. 

Overall, the atmosphere was stuffy and the prices were too high for what we received. I was left feeling disappointed.

input:
This review is LONG overdue!  I visited Stitch-It in June 2013

In brief: Stitch it did an EXCELLENT job on my dress and I was extremely pleased.  I needed it done in a rush and they were able to accommodate me.  Given the tight turnaround, and the work that needed to be done, I didn't mind paying a premium.  The service and results far exceeded my expectations.

Complete Experience: I was attending a convention in Nashville, TN and had ordered an evening gown online a week before (admitted procrastinator tendencies).  The gown was a navy blue Tadashi Shoji evening gown with sequins and an intricately designed lace and sheer layered bodice. The gown was a tad bit too long and there was a bulge in the back. The dress arrived a few days before I was scheduled to fly out to Nashville and I knew I wouldn't have time to get it tailored before leaving.  I found a few Nashville area tailor shops on Yelp, read the reviews and decided I might try Stitch-It.  I also saw a few cleaners that advertised they performed tailoring services, but they (quite frankly) didn't give me the warm and fuzzies.  

Stitch-It was about a 30 minute drive from the Gaylord Hotel where I was staying, so before taking a taxi that far, I decided to check with the hotel to see if they had an in-house tailor.  When I took the dress to the Gaylord tailor/seamstress (who was the nicest lady ever), she looked at the gown and said "I can hem the bottom....I'd have to do it by hand.  The top part though....I won't touch that with a 10ft. pole!"  I laughed, but appreciated her honesty in not being able to handle the work that I needed done.  

I contacted Stitch-It and sent pictures of the dress via text message to a nice young man who's name I can't remember (I think it was Cameron...I could be wrong).  They assured me that they should be able to accommodate me, so I hopped a cab and visited Stitch-It.  When I arrived I was greeted by courteous and professional staff.  I was shown to the dressing room and changed into my gown.  My personal tailor was Maggie O'Neill and she was AWESOME!  After the fitting and pinning, I left the gown and picked it up in two days.  It fit perfectly and was well worth the fee.  If I lived in Nashville, I would DEFINITELY use Stitch-It on a regular basis.
Refine this for me please:
This review is LONG overdue! I visited Stitch-It in June 2013, and I must say, they did an EXCELLENT job on my dress. I was extremely pleased with their service and the results.

I needed my dress tailored in a rush, and Stitch-It was able to accommodate my tight turnaround time. Despite having to pay a premium for the rush service, I didn't mind because the final outcome exceeded my expectations.

To provide some context, I was attending a convention in Nashville, TN and had ordered an evening gown online just a week before (yes, I admit I have procrastinator tendencies). The gown was a navy blue Tadashi Shoji evening gown with sequins and a beautifully designed lace and sheer layered bodice. However, it was slightly too long and had a bulge in the back. 

The dress arrived a few days before my trip, and I knew I wouldn't have time to get it tailored before leaving. So, I turned to Yelp to find a tailor in the Nashville area, and that's when I came across Stitch-It. Although there were a few cleaners that advertised tailoring services, they didn't give me the assurance and confidence that I needed.

Stitch-It was located about a 30-minute drive from the Gaylord Hotel where I was staying. Before making the trip, I decided to inquire with the hotel if they had an in-house tailor. To my disappointment, the Gaylord tailor/seamstress informed me that she could only hem the bottom of the dress by hand, and she couldn't touch the intricate top part.

With no other options, I contacted Stitch-It and sent them pictures of the dress via text message. I spoke with a kind young man, whose name I believe was Cameron, and he assured me that they should be able to accommodate my needs. So, I jumped in a taxi and headed to Stitch-It.

When I arrived, I was warmly greeted by the courteous and professional staff. They directed me to the dressing room where I changed into my gown. My personal tailor, Maggie O'Neill, was absolutely AWESOME! She took precise measurements and diligently worked on fitting and pinning the dress.

I left my gown in their capable hands and returned two days later to pick it up. To my delight, it fit perfectly and was well worth the fee I paid. If I lived in Nashville, I would DEFINITELY make Stitch-It my go-to tailor.

input:
This is the most beautiful salon I have ever seen. It very clean an organized with an amazing friendly staff. I was given a tour by the owner Doug he is one cool dude.

Doug has an extensive resume of accomplishments as a stylist, he teaches and trains all over the world and brings his expertise and share with his salon staff by holding a weekly training in his salon to ensure his staff is up to date with the latest technique and fashions. If I would trust anybody with my hair it would be here at this place.

I would recommend this place to anybody local or is from out of town.
Refine this for me please:
This salon is an absolute gem, truly the most beautiful establishment I have ever had the pleasure of visiting. Impeccably clean and exquisitely organized, it boasts an exceptionally friendly and talented staff that made me feel instantly at ease. During my visit, I was fortunate enough to have the owner, Doug, personally give me a tour. Let me tell you, he's not just any ordinary owner – Doug is one cool and impressive individual.

Having an extensive resume of accomplishments as a stylist, Doug's expertise is known and sought after internationally. He dedicates his time to teaching and training others all around the world, yet he still manages to bring his invaluable knowledge and skills to his own salon. Through regular weekly training sessions, Doug ensures that his staff stays at the forefront of the latest techniques and trends in the industry. This level of commitment and dedication is simply unparalleled.

If you care about your hair and are looking for someone you can trust implicitly, this is the place to be. Whether you are a local resident or someone visiting from out of town, I wholeheartedly recommend this extraordinary establishment. You won't find a better salon experience anywhere else.

input:
So delicious! I am so happy Reno is getting more variety in it's restaurants. 
Bab Cafe has a great menu, service was quick even during the lunch rush. 
I had the Dak-Galbi Bibim-bab "teriyaki chicken." The meat was tasty, veggies were fresh, sauces were awesome. I also ordered a side of potstickers (because I can never resist potstickers) and they were so great. 
Only wish it were a little easier to get to, being downtown parking can be a challenge.
Refine this for me please:
I absolutely loved it! It's such a joy to see Reno's restaurant scene expanding with more diverse options. Bab Cafe exceeded my expectations with their outstanding menu and lightning-fast service, even during the busy lunch hour. 

The Dak-Galbi Bibim-bab, also known as "teriyaki chicken," was simply delightful. The meat was flavorful, the veggies were crisp and fresh, and the sauces were absolutely fantastic. I couldn't resist ordering a side of potstickers, and boy, was I glad I did! They were incredibly tasty.

The only drawback I encountered was the slightly challenging accessibility due to being located downtown. Parking can be a bit of a hassle.

input:
If you're looking for a great brunch place in New Orleans, definitely come here!

My boyfriend and I had brunch here on Sunday, and we loved it! We both started with the Brandy Milk Punch, which was divine.  If you are of age, order this drink!  It is an alcoholic milkshake, and I could literally go here just to drink that because it is so good.  

They bring out fresh bread and butter, and then my boyfriend and I ordered the trio of appetizers.  The trio is quite small, but it includes a duck springroll, fried chicken livers and a fried oyster.  The duck springroll came with a wonderful tangy sauce, which I greatly enjoyed.  My boyfriend enjoyed the fried chicken livers and the fried oyster, but those are not two of my favorite things.

For my entree, I ordered the shrimp and grits.  Oh my goodness... so good! The shrimp are bacon-wrapped, and the grits are true Southern grits.  I will definitely order this dish again when I get the chance to return.  My boyfriend ordered the fish of the day, which was blackened Mahi Mahi, and he loved it.  

Definitely go to Mr. B's!
Refine this for me please:
If you're searching for an excellent brunch spot in New Orleans, look no further than Mr. B's! My boyfriend and I had the pleasure of dining here on Sunday and we were blown away. To start, we both indulged in the heavenly Brandy Milk Punch. I highly recommend this drink if you're of legal drinking age; it's like an alcoholic milkshake that I could happily come back for on its own.

We were served fresh bread and butter, followed by our chosen appetizer trio. Although the portions were small, the selection was delightful. I particularly enjoyed the duck springroll with its tangy sauce. My boyfriend savored the fried chicken livers and fried oyster, though they weren't exactly to my taste.

Moving on to our entrees, I couldn't resist the shrimp and grits. Let me tell you, they were fantastic! The bacon-wrapped shrimp paired perfectly with the authentic Southern grits. I promise to order this dish again when I have the opportunity to return. On the other hand, my boyfriend opted for the blackened Mahi Mahi, their fish of the day, and he couldn't have been happier with his choice.

Be sure to make a visit to Mr. B's - it's definitely worth it!

input:
Came there again because of yelp reviews!
Just want to tell you the way the salon looks like already giving you feeling that they know what are they doing! Very clean, simple, professional. Two ladies met me at the front room, ask me about my preferences, tell me about the packages and prices they have - very understandable.  They put some information about me in the computer and i am all set for waxing!  They goes by appointments - always!! 
I did my armpits - to give it a try) My specialist were Despina!  Really really nice lady i've been pleased talking to her while she was easy with no pain taking off the hair which were really hard cause for 3-4 month i used shaving and the hair got really thick! Still it wasn't so painful cause she used the hard wax which i Loved immediately! Great job - very clean - fast and easy! And price was just 16$ which were really good deal for this quality of waxing! 
She asked me when i would like to come back for armpits an we scheduled apointment in 3 weeks! But I might go earlier for bikini! I believe it wouldn't be so painful like it was before! So i will go for it! 
As well i bought there a treat for ingrown hair!  We will see how it works)
Thank you Very much for great service! And great atmosphere! You can trust them!
***** little addition********
Did a bikini today!  Never was painless than today! ! Next time I will do full bikini! 
Again thank you Despina!
Refine this for me please:
I returned to this salon again because of the great Yelp reviews! The salon's appearance immediately gives off a professional vibe with its cleanliness and simplicity. When I arrived, two ladies greeted me in the front room and asked about my preferences. They explained the different packages and prices in a clear and understandable manner. They entered my information into the computer and I was all set for my waxing appointment. 

I decided to try waxing my armpits and my specialist, Despina, was really friendly. She made the experience easy and painless, even though my hair had become thick from months of shaving. Despina used hard wax, which I loved, and the job was done quickly and efficiently. The price was only $16, which was a great deal considering the quality of the waxing. Despina also asked when I would like to come back for my next armpit waxing and we scheduled an appointment in three weeks. However, I am considering going for a bikini wax earlier because I believe it won't be as painful as it was before.

I also purchased a treatment for ingrown hair at the salon and I am excited to see how it works. Overall, I am very thankful for the great service and atmosphere provided by the salon. They have earned my trust.

***** little addition********

Today, I got a bikini wax and it was even less painful than before! Next time, I am going to try a full bikini wax. I want to thank Despina once again for her excellent service.

input:
After trying twice unsuccessfully to get there early enough to get a meal within 20 minutes, I finally was able to break away from work and was 5th in line. I had heard of the "food truck nazi" and that it was the best in town and found Gus, the falafel nazi, as he called himself, lived up to his reputation and more. 
As my turn came up, I approached the cart tenuously, for I did not want to blow it by asking too many questions. He immediately recognized me as a new customer and told me all about the fresh ingredients he uses.
Chicken is cooked over coal and was tender on the inside and perfectly cooked on the outside. Falafel was delicious, as were the grapes and his homemade pasta that went along with it.
There was enough food for 2 people.
Well worth the wait!
Refine this for me please:
After unsuccessfully attempting to arrive early enough for two previous attempts at getting a meal within 20 minutes, I was finally able to break away from work and found myself fifth in line. Prior to this, I had heard about the highly regarded "food truck nazi" known as Gus, who claimed to be the best in town. I can confidently say that Gus, also known as the falafel nazi, exceeded his reputation. 

As I cautiously approached the cart, mindful of not asking too many questions and potentially spoiling my chance, Gus immediately recognized me as a new customer and graciously shared details about the fresh ingredients he utilizes in his dishes. The chicken, cooked over a charcoal fire, exhibited a tender, juicy inside and a flawlessly cooked exterior. The falafel was truly delicious, complemented by delectable grapes and his homemade pasta accompaniment. Notably, the portion provided was generous enough to satisfy two people. 

Without a doubt, the wait proved to be incredibly worthwhile.

input: SRS is truly an exceptional management company. They have been extremely accommodating with very specific requests that I have made. Recommend.
Refine this for me please: SRS is an exceptional management company that truly goes above and beyond to meet their clients' needs. I have personally experienced their exceptional level of accommodation, as they have exceeded all my expectations by addressing even the most specific and unique requests. I highly recommend their services.

input: Another five-star dining review!  Fresco serves-up wonderful fresh and tasty pizza.  We tried this store as a change in our usual fare when we visit Tucson during the gem shows.  For what you get, their prices are very reasonable.  My husband and I were new, and the friendly young man behind the counter told us about their pizza, how it is made from all fresh ingredients, etc.  The restaurant was very clean and inviting.  We ordered the meat-special pizza, which included chunks of chicken besides the usual sausage, pepperoni, ham and bacon.  The pizza was GREAT!  Crispy AND tender crust, plenty of toppings, and a "multiple-napkiner."  We also had a nice talk with the young owner, and you can tell his business is his passion and only wants to serve the best and highest quality food to his customers.  We will definitely return next year!  Do I recommend Fresco?...YOU BETCHA I DO!!!
Refine this for me please: Another outstanding dining experience! Fresco delivers delicious and fresh pizza that deserves five stars. During our trip to Tucson for the gem shows, we decided to try something different and stumbled upon this gem. Surprisingly, their prices are surprisingly reasonable for the quality of food they offer. As newcomers, we were greeted warmly by a friendly young man at the counter who passionately described their pizzas, emphasizing the use of fresh ingredients. The restaurant itself was impeccably clean and had an inviting ambiance. Opting for the meat-special pizza with chunks of chicken alongside sausage, pepperoni, ham, and bacon, we were blown away. The crust was the perfect balance of crispy and tender, generously topped and ultimately a messy (in a good way) delight. We even had the pleasure of engaging in a pleasant conversation with the young owner, whose dedication to providing the best, top-notch food for his customers was evident. We are already planning to return next year. Without a doubt, Fresco comes highly recommended - you won't be disappointed!

input:
We went to this restaurant after running in the Philadelphia marathon.  We had a large group (12) with us including kids (ages 10-14), parents and grandparents.   The place is very clean and looks fairly new or at least newly decorated.  The service was excellent and friendly.  The food was very good for the parents but everything was on the spicy side which was not so great for the kids and grandparents.  The lighting was very dim which was an issue for the grandparents reading the menu.  

The Veggie wings were great as were the cactus and sweet potato burritos.   The guacamole was very good although the spicy chips were a little too much.

They offer pitchers of margaritas which was great for our large group.
Refine this for me please:
After participating in the Philadelphia marathon, our group of 12, including children aged 10-14, parents, and grandparents, decided to dine at this restaurant. The establishment appeared to be exceptionally clean and possessed a relatively new or recently redecorated ambience. The service provided was outstanding, with friendly staff members attending to us. While the food impressed the parents, it leaned towards the spicier side, which was not ideal for the kids and grandparents. Additionally, the dim lighting presented an issue for the elderly members of our party when trying to read the menu.

Nonetheless, the Veggie wings, cactus, and sweet potato burritos were excellent choices. We particularly enjoyed the delicious guacamole, despite finding the accompanying spicy chips a bit overwhelming.

One advantageous feature was that pitchers of margaritas were available, which was ideal for our larger group.

input:
First of all, I think this might be my first Yelp review about "fast food." It's not a genre I ever eat unless I'm forced to on a road trip.  However, I am from Buffalo, NY, and am a chicken-finger connoisseur, so I decided to give this place a chance.  Additionally, it was on a road trip of sorts.  We had been at the beach all day and were halfway back home to central Tampa.

The service is amazing!  I have never seen fast-food workers who take so much pride in their jobs.  These people were drinking the Zaxby's cool-aid!  They seemed more like Disney employees than fast-food workers.  Both a female counter gal and a male (possible the manager/franchisee) went out of their way to make sure we liked everything.  

The food was a solid 4 stars, but my review overall is rounded up for the above mentioned points.  We had the chicken finger sandwiches on Texas toast.  While the chicken fingers themselves were super juicy and moist, the Texas toast was too greasy to eat them on.  I love sauce and enjoyed the variety.  We tried the Zax, hot honey mustard, insane hot and ranch.  What is missing from the sauce variety, for me, is a spicy bbq and blue cheese.  Serving ranch with hot sauce is an insult to the folks in Buffalo that created the cuisine.  Aside from the bread and sauce small issues, I really enjoyed our meal.  Additionally, it was so cheap!!  $12 and change for 2 meals with drinks.  

I am a fan!  This place doesn't quite hit all the marks of Buffalo-Inspired food, but it does a pretty good job of putting a southern twist on chicken fingers!
Refine this for me please:
First of all, this is my first Yelp review about "fast food" as it's not a genre I typically indulge in unless forced to on a road trip. However, being from Buffalo, NY, where I consider myself a chicken-finger connoisseur, I decided to give this place a chance during a road trip. Additionally, we had spent the day at the beach and were halfway back home to central Tampa.

I was pleasantly surprised by the exceptional service! The level of pride and dedication exhibited by the fast-food workers was unmatched. It felt more like being at a Disney park than a typical fast-food establishment. Both a female counter attendant and a male, possibly the manager, went out of their way to ensure our satisfaction.

As for the food, I would give it a solid 4 stars, but my overall review is rounded up due to the aforementioned points. We opted for the chicken finger sandwiches on Texas toast. While the chicken fingers themselves were incredibly juicy and moist, the Texas toast turned out to be too greasy to fully enjoy them. The sauce selection was varied and enjoyable, with options like Zax, hot honey mustard, insane hot, and ranch. However, I personally felt that a spicy BBQ and blue cheese sauce were missing from the lineup. Offering ranch with hot sauce seemed somewhat disrespectful to the creators of Buffalo cuisine. Despite these minor bread and sauce issues, our meal was thoroughly enjoyable. Moreover, it was incredibly affordable at just $12 and change for two meals with drinks.

I consider myself a fan! Although this place doesn't quite live up to the standards of authentic Buffalo-inspired food, it does an admirable job of putting a unique southern twist on chicken fingers!

input: I can't say enough great things about the baked goodies that come out of this kitchen.  I have YET to have anything that is 'subpar'.  Everything comes out with full flavor and with the right texture! Then the delicate and decorative detailing--just phenomenal.  You can tell that TIME and LOVE goes into each piece of goodness!!  I love all of the signature flavors.  I am a 'classic' cupcake person- and absolutely love her signature cream cheese frosting.  Talk about melt in your mouth! If you are looking for any sort of cake, cupcake, pie, cookie, or ALL THE ABOVE...do yourself a favor and treat yourself and loved ones to Sugar Coated! (no pun intended!) =)
Refine this for me please:
I cannot express enough how amazing the baked goodies from this kitchen are. Every single item I have tried has exceeded my expectations; there hasn't been a single mediocre or below-average treat. The flavors are rich and satisfying, and the texture is just right. Moreover, the attention to detail in the delicate and artistic decorations is absolutely phenomenal. It is evident that an immense amount of time and love goes into every piece of deliciousness created here. 
Personally, I am a fan of classic cupcakes, and the signature cream cheese frosting is pure bliss. It truly melts in your mouth and enhances the entire experience. Whether you're in the mood for cake, cupcakes, pies, cookies, or all of the above, do yourself and your loved ones a favor and indulge in the delights of Sugar Coated (pun not intended!). It will be a treat that you won't regret.

input:
It is unfortunate that with such a unique location and such a brand and product offering this specific store offers such lousy service. The wait is endless, no one is available to help and at Christmas time getting a gift wrap is act of God that requires endless wait. I bought gifts and knew that the wait for wrapping would be long SO I even left my items at the store to be gift wrapped at their leisure. They were not even moved from the counter where I bought them when I returned almost two hours later ready for pick up. This was a gift that needed to be given and The staff COMPLETELY "dropped the ball" on my time constraints! 

I love their stuff, but today was my last shopping experience at this location: couldn't get a gift wrapped after being assured that it could be done in a timely fashion???  I'll  cancel my card, do everything online and try not to go there if I can. It's really a shame!
Refine this for me please:
It is truly unfortunate that despite having such a unique location, brand, and product offering, the service provided by this particular store falls far below expectations. The wait times are never-ending, assistance is nowhere to be found, and getting a gift wrapped during the chaotic Christmas period seems like an impossible task. Despite being aware of the long wait for gift wrapping, I thoughtfully left my purchased items at the store, hoping they would be efficiently wrapped at their convenience. However, to my dismay, when I returned nearly two hours later to collect my items, they hadn't even been moved from the counter where I originally bought them. This was a time-sensitive gift that needed to be given, and the staff completely mishandled the situation, effectively ruining my plans.

Although I genuinely adore the products they offer, today's shopping experience at this location has left me disheartened and consequently, I have made the decision that it will be my final visit. I was assured that gift wrapping could be completed promptly, but instead, my time constraints were completely disregarded. As a result, I will now be canceling my card, transitioning to online shopping, and avoiding this store whenever possible. It truly is a regrettable situation that such circumstances have occurred.

input: They have a couple of really nice ladies, that go out of their way to help you. But there's one that will rip your head off if you're not careful. It won't take ya long to figure this out on your own though.  Jus' sayin'......
Refine this for me please: They have a few exceptionally kind and helpful ladies, but there is one you must be cautious with as she can be quite aggressive. However, you will quickly notice this for yourself. Just a friendly heads-up.

input: Hendricks is a must try in St.Louis. The meats,sauces,and sides are better than most barbecue places.Onion rings are huge and the coleslaw is tasty and finely shredded. Service is good and very friendly. Takes awhile to get the meal,but it gives you time to check out the unique decor.
Refine this for me please: Hendricks is a must-visit destination in St. Louis. This barbecue joint stands out from the rest with its superior quality meats, delectable sauces, and delicious assortment of sides. The onion rings are notably massive, and the coleslaw is not only flavorful but also finely shredded. The service here is exceptional, with friendly staff who create a welcoming atmosphere. Although it may take a bit of time to receive your meal, this allows you to enjoy the one-of-a-kind decor that adds to the overall experience.

input: Found there to be a good variety of food for a late night dinner with young kids. Wish we had one this good near us in upper PA. Person that rang us in was friendly and helpful. Two things  made our experience top notch. First was out waiter Eric, who was friendly, observant, went out of his way to get odd requests, and quick to getting back to us.  Eric is the type of waiter you would find a quality sit down restaurant.  The other were the 2 people at the grill house station. When I asked to have shrimp not basted due to a pepper allergy that offered to get different tings to remove them from the grill. I appreciated their thoughtfulness.
Refine this for me please: We found a great variety of food for a late night dinner with young kids. We were impressed and wished there was a place this good near us in upper PA. The person who handled our order was friendly and helpful. Two standout factors made our experience exceptional. Firstly, our waiter Eric was fantastic - he was friendly, observant, and went above and beyond to accommodate our unusual requests. He also served us promptly. Eric embodies the qualities you would expect from a top-notch waiter at a quality sit-down restaurant. Secondly, the two individuals at the grill house station were outstanding. They willingly catered to my shrimp allergy by offering to prepare them separately without the basting sauce and took great care to avoid cross-contamination. We truly appreciated their thoughtfulness.

input: i was looking forward to a new coffee spot, but this won't be it for me.  they dont have a menu first off, and im not a coffee connoisseur, so i was a little thrown off.  i kept it simple, asked for an iced tea, but they did give me hot tea w/a cup of ice.  v. artsy crowd here, great for people watching, but not for studying.  its a little loud, my headphones were not enough to block out the noise, so i was stuck listening to watever they chose, which wasn't my preference.  the servers were all really nice, and they kept cleaning the tables quite often.  all in all it wasnt a bad experience, but not one to keep me coming back either...
Refine this for me please: I was excited to try out a new coffee place, but unfortunately, it didn't meet my expectations. Firstly, they didn't have a menu, which was a bit off-putting for someone like me who isn't a coffee expert. I decided to keep it simple and ordered an iced tea, but they mistakenly brought me hot tea with a cup of ice. The atmosphere attracted an artsy crowd, which made it great for people-watching, but not suitable for studying due to the noise. Despite wearing headphones, I couldn't drown out the surrounding noise and had to listen to whatever music they were playing, which wasn't my preference. On the positive side, the servers were all friendly, and they made sure to clean the tables frequently. Overall, it wasn't a terrible experience, but it's not a place I would go back to either.

input: lit!!!!! just wanna give a shoutout to my g, kyle. he was such a chill waiter and deserves a raise or somethin. he recommended me the honey hot sauce and it was some of the best hot sauce i had eaten in ages. kyle from milk and honey changed my life and i will forever owe him. also the biscuits brought me to heaven. i didn't even order one i just stole from my friends but they were just that. good. so yeah def come here and ask about kyle. tell him i miss him and that i hope we get reunited soon.
Refine this for me please: I want to give a big shoutout to my friend Kyle, who works as a waiter at Milk and Honey. He was absolutely incredible and I genuinely think he deserves a raise for his exceptional service. On his recommendation, I tried the honey hot sauce and it was hands down the best hot sauce I have had in a very long time. Kyle from Milk and Honey has truly changed my perspective and I will be forever grateful to him. Additionally, the biscuits at this place were heavenly. I couldn't resist taking one from my friends' plates and they were simply amazing. I highly recommend coming here and specifically asking for Kyle. Please pass on that I miss him dearly and I hope we can reunite soon.

input:
Went here before a show we were seeing in the University City area.  It is just across the street from 30th Street Station, and just down the street from Drexel University.  We we able to get street parking about 2 blocks down the street, so that is always a plus.  

Service was sufficient for dinner.  We tried the mac and cheese appetizer that had just the right amount of breadcrumbs on it.  It was served hot, but with average taste.  We also tried the cheeseteak egg rolls - decent, but not a lot of meat in them.  Some of the bites I had of the egg roll were merely the fried dough without getting to any of the cheese and meat.   They were served with ketchup and a special mustard that had some horseradish in it for a bit of a kick!  I must say, it is a neat thing for a Philadelphia Pub to have on a menu.  

For our main entrees, we both had the chicken pot pie.  The vegetables were plentiful, and the chicken was all white meat, though there was not that much of it.  The crust was somewhat flaky, but there was a section of my pot pie crust that didn't seem like it was cooked all the way through.  

Dessert portion sizes were huge!  We had the bread pudding which was average in taste, and served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.  The brownie was served ala mode with vanilla ice cream as well.  The brownie was definitely dry and lacking in taste, though I consider myself to be a brownie snob, so maybe I'm being overly picky.
Refine this for me please:
We went to this place before attending a show in the University City area. It is conveniently located just across the street from 30th Street Station and a short distance from Drexel University. Finding street parking about 2 blocks away was a bonus.

The service for dinner was satisfactory. We decided to start with the mac and cheese appetizer, which had the perfect amount of breadcrumbs. It was served hot, but the taste was average. We also tried the cheesesteak egg rolls, which were decent but lacking in meat. Some of the bites I had were just fried dough without any cheese or meat. They were accompanied by ketchup and a special mustard with a horseradish kick, which was a unique addition to the menu at a Philadelphia Pub.

For our main courses, we both ordered the chicken pot pie. The dish had an abundance of vegetables and the chicken was all white meat, though there was not a substantial amount of it. The crust was somewhat flaky, but I noticed a section that seemed undercooked.

The dessert portions were huge! We opted for the bread pudding, which had an average taste, served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. The brownie, served ala mode with vanilla ice cream as well, was disappointingly dry and lacking in flavor. However, I must admit that I have high standards when it comes to brownies, so I may be overly critical.

input: Went for a bachelorette party on a Saturday night in April. Definitely try to arrive on the earlier side! We got there at 8 and there was no line (by the time we left at around 11 there was a line down the street). The cover band is awesome. There were at least 10 other bachelorette groups there and a few 50th birthday parties too. Their signature cocktails are great but overpriced in my opinion. I would go back though for another bachelorette party or birthday. Probably wouldn't try if it was any regular night out. Gets very crowded.
Refine this for me please: I attended a bachelorette party on a Saturday night in April and would recommend arriving early to avoid waiting in line. We arrived at 8 pm and experienced no wait, but when we left around 11 pm, there was a line down the street. The cover band at the venue was fantastic. It's worth noting that there were multiple other bachelorette parties and a few 50th birthday celebrations present as well. While the signature cocktails were enjoyable, I found them to be a bit overpriced. Nonetheless, I would consider returning for another bachelorette party or birthday celebration. However, I would probably not choose this venue for a regular night out due to the high crowd volume.

input: Hands down best fall off the bone BBQ I've ever had.Excellent pulled pork everything had that great smoky flavor.Very creamy mac and cheese.Service was fast and friendly. Dessert was equally as good walnut brownie and ice cream delight.Such a great find.
Refine this for me please: This was by far the best fall-off-the-bone BBQ I have ever had. The pulled pork was excellent, with a delightful smoky flavor. The mac and cheese was incredibly creamy, a perfect complement to the main dish. The service was both fast and friendly. To top it off, the walnut brownie and ice cream dessert was equally as delicious, providing a delightful ending to the meal. Overall, this restaurant was an amazing find.

input: It's a good thing I've had a few weeks to cool off from my experience at Copabanana before writing this review or it might not have been pretty. Anyhow, I came during university city restaurant week and will never return. We sat outside and there were kids playing football right near the tables and being loud. We moved to the other side of the restaurant (still outside) and the kids made there way over to us and continued playing. We couldnt get away. We went to a table inside. Food was terrible. Steak was fatty and overcooked and mashed potatoes werent fresh. The waitress was about the only thing good about this place. She agreed on the steak and took it back. Came back with chicken as I asked for and it was like biting into rubber bands. All in all it was a disaster and I'll never return. 1 star for the waitress.
Refine this for me please:
After having sufficient time to reflect on my experience at Copabanana, I must say that it is fortunate I had a few weeks to cool off before writing this review. Otherwise, the outcome might not have been pleasant. I happened to visit during university city restaurant week, and I can confidently say that I will never be returning. To elaborate, we opted to sit outside, where we encountered a group of children playing football near our tables, causing quite a disturbance with their noise. Hoping to escape this disruption, we relocated to the other side of the restaurant, still outdoors. However, much to our dismay, the kids followed us and continued their game right by our new location, effectively preventing us from finding solace. Exasperated, we decided to move inside. 

The disappointment continued when we sampled the food. The steak I ordered was disappointingly fatty and overcooked, and the mashed potatoes lacked freshness. The only commendable aspect of our experience was the waitress, who sympathized with my dissatisfaction regarding the steak and promptly took it back. However, when she returned with the replacement chicken I requested, it proved to be tough and rubbery, resembling biting into a rubber band. This disastrous encounter has undoubtedly left a lasting negative impression, leading me to conclude that I will never set foot in this establishment again. I feel compelled to award a solitary star solely to acknowledge the waitress' efforts.

input: Best shrimp and grits in NOLA! Delicious fresh juices too. This is my fiance's second time here in two years and he still thinks it's the best he's tried.
Refine this for me please: Experience the epitome of culinary bliss in NOLA with the absolute finest shrimp and grits in town! Our enticing flavors will tantalize your taste buds, leaving an unforgettable impression. Enhance your dining experience further with our delectable assortment of refreshing, freshly-squeezed juices. Even after his second visit in just two years, our exceptional shrimp and grits have secured a special place in your fiancé's heart as the absolute best he has ever savored.

input: Finally! A good tapas place in Nashville. Friendly staff, nice open kitchen, delicious food. I can't wait to go back and try more.
Refine this for me please: Incredible! I have finally discovered a gem of a tapas place in Nashville. From the moment I walked in, the staff greeted me with warmth and kindness. The open kitchen added a touch of excitement, and the aroma of the food was simply irresistible. The taste surpassed all expectations - each dish was carefully crafted and absolutely delectable. I am eagerly counting down the days until I can return and explore even more of their mouthwatering offerings.

input: Super delish!! No frills! Just great sea food, sour dough bread was great! And I loved the 80s music playing!!
Refine this for me please: Exceptionally delicious! Simple yet superb seafood, accompanied by outstanding sourdough bread. The cherry on top was the fantastic 80s music that added to the overall experience.

input: Dr. Curtis Dechant has an excellent chair-side manner, and he establishes a good rapport with his patients. The office is very comfortable, and the latest high-tech equipment makes eye appointments much easier to bear. I also appreciate their selection of eyeglass frames and the friendly staff.
Refine this for me please: Dr. Curtis Dechant is an exceptional healthcare professional who possesses an outstanding chair-side manner, effortlessly establishing a strong rapport with his patients. Additionally, the office itself exudes comfort, further enhancing the overall experience of eyecare appointments. The incorporation of state-of-the-art high-tech equipment promotes an easier and more manageable eye examination process. Furthermore, his practice offers an extensive and diverse range of eyeglass frames, allowing patients to find their perfect fit. Lastly, the staff members are extremely friendly, further contributing to the positive and welcoming atmosphere.

input: Very cute place and good food. Pear cider beer was really good the service was really good and great ambiance and the price was very reasonable
Refine this for me please: This place is incredibly charming with adorable decor, and the food is delicious. The pear cider beer they offer is especially noteworthy and the service is excellent. The ambiance adds to the overall experience, creating a great atmosphere. Additionally, the prices are quite reasonable.

input:
I really enjoy this little restaurant full of goodness. Primarily a dessert place, Seasons also serves up some wonderful food dishes which are largely modernized updates on traditional classics. 

I always enjoy the shaved ice when I come here. The kind Seasons offers is a different type of dessert that I haven't seen anywhere else. The variety of boba tea that they have is also very 
good. Among my favorite shaved ice are the hula and the koko loco. If you want half and half flavors of shaved ice in your cup there is an additional $1.50 charge for a large size. There are pre-designed concoctions or you could create your own configurations of toppings and flavors. The pre designed concoctions are a better deal.

Seasons is situated on the end of a strip mall (across from a large shopping plaza with Regal Cinemas and Marshalls) with plenty of parking. The store itself is clean, bright, and modern and is kid-friendly as there are high hairs available for use. 

The service has always been friendly, fast, and efficient. Seasons employs an order at the counter, take number, and food is borough out to you when ready model. 

I can't comment on the food exactly but my boyfriend loves the quail and our friends enjoy the chicken wings which Boon touts as "the best food item" there. The quail is small and very flavorful and the wings are a good size and seasoned with five spice which was enjoyed by all. 

I look forward to many more visits with friends at this location. Check Seasons out and enjoy!
Refine this for me please:
I thoroughly enjoy dining at Seasons, a delightful little restaurant that is known for its delectable desserts. While it primarily focuses on desserts, Seasons also offers an array of mouthwatering food dishes that put a modern twist on traditional classics.

One of my personal favorites at Seasons is their exquisite shaved ice. It's a unique and distinctive dessert that I haven't encountered anywhere else. Additionally, their selection of boba tea is exceptional. Among the various options, the hula and koko loco shaved ice flavors stand out. If you're interested in combining flavors, a large size with two different flavors incurs an extra charge of $1.50. You can either opt for pre-designed concoctions or create your own customized version with different toppings and flavors. However, the pre-designed options provide better value for money.

Located at the end of a strip mall, Seasons offers ample parking. The interior of the restaurant is clean, bright, and modern, creating a pleasant dining atmosphere. Moreover, it is also child-friendly, as high chairs are available for use.

The service at Seasons has consistently been friendly, prompt, and efficient. Their ordering system entails placing your order at the counter, receiving a numbered ticket, and your food being brought to you when it's ready.

While I cannot personally comment on the food, my boyfriend adores their quail dish, and our friends highly recommend their chicken wings, which are regarded as the "best" item on the menu by Boon, the restaurant's proprietor. The quail is flavor-packed despite its small size, and the wings are generously portioned and seasoned with five spice, much to the delight of everyone who tries them.

I eagerly anticipate many more visits to Seasons with friends. I urge you to discover this spectacular restaurant and relish in its offerings.

input: Overpriced for what you get. I think this is a cute spot to meet up with a friend, but that's about it. I prefer my own homemade coffee to be honest. Adorable concept, just could use some improvement to products offered and prices.
Refine this for me please: The overall experience is quite expensive considering what you receive. While I find this place charming for meeting up with friends, my personal preference lies with the coffee I make at home. The concept is undeniably adorable, however, there is room for improvement in terms of both the selection of items and their pricing.

input: This place was absolutely awesome. 75 cent oysters. After 2 dozen I moved to the excellent cheesy grits. Great place to eat. Even better during happy hour.
Refine this for me please: This place was beyond amazing! They offer oysters for just 75 cents, and trust me, I couldn't resist indulging in 2 dozen of them. And let me tell you, their cheesy grits were absolutely excellent. It's not just a good place to eat, it's a fantastic place. Plus, if you visit during happy hour, the experience becomes even more exceptional.

input: Love it!! I go to this place whenever I am in town and have NEVER been disappointed. The food is organic, fresh and delicious. I love that they buy from local farmers and fishermen. They also grow a lot of their own veggies! You can't get much fresher than that. There's lots of variety so I haven't even come close to trying everything. My favorite breakfast item is Carly's breakfast. Avocado on sourdough toast with a fried egg and sweet potatoes. Sooo good! Highly recommend this place!
Refine this for me please: I absolutely love this place! Whenever I am in town, it's my go-to spot and has never failed to impress me. The food here is not only organic, but also incredibly fresh and delightful. What I truly appreciate is their commitment to supporting local farmers and fishermen by sourcing their ingredients from them. Moreover, they even grow a variety of vegetables on-site, making their dishes as fresh as can be. With such an extensive menu, I haven't even scratched the surface of trying everything they offer. One of my all-time breakfast favorites is Carly's breakfast, featuring avocado on sourdough toast, topped with a fried egg and served alongside delectable sweet potatoes. Trust me, it's absolutely amazing! I wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone seeking a fantastic dining experience.

input: The burgers were very good very flavorful. I had the El Mariachi. As with what other reviewers have said the portion is not big. But I believe it makes up in flavor. I also have salted caramel ice cream it was very good homemade style. I do recommend the rooster sauce.
Refine this for me please: The burgers at this place are incredibly delicious and bursting with flavor. I specifically tried the El Mariachi burger and it did not disappoint. Some reviewers mentioned that the portion size is on the smaller side, but I feel that the amazing flavor more than makes up for it. For dessert, I indulged in their salted caramel ice cream which had a delightful homemade taste. Lastly, I highly recommend trying their rooster sauce for an extra kick of flavor.

input: Just had a late dinner there on a Sunday night and was really surprised at how good the sushi was and how low my ticket was. I had a plate full of sushi and it cost me $13.00. The staff seems to be having a good time too. Very friendly place. I really enjoyed it and will be back soon!
Refine this for me please: I recently had a late dinner at this restaurant on a Sunday night and was extremely impressed with both the quality of the sushi and the affordability of my meal. Despite ordering a plate full of sushi, my total bill came to just $13.00. Additionally, the staff appeared to be quite jovial and friendly, creating a welcoming atmosphere. overall, I had a wonderful dining experience and definitely plan on returning in the near future!

input:
I had to write an order after coming here a couple of times because this place is just terrible. I tried their hoagies and they are so greasy i got nauseous after eating them... Then yesterday i accidently ordered from here instead of angelinos and i got the buffalo chicken sandwhich and it was just covered in blu cheese and greasy sauce it was so Disgusting.  All their food is terribly greasy and over seasoned its too much.. Back off on it a little and use freasher ingredients it will be much better!

Ill also add that their desserts suck, taste bland and a waste of money. Their sodas are usually expired and flat. I hate everything about this place!
Refine this for me please:
I am extremely dissatisfied with my experiences at this establishment. Despite giving it multiple chances, I have found their hoagies to be excessively greasy to the point of causing nausea. This became evident after consuming them on several occasions. Recently, I mistakenly placed an order here instead of Angelinos and received a buffalo chicken sandwich that was drenched in an unpleasant combination of blue cheese and greasy sauce. The overall taste was absolutely revolting. Furthermore, their food consistently suffers from excessive seasoning, leaving an overwhelming flavor. I strongly recommend reducing the amount of seasoning used and opting for fresher ingredients to enhance the overall quality of the meals.

Additionally, I must express my disappointment with their desserts. They lack any notable flavor, appearing bland and ultimately proving to be a waste of money. Moreover, their sodas frequently seem to be expired, resulting in a flat and unsatisfying beverage. To summarize, I have encountered numerous deficiencies in every aspect of this establishment and am thoroughly displeased.

input: Paid for non-smoking room but there was a smell and ashtrays in the room. Since all we were doing was sleeping there we didn't say anything. Shower was crazy slow to drain. Pillows were so lumpy that I woke up with a migraine. Room was clean and staff was nice. Free wifi but wouldn't connect.
Refine this for me please: I paid for a non-smoking room, however, upon entering, there was a noticeable smell and even ashtrays present. Since our stay mostly entailed sleeping, we decided not to raise the issue. Additionally, the shower had a frustratingly slow drainage system, and the pillows were incredibly lumpy, resulting in me waking up with a migraine. On the positive side, the room appeared clean, and the staff was friendly. Although the hotel offered free wifi, I experienced difficulty connecting to it.

input: Maybe caught the staff on a bad day, but the people in the pharmacy were not friendly. Was told my prescription be ready in 15, when i showed up 20 minutes later they said it would be ready in a half hour. If your in a hurry dont bother filling up your prescription here. Might as well go next door to Walmart!
Refine this for me please: Perhaps the staff at the pharmacy were having a bad day, but I found them to be unfriendly. They initially informed me that my prescription would be ready in 15 minutes, but when I arrived 20 minutes later, they informed me it would take an additional half hour. If you're in a rush, I would advise against getting your prescription filled here. It might be better to go to Walmart next door instead.

input:
I loves me some seitan, and that's why I keep going to El Camino. The seitan wings & seitan nachos are so good! Unfortunately, the service is not. It can be extremely slow. On one occasion it took them so long to get my seitan nachos out to me that they had to give them to me on the house. All of my friends were done eating and ready to leave and I was JUST getting my food! 

As for the rest of the food at El Camino, the only other thing I've tried would be the fried pickles. I have to say, I was not impressed. I love both pickles and fried things but these were not good. The coating was too grainy and I just didn't like the taste. 

The seitan is so good that it keeps me coming back. And the margaritas are pretty good too.
Refine this for me please:
I really enjoy seitan, which is why I frequent El Camino. Their seitan wings and seitan nachos are absolutely delicious. Unfortunately, the service leaves much to be desired. It tends to be extremely slow, and on one occasion, it took them so long to bring out my seitan nachos that they ended up giving them to me free of charge. This delay was quite frustrating, as all of my friends had already finished eating and were ready to leave while I was just receiving my food.

Regarding the other food options at El Camino, I have only tried the fried pickles. I must admit, I was not impressed. Despite my love for both pickles and fried foods, I found the coa+ting to be too grainy and didn't enjoy the overall taste.

Despite these setbacks, the incredible seitan keeps me coming back to El Camino. Additionally, their margaritas are fairly good as well.

input: Excellent place to get a tattoo. I have had two done at B13 and am really pleased with both. One was with a group of people and the owner was able to fit all 4 of us in with a great sketch on really short notice. If you aren't sure who to go to, I've seen especially awesome work by Amanda, though everyone is great I'm sure.
Refine this for me please: I highly recommend B13 as an exceptional tattoo parlour. I personally had two tattoos done there and couldn't be happier with the results. When I went with a group of friends, the owner was able to accommodate all four of us on short notice, delivering a fantastic sketch. Although every artist at B13 is undoubtedly amazing, I must mention Amanda, as her work has particularly impressed me.

input:
We went on a Friday night and the place was full, but even so there was only a 20 minute wait. 
The service was ... Hit and miss. I don't want to rip on our server too much because our server was obviously trying but just not hitting the mark. The food was Ok, but I don't believe I'll be back. It just wasn't great.
Refine this for me please: On a bustling Friday night, we found the place completely filled up. Surprisingly, the wait time was only 20 minutes. As for the service, it was a bit inconsistent. While our server seemed to be making an effort, they didn't quite meet our expectations. The food was decent, but it fell short of being memorable. Unfortunately, this experience didn't leave a strong enough impression for me to consider returning.

input:
I would recommend Twisted Twig to everyone - excellent service, very friendly, and create amazing arrangements!

You will not regret working with Jen! I reached out to a few different florist 2 weeks before my wedding. I was frantic my wedding was only 2 weeks away and didn't have a florist, even though it was a small wedding. I got a hold of Jen, who I might say was very responsive.

I got on the phone with Jen and she was so nice and very genuine. We spoke about what I was looking for and I texted her some pictures of inspiration and my dress. She asked me if there were certain flowers I was looking for and my budget. I didn't have any flowers in mind, as long as the colors are what I wanted and told her my budget. She sent me a quote, staying within my budget, noting the flowers she would use for the bouquet, boutonniere, and floral arrangements for the arch I had. It was nice that Jen works with you to stay in your budget yet still get what you want.

On the wedding day, Jen arrived at my hotel door right on time with my beautiful bouquet. The floral arrangements at the site was gorgeous also. Jen really hit the mark on what I wanted for my wedding. She also was very sweet and added some roses on the chairs by the aisle to my surprise, which was not on the quote. That was very special because it pulled the whole ceremony look together and I felt Jen really wanted everything to look perfect for me.
Refine this for me please:
I highly recommend Twisted Twig to anyone in need of floral arrangements. The service I received from Jen was exceptional, as she was not only responsive but also very friendly and genuine. Despite my last-minute request, she worked with me to create beautiful arrangements for my wedding within my budget.

During our initial conversation, Jen took the time to understand my preferences and even asked for pictures of my inspiration and dress. She made sure to consider any specific flowers I wanted and stayed within my budget when providing a quote. I appreciated her commitment to working with me to make sure I got what I wanted without breaking the bank.

On the day of my wedding, Jen arrived right on time at my hotel with a gorgeous bouquet that perfectly matched what I had envisioned. The floral arrangements at the ceremony site were equally stunning. To my surprise, Jen went above and beyond by adding roses to the aisle chairs, which pulled the entire look together. It was evident that Jen truly cared about making everything flawless for my special day.

input: I deducted one star because the service was not great. Our waiter wasn't friendly at all. The first question was "soup or salad ". I wanted to order appetizer and lunch special, but he assumed we were having lunch. Seaweed salad was really good. Shiomay was small but good. The sashimi was fresh. Banzai roll was great and unique. Raw salmon and white fish with avocado and fish egg wrapped in cucumber with some sweet sauce. Perfect for those who is looking for no-rice roll. Salad dressing was more like carrot purée.
Refine this for me please: I deducted one star due to subpar service from our unfriendly waiter. Despite requesting an appetizer and lunch special, he assumed we were only having lunch, which was disappointing. However, the seaweed salad was delicious, and the shiomay was small but tasty. The sashimi delivered a fresh and satisfying experience. One highlight was the outstanding and unique Banzai roll, consisting of raw salmon, white fish, avocado, and fish eggs wrapped in cucumber with a delightful sweet sauce. This roll is an excellent choice for those seeking a rice-free option. I would like to note that the salad dressing resembled more of a carrot purée.

input: I honestly didn't know this place existed until my friend suggested it for brunch over the weekend. I can't believe I live four blocks away and haven't been here before! I ordered the honeybee crepe and an almond croissant. I'm one to typically bring leftovers home but the food was so delicious there was nothing left to take much to the surprise of my friends. There is a small seating area downstairs and some window seating on the first floor. I'd recommend getting there on the earlier side if you're with a group and want to sit. I'd also recommend this for smaller groups. Will definitely be going back.
Refine this for me please: I was completely unaware of this place's existence until a friend recommended it as a brunch spot. It's unbelievable that I've been living just four blocks away and have never visited before! For my meal, I decided to try the honeybee crepe and an almond croissant. Normally, I tend to take leftovers home, but the food was so delectable that there wasn't a single morsel left, much to the surprise of my friends. The seating area is limited, with a small space downstairs and some window seating available on the first floor. If you're in a group and wish to secure a seat, I suggest arriving early. Additionally, I recommend this place more for smaller groups. Without a doubt, I'll be returning in the future.

input: This is the best location EVER. The donuts are made to order I believe after 5pm. They are always super hot you can barely eat them . Even the next day they are delicious.

input: Ew. I don't know what upsets me more, the borderline gross food or how much I had to pay for it. Yes, truffle oil is delicious, but pouring it over burned, greasy fries does not a delicious, 16 dollar meal make. We won't be back.

input: Pleasantly surprised to find Taiwanese restaurant in Reno. Convenient to all of the hotels.  Solid boba tea and authentic Taiwanese food if you know what to order

input: I loved this place.  Walking by, I almost didn't go in, because Im a vegetarian and it looked like there was only meat on the menu. I'm glad that I looked closer.
