Despite this, the rest of our meal was overshadowed by being generally ignored and subpar service. Considering the quality of the food, I found it to be overpriced. Unless there is a compelling reason to return, I am unlikely to dine there again.

input:
Second visit even better than the first!!  Loved the butternut squash and goat cheese Rangoons, and the delightfully filling mushroom yakisoba. Amazing flavor, and a smoky , meaty feel though it is meatless. Then came the coconut curry ramen. Heaven in a bowl. 
My only complaint is when you have to wait for seating there is no way to hang by the bar without constantly feeling you are in The servers' way as they breeze by with deliciousness in bowls and plates. So worth the wait before heading to the theater. Plus, food comes out very quickly so we made the curtain, just barely, but with really happy tummies.
Refine this for me please:
Second visit was even better than the first! We absolutely loved the butternut squash and goat cheese Rangoons, which were filled with amazing flavor. The mushroom yakisoba was also delightfully filling and had a smoky, meaty feel despite being meatless. However, the highlight of the meal was definitely the coconut curry ramen - it was like heaven in a bowl.

The only downside was the waiting time for seating. Unfortunately, there is no designated area by the bar to hang out without feeling like you are constantly in the servers' way as they pass by with delicious bowls and plates. Despite this slight inconvenience, the wait was completely worth it, especially if you're heading to the theater afterwards. Additionally, the food came out very quickly, allowing us to make it to the show just in time, albeit with really happy tummies.

input: I cannot comment on the food as I had only a couple beers. I did have the white IPA and a red ale which were good but not blow me away. I might be spoiled having 2 friends who brew professionally but the beers were good, not outstanding. The location is kind of far from other stuff which normally wouldn't bother me but everything around is seriously industrial and scenery does make a better place. They do discount the beer $1 when a train comes by and maybe that's the best they can make of a meh location. Probably give it more like a 3.5 stars. It does say something that there was a loyal following at 4pm on a Sunday.
Refine this for me please: I cannot provide a detailed opinion on the food as I only had a few beers. Specifically, I tried the white IPA and red ale, which were enjoyable but not extraordinary. I might be biased due to having two friends who brew professionally, which could potentially raise my expectations. While the beers at this establishment were decent, they did not stand out as exceptional. It is worth noting that the location is somewhat remote, surrounded by industrial areas, which, personally, did not bother me but lacking scenic surroundings could enhance the overall experience. An interesting aspect is that they offer a discount of $1 on their beers when a train passes by, perhaps this is their attempt to add value to the less-than-ideal location. Considering all factors, I would rate this place closer to 3.5 stars. It is worth mentioning that it does hold significance that there was a dedicated following present at 4pm on a Sunday.

input:
I first found out about this adorable little salon here on yelp while looking for a place to get a manicure downtown/ CBD.  I visited on 3/8/13 and got their "Mini Manicure"- it's only $15!  I chose an OPI polish and the nail technician did a GREAT job!  So great in fact, that today on Monday, 3/18/13- I did not have ONE CHIP!  This is amazing for polish!  My nails looked fabulous!  The technician was friendly, as were the other stylists.  I'm not sure if it was the manager or the owner that was working the front desk- but she came over as well and was super friendly and welcoming.  The salon looks amazing, trendy, and peaceful.  It has a great vibe.

I was so happy with my first appointment- that I went back today, and left disappointed.  I went to the same nail techinician- and we talked as she worked on my nails.  The person working the front desk (seemed like an owner/ manager- although different from my first visit) was SO  nice, welcoming, and talkative.  This time though I needed a gel manicure, in french- as I am in a wedding this weekend.  I explained that I was in the wedding, assuming the technician would know that this more special than just an everyday manicure  The technician stated after she started my nails, that she did not have the proper brush that she needed in order to do the manicure.  So like most places- they paint the white, and then go back later with a brush to create the crisp, perfect line.  Since she did not have the brush to do that- she used a q- tip.  So obviously the lines are not perfect or even.  Along with the lines being uneven- some are thicker than others, and the edges go up, instead of down.  My nails are not at all filed and shaped pretty either.  For $40 (+ a tip)- I really expect them to look right.  I went during my lunch hour, and it was supposed to be 30 minute appointment, but the appointment took a little bit over an hour.  I understand that french takes a little extra time- but this seemed like quite a bit extra.  I was late for work, and had to hurry out of there when she was finished and did not want to be even more late to work to stay there to make a complaint.  I wish I would have- but I also felt bad because the technician was trying so hard- but they are just not up to par.

I'm conflicted, but I don't know that I'll return.  I loved it to so much the first time, I even sent friends over there.  But after this time- I am not happy with the product.  I wish it wasn't gel- because I can't even take the polish off myself.  So I'm forced to have nails that I am unhappy with, or go to somewhere else and pay to have this taken off, and then pay to have them re done- all before a 6am flight on Wednesday morning, and it's Monday afternoon....
Refine this for me please:
I first discovered this delightful salon on Yelp while searching for a downtown/CBD location to get a manicure. On 3/8/13, I visited and had their "Mini Manicure" for only $15. I selected an OPI polish and the nail technician did an excellent job. In fact, my polish did not chip at all until today, Monday, 3/18/13, which is impressive. My nails looked fabulous! The technician was friendly and so were the other stylists. Either the manager or owner, who was working the front desk, was also incredibly friendly and welcoming. The salon has an amazing, trendy, and peaceful atmosphere.

I was so pleased with my first appointment that I decided to return today, but unfortunately, I left feeling disappointed. I requested the same nail technician, and while she worked on my nails, we engaged in conversation. The person at the front desk (presumably the owner or manager, different from my first visit) was kind, welcoming, and talkative. However, this time I needed a gel manicure in french as I am in a wedding this weekend. I assumed the technician would understand that this was a special occasion and not an ordinary manicure. Unfortunately, after starting my nails, the technician revealed that she did not have the proper brush needed for the manicure. Consequently, she used a q-tip instead, resulting in uneven and imperfect lines. Some lines are thicker than others, and the edges go upwards instead of downwards. Additionally, my nails were not filed or shaped neatly. Considering the cost of $40 (plus a tip), I expected a better outcome. The appointment, which was supposed to be 30 minutes during my lunch hour, lasted over an hour. While I understand that a french manicure takes extra time, this seemed excessive. I had to rush back to work and did not want to be further late by staying to make a complaint. In hindsight, I regret not addressing the issue, but I also felt guilty because the technician was clearly trying her best. However, the quality of the service was subpar.

I am uncertain about returning to this salon. I adored it so much after my first visit that I even recommended it to my friends. However, after this experience, I am dissatisfied with the outcome. It is unfortunate that I cannot remove the gel polish myself and am now stuck with nails that I am unhappy with. I have two options: either find another salon to remove the polish and redo my nails before my early flight on Wednesday morning, incurring additional expenses, or keep the unsatisfactory nails for the time being.

input:
A bit off the beaten path for most tourists, as it is in the Marigny, but worth the trip. Sure, the place is not perfect, but there are ultra-expensive restaurants in the FQ that are also not perfect. Look, cheap food, especially food this good, gives "wiggle" room for imperfections.

Breakfast served all day is a bonus. Sometimes you just got to have a lox omelet (under $10) late in the day. The restaurant boasts vegetarian and *gasp* vegan dishes, but someone needs to tell them that cheese doesn't fit into either of those categories. That aside, the french fry poboy, and the mac 'n cheese sandwiches are amazing. So is the Saturday Blue Plate of BBQ Chicken legs. 

Every entree is under $10, well except for the Friday Blue Plate, but why quibble? And who can argue with $5 Bloody Mary's, especially ones that are this good?
Refine this for me please:
Located in the Marigny, this hidden gem may not be on the typical tourist path but is definitely worth a visit. While it may not be flawless, high-end restaurants in the French Quarter also have their imperfections. Besides, the affordability of the food, especially when it's this delicious, allows for some leeway.

One of the highlights is the availability of breakfast served all day. Sometimes, getting to enjoy a lox omelet (priced under $10) even in the late afternoon is just what you need. The restaurant takes pride in offering vegetarian and even vegan options, though it's worth noting that cheese doesn't quite fit into either category. With that being said, their french fry poboy and mac 'n cheese sandwiches are simply amazing. Don't miss out on the mouth-watering Saturday Blue Plate featuring BBQ Chicken legs.

The best part? Every entrée is priced under $10, except for the Friday Blue Plate, but let's not get caught up on the details. And who can resist a $5 Bloody Mary, especially when it's as good as theirs?

input: Awesome sangria.  Rotating craft beers. Pizza and calzones keep me coming back
Refine this for me please: Exquisite sangria, a diverse selection of rotating craft beers and the delicious offerings of pizza and calzones ensure my frequent return.

input: First off, it is a bar through and through. The alcohol selection is good and the drinks well mixed. It is also a casino bar, so you'll be paying higher than average prices. There is a small food menu, but the selection isn't that great. To add insult to injury the food made me ill. The reviews about service aren't exaggerations. We, too, practically had to tackle our server to order food and drinks many of times. Not my preferred place to go when there are so many better options in Reno.
Refine this for me please: First and foremost, this establishment is primarily a bar, offering a solid variety of alcoholic beverages that are skillfully mixed. However, due to its casino affiliation, it is important to note that the prices here tend to be higher than the average. As for the food options, the limited selection leaves much to be desired and, unfortunately, my personal experience was exacerbated by feeling ill after consuming it. Regrettably, the negative reviews regarding the service are accurate, as we encountered numerous occasions where it was a challenge to get the attention of our server to place orders for both food and drinks. With numerous superior alternatives available in Reno, this place falls far from being my preferred choice.

input: Rude and unprofessional staff. I called today to find out if they had availability over the Thanksgiving holiday and the staff was short and basically said no then hung up the phone. I will take my business elsewhere.
Refine this for me please: I encountered rude and unprofessional staff when I called today seeking availability for the Thanksgiving holiday. The staff was abrupt, provided minimal information and abruptly hung up the phone. As a result, I have decided to take my business elsewhere due to their discourteous behavior.

input: Went there due to having a gc, and was suprised at the great food!  Had the sauteed stirfry over spinach, and my gf had the abundant pile of nachos.  They have a pretty decent selection of other delectables, and the day time bartender was very pleasant.  I would recommend to someone who wants a friendly atmosphere with decent food in a sports bar setting.  They actually do have sports playing on the tvs.
Refine this for me please: I went to this place because I had a gift card and was pleasantly surprised by the amazing food! I ordered the sautéed stir fry over spinach, and my girlfriend enjoyed a generous portion of nachos. They also offer a decent selection of other delicious dishes, and the daytime bartender was incredibly friendly. I would highly recommend this place to anyone seeking a friendly atmosphere with good food in a sports bar setting. They even have sports playing on the TVs.

input: Horrible experience, pizza was soggy and cold when I received it, took 2 hours until I actually received my order as well. Absolutely no communication on my order, even after calling twice. Once I finally received the pizza I called to get my money back, which was communicated that I would not be charged, soon to find out that I was charged the very next day. I highly recommend never ordering from here, service was horrible and they were extremely rude. I won't be ordering from here again and either should you.
Refine this for me please: I had an incredibly unpleasant experience with this pizza delivery service. Not only was the pizza I received soggy and cold, but it also took an unreasonable 2 hours to arrive. Throughout the entire process, there was a complete lack of communication regarding my order, even after I made two phone calls. Finally, when I received the pizza, I immediately called to request a refund, which they assured would be processed without any charges. However, to my dismay, I discovered the next day that I had indeed been charged. The combination of horrible service and the disrespectful behavior of the staff make it absolutely necessary for me to strongly advise against ordering from this place. I will definitely not be ordering from them again, and I highly recommend others to do the same.

input:
Incredible service and incredible food! The black bean ravioli is succulent! The bone-in steak was flavorful and amazingly juicy and delicious. And the best of all, service was perfect. From the friendly hostess to the waiter to the chef who personally came over to make sure we enjoyed our food, everyone really made us feel at home. 

As an added bonus, the ambiance is beautiful. Decor, lighting, and fireplace makes the place very homely. 

Highly recommended. I went as a group of four and had an excellent time.
Refine this for me please:
The service and food at this establishment are truly exceptional! I was blown away by the succulent black bean ravioli, while the bone-in steak exceeded my expectations with its incredible flavor and irresistibly juicy tenderness. Perhaps what impressed me the most was the flawless service. From the warm and welcoming hostess to the attentive waiter, and even the chef who went above and beyond to ensure our satisfaction, the entire staff made us feel right at home.

The ambiance of the restaurant is equally noteworthy. The charming decor, perfectly balanced lighting, and inviting fireplace all contribute to creating a cozy and homely atmosphere.

I cannot recommend this place enough! My group of four had an amazing time, and I guarantee you will too.

input:
I've been driving by this location for several weeks anticipating their opening.  With the established Legends Sports Bar directly across the street I thought this place must have something very special to feel they can compete.

They took over the building that was prevriously used by the Ruby River Steakhouse.  The owners apparently opted not to change a thing about the indoor seating.  Gone are all the cowboy boots, up are various team jerseys. It looks like somebody went to Pro Image at the mall to decorate the place.  Nothing appears to be autographed or evoke a sense of authenticity.

Video games are available for the kids, so bring your quarters.  No dart boards, shuffleboard, air hockey or pool tables.  This is pretty much a dine and drink only establishment.

More TV's in the place than I could count (I figure at least 20), all tuned to ESPN or ESPN2.  No clue at this time if they are choosing to use Direct TV, Dish, or Cable One for their service.  However, they already have made one of the biggest mistakes I think most wannabe sports bars make; they broadcast music rather than sound from a live sporting event.  With live sporting events available almost everyday from 12pm - 12am, you would think they would want to try to emphasize that rather than muzak (tuned to a country station; still feels like the Ruby River).

A word of advice here, if you want people to stay and eat and drink, you gotta give them something on which to focus their attention.  The sounds of the game will get their attention.  They came to a sports bar to think about sports, not Conway Twitty.

Typically, when I see the word pub in a restaurant name, I think it is just beer and wine, but it looks like Timeout has a full bar with several specialty drinks.  With a designated driver, it may be fun to experiment.

The food is typical sports bar fare; salads, burgers, pasta.  Most items will cost $9 - $11, with entrees running more.  A few twists on their offerings will ensure that I stop in to try something different, but unless the atmosphere improves, I think I will always leave a little disappointed. 

Those staying at the nearby motel may like the proximity, but I think they might find the walk across the street to Legends worth the extra steps.

Happy Hour 2pm - 6pm Monday -  Friday; Late Happy Hour 10pm - close Monday - Thursday.  Happy Hour all day Sunday.
Refine this for me please:
I have been eagerly driving past this location for weeks, eager to see its grand opening. Being situated right across from the popular Legends Sports Bar, I couldn't help but wonder what special features this place has to offer in order to compete.

Taking over the building previously occupied by the Ruby River Steakhouse, it seems the new owners have made minimal changes to the indoor seating. Gone are the cowboy boots, replaced by various team jerseys. The place almost looks like it has been decorated with items from Pro Image at the mall. However, there is a lack of autographed memorabilia or genuine authenticity.

For families with kids, there are video games available, so bring some quarters. However, this establishment primarily focuses on dining and drinking, as it does not have dart boards, shuffleboard, air hockey, or pool tables.

There are an impressive number of TVs in the place, too many to count. I estimate at least 20, all tuned to either ESPN or ESPN2. I am unsure which service they use, whether it's Direct TV, Dish, or Cable One. Unfortunately, they have already made a common mistake made by many aspiring sports bars: they play music instead of the sound from live sporting events. With live sports available almost every day from 12 pm to 12 am, you would think they would prioritize showcasing that instead of playing background music that still reminds me of the Ruby River.

Here's a piece of advice: if you want customers to stay, eat, and drink, you need to provide them something captivating to focus on. The sounds of the game will grab their attention. People came to a sports bar to immerse themselves in sports, not listen to Conway Twitty.

Usually, when I see "pub" in a restaurant name, I assume it only serves beer and wine. However, Timeout seems to have a full bar with several specialty drinks. With a designated driver, it might be fun to try out their unique concoctions.

The food is what you would expect from a typical sports bar: salads, burgers, and pasta. Most items range from $9 to $11, while entrees are pricier. They do have a few interesting twists in their menu, which might entice me to try something different. However, unless the atmosphere improves, I fear I will always leave feeling somewhat disappointed.

Those staying at the nearby motel might appreciate the convenience, but I believe they would find the extra steps across the street to Legends worth it.

Happy Hour runs from 2 pm to 6 pm, Monday to Friday, with a late Happy Hour from 10 pm until closing from Monday to Thursday. On Sundays, there is an all-day Happy Hour.

input: If you like onion rings order them here. Some of the best I have ever have. I also had a Reuben which was very good also.
Refine this for me please: For those who enjoy onion rings, I highly recommend ordering them here - they truly are some of the best I've ever had. Additionally, I had a very satisfying Reuben sandwich that I must commend as well.

input: The cutest and definitely the friendliest coffee shop in Boise! The coffee is great but the staff is even better. Love this place!
Refine this for me please: This charming coffee shop in Boise is undoubtedly the cutest and most welcoming establishment you'll find. While their coffee is undeniably fantastic, it's the exceptional staff that truly sets this place apart. I absolutely adore this cozy spot!

input:
Hubby and I were eager to try this establishment due to a rave review from some close friends. We decided for our date night we would give it a try on Saturday. We pulled up about 8pm and the open sign was turned off. We thought maybe the light was burnt out or someone just forgot to plug it in. So we proceeded to the door. There were people inside and the sign said open till 11pm, so we walked inside. It was like walking into the Twlight Zone, everyone stopped and stared at us. The woman behind the bar came over and told us they were closed. HUH! Ok.... so we left. It was very akward and unpleasant. If they were closed then the door should of been locked or a sign on the door stating private party or something. 
Not sure if we will attempt to try to dine there again.
Refine this for me please: My spouse and I were excited to give this place a try after receiving a glowing recommendation from our close friends. We planned to make it our date night and decided to go on a Saturday. Arriving at around 8 pm, we noticed that the open sign was turned off. We assumed it was either due to a burnt out light or just an oversight. Regardless, we continued towards the entrance. Upon entering, we were met with an eerie atmosphere as all eyes turned towards us. The bartender approached us and informed us that they were actually closed. It was quite baffling. We left feeling extremely uncomfortable and disappointed. If they were closed, they should have either locked the door or displayed a sign indicating a private event or some sort of closure. Given this experience, we are uncertain whether we will give this establishment another chance in the future.

input: Awesome food! It was so fresh and delicious. The papaya salad was delicious! Try the curry..simply spicy and beautiful. The service was great too! They have take out!!!
Refine this for me please: The food at this place was absolutely amazing! It was incredibly fresh and delicious. I highly recommend trying the papaya salad, as it was absolutely fantastic. And don't miss out on their curry - it had the perfect balance of spiciness and incredible flavors. On top of the incredible food, the service was excellent as well. Oh, and the best part is that they offer take out!

input: I have new dental insurance and had to find a dentist in network and came across Music City Dental. Dr. Spurlin and her staff are great! They are very gentle and make sure the patient is comfortable at all times. I had to get a filling and am terrified of shots. I didn't even feel when Dr. Spurlin gave me my shot. I was offered a pillow, blanket and choice of watching a movie or listening to music. I had a pleasant experience and am definitely a permanent patient!
Refine this for me please: I recently obtained new dental insurance and had the task of finding an in-network dentist. That's when I discovered Music City Dental and let me tell you, Dr. Spurlin and her team are simply fantastic! Not only are they incredibly gentle, but they also prioritize the comfort of their patients throughout the entire process. Despite my fear of shots, I was pleasantly surprised to not even feel a pinch when Dr. Spurlin administered the injection for my filling. Moreover, they offered me a variety of amenities such as a pillow, blanket, and the choice between watching a movie or listening to music. Thanks to their extraordinary care, my visit turned out to be a truly pleasant experience, and I have decided to become a permanent patient of Music City Dental.

input:
The beef noodles was a bit too salty and the fried rice was a bit oily. But overall they are good. We liked the shrimp spring rolls a lot. It is one of the best we have tried. 

The place could have earned higher points. But I have to give it a three stars because of the chaotic seating arrangement. The owner gave tables to people behind us despite we reminded the him and the staff. Perhaps that is what you get when you go to a teeny tiny Chinese restaurant during a long weekend.
Refine this for me please:
Please revise this passage:

Although the beef noodles were a bit too salty and the fried rice was a bit oily, overall they were good. We particularly enjoyed the shrimp spring rolls, which were among the best we have tried. However, I would rate the place with three stars due to the chaotic seating arrangement. Despite reminding the owner and staff, they gave tables to people behind us. Perhaps this is to be expected when dining at a small Chinese restaurant on a busy long weekend.

input:
Great community vibe... i've run into friends and struck up conversation with new ones each time i've been in.  Its nice to have new hang within walking distance of my house.  I've stuck to the classic burger and love it... everything from the buns to the ketchup is made in-house and has unique taste. The bar had pretty much whatever i wanted... last night the bartenders made some homespun watermelon concoction.

To touch on some other reviews... i understand everyone has a different experience, but to say the place is 'too hipster' seems like someones still jaded from feeling left out in high school...  and personally attacking the owner is tasteless and has no place in a review.  We should be glad we don't all have someone looking over our shoulder attacking our motives. I like what Burger Up is trying to do and i like that they hired a bunch of folks representative of our Nashville community... if you need a non-musician wait staff who dresses just like you and takes you to prom, you're probably in the wrong town.
Refine this for me please:
Refined version: The community atmosphere at this place is amazing. Every time I've been here, I've had the opportunity to meet friends and strike up conversations with new people. It's wonderful to have a new hangout spot within walking distance from my house. I've always stuck to their classic burger, and it's absolutely delicious. From the homemade buns to the unique ketchup, every element has a distinct and satisfying taste. The bar offers a wide variety of options, and the bartenders even whipped up a delightful homemade watermelon drink for me last night.

Regarding some negative reviews, I understand that everyone's experience can differ, but labeling the place as "too hipster" seems like an unfair judgment stemming from personal insecurities. Also, attacking the owner personally in a review is tasteless and uncalled for. We should be grateful that our own actions and motives aren't constantly scrutinized by others. I appreciate Burger Up for their vision and for hiring diverse staff members who represent our vibrant Nashville community. If you're looking for a wait staff that embodies the same style as you and takes you to prom, you might be searching in the wrong town.

input: I am not an indian food type of person but this place lives up to the hype. When you go, just let Hassan make something for you, don't try and overwhelm yourself with the different options. Make sure to get a chaat and a lassi as the two really complement one another.
Refine this for me please: Although I typically don't enjoy Indian food, this place truly exceeded my expectations. The experience is worth trying, especially if you're not familiar with the cuisine. I highly recommend letting Hassan surprise you with his choice of dishes, rather than getting overwhelmed by the extensive menu. Do try the chaat and lassi, as they wonderfully complement each other.

input:
Excellent food, good service, great location. 

My wife had shrimp and grits, I had the barbecued shrimp -- both were outstanding. The appetizers were good. The bread pudding was a tad dry in the city that is supposed to be the mother lode of bread pudding. 

Mr. B came close to snagging the fifth star but the service could have been more attentive and the place is freezing - - in July in New Orleans. Wear long sleeves or bring a jacket.
Refine this for me please:
The overall experience at Mr. B's was enjoyable with excellent food, good service, and a great location. My wife and I were particularly impressed with the shrimp and grits and barbecued shrimp dishes, both of which were outstanding. The appetizers also met our expectations. However, we found the bread pudding slightly dry, which was surprising considering that New Orleans is famous for it. 

Although Mr. B's came close to receiving a five-star rating, there were a few downsides. The service could have been more attentive, and the temperature inside the restaurant was uncomfortably cold, especially for a July visit to New Orleans. It is advisable to come dressed in long sleeves or bring a jacket to ensure a comfortable dining experience.

input:
Wow. We visited NOLA last week and took the truly awesome and informative  Steamboat Natchez trip on March 30. Can't tell you how interesting it was and pleasant. Plus these people are so well-organized and nice. JoJo reserved us a window seat - just could not believe the kind and excellent service. 
Very very nice.  Recommend!!!!
Refine this for me please: During our visit to NOLA last week, we had the pleasure of embarking on the truly awe-inspiring and educational Steamboat Natchez trip on March 30th. We were thoroughly captivated by the fascinating experience and delightful atmosphere. Additionally, the level of organization and the genuine kindness exhibited by the staff surpassed all expectations. We were graciously accommodated with a window seat by the wonderful JoJo, whose exceptional service left us in awe. We highly recommend this outstanding excursion and cannot speak highly enough of our pleasant experience.

input: Quite possibly the perfect business model to fail if it wasn't for a sequestered clientel?  We visit New Orleans often, and it is an activity of ours to bet on how many beers or ingredients they are out of.  Bartenders rude and swearing. It's almost comical, we sit and listen to patrons asking for draft beers and mixed drinks and getting responses "can't do that".  They said "No mules", to at least 5 people as we sat for about 30 mins today.  2 out of 4 taps not working. What an absolute waste of opportunity.
Refine this for me please: The business model of this establishment is on the verge of failure, saved only by a loyal customer base. Our frequent visits to New Orleans have provided us with an amusing activity of betting on how many beers or ingredients will be unavailable at this establishment. The bartenders are consistently rude and resort to swearing. It is almost comical to witness patrons ordering draft beers and mixed drinks, only to be met with responses like "can't do that". Today, we sat for about 30 minutes and witnessed at least five people being denied mules, while also discovering that two out of the four taps were not functioning. This establishment is an utter waste of potential.

input: We had a mixed experience at Mr. B's.  We started at the bar for drinks and a starter due to table wait. Bar was nice for a busy night. Our table was ready early so the bar staff transferred our starter to the table and things went down hill quickly. Starters were delivered and then we were ignored for over 45 minutes. No drinks, water etc. Finally a waiter in another section took out order. We ordered BBQ shrimp (best thing on our table), rabbit and wood plank grilled fish. Fish was a very small piece and not worth the $$$. Rabbit was good! Hit and miss service ruined the experience.
Refine this for me please: Our experience at Mr. B's was quite mixed. We initially began at the bar for drinks and a starter because there was a wait for a table. The bar was enjoyable, considering how busy the night was. However, when our table was ready earlier than expected, the bar staff transferred our starter to the table and things quickly took a turn for the worse. After our starters were delivered, we were completely ignored for over 45 minutes – no drinks, no water, nothing. It was only when a waiter from another section noticed our predicament that we were finally able to place our order. Although the BBQ shrimp was the standout dish at our table, the wood plank grilled fish was disappointingly small and not worth the price. On the other hand, the rabbit dish was quite good. Unfortunately, the inconsistent service really ruined the overall experience.

input:
This place is so cute. The interior is adorable and casual. There's some small booths and chairs and tables for hanging out and enjoying your food/drinks. It's all so clean, too, which is a huge plus.
There's a little section with baked goods, some Asian and some more American. They have mostly Vietnamese food, but I also saw some other types of food (e.g bulgogi).
I came in with two friends and the woman who helped us was really personable and friendly. We ordered banh mi and boba tea, and sat down waiting for our food to be brought to us. The banh mi was really yummy, especially the bread. I had boba milk tea, which was as good as any milk tea I've had before. 
They have a drink card which you can get stamped to receive a free tenth drink. Definitely an incentive to return. Also, their hours are awesome, which is a huge plus.
Refine this for me please:
This place is incredibly charming with its adorable and casual interior. The small booths, chairs, and tables provide a cozy atmosphere for enjoying your food and drinks. Additionally, the cleanliness of the establishment is a major advantage.

There is a delightful section dedicated to baked goods offering a mix of Asian and American treats. While the majority of their menu consists of Vietnamese cuisine, they also have other options available, including dishes like bulgogi.

As I entered with two friends, we were greeted by a delightful and friendly woman who provided excellent service. Our order consisted of banh mi and boba tea, which we eagerly anticipated while seated. The banh mi exceeded expectations, especially the bread, and the boba milk tea was on par with the best I have tasted in the past.

One noteworthy perk is their drink card which can be stamped, ultimately leading to a free tenth beverage. This definitely serves as an incentive to revisit this establishment. Additionally, their convenient operating hours add to the appeal of this place.

input: I stopped at Walgreens in hopes of seeing the new ELF Villain's collection. Sometimes Walgreens gets them before the holidays. Sometimes they don't. This particular one doesn't ever get them according to their cosmetics person. SAD. Really sad. I suppose I'll have to skulk other Walgreens to find them.
Refine this for me please: I made a pit stop at Walgreens, hoping to catch a glimpse of the new ELF Villain's collection. It's hit or miss whether Walgreens carries them before the holidays, and unfortunately, this particular store never seems to have them, as confirmed by their cosmetics staff. It's quite disappointing, to say the least. Looks like I'll have to scout out other Walgreens locations in my search for them.

input: This is the best Italian food I've ever had. Very small elegant restaurant, entrees were really good and very tasty cheesecake. To top it off, the entire staff was super friendly. Highly recommended for date night.
Refine this for me please:
I would suggest revising the sentence to enhance coherence and clarity:

"This restaurant offers the best Italian food I have ever had. It is a small and elegant establishment where the enticing entrees are exceptionally tasty, and the cheesecake is absolutely delicious. Moreover, the staff members are all incredibly friendly and courteous. I highly recommend this place for a memorable date night."

input:
This is my favourite place to get fish tacos! It's all I ever order, along with the occasional queso or beans which are also delicious. My friend was visiting from out of town and he ordered the beef taco and chicken fajitas and thought they were pretty average. However, he agreed that the fish tacos were amazing. Since 2 full me up and they're only like $2.60 each it's a pretty happy visit all round for me! Plus the interior and patio are awesome
(And there's Ben and Jerry's right next door for dessert)
Refine this for me please: This is my absolute go-to spot for the best fish tacos! I can never resist ordering them every time I visit. Occasionally, I'll treat myself to some mouthwatering queso or tasty beans on the side, which are equally amazing. When my friend from out of town joined me, he decided to try the beef taco and chicken fajitas, but found them to be just average. However, we both agreed that the fish tacos were out of this world. The fact that I only need two to feel satisfied, and they are incredibly affordable at just $2.60 each, makes every visit a delightful experience. Moreover, the restaurant's interior and patio are both fantastic, adding to the overall atmosphere. Plus, if I'm in the mood for something sweet after my meal, there's a Ben and Jerry's conveniently located right next door for dessert.

input: Replaced a dive watch battery in less than 5 minutes for a very reasonable fee.  Prompt, friendly service.  Plenty of staff.  Convenient location.
Refine this for me please: Prompt, friendly service was provided when I had a dive watch battery replacement, which was completed in less than 5 minutes. The fee charged was very reasonable, and I found the experience to be convenient due to the ample staff available at the convenient location.

input:
Stopped here last week while in the area from Burbank. Had read about it on Trip Advisor. It is in a great location, quiet, peaceful and cool under the shade of the big old trees. For its location and it being noon on a Thursday we were surprised to find there was literally only one table open when we walked in. Food is served pretty quick though so it didn't seem anyone was really waiting. 
Based on reviews we had read, my hubby had the tri-tip sandwich. I ordered the buffalo burger. I have to say that was one of the best burgers I have ever had in my life. As usual, we traded tastes of our orders. My hubby was so jealous of my buffalo burger and I heard about it several more times throughout the day, that he should've got the burger. The tri-tip was quite dry, and it was literally just the meat on bread, big bread.  The horseradish sauce (served on the side) was very tasty though.
For the tri-tip, I give a 3, hubby gives a 4. We both give the buffalo burger a definite 5++.

Either way, worth checking out if you want something with a unique atmosphere and that is away from town but not a long drive. Very peaceful.
Refine this for me please:
During our visit to the Burbank area, we stopped by this place last week after reading about it on Trip Advisor. The restaurant is conveniently located and offers a tranquil and cool ambiance under the shade of beautiful old trees. Despite it being noon on a Thursday, we were surprised to find only one available table when we walked in.

Fortunately, the service was prompt, and we received our food quickly without having to wait for a long time. Following the recommendations we had read, my husband opted for the tri-tip sandwich while I decided to try the buffalo burger. I must say, the buffalo burger was one of the most delicious burgers I've ever had in my life. We traded bites, and my husband couldn't help but express his envy as he wished he had ordered the burger instead. On the other hand, the tri-tip sandwich was disappointing as it was rather dry and solely consisted of meat on a large piece of bread. However, the horseradish sauce, served on the side, provided a tasty accompaniment.

To rate the tri-tip, I would give it a 3, while my husband would give it a 4. As for the buffalo burger, we both give it an enthusiastic 5++.

Overall, if you're seeking a unique atmosphere and a peaceful escape away from town, this place is definitely worth a visit. It's not far to drive, ensuring a convenient experience, and delivers a serene dining experience.

input:
I have frequented the Mad Mex, University City location for years.  I was pleased to see this new location which is closer to my home and I don't have to deal with the obnoxious students.  I have been here for Happy Hour and just for dinner at another time.  It has been busy both times and it seems that the staff need to be trained a little more in chaos and crowd management.  The best deals are during Happy Hour - the $3, $5 & $7 Margarita's.  I also believe wings are 1/2 off.  My friends seemed to enjoy their orders of Burritos, Gaucamole and enchiladas.  

The food is average and for the price of drinks - it would be a great place to hang if the service improves.
Refine this for me please:
I have been a long-time customer of Mad Mex, particularly the University City location. So, I was happy to discover their new location closer to my home, as it means I don't have to deal with the annoying students. I have visited this new location for both Happy Hour and regular dinner times, and on both occasions, it has been quite crowded. However, I feel that the staff could benefit from some additional training in handling chaos and large crowds.

The best deals can be found during Happy Hour, with $3, $5, and $7 Margaritas, as well as half off on wings. My friends have enjoyed their orders of Burritos, Guacamole, and Enchiladas. However, I find the overall food quality to be average, especially considering the prices. If the service improves, this place would be much more appealing, as it offers a great spot to hang out.

input:
I brought my boyfriend here on a Saturday for a tour and beer sampling since Yuengling is one of his favorite beers. We never knew it was so close!

Be sure to look on their website for tour times before going and read the FAQ's. 
- First note: There were many people wearing flip flops on our tours vs. the insisted closed toe shoe policy, but that could be because of the next note.
- Second note: There is no production/brewing on Saturdays so the brewery is quiet and empty.

We looked around the main waiting/lobby area and gift shop waiting for our 12p tour to begin.  We had quite a large group, which had to split into two smaller ones. The tour lasted about 40 minutes, starting with a ten minute video of the history of Yuengling and the rise to present day. Next, the guide takes you out to the brewery, and into the kettle room, around through the lab, the bottle line, and the holding tanks. The tour was informative and hands on. Our guide was informative and knew quite a lot about the history and brewing process. She did a great job!

Once done, you loop back into the lobby where the tasting room is and it's drinks galore. The BEST PART? FREE. Tips are encouraged! ;)
We tried the Premium Lager, Lager, and Black and Tan. Sadly they were out of the Lord Chesterfield this day and the Premium Light is not available here in FL.

Overall, a great tour and I will be revisitng with my parents when they are in town!
Refine this for me please:
I brought my boyfriend here on a Saturday for a tour and beer sampling because Yuengling is one of his favorite beers. To our surprise, we didn't realize the brewery was so close to us!

Before you visit, make sure to check their website for tour times and read the FAQ section. 
- Note: Despite the insisted closed toe shoe policy, we noticed many people wearing flip flops during our tour, although this might be due to our next observation.
- Note: On Saturdays, there is no production or brewing happening, so the brewery is quiet and empty.

We spent some time exploring the main waiting area, lobby, and gift shop while waiting for our scheduled 12p tour. Our group was quite large, so we had to split into two smaller groups. The tour lasted about 40 minutes and started with a ten-minute video showcasing the history of Yuengling and its journey to the present day. Our guide then took us to various parts of the brewery, including the kettle room, lab, bottle line, and holding tanks. The tour was interactive and educational, and our guide did an excellent job sharing her knowledge about the brewery's history and brewing process.

After the tour, we returned to the lobby, where the tasting room is located. The best part? It's completely free, although tips are encouraged! We had the opportunity to sample the Premium Lager, Lager, and Black and Tan. Unfortunately, they were out of Lord Chesterfield during our visit, and the Premium Light is not available in Florida.

Overall, it was a fantastic tour, and I plan on revisiting with my parents when they come to town!

input:
Really disappointed. I've been to the Marathon at 18/Spruce and had excellent service, drinks and food. Thought that would transfer to this location - not at all.

To sum it up, our server was extremely energetic, but not in a good way. More like a frantic energy. I was there to enjoy a few drinks and dinner with a friend who was visiting (AKA looking to spend money AKA you will get a larger tip if you let us stay longer) and we were rushed out. Server brought boxes for food we were still eating, without asking if we wanted them. A few minutes later he physically put the food in the boxes at the tableside while mumbling something like "I don't like food sitting on the table." .....we didn't even want to take it home. Next, when we said we were having another friend join for another round or two of drinks he told us we couldn't stay at the booth we were at and we needed to go to the bar. What? I point blank asked him if he was kicking us out of the booth and he said "yes!" energetically. There was no one waiting for tables and there were numerous open tables/booths around the restaurant. I felt extremely uncomfortable and wanted to leave immediately. Our friend joined after all this happened, and when the server came over to ask if they wanted a drink, he seemed surprised when we told him we were just going to leave. YOU LITERALLY just told us we couldn't sit at this table any longer!! We then left.

I worked in restaurants for a long time and I'm pretty easy to please when it comes to restaurant service. I was not pleased at all during this visit.

On another note, the food was not that great.
Refine this for me please:
I was very disappointed with my experience at the Marathon location on 18/Spruce. I had previously enjoyed excellent service, drinks, and food at another Marathon location, so I had high expectations. Unfortunately, those expectations were not met at this particular location.

To put it simply, our server seemed excessively energetic, but not in a positive way – more like frantic. I was there to have a relaxing evening with a friend who was visiting, and we intended to spend money on drinks and dinner. We felt rushed and uncomfortable throughout our entire visit. The server brought boxes for our food before we were finished eating, without even asking if we wanted them. He then proceeded to put the food in the boxes at our tableside, muttering something about not liking food sitting on the table. We didn't even plan on taking the food home.

To make matters worse, when we mentioned that another friend would be joining us for more drinks, the server informed us that we couldn't stay at our booth and directed us to the bar. This caught us off guard, and I directly asked if he was kicking us out, to which he energetically confirmed. Keep in mind, there were plenty of open tables and booths in the restaurant, and no one was waiting for a table. The situation made us extremely uncomfortable, and we immediately wanted to leave. Our friend arrived later, and when the server came over to take their drink order, he seemed surprised when we informed him that we were leaving. It was frustrating because he had just told us we couldn't stay at our table!

Having worked in the restaurant industry myself for a long time, I am generally easy to please when it comes to service. However, this visit left me entirely dissatisfied.

Furthermore, the food itself was not particularly impressive.

input: We arrived for lunch at 12p on a Friday - wasn't busy at all. It took FOREVER to get anything. We were really pleasant and kind but we had to complain several times to get any beverages that we ordered. It took them 40 minutes to let us know that a beer we ordered was no longer available. The food was great, but not worth the lengthy wait and slow service.
Refine this for me please: We arrived for lunch at 12p on a Friday hoping for a smooth dining experience, but sadly it wasn't the case. Despite the lack of a crowd, our beverage order seemed to take an eternity to arrive. Despite our patience and politeness, we had to make multiple complaints before receiving the beverages we had ordered. To add to the frustration, it took a whopping 40 minutes for them to inform us that the beer we had requested was out of stock. While the food ended up being enjoyable, the considerable wait time and slow service certainly made it feel less worthwhile.

input: Walked by this place and decided to check it out. Great beer and burger place, made even better knowing many things were organic. You can order from the menu, or create your own burger. They also have rotating beers and specials. Nice atmosphere and staff. Burgers don't come with anything, so order from the sides if you want some fries. (There's also sandwiches and salads if you don't want a burger) Vegetarian friendly.
Refine this for me please: While passing by, I couldn't resist but step into this place. To my delight, I discovered a wonderful destination for beer and burgers that exceeded my expectations with its commitment to organic ingredients. The menu offers a variety of options to satisfy different cravings, allowing you to either choose from the offerings or unleash your creativity and build your own burger. Moreover, the establishment maintains a refreshing selection of rotating beers and intriguing specials. The inviting atmosphere and attentive staff further contribute to the overall positive experience. However, it's important to note that the burgers are not accompanied by anything, but you have the option to order a side of fries to complete your meal. Don't worry if you're not in the mood for a burger; they also cater to those who prefer sandwiches or salads. Additionally, vegetarians will find plenty of options to indulge in.

input:
First time I went to Earl's new American kitchen I liked the food it was good wasn't great but it was a ok 
 service not so great sat at the bar did not really care for a bartender tried it again second time bartender was really rude I would never go back there  or Recommend it to anyone
Refine this for me please: During my initial visit to Earl's new American kitchen, the food was satisfactory; it was good, but not outstanding. The service, specifically at the bar, left much to be desired. Unfortunately, the bartender did not provide a pleasant experience. Despite this, I decided to give the establishment another chance. However, during my second visit, I encountered an exceptionally rude bartender. Considering this experience, I personally have no intention of returning to Earl's or recommending it to others.

input:
I visited Jake's for the first time after learning that the small diner I used to go to in Delaware as a kid had become a franchise. I was so excited to experience the delicious burgers and fries that I craved as a kid.

I walked into the establishment and was frankly unimpressed by the ambiance. The restaurant was moderately clean and very open. The menu actually reminded my of a Five Guys. You get to choose your own toppings (all free) to put on 1, 2, or 3 patties.

I ordered the regular cheeseburger with a ton of toppings and a regular size french fry to share with my boyfriend. The burgers were delicious. The bread was soft and tasty and the burgers were succulent and juicy. The fries were disappointing. McDonalds fries taste better and usually aren't even as cold as Jake's were.

Man oh man, Jake's. I'll go back for the burgers, maybe, but I definitely will stick to the original location for a better experience.
Refine this for me please:
After hearing that the small Delaware diner I frequented as a child had become a franchise, I eagerly decided to visit Jake's for the first time. Anticipating the delightful burgers and fries of my childhood, I walked into the establishment only to be unexpectedly underwhelmed by the ambiance. Although the restaurant was moderately clean and had a spacious layout, it reminded me more of a Five Guys than the cozy diner I remembered.

Nonetheless, I proceeded to order a regular cheeseburger with an assortment of toppings, as well as a regular-sized serving of fries to share with my boyfriend. To my delight, the burgers proved to be a scrumptious delight. The bread was soft and flavorful, perfectly complementing the succulent and juicy patties. Unfortunately, the fries failed to meet expectations. Disappointingly, they lacked the deliciousness of McDonald's fries and were even colder in comparison.

While I may consider returning to Jake's solely for their delectable burgers, I believe that the original location of the diner will always provide a superior overall experience.

input: I think its funny that my car needed a jump infront of their shop on broad street and i was told No because of not being able to leave the store. When asked if another employee could help he said no he is about to leave. I then asked if he can give me a jump when he leaves and i also got a NO. Funny how theycservice cars, help people with cars but cant even give me a jump. Lame service. Not customer oriented at all. Typical fat guy behind the counter surfing the web and playin on his phone. The worst
Refine this for me please: I find it amusing that when my car needed a jump in front of their shop on Broad Street, they refused to help, citing their inability to leave the store. Even when I requested assistance from another employee before they left, they declined. It's ironic that a business servicing cars and helping people with automotive issues couldn't even offer me a jumpstart. Their service was lacking and not customer-oriented in the slightest. It's a prime example of the typical disinterested employee, focused on surfing the web and playing on their phone. Overall, the experience was incredibly disappointing.

input: I ordered the Pulled Pork Nachos.  They were delicious!  Instead of tortilla chips they are served with potato chips...perfect to share with a Beer or Bloody Mary
Refine this for me please: I thoroughly enjoyed the Pulled Pork Nachos I ordered. The unique twist of serving them with potato chips instead of tortilla chips was a delightful surprise. These nachos are perfect for sharing alongside a refreshing beverage like a Beer or Bloody Mary.

input: This place was cute and was in a great location!  It is one block up from the beach and wharf, two blocks over from State Street.  Parking was convenient, and our room was a King overlooking the courtyard and spa on the ground floor.  If there were people in the spa, they could be heard, but the noise didn't bother since the spa closed at 9pm.  The room was clean with a nice couch to lounge on, a refrigerator, a nice fireplace, ample closet and counter space, and a nice bathroom.  The wine and cheese at 5 was a nice touch as well.  Although this place didn't have a lot of extras, it was a pleasant stay, friendly and helpful staff, a good price, perfect location, and suited our needs just fine for a place in Santa Barbara.  My only complaint was that the room got a little stuffy, but was fine once we opened the windows and used the ceiling fan to air it out.  Would consider staying here again.
Refine this for me please:
This place was not only cute, but also in a fantastic location. It was just one block away from the beach and wharf, and only two blocks over from State Street. Convenient parking was available, and our King room on the ground floor provided a delightful view of the courtyard and spa. We could occasionally hear people in the spa, but it was not bothersome as the spa closed at 9pm. The room itself was clean and comfortable, featuring a cozy couch, a refrigerator, a lovely fireplace, ample closet and counter space, and a well-appointed bathroom.

The addition of wine and cheese at 5pm was a nice touch, and although the place didn't offer many extra amenities, it provided a pleasant stay. The staff was friendly and helpful, the price was reasonable, and the location was perfect for our needs in Santa Barbara. The only issue we encountered was that the room felt a bit stuffy, but that was easily remedied by opening the windows and using the ceiling fan to circulate air. Overall, we would definitely consider staying here again.

input:
I've been to Mirna's about four times over the past few years and never been disappointed. The portions are HUGE, especially for the modest price tag. Do yourself a favor and get a pasta dish, I can assure you that you'll be glad you did. I've had fish there too, which wasn't bad by any means, but the pasta plates are definitely their specialty. A couple of the times I've been there they treated us to free hummus and pita, which is always a plus. BYOB!

Only knock on the place is that it's pretty small, so make sure to call ahead to reserve a table or check for a wait.
Refine this for me please: In my experience, I have visited Mirna's multiple times over the past few years and have consistently had positive experiences. One aspect that stands out is the generous portion sizes, particularly considering the affordable prices. If you decide to visit, I highly recommend trying one of their pasta dishes as they are truly exceptional. While I have also tried their fish and found it to be decent, the pasta plates remain their specialty. On a few occasions, they pleasantly surprised us with complimentary hummus and pita, which added to the dining experience. It is worth noting that the restaurant has limited seating, so it's advisable to call ahead and reserve a table or inquire about potential waiting times. Additionally, Mirna's is a BYOB establishment.

input: While I generally support independent restaurants over chain places,I still don't buy into the overpriced center city Phila hype. The place was actually roomier than the south Philly closets we usually take my mother in law for her birthday,but the prices were jaw dropping...quite different from the online menu. The food and portions were ok,and the dessert was something different than the average places. The bus help was a bit out of sync with the waiter,as they were asking us if we were done with our plates just as the waiter was telling us the desserts,and as the Philly standard the bathroom was a bit small to accomodate the size of the place.
Refine this for me please: Although I typically prefer independent restaurants over chain establishments, I am not convinced by the overpriced hype surrounding the center city Philadelphia dining scene. However, I must admit that the restaurant I recently visited was surprisingly more spacious compared to the cramped south Philly places we usually visit for my mother-in-law's birthday. Unfortunately, the prices were exorbitant, which was quite different from what the online menu indicated. The food and portion sizes were acceptable, and the dessert stood out as being unique compared to other average restaurants. The bus staff seemed out of sync with the waiter, frequently asking if we were finished with our plates just as the waiter started describing the dessert options. Additionally, the restaurant adhered to the typical small bathroom size inherent to Philadelphia establishments.

input: Platoon is awesome and you definitely want Steve C as a trainer. When I started platoon, I was going once a week and attending a different group exercise class the other days of the week. After a few months, I was only coming to platoon 3-5 days a week. I loved how my workouts were customized to what I could do and wanted to do instead of a group workout that was impossible to complete. Steve is a great listener and motivator and sets realistic goals. The staff at platoon are very nice and accommodating. I never had a problem with billing or scheduling.
Refine this for me please: Platoon is an absolutely fantastic fitness facility, and I highly recommend Steve C as a trainer. When I initially began attending Platoon, my workout routine consisted of one session per week, with other group exercise classes filling the rest of my week. However, after a few months, I found myself attending Platoon 3-5 days a week. The reason for this shift lies in my admiration for the personalized nature of the workouts at Platoon. Unlike group exercise classes that often present daunting challenges, Platoon tailored my workouts to suit my abilities and preferences. I cannot praise Steve enough for his exceptional listening skills and motivation techniques, always setting goals that were achievable yet challenging. The entire staff at Platoon exudes kindness and accommodation, as I never encountered any issues regarding billing or scheduling.

input: The Tater-Tots were good but not anything I haven't  had before. Burger was satisfactory.  Quick stop for lunch.  Staff was helpful with providing directions to local attractions.
Refine this for me please: The Tater-Tots were tasty, although they didn't offer anything particularly unique that I hadn't tried before. The burger was decent and met my expectations. It was a convenient spot for a quick lunch. Additionally, the staff was friendly and provided helpful directions to nearby attractions.

input:
As a frequent customer who has come since the place opened, I had previously rated this place higher, based on a recent experience decided to downgrade.

Myself and both in-laws had visited, one of which was senior. Had a mail coupon for $5 off, which had no disclaimer.  I wanted to apply this to our party of three (2 adults, 1 senior). Cashier gave us a hard time stating that her management dictated that she wasn't allowed to apply the coupon if we were combining it with a senior discount. What logic is that? How would it be any different if I had paid for myself and my mother in law, applied the coupon. Then told my father in law, the senior, to pay on his own. Seriously, Retarded. 

This is on YOU management not that poor girl. Either for not creating a better customer experience or poorly training your staff.
Refine this for me please: As a long-time and loyal customer, my previous positive rating of this establishment was recently reconsidered due to a disappointing experience. During a recent visit with my in-laws, one of whom was a senior, I presented a mail coupon for a $5 discount. To my surprise, the cashier insisted that she couldn't honor the coupon if we also wished to apply the senior discount. This policy seemed illogical to me. If I had paid separately for myself and my mother-in-law, used the coupon, and then had my father-in-law, the senior, pay separately, how would that have made any difference? This issue reflects poorly on the management's ability to create a satisfactory customer experience and suggests inadequate training for their staff. The blame for this incident lies with the management, not the cashier.

input: Our 1st visit here. We went through the drive thru & ordered 4 Chicago dogs. The total bill was $10.  The Chicago Dogs were great & the only place in a 28 mile radius that you can purchase one. The only 2 things missing were a poppyseed bun & celery salt. My last attempt for a Chicago dog locally was Sonic (yuck). SuperGyro uses 100% beef hot dogs, that neon green relish, sport peppers, onions, dill pickle tomatoes & onion. I'll be back for more & also to try the other menu items.
Refine this for me please: During our first visit, we opted for the drive-thru and ordered four Chicago dogs. The bill came up to a total of $10. We were thoroughly impressed with the Chicago Dogs as they were the only ones available within a 28-mile radius. The only minor drawbacks were the lack of a poppyseed bun and celery salt. In my previous attempt to find a Chicago dog locally, I had tried Sonic's version (which was quite disappointing). However, SuperGyro's version exceeded my expectations, thanks to their use of 100% beef hot dogs and authentic ingredients like neon green relish, sport peppers, onions, dill pickle tomatoes, and onions. I am definitely planning on returning for more Chicago dogs and to explore the rest of their menu.

input: Wawa is like a beacon in a cold, dark world.  I grew up around Sheetz locations, but I have to admit that I prefer Wawa.  The sandwiches are really good, and they have the typical snacks/drinks you would expect from a convenience store.  This particular location is not quite as friendly as the one I go to near the office, but whatever.  I can still walk out with all of my snacking requirements.
Refine this for me please: Wawa shines as a guiding light in a bleak and frigid world. Despite my previous exposure to Sheetz establishments, I wholeheartedly confess my preference for Wawa. Their delectable sandwiches and assortment of expected convenience store snacks and beverages cater to my every craving. While this specific location may lack the warmth and friendliness of the one I frequent near my office, it still satisfies all my snacking needs.

input: My dad and I stopped in on the way back to the hotel because we wanted a 2nd drink after being disappointed with our first at another place. We ordered the hand grenades rather than pore over the menu. There was a band playing so we decided to sit for a bit Holy cow on those drinks!! They were $9 each (with souvenir cup) and we were really feeling it towards the end of the drink. It was during the day and we were enjoying the nice weather and band playing. This place was on the corner of Bourbon, close to Jackson Square and there was lots of open air coming through. We were singing along with the band which is an indication of how good that drink made us feel, lol. We had a lot of fun, good atmosphere in that bar.
Refine this for me please: My dad and I decided to make a quick stop at a bar on our way back to the hotel. We were looking for a better drink experience after being disappointed with our first choice at another place. Without much thought, we opted for hand grenades instead of carefully scanning the menu. The bar had a live band playing, so we thought why not stay for a while. Wow, those drinks were something else! They came at a price of $9 each, including a souvenir cup, and towards the end, we could really feel the effects. Despite it being daytime, we thoroughly enjoyed the pleasant weather and lively band. This bar was located near the corner of Bourbon, close to Jackson Square, allowing plenty of fresh air to flow in. We were even caught up in the moment and found ourselves singing along with the band, which says a lot about how those drinks made us feel! Overall, it was a great time with a fantastic atmosphere in that bar.

input:
I went to this location because it's easy to get in and out even tho it is a busy corner. This is my second visit. My first visit was mediocre. The woman who assisted me was not really friendly (sorry I didn't get names at either visit) but was helpful and professional. My second visit I was assisted by a different woman who was also helpful, knowledgeable and professional. I realized the women were not being rude; they are just quiet. Neither woman made small talk but answered every question I had. 
Now my second visit deserved 5 stars. I normally pack things myself and just need it shipped, but I was shipping a skateboard and could not box it correctly. The woman went above and beyond to help me and she offered more assistance than was professionally required.  I will return to this location for all my shipping needs.
The store is clean, and packs (no pun intended) a lot of product into a small space. The staff is knowledgeable. They have boxes, packing materials, and offer copying services. You may not get a big smile and a lot of small talk, but you will get the highest level of service. In my opinion.
Refine this for me please:
I visited this location for the second time because it is easily accessible despite being located on a busy corner. On my first visit, I found it to be average. The woman who assisted me, although not very friendly (names were not obtained during either visit), was still helpful and professional. During my second visit, I was assisted by a different woman who was equally helpful, knowledgeable, and professional. Although neither woman engaged in small talk, they answered all my questions. 

My second visit truly impressed me and I would rate it as a 5-star experience. Typically, I prefer to pack my items myself and only require shipping services. However, as I needed assistance in boxing a skateboard, the woman went above and beyond her professional duties to help me. She even offered additional assistance beyond what was required. I am now convinced that the lack of small talk from these women does not equate to rudeness, but rather their quiet nature. 

I am definitely going to return to this location for all my shipping needs. The store is well-maintained and effectively utilizes its compact space. The staff is knowledgeable and provides services such as copying along with supplying boxes and packing materials. While you may not receive a warm smile and casual conversation, rest assured that you will receive exceptional service. This, in my opinion, is the highest level of service one can expect.

input: I had chicken BBQ burritos with all kinds of stuff that I like. I love the it ! Good place to sit down with family & had a meal. I wish they had a place for kids to play that would be even better !
Refine this for me please: I thoroughly enjoyed the chicken BBQ burritos at this restaurant, as they were filled with all of my favorite ingredients. It's an excellent place to dine in with family, offering a cozy environment for a meal together. However, it would be even better if they provided a designated area for kids to play.

input: We stopped here for my Chai and Hubby's coffee and caffeine mania. The line went quite fast, they're quick with the service especially not a lot of people at the time. My Chai came out good, awesome! One thing I forgot to do is to purchase more coffee for the house. They have lots for sale. But not too worry because we still have plenty of Starbucks coffee at home. What would life be without Starbucks?
Refine this for me please: We decided to make a quick stop for my Chai and my husband's coffee, indulging in our love for caffeine. Fortunately, the line moved swiftly, thanks to the efficient service and the lack of customers during that time. I was delighted with the taste of my Chai; it was truly satisfying. However, I realized that I forgot to buy more coffee for our home supply. Luckily, we still have an abundance of Starbucks coffee at home, so there's no need to worry. After all, what would life be like without the comfort of Starbucks?

input:
It's a young start up company. Patience is a virtue.
Many in the gun community lack this virtue, so be it.
Owner seems to be a stand up guy and has stood by his word in my dealings with him.
I met the owner, Jacob, at a gun show in Las Vegas where I purchased a Cerakoted billet lower.
Pretty quality work on the machining and Cerakote job.
Traded emails with the owner and always got a quick response with the information I requested.
Refine this for me please: This start-up company is relatively young, and as the saying goes, patience is crucial. Unfortunately, many individuals in the gun community tend to lack this virtue. However, the owner of this company appears to be a reliable and trustworthy individual who has consistently fulfilled his promises in my personal interactions with him. I had the opportunity to meet Jacob, the owner, at a gun show in Las Vegas, where I purchased a high-quality Cerakoted billet lower. The craftsmanship and attention to detail in both the machining and Cerakote job were impressive. Additionally, whenever I reached out to the owner via email, he responded promptly and provided the requested information.

input: Very impressed with this place, particularly the menu (amazing) and the food. We ordered the fruit bruschetta (yum, what an awesome idea!) and the Popeye skillet and the Roadhouse sw. Great food, creative options! Couple areas of critique: it was FREEZING (every woman had a sweater on in July) and lack of ambiance. The latter could be easily remedied with some decent background music, and better lighting? (Overhead office lighting is a drag, but large windows a plus) Customer service was good not great, tad disconnected...but it was a holiday weekend. Overall, a keeper. I'll def be back!
Refine this for me please:
I was very impressed with this place, especially the menu which was absolutely amazing. We tried the fruit bruschetta, and it was a fantastic and innovative idea. We also ordered the Popeye skillet and the Roadhouse sandwich, both of which were amazing. The food here is delicious, and they offer a lot of creative options.

There are, however, a couple of areas that could use improvement. Firstly, the temperature in the restaurant was freezing. It was so cold that every woman had to wear a sweater in the middle of July. Additionally, the ambiance was lacking. Some background music and better lighting would easily remedy this. The overhead office lighting made the atmosphere feel dull, but the large windows were a plus.

The customer service was good, but not great. There was a slight disconnect, though it could be attributed to it being a holiday weekend. Overall, this place is a keeper, and I will definitely be back!

input: Great job on my fill and gel pedicure. Even though it was close to closing, they took their time and even accommodated every request I had (I'm VERY particular). Clean environment and very friendly staff. Way more than I could have expected for a nail salon in a mall. P.S. My foot and hand massages afterwards were heavenly. I will DEFINITELY be back!!!
Refine this for me please: I am extremely impressed with the quality of my fill and gel pedicure. Despite it being near closing time, the staff at the salon took their time to ensure that every detail was perfect, and they graciously catered to all of my specific requests (which, I must admit, can be rather demanding). The environment was impeccably clean, and the staff were incredibly friendly throughout my visit. I was pleasantly surprised by the level of service provided, especially considering it was a nail salon located in a shopping mall. Additionally, the foot and hand massages I received afterwards were absolutely heavenly. Without a doubt, I will be returning to this salon in the future.

input: I can't recall the day I went but it was a memorial resturant experience.  I was greeted by an incredibly nice cashier. After a hard decision I ordered a Devils delight and the girl giggled ( of course I was confused) She explained it was Dev's Delight and named after her because it was her idea for a burger and me calling it Devils delight was a bit funny because her friends call her Devil Dev ( hard to believe such a nice girl could aquire such a nickname but cute). After she took my thorough of a medium burger, and truffle fires i didn't have to wait very long. Even before I ate the burger the smell it self had my mouth watering.  The burger was cooked to perfection and what was on the burger was amazing!  This burger was a standard beef foundation with mozzarella cheese tomato basil and a portobello mushroom, what great idea for a burger! For a mushroom lover this with a side of the delicious truffle fries is perfect. Excellent quality and service,  a bit expensive but worth every penny. No question about it I will be a return customer!
Refine this for me please:
I had a wonderful experience at a memorial restaurant, although I can't quite recall the exact day I went. Upon arrival, I was warmly greeted by a cashier who was incredibly friendly.  After much contemplation, I finally decided to order the Devils Delight burger. To my surprise, the cashier giggled when I placed my order (which left me quite confused). She kindly explained that it was actually called Dev's Delight and was named after her as it was her brilliant idea for a burger. Her friends had given her the nickname "Devil Dev," which was a bit amusing considering how sweet she appeared to be. 

Once she took my order for a medium burger and truffle fries, the wait time was surprisingly short. The aroma of the burger alone had my mouth watering even before I took my first bite. The burger itself was cooked to perfection and the toppings were absolutely amazing! The standard beef patty was topped with mozzarella cheese, tomato, basil, and a mouthwatering portobello mushroom. What a brilliant combination for a burger! As a mushroom enthusiast, this dish paired perfectly with a side of their delicious truffle fries. 

The quality of both the food and service was excellent, though I must admit the prices were a bit on the higher side. However, every penny spent was well worth it. Without a doubt, I will definitely be returning as a customer.

input: I was trying to find a decent place for dinner tonight for my moderately health conscious self when I came across this place. After figuring out what I wanted and put the Be My Bison burger in my cart for the online order, I realized it would be over a two mile round trip excursion from my job. Defeated, I started to search elsewhere but I could not get that burger off of my mind. I came back a few hours later and submit my order.
