I hiked it there and it just came out of the kitchen as I walked in.  I grabbed my burger and continued on my way back to work. O-M-G! Absolutely in love with this place. It has been quite the task to try and find healthy places that fit my diet but this is a dream come true! Thank You!
Refine this for me please: I was in search of a suitable dinner spot for tonight, keeping in mind my moderate health-conscious preferences, when I stumbled upon this incredible place. After deciding on the delectable Be My Bison burger and placing my order online, I realized it would require a two-mile round trip from my workplace. Initially disheartened, I began exploring other options, but my mind couldn't shake off the thought of that burger. Hours later, I made up my mind and submitted the order. Determinedly, I embarked on the journey, and as soon as I reached the restaurant, my piping hot burger was ready. Without wasting a moment, I collected my order and continued on my way back to work. Oh my goodness, I am head over heels for this place! It has been quite a challenge to find healthy eateries that align with my dietary needs, but this place feels like a dream come true. I am immensely grateful!

input:
this place was awful. the first time my mother and I went we were very excited because everyone had been talking about it and we want to support local business. The day we went it happened to be pouring raining. So we are standing there at the hostess stand cold and wet waiting to be seated. Not only was the hostess not there, no one even acknowledged that we were there. The bartender who was right next to he stand was on his blue tooth and only looked our way to flirt with me. My mom was so annoyed we just left. 

The second time we went was because we were going to be in the area and we decided to give it a second try. We were seated right away and the music was really good. The waiter could have cared less about our table. he acted like we were doing him a favor by even coming to the table. The menu was thin and nothing to really choose from. when he eventually brought the food it was decent. My mom hated her salmon cakes because they were overly breaded and poorly season. it honestly looked like two pieces of bread. 

It was overpriced for what we had. I WOULD NEVER RECOMMEND THIS PLACE. The take out makes great dog food though.
Refine this for me please:
This place was a major disappointment. The first time my mother and I visited, we were filled with anticipation as we had heard positive reviews and wanted to support a local business. However, our excitement quickly vanished when we arrived on a rainy day to find nobody at the hostess stand to greet us. We stood there cold and wet, completely ignored by the staff. To make matters worse, the bartender who was right next to the stand paid no attention to us except to flirt with me. Frustrated and annoyed, my mom and I decided to leave.

Despite our initial experience, we decided to give this place a second chance when we happened to be in the area. This time, we were promptly seated and enjoyed the good music. However, our waiter showed no interest in providing good service and acted as if we were inconveniencing him by being there. The menu was disappointingly limited, leaving us with little to choose from. Eventually, our food arrived and while it was decent, it fell short of expectations. My mom particularly disliked her overly breaded and poorly seasoned salmon cakes, which resembled two pieces of bread.

Considering the underwhelming experience we had, the prices were outrageously high. I would never recommend this place to anyone. On a positive note, their takeout is suitable for dog food.

input: Service was good. Mesquite wings are very good  best to share or save some don't be greedy like me and try.and go back to work. Only downside was the weak lemonade. It was the weakest I ever had.
Refine this for me please: The service provided was excellent. The mesquite wings exceeded my expectations and are best enjoyed when shared or saved for later. I personally made the mistake of being greedy and indulging instead of returning to work. However, one drawback was the very weak lemonade. In fact, it was the weakest lemonade I have ever encountered.

input:
I don't know how I lucked out with having this taqueria in our neighborhood, but this is the best Mexican food you'll get in New Orleans.

We discovered Taqueria Guerrero after finding that burrito joint down the street was packed, had a line wrapping around the buidling (you know which one!).

After finding street parking near the mattress store, we plopped down and ordered the 3-taco plate (al pastor, mmmm) with beans and rice on the side and a burrito (barbocoa). I am a creature of habit and order the same tacos, but the bf has ventured out to get other dishes such as the fajita plate or the really spicy shrimp (camarones del diablo?). All very tasty.

The rest is history. It's embarrassing how often I suggest this place when we want to go out/get take out.
Refine this for me please:
I feel incredibly fortunate to have stumbled upon Taqueria Guerrero in our neighborhood. In all honesty, it is unquestionably the finest Mexican cuisine you'll find in the entirety of New Orleans.

Our journey to this hidden gem began when we discovered that the popular burrito joint down the street was teeming with customers, with a line that seemed to stretch endlessly around the building (I'm sure you know exactly which one I'm referring to!).

After miraculously finding a spot to park on the street near the mattress store, we eagerly settled down and promptly placed our orders. We opted for the tantalizing 3-taco plate, with the al pastor variety being a personal favorite. Of course, we couldn't resist getting a side of beans and rice to perfectly complement our meal. Additionally, I must admit, I tend to stick to my tried-and-true taco choices, but my boyfriend has fearlessly ventured out and sampled dishes like the fajita plate and the incredibly spicy shrimp known as camarones del diablo. Needless to say, every option on the menu is incredibly delicious.

From that point forward, our love affair with Taqueria Guerrero commenced, and now it's almost embarrassing how frequently I suggest it whenever we're seeking a dine-in or takeout option.

input:
Came here with a group of 15 people on a Tuesday night. We had reserved a space in advance. 
While the food was good, what was lacking was good service and cleanliness. We sat down at our table and it was sticky, and there was a dirty and also sticky fork still on it...so the assumption was that the table simply hadn't been wiped down all the way. Yuck. 
We ordered and the food took a fair amount of time, understandable because of such a large party. Problem was, when the food came out, no server knew what we'd individually ordered, so it became a huge mix up with people eating others' food. 
I ordered the pork belly tacos which had a great caramelization on the outside and tender inside. I also ordered the spicy beef pho, which was perfectly balanced with flavor after adding the accompanying bean sprouts and limes. 
The wait for the check and processing payment was long and arduous, a problem again because we had a Lyft driver waiting outside for us. 
All in all, go for the food, not for the service.
Refine this for me please:
My group of 15 people visited on a Tuesday night after making an advance reservation. Although the food was enjoyable, the service and cleanliness left much to be desired. Upon sitting down, we noticed that our table was sticky, and there was even a dirty fork left behind suggesting that it hadn't been properly cleaned. This was quite off-putting. 
When we placed our orders, it took a considerable amount of time for the food to arrive, which is understandable considering our large party. However, the servers seemed to have no knowledge of who ordered what, resulting in a mix-up where people ended up eating each other's food. 
I personally ordered the pork belly tacos, which exhibited a delightful caramelization on the outer layer and had a tender inside. Additionally, I opted for the spicy beef pho, which was excellently balanced in flavor especially after adding the bean sprouts and limes provided. 
The wait for the check and payment processing was frustratingly long, especially since we had a Lyft driver waiting for us outside. 
Overall, I would suggest visiting this place for the good food, but not for the service.

input: Unfortunately, I'm NOT happy after coming to this salon yet again. I got a message from the owner saying he'd like to have me come in to receive a FREE service because they previously ruined my hair. So, I thought since he's the owner my hair would turn out good but I was wrong. I'm really unhappy with this whole experience. I showed him multiple photos on google of what I wanted done to my hair which was a lot of blonde. I told him I do not want any ORANGE in my hair as I wanted a "white blonde". He said you won't have any orange in your hair. I have a message from him the OWNER saying I would receive a FREE service if I deleted my previous review. He should of NEVER offered a free service if it wasn't really free! So, I said how much because I thought I was getting my hair done for free. He said since your hair is long and thick you'll have to pay for the hair color and "medicine" but he won't charge me for his time. I said ok how much he said $80. He said it would cost me $180 if he didn't give me a discount which is very pricey. He put a lot of highlights on my hair and worked quickly as he seemed to want to rush on my hair which I do not like. My hair is important to me, I don't want my hair to fall out. He said this medicine he's gonna put on my hair is $50 for a treatment and that I needed it because of the blonde going on my hair which I know any coloring is damaging and blonde is very damaging but he said he charges everyone who gets hair color for this so called medicine which they mix into the color you dye your hair. You can purchase the entire set online (3 bottles) for $75 which is supposed to give you like 15 applications so he's definitely charging a lot of money! He only put No.1 on my hair and not No.2 or No.3. He also had a lady (the receptionist) wash out my hair? Ok, even though she was nice why would he have her do that when she said she knows nothing about hair because I asked if she's styling my hair and she said she doesn't do hair and I wouldn't want her to do my hair. As I was waiting there was a lady next to me, she got her hair cut and a perm. She was done but she wasn't happy, she told the lady she didn't like the hair cut and she had her style it more and trim off a little more but the lady still wasn't happy. The girl told the client when she washes her hair it will be better.. um how? I know she left very unhappy! Also the lady behind me was getting her hair cut and when he (the owner) was done cutting her hair she looked in the mirror and wanted it different and styled different so that made me have to wait longer but 2 clients were not happy and also myself. That's not a good look TJ nail and spa! I had a towel on my head and waited about 30 mins just to get my hair blow dried because he was cutting another clients hair. I seen orange roots, I was mad!!! He finally came over and I said I don't like the orange color on my roots, can you put a toner on my hair and he said it's not orange it's the lighting. The lighting?! It wasn't the lighting! He proceeds to blow dry hair and then starts straighten it without asking me if I wanted it straightened or curled, you are supposed to pick how you want your hair styled. At that point I knew my hair wasn't what I wanted and it wasn't gonna be fixed even if I wanted it too. I just sat there in the hair, mad and yet again very disappointed! I looked in the mirror and seen my hair damaged and brittle, orange and brassy and not even close to what I wanted. There goes my money down the drain, yet again. I will not be back to get my hair ruined and he made me delete my previous review which was also 0-1 stars before I left his salon but I had to write this one, this is real, this is honest, beware of getting your hair completely ruined and nothing close to what you want! Like I said I showed the OWNER multiple photos and I stated I did NOT want any orange on my hair but I did have orange on my hair, I didn't get what I wanted like he said, he said he doesn't mess up, he's been doing hair for years. As a salon owner I think he should take the time to really do what the client wants and achieve what the client wants done to their hair, if the workersowner would do that then there shouldn't be any bad reviews but there is so that shows you they do not care, not even the owner cares. They just want to rush and get done to get paid, they don't care if the customer is happy or not. There are more bad reviews from people going to this salon and having horrible experiences but he is bribing people to delete their bad reviews because he told me the bad reviews is hurting his business which is why people do reviews, to let people know this place is awesome or this place is horrible, beware, stay away. I do reviews to let people know the good, the bad and the ugly. I do reviews anywhere and I'm always 100% honest. So, if bad reviews hurt his business that is all on him and his employees not me or anyone else.
Refine this for me please:
Unfortunately, I am once again dissatisfied with my experience at this salon. I received a message from the owner offering me a free service to rectify the previous damage done to my hair. I mistakenly believed that since he was the owner, my hair would turn out well this time. However, I am extremely disappointed with the outcome. I showed him several photos of the blonde hair I desired, emphasizing that I did not want any orange tones. He assured me that there would be no orange in my hair. The owner promised me a free service in exchange for deleting my previous negative review, but it was not truly free. When I inquired about the cost, he said I would have to pay for the hair color and a treatment, but not his time. This amounted to $80, which I thought was reasonable until I learned that the regular price would have been $180. 

During the process, the owner hurriedly applied numerous highlights to my hair, which made me uncomfortable as I value the importance of proper care for my hair. He insisted that I needed a $50 treatment for my hair due to the damage caused by the blonde color, despite the fact that I was aware of the inherent damage of any coloring process. He also mentioned charging all clients for this so-called treatment, even though the same product can be purchased online for a fraction of the cost. To my dismay, he only used one part of the three-part treatment on my hair. Additionally, I found it puzzling that the receptionist, who admitted to knowing nothing about hair, was tasked with washing out my hair instead of a stylist. 

While waiting, I witnessed another dissatisfied customer who received an unsatisfactory haircut and perm. Despite the client's dissatisfaction, the stylist simply assured her that washing her hair would improve the look, which seemed unlikely to me. Another customer was also unhappy with her haircut and requested some changes, causing me to wait even longer for my turn. With two unhappy clients and myself left disappointed, this did not reflect well on TJ nail and spa. 

After waiting approximately 30 minutes with a towel on my head, I finally had my hair blow-dried, only to notice orange roots, which infuriated me. When I voiced my concern, the owner dismissively claimed it was a lighting issue, despite this being clearly untrue. He then proceeded to straighten my hair without confirming if that was the desired style, failing to adhere to standard protocol. At that moment, I realized my hair was not going to turn out as I had hoped, and my dissatisfaction grew. Upon looking in the mirror, I observed that my hair was damaged, brittle, brassy, and far from the desired result. I regretfully realized that I had wasted my money once again. 

I will not be returning to this salon to have my hair ruined, especially since the owner coerced me into deleting my previous negative review. However, I feel compelled to share this honest and genuine review, as it is crucial for others to be aware of the potential for their hair to be completely unsatisfactory and far from their desired outcome. Despite showing the owner multiple photos and explicitly stating my preference to avoid any orange tones, my hair ended up with unwanted orange hues. This contradicts his insistence that he never makes mistakes, as he claimed to have years of experience. As a salon owner, I believe it is crucial for him to prioritize fulfilling clients' desires and meeting their expectations. If the owner and staff were committed to doing so, there would not be any negative reviews. Sadly, this proves that they either lack the care or the skills to deliver satisfactory results. It appears that there are other negative reviews from dissatisfied customers at this salon, and the owner attempts to bribe people into removing their negative feedback. However, the purpose of reviews is to inform others about their experiences—both positive and negative. I personally provide reviews to offer honest insight. If negative reviews are damaging the owner's business, it is solely their responsibility and the fault of their employees, not mine or anyone else's.

input:
I am so glad we had our wedding here!!! I cannot say enough what a pleasure it was to work with Breanna, the venue manager and Eli, the food and beverage director. Our wedding here was a destination wedding, so we were very concerned about making sure all of our family and friends that travelled a long way to get to our wedding had a good time. Being a couple straight out of grad school, we were also very concerned with keeping the cost manageable. Everything worked out on all accounts! 

We first picked the venue for two reasons: the price was right and the venue is GORGEOUS. The pricing was very straightforward, which we really appreciated, and when looking at other options in the Santa Barbara area, the Riviera mansion was pretty comparable with other venues which are not all inclusive (ones where you have to find your own caterer, rent linens, etc etc). Planning a wedding without a coordinator and from across the country, it was also definitely worth it for us to go with a venue that minimized the amount of details we would have to think about.

The looks and layout of the place are what sold us though. With people coming from the east coast and middle of the country, we wanted something that would really showcase Santa Barbara's cool architecture and vibe. The mansion is exactly that.  The layout is also pretty perfect for a multigenerational wedding. We were able to enjoy the California weather for our ceremony and cocktail hour outside, then go inside for dinner, avoiding the cooler night air. Later, we could turn up the party in the bar/dance floor area, while the older folks talked and relaxed on the couches in the living room. It really has something for everyone.

What I didn't realize when we picked it was how absolutely awesome all the staff would be to work with. Breanna was super helpful, answering all my questions promptly and pleasantly, and accommodating my sometimes short notice visits to the area. When we did our walkthrough a couple of days before the wedding, Breanna and Eli paid attention to every detail and made sure we were taken care of, as they did the day of the wedding too. Eli was incredibly attentive and easy to work with! My dad is in the restaurant industry and was in charge of setting up desserts (we had family make some traditional desserts, as well as got some cupcakes from Enjoy Cupcakes- also a great idea!). Eli worked with him to get whatever he needed, risers, tablecloths, etc and was really sweet about it. 

The attention to bartending at the Riviera Mansion deserves a paragraph of its own. Breanna worked with me and the bartender (who's name I forget but has worked there for 20 years and is also incredibly awesome) to create a peach moscow mule as our signature drink (our colors were peach and green) and get it to taste just right. She even arranged it so we had fresh peaches! At the wedding, everyone raved about them, even guests who usually prefer something more manly sounding. The staff had all drinks ready to go for our cocktail hour, and also passed trays of drinks, so there was never a line at the bar (something guests also specifically mentioned that they appreciated). Hell, Eli even followed me with my drink for a couple of minutes around dinner since my hands were full of other things! Really spectacular and attentive service.

Five stars all around. It was absolutely a joy to have our wedding here.

input:
Yeah, I know what you're thinking. One Wawa store is pretty much the same as another, so why even bother writing a review? But I think we have a winner here.

When this Wawa store opened for business, gas prices at gas stations all along Concord Pike fell by 30 cents per gallon just to compete with them. Sure, this Wawa store could've followed the general pricing in the area and lowered prices just a few cents, keeping the bulk of the profit. But no, they'll have none of that. I love a store that is on the side of my wallet!

Secondly, I love the automatic start/stop digital air pump. So far, I've only seen that at BJ's Wholesale and Sheetz. It's a snap to use and I get the exact tire pressure every time.

As for service, they seem nice and relatively efficient. The internal layout of the store is the new style that I first saw in Newark. Having separate non-cigarette cashier lines may speed things up in peak periods, although I've never been there during the day, so I wouldn't know.
Refine this for me please:
I understand your skepticism, but trust me, this Wawa store is worth reviewing.

When they opened, gas prices at nearby stations dropped by a staggering 30 cents per gallon just to compete. Instead of making a small reduction, they went all out to benefit their customers. It's refreshing to see a store that genuinely cares about my wallet.

One standout feature is their automatic start/stop digital air pump. I've only come across this convenient feature at BJ's Wholesale and Sheetz. It's incredibly easy to use, and I always get the precise tire pressure I need.

In terms of service, the staff is friendly and quite efficient. The store's layout follows the new style I first encountered in Newark. They have separate cashier lines for non-cigarette purchases, which could help speed up transactions during busy hours. Though I can't personally vouch for daytime service, it seems like a smart approach to handle peak periods.

input: Mediocre food. very slow service , our food came one by one Within 10 to 15 minutes of each other. Rude servers and took us a long time to get our bills with lots of mistakes. Overall very bad experience

The servers displayed rude attitudes, and it took an excessive amount of time to receive our bills, which were riddled with numerous mistakes. input:
For a seafood restaurant at the edge of pear expectations should be set high. My wife and I have come here 3 times now and ordered different plates off the menu each time. This last time we ordered cioppino, clam chowder, and a crab salad sandwich;
*Good - clam chowder (excellent flavor and consistency) would order again.
*Not great - cioppino (lacked flavor & a variety of sea food/lack there of) would not order again
*Pass - crab salad sandwich (lacked flavor, mayo was overpowering, crab flavor was almost non-existent, side of onion rings too greasy) - would not order again 
The overall experience is okay, better if seated outside right on the pear overlooking the ocean, inside is very small. Service is good but be prepared to wait a bit to be seated. 
Is it worth a visit? Yes, but be selective of what you order as the menu tends to be a hit and miss.
Refine this for me please:
For a seafood restaurant located at the edge of a pier, it is important to have high expectations. My wife and I have dined at this establishment on three separate occasions, trying different dishes each time. During our last visit, we ordered cioppino, clam chowder, and a crab salad sandwich.

One standout was the clam chowder, which had an excellent flavor and a perfect consistency. We were thoroughly satisfied with it and would definitely order it again.

On the other hand, the cioppino was a disappointment. It lacked flavor and did not offer a sufficient variety of seafood. Due to these shortcomings, we would not consider ordering it in the future.

Similarly, the crab salad sandwich was disappointing as well. The lack of flavor, overpowering mayo, and almost non-existent crab flavor made it less enjoyable. Additionally, the side of onion rings was excessively greasy. We would not recommend ordering this dish again.

The overall experience at the restaurant was just okay. The ambiance is better if you choose to sit outside, enjoying the view of the ocean from the pier. The indoor seating area is quite small. The service provided was good, although there may be some waiting time before being seated.

In conclusion, a visit to this seafood restaurant is worthwhile, but it is important to be selective in choosing your order as the menu has its hits and misses.

input: We went there with several family members and had a good afternoon. The staff was friendly and helpful. It was a fun activity!
Refine this for me please: Several family members and I had a delightful afternoon visiting the place. The staff, who were extremely friendly and helpful, contributed to our enjoyable experience. Overall, it was a fun-filled activity that we thoroughly enjoyed.

input: Chef Kevin Sbraga knows fried chicken. My first exposure to his succulent birds was the hot chicken at The Fat Ham. Lo and behold, his lavender honey fried chicken tops its spicy cousin. The chicken is brined in buttermilk, dredged in seasoned flour and sits for ten minutes. It's then coated with a second round of flour and dropped into the fryer. The chicken (breast, wing, thigh, drumstick) is drizzled with lavender honey and sprinkled with salt and ground pink peppercorns. It comes with a buttermilk biscuit, whipped honey-thyme butter, and red bliss potato salad. It is some of the best fried chicken I've eaten in a long time. Crunchy, crispy coating on the outside with a juicy, moist inside. The sweet honey glaze is truly outstanding and finger lickin' good. The biscuit is awesome. I would definitely order this dish again and again. I got the salty but delicious fried smelts with chili pepper aioli as an appetizer. My friend Chris W got the filet mignon and butter poached king crab surf and turf. For dessert, I had a slice of salted pecan pie and he had the ice cream sundae. Every dish at Juniper Commons was top-notch. Chef Sbraga does it again!
Refine this for me please: Chef Kevin Sbraga is renowned for his expertise in fried chicken, and my first encounter with his delectable birds was at The Fat Ham where I tried their hot chicken. However, I was pleasantly surprised to discover that his lavender honey fried chicken surpasses its spicy counterpart. The preparation involves brining the chicken in buttermilk, coating it in seasoned flour, then allowing it to rest for ten minutes. Afterwards, it undergoes a second round of flour coating before being immersed in the fryer. The chicken, consisting of breast, wing, thigh, and drumstick, is then drizzled with lavender honey, sprinkled with salt and ground pink peppercorns. The dish is accompanied by a buttermilk biscuit, whipped honey-thyme butter, and red bliss potato salad. Undoubtedly, this fried chicken stands out as some of the finest I've had in a long time, boasting a crispy and crunchy exterior along with a juicy, moist inside. The remarkable honey glaze adds a delightful sweetness that is absolutely irresistible. Additionally, the biscuit is a real standout, leaving a lasting impression. I would unquestionably order this dish repeatedly. As an appetizer, I also tried the fried smelts with chili pepper aioli, which were salty but delicious. Meanwhile, my friend Chris W opted for the filet mignon and butter poached king crab surf and turf. For dessert, I savored a slice of salted pecan pie while he indulged in the ice cream sundae. Every single dish at Juniper Commons exceeded expectations, solidifying Chef Sbraga's skill and mastery once again.

input:
I really wanted to like Casselli's, but it wasn't in the cards. Maybe I just caught them on a bad night, but I didn't really enjoy much about my visit. The waiter was very unpleasant - was banging down the plates and glasses on the table when he delivered them. Maybe he was having a bad day, but I still would have expected better. 

We had mixed experiences with the food. Mine and our friends' was OK, but my wife's baked ravioli would have been more use to a hockey team for use as pucks. They were really overdone - woefully overdone. 

The worst part was that our table was next to the opera singer guy. He was singing extremely loudly and it was nigh impossible to maintain a conversation - especially coupled with how close we were to the table next to us and their attempts to speak over Opera Guy.

Part of me wants to give them another chance (since I hate writing bad reviews) and the other part is annoyed over the waiter's attitude. I probably will not go back. There are so many good Italian restaurants worth visiting that the opportunity cost of returning to Casselli's seems too high.

On the upside, they have somewhat convenient parking in the lot behind the restaurant (near the Shawmont School).

Note: cash-only.
Refine this for me please:
I had high hopes for Casselli's, but unfortunately, it didn't meet my expectations. It's possible that I caught them on an off night, but overall, I didn't enjoy my experience. The waiter left much to be desired, as he aggressively placed the plates and glasses on the table. Even if he was having a bad day, I still expected better service.

The food was a mixed bag. My friends and I found our meals to be decent, but my wife's baked ravioli was terribly overcooked. They were practically unfit for consumption; they were so overdone.

The most frustrating part of our evening was being seated next to the opera singer. His volume was extremely loud, making it nearly impossible to hold a conversation. As if that wasn't enough, the neighboring table also had to raise their voices to be heard over the opera guy.

I'm torn between giving Casselli's another chance (because I hate leaving negative reviews) and being frustrated with the waiter's attitude. However, I highly doubt I'll give them another shot. There are plenty of fantastic Italian restaurants out there that are worth a visit, so the opportunity cost of going back to Casselli's just seems too high.

On a positive note, they do offer convenient parking in the lot behind the restaurant, near the Shawmont School.

Please keep in mind that Casselli's only accepts cash.

input:
My wife bought a car here.  I handled the negotiations.  

Our salesman was friendly and helpful.  Once the negotiations began however, our salesman left the picture and we were left to deal with the manager.  This experience was annoying.  I had done my research and shopped around.  The manager must not be accustomed to dealing with informed shoppers because he was obviously lying to me on a number of fronts.  Had my wife not needed the car immediately - and wanted a color that was only available this dealer - I would have moved on to another dealership.  

My advice would be that if you have to come here be armed with knowledge and info on pricing from other dealers but in general I would probably buy from a different dealer if I had to do it over.
Refine this for me please:
I handled the negotiations when my wife bought a car at this dealership. Initially, our salesman was friendly and helpful. However, once we started negotiating, the salesman stepped back and we had to deal with the manager. Unfortunately, this experience was frustrating. Despite my thorough research and shopping around, it seemed like the manager was not used to dealing with well-informed shoppers. He made several obvious lies during our discussion. If my wife did not urgently need a car and specifically wanted a color only available at this dealership, I would have chosen a different dealership.

My recommendation would be that if you decide to visit this dealership, make sure to come prepared with knowledge and pricing information from other dealers. However, if given the opportunity to start over, I would most likely buy from a different dealer.

input:

input: I've used Merrigans several times for work on both a 2012 RV and a vintage 1984 Dolphin. Definitely the place in Tucson where you won't get ripped off for work on your RV. If you want it done right and still have money left in your travel fund, go to Merrigans. Refine this for me please: Merrigans has been my go-to for both my 2012 RV and vintage 1984 Dolphin, and while their phone response and callback can be improved, their ability to efficiently fix any issue at a reasonable price is unmatched. Patience pays off when it comes to experiencing their top-notch repairs and fair pricing. As a genuine mom and pop shop, they boast an impressive assortment of parts for older RVs and possess the necessary expertise to fix any problem. Rest assured, Merrigans is the trustworthy place in Tucson where you won't be taken advantage of for RV repairs. When you want the job done right without draining your travel fund, look no further than Merrigans. Additionally, they provide a complimentary 24-hour dump station with water.

input:
Amazing food!! and  the whole experience is great there every time. I suggest going there with a  group of about 6 people so it doesn't totally break the bank but if you've got the money then who cares! Have fun!

First you enter in and select the wine you would like. The staff is helpful and knowledgeable about their stock. (And if for some reason at the end you didn't  finish your bottle they will cork it back up for you to take.) Then select your cheese platter. Lots of yummy stinky cheese to select  from and prosciutto. I wish they had more cured meats but it's all yummy anyway. You pay for the wine and cheese there. Which in a large group one or two people can take care of this  part. 

Then going to get a seat can be difficult but just be patient. There's outdoor seating that's very nice and always a live band playing. Inside upstairs is nice as well. Once you're all set with your wine and group it's time to order. Go to the window and play your order. Definite things you must get.... the bacon wrapped dates stuffed with chorizo and the goat cheese and mushroom dish....AMAZING! Although everything I've ever had here is great. 

Then just wait for your cheese platter, food and enjoy!
Refine this for me please:
The dining experience at this place is consistently outstanding, with incredible food and a great overall ambiance. I recommend visiting with a group of around 6 people to keep costs reasonable, but if budget is not a concern, go ahead and splurge! It's guaranteed to be a fun time.

Upon entry, you will be greeted with a wide selection of wines to choose from. The staff is knowledgeable and eager to assist you in finding the perfect bottle. What sets them apart is their willingness to cork and pack up any unfinished wine for you to take home. 

Next, make sure to try their delicious cheese platter. While the variety of cured meats could be improved, the assortment of stinky cheese and prosciutto is still mouthwatering. You can conveniently pay for the wine and cheese at the counter, making it easy for one or two people in a large group to handle this task.

Finding a seating arrangement can be challenging, but just be patient and you'll eventually secure a spot. The outdoor seating area is particularly pleasant, complemented by live music performances. If you prefer, the upstairs seating area inside is also quite nice. Once settled with your wine and group, it's time to place your food order. Head to the window and let them know your choices. Two standout dishes that you absolutely must try are the bacon wrapped dates stuffed with chorizo and the goat cheese and mushroom dish. However, I must emphasize that everything I've ever tried here is fantastic.

Now all that's left to do is wait for your cheese platter and food to arrive, and thoroughly enjoy your meal.

input: Came to see my son's band Last Frontier. The staff and food here is top notch!   Had the porkbelly and fish nachos.  Awesome.  Great selection of whisky. Great sound system for the band.
Refine this for me please: I came to see my son's band, Last Frontier, and I must say the overall experience was fantastic. The staff truly impressed me with their outstanding service, and the quality of the food exceeded my expectations. I had the pleasure of trying the pork belly and fish nachos, and they were absolutely amazing. Additionally, the establishment boasted an impressive selection of whisky, which was a delightful surprise. Furthermore, the sound system utilized for the band was top-notch, contributing to an enjoyable and immersive musical experience.

input: I have never had any issues with this place and we have been here many times. Not only do they sale paint but also everything that you need to get the job done. Everyone is extremely friendly and helpful. Refine this for me please: I have never encountered any issues with this place, despite having visited it multiple times. It stands out to me as one of the few paint stores I have ever been to, apart from places like Home Depot or Lowes. In terms of paint stores, it holds a high position on my list. Not only do they offer a wide range of paint options, but they also provide all the necessary items to complete a painting project. The staff members are exceptionally friendly and helpful. Additionally, they maintain a record of your paint details so that you don't have to remember them when making future purchases. Personally, I usually take advantage of their paint sales, particularly the 30% off promotion. During these sales, we purchase their interior Super Paint, which is included in the deal.

input: The food was great, the service excellent.  Had dinner outside on the deck, saw lots of dolphins.  Will come back for sure.
Refine this for me please: The food was absolutely fantastic, and the service was exceptional. input:
I find it hugely ironic that WF is trying to reposition itself as a 'value' food store right now when others (i.e. Trader Joe's up the street) have been doing that for years.  For value, go elsewhere.  For pretty food, lovely store displays and a feeling of smugness, check out Whole Foods.

Despite my snark, I have to admit that it's nice to see an enormous, clean and well stocked yuppie market in Reno finally.  Now that this town has been rated by National Geographic as a top outdoors place to live in, it needs the retail to support that (and I don't mean another REI).  For myself, I'm too cheap to look seriously at this place for my regular shopping needs, but for lunch and the odd stopover, it's awesome.   Beautiful produce, drool inducing cheese selections and a bakery that would break my budget if I bought everything that struck my fancy.

Plus it's proximity to the freeway (for those of us who do our shopping based on distance from the 395 or 80) makes it an ideal stop to/from the airport.
Refine this for me please:
I find it rather ironic that Whole Foods is now trying to position itself as a "value" food store, considering that other stores like Trader Joe's have already been successfully doing that for years. If you're looking for value, I would suggest going elsewhere. However, Whole Foods does excel in offering aesthetically pleasing food displays, a sense of smugness, and a wide variety of beautiful food options.

Putting my snark aside, I must acknowledge that it is refreshing to finally have a large, clean, and well-stocked upscale market like Whole Foods in Reno. With the city being recognized as a top destination for outdoor enthusiasts by National Geographic, it is essential to have the necessary retail support (and not just another REI). Personally, I find the prices at Whole Foods a bit steep for my regular shopping needs, but it is an incredible place to grab lunch or make an occasional stopover. The produce is exquisite, the cheese selection is mouthwatering, and the bakery alone could easily exceed my budget if I indulged in everything that caught my eye.

Moreover, the store's convenient location near the freeway (perfect for those of us who base our shopping decisions on proximity to the 395 or 80) makes it an ideal stop before or after a trip to the airport.

input: Great service and awesome food!!!! We go here all the time. Each time it is excellent! Very very Stellar
Refine this for me please: The service is exceptional, and the food is truly incredible! We are regular patrons here and are always impressed. The experience is consistently superb, without a doubt.

input:
Monthly lunch with my fellow colleagues the other day and the person assigned to get lunch ordered from Fresh and had it delivered. 

My selection was the Chopped Italian salad. The salad consists of mixed greens, salami, smoked turkey, tomato, garbanzo beans and parmesan cheese served with the house vinaigrette. The salad was lacking for me. I think such a salad would be so much better with a few more Italian-esque ingredients in it, perhaps a little more anitpasto like. I know, it's not advertised as antipasto but c'mon....this salad was boring.  Throw in a couple of olives, some artichoke hearts, some sliced pepperoncinis. Maybe my tastebuds were having an off day but the salami wasn't very flavorful either. Charge a couple dollars more for a more inventive salad. Please!

I do want to give them another chance since so many reviews on here are glowing. Maybe I need to stick with a panini or something but I really do love salads for summer lunches.
Refine this for me please: During our monthly lunch with colleagues, we ordered from Fresh and had our food delivered. I chose the Chopped Italian salad which consisted of mixed greens, salami, smoked turkey, tomato, garbanzo beans, and parmesan cheese served with the house vinaigrette. However, I found the salad underwhelming. In my opinion, it would have been much better with additional Italian-esque ingredients, such as olives, artichoke hearts, and sliced pepperoncinis. The lack of flavor in the salami was disappointing as well. I believe that for a slightly higher price, a more inventive salad could be offered. Although I am willing to give them another chance, considering the positive reviews, I might opt for a panini or explore other options instead. Nonetheless, I do enjoy salads for summer lunches.

input: Tyson is on point, sharp and follows through on his word. I brought an RV with a ford front end to him not only did he get me in right away but he finished ahead of time. Rest assured, they are the only experts I entrust my vehicles to.

input: We sat at a pretty hectic lunch at Johnny rockets in the casino. Our server was Lyndel! She was awesome! Helped us at every needy request lol... Good was good, too! I'm too full

input: This place is fantastic. The food is exceptional and the service couldn't be better. Very nice and generous people with a cool atmosphere. I eat here almost every weekend. Can't beat the Cuban espresso!

input:
Great pizza!  The owner Pete is usually there and he's a great guy.  They have lots of fantastic pizzas, but my favorites are the California (white pizza with pieces of breaded chicken cutlet, bacon, and tomatos, and ranch dressing instead of red sauce), Meatlovers (5 meats, but the sausage is the kind that does not have fennel in it, so more points for that), Veggie pizza (they saute the veggies first before they go on the pizza, and instead of using green peppers, they use sweet peppers).  

Unfortunately, the shop was damaged by a fire in the next door laundry mat and they've been closed for a few weeks, but I can't wait for their doors to open again soon. I miss the lunch special, 2 slices and a self serve soda for $3.99.   Best local pizza you'll find in the Hatboro area.
Refine this for me please:
Refined: Amazing pizza! I love going to this place because the owner, Pete, is always there and he's such a wonderful person. They serve a wide variety of incredible pizzas, but my personal favorites are the California (a white pizza with breaded chicken cutlet, bacon, tomatoes, and ranch dressing in place of the traditional red sauce), the Meatlovers (a pizza loaded with five different meats, and the sausage they use doesn't have fennel which adds to its appeal), and the Veggie pizza (the veggies are sautéed beforehand, and they swap out green peppers for sweet peppers which give it a unique touch).

Unfortunately, they faced some unfortunate fire damage from the neighboring laundry mat and had to close down for a few weeks. I'm eagerly waiting for their doors to reopen because I'm really missing their lunch special which was a steal - two slices of pizza accompanied by a self-serve soda for only $3.99. Trust me, if you're in the Hatboro area, this is definitely the best local pizza joint you'll come across.

input: Buffalo chicken cheese dip is amazing.  Friendly wait staff and prices are reasonable.

input:

input: Came here for my 21st birthday dinner with my family and had a great experience! The food and drinks were to die for, but they were extremely overpriced. Even though the quality of food was good, I still don't think it was worth what we paid for. I recommend getting the lobster mac and cheese as an appetizer, it was probably the best mac and cheese I've ever eaten. At the end of the meal, they gave us some small complimentary desserts, even though we ordered a bunch of desserts to top off our meal. Had a great time, but definitely overpriced.
Refine this for me please: I celebrated my 21st birthday dinner at this restaurant with my family and overall, it was a wonderful experience. The food and drinks were absolutely delicious, although I must admit they were quite pricey. While the quality of the food was excellent, in my opinion, it didn't justify the high prices. However, I highly recommend trying their lobster mac and cheese as an appetizer - it was hands down the best mac and cheese I've ever tasted. Additionally, despite ordering several desserts, we were pleasantly surprised to receive some complimentary small desserts at the end of our meal. We had a fantastic time, but the pricing was undeniably on the expensive side.

input:

I love the open kitchen. 

Great beer selection.

The ambiance is exceptional, striking the perfect balance between being suitable for a romantic date or a gathering of beer enthusiasts watching sports.

Additionally, their beer selection is excellent, offering a wide variety of options to choose from.

Personally, I will definitely be returning for their delectable rosemary fries, and my fiancée is equally eager to indulge in their incredibly satisfying house burger.

input:
If you are going for the food, I would give it 5 stars, but since this is a brewhouse, I only gave it 3. 

I ordered the light flight since we went for lunch and I wasn't looking for a heavy meal. The beer was OK at best. It was bland, a little strange in after taste and uninspired. Light beers dont have to equal tasteless. My boyfriend had a "hoppy beer with citrus undertones". He could taste neither the hops or the citrus  (disclaimer - we are from VT and are used to very hoppy beers!)  

Now the food - that was great. We went at lunch time and was able to get a soup and salad for 8.95. We both had the same thing - Chicken Bruchetta salad and French Onion Soup. The portion was fantastic for a lunch size and the soup really flavorful! 

For a lunch downtown it was great, but I would go for the brews...
Refine this for me please:
If you're primarily interested in the food, I would rate this place 5 stars. However, since it is a brewhouse, I can only give it 3 stars. 

During our visit for lunch, I opted for the light flight as I wasn't looking for a heavy meal. Unfortunately, the beer was only mediocre at best. It lacked flavor, had a slightly peculiar aftertaste, and seemed uninspired. It's worth noting that light beers don't necessarily have to be tasteless. My boyfriend ordered a "hoppy beer with citrus undertones," but couldn't detect any hint of hops or citrus in it (though it's important to mention that we come from Vermont, where we're accustomed to very hoppy beers!). 

However, the highlight of our experience was undoubtedly the food. We visited during lunchtime and were pleased to find a soup and salad combo priced at $8.95. Both of us ordered the Chicken Bruchetta salad and French Onion Soup, which were nothing short of excellent. The serving size for a lunch portion was generous, and the soup was bursting with flavors. 

Overall, if you're looking for a great lunch spot in downtown, this place is fantastic. However, if you're primarily interested in the quality of the brews, it may not be the best choice.

input:
This place just opened up near rivers edge apartments. It's a boutique style taqueria with a menu that anyone can enjoy. The head chef was nominated for a James Beard Award and it shows in his flavorful and diverse menu choices! The restaurant has both an outdoor and indoor setting with double doors that allow access to both, with a bar around the corner. 

I personally have tried every taco on the menu as well as the appetizers! Each taco uses fresh local ingredients with an option for vegetarians and meat eaters like myself. My two favorites are the mushroom taco and the short rib taco, both have unique and fantastic flavors. But I would recommend trying them all, you will not be disappointed! Overall a great place for lunch or dinner! I will definitely be going back soon!
Refine this for me please:
There's a new boutique style taqueria near rivers edge apartments that recently opened. This place offers a diverse and flavorful menu that appeals to everyone. The head chef, who was nominated for a James Beard Award, has curated an outstanding selection of dishes.

The taqueria provides both indoor and outdoor seating options, with double doors that connect the two areas. Additionally, there is a convenient bar located around the corner.

Personally, I have had the pleasure of sampling every taco on the menu, along with the appetizers. Each taco is carefully crafted using fresh, locally sourced ingredients. There is something for everyone, including both vegetarians and meat lovers like myself. Out of all the options, I highly recommend trying the mushroom taco and the short rib taco, as they both offer unique and incredible flavors.

In conclusion, this taqueria is an excellent choice for either lunch or dinner. I am already looking forward to my next visit.

input: Originally, our little group headed to Franklin Fountain and the line was around the block-- Capofitto was only a few steps away with no line (and bonus--cheaper/better dessert treat!). Although we only stopped by for some gelato, the pizza at Capofitto looked and smelled incredibly delicious. The gelato we had was exceptional, as expected from Capogiro Gelato. I highly recommend trying the combination of their "Chocolat Scurio" and "Pera" flavors - it was absolutely perfect. I can't wait to go back and try their pizzas soon!

input: This hospital is by far the best for families on the East Coast. They make seeing multiple MDs on the same day very easy and the quality of care is incredible. input: I highly recommend this place! This was our first "Chef Tasting"! It was exquisite!! We had 9 courses and all were truly delicious. Wine was amazing. If you are in Philly, I highly recommend Vetri.

input:

input: Don't go here. They gave me grief over the groupon then didn't bother to actually change my oil filter or tell me that they hadn't changed it so I drove 5k miles on an old filter. Crappy customer service, rude attitude, find somewhere better.

input: I attended the #welldoneTBO tweet-up at Anthony's Coal Fired Pizza last week and had a great time. The folks at Anthony's were amazing with the customer service. We got to try so many menu items, and all were amazing. The Philly Cheesesteak Pizza was my 10 year old's favorite. I loved the Cauliflower pizza...so buttery and garlicky and delicious (vegetarian). We also got to try the carmelized onion-smothered wings which were out of this world. Also tasted: meatballs, ribs, salad...all very good. We ordered off the menu a half and half pizza with pepperoni, sausage and mushrooms. So good. If they had liquor on the menu I would have given them five stars (I'm just not a beer or wine person). Thanks for a great evening Anthony's! We'll be back.
Refine this for me please: I recently attended the amazing #welldoneTBO tweet-up at Anthony's Coal Fired Pizza last week and had an incredible time. The team at Anthony's provided exceptional customer service throughout the event. We had the opportunity to taste an array of menu items, and each one was outstanding. Personally, my 10-year-old adored the Philly Cheesesteak Pizza, while I couldn't resist the delectable Cauliflower pizza which was incredibly buttery, garlicky, and perfect for a vegetarian like myself. Additionally, we indulged in the mouthwatering caramelized onion-smothered wings and also enjoyed the meatballs, ribs, and salad- all of which were very delicious. One of the highlights was a custom half and half pizza with pepperoni, sausage, and mushrooms, which was absolutely delectable. The only thing that would have made the experience even better would have been the inclusion of liquor options on the menu, as I'm not particularly fond of beer or wine. Despite that minor preference, I would enthusiastically give Anthony's five stars. Thank you, Anthony's, for an incredible evening - we can't wait to return.

input: Awesome service and food.  Served with a dry ice fog thing that add a layer of coolness to the whole experience.
Refine this for me please: Absolutely exceptional service and exquisite food. The addition of a mesmerizing dry ice fog creates an enchanting ambiance, elevating the entire dining experience to a new level of coolness and delight.

input: Come here for delicious, home style New Orleans cuisine. We went in the afternoon, and although it was full, we were lucky and a table was ready right away. We did the a la carte as opposed to the buffet. It was our favorite meal of the trip!
Refine this for me please: Indulge in mouthwatering home style New Orleans cuisine at this delightful establishment. Despite visiting in the afternoon when the restaurant was bustling, we had the fortune of being seated immediately. Opting for the a la carte menu instead of the buffet, we were treated to a sensational dining experience, surpassing all other meals during our trip.

input: A great restaurant to take people visiting from out of town. Very popular for breakfast/brunch on the weekends. Refine this for me please: "The ideal choice for hosting out-of-town guests, this restaurant is immensely popular for its delightful breakfast and brunch options, especially on weekends. It's worth noting that any time after 9:30 AM, expect a waiting time of at least an hour, although the excellent menu selection and scrumptious dishes make it well worth it. The service may take a little while, but fear not, as the establishment boasts a wonderful bakery, coffee, and gelato counter that swiftly caters to your needs.
