Food: 5/5
Service: 5/5
Price: 4/5 - A little high but the quality is exceptional.

input:
Tasty selection and very preppy! 

One cannot go wrong with the What's Up Doc omelet. One complaint with the omelets is the actual size, they seem to fluctuate. Clearly a difference in 4-5 extra bits worth of omelet. 

If you have a sweet tooth, any of french toasts are great! Fancy Breakfast Sandwich is great! I substituted the prosciutto with bacon and got great results! Great mimosas!
Refine this for me please:
Delicious variety and wonderfully upscale! You can never go wrong with the flavorful What's Up Doc omelet. The only slight drawback is that the portion sizes of the omelets can vary, occasionally lacking consistency in 4-5 additional bites of omelet.

For those with a sweet tooth, the French toasts are absolutely delightful! The Fancy Breakfast Sandwich is also a fantastic choice. Personally, I opted for bacon instead of prosciutto and was incredibly pleased with the outcome. Additionally, their mimosas are exceptional!

input: Great store if you like 50's-Midcentury modern! The prices are a little high compared to my favorite stores in STL, but this store is one of a kind thats for sure!
Refine this for me please: This store is a must-visit if you have a penchant for 50's-Midcentury modern style. While the prices may be slightly higher than my preferred stores in STL, it's undoubtedly a unique shopping experience that stands out from the rest.

input: STAY AWAY! I am a gold member, so I stay at Hamptons frequently. I have stayed here before, and it seems to be under constant construction. My room was dirty. I came back to give them another chance as it is close to my appointments. I show up for a four night stay, and they send me away because they are booked, but tell me I can come back tomorrow night. Seriously? I couldn't believe that. I wont be back.
Refine this for me please:
Please note that the revised response contains modified content.

WARNING: DO NOT STAY HERE! As a loyal gold member who frequently stays at Hamptons, I have been very disappointed with my recent experiences. Despite staying here before, it appears that the hotel is consistently undergoing construction, which is quite inconvenient. On top of that, my room was disgustingly dirty during my last visit. Hoping for an improvement, I decided to give them another chance since it's conveniently located near my appointments. However, upon arriving for my planned four-night stay, they turned me away, claiming to be fully booked, and suggested I return the following night. I was utterly flabbergasted by their lack of consideration. Needless to say, I will never be returning to this hotel and will be seeking alternative accommodations.

input: The best fried rice ever! Also the best Pho I had while in Nashville. I'm from Seattle so I'm a little spoiled in that department. If you're looking for a good place to try it for the first time or just looking for a good Vietnamese restaurant, GO!
Refine this for me please: Experience the ultimate culinary delight with the best fried rice you'll ever taste! Furthermore, indulge in the most exceptional Pho I've come across during my time in Nashville. As a Seattle native, accustomed to exceptional Vietnamese cuisine, I can affirm this restaurant surpasses expectations. Whether you're a first-time enthusiast or simply seeking a remarkable Vietnamese dining experience, this is the place to be!

input: Walked here from our condo and found this awesome place! Delicious sliders...donuts...unique drinks... Awesome atmosphere and the staff was sooooooo friendly! Will definitely be back!!!!!
Refine this for me please: I walked here from our condo and discovered this incredible place! They serve delicious sliders, mouth-watering donuts, and offer a variety of unique drinks. The atmosphere is absolutely amazing, and the staff members were extremely friendly and attentive. I can't wait to return to this fantastic spot!

input: As far as I know, this is the best video rental store in existence.  The staff is knowledgeable and friendly, but the selection really sets it apart.  Suppose you want to rent the newest release and a VHS of the best hockey fights of the 1970s...They would probably have both available at a very low cost.  I only wish that there was a place like Casa Video in Chicago.
Refine this for me please: As far as I'm aware, Casa Video stands out as the ultimate video rental store. The staff impresses with their expertise and welcoming attitude, while the exceptional selection truly sets it apart. Whether you're looking for the latest releases or a VHS featuring the most thrilling hockey fights from the 1970s, you can count on Casa Video to have both options available at incredibly affordable prices. I only find myself longing for a similar establishment like Casa Video in Chicago.

input:
That horrible angst - you want sushi, but you're not SO hungry that you can do AYCE or want to spend $25 for lunch. So we popped in on a weekend for a late lunch and decided to order a la carte.  I ordered a long roll and a hand roll, a drink and a chocolate mochi (OMG, I am officially in love with these things) and the total cost came to just under $20 with tip.  It filled my belly enough so that I was satisfied.  Had I gone for just one more roll, I probably would have broke even with the AYCE, but I probably would've been so stuffed to the point where I wouldn't have needed to eat anything else all day - not the plan for this particular day.

The rolls tasted fresh and delicious, but the surprise was definitely the mochi - so creamy and tasty.
Refine this for me please: That dreadful feeling of craving sushi, but not wanting to spend too much or overeat – it's a tough spot to be in. So, we decided to visit a sushi restaurant for a late lunch on a weekend and opted for ordering individual items instead of all-you-can-eat. My order consisted of a long roll, a hand roll, a drink, and a chocolate mochi (which I must say, I am absolutely smitten with). The bill, including tip, came in at just below $20. This satisfying meal filled me up just the right amount. If I had ordered one more roll, I might have broken even with the all-you-can-eat option, but then I would have been uncomfortably stuffed for the rest of the day – not what I had in mind. The rolls were fresh and flavorful, as expected, but the real surprise was the mochi – it was incredibly creamy and delicious.

input: Not too sure why all the negative reviews. I was in and out within 5 mins. Maybe it was because I wasn't looking for something elaborate, who knows. Anyways, I got exactly what I needed and the employees were courteous. The store was organized, well stocked and clean. Unfortunately for this area however, I don't see them staying in business. So many other places near by closed.
Refine this for me please: I'm not entirely sure why there are so many negative reviews, but personally, I had a great experience. Despite not having a complex shopping requirement, I found exactly what I needed and the staff were polite. The store was well-organized, had sufficient stock, and was kept clean. However, it is unfortunate to see that many neighboring establishments have closed down, which makes me doubtful about their long-term success in this area.

input: Best Pizza period. Love the staff and the beer is always cold and the taps are always maintained. If you want fresh beer and a slice it's only 5 bucks.
Refine this for me please: Best Pizza, the absolute best. The staff is incredibly friendly and the beer is always served cold, with the taps impeccably maintained. Plus, for a mere 5 dollars, you can indulge in a refreshing slice of pizza accompanied by a fresh pint of beer.

input:
All of hype about Federal Donuts made me a little worried it wouldn't live up to it's reputation. But, it absolutely did. I'm a vegetarian so I can only personally comment on the donuts and coffee; however, my husband is obsessed with the chicken. His favorite is the buttermilk ranch.

The donuts are pretty amazing. Paired with an iced coffee and it doesn't get any better. The staff couldn't be nicer- even when they're busy.
Refine this for me please:
Despite initially being worried that Federal Donuts wouldn't live up to its hype, it completely exceeded my expectations. As a vegetarian, I can only provide personal feedback on the donuts and coffee, which were truly impressive. On the other hand, my husband, who is a chicken lover, is absolutely obsessed with their chicken. His top pick is the buttermilk ranch option.

The donuts themselves are undeniably excellent, especially when paired with an iced coffee. Additionally, the staff at Federal Donuts always maintains an exceptional level of friendliness, even during peak hours.

input:
Three chances and they are out! We tried to like this place as the location is easy and convenient. The bar is great, the staff friendly, but there is not a dish I have tried that is passable (although the asian shrimp wasn't bad, but very sweet). First visit we wrote off as a new restaurant working out the bugs. On our second visit I ordered a turkey burger and received a dry turkey patty. No one informed me that they were out of buns, but they could have at least tried to dress it up. It was seriously a lone piece of ground meat (to their credit, the manager did comp that meal). Today we received fish and chips that had to come out of a box and chicken salad that could have greased my axles!

We won't be back.
Refine this for me please: We gave this place three chances, but unfortunately, they couldn't meet our expectations. Despite its convenient location and great bar atmosphere, none of the dishes we tried were satisfactory, except maybe the asian shrimp which was overly sweet. At first, we thought the restaurant was still adjusting, so we overlooked the issues during our initial visit. However, on our second visit, I ordered a turkey burger and received a dry patty without any buns. They made no effort to make it presentable. The only positive aspect was that the manager comped the meal. Today, we received fish and chips that seemed to come from a box, and the chicken salad was extremely greasy. Based on our experiences, we have decided not to return.

input:
I could say that this is a touch of Italy in a strip mall, but even I recognize that is a little too precious. Stepping into the dark, cool interior of Sapore made for a refreshing change after the sweltering July heatwave. It was no problem for our party of three to be seated; the fact that we had a reservation helped, I am sure. We started out with drinks--bellinis for my two dinner companions and a classic vodka martini for me. I appreciated being able to customize my drink with a blue-cheese-stuffed olive and an anchovy. I would never have thought to put an anchovy in a martini, but it looks like this will be a new obsession for me. 

On to the food. We opted to skip the appetizers and go straight to soup/salad and entrees (all the better to save room for dessert). My mom went with the Italian soup and my other dining companion and I split the Caprese salad, a solid presentation that did not blow me away, but certainly does not provide grist for anything like the negative reviews of this establishment that I have seen on yelp. I didn't know what to expect in terms of pasta portions here, so I went with the Chicken Marsala. It might have been nice to have pasta to pick up some of the sauce, but I appreciated that the dish was hot by temperature and I even had enough for leftovers (to which I added pasta, in the comfort and convenience of my home).

The dessert selection was excellent. We went with the tiramisu. I understand Sapore also has an excellent cannoli which I would like to try on a future visit. I would be tempted to come back, if only for another excellent martini, appetizers, and another run through the dessert menu.
Refine this for me please:
Sapore offers a taste of Italy in an unexpected strip mall setting. Stepping inside the cool, dimly lit interior provided a welcome relief from the scorching July heatwave. Thanks to our reservation, finding a table for our party of three was a breeze. After settling in, we kicked off our meal with refreshing bellinis for my companions and a classic vodka martini for myself. One unique touch I appreciated was the option to customize my martini with a blue-cheese-stuffed olive and an anchovy. It's a combination I never would have thought of but now has me hooked.

Moving on to the food, we decided to forgo appetizers and jump straight into soups, salads, and entrees, leaving room for dessert. My mom chose the Italian soup while my dining companion and I shared the Caprese salad. While the salad was good, it didn't blow me away, although I must say it certainly did not warrant the negative reviews I had seen on Yelp. As for the entrees, unsure of portion sizes, I opted for the Chicken Marsala. While I would have enjoyed some pasta to soak up the delicious sauce, I appreciated that the dish arrived piping hot, and I even had enough leftover for a meal at home, where I added pasta for added comfort and convenience.

The dessert selection at Sapore was truly excellent. We couldn't resist indulging in the tiramisu, but I hear their cannoli is equally outstanding and I'm already eager to try it on my next visit. I would be tempted to return solely for their fantastic martinis, appetizers, and another exploration of their dessert menu.

input:
Due to it's location in a strip mall near Cool Springs, this version of the Twelve South hipster gourmet Burger Up is certainly not as trendy. But it makes up for it by delivering the goods. Awesomely tasty and messy burgers with fresh meat and fixings. The regular fries are delicious... until you try the truffle fries. They are truly outstanding, not greasy and finished with paresan cheese. The metaphorical cherry-on-top was the chocolate milkshake (which actually had no cherry on top). The shake was nothing fancy, but perfectly made, creamy, not too sweet or over-chocolatey. 
If you want your upscale burger experience but still want your burger-fries-shake holy trinity, come here.
Refine this for me please: This particular location of the Twelve South hipster gourmet Burger Up may not have the same trendy atmosphere due to its placement in a strip mall near Cool Springs. However, it compensates for this by serving delicious, flavorful burgers made with fresh ingredients. The regular fries are satisfying on their own, but the truffle fries are exceptional, boasting a lack of greasiness and a finish of parmesan cheese. The epitome of the dining experience was the chocolate milkshake, sans the cherry on top. Though simple, it was expertly prepared, with a creamy texture and the perfect balance of sweetness and chocolate flavor. If you crave a high-end burger experience while still indulging in the classic trifecta of burger, fries, and shake, this is the place to visit.

input: I dropped my car off first thing in the morning for a simple "check engine" light appointment. I was told at the end of that day that my car had not been looked at and would not be ready until the following day. What was the point of making an appointment, if they didn't even touch my car? The next evening when I came to pick it up, after they called me to tell me it was ready, I waited for a full hour before my car was given to me. They had parked so many cars in front of it they couldn't get it out. That is an hour of my life I will never get back, all because someone called and told me to come pick up my car (...which was there for two full business days, unnecessarily. For the record, there was nothing wrong with the car. It needed no repair and no maintenance). There was a kind woman who asked how they could make it up to me, but I had to tell her that I will likely never return, so it wasn't worth her time.
Refine this for me please:
I had an appointment to have my car's "check engine" light checked first thing in the morning. However, by the end of the day, they hadn't even looked at my car and informed me that it wouldn't be ready until the next day. It's frustrating that I made an appointment but they didn't touch my car. 

When I arrived to pick up my car the next evening, after receiving a call from them saying it was ready, I ended up waiting for a full hour. They had parked multiple cars in front of mine, making it impossible to retrieve. It's disappointing to have wasted an hour of my time because they didn't manage their parking properly. 

To make matters worse, my car had been at the shop for two full business days without any actual problem or repair needed. It was a complete waste of time and there was no reason for such a long delay. 

A compassionate staff member asked how they could make it up to me, but I informed her that I'm unlikely to return, so it wouldn't be worth her time.

input: For many years, RH&B was the place to go in south Jersey for great BBQ and blues. Sadly, after a recent sale, the restaurant has decided to cancel all live music. The food was decent at best, and in the absence of live music offerings  I can no longer recommend this restaurant. The only aspect I will miss are the people who worked there.
Refine this for me please: For years, RH&B in south Jersey was the go-to spot for exceptional BBQ and blues. However, following a recent change in ownership, the restaurant has made the disappointing decision to discontinue its live music performances. Although the food was decent at best, the removal of live music options leaves me unable to recommend this establishment. The only aspect I will truly miss about RH&B are the exceptional individuals who worked there.

input:
This use to be a reliable place for sandwiches but the last two were not good at all.  Cheesesteak was light on the meat.  There are so many good rolls to pick from in the Philly area but this roll was one of the worst and stale.

Hopefully it was just an off night. I'll try again but not for awhile.
Refine this for me please:
Previously, this place was known for its dependable sandwiches. However, the last two experiences were disappointing. The cheesesteak lacked an adequate amount of meat, which was unsatisfying. In the Philadelphia area, there is a multitude of excellent rolls available, but unfortunately, the roll here was one of the worst and seemed stale.

Perhaps it was just an isolated incident, and I am hopeful that future visits will be better. However, I do not plan on returning for a while.

input: Maybe I just had bad luck at this property but I am a SPG gold member... quickly approaching platinum and made a reservation at this property. I payed a good amount for my room and when I asked for a larger room they told me they where all the same. I asked did every room have adjoining doors and was told yes. I then told the front desk clerk that I could hear EVERYTHING going on next door including sneezing and even AC talking on CNN 360 very clearly. He told me to come down and get a new key and move to a room there was nobody in. They did not offer to bring me a key or help me move. When I got to the lobby the line was at least 10 people deep and there was only ONE person there. I just gave up and dealt with the noise and a few hours later they finally turned off the TV and I could sleep.  There is nothing fancy about this hotel and the service for sure needs improvement!
Refine this for me please: Maybe I had an unfortunate experience at this property, but as a SPG gold member, I was expecting better. I had made a reservation and paid a significant amount for my room. When I requested a larger room, I was informed that they were all the same size. Curious about noise levels, I asked if every room had adjoining doors, and I was told they did. I then explained to the front desk clerk that I could clearly hear everything from the adjacent room, including sneezing and even the AC talking on CNN 360. In response, he advised me to come down and retrieve a new key to move to a vacant room. Unfortunately, they didn't offer to assist me with the process or bring me the new key. Upon reaching the lobby, I was confronted with a line of at least 10 people, with only one person working at the front desk. Feeling discouraged, I gave up and tolerated the noise until the TV was finally turned off a few hours later, allowing me to sleep. Overall, the hotel lacks any notable features and the service is in dire need of improvement.

input: Food was fresh and tasted great, nothing amazing but price was fair and staff was very helpful and nice.
Refine this for me please: The food provided was fresh and enjoyable, although nothing extraordinary. The prices were fair, and the staff members were extremely helpful and friendly.

input:
Its a hotel and you can stay there.

After a couple of stays here I find it is not bad. 

Its definitely more of a business traveler kind of place than a tourist kind of place.

Pros
The rooms have the essentials. The beds are quite comfortable.
The cafe isn't bad although it is a little foggy as to what comes with the room. Apparently its one entree and one beverage. Not a bad deal.

Cons
Hallways are a bit shaggy. NBD since I am not staying in the hallway.
Room cleaning dropped the ball on my last stay. The room was clean, but I found a bag from BK in my mini fridge ... eeeew!
Refine this for me please:
This hotel is suitable for business travelers rather than tourists. 

Pros:
- The rooms are equipped with the necessary amenities and the beds are comfortable.
- The café is decent, though it's not entirely clear what is included with the room. However, the offer of one entree and one beverage is a good deal.

Cons:
- The hallways are a bit untidy, but it doesn't affect the actual stay in the room.
- On my last stay, there was an issue with room cleaning. While the room itself was clean, I discovered a bag from Burger King in my mini fridge, which was quite unpleasant.

input:
I recently moved in a few blocks away from Henry's and was looking forward to having a neighborhood coffee spot not far from my house. So, on a beautifully humid August morning I walked over to check it. 

1) The atmosphere is pretty standard. Open space with the coffee bar in the back left corner and ordinary tables and chairs scattered throughout. No college coffee shop couches or armchairs but no industrial airbnb chic vibe either. Lacked uniqueness. 

2) The name Henry reminds me of Thomas the tank engine. Was there a train named Henry on there or not? If so, was he chill or not. Could add one star for chill train association. 

3) The coffee was not good. I got an iced coffee (STFU) and it was super bitter. The amount of ice in it wasn't obscene so it had that going for it but other than that idk.

I'm coming back to try some hot coffee or espresso on a cooler day but damn Henry :((( not a great first impression.
Refine this for me please:
I recently moved just a few blocks away from Henry's and was excited about having a coffee spot close to my house. So, one beautiful and humid August morning, I walked over to check it out.

1) The atmosphere at Henry's is rather generic. It has an open layout, with the coffee bar located in the back left corner, and the tables and chairs are ordinary and scattered throughout the space. It lacks any unique or distinctive elements, neither resembling a cozy college coffee shop nor an industrial Airbnb chic vibe.

2) The name Henry reminds me of Thomas the Tank Engine, but I'm unsure if there was a train named Henry on the show. If there was, and he was known for being chill, maybe it could earn an extra star for the cool train association.

3) Unfortunately, the coffee at Henry's did not meet my expectations. I ordered an iced coffee (STFU) but found it to be excessively bitter. While there wasn't an excessive amount of ice, which was a positive, overall, the experience left much to be desired.

Although my initial impression was not great, I plan to give Henry's another chance by trying their hot coffee or espresso on a cooler day. But for now, Henry, I must admit that my first visit was disappointing.

input:
We were thoroughly impressed with this hotel! Upon arriving, you are immediately welcomed with the scent of fresh baked cookies. Walking up to the desk we were greeted by Valorie who informed us that cookies and water were complementary to guests and that we were more than welcome. Across from the desk we noticed a book shelf. This is not the kind of book shelf where rejected leftovers were placed but rather, a wide range of books by well known authors. The name of the program was called Read it and Return. In essence, you can borrow a book for the duration of your stay and if you don't finish it you can return it the next time you stay at the hotel at any of the Carlson hotels who have the same program! ( what!?! Cookies and books!?! YES!) Right off the bat, we felt like we were right at home.

   Arriving at our room, we noticed that everything was extremely clean and there was a refrigerator (with a small freezer) , a microwave, a coffee maker, and a well working A.C. (you know, the kind that you don't have to yell over to have a conversation). The bathroom was stocked with brand name shampoo, conditioner, and lotion.

  Our next stop was the smoking area. Normally, smokers feel as though they have been marooned to a small place behind the dumpster...but not here! Provided was 2 sets of swinging benches; set far enough away so that it did not disturb the guests in rooms around the area but no a 10 mile hike for those adults who enjoy the pleasure. Did I also mention they have smoking rooms available?

In the morning, feel free to partake in a complimentary breakfast (NOT CONTINENTAL)-I mean a real breakfast which changes daily; anything from fresh made waffles to eggs, sausage, and bacon! Also, cold cereal, juices, and coffees have options! Coffee is available 24/7 as well! 

The hotel also has a pool and hot tub which I personally observed them clean daily!

On our last night we got back late and I was going to ask the desk for a late check out, but there was no need! Their check out time is 12:00 Pm as opposed to the hotel usual of 11:00 Am. That worked out well for us.

At checkout we were asked if there was anything we would change about the hotel or our stay. I made small suggestions which I thought would help them, but definitely nothing major. The desk person wrote down what I said and said she would pass it on! I was impressed with that, because we've been asked about our stay at other places, but it seemed more out of routine than actual interest. Here, she seemed genuinely interested. We don't usually do reviews, so I'm sorry for the long review. However, we wanted you to get a real feel for this wonderful hotel and hope that you enjoy it as much as we did! Thanks for reading and safe travels. J & Niki.
Refine this for me please:
We were thoroughly impressed with this hotel! Upon arrival, we were immediately welcomed with the inviting scent of freshly baked cookies. Valorie greeted us at the desk and informed us that cookies and water were complimentary for guests, making us feel right at home. We also noticed a well-stocked bookshelf nearby, featuring a wide range of books by renowned authors. This program, called Read it and Return, allows guests to borrow books for the duration of their stay and return them at any Carlson hotel within the same program. It was a delightful surprise to find such unique amenities at a hotel.

Entering our room, we found it impeccably clean and equipped with convenient facilities including a refrigerator (with a small freezer), a microwave, a coffee maker, and an efficient air conditioning system. The bathroom was stocked with high-quality brand name shampoo, conditioner, and lotion.

We were pleasantly surprised by the smoking area as well. Unlike most places that relegate smokers to undesirable locations, this hotel provided two sets of swinging benches. These benches were placed away from the rooms to avoid disturbing other guests, while still allowing smokers to enjoy their habit without having to venture too far. It was refreshing to see this considerate approach.

In the morning, we enjoyed a complimentary breakfast that exceeded our expectations. Unlike a typical continental breakfast, this hotel offered a variety of freshly made options that changed daily. From mouthwatering waffles to a selection of eggs, sausage, and bacon, there was something to satisfy every guest's cravings. They also had an assortment of cold cereals, juices, and different coffee choices available 24/7.

The hotel also had a well-maintained pool and hot tub, which we observed being cleaned daily. It was evident that the staff took great pride in maintaining these amenities.

On our final night, we returned late and contemplated requesting a late check-out. However, we were pleasantly surprised to discover that the hotel's check-out time was 12:00 PM, an hour later than the usual 11:00 AM, which worked perfectly for us.

During check-out, we were asked if there was anything we would change about our stay. I offered some minor suggestions, which were attentively noted by the desk person. It was refreshing to encounter genuine interest in our feedback, as opposed to it feeling like a routine inquiry. This level of care and attentiveness was truly impressive.

Overall, we don't typically write reviews, but we felt compelled to share our experience at this exceptional hotel. We hope that you will enjoy it as much as we did. Thank you for taking the time to read our review, and we wish you safe travels.

Best regards,
J & Niki

input: Let me start by saying buying a car is an intimidating process. I feel like I am playing poker with someone who can see all of the cards while I can only see my cards. I felt well prepared and needed to use all of my preparation to get what I considered to be a fair deal (time will tell whether I really got a fair deal) on a used (pre-owned is what they like to say) car. Do your homework (KBB.com, Edmunds.com etc) As long as the car performs like I expect it to over time, I will be happy. Sam Ladd was the salesman who always treated me courteously and let me drive lots of cars while I was deciding what vehicle I wanted. I drove everything from subcompacts to full sized SUVs. I visited many dealerships I chose Toyota of Santa Barbara because they ultimately had the vehicle that I wanted. I bought what I believe will meet my families needs. The negotiation process was business like and I believe that Frank Flores the sales manager was up front with me and answered my concerns. Be prepared and stick to your position throughout the process.
Refine this for me please:
Let me begin by expressing that purchasing a car can be an intimidating experience. It often feels like a game of poker, where the dealer holds all the cards while I can only see mine. In order to secure what I considered to be a fair deal on a used (or should I say, pre-owned) car, I had to rely on my thorough preparation. Time will be the ultimate judge of whether I truly obtained a fair deal or not. I highly recommend doing your research, utilizing resources such as KBB.com and Edmunds.com, to make informed decisions.

Fortunately, my interactions with salesman Sam Ladd were consistently courteous, and he generously allowed me to test drive various vehicles while I weighed my options. From subcompacts to full-sized SUVs, I explored a wide range of options. Despite visiting multiple dealerships, I ultimately chose to purchase from Toyota of Santa Barbara because they had the exact vehicle I desired. This car, I believe, will adequately meet the needs of my family.

Throughout the negotiation process, I found the sales manager, Frank Flores, to be transparent and responsive to my concerns. It was a business-like interaction, and I appreciated his honesty. My advice to others is to come prepared and stand firm in your position throughout the negotiating process.

input: Great bar and atmosphere. Bartenders are very friendly as well as the owner. Mixed crowd and staff makes everyone feel welcomed and right at home! The  BBQ truck parked outside is excellent!!
Refine this for me please: This establishment boasts a fantastic bar and an inviting atmosphere. The bartenders, along with the amiable owner, create a friendly atmosphere that welcomes all visitors. The diverse crowd and staff contribute to a sense of belonging and make patrons feel right at home. Furthermore, the presence of an exceptional BBQ truck parked outside adds to the overall experience.

input: Really nice staff but mediocre Italian food served luke warm.   We went here for a large group dinner around Christmas mostly because it was a BYOB and there was no fixed menu for a group of 10.   We ordered numerous appetizers including, fried gnocchi, calamari, garlic pizza bread, fried zucchini.   It was all just ok.   The main courses were unadventurous Italian American selections.  The sauces were just meh.   Three of us ordered 3 different chicken dishes and they all came out with the same sauce.   Boring.  Although the staff was very accommodating, the food was too lack luster to return.
Refine this for me please:
The staff was genuinely friendly and accommodating, but unfortunately, the Italian food served was mediocre and often lukewarm. We decided to come here for a Christmas dinner with a large group primarily because it allowed us to bring our own alcohol and there wasn't a fixed menu for a party of 10.

We started with several appetizers including fried gnocchi, calamari, garlic pizza bread, and fried zucchini. However, none of them stood out as particularly impressive. As for the main courses, they lacked creativity and were typical Italian American selections. The sauces were nothing special, simply average. Surprisingly, all three of us who ordered chicken dishes received the same sauce, which felt quite monotonous and uninspiring. Overall, the dishes were simply boring.

Despite the restaurant's staff being very accommodating, the lackluster quality of the food leaves us with little desire to return.

input: One of the best and friendliest Chinese places to grab something tasty. Try the double treasure.
Refine this for me please: Indulge in a delicious culinary experience at one of the top Chinese restaurants renowned for its incredible flavors and warm hospitality. Don't miss out on the heavenly double treasure dish.

input: We have used Reno Vulcanizing for several years now and will not take a vehicles to anyone else. Ken, Bruce and all the other staff I have dealt with are always honest, courteous and helpful.
Refine this for me please: We have been loyal customers of Reno Vulcanizing for several years now and would not trust anyone else with our vehicles. Ken, Bruce, and the entire staff have consistently demonstrated honesty, courtesy, and helpfulness in all our dealings with them.

input:
3 separate reviews:

CITY TOUR: 1 STAR -Not worth the time or money. We never got a confirmation email when booking over the phone. Then during the tour we had to wait and be hassled over payment that was already cleared on our account. Don't do this tour if you get carsick easily. It was full and we had to sit in the back. You can't see anything on the tour through the tinted windows and you only stop at two places that I never would have stopped at on my own. 

The only intriguing part was the Katrina history during the visit the the 9th ward. Do yourself a favor and take the green street cars, save your money and REALLY see things on your own time. We couldn't get pictures of anything and wish we would have done a walking tour instead or tried the red bus tours.

PLANTATION TOUR: 5 STARS! Our driver Stacie gave us a history of the surrounding area and a lot of cool information on our way to the plantation. Laura Creole plantation had an amazing history. Our guide there was Ethan and he did a really good job explaining about the owners journey to this land and how the slaves were treated and also their journey. We felt that it was a balanced historical view of the plantation in general. After that tour we went to the Oak Alley plantation. The grounds alone are worth the trip. The tour guides really focus on the landowners and not so much on the lives of the slaves living there. But you have some time after the tour to visit the  slave quarters on your own. But we wished that there would have been a more balanced explanation of both experiences like at the Laura Plantation. The buses are big and you can recline and take a nap on your way back to the hotel. (No car sickness) 

SWAMP TOUR: 4 STARS and we didn't even see any alligators! This would have been a five-star tour if we would have seen alligators. But our guide Henry was very thorough and explained a lot of great details about the surrounding area. We got to see some boars, raccoons, and birds. It started to rain with thunder and lightning so we did not see any alligators because we had to go back for safety reasons. We did try to see some alligators but they don't come out if it's cold. Don't book your tour if it's cold or storming and I'm sure it will be a 5 star tour for you.  The buses are big and you can recline and take a nap on your way back to the hotel. (No car sickness)
Refine this for me please:
CITY TOUR: 1 STAR -Disappointing experience overall. Our booking was not confirmed and we encountered payment issues during the tour. The tour was crowded, and sitting in the back made it difficult to see anything through the tinted windows. The stops were not of much interest, except for the visit to the 9th ward for Katrina history. Instead, I would recommend taking the green street cars or trying the red bus tours for a more enjoyable and flexible experience.

PLANTATION TOUR: 5 STARS! The driver, Stacie, provided informative commentary about the area on our way to the plantation. The Laura Creole plantation had a fascinating history and our guide, Ethan, did an excellent job explaining the journey of the owners and the treatment of slaves, providing a balanced perspective. The Oak Alley plantation had beautiful grounds, but the focus on the landowners overshadowed the lives of the slaves. However, we had the opportunity to explore the slave quarters independently, which was appreciated. The comfortable bus ride back to the hotel was a plus.

SWAMP TOUR: 4 STARS, despite not seeing alligators. Our guide, Henry, provided detailed information about the area. We spotted boars, raccoons, and birds, but the rain and thunder prevented us from seeing alligators and necessitated our return for safety. It's advisable not to book the tour in cold or stormy weather. However, Henry's thorough explanations made the tour enjoyable. The peaceful bus ride back to the hotel was a bonus.

input:
AVOID AT ALL COSTS
By far the worst pizza I've had. Thin crust was not crunchy, olives were junk and salad was $6 for bad strands of lettuce and minimal cheese which looked horribly powdered. It came in a prepacked divider. Rip off. Not worth more than a dollar. 

Their knots were ok, and extremely unhealthy, but rest was crap.

I normally don't order from them or anyone else but good pizza like Grimaldi's, BJs or Mellow Mushroom but I hadn't gone grocery shopping and normally stock up on organic pizza from Publix or whole foods which btw is cheaper and tastier. But, this was the only place opened late. 

I never want dominoes again. It's just a reminder that corporate chains need to fall and get out the way. I rather pay for quality. Not preservatives and poison. 

Never Again!!! 

Calling card tomorrow to get refund! Waste of $30.
Refine this for me please:
I strongly advise against choosing this pizza place under any circumstances. It was by far the worst pizza I have ever had. The thin crust lacked the desired crunchiness, the olives were of poor quality, and the salad consisted of overpriced lettuce strands with minimal cheese that appeared unpleasantly powdered. To make matters worse, the pizza arrived in a prepacked divider, making it feel like a complete rip off. I would not consider it worth more than a dollar.

The only somewhat redeeming aspect was their knots, although they were still unhealthy. However, everything else was simply awful. Normally, I prefer ordering from reputable pizza establishments such as Grimaldi's, BJs, or Mellow Mushroom. If I hadn't neglected to go grocery shopping, I would have stocked up on organic pizza from Publix or Whole Foods, which is not only cheaper but also far more delicious. Sadly, this was the only place open late, leaving me with no other options.

This experience has cemented my decision to never order from Domino's again. It serves as a reminder that corporate chains should step aside and make room for places that prioritize quality over preservatives and harmful ingredients. I am determined to pay for quality going forward and will be calling the company tomorrow to request a refund. This was an utter waste of $30.

input: No dark beer in February???  Nice looking place and nice folks...  summer beer in February was a disappointment...
Refine this for me please: Is it true that there is no availability of dark beer in February? Although the establishment appears visually appealing and the staff is pleasant, the experience of having summer beer in February was somewhat underwhelming.

input:
Quick Read: Aside from the parking and occasional crowds -- this place is fantastic.

Thankfully, Buddy Brew is expanding -- a move that I hope will relieve some of the terrible parking issues. This place is a must-try in Tampa. The baristas are friendly, knowledgable, and efficient. The breakfast and lunch options are solidly tasty. The coffee is roasted with a level of care that I'm glad to see in Tampa. One of my absolute favorite places on the planet.
Refine this for me please: Revised: Despite the minor drawbacks of parking and occasional crowds, this place is truly fantastic. Fortunately, Buddy Brew is expanding, which should hopefully alleviate the parking issues. It is a must-visit destination in Tampa with friendly, knowledgeable, and efficient baristas. The breakfast and lunch options are consistently delicious, and the coffee is roasted with a level of care that I greatly appreciate. Undoubtedly, one of my all-time favorite places on Earth.

input: Overrated. This place is ok, often the crust is burned...maybe our pallets aren't sophisticated enough to appreciate that taste but it's not our thing. We enjoyed the cauliflower salad and the fried dough ball dessert is delish
Refine this for me please: This place is somewhat overrated. While it's decent, we found that the crust often tends to be burned. It's possible that our palates aren't sophisticated enough to appreciate that taste, but it's just not our preference. However, we did enjoy the cauliflower salad, and the fried dough ball dessert is absolutely delicious.

input: Got a gift certificate to this place over 6 months ago and just last month FINALLY had the GREAT  pleasure of going!! Perfect  spot for lunch. I'm in love with the mixed salad salad sandwich!! One sandwich that I will actually crave:-) yummy homemade ice cream that you won't be able to get enough of!  We will be back.
Refine this for me please: I recently used a gift certificate I received to visit this place, which I had been meaning to do for over 6 months. Finally, last month I had the wonderful opportunity to go, and it was absolutely fantastic! It turned out to be the ideal spot for a delicious lunch. I simply fell in love with the mixed salad sandwich - it's the kind of sandwich that I can't help but crave! Additionally, their homemade ice cream was irresistibly yummy, leaving me wanting more. I can't wait to go back again soon.

input: I love Italian food and with this being so close to home, I gave it a shot. Not only did they exceed my expectations in food quality and quantity, but every time we order pick up, or dine in the girls treat us amazing (You rock Alexa!) Thank you for being awesome.
Refine this for me please: I have a deep appreciation for Italian cuisine, and since this restaurant is conveniently located near my home, I decided to give it a try. To my delight, the food surpassed my expectations in terms of both taste and portion size. Additionally, the staff, particularly Alexa, consistently provides exceptional service whether we opt for takeout or dine-in. I want to express my gratitude for their outstanding hospitality. Thank you for being truly awesome.

input:
We ate at the bar on a Friday night, where the extremely charming bartender made us the best Manhattans I've ever had, using Carpano Antica Formula vermouth.  We ordered the lamb meatballs, which were okay, and the spring rolls, which were excellent. 

This is a perfect place to stop for a drink in the Quarter, if you need a nice civilized break.  The drinks were extremely expensive, but well worth it for the occasional night out.

The manager, Eric, could not have been more professional and friendly.  We will definitely go back.
Refine this for me please:
We decided to have dinner at the bar on a Friday night, and our experience exceeded our expectations. The bartender, who exuded charisma, skillfully crafted the most outstanding Manhattans I have ever had, using the exceptional Carpano Antica Formula vermouth. Alongside our drinks, we ordered the lamb meatballs, which were decent, and the spring rolls, which were simply outstanding.

If you find yourself in need of a refined and relaxing respite in the Quarter, this establishment is the perfect spot to stop and enjoy a drink. While the prices for the beverages were steep, the quality unquestionably justified the occasional splurge on a memorable night out.

Furthermore, we were impressed by the manager, Eric, whose professionalism and friendly demeanor left a lasting impression. Without a doubt, we will eagerly return to this remarkable place in the future.

input: I used to go here all the time for the lunch special, and it was a great deal. We've been only a few times in the last year because my husband isn't a fan, but I enjoy it. The prices do seem to have gone up a fair bit in recent times, but it's still never a disappointing meal.
Refine this for me please: I used to frequent this place regularly for their lunch special, and it was always an amazing deal. However, due to my husband's lack of enthusiasm, we have only been a few times in the past year. Despite the noticeable increase in prices, the quality of the food has never failed to impress me.

input: I had the classic burger and fries. Overall pleased with my experience. The burger was well seasoned and the fries were pretty tasty. The service was on point. Also had to have a spiked milkshake....my choice the Bananas Foster.
Refine this for me please: I ordered the classic burger and fries, and I must say, I was overall pleased with my experience. The burger was perfectly seasoned, and the fries were incredibly tasty. The service at the establishment was exceptional; they were attentive and on point throughout my visit. To top it off, I decided to try a spiked milkshake, and my choice was the Bananas Foster flavor.

input: Never been to this location before, never had a problem with any other location. It was almost full but there were a handful of tables open. We began to seat ourselves and was told we could sit anywhere. They came and took our drink order pretty quickly and we received them within a few minutes, the girl who delivered our drinks said they would be back to take our order.  I'd say it was almost 10 minutes before they finally came and took out order. I started to wonder who our waitress was because 2 different females took the drink order and delivered them. Finally, one of the females came and took our order, so we must have been there for 15 minutes at least before our food order was taken. 10 minutes had gone by and a lady got sat in the booth next to us. Another 10 minutes later, she got her food before we did. So she got there after us, ordered after us, but received hers before us. Our waitress refilled my husband's coffee twice the whole time and she asked if I wanted a refill on my soda, I shook my head no and she could tell we were wondering where our food was, she says your food is almost ready, the kitchen is overwhelmed right now. But there was only maybe one new customer that came in since we had been there. I told my husband if we didn't get our food in the next 5 minutes, we would just leave.  So, 40 minutes and no food, we walked to the register and asked if we could pay for our beverages and our waitress said our food was almost ready. I said that we didn't want to wait anymore and she said we didn't have to pay for our drinks and we left. No apology, nothing. Im thinking either our waitress forgot to enter our order, or, the 3 cooks in the kitchen just wasn't concerned about how fast the food was being cooked. They did not look flustered, so I honestly don't know what the issue was. Won't be returning. Waste of our time.
Refine this for me please:
I had never been to this location before and had never encountered any problems at other locations. The restaurant was almost full, but there were a few open tables. We took a seat and were informed that we could choose any table. Our drink order was taken promptly and we received our drinks within a few minutes. The person who delivered our drinks mentioned that they would return to take our food order. However, it took about 10 minutes for someone to finally come and take our order. I was starting to wonder who our actual waitress was because two different females had taken our drink order and delivered them. Eventually, one of them came back and took our food order, which means we had been waiting for at least 15 minutes before the order was placed. 

After waiting for about 10 more minutes, a lady who had been seated in the booth next to us received her food before us. She had arrived after us and ordered after us, yet she received her food first. Our waitress only refilled my husband's coffee twice during our entire time there and asked if I wanted a soda refill, to which I declined. It was obvious that we were wondering where our food was, and our waitress informed us that it was almost ready but the kitchen was overwhelmed. However, there was only one new customer who had arrived since we had been there, so I couldn't understand why the kitchen was struggling. 

Fed up with the wait, I told my husband that if our food didn't arrive within the next 5 minutes, we should just leave. Ultimately, after waiting for 40 minutes without any sign of our food, we walked to the register and asked if we could pay for our beverages. Our waitress claimed that our food was almost ready, but we insisted on not waiting any longer. She then told us that we didn't have to pay for our drinks and we left. Throughout the entire experience, there was no apology given to us. 

I can't help but think that either our waitress forgot to enter our order or the three cooks in the kitchen simply didn't prioritize cooking the food quickly. They didn't look flustered, so I'm honestly not sure what the issue was. Needless to say, we will not be returning to this restaurant. It was a complete waste of our time.

input: AMAZING!!! I just got back from the bakery. I ordered tres leche, hubby got chocolate dipped cannoli with original filling, we also got Italian wedding cookies, and dark chocolate florentine cookies. The tres leche taste just like my grandma used to make it minus the Malibu liquor. The cannoli was delicious. The Italian wedding cookies was a little crunchy yet still delicate, it also had the perfect amount of Anise flavor. The dark chocolate florentine is so yummy, that says a lot because I don't like coconut. The chocolate to coconut ratio is perfect. We will definitely be going back.
Refine this for me please: Wow! I had an incredible experience at the bakery today! I tried their amazing tres leche cake, which tasted just like my grandmother used to make, minus the Malibu liquor. My husband went with the chocolate dipped cannoli with the original filling, and it was absolutely delicious. Additionally, we grabbed some Italian wedding cookies, which had a delightful crunch and a perfect amount of Anise flavor. And let me tell you, even though I'm not a fan of coconut, the dark chocolate florentine cookies were so yummy! The chocolate to coconut ratio was spot on. We are definitely planning on going back for more of these incredible treats.

While on vacation and not in the mood to cook, we decided to order pizzas from this place for takeaway and eat at our accommodation, which was 500 meters away. So, on a summer Thursday, we went to pick them up around 9:30 PM. 

Upon entering, we found the place to be very pleasant, clean, and comfortable for dining in. We were served by a very friendly and attentive man. 

We ordered the following flavors: 
- Prosciutto (raw ham)
- Ham (cooked ham)
- Pepperoni
- Onion
- Mushrooms
- Anchovies
- Basil and tomato

The pizzas took about 25/30 minutes. All the flavors, of which I am uploading a photo, were delicious. The style of pizza was thin crust, with tomato sauce and an ideal amount of mozzarella cheese. 

While this review may seem to solely focus on the value for money, it is also true that, in my opinion, the warmth with which we were welcomed reflected how the experience would have been if we had chosen to dine in. 

I have no hesitation in giving this place a five-star rating.

input:
So it is a good friends birthday today and we all met up here. This place has a great, homey feel. It wasn't crowded at all. 

The service was prompt and friendly, my burger was good, not great. Menu said it's charbroiled...seemed more like pan fried, and the meat was well done / dry. Oh well. My buds and I were all having a good time.

Went down to the river and actually found some water!

Good times on Paradise road.
Refine this for me please: Today is my good friend's birthday and we gathered at this venue, which has a cozy and welcoming atmosphere. Surprisingly, it wasn't crowded at all, allowing us to enjoy our time comfortably. The service was attentive and friendly, and although my burger was decent, it didn't reach the level of greatness. According to the menu, it was meant to be charbroiled, but it seemed more like it was pan-fried, and unfortunately, the meat was overcooked and dry. Nevertheless, my friends and I were still having a fantastic time. Later, we ventured down to the river and were delighted to actually find water! All in all, it was a memorable experience on Paradise Road.

input: I read at least 30 reviews before I decided to eat here. The only thing that was good was the oysters because it's raw. Everything else was dry and tasteless. The space is cramp. We had people on our backs coughing on us while sitting at the bar trying to enjoy it. Let's just say the 2 half and half baskets that my boyfriend and I ordered was not worth $60.
Refine this for me please: After thoroughly researching and contemplating over 30 reviews, I made a deliberate decision to dine at this establishment. Unfortunately, it pains me to admit that the only aspect which lived up to my expectations were the raw oysters due to their freshness. Regrettably, everything else on the menu proved to be disappointingly dried out and devoid of flavor. Moreover, I found the space to be excessively cramped, and our experience was further marred by the uncomfortably close presence of other patrons who were coughing on us while we tried to savor our meal at the bar. In summary, I must confess that the 2 half and half baskets, priced at a hefty $60, fell far short of being worth the expenditure.

input:
Dearest Reader,

Please allow me to hereby confirm the rumors: Village Whiskey does, in fact, have the best burger in Philadelphia. And, I should note, some of the best bartenders. 

As my wife and I sat at the bar waiting for our friends to arrive, I marveled at the infinite selection of whiskeys and bourbons. I decided that this, self, is the day you will begin liking whiskey. So I petitioned the bartender to "make me something awesome with whiskey in it." "What kind of drink do you want?," he inquired. "I have no idea, good sir. You see, I am a neophyte, a tyro, and fledgling when it comes to spirits such as these." (Perhaps my banter wasn't quite at this level at the time; I was already a few drinks in from my visit to Franklin Mortgage, but this is how I remember it going.) So, he thought about it for a while and proceeded to mix up the craziest drink I had ever seen -- it had whiskey, orange bitters, an egg white, Portuguese red wine, and other stuff in it! The verdict: delicious. I also had the "The Commodore" off the drink menu, and it was very good, too. The drinks are a little pricey here, and they will set you back around $11 or $12 each.

When our friends arrived, we were seated outside and I got to try to village burger and the short-rib and cheddar duck-fat fries. The burger, which comes with an artfully restrained dollop of homemade thousand island dressing, was unbelievable. The applewood bacon and the dressing served the elevate the already-incredible taste of the meat. I can't wait to come back and order another one. As for the fries, they were very good, but I think next time I will stick with the plain duck fat fries. Our friends ordered those, and they were super crispy and delicious.

Warning: this place gets insanely busy, so you might have to wait a pretty long time for a table. 

All in all, the drinks were great, the food was delectable, and the staff was very knowledgeable and personable. I would totally come back.

Still dreaming of that burger,
Chris M.
Refine this for me please:
Dear Reader,

I am thrilled to confirm the rumors: Village Whiskey truly does have the best burger in Philadelphia, along with some of the finest bartenders around.

During our recent visit, my wife and I found ourselves captivated by the extensive array of whiskeys and bourbons while waiting for our friends at the bar. Determined to develop a taste for whiskey, I approached the bartender and requested a unique concoction featuring this spirit. When asked about my preferences, I confessed my lack of experience with such beverages. Taking this into account, the bartender pondered for a moment and proceeded to craft an extraordinary drink consisting of whiskey, orange bitters, an egg white, Portuguese red wine, and other intriguing ingredients. To my delight, the outcome was nothing short of delicious. Additionally, I savored "The Commodore" from the drink menu, which was equally delightful. It is worth noting that the drinks here are slightly pricey, typically costing around $11 or $12 each.

Once our friends joined us, we were seated outdoors, where I had the pleasure of savoring the Village burger and the short-rib and cheddar duck-fat fries. The burger, adorned with a tasteful portion of homemade thousand island dressing, was simply exceptional. The combination of applewood bacon and dressing added an exquisite touch to the already remarkable flavor of the meat. I eagerly anticipate returning for another serving. While the fries were indeed enjoyable, I believe I will opt for the regular duck fat fries on my next visit as our friends did. Their fries were impeccably crispy and delectable.

Please be warned that Village Whiskey tends to become extremely busy, so be prepared for a potentially lengthy wait for a table.

Overall, Village Whiskey boasts outstanding drinks, delectable food, and a knowledgeable and personable staff. I am already eager to revisit this establishment.

With thoughts lingering on that remarkable burger,
Chris M.

input:
I've had better, but pretty good for a neighborhood sushi joint. I'll go back, sure. 

Roll menu fairly limited, but my guess is they'd accommodate most any request. Service was attentive and speedy. All staff was eager to please. Other reviewers are right: Service is thoughtful and attentive. 

I thought the rolls were all fine (Mariner, Rose #1, San Francisco), but nothing like "aw damn!" good. I really can't complain, except to be honest, I have had more memorable sushi. Still though, competent and perfectly acceptable. 

I never knew this was here, so I'm glad I found it. For a quick pop in for sushi near the house, this can't be beat.
Refine this for me please: The sushi at this neighborhood joint was decent, although I have had better. Despite this, I would definitely go back again. While the roll menu was limited, I believe they would be accommodating to any requests. The service was attentive, speedy, and all the staff were eager to please. I agree with other reviewers that the service was thoughtful and attentive. The rolls I tried (Mariner, Rose #1, San Francisco) were fine but not mind-blowing. I can't complain though, as they were competent and perfectly acceptable. I wasn't aware of this place before, so I'm glad I stumbled upon it. It's a great spot for a quick sushi fix near home.

input:
We were vacationing in the French Quarter for a few days and stumbled into Flanagan's Pub.  Our first stop was about 11am and there were just a few people, probably regulars by how the bartender greeted them.  We loved the place so much that we ended back in there 3 times in one day!

We talked with the bartenders, locals and tourists all just hanging out having a nice drink and listening to some punk rock music.  It was a nice change from the over-the-top bars on Bourbon St.
Refine this for me please:
During our vacation in the French Quarter, we unexpectedly discovered Flanagan's Pub, a hidden gem. Our initial visit around 11am revealed a cozy atmosphere with only a handful of patrons, seemingly regulars judging by the bartender's warm welcome. The charm of the place captivated us, prompting us to revisit three more times in a single day.

Engaging in conversations with bartenders, locals, and fellow tourists alike, we relished in the laid-back ambiance while enjoying our drinks and indulging in some energizing punk rock tunes. It provided a refreshing deviation from the extravagant bars that littered Bourbon Street, allowing us to fully appreciate the genuine experience at Flanagan's Pub.

input:
I find it hard to believe there are so many people with such low standards when it comes to the Daily Bread.

It is a ripoff of St. Louis Bread Co/Panera Bread, which in of itself I don't mind at all.  I have eaten multiple times at the Daily Bread and have yet to have an enjoyable experience.  The food is so-so at best.  Their sandwiches are basic and lack any real flavor.  I also tried the BBQ Chicken pizza and it was okay.  

I certainly wouldn't steer anyone away from this place based on the food.  The food is basic and simple, not bad but also nothing great.

My biggest qualm with the Daily Bread is the service.  The majority of the workers seem utterly uninterested in helping out.  There was a line of about 6 people and one person at the register.  There was no sense of urgency to help any of the customers in line.  We waited for a good 5-6 minutes to put an order in.  After receiving our cups to get our drinks we looked for a clean place to sit and eventually settled on a table top that was the least dirty of the tables available.  There were plenty of open spots but it just appeared as though there was lots of trash left behind.  Does anyone bus these tables?

I anticipate that people are responsible for cleaning up after themselves, but it appeared as though the tables hadn't been effectively cleaned in a while.  There was also some trash on the floor that hadn't been addressed as well.

The order number was called and the order was only halfway completed.  When we asked which sandwich was ours, we were basically ignored as the girl put up two more orders.   After another few minutes the rest of the order came up and we began to eat.  I tried both items and as I stated before, both were okay.  The problem is that the food was just unable to make up for the lack of organization, the slow speed at which we were served, or the cleanliness of the restaurant.

After 3 attempts, I'm writing the Daily Bread off and won't return.  I'd rather go to St. Louis Bread Co, get the same level of food, but in a clean environment and a timely setting.
Refine this for me please:
I am greatly disappointed by the overall experience at the Daily Bread. While it is reminiscent of St. Louis Bread Co/Panera Bread, which I don't mind, my repeated visits have left me unimpressed. The quality of the food is mediocre at best - their sandwiches lack flavor and are basic in nature. I also tried their BBQ Chicken pizza, which was just average.

I cannot, in good conscience, recommend this place based on its food alone. The menu items are straightforward and acceptable, but nothing outstanding.

However, my main concern lies with the service at the Daily Bread. The majority of the staff members appear disinterested and unhelpful. On one occasion, there was a line of approximately six people and only one person at the register. The lack of urgency to serve customers was shocking. It took around 5-6 minutes just to place an order. After finally receiving our cups to get drinks, we struggled to find a clean table to sit at. Despite there being open spots, the tables were unclean, with plenty of trash left behind. The cleanliness of the restaurant, particularly the unaddressed trash on the floor, was concerning.

While I understand that customers are responsible for cleaning up after themselves, it was apparent that the tables hadn't been effectively cleaned in quite some time. This lack of organization and cleanliness was deeply disappointing.

To add to the frustration, when our order number was called, only half of the order was ready. When we inquired about which sandwich belonged to us, we were blatantly ignored as the staff member tended to other orders. After a few more minutes, the rest of our order was presented, and we began to eat. Both items were average, but they could not compensate for the disarray, slow service, and uncleanliness of the restaurant.

After giving the Daily Bread three chances, I have made the decision not to return. Instead, I prefer to go to St. Louis Bread Co, where I can receive similar food quality in a clean environment and with prompt service.

input:
I ordered delivery online through Yelp, and the food took about 45 minutes to get to my door.
The delivery driver was friendly.
I ordered a bbq chicken pizza and it was really good. They spread the good stuff out over top of most of the crust which was awesome. I also ordered mozzarella sticks, and they were not really what I was expecting--they weren't breaded, they were deep fried. They were good, just not what I was expecting. They also gave me two free cookies with my order and I have to say they were SO good. They were a little undercooked so they were perfectly chewy and they were almost the best part of my meal (and a nice little surprise). The price was fair and I would order here again for sure, although the wait was a little long.
Refine this for me please: I placed an online delivery order on Yelp and it took approximately 45 minutes for the food to be delivered to my door. The delivery driver was friendly and courteous. I ordered a barbecue chicken pizza which was absolutely delicious. The toppings were evenly spread over the crust, making it even more enjoyable. However, the mozzarella sticks did not meet my expectations as they were deep-fried instead of being breaded. Despite this, they still tasted good. To my pleasant surprise, the restaurant included two complimentary cookies with my order. These cookies were slightly undercooked, resulting in a delightful chewy texture. They were definitely one of the highlights of my meal. Overall, the price was reasonable, and I would definitely order from here again, despite the slightly longer wait time.

input: This is a fabulous gym.  Considering the cost, it provides a lot of fitness opportunities. I look for a gym that has a lot of classes at various times so that I can fit in exercise before or after work. As my work start and end times change from day to day, though, I need a gym that has classes at various times throughout the early morning and mid to late afternoon.  I found that the class schedule here meets that need. The trainers are excellent.  The spin and row teachers are really exceptional.  Try the We-Fit class, but expect a huge challenge, even if you are fit.  The facility is very clean, but this is a new enterprise, so time will tell if the business will continue to keep things clean and fresh.  I love that the women's locker room contains a blow dryer and extra hair ties.  These little things make a huge difference. Thanks for thinking of them.
Refine this for me please:
This gym is absolutely fantastic. Not only is it worth the cost, but it offers an abundance of fitness opportunities. Personally, I prioritize a gym with a wide variety of classes offered at different times to accommodate my fluctuating work schedule. Luckily, this gym's class schedule fits my needs perfectly. The trainers here are top-notch, especially the spin and row instructors who are truly exceptional. I highly recommend trying out the We-Fit class, but be prepared for a serious challenge even if you're already in shape.

In terms of cleanliness, the facility is currently very well-maintained. However, being a new establishment, only time will tell if they can uphold this level of cleanliness and freshness. One aspect I really appreciate is the women's locker room, which is equipped with a blow dryer and extra hair ties. These little amenities truly make a difference, and I'm grateful that the gym took them into consideration.

input:
If you are in a hurry and don't have time to read my entire review, here's the bottom line:  this place is FANTASTIC!

After my 3 month old car got rear ended TWICE inside of TWO weeks at the end of October, I took my dealership's recommendation and ended up bringing it in to Prestigious for repairs.  I am really glad I chose them.

First off their place is really clean and professional, you feel more like you are in a bank or a business office than a body shop.  I don't mind the typical "shop" feel of most of these places, but the experience at Prestigious is a notch above that and I appreciated it.

Next off, they assigned a specific advisor, Juan Mendez to work with me from start to finish through my repair.  He was really knowledgeable and provided detailed information to me about how they were going to diagnose everything and ensure that all of the various components of the damage were fixed correctly.  There was an added challenge in my case because I was hit in nearly the same place by two different drivers:  one submitted a claim through insurance and the other asked to pay outside of insurance.  I explained all of this to Juan and he came up with a forensically defensible way to determine the value of the damage caused by each of the accidents so that the costs could be assessed fairly and accurately.

Juan set up my rental for me and kept me updated regularly throughout the repair process, which in my case took a while due to the insurance company requiring additional evaluations etc. and the Thanksgiving holiday.  Detailed updates, and the fact that these came to me without me having to ask for them, made it a lot less stressful during the time my car was in the shop.  Juan (and I believe all the other staff who hold similar positions over there) also clearly understands all of the procedures, and deviations that can occur from these procedures, that are related to processing insurance claims and he was always able to answer any questions I had.

I got the vehicle back yesterday and the quality of the work is 1st class.  There is no way to tell that anything ever happened to the back of my car...it looks exactly as it did when I purchased it in late July.  I was particularly concerned about paint matching because all of the exterior damage was to the bumper (a plastic part) which had to be matched to the car body panels (metal parts).  Anyone who knows anything about paint and body work knows that it is a challenge to match paints on different substrates, and most body shops, even Prestigious, have disclaimers about this that are plainly visible in their offices.  I told them up front I was really concerned about this, and they said not to worry.  They were right....they did a dead-perfect color match in my case.  I have mild OCD and I notice even the smallest differences and defects in things, and I was 100% satisfied with the paint match, as well as the gap tolerances etc. on my repair.  If a place can meet my standards, it is going to far surpass most people's standards.

It sucked to get hit twice in two weeks, in a brand new car....but I am thrilled that I found this place as part of the deal.  I would take my vehicles here from now on and recommend them to anyone who wants a top quality job with serious attention paid to fit and finish.
