input: I am from Colorado and am visiting Santa Barbara and let me tell you... what a great place to eat. The food was quality, but the customer service was even better. Also, I thought the price was really good for the amount of food you get. Food came out fast as well. Overall, I'd say it's a great breakfast place if you are in Santa Barbara
Refine this for me please: As a visitor from Colorado, I must say that Santa Barbara offers an exceptional dining experience. The quality of the food surpassed my expectations, but what truly stood out was the impeccable customer service. In addition, the generous portions at such reasonable prices made for a satisfying meal. The prompt service also deserves praise, as our food arrived swiftly. Without a doubt, I highly recommend this establishment as a fantastic breakfast spot when in Santa Barbara.

input:
I stopped in for lunch one day after years of, 'I really need to try that place.'  I really like their layout.  They have an uncrowded floor of tables and booths and a lunch counter along one side.  The counter faces the cooks' area, which I like because the bustle of multiple grills, fryers, and prep areas serves as a good distraction, not to mention you get frequent interaction with the staff.  They were busy and getting everything done, but they weren't rude or frazzled, and I had a real sweet waitress.

I ordered the fried shrimp po boy dressed, and asked for a side of rebbeans instead of fries.  I almost had second thoughts on that because the burgers that they were cooking right in front of me looked and smelled so good.  I really have a difficult time resisting the grill.

The food was average and is what you would expect in a tourist spot in the Quarter.  They may get another star if I go back for one of them burgers.
Refine this for me please:
After years of hearing about this place, I finally decided to stop in for lunch one day. I was immediately impressed by their well-designed layout, featuring a spacious floor with plenty of tables, booths, and a lunch counter. The counter faced the cooks' area, which I found appealing as it allowed me to observe the bustling activity of multiple grills, fryers, and prep areas. This environment served as a delightful distraction while also enabling frequent interaction with the friendly staff who were busy managing everything.

As I perused the menu, I couldn't resist ordering the fried shrimp po boy dressed, and decided to switch things up and opt for a side of rebbeans instead of the typical fries. However, I couldn't help but be tempted by the mouthwatering burgers being cooked right in front of me. Resisting the allure of the grill proved to be quite a challenge for me.

When the food arrived, I found it to be average, meeting the expectations one would have for a popular tourist spot in the Quarter. However, I can't help but wonder if my rating would increase if I were to return and try one of their highly enticing burgers.

input:
these people are great.
through the years we've experienced everything and seen probably every doctor. these are true animal people, through and through, and you can always count on them for the best. not much else to say!
Refine this for me please: These individuals have consistently demonstrated greatness over the years. With our numerous encounters and visits to various doctors, they have proven themselves to be truly devoted to animals. You can always rely on them to provide the highest level of care. There is not much more to add, except that they are exceptional.

input: Great family restaurant feel. Po boys had the perfect bread. We had 3 different kinds and all were tasty. Mac 'n Cheese was good and a little spicy. Really fabulous service.
Refine this for me please: The ambiance of this restaurant is perfect for families. The po boys served here are exceptional, thanks to the delicious bread used. We tried three different varieties, and each of them was bursting with flavor. Additionally, the mac 'n cheese had a delightful kick of spice and was quite enjoyable. The service provided by the staff was truly remarkable, making our dining experience even more fantastic.

input:
This place was definitely the best dining experience I had in NOLA during my week-long trip! My husband and I walked in without reservations during their Sunday Jazz Brunch. We waited about 40 minutes, but we had the music and ambience to keep us occupied. 

Despite the place being ridiculously busy, our server didn't rush us at all. He encouraged us to take our time browsing the menu and placing our orders- definitely one of the friendliest servers I've encountered. 

The food here was absolutely amazing! The complimentary bread and butter was very nice. My husband and I started off with the seafood gumbo, and it was delicious! Both of us had a sea bass entree and it was definitely the best fish I've ever had. The fish came with a side of green beans and this DELICIOUS sauce that could make anything taste great. We finished off with chocolate orange ice cream and creme brûlée for dessert. The next table over was raving about their bread pudding, so I'm guessing dessert is usually a hit all around at this place. 

The coolest bit about my experience here was that my husband and I got seated where Ronald Reagan sat on his two visits to Mr. B's (far left corner)- Reagan just so happened to visit on my birthday! 

Our bill came out to be $100+ but it was worth every penny. If I'm in NOLA again, I'm definitely revisiting Mr. B's.
Refine this for me please:
During my week-long trip to NOLA, this place truly stood out as the best dining experience I had. Even though we arrived without reservations during their Sunday Jazz Brunch, my husband and I were willing to wait approximately 40 minutes, particularly because the lively music and inviting atmosphere kept us entertained.

Surprisingly, despite the overwhelming number of patrons, our server never made us feel rushed. On the contrary, he kindly encouraged us to take our time perusing the menu and placing our orders, which was quite refreshing and added to the overall enjoyment of our visit.

The food at this establishment was undeniably exceptional. To start, the complimentary bread and butter provided a wonderful introduction. We opted for the seafood gumbo as our appetizer, and it exceeded our expectations in terms of flavor and quality. For our main course, both of us selected the sea bass entree, and it proved to be the finest fish we had ever tasted. The sea bass was served alongside delectable green beans and an incredibly flavorful sauce that enhanced the taste of every bite. To conclude our meal, we indulged in the chocolate orange ice cream and creme brûlée for dessert. The table adjacent to ours was highly impressed by the bread pudding, suggesting that the desserts here are consistently delightful.

The most extraordinary aspect of our experience here was being seated in the exact spot where Ronald Reagan dined on his two visits to Mr. B's – coincidentally, these visits occurred on my birthday! This unexpected connection added an extra layer of significance to our dining experience.

While the bill amounted to $100+, we confidently perceived it as money well spent. Should I find myself in NOLA again, without a doubt, I will prioritize revisiting Mr. B’s.

input:
If you are visiting Indianapolis, I highly suggest this hotel. My boyfriend and I went just for one night and used his AAA discount which saved us a lot. They have a parking structure attached to the hotel for $20 a night. Starting at the garage they had such cool urban art that continue throughout our stay. The check in was an easy process and the service was amazing. Everywhere you turn there is another interesting piece of art work to look at. Our room was very nice, keurig coffee machine,large luxurious shower, comfy robes, and comfortable california king. We had tickets to the Pacers game which worked out perfectly. We had drinks and dinner before the game at Plat 99 which is in the hotel- again more great decor. They had a whole timeline of cocktails and complementary truffle popcorn. (they also had a really cool outdoor rooftop seating area for the bar, but was too cold and snowy to go out on) Bankers Field house was maybe 1 minute away walking. After the game we came back and got some drinks at Plat 99 again, it was pretty crowded, fun environment. For breakfast we ate at the Market Place downstairs, it was one set price for a buffet and had a lot of good food.

We checked out at 11am- very easy and the concierge was friendly and helpful. Before we left we spent about 30 minutes just walking around the hotel looking at all the art work, it is like a modern art museum. 

Overall we loved this hotel, for a quick getaway to Indianapolis, especially if you are going to a Pacers or Colts game, is was fantastic. Next time I go back to Indianapolis I will be staying here again.
Refine this for me please:
If you're visiting Indianapolis, I highly recommend this hotel. My boyfriend and I stayed for one night and took advantage of his AAA discount, which saved us a significant amount. The hotel has a convenient attached parking structure available for $20 per night. From the moment we arrived at the garage, we were greeted with captivating urban art that continued throughout our stay. The check-in process was easy and the service was exceptional. Everywhere we turned, we were met with intriguing artwork. Our room was wonderful, complete with a Keurig coffee machine, a spacious luxurious shower, comfortable robes, and a cozy California king bed.

We had tickets to a Pacers game, and the hotel's location was perfect for us. Before the game, we enjoyed drinks and dinner at Plat 99, a restaurant located within the hotel. Once again, the decor was fabulous, and we were impressed by their extensive cocktail menu and complementary truffle popcorn. Although the rooftop seating area was tempting, the cold and snowy weather prevented us from exploring it.

Bankers Fieldhouse was only a minute's walk away, making it incredibly convenient. After the game, we returned to Plat 99 for some more drinks. It was a lively and energetic atmosphere, albeit a bit crowded. For breakfast, we dined at the Market Place downstairs, where we found a delectable buffet with a variety of delicious options.

Checking out at 11 am was a breeze, and the concierge was friendly and helpful. Before leaving, we took some time to appreciate the hotel's extensive art collection, feeling as if we were strolling through a modern art museum.

Overall, we absolutely loved our experience at this hotel. It's perfect for a quick getaway to Indianapolis, especially if you're attending a Pacers or Colts game. We already know that on our next visit to Indianapolis, we'll be choosing this hotel again.

input:
Cashier was trying to put a beer on my to go order and I did not get the fish taco I ordered.

They have nice setting and the establishment seems to be fairly nice, it has got tvs, a bar, a number of tables in various sizes, and a downtown street patio complete with fire heaters for cold nights.

I had the sonoran dog and received two beef tacos that I did not ask for.  The tacos has scraps of beef with cilantro and onion.  They also have the regular styled tacos with tomatoes and lettuce.  The dog was the last one sitting the bin and a bit soggy.  Compared to truck dogs, it does not compare.  The tacos were simply bits of beef with onion and cilantro, nothing impressive and nothing like what is seen in the pictures.

Perhaps, my disappointing experience was due to how the place was packed, had a line out the door by the time I left, and was somewhat loud, but that is no excuse for the terrible eating experience.  They were starting to run out of the beef and dog that I ordered when I got in at the end of a fairly short line, i would hate to think how much worst if I came in a bit later for the dinner rush.
Refine this for me please:
The cashier mistakenly added a beer to my to-go order and I did not receive the fish taco I had ordered. Despite this, the establishment has a nice setting with TVs, a bar, various-sized tables, and a downtown street patio with fire heaters for chilly nights.

I opted for the Sonoran dog but received two beef tacos instead, which I didn't request. The tacos consisted of scraps of beef with cilantro and onion, while they also offer regular-style tacos with tomatoes and lettuce. The Sonoran dog I received was the last one remaining in the bin and was slightly soggy, lacking the quality of truck dogs. The tacos were underwhelming, simply consisting of small pieces of beef with onion and cilantro and not living up to the expectations set by their pictures.

Perhaps my disappointing experience can be attributed to the packed crowd, with a line out the door by the time I left, creating a somewhat loud atmosphere. However, this does not justify the overall poor dining experience. They were already running low on the beef and Sonoran dog that I ordered when I arrived, despite joining a fairly short line. I can only imagine how much worse it would be during the dinner rush if I had arrived a bit later.

input:
When I was preparing to write this review and give Sam's a particular number of stars, I encountered a dilemma.  Should my star rating be based upon comparing Sam's to all Sports Bars in which I have ever been?  Or, should it be a comparison to Nashville Sports Bars?

I chose the former:  compared to everywhere - because if you're from out of town that only seemed fair.  The sad news is that for a vibrant southeastern city where we have two professional sports teams, our sports bars kinda suck.

Sam's is honestly one of two great sports bars in the city.  I really like Sam's and I really like the patio in Spring, Summer, and early Autumn.  But, when compared to so many sports bars across the country in other cities of comparable size with their own sports' teams... Sam's is just mediocre.  

The service is always a toss up, and the ladies dressed in those referee outfits - could you not find some attractive Southern women to put on those booty shorts and v-cut referee shirts?  Some of the regular old-time employees who have been there since I was in undergrad - a decade ago - really should not be wearing tight clothes.  Wow.  That was just really mean.  I'm sorry.

The food is on the better side of bar fare.  But their beer selection could want for some better beers and a wider variety of selection.  The mixed drinks tend to be a bit weak, in my opinion.

But, hey, it's a bar.  It has lots of TVs and they play the game commentary over the speakers throughout the bar.  All and all, if you want to watch sports at a bar, then I would recommend Sam's.
Refine this for me please:
When I sat down to write this review and give Sam's a star rating, I faced a tough decision. Should my rating be based on comparing Sam's to all the sports bars I've ever been to, or should it be specific to Nashville sports bars?

After much thought, I decided to compare Sam's to sports bars from all over, as that seemed fair for out-of-town visitors. Unfortunately, despite being a vibrant southeastern city with two professional sports teams, the sports bars in Nashville aren't great.

Sam's, however, is one of the two standout sports bars in the city. I personally enjoy Sam's and especially love the patio during the Spring, Summer, and early Autumn. But in comparison to sports bars in other similarly-sized cities across the country, Sam's falls a bit short.

The service is hit or miss, and the waitresses in referee outfits aren't as attractive as one would hope. Perhaps they could consider hiring some attractive Southern women to wear those shorts and v-cut shirts. It was harsh of me to criticize the old-time employees who have been there for years, so I apologize for that.

The food at Sam's is better than your average bar fare, but their beer selection could use improvement. It would be nice to see a wider variety of beers and higher quality options. Additionally, the mixed drinks tend to be weak, in my opinion.

However, at the end of the day, it's still a sports bar. They have plenty of TVs, and the game commentary is played through the speakers in the entire bar. Overall, if you're looking for a place to watch sports, I would recommend Sam's.

input: Great location, great food, and friendly staff! There are only a few seats and the store gets pretty crowded with people waiting for their food. I saw a lot of online order ready to go at the counter and think that would be the smart move the next time I want to come during a weekday lunch rush. Weather permitting, it's great to grab some HCV and eat it in Rittenhouse Square across the street! I've come a few times with friends and coworkers and no one has complained about their choices (vegetarians and meat eaters alike)!
Refine this for me please: This place has an amazing location, offering great food and accommodating staff. However, due to its limited seating capacity, it tends to get crowded during peak hours, with customers waiting for their food. I noticed that many customers opt for online orders, which seems like a practical solution for those visiting during the busy lunch rush on weekdays. If the weather permits, it's a great idea to grab some HCV (presumably the restaurant's specialty) and enjoy it in the nearby Rittenhouse Square. I have personally visited multiple times with both vegetarian and meat-eating friends and coworkers, and everyone has been satisfied with their choices.

input: Absolute garbage company. Trying to get from Indy to Chicago and they are more than an hour late, did not inform me of the delay, and their entire customer policy (feel free to read it on the website) consists of "we cannot be held responsible for anything." Sitting at a bus stop with 20 people whom are all having their time wasted with absolutely no recourse.
Refine this for me please: This company is extremely irresponsible and inefficient. I am currently waiting at a bus stop with 20 other people, all of us wasting valuable time because this company failed to inform us about the over one-hour delay in our journey from Indy to Chicago. I highly recommend checking out their customer policy on their website, which conveniently states that they cannot be held accountable for any issues.

input: I'm glad that Michael & Lucy found a way to open up another family restaurant after years at Tony's on Linden (now closed following an ugly family dispute). The food is good and the prices are reasonable (ask about the slice and salad special). The Tuscany design is pleasant as are the owners (Lucy is always sweet and friendly). They have local beer on tap (Figueroa, Island Brew and others), 3 HD sports TVs inside, one HD sports TV outside for patio diners, a TV dedicated to surf videos and a TV dedicated to kids shows (and a classic old family friendly Ms Pac-Man game that was a hit with 2 kids when I was there). It's a tough location but I hope they make it work. Santa Claus Lane seems to be having a bit of a Renaissance after many years of being known mostly for outdated kitschy roadside attractions. Good luck!
Refine this for me please:
I'm delighted to hear that Michael and Lucy have managed to open a new family restaurant after their time at Tony's on Linden came to an unfortunate end due to a family dispute. The restaurant offers delicious food at reasonable prices, and I highly recommend asking about their slice and salad special. The Tuscany design creates a pleasant atmosphere, and the owners, especially Lucy, are always warm and friendly.

Not only do they have a variety of local beers on tap, including Figueroa and Island Brew, but they also provide ample entertainment options. Inside, there are three HD sports TVs, while the patio diners can enjoy their meals while watching sports on one HD TV located outside. Additionally, there is a dedicated TV for surf videos and another for kids shows. One highlight that I observed during my visit was their classic and family-friendly Ms. Pac-Man game, which was a hit with two kids.

While the location may present its challenges, I am optimistic that Michael and Lucy will find success. It's great to see Santa Claus Lane experiencing a renaissance after many years of being known for outdated kitschy roadside attractions. I wish them the best of luck!

input: Don't let the shopping center location deter you! Amazing place and even a more amazing staff. Curtis is the true epitome of great service. Loves his job and wants nothing more than for you to enjoy your dining experience. Try the scallops small plate, you won't regret it, but the whole dining experience is top notch.
Refine this for me please: Don't be discouraged by the shopping center location; this place is truly amazing, and the staff is even more phenomenal. Curtis, in particular, epitomizes outstanding service. He genuinely loves his job and goes above and beyond to ensure you have a fantastic dining experience. I highly recommend trying the scallops small plate – it's absolutely delightful. However, the entire dining experience, from start to finish, is truly first-rate.

input: Awesome! Loved this place. Great little breakfast joint easy walk south of route 90. Easy walk from French Quarter and surrounding areas. We got the bananas foster and it was incredible. Great decorations and colorful setting that feels like how you'd expect New Orleans to feel. Highly recommend.
Refine this for me please: I thoroughly enjoyed my experience at this place - it was truly awesome! This hidden gem is a charming breakfast joint conveniently located just a short walk south of route 90. It is also within easy walking distance from the French Quarter and other surrounding areas. The highlight of our visit was the delectable bananas foster dish, which was absolutely incredible. The ambiance of the restaurant is both vibrant and beautifully decorated, capturing the essence of New Orleans perfectly. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a fantastic dining experience.

input:
Great birthday cakes...I mean it.
  BUT: The cupcakes and cookies out front tend to be stale at times...although when I have complained they made good on everything. 
  I will go back!
Refine this for me please: I highly recommend their birthday cakes, they truly are great. However, it's worth mentioning that occasionally the cupcakes and cookies at the front are stale. Nevertheless, the customer service is excellent and they always resolve any issues promptly when brought to their attention. Despite this minor flaw, I will definitely be returning in the future.

input:
Service was a bit slow for Saturday lunch but not unacceptable. Understandable as a new place gets its feet under it. I tried to go Friday night and it was a total mess. Long line and nobody taking names. We left. 

The margarita was great. I had the cilantro chicken enchiladas. Also great! The outdoor seating area was very pleasant under the umbrellas on a lovely Saturday afternoon. 

Overall, I liked it. They just need a bit more time to figure out the flow. I'm thrilled to see something affordable move into my neighborhood. The prices are very reasonable and this place isn't trying to be "casual fancy" like the last two train wrecks that occupied this space.

Hope Loco thrives for years to come!
Refine this for me please:
The service during Saturday lunch was a bit slow, but it was understandable as the restaurant is new and still finding its footing. On the other hand, when I attempted to visit on Friday night, it was chaotic with a long line and nobody organizing the waitlist, so my party left.

However, I can't praise the margarita enough. It was excellent. I opted for the cilantro chicken enchiladas, and they were also delicious. The outdoor seating area was pleasant, especially with the umbrellas providing shade on a lovely Saturday afternoon.

Overall, I enjoyed my experience at the restaurant. They just need some more time to streamline their processes. It's exciting to have an affordable option in my neighborhood. The prices are reasonable, and this establishment isn't trying to be overly pretentious like the previous failed attempts at this location.

Here's hoping Loco thrives and becomes a long-standing presence in the area!

input:
I've been going here now for a couple of months. I have never received more compliments on my nails then I have since seeing Nary! 

I love all the girls that work there, and we all banter amongst each other, and the other clients as well. No more sitting in silence while I get my nails done!! Yay!

I recommend making an appointment! This is not a dime a dozen nail salon! They offer the newest designs and jewels that so many others don't, and because of that, it's busy. You can walk in, but prepare to sit and wait. And if you want crazy encrusted nails, you can get them here! But you'll pay for what you want, so if you're on a budget throw out your number from the beginning so you aren't shocked at check out. 

See you ladies in 2 weeks!!
Refine this for me please:
I have been a loyal customer at this nail salon for the past couple of months and I am extremely satisfied with the results. Since seeing Nary, I have received an abundance of compliments on my nails - more than ever before! 

One of the things I appreciate about this salon is the friendly atmosphere created by the amazing staff, including the banter among each other and with clients. Gone are the days of sitting in silence while getting my nails done! It's a lively and enjoyable experience. 

I highly recommend making an appointment at this salon as it offers much more than your average nail salon. They provide the latest designs and embellishments that many others do not. However, be prepared for a busy salon. While you can walk in, expect some waiting time. Additionally, if you desire extravagant nails with lots of jewels, this is the place for you. Keep in mind that the price reflects the quality, so it's important to communicate your budget from the beginning to avoid surprises at checkout. 

Looking forward to seeing my fellow ladies in 2 weeks!

input: A definite go-to place if you're in Treasure Island! Love the char-grilled oysters!  Great staff!  Big outdoor seating area and best yet, it's pet friendly so bring your pup!!!  Coming from Austin where pets are accepted everywhere this is a real bonus for me!
Refine this for me please: If you find yourself in Treasure Island, this place is an absolute must-visit! The char-grilled oysters are exceptional and the staff is friendly and attentive. The highlight is the spacious outdoor seating area which is perfect for socializing. What sets this place apart is its pet-friendly policy, so don't forget to bring your furry friend along! As someone who is accustomed to pets being accepted everywhere in Austin, this is a delightful bonus for me.

input: Lots and lots of mostly fried seafood. Surprisingly expensive for a working class joint. It's the kind of place a dock worker would take his family for a fancy meal and not feel out of place. And it's definitely a New Orleans sort of experience. But the food isn't that great.
Refine this for me please: A New Orleans-inspired seafood joint offering an extensive menu featuring mainly fried seafood. Surprisingly pricy for its working-class vibe, it's a restaurant where dock workers can treat their families to a slightly upscale meal without feeling out of place. However, the food falls short of its expected greatness.

input: This place came highly recommended from some family that has been here many times. Service was fast and friendly even though they were extremely busy. Food was very tasty with mostly basic fare for breakfast.  The Cajun tasso omelet was fantastic. Not too spicy but just enough. Hash browns were fluffy and delicious. Other food at the table was French toast and eggs over medium. Everybody left satisfied and full. Will def come back for more next visit.
Refine this for me please: This place was strongly recommended by family members who are frequent visitors. Despite being incredibly busy, the service was fast and friendly. The food, while mostly simple breakfast options, was delicious. In particular, the Cajun tasso omelet stood out - it had the perfect amount of spice. The hash browns were fluffy and incredibly tasty. Other dishes ordered at the table included French toast and eggs over medium, and everyone left feeling satisfied and full. I will definitely be returning for more during my next visit.

input: I came here with a group of four and had a great experience. There are tons of interesting appetizers to try--we had dumplings with corn and mushrooms, wings, and some specials that are escaping me. Each of us also got an order of noodles. These are not chinatown noodle house portions, but they also aren't chinatown noodle house ingredients. Interesting, fresh, and tasty. Plus its a great deal and BYO to boot. Great addition to 10th street!
Refine this for me please: I came here with a group of four people and we had an amazing experience. The variety of appetizers available was impressive. Some of the appetizers we tried were the delicious dumplings filled with corn and mushrooms, flavorful wings, and other daily specials that I can't quite remember. In addition to the appetizers, each of us ordered a serving of noodles. The portions were not as generous as those found in a typical Chinatown noodle house, but the quality of the ingredients used more than made up for it. The dishes were interesting, fresh, and incredibly tasty. Another great aspect of this place is the reasonable prices, and you can also bring your own drinks. Overall, it's a fantastic addition to 10th street.

input: Best sandwiches in St.Louis! Could eat here everyday. Always a very friendly crowd when I come and eat here.
Refine this for me please: The sandwiches at this St. Louis establishment are truly exceptional and have the potential to become a daily indulgence. Besides the exceptional food, the consistently friendly and welcoming crowd adds to the overall pleasant dining experience.

input:
A great lunch or dinner stop in Reno, NV.  

We've had some fine meals in this establishment......Tyler (manager) does a great job with his staff, and it shows in the overall results.

They are also a pub, so its got a great selection of beers and wines too!
Refine this for me please:
For an exceptional lunch or dinner experience in Reno, NV, look no further than this esteemed establishment. The moment you step in, you will be greeted by Tyler, the exceptional manager who leads his staff with excellence. The results speak for themselves, as the quality of their meals is consistently top-notch. 

Not only does this establishment excel in their culinary offerings, but it also boasts a pub ambiance, complete with an impressive selection of delectable beers and wines.

input:
As a childless woman I wasn't sure how I was going to enjoy my experience here but I give the good folks at Chuck E Cheese credit....they do run a fairly tight ship. There are lots of staff running around both on the floors and behind the counters so whether you need to order another sample platter or get a refund after a machine ate your token you will never be stuck waiting too long. There is also staff at the door and they do stamp the kids to make sure they don't wander away on their own or with somebody they do not know.

I like that all the games here are just one token. There are also quite a few different types of games available from Arcade style to games of chance. One thing I did notice is that the game area is larger then the play area which means your kiddo's are more likely to want to spend their time here and your likely going to be reaching for your wallet on more then one occasion.

There was a decent amount of food sent to our birthday party table and even with six kids and five adults there was still pizza left over. I did find the birthday area to be a little crowded and we did on more then one instance accidentally back our chairs into people from the neighboring party table. 

The staff here were great and very attentive making sure all the special birthday rock stars were well looked after. I don't know how many times I would really need to come into a place like this as I don't have that many friends with kids but it was great to see them enjoying themselves as well as reliving some fond memories from my own trips to Chuck E Cheese as a little girl.
Refine this for me please:
As a woman without children, I was initially uncertain about how much I would enjoy my experience at Chuck E Cheese. However, I must give credit to the competent staff who clearly maintain a well-organized establishment. There are numerous employees bustling around both on the floors and behind the counters, ensuring that you never have to wait too long for assistance, whether it's ordering another sample platter or securing a refund after a token-eating mishap. Additionally, there are staff members stationed at the entrance who vigilantly stamp the children to prevent them from wandering off with strangers.

I appreciate that all the games here only require one token. Furthermore, there is a wide variety of game types available, ranging from arcade-style to chance-based games. One observation I made is that the game area is larger than the play area, which means that your kids are more likely to want to spend their time here, resulting in frequent trips to your wallet.

During our birthday party, an ample amount of food was provided and despite having six kids and five adults, there was still leftover pizza. However, I did find the birthday area to be a bit crowded, and on multiple occasions, we accidentally bumped our chairs into people from the neighboring party table.

The staff at Chuck E Cheese were fantastic and highly attentive, ensuring that all the birthday celebrants were well taken care of. Although I may not have many opportunities to visit a place like this since I don't have many friends with kids, it was heartwarming to witness them thoroughly enjoying themselves and reminisce about my own childhood memories at Chuck E Cheese.

input: This was such a nice change from the other restaurants. Simple fresh organic food.  Full coffee, latte, etc options. Sasquatch brew is delicious. Also, very nice ambiance. Casual, relaxed, and comfortable. The owners are amazing and friendly.
Refine this for me please: This restaurant was a delightful departure from the others I've been to. They specialize in serving simple, fresh, and organic food that exceeds expectations. Additionally, their beverage selection, including coffee, latte, and other choices, is comprehensive and satisfying. One standout is their delicious Sasquatch brew. The ambiance of the place is incredibly pleasant, creating a casual, relaxed, and comfortable atmosphere. Moreover, the owners are truly remarkable, as they consistently go above and beyond to make guests feel welcome and appreciated.

input: Delicious! Best place around for ice cream . Everything is made fresh from cows without hormones and antibiotics . It's cash only, but it's worth the trip to the ATM.
Refine this for me please: Delicious! This is undoubtedly the ultimate ice cream destination in the area. They pride themselves on serving only the freshest ice cream made exclusively from hormone and antibiotic-free cows. While it's important to note that they accept cash only, rest assured that a trip to the nearby ATM is absolutely worthwhile to experience the delightful flavors offered here.

input:
This was our second choice after finding out Rio Mar was closed for Mardi Gras week. We had a hell of a time getting here since it was on the other side of the parade from where we were staying.
   Nonetheless, we had a great meal. 
    Service was spot on. Professional but not overbearing or obvious. 
    A little disappointed that they were out of two ingredients for one of their signature cocktails, but it WAS the day before Mardi Gras.
   The bread and butter at the table was excellent. Crunchy outside, soft inside.
   The beets salad was so much better and different from similarly named items at other restaurants. The greens literally tasted like they had been picked from a sun warmed field minutes before.
    G's Choucroute was a meaty fiesta. He loved it. My crab ravioli was lovely with a delicate Meyer lemon sauce. 
    Bread pudding for dessert was just how we like it - sans raisins.
    Truly a memorable meal. Way better than most hotel restaurants.
Refine this for me please:
This was our second choice after discovering that Rio Mar was closed for Mardi Gras week. Despite the difficulties we faced in getting here, being on the opposite side of the parade from our accommodation, we still had a great time.

The service was impeccable - professional without being overbearing or obvious. It is worth noting that we were slightly disappointed that they were out of two ingredients for one of their popular cocktails, but considering it was the day before Mardi Gras, it was understandable.

The bread and butter served at our table were excellent, with a crunchy exterior and soft interior. The beet salad stood out from similar dishes at other restaurants, with the greens tasting incredibly fresh, as if they were picked moments before from a sun-warmed field.

G's Choucroute was a flavorful and meaty delight, and he thoroughly enjoyed it. My crab ravioli was equally delightful, complemented by a delicate Meyer lemon sauce.

For dessert, the bread pudding was just how we liked it - without any raisins. It concluded the meal perfectly.

Overall, this dining experience was truly memorable and surpassed our expectations, surpassing the quality of most hotel restaurants.

input: Found 51st Deli on Uber Eats and we loved it!!! I can't wait to check it out in person!
Refine this for me please: Discovered 51st Deli on Uber Eats and we absolutely adored it! I'm eagerly anticipating the opportunity to visit the place in person.

input: The Honey Apple grilled cheese sandwich is totally to die for! I never been more happy to eat a grilled cheese sandwich in my life! The staff is friendly, the decor is cool and hip, and the food is great. The Meltdown in Montgomeryville does not compare. The service is rude and the decor is too futuristic/weird. I had my server throw my sandwich at me and splash another customer with soup at Montgomeryville. Regardless of then other shops, I love meltdown it really helps a cheese lover out!
Refine this for me please:
Let me help you refine your statement:

"The Honey Apple grilled cheese sandwich at Meltdown is absolutely amazing! I have never been happier to eat a grilled cheese sandwich in my life. The staff is extremely friendly, the decor is cool and hip, and the overall food experience is excellent. In comparison, The Meltdown in Montgomeryville falls short. The service there is rude, and the decor is just too futuristic and weird for my taste. To make matters worse, during my visit, my server threw my sandwich at me and even splashed soup on another customer. Despite these disappointing experiences at other shops, Meltdown remains my favorite. It truly caters to cheese lovers like me."

input:
They have combination deals that make rolls and sushi super cheap! The rolls are definitely on the smaller side, so you'll need to order up on the combination deal if you want to get full. Sashimi was actually more fresh than I thought it would be, considering the price! 

Also, the joint is sort of small, and the service is slow, but the place is BYO, so you can just head downstairs and bring up some beers while you're waiting.
Refine this for me please:
They offer great combination deals that make rolls and sushi extremely affordable! The rolls, although small in size, can be satisfying if you order from their combination deal options. Surprisingly, the sashimi is quite fresh, surpassing my initial expectations given its affordable price.

It's worth noting that the restaurant is on the smaller side, and the service can be a bit slow. However, the advantage is that it is a BYO establishment, allowing you to conveniently bring your own beer from downstairs while waiting.

input: The food was good, service was horrible. I ordered orange juice for my kids and waited till we were almost done eating then finally got the juices. They take cash or checks only. Everything else was OK, but they could do a little bit better on their service.
Refine this for me please: The food at the restaurant was enjoyable, but unfortunately, the service was quite poor. Specifically, I had ordered orange juice for my children, and we had to wait until we were nearly finished with our meal before we received the juices. Additionally, it is worth noting that they only accept cash or checks as payment methods. While everything else was satisfactory, there is definitely room for improvement when it comes to their service.

input:
After coming here for many years, I was very disappointed by my last trip. The one place you never cut corners is in the food, and that's exactly what they did. 2 of the 3 salsas were so watery that you didn't get any tomatillo or tomato on your chip, at all. The third salsa, the pics de gallo, was the worst chop job I've ever seen in a restaurant. Huge pieces of Serrano pepper with varying sizes of everything else, and in stark contrast to the other 2, completely dried out. 

Without even looking at the menu, I know what I want... #15. That decision hasn't changed for over 10 years. Today I should have made a different choice. I'm not sure if they recently went thru a purveyor change but the quality of everything on the plate was horrible. 

I used to love the rice, it changed. I used to love the chicken quesadilla, now it's flavorless and covered in 2 lbs of cheese for 1/2 a breast.

Please go back to your old ways and cut costs elsewhere, other than the food.
Refine this for me please:
After being a loyal customer for many years, the disappointment I experienced during my last visit was truly disheartening. The one aspect where they should never compromise, the food, fell short this time. Two out of three salsas were excessively watery, devoid of the rich flavors of tomatillo and tomato that should accompany every chip. As for the third salsa, the pico de gallo, it was an utter failure in terms of preparation. The restaurant seemed to have completely overlooked the basic principles of chopping, resulting in disproportionately sized chunks of Serrano pepper and other ingredients. To add insult to injury, this salsa was completely dried out, a stark contrast to the other two.

Without even glancing at the menu, I am always certain about my choice - #15. This decision has remained unchanged for over a decade. However, on this regretful day, I should have ventured towards a different option. Whether they recently switched suppliers or not, the quality of every item on the plate was abysmal.

I used to relish the rice, but it is now a far cry from its former glory. The chicken quesadilla, which used to burst with flavor, has now become bland and drowned in an excessive amount of cheese, overshadowing the taste of a mere half-breast portion.

I implore the establishment to revert back to their previous practices and find ways to reduce costs that do not compromise the quality of their food.

input: Just got 2 tattoos at Stigma today and I am so happy! I went there because they have good reviews and their website is good. I got a cluster or roses on my shoulder with some "brush strokes" of color on them. My tattoo artist is Eddie. He is very friendly and fun! He did exactly like I asked. He is a very good artist. His line work is perfect and so I will be going back to him for more. I have a bad back (bulging and hemorrhaged discs) and sometimes I can't sit in the same place for long periods of time. Eddie was very helpful and accommodating with that. While I was there I talked to pretty much every employee there. The entire staff are really friendly. It's a cool place to be. I did a Yelp check-in and got $10 off! How cool is that?! On the website I saw that the owner, Chino developed his own tattoo ointment. He said that he just wasn't very happy with the other stuff that's out there because they are petroleum product so he did a ton of research and developed his own. It has ingredients like sunflower and soybean oil, lavender, beeswax, vitamin E, Shea and cocoa butter. I bought some and it is indeed very soothing. If you are looking to get inked, go here. You will be in good hands with some great artists and you will be just as happy as I am right now.
Refine this for me please:
I recently got two tattoos at Stigma and I couldn't be happier! After reading their positive reviews and visiting their impressive website, I decided to give them a try. I chose to have a cluster of roses with subtle brush strokes of color on my shoulder. Eddie, my tattoo artist, was incredibly friendly and fun to work with. He executed my vision perfectly and his skill as an artist really shined through with flawless line work. I definitely plan on returning to him for future tattoos.

One of the challenges I face due to my bad back (bulging and hemorrhaged discs) is discomfort from sitting in one position for extended periods of time. However, Eddie was extremely understanding and accommodating, which I greatly appreciated. During my time at Stigma, I had the opportunity to chat with several of the employees and they were all equally friendly and welcoming. The atmosphere of the studio is very cool and inviting.

As an added bonus, I received $10 off for checking in on Yelp, which I thought was pretty awesome. While browsing their website, I discovered that the owner, Chino, has developed his own tattoo ointment. He mentioned being dissatisfied with other petroleum-based products on the market, prompting him to do extensive research and create his own formula. The ointment contains ingredients like sunflower and soybean oil, lavender, beeswax, vitamin E, Shea butter, and cocoa butter. I decided to try it out and can confirm that it provides soothing relief.

If you're considering getting a tattoo, I highly recommend choosing Stigma. The talented artists, including Eddie, will ensure you're in good hands, and the overall experience will leave you just as thrilled as I am right now.

input: This place is a lot of fun. I like that there is a outdoor patio with hip hop music and indoor dance area with salsa . If you need a change in tunes or scenery , just move !
Refine this for me please: This place offers a lot of enjoyable experiences. I appreciate the presence of an outdoor patio with lively hip hop music, as well as an indoor dance area featuring salsa. If you feel like switching up the music or surroundings, simply relocate!

input:
Had not been for years.

We went for lunch. Great decor. Great wait staff. Personable and on the ball.

My bud had the fish special, serving was a bit small but delish he said.

I had the fattoush salad with chicken. Spicing was everything it should be. The chicken was good, just that. The lettuce was limp and so was the pita. Not an olive in sight.

Pricey, especially for lunch. We will not be rushing back.
Refine this for me please:
After years of absence, we finally decided to go for lunch. The restaurant had a great decor and the wait staff were exceptional, personable, and attentive.

My friend tried the fish special and despite the small serving size, he found it absolutely delicious.

As for me, I opted for the fattoush salad with chicken. The spices used in the dish were spot on, giving it the right amount of flavor. However, the chicken itself was just average and the lettuce and pita were disappointingly limp. Additionally, there was a noticeable absence of olives in the salad.

Considering the quality and portion size, the price for lunch was quite steep. Based on this experience, we have no plans to return to this establishment anytime soon.

input: Our animals are an extension of our family.  So, we aren't going to take them to any old place for boarding, grooming and medical examinations.  I'm a big fan of the Animal Clinic because they treat the pets as if they were their own pets.  You can't ask for any more.  I would have given them 5* but the location is a little difficult to get out of when leaving.
Refine this for me please: Our animals are an essential part of our family, and therefore, we are very selective when it comes to choosing a boarding, grooming, and medical facility for them. That's why I highly recommend the Animal Clinic. What sets them apart is their exceptional care and treatment of pets, as if they were their own. It's truly remarkable. Though I would have given them a perfect rating of 5 stars, the only downside is the slightly inconvenient location that makes it a bit challenging to depart from.

input: Literally, the worst Taco Bell I have ever been to. The restaurant is filthy, the service is awful, and they didn't make any of our order correctly, and really, how hard is that?  I won't be back and if I were you I would find a different place to go.
Refine this for me please: This Taco Bell location was truly awful. The restaurant was disgustingly unclean, the service left much to be desired, and to top it off, they couldn't even get our order right. I mean, seriously, how difficult is it to make a simple order? Needless to say, I won't be returning, and I strongly advise you to seek an alternative dining option.

input:
I like the Neuvo-Latino-Americano grub here.  The place has moved locations and is now a bit larger.  Chips & Salsa are always fresh 7 tasty, too.

I wish I could give a more substanital review but I ate here so long ago - and at the old location - so I'd better just keep my mouth shut.
Refine this for me please:
I thoroughly enjoy the Nuevo-Latino-American cuisine offered at this establishment. The recent relocation has resulted in a more spacious venue, which is a positive change. Additionally, their chips and salsa are consistently fresh and delicious.

Unfortunately, I am unable to provide a more comprehensive review as my dining experience occurred quite a while ago, and it took place at their previous location. Therefore, it might be best for me to refrain from sharing further opinions.

input: Found Player's while driving by. Everyone is very friendly. The service is great. Atmosphere is very relaxed. Great experience overall. Oh and a great shave and cut for a great price!
Refine this for me please: Came across Player's while driving and had a fantastic experience. The staff was exceptionally friendly, offering great service in a relaxed atmosphere. The prices for their top-notch shave and haircut were also very reasonable. Overall, a thoroughly enjoyable experience at Player's.

input: terrible food and the manager was shockingly rude when I tried to return my food. I had the frogs legs and they were rubbery and tasted awful. I was disgusted by her behavior and she should be ashamed of herself. I have never been treated more horribly by someone.
Refine this for me please: The food at the restaurant was incredibly disappointing, and to make matters worse, the manager's behavior towards me when I attempted to return my meal was shockingly rude. I ordered the frogs legs, which not only were rubbery in texture but also had an unbearable taste. I was truly appalled by the manager's conduct, and it seemed evident that she lacked any sense of professionalism or customer service. I believe her behavior was disgraceful and it is disheartening that I have seldom encountered such terrible treatment from someone in any setting.

input:
The location is pretty random (at the end of a long winding road with a bunch of other hotel off of the highway with no food nearby) and the building has seen better days.  

My room featured an unclean floor, torn wallpaper, dusty bathroom vents, and water spots in the bathroom.  The hallways might remind one of "red rum" and the building itself is ugly showing it's age as a product of the 70s (as am I so I can judge).

The bed was comfortable and the room serviceable but it was disappointing as I have grown accustomed to a higher level of quality in my Doubletree experience throughout the country.
Refine this for me please:
The location may be considered somewhat arbitrary, as it is situated at the end of a meandering road alongside various other hotels adjacent to the highway, devoid of any nearby dining options. Moreover, the building exhibits a worn-out appearance, having definitely witnessed better days.

Upon entering my room, I couldn't help but notice a lack of cleanliness, evident in the dirty flooring, tattered wallpaper, and bathroom vents tainted with dust. Additionally, the bathroom displayed unsightly water stains. The hallways possess an eerie ambiance, reminiscent of the infamous "red rum" scene, while the structure itself, a product of the 70s era (much like myself), proudly exhibits its dated aesthetics.

Though I must acknowledge the comfort of the bed and the functional nature of the room, overall, the experience proved to be disheartening. Given my familiarity with the Doubletree brand and the elevated level of quality I have come to expect from their properties nationwide, this particular establishment fell short of meeting those expectations.

input:
The hotel is beautifully done. It has a boutique feel and not like just a normal hotel like the Hilton. I had my birthday party there at the restaurant and it was so very nice. The service was wonderful and the rooms are beautiful. The air conditioner was pretty loud in our room but that is my only complaint. It's very close to Printers Alley which is so cool! 
I would definitely stay in this hotel again!
Refine this for me please: The hotel is meticulously designed, exuding a charming boutique atmosphere that sets it apart from conventional establishments like the Hilton. I celebrated my birthday at the hotel's restaurant, and the experience was nothing short of delightful. The service was exceptional, and the rooms were exquisitely decorated. The only drawback was the slightly noisy air conditioner in our room, but it was a minor inconvenience. Additionally, the hotel's proximity to the vibrant Printers Alley added to its allure. Without a doubt, I would choose to stay at this hotel again in the future.

input:
Cool spot in a great location.
We got there early, so didn't have the same crushing crowds others have talked about.
The bartenders are awesome.
Made me a Perfect Rye Manhattan on the rocks, never had one before...I'm hooked.
Easily the best burger I've ever had!
Will absolutely be back
Refine this for me please: The spot is exceptionally cool, situated in an excellent location. Arriving early was a smart decision as we managed to avoid the overwhelming crowds that previous visitors have mentioned. The bartenders deserve high praise as they were remarkable. They skillfully concocted a Perfect Rye Manhattan on the rocks for me, a drink I had never tried before, and now I'm completely charmed. Furthermore, I cannot emphasize enough how outstanding the burger was – it undeniably takes the top spot as the best burger I have ever tasted. Without a doubt, I will be returning to this fantastic establishment.

input: Excellent food and excellent service!  My new favorite breakfast place. I loved the biscuits and gravy, extra crispy bacon, sausage links and challah French toast!
Refine this for me please: The food and service at this breakfast place are truly exceptional! It has quickly become my favorite spot for breakfast. Their biscuits and gravy, extra crispy bacon, sausage links, and challah French toast are absolutely delicious.

input: We hired Terra as the florist for our wedding and were very pleased with her work. We liked that she took the time to run through the venue with my husband and really tried to understand our needs and accommodate our budget. The florals for the wedding came out beautiful and we loved the draping for the ceremony and the reception. The only concern we had was that some of flowers in the bride's and the bridesmaids' bouquets started wilting during the day, but we understand that it is because the flowers were in full bloom and it could also have been due to the heat. Overall, we were happy we found Terra for our wedding!
Refine this for me please: We were extremely satisfied with Terra's role as our wedding florist. She went above and beyond by taking the time to survey the venue with my husband, listening attentively to our preferences, and working within our budget. The outcome was absolutely stunning - the floral arrangements for both the ceremony and reception were beautiful. The draping added an extra touch of elegance that we adored. The only minor issue we encountered was that some of the flowers in the bride's and bridesmaids' bouquets wilted throughout the day. However, we understand this may have been due to the blossoms being in full bloom and the warmth of the day. Despite this small setback, we are thrilled to have discovered Terra for our wedding.

input: Excellent healthy options for NOLA dining with lots of to go choices. I had turkey meatballs and spaghetti. It is a wonderful lunch place.
Refine this for me please: Discover fantastic and wholesome dining options in New Orleans (NOLA) featuring an array of convenient to-go choices. One standout lunch spot, in particular, offers delectable turkey meatballs served with spaghetti, proving to be an excellent and satisfying choice. The combination of nutritious ingredients and flavors make it an outstanding destination for health-conscious dining in the city.

input: This is everything I want in take out food - fresh, yummy, and relatively healthy. I also love that there is a good to go place in Northern Liberties that is convenient - there is not enough of that!
Refine this for me please: This take out food has everything I desire - it is fresh, delicious, and reasonably healthy. Moreover, I greatly appreciate the presence of a convenient to-go place in Northern Liberties, as such options are unfortunately scarce.

input:
We had an alumni event here and I really enjoyed it. It's dimly lit, very cozy inside - it's decorated kind of like an old library. It was a great quiet,casual spot if you're looking for a low key place to have good drinks. 

They have a few beers and wines, but we focused mostly on the happy hour cocktails - moscow mules, old fashioneds, etc. Everyone loved theirs, no complaints!
Refine this for me please:
I thoroughly enjoyed attending an alumni event held at this establishment. The ambiance is charming with its dim lighting and cozy interior, reminiscent of an antiquated library. If you are seeking a relaxed and unpretentious setting to enjoy excellent beverages, this venue is perfect.

While they offer a modest selection of beers and wines, we primarily indulged in their happy hour cocktails, such as Moscow Mules and Old Fashioneds. I am delighted to report that everyone in our group thoroughly enjoyed their drinks, with no grievances or disappointments to be found.

input: The burgers are amazing! French fries are decent (so get the onion rings).
Refine this for me please: The burgers are absolutely amazing! While the French fries are decent, I highly recommend trying their onion rings for a truly delightful side option.

input: Ive eaten there twice and both times it was terrible. Steak was salty, fish dry, my salad was frozen , service awful. . Im really not sure how this place gets any good reviews.
Refine this for me please: I have personally dined at that restaurant on two separate occasions, and unfortunately, both times left much to be desired. The steak I ordered was excessively salty, the fish I tried was dry and overcooked, and to my surprise, even the salad I had was noticeably frozen. Additionally, the service I experienced was quite disappointing. After these underwhelming experiences, I am truly perplexed as to how this establishment manages to receive any positive reviews.

input: Even after finding many great Spanish restaurants in the country (mostly NYC), Modesto is still one of my favorite Spanish place to eat.  This place is really good!  Too bad I don't live near St. Louis anymore since this is one of the places that I miss.
Refine this for me please: Despite my discovery of numerous excellent Spanish restaurants in the country, particularly in NYC, Modesto remains one of my preferred establishments for enjoying Spanish cuisine. The quality of their food is truly outstanding! It's unfortunate that I no longer reside near St. Louis, as this is one of the places I sincerely miss.

input:
Wow what a terrible spa. I can only speak for the manicure/pedicure aspect because I did not get a massage. Typically, you go to a spa to escape and relax - you can not do that here. It is small, dirty, and the staff is terrible. 

I walked in and the receptionist was on the phone - he did acknowledge that I was standing there, but several staff walked by and did not offer to assist. Finally, after two other guests came in behind me, someone came up and took me back - just to get me out of the way. Asked what my name was and left. Did not offer me water/refreshments of any kind. I've had better reception at the local nail salon. Then I had to wait for 10-15 minutes for my technician to finish up her current client, which I didn't mind because I leisurely picked out my color. When it was my turn, the nail technician was shaky and rushed. She cut my cuticle and I bled. She was sick and kept blowing her nose into her shirt (gross!!) and took time outs to really blow/dig in her nose with a tissue right in front of me! Lady, you are touching my hands with yours, you are blowing bacteria into the air, if you are that sick don't come to work - *Management, if your employee is that sick do not make them come in! You will lose clients. 

She gave me the worst hand/arm massage I have ever had (that is usually everyone's favorite part, and the technician's opportunity to shine!). No pressure was applied, and she just basically rubbed lotion into my skin and made a snarky comment about how my skin was so dry is was just "drinking up all the lotion." Yes, I realize it's dry, probably due to the 20 degree weather and wind outside, but thank you for making me feel self-conscious. 

When I went to leave the receptionist was on the phone again, but did actually put them on hold to get me out of there. I opted to put everything on my room charge, which resulted in extra fees but I didn't care. There was a blaring sign saying how they preferred cash gratuity and that there would be extra fees associated with putting services on your room. Yes, everyone prefers cash gratuity - but how tacky can you be?!! 

Overall, it was an extremely disappointing experience. I have been wanting to stay at the Monteleone for years and made it a priority to experience their salon. My gel nail polish is already chipping and it hasn't even been a week. Spa Aria definitely needs a overhaul and I would recommend you go anywhere else but here.
Refine this for me please:
