If you're that sick, please don't come to work. And to the management, don't make your sick employees come in if you want to retain clients.

To make matters worse, the hand/arm massage I received was the worst I've ever had. Usually, that's everyone's favorite part and an opportunity for the technician to shine, but not in this case. No pressure was applied, and she simply rubbed lotion into my skin. She even made a snarky comment about how dry my skin was, making me feel self-conscious. Yes, I know it's dry, probably due to the cold weather outside, but thanks for pointing it out in such a rude manner.

Upon leaving, the receptionist was on the phone again, but he did put them on hold to check me out. I opted to put everything on my room charge, despite the extra fees associated with it. The spa had a sign blatantly requesting cash gratuity and warning about additional charges for using the room charge option. While I understand that cash gratuity is preferred, it was tacky of them to display it so prominently.

Overall, the whole experience was extremely disappointing. I've wanted to stay at the Monteleone for years and made it a priority to try their salon. However, Spa Aria was a major letdown. To avoid a similar experience, I strongly recommend going anywhere else instead. Additionally, my gel nail polish is already chipping, and it hasn't even been a week. Spa Aria is definitely in need of a major overhaul.

input: I got the hot shave and it did not disappoint. They do 6 towels and a facial massage with oils in between. Great shave, great environment.
Refine this for me please: I opted for the hot shave and it truly exceeded my expectations. The experience entailed a superb treatment involving the use of six towels along with a rejuvenating facial massage using essential oils. The shave itself was impeccable, complemented by an exceptional atmosphere.

input: We've been going to this place since it opened and it's always decent, not to mention super fast! TdM is owned by Subway and has a similar feel to it, but I think the quality is much better than Subway. It's a build-your-own burrito and taco place and the ingredients are always fresh and well-stocked. I usually eat vegetarian, so there are plenty of options for me to eat. I always get a veggie burrito and load it up with lots of veggies! I also like their chips and "medium" salsa. If ever around Delgado, check out Taco del Mar!
Refine this for me please: Since its opening, we have frequented Taco del Mar and have always been pleased with the experience. The service is exceedingly quick, which is a major plus. While the restaurant is owned by Subway and has a similar ambiance, I find the overall quality to be far superior. Taco del Mar follows a build-your-own style for both burritos and tacos, and their selection of fresh and well-stocked ingredients is consistently impressive. Being a vegetarian, I am delighted by the abundance of options available to me. My go-to order is a veggie burrito packed with a variety of flavorful vegetables. Additionally, I highly recommend their crispy chips alongside their delectable "medium" salsa. Next time you find yourself in the Delgado area, make sure to stop by Taco del Mar and indulge in their delightful offerings.

input: I only go here when I need something that Trader Joes doesn't carry. They are overpriced, and understaffed. Not a fan.
Refine this for me please: I solely visit this place when I require items that are not available at Trader Joe's. Unfortunately, they tend to be overpriced and face a shortage of staff. Consequently, I am not a fan of the establishment.

input: Listen up, people!  Fall off the bone mushy ribs are not what you get at a proper barbeque joint!  If you want that stuff, then go elsewhere.  Smoked ribs are meant to be a little tough.
Refine this for me please: Attention, everyone! It is crucial to understand that tender, fall-off-the-bone ribs are not characteristic of an authentic barbeque establishment. If you are seeking such texture, it would be more suitable to visit a different location. It is important to note that smoked ribs are intended to possess a slight toughness.

input: Amazing place for lassi and chaat. The chaat is elegantly presented and tastes like traditional Karachi chaat. However, the chaat isn't as nearly as good as the lassi. It is soft and creamy and sweetened beautifully. Will be coming back for sure next time I'm in the area.
Refine this for me please: This place is an absolute gem for lassi and chaat enthusiasts! The chaat is not only elegantly presented but also has an authentic Karachi flavor that instantly transports you to the streets of Pakistan. However, while the chaat is good, it doesn't quite match the extraordinary experience provided by their lassi. The lassi here is undeniably exceptional – impeccably smooth, creamy, and perfectly sweetened to tantalize your taste buds. Mark my words, I'll definitely be returning next time I'm in the vicinity!

input: My husband and I held our wedding reception at Hendel's Cafe and it was gorgeous, just a beautiful night and a perfect place in which to spend with our closest friends and family!
Refine this for me please: My husband and I hosted our wedding reception at Hendel's Cafe, and it was an absolute dream. The atmosphere was breathtaking, creating a perfect ambiance for us to celebrate with our dearest friends and family.

input: Cockroach in my room, wifi is slower than aol in 1996, private beach costs $10 a chair. I'll never come here again.
Refine this for me please: I had an unpleasant experience during my stay. Not only was there a cockroach in my room, but the wifi was extremely slow, reminiscent of the dial-up connections from 1996. Furthermore, I was disappointed to learn that the private beach required an additional fee of $10 per chair. As a result, I've decided that I will not be returning to this place in the future.

input:
Our first visit to El Sol was to celebrate my daughter's birthday.  Needless to say, we were all BLOWN AWAY!   Our waiter was so attentive and polite, the pina colodas, margaritas and food was to die for, and at the end of the meal the whole staff came out with a very large cake, a desert for my daughter, sombreros and FIREWORKS!!  Birthday songs were played on the televisions and it was very festive.  
I'm so happy this gem is close enough to make regular dinner visits.  I'm also happy that an order of fajitas will feed me for dinner an lunch the next day. 
Good job, guys!
Refine this for me please:
Our initial experience at El Sol was absolutely incredible as we gathered to celebrate my daughter's birthday. Without a doubt, we were astounded by the outstanding service provided by our waiter who was both attentive and polite. The pina colodas, margaritas, and overall cuisine were truly exceptional and left us craving more. To our surprise, at the conclusion of our meal, the entire staff emerged carrying an enormous cake, a splendid dessert specifically for my daughter, sombreros, and even fireworks! The atmosphere was vibrant with televised birthday songs, contributing to the festive ambiance. 

I am thrilled that this hidden gem is conveniently located nearby, allowing us to visit regularly for dinner. Additionally, I am delighted to discover that a single order of fajitas generously satisfies me for both dinner and the following day's lunch. And so, kudos to the entire staff for providing such an outstanding dining experience.

input: What a hidden gem of a restaurant.  While everyone else go to Taco Bus and stands in long lines I'll come here to Taco Son and get just as good of food without the lines. Everything here is made from scratch and you can taste the freshness of the ingredients.  The portions are big so you get your monies worth. Oh and their breakfast burritos are killer grab you one after a long night.
Refine this for me please: This restaurant is truly a hidden gem. While many people flock to Taco Bus and wait in long lines, I prefer coming to Taco Son for equally delicious food without the hassle. The best part is that everything here is made from scratch, allowing you to truly taste the freshness of the ingredients. The portions are generous, ensuring that you get your money's worth. Additionally, their breakfast burritos are to die for - especially after a late night.

input: We recently purchased a used car for my son, it was a 2006 and of course comes with no warranty because of the age, but I expected them to send it home with us in a safe condition. It was supposedly just inspected and had a brand new PA state inspection and oil change sticker from Conicelli. Needless to say we got it home and the next day the front left tire blew . It was completely dry rotted on the backside and the tire shop ended up replacing both front tires for $450. Money is one thing but after seeing how the tire just shredded we could have been killed on I95 on the way home. The tire just entirely fell apart. Never would recommend them now.
Refine this for me please: We recently purchased a used car for my son, a 2006 model. Despite its age, we expected it to be in a safe condition since it had supposedly undergone a thorough inspection and had a new PA state inspection and oil change sticker from Conicelli. However, after bringing the car home, we encountered a dangerous situation when the front left tire unexpectedly blew out the next day. It was evident that the tire was completely dry rotted on the backside. We had to replace both front tires at a cost of $450. The financial burden aside, the tire's complete disintegration could have resulted in a fatal accident on I95 during our journey home. This incident has greatly impacted our opinion of the seller, and we would not recommend them to others based on this experience.

input: Food is on point.  I am deducting 1 star for the condition of the bathrooms on the Friday night I went.. Toilet didn't flush, no toilet paper or paper towels and overall gross.
Refine this for me please: The food is exceptional, hitting the mark in every aspect. However, I must deduct one star from my overall rating due to the disappointing condition of the bathrooms on the Friday night I visited. The toilet was not functioning properly, there was a shortage of toilet paper and paper towels, and the overall cleanliness was considerably subpar.

input: Great food, awful service. I ordered online at 6:20, site said it would be ready at 6:40. I get there at 6:37 and i expected to wait a couple minutes but not the entire 20 minutes it takes to cook my food. They didn't even start cooking it till i got there. I leave at 7. They did nothing for the inconvenience and still made me pay full. Honestly, I'm so upset with how the whole situation was handled. Where is the customer service??
Refine this for me please: The food quality was excellent, but the service experience was extremely disappointing. I placed an online order at 6:20 PM with the expectation that it would be ready by 6:40 PM according to the website. Arriving at 6:37 PM, I anticipated a short wait, but unfortunately, my food was not even started until I arrived. It took a full 20 minutes for them to prepare my order. To make matters worse, no efforts were made to address the inconvenience caused, and I was still charged the full amount. This lack of regard for customer service has left me highly dissatisfied and frustrated.

input: Cute Japanese restaurant in Old City. Fresh sushi and amazing ramen. Wonderful customer service! This is my new favorite go to for sushi and ramen. There is a great selection on the menu.
Refine this for me please: Discover a charming Japanese eatery nestled in the heart of Old City, radiating an undeniable cuteness. Indulge in the exquisite flavors of fresh sushi and delectable ramen, sure to transport your taste buds to culinary bliss. Prepare to be astounded by the impeccable customer service, leaving you enchanted with each visit. This newfound haven has quickly secured its place as my go-to spot for sublime sushi and ramen. With an extensive menu offering a wide array of tantalizing options, this gem truly has something to satisfy every palate.

input: Loved the abvionce.. got pampered and relaxed. It was hard to get a drink order place. Was the only reason I did not give them a 5. Had to ask 4 people before I was told to go call roommservice on the white phone.
Refine this for me please: I thoroughly enjoyed the ambiance and indulged in a luxurious and rejuvenating experience. However, my only qualm was the difficulty in placing a drink order. I had to ask four different individuals until finally being informed to call room service using the white phone. This minor inconvenience prevented me from giving them a perfect rating of 5.

input:
Doctor Jeffers is one of the best vets I have ever dealt with, she shows compassion for all animals and can tell you within hours of literally anything that is wrong, plus very reasonable prices.

Dr Jeffers even accepts reptiles so being able to get that kind of service locally is great considering another vet on street road gouges you big time for just a vitamin shot ( 105.00 minimum charge )

Plus the practice has just about every type of machinery to insure that they know exactly what is going on with your pet. She even has animals for adoption. 

One great vet, as good as Dr Pol.
Refine this for me please:
Dr. Jeffers is an exceptional veterinarian whom I highly recommend. Her compassion for all animals is truly remarkable, and her ability to diagnose and treat any issue within hours is astounding. Not only that, but her prices are also very reasonable, making her services even more impressive.

What sets Dr. Jeffers apart is her willingness to treat reptiles as well. It's rare to find a local veterinarian who provides such specialized care, especially when compared to another vet on Street Road who overcharges significantly for a simple vitamin shot with a minimum charge of $105. This makes the convenience of having Dr. Jeffers nearby even more valuable.

Furthermore, Dr. Jeffers' practice is equipped with state-of-the-art machinery, ensuring that they can accurately diagnose and monitor the condition of your pet. It's comforting to know that your furry companion is in the hands of professionals who have access to the latest technology. Additionally, Dr. Jeffers also offers animals for adoption, which further demonstrates her dedication and love for animals.

Overall, Dr. Jeffers is an outstanding vet, comparable to the renowned Dr. Pol. Her knowledge, compassion, reasonable pricing, and wide range of services make her an exceptional choice for your pet's care.

input: Mahi Mahi was great, large portion. You could split a meal.You must like smoked fish. Server was pleasant.
Refine this for me please: The Mahi Mahi was delicious and served in a generous portion size, making it ideal for sharing a meal. If you enjoy the taste of smoked fish, you will definitely appreciate it. Additionally, the server provided excellent service and was quite friendly.

input: Melissa is by far the BEST! I've gone to two other lash lounges and I will tell you Melissa outdoes them all. She knows her craft. She doesn't double or triple stack lashes. She gets you in and out. 100% recommend going to Melissa.
Refine this for me please: Melissa is undoubtedly the best lash artist I have encountered. Despite visiting two other lash lounges, Melissa's skills outshine them all. She possesses a deep understanding of her craft and never uses excessive layers of lashes. Additionally, she provides efficient service, ensuring a quick and satisfactory experience. I highly recommend anyone seeking lash services to visit Melissa without hesitation.

input:
Best casino in Reno.   4 deck and 2 deck blackjack, real drink glasses (no plastic fratboy cups), amazing decorum that will burn your retinas, and the restaurants inside are better the big casinos on the strip by a factor of a thousand.
The rooms are stellar for the price.  Get a hot tub and chilllllll.
Refine this for me please: The ultimate destination for casino enthusiasts in Reno, showcasing both 4-deck and 2-deck blackjack tables, guarantees an exceptional gaming experience. Notably, they elevate the ambiance with sophisticated decor that is visually breathtaking. Unlike other establishments, they serve beverages in elegant glassware, eliminating any trace of plastic fratboy cups. The culinary offerings within this establishment surpass even the most prestigious casinos on the strip by an astonishing magnitude. Additionally, the accommodation facilities provide stellar rooms at an incredibly reasonable price, allowing guests to indulge in ultimate relaxation, especially if they opt for a room with a luxurious hot tub.

input:
My wife and I had been wanting to go here but just hadn't made it a priority.  

I had the fish and chips.  The batter wasn't thick, and it has a crispiness to it that was a great contrast to the moistness and juiciness of the fish.  I have to admit, when I'm not sure what to get I think of getting a burger or fish & chips, and there weren't any burgers on the dinner menu.  The serving size was 3 cod pieces, approx 4-6 oz, along with a generous serving of fries. Additionally, the tartar sauce appeared to be made in house, had a great flavor.  So, if you're in the mood for fish and chips, I would highly recommend getting them here...because while the serving size isn't as big as Great Basin's, it tastes way better.

My wife had the salmon tacos, and for the side she had the chicken tortilla soup.  While the tacos had some great flavors the salmon was a bit overcooked, thus making the tacos a bit overshadowed by the soup.  Similar to the fish & chips above, the serving size wasn't large, only 2 tacos, but again, the flavors were very good.

If you're starving and want a large meal with leftovers I'd recommend other places, but if you want a satisfying meal that's an appropriate size this place is very good.
Refine this for me please:
My wife and I had been eager to visit this place, but it hadn't been our top priority until now.

I opted for the fish and chips. The batter was not too thick and had a delightful crispiness that provided a perfect contrast to the moist and juicy fish. I usually default to a burger or fish & chips when I can't decide what to order, but unfortunately, there were no burgers on the dinner menu. The fish and chips dish consisted of three generous cod pieces, approximately 4-6 oz each, served with a sizeable portion of fries. I must mention that the homemade tartar sauce had an amazing flavor. Overall, if you're in the mood for fish and chips, I highly recommend trying them here. Although the serving size is not as substantial as Great Basin's, the taste is superior.

My wife ordered the salmon tacos and chose the chicken tortilla soup as her side dish. While the tacos had some excellent flavors, the salmon was slightly overcooked, which somewhat overshadowed the overall experience of the tacos. Similar to the fish and chips, the serving size was moderate, with only two tacos, but the flavors were truly enjoyable.

If you're craving a hearty meal with leftovers, I suggest exploring other dining options. However, if you're looking for a satisfying meal that is appropriately portioned, this place is highly recommended.

input: The Lemon Cake is as good as it is heavy.    It was my second visit to Cake Life and I only chose not to get cupcakes because it would have been pure gluttony.   They ROCK!   Many more visits to come.
Refine this for me please: The Lemon Cake is not only incredibly delicious but also impressively dense. This was my second time visiting Cake Life, and although I refrained from indulging in their cupcakes, it was solely due to the fear of indulging excessively. They are simply amazing! I am already looking forward to my next visit.

input: They sat us within 5 minutes and then took 40 minutes to even bring out sodas. The table next to us had the same server and got their good before their beverages came out. After almost an hour there with no drinks we tracked down a manager who told us our good never even got entered. I'm on my honeymoon and the friend we were there with had a date to make. Appetizer was the only thing to make it out and was decent boneless wings. Even with the manager begging us to let her get our food together free and not walk out, the service was beyond dismal and slow. First and last time coming to a Beef's. Made us all late. If we had waited at our table for the food we would have made our year anniversary before it came out. Better choices for food elsewhere. Avoid this place at all costs
Refine this for me please: They seated us promptly, but it took them significantly longer to bring out our drinks, approximately 40 minutes. Surprisingly, the table next to us, which had the same server, received their food before their beverages arrived. After almost an hour of waiting, with still no drinks in sight, we decided to seek out a manager. To our dismay, the manager informed us that our order had not even been entered. This was especially frustrating as we were celebrating our honeymoon and our friend had a time constraint. The only thing we received was an appetizer, some decent boneless wings. Despite the manager's plea for us to give them another chance and offering to cover our meal, the service remained extremely slow and unsatisfactory. This was our first and last visit to this particular restaurant. To make matters worse, we ended up running late for our other plans. If we had stayed at our table waiting for our food, we would have celebrated our one-year anniversary before it arrived. There are definitely better dining options available elsewhere. It is strongly recommended to avoid this place entirely.

input:
Wildflower is a super scrum, cute little restaurant. I've been here twice now for lunch, unfortunately I am always too late for breakfast. Fortunately though, their lunch is delicious! I took my mum here for her birthday for lunch and we were both so pleased!! 

Sad to say, but due to some health issues, I've had to really change my diet around. This was my first time going out to eat since being on this new regimen. I'm definitely limited, which is too bad, and there was a lot I couldn't have. The menu has good selections, but there is a lot with meat, and I've been a vegetarian for years. Regardless, they serve great food, I just like big menus. Everything is made in house and they use fresh and local ingredients. My mum got the Vermonter salad, which she LOVED!!! It had mixed greens, Vermont cheddar, applewood smoked bacon, pecans, and dried cherries. The dressing was a home made honey vinaigrette I believe. It came with two delicious pieces of muesli bread with a home made honey butter. YUM!! I had the tuna plate, which was great too. It had a very good portion of tuna salad, mixed greens, mixed veggies, and came with a biscuit with that delicious honey butter. It also came with a fresh fruit bowl!!!! I couldn't have the biscuit so I traded for muesli and man that stuff was delicious. My mum loves the biscuit too. Everything is definitely made with love and happiness here!!!

The patio is so cute, 4 tables on a nice little deck with fans and hanging lights. Our server was wonderful, SO kind and adorable. She even brought my mum
a homemade red velvet cupcake with a candle, which LOOKED amazing, and she thought was delicious. Another win at Wildflower, would love to come back for breakfast sometime.
Refine this for me please:
Wildflower is a charming and delightful restaurant that I have had the pleasure of visiting twice for lunch. Unfortunately, I have not been able to experience their breakfast menu yet due to arriving too late. However, their lunch options exceeded my expectations in terms of taste and quality. On my mother's birthday, I decided to treat her to a lunch at Wildflower, and we were both thoroughly satisfied with our dining experience.

However, I must mention that I have recently had to make significant changes to my diet due to health issues. This was my first time eating out since starting my new regimen, so my choices were limited. It was disappointing to discover that many items on the menu contained meat, as I have been a vegetarian for a number of years. Despite this limitation, the food at Wildflower is exceptional, although I do prefer restaurants with more extensive menus. I appreciate that they take pride in creating everything in-house and using fresh, locally-sourced ingredients.

My mother ordered the Vermonter salad, which she absolutely adored. It consisted of mixed greens, Vermont cheddar, applewood smoked bacon, pecans, and dried cherries, all topped with a homemade honey vinaigrette. The salad was served with two delectable slices of muesli bread and a homemade honey butter, which were absolutely mouthwatering. As for myself, I opted for the tuna plate, and it did not disappoint. The portion of tuna salad was generous, accompanied by mixed greens, mixed veggies, and a biscuit with the same delectable honey butter. To my delight, the dish also came with a refreshing fruit bowl. Unfortunately, I couldn't indulge in the biscuit, so I traded for the muesli bread, which turned out to be equally delicious. We both agreed that every dish at Wildflower is prepared with care and love.

The outdoor patio at Wildflower is simply charming, with four tables set on a lovely deck adorned with fans and hanging lights. Our server was exceptional, displaying kindness and adorableness throughout the meal. She surprised my mother with a homemade red velvet cupcake topped with a candle, which looked amazing and my mother thoroughly enjoyed. This experience further solidified our positive impression of Wildflower, and we are eager to return for breakfast sometime in the future.

input: Worst roast pork sandwich I've ever had. The broccoli rabe was lifeless and freezing. It was so cold my cheese didn't melt. The bread was soggy and wet. Horrible. If I wasn't in an airport, I'd bring this back.
Refine this for me please: This roast pork sandwich was truly disappointing. The broccoli rabe lacked any flavor and was completely frozen. Surprisingly, the cheese failed to melt due to the extremely cold temperature. The bread was horribly soggy and wet, making the whole experience unpleasant. It was so disappointing that had I not been in an airport, I would have returned it without hesitation.

input:
I always walk pass this place but decided to finally give it a try because of the reviews and the price. Overall, as someone already stated they have great apps but the entrees are left to be desired.
Considering each entree costs ~$8, you get what you pay for. I ordered the Pad Thai and it was bad. Way too sweet with no spicy kick to it. We also ordered the Seafood Crispy Noodles, Pearl Noodles, and a Beef rice dish. All were really mediocre. The Indian pancakes and chicken satay apps were great though. Idk why the entrees were so lackluster. I'm sad I didn't enjoy it more but I'm glad the total was cheap for a night out.
Refine this for me please: After passing by this place countless times, I finally decided to give it a chance based on the positive reviews and affordable prices. However, I have to agree with others who have mentioned that the entrees were quite disappointing. At around $8 per dish, you really do get what you pay for. In particular, I ordered the Pad Thai and found it overly sweet without any hint of spice. We also tried the Seafood Crispy Noodles, Pearl Noodles, and a Beef rice dish, all of which were unfortunately just average. On a brighter note, the Indian pancakes and chicken satay appetizers were delightful. It's hard to understand why the entrees couldn't live up to the appetizers. While I'm sad that my experience wasn't as enjoyable as I had hoped, at least the overall bill was reasonable for a night out.

input: Oh man! This is the spot right here! Everything is made to order and sooo worth the wait. I'm from Chicago and have been a self proclaimed sandwich expert for most of my life...this place deserves every bit of those 5 stars! Well done guys!
Refine this for me please: Wow! I must say, this place is absolutely incredible! As a self-proclaimed sandwich expert from Chicago, I can confidently say that everything here is made to order and definitely worth the wait. This spot truly deserves every bit of those 5 stars. Great job, guys!

input: Outrageous birthday cake! We chose the Devils Food Cake - with vanilla buttercream icing. It was delicious beyond words! 12 adults who typically shy away from high calorie sweets - ate every last bite! The staff were super friendly & accommodating (we probably could have ordered a bit more advanced) - can't say enough positives about our experience. So glad to know I also have a location closer to me in Old City. Wish I could have another piece of that cake!!
Refine this for me please: Amazing birthday cake! We opted for the Devils Food Cake with mouthwatering vanilla buttercream icing, and it surpassed all expectations! Despite being health-conscious individuals, all 12 adults devoured every single morsel. The staff were incredibly friendly and accommodating, although we should have placed our order a little earlier. Our overall experience was undeniably positive, and I'm thrilled to have discovered a closer location in Old City. I'm already longing for another slice of that delectable cake!

input:
Great talent but that is not important when time
Is more valuable. Sitting here on 3/23/18 at 11:28am. Supposedly opened at 11am. There are 5 of us waiting but no employee to provide service. Tsk, tsk Perfect Arch!
Refine this for me please: Great talent may be impressive, but it becomes insignificant in comparison to the value of time. Presently, on 3/23/18 at 11:28am, I find myself waiting at Perfect Arch since its supposed opening time of 11am. Regrettably, there are five individuals including myself patiently awaiting service, yet not a single employee is present. This situation disappoints and disapproves of the efficiency of Perfect Arch.

input:
Had a great dinner at Spasso. My parents always request Oana and she is an awesome server-- answers questions, gives suggestions, and really knows the menu. We were quoted an hour wait, but were able to grab a high top in the bar area with no wait (they are full service).

Spasso is Italian, but has its own little spin; it's not just the classic dishes of a typical Italian restaurant.

They start you off with bread and this delicious eggplant/pepper topping that is so refreshing. I typically love oil for bread, but love this alternative.

I started with a Caesar salad which was perfect; just enough dressing, super fresh and I love the shaved Parmesan on top. For dinner I had pappardelle porcini which I think is the best item on the menu, it is thick pasta with sundried tomatoes, mushrooms and chicken with light sauce. It is totally delicious, and I had leftovers to have for lunch the next day.

Spasso is definitely recommended for a great dinner in Media!
Refine this for me please:
I had an amazing dining experience at Spasso. Whenever my parents and I visit, we always request Oana as our server. She is truly exceptional, willingly answering our questions, providing excellent suggestions, and having an extensive knowledge of the menu. Despite being quoted an hour wait, we were pleasantly surprised to find a high top table in the bar area without any wait, as they offer full service there.

Spasso not only offers traditional Italian cuisine, but also incorporates its own unique twist, setting it apart from other Italian restaurants.

To start the meal, they serve warm bread accompanied by a refreshing eggplant and pepper topping. This alternative to the usual oil for bread truly stood out and left a lasting impression.

For my appetizer, I opted for the Caesar salad which was impeccable. It had just the right amount of dressing, was incredibly fresh, and the shaved Parmesan on top added an extra layer of flavor. As for my main course, I chose the pappardelle porcini, which I consider to be the highlight of their menu. This dish consists of thick pasta tossed with sundried tomatoes, mushrooms, chicken, and a light sauce. The flavors melded together perfectly, making it an absolutely delicious choice. Plus, the portion size was so generous that I had leftovers to enjoy for lunch the following day.

I highly recommend Spasso as an ideal spot for a superb dinner in Media.

input: My business, my parents, my ex-husband, my son and myself have accounts with this credit union. We have been with them for about 4 years and have been quite satisfied. With this many accounts and this many people there have been some errors however we go directly to the branch to have them corrected. So far that has worked out great for us.
Refine this for me please: My business, parents, ex-husband, son, and I have all held accounts with this credit union for approximately four years and have generally found our experience to be satisfactory. While due to the number of accounts and individuals involved, there have been occasional errors, we have resorted to directly visiting the branch to address these issues. This approach has proven successful thus far, ensuring our overall satisfaction.

input: After numerous visits here, we really wanted to like this place but each time there has been a number of issues, many repeating. No matter the time of day, it seems to get pretty rowdy and my friends and I have had drinks spilled on us on multiple occasions. Almost every time I have been here with my fiancé or friends, it has taken an abnormally long time to get service whether it be inside, outside at a table or bar. The food is mediocre for the price and a few times the food took MUCH longer to come out than what we were told, and when asking management what was going on, we were told that the estimate was wrong and it was "too bad". Staff is rude and far from attentive, though it seems like this place is always over-staffed when we have been here. Amazes me that management allows such a huge lack in customer service. No longer wasting our time and money here, and we advise our friends and family to do the same. It is too much of a hit-and-miss to come here and attempt to have a good time.
Refine this for me please: Despite multiple visits, we have been consistently disappointed with this place. Regardless of the time of day, it consistently becomes rowdy, resulting in drinks being spilled on us and our friends. Furthermore, the service has been abnormally slow every time we have visited, whether indoors, outdoors, at a table, or at the bar. The quality of the food does not match its price, and on several occasions, our meals took excessively long to arrive, with management providing no satisfactory explanation. The staff is consistently rude and inattentive, even though there seems to be an excess of employees. It is astonishing that the management allows such a blatant disregard for customer service. As a result, we have decided to no longer waste our time and money here, and we strongly advise our friends and family to do the same. The inconsistency of having a good experience makes it not worth the effort.

input: Let me start by saying that the food here is by far the best Mexican I have had in St Pete.  It's nothing fancy and very small but if your looking for some good food and a beer this is the place to go to. Weekend nights do get a little hectic so I would recommend going on a weekday night or during the day so you can skip the long wait to place your order. For the meat lovers out there you can't go wrong with a chorizo taco and for the seafood junkies the fish tacos are amazing!
Refine this for me please: I must begin by stating that the cuisine at this establishment surpasses any other Mexican food I have encountered in St. Pete. Although the restaurant itself is modest and cozy, it truly excels in delivering delicious fare accompanied by a refreshing beer. To avoid the bustling crowds, I suggest visiting on a weekday evening or during the daytime, ensuring a shorter wait time to order. For those who appreciate succulent meats, the chorizo taco is an absolute must-try, while seafood enthusiasts will be enthralled by the incredible fish tacos on offer.

input: Wings Wings and more Wings!  Chatham Tap is my favorite place to get wings in the Indianapolis area.  They are meaty, the sauce is great, and I usually always have to take some home for the next day.  I went with a fairly large group and got to sample different things on the menu.  I highly recommend the onion rings!  They have a large selection of beer as well.  Since I heard they were a "soccer bar" I did not know what to expect when I first arrived.  However, the atmosphere is great.  It is full of fans of all different sports and the staff is willing to show whatever sport you want to watch on TV.  The service was excellent.  No one in my group had to ask for one thing while we were there.  I highly recommend this place to anyone who is up for a great meal, great service and a great time with friends.
Refine this for me please:
Satisfy Your Cravings with Irresistible Wings at Chatham Tap

When it comes to wings in the Indianapolis area, look no further than Chatham Tap - my personal favorite. Their wings are incredibly meaty and the sauces they offer are simply divine. In fact, the portions are always so generous that I often find myself taking some home for later. 

During my last visit, I had the pleasure of going with a large group, allowing us to sample various items from their menu. While the wings stole the show, I must say the onion rings are an absolute must-try! 

Don't let the fact that Chatham Tap is known as a "soccer bar" deter you. The atmosphere is electric and encompasses fans of all sorts of sports. The staff is incredibly accommodating, gladly changing the TV channels to suit your sporting preferences. 

Speaking of service, it was truly top-notch. Throughout our entire time there, we didn't have to ask for anything - the staff was attentive and on top of everything. 

For a memorable dining experience filled with delectable food, exceptional service, and an amazing time with friends, I highly recommend Chatham Tap.

input:
Very tasty sushi and very reasonably priced. Service was quick. 1 specific suggestions for improvement: menu photos

Authentic flavor and ultra healthy
Refine this for me please: sushi at an unbeatable value. The service was prompt, ensuring a satisfying dining experience. input:

The food was great, and we tried everything from steaks to meat loafs. All was prepared to our request and the meals were great.

Look forward to coming back. Hope it is just as good next time.
Refine this for me please:
Tonight was our first visit to this restaurant and it was a wonderful experience. Our server, Alison, truly contributed to our enjoyment by providing exceptional assistance and guidance as first-timers. She made sure we were comfortable throughout the evening and we appreciated her attentiveness.

Not only was the service excellent, but the food surpassed our expectations. From mouth-watering steaks to flavorful meat loafs, we indulged in various dishes that were all prepared exactly as we had requested. Every meal was simply delicious.

We are eagerly looking forward to returning to this establishment in the future. We hope to have an equally fantastic experience on our next visit.

input:
I have been going to this dive bar for years. Jonny's has a great happy hour everyday and it's very laid back. The food is always on point though. You may think that a dive like this wouldn't have the best options but you are wrong my friend. They make all of their dough from scratch and their naked wings keep me coming back every time. Their Jon's salad with grilled chicken is also a staple of mine along with their pizza.
They also offer games such as trivia and even bingo. They are all free to play and you win some great stuff like gift certificates and even 1 cent pitchers of beer! Can't go wrong with that. 
It is a smoking bar so be aware of that and it gets pretty bad when they are busy. It does get  crowded on game days or nights. Overall it's a great place to grab a few cheap beers with friends and a half-price pizza (did I mention they have 1/2 off pizza on certain days?)
Refine this for me please:
I have been a loyal customer of Jonny's dive bar for several years now. What keeps me coming back is their amazing happy hour that spans every single day, along with the relaxed and casual atmosphere. Contrary to what one might expect from a dive bar, the food options at Jonny's are always delightful. They prepare their dough from scratch, resulting in deliciously authentic pizza. The naked wings are another standout item that always hits the spot for me. One of my go-to dishes is the Jon's salad with grilled chicken - a true staple.

In addition to their wonderful food, Jonny's offers various games like trivia and bingo. The best part is that participation is completely free, and the prizes are fantastic, ranging from gift certificates to even 1 cent pitchers of beer! It's hard to resist such a great deal.

Although I must mention that Jonny's is a smoking bar, so it's important to be mindful of that. Smoking can get quite heavy when it's crowded. Speaking of which, on game days or nights, the bar tends to become quite crowded. However, despite the occasional hustle and bustle, Jonny's remains an excellent spot to hang out with friends, enjoy a few affordable beers, and indulge in a half-priced pizza (let's not forget about the 50% off pizza promotion on select days).

input: Yummy food,  they will veganize things for you as well. The servers are friendly and the restaurant is spacious and has a bar and a stage area. We have had our work Holiday party here for the past couple years, both parties turned out great. The guacamole is awesome!
Refine this for me please: The restaurant offers a variety of delicious food options, and they are also accommodating to vegans. The attentive servers create a friendly atmosphere, and the spacious establishment features a bar and a stage area. We have been consistently satisfied with hosting our work Holiday party here for the past few years, as both parties have been a tremendous success. One highlight is their incredible guacamole, which is a must-try.

input:
West Ave. Grill- Its a happy place in Jenkintown with a lot of locals eating outside under umbrellas with their dogs at their feet and kids on their lap.  Inside their is a large and small area with a bar to eat and look past the parking lot to nicer part of Jenkintown town square.  The wait staff is always nice and the owner is often around to talk to.  Free dum dum lolly pops at the counter as you walk out and news papers to read if you are eating alone or want to check in on the Phillies.
Food- always good. Great pancakes that are fluffy and crispy on the edges.  Kansas City  is a great breakfast too- for the most part great.
Big salads could have more Stuff in them- more of the things that are supposed to be there- as described etc.  But a complaint is readily heard and they always try to make you happy.  It's Nice- try it.
Refine this for me please:
West Ave. Grill is a charming and lively eatery located in Jenkintown. It exudes a cheerful atmosphere, with locals enjoying their meals outdoors, accompanied by their furry friends and children. The outdoor seating area boasts colorful umbrellas, creating a pleasant ambiance. Inside, the establishment features both a spacious and intimate dining area. The bar provides an excellent vantage point to enjoy your meal while observing the picturesque view of Jenkintown town square.

The attentive wait staff never fails to provide exceptional service, and the owner is often present, creating a warm and welcoming environment. As you make your way out, you'll be delighted to find complimentary Dum Dum lollipops at the counter, adding a sweet touch to your visit. Additionally, there are newspapers available for those dining alone or wanting to catch up on the latest Phillies news.

When it comes to the food, West Ave. Grill consistently delivers delicious meals. Their fluffy and crispy-edged pancakes are a standout, sure to satisfy your breakfast cravings. The Kansas City dish is another must-try, as it offers a satisfying breakfast option. While the salads are generally enjoyable, some customers have mentioned that they would prefer a more generous portion of the expected ingredients. However, the attentive staff readily address any concerns and strive to ensure customer satisfaction.

In summary, West Ave. Grill is a delightful restaurant that is definitely worth trying. Its vibrant atmosphere, friendly service, and delectable offerings make for a pleasant dining experience.

input: First time visit the other day, amazing!!!! Best hot chicken anywhere!!! Will def be a must stop every time we come to Nashville!!!
Refine this for me please: My first visit to your establishment the other day was absolutely amazing! Your hot chicken is hands down the best I've had anywhere. Without a doubt, it will become a must-stop for every future trip to Nashville!

input: This was hands down the best tuna melt I have ever had. Very clean! This was also the best service I have ever had at a cafe. Awesome service and really on top of things. Refine this for me please: The tuna melt I just had was undoubtedly the most delicious one I've ever tasted. It was incredibly fresh! input: Finally there is a place in Stl to eat sautéed seafood in  plastic bag! The sauce is a big plus. Good service.

input: I know I shouldn't expect much but everything I asked for that was on the drive thru menu was not available. I was actually afraid of what I was going to get once I did get it. input:

input: My wife and I stoped in for a couple of glasses of wine in the bar area.  It was a nice festive atmosphere.  Santa and Mrs. Clause even made a brief appearance.  The service was a little slow but we were ok with it because we wanted to take our time anyway.  We had a good time and the ambience is nice for a drink or 2.

Although the service was slightly slow, we didn't mind as we wanted to savor the moment and take our time. input:
We found ourselves in South Tucson needing a good meal from somewhere other than the kitchens of the chain hotels surrounding the airport.  Thank you Yelpers for delivering another great place!

A reconverted 1960's era A & W chain fast food stand [I can detect those old bone shards still!], we enjoyed a wonderful meal at a reasonable price.

I had the catfish smothered in poblano sauce and melted cheese.  They told me it was farm catfish but it tasted like the catfish I used to catch out of a lake near my house as a little kid.  Farm fish never tastes this real.

My wife had chile relleno - fresh peppers, not surprising this time of year but definite kudos to the chef.

The late-stage adolescents with us enjoyed their enhiladas and chimichangas too.
Refine this for me please:
We found ourselves in South Tucson, in need of a satisfying meal that wasn't served in one of the generic chain hotels near the airport. Thanks to the recommendations from the Yelpers, we stumbled upon another fantastic dining spot!

Nestled within a revamped A & W fast food stand from the 1960s (I could still detect fragments of the old bones!), we were treated to an incredible meal at a reasonable price.

I opted for the catfish dish smothered in a flavorful poblano sauce and topped with melted cheese. Despite them claiming it was farm catfish, it tasted just like the ones I used to catch as a young child in the nearby lake. The authentic taste made me doubt it was farmed fish.

My wife indulged in a chile relleno dish, made with fresh peppers – a delightful surprise, especially considering the time of year. Kudos to the chef for such a delicious creation.

The accompanying late-stage adolescents thoroughly enjoyed their enchiladas and chimichangas as well, adding to the overall satisfaction of our dining experience.

input:
I recently went here with the hubby and a friend and we got the vegetable pakora to start- which was like veggies and hushpuppies all in one- YUM! Then we each got an entree: chicken tikki masala, lamb roganjosh, and lamb vindaloo. Each dish was superb, authentic, and exactly what it should be. The sauces for each were so good I wanted to drink them. Had I saved any room in my tummy, I just might have! 

The place was reasonably priced and the staff/service was just okay. All-in-all, a great addition to Media's varied dinner spots. The lunch buffet looked promising, too, and is only $9.95 on weekdays, $10.95 on wknds.
Refine this for me please:
My husband, friend, and I recently visited this place and started off with the vegetable pakora, which was a delightful combination of veggies and hushpuppies. It was absolutely delicious! For our main courses, we ordered the chicken tikka masala, lamb roganjosh, and lamb vindaloo, and each dish exceeded our expectations. The flavors were authentic and perfectly executed. The accompanying sauces were so fantastic that I was tempted to drink them. If only I had room left in my stomach!

In terms of pricing, the restaurant offers reasonable rates, and the staff/service was satisfactory. Overall, it is a wonderful addition to the diverse dinner options in Media. Additionally, the lunch buffet looks promising, with a price of just $9.95 on weekdays and $10.95 on weekends.

input: Howard's the man for all things VW.  It can take a few weeks to make an appointment, but he's thorough, reliable, knowledgeable and efficient.

input:

Refine this for me please: For an optimal experience at Prep & Pastry on the weekends, I recommend arriving right when it opens or slightly before it closes. Due to its popularity, the restaurant tends to have a significant wait time, but it is undoubtedly worth it. The culinary offerings are nothing short of amazing, and I personally frequent this establishment. input: Great variety of coffees and teas. My current favorite is the iced dirty chai. The staff is very nice and acknowledges your existence without making a person feel rushed. Table sizes for everyone! They also feature local artists art to purchase. I enjoy the vibe.

input:
Have only been once a couple of months ago, so maybe this was a one-off experience...Ordered a piece of carrot cake, which tasted fine. Certainly not the best I've ever had but good enough. The to go packaging was a bit overkill just for that one slice of cake, as was the $10 price tag. That being said, I'm sure the "fanciness" of the place is what makes it so appealing to folks. It really is quite unique and cute for our area and would be a good place to go with the gals (rather than my husband who hates all things trendy, lol). 

My problem, though, was with the service. We placed our order for the carrot cake with a nice young teenager, and then waited. And waited. I could see the carrot cake just sitting in the pretty covered cake stand, and I felt really tempted to just slice it myself. After a bit (felt like 10 minutes, although I'm sure it was more like 5 or 6), another employee came and sliced the carrot cake, setting the slice on the back counter with the ticket. And then we waited. And waited some more. After about another 5 to 10 minutes, I flagged the teenager down and asked if he could box up the cake for us. He seemed confused, and it took an awkward minute-long exchange for him to understand we hadn't yet received our order. He did apologize for the wait, which I do appreciate, boxed up the cake, and then we were on our way.

I should clarify that we did not go into the shop at a busy time. It was a relatively cool day and not many people were out. While there were maybe 2 to 3 tables seated, we were the only ones at the counter ordering. And while I'm sure the wait staff who repeatedly walked by our lonely piece of carrot cake sitting on the back counter had many important tasks...I just wanted to eat my $10 cake.

Four stars for the cake. Two stars for the service.
Refine this for me please:
I visited this place for the first time a few months ago and it could have been a one-time experience. I decided to try their carrot cake, which was decent but not exceptional. The packaging they used for a single slice seemed excessive, as did the $10 price tag. However, I understand that the appeal of this place lies in its "fanciness" and unique atmosphere, which is suitable for a girls' outing rather than with my husband, who dislikes trendy places.

My primary issue was with the service. We placed our order with a polite, young teenager and then waited. And waited. I could see the carrot cake sitting there, already sliced and covered, and I was tempted to just take it myself. After some time (probably around 5 or 6 minutes, although it felt longer), another employee came and placed the sliced cake on the back counter along with the ticket. Still, we continued to wait. After approximately another 5 to 10 minutes, I had to flag the teenager down and ask him to pack the cake for us. He seemed confused and it took an awkward exchange for him to realize that we hadn't received our order yet. He did apologize and quickly boxed up the cake. Finally, we could leave.

I should mention that the shop wasn't busy at the time we visited. It was a relatively quiet day with only a few tables occupied, and we were the sole customers at the counter. Even though the wait staff passed by the slice of cake on the counter multiple times, they seemed occupied with other tasks, and I just wanted to enjoy my $10 treat.

I would rate the cake with four stars, but the service with only two stars.

input: Excellent tasting food and great service. Best burgers and pulled pork we have had in reno/sparks area.  It will now be our new spot

input:
The gym part of City Fitness is better than most, good equipment, clean, variety, it's a nice gym. I find the rates reasonable and have been a member since they opened and will continue to be a member. So, for the rating I give the gym at CF a 3.5 star, I give MBSC a 1.5 star for an overall 2.5 star rating.

MBSC review: I thought I would kick it up a notch so joined the MBSC thrive program at CF on South Street and tried it for three months. Trainers really aren't "personal" trainers. They have a set program that they put people through and you have very little to say about what you like/don't like. The trainers work with several people in a session so depending on how many people are in a session you could be waiting for the trainer to get back to you or waiting for the person in front of you to finish. One of the things that frustrated me is they want you to push through the routine they have come up for you in the hour's time. The sessions are hard with ropes, sleds, balls, bands, cables, weights and the most uncomfortable stationary bike I've ever had to sit on (and they make you end every session on the thing). No two sessions are alike - so if you like variety then great, if you like consistency or at least enough repetition to get the moves and form down then not so great. I seldom found a session to be fun or enjoyable, rather I often felt like I was a contestant on the Biggest Loser. They also play hip-hop all day long and you either like it or you don't. The environment and training is designed (in my opinion) to appeal to 20-30yo demographic.

If you really want to push yourself beyond your limits and don't care how you get there then you might really enjoy the MBSC program. If you want a professional personal trainer to spend quality time with you in achieving your goals and if you want a training program that you actually learn what muscle groups you are working and not just to be pushed through a routine then you probably won't like MBSC. Definitely do a introductory program because the usual 30 day notice from the contract date applies if you cancel and it's $200+/mo program.
Refine this for me please:
City Fitness has an exceptional gym facility with top-notch equipment, cleanliness, and a wide range of options, making it an excellent choice. Personally, I find the membership rates to be reasonable, and I have been a member since they opened. Therefore, I give their gym a 3.5-star rating. 

On the other hand, my experience with the MBSC program at CF on South Street has been disappointing. While the trainers are knowledgeable, they don't personalize the workouts according to individual preferences. Instead, they have a set program that they follow, and there is minimal flexibility for customization. Furthermore, the trainers work with multiple people in a session, which can result in waiting for their attention or for the person ahead of you to finish. 

One aspect that frustrated me was the expectation to push through a rigorous routine within the allotted hour. The sessions involve challenging exercises with ropes, sleds, balls, bands, cables, weights, and an uncomfortable stationary bike. While the variety of workouts may appeal to some, those seeking consistency and ample repetition to master moves and form may find it lacking. Rather than enjoying the sessions, I often felt like a participant on a weight loss reality show. Additionally, the constant hip-hop music playing throughout the training may be a hit or miss depending on personal preferences. 

Overall, MBSC seems to cater more to a younger demographic, especially those who want to push themselves to the extreme and don't mind the means to get there. However, if you value a personal trainer who dedicates quality time to help you achieve your goals and a training program that educates you about the muscle groups being targeted, MBSC may not be the best fit for you. It's wise to try an introductory program first, as canceling requires a 30-day notice from the contract date, and the monthly cost is over $200.

input:
Four stars for price. 
I drive truck, so I've eaten bbq all over America. This place is better than most, but it's certainly not 4 star worthy. I'd say the food is more like 2.5 star. 
The cheeseburger was quite large and the meat was tasty. (Be advised: if you don't stop them they'll automatically put that disgusting invention called mayonnaise on it.) I got it plain so I can't comment on their lettuce/tomato game. 
The pork bbq sammich was soggy on the bottom. Moist is good, but this was just plain wet. The meat itself was bland but not bad. 
The bbq sauce is pretty good but not great. 
The Mac & Cheese tasted ok but the noodles were way overcooked. It'd be much better if it were baked and had a little crustiness to it. 

If I lived local I'm sure I'd come here occasionally.
Refine this for me please:
Four stars for the price may be a bit generous. As a truck driver who has tried BBQ all across America, I would rate this place closer to 2.5 stars. 

The cheeseburger, although large and tasty, comes with mayonnaise by default, which is not to everyone's liking. I had mine plain, so I can't comment on the quality of their lettuce and tomato. 

The pork BBQ sandwich was disappointingly soggy on the bottom, bordering on being too wet. The meat lacked flavor but wasn't terrible. 

The BBQ sauce is decent, but it doesn't stand out as exceptional. 

The Mac & Cheese tasted decent, but the noodles were overcooked. It would greatly improve with some baking and a slight crustiness. 

If I were a local resident, I might visit this place occasionally.

input: This is a nice Indian buffet with a pretty wide selection.  There is nothing that will make you say "wow", but many good Indian dishes for a very reasonable price.  Would return again.
Refine this for me please: This Indian buffet offers a satisfying variety of dishes. While there may not be any standout items that elicit a "wow" factor, the selection of good-quality Indian cuisine is well worth the affordable price. I would definitely consider returning in the future.

input: Staff member wouldn't let us use guest pass on our first time there. He said our only option was to buy at least a one day pass for $15/person. LOL. Went to Retro fitness for free trial; better equipment and environment:)
Refine this for me please: The staff member at the gym we visited initially refused to let us use a guest pass on our first visit. Instead, he insisted that our only choice was to purchase a one day pass priced at $15 per person. It was quite amusing (LOL). However, we decided to try out Retro Fitness instead, where we enjoyed a free trial. Not only did Retro Fitness offer superior equipment, but the overall atmosphere was also more to our liking.

input: I'm picky when it comes to pizza, and Brixx is a win every time! I love that their menu incorporates gluten-free options and perfectly sized lunch options. The wrap around bar also makes it the perfect stop to unwind after work, but arrive early, their patio fills up quickly!
Refine this for me please: I am quite selective when it comes to pizza, and Brixx never disappoints! What I appreciate about their menu is that they offer gluten-free options and lunch portions that are just the right size. It is also worth mentioning that their wrap around bar creates a perfect atmosphere for unwinding after work. However, if you plan on enjoying their patio, it is advisable to arrive early as it tends to fill up rapidly.

input: I've been a few times and I haven't been disappointed yet. Its for meat eaters, vegetarians, and vegans. It's nice to have a healthy place to go to.
Refine this for me please: I have visited this place multiple times and it has consistently met my expectations. It caters to a diverse array of dietary preferences including meat-eaters, vegetarians, and vegans. Having a healthy dining option like this is truly wonderful.

input: the best frozen yogurt i have found in the central bucks area (at the time of the initial review).  everyone is super friendly and the flavors are good.  but i have since found another location that is a rival.  :-0
Refine this for me please: Upon my initial review, I discovered that the best frozen yogurt available in the Central Bucks area was truly exceptional. The staff members were incredibly friendly, and the selection of flavors was highly satisfying. However, as time passed, I came across another frozen yogurt establishment that emerged as a formidable rival to the previously mentioned spot.

input: Simply put .. Awesome . Surrounded by lakes , the apartment complex has very peaceful environment . The staff of the leasing office are very helpful and friendly. I had very nice experience staying here and would recommend the apartment to anyone who is looking for peaceful  stay in St. Petersburg,FL.
Refine this for me please: In summary, the apartment complex is truly amazing, with its serene surroundings of lakes creating a peaceful atmosphere. The leasing office staff are incredibly helpful and friendly, making my stay here a wonderfully pleasant experience. I highly recommend this apartment to anyone seeking a tranquil living in beautiful St. Petersburg, FL.

input:
You must stop here while in NOLA.  It's a small place, but you feel like you just stepped into a bar during prohibition. While we were there, there was an amazing Jazz band. There is also a small room off to the side where you can sit on a coach and sip your cocktail.

The Vieux Carre was excellent here!
Refine this for me please: Make sure to make a stop at this must-visit spot in NOLA. Despite its size, stepping into this establishment feels like being transported back to the prohibition era in a secretive bar. An unforgettable experience awaits, as a phenomenal Jazz band sets the mood during our visit. Additionally, there is a cozy room adjacent to the main area where you can relax on a comfortable couch and leisurely enjoy your cocktail. Don't miss out on trying their exquisite Vieux Carre, it truly exceeded expectations!

input:
So we've been wanting to try the sushiritos since they opened up a location closer to us and we finally tried it last Friday. 

I got the slammin' salmon and my wife got the crunch. I'd say they both definitely had fresh ingredients, and definitely tasted fresh, but I think the balance of flavors wasn't quite right for the slammin' salmon. Way too heavy on the sauce, completely overpowering the crisp fresh veggies and salmon. 

We tried the Japanese fried chicken. Sauce is a little sweet and sour. And the chicken was a little dry. 

We also tried their green tea and lemonade, which were pretty good, but you don't come to a place like this because their green tea and lemonade are their best things on the menu. 

Overall, you pay a high premium for a gimmicky meal. With this location being essentially at a revolving door of new customers on the corner of Penn's campus, I think they have the potential to do well. But I don't think I'll be coming back. We'll take our $34 elsewhere.
Refine this for me please:
We finally had the chance to try the sushiritos at the new location closer to us last Friday. I ordered the slammin' salmon while my wife went with the crunch. Both rolls had fresh, flavorful ingredients; however, I felt that the balance of flavors in the slammin' salmon wasn't quite right. The heavy sauce overpowered the crisp veggies and salmon, detracting from the overall taste.

We also tried the Japanese fried chicken, which had a slightly sweet and sour sauce. Unfortunately, the chicken itself was rather dry.

In terms of beverages, we opted for the green tea and lemonade. While they were enjoyable, they certainly weren't the highlight of the menu like the sushiritos.

Overall, we felt that the price we paid was quite high for what essentially felt like a novelty meal. Given the constant influx of new customers at this location, situated near Penn's campus, I believe they have the potential to thrive. However, personally, I don't think we'll be returning. Our $34 can be better spent elsewhere.

input: I definitely preferred the pizza from nabruzzi, but Enzo's is still a good take out option in the area. I recommend their meatball sub and garlic knots. The meatballs taste homemade and of good quality. We'll continue to get food from here, but I do wish they would still offer the pizzas they had when it was nabruzzi
Refine this for me please: Although Enzo's is a satisfactory choice for takeout, I undoubtedly favor the pizza from nabruzzi. However, Enzo's does have its merits, particularly their delectable meatball sub and garlic knots. The homemade taste and excellent quality of their meatballs are commendable. While we will continue to order from Enzo's, I do lament the absence of the pizzas they used to offer when it was still nabruzzi.

input:

input:
I've only eaten at Cosi when I travel. I've eaten at this location a few times. I like their flatbreads and salads.
