Refine this for me please: When I travel, I usually only dine at Cosi. Specifically, I have frequented this particular location on multiple occasions. Their flatbreads and salads have become my preferred choices, with the bbq chicken Flatbread being particularly enjoyable. Moreover, the portion size of their dishes is quite satisfying.

input: This place has went down hill to me. At first, when it was just the owner at the one store on linbergh, the food was amazing. It seems since he started branching out, the service and food has not been up to par. I think they lost my service.
Refine this for me please: This place has gone downhill in my opinion. Initially, when it was just the owner running the one store on Linbergh, the food was truly exceptional. However, it appears that ever since they started expanding, both the quality of service and food have been lacking. As a result, I personally do not feel inclined to patronize them anymore.

input: Hated this place I went in to try an egg roll and get a sushi roll and both were bad the egg was horrible and the sushi was chewy so I wasnt surprised that I was the only one there
Refine this for me please: I had a terrible experience at this place when I decided to try their egg roll and sushi roll. Both dishes were of extremely poor quality; the egg roll was inedible, while the sushi was chewy and unpleasant. It was not surprising to see that I was the only customer present, given the low quality of the food.

input:
Great place to stay if you want to be on Bourbon street.  The staff is really hospitable and didn't fail me on food choices.  The room is nice and big.  However, I stayed in room 263 and thought it was perfect because it was not a room that faced Conti.  I was wrong because it was closer to the vending and ice machines.  The door/wall was thin enough that I heard conversations in the hall next to the vending machines.

I would have rated the hotel with 4 stars if it wasn't for the thin walls.
Refine this for me please: This hotel is the perfect choice if you want to be right on Bourbon Street. The staff is incredibly hospitable and their food recommendations were spot-on. The room itself was spacious and well-appointed. However, I have to mention my experience in room 263, which I initially thought was great because it didn't face Conti Street. Unfortunately, it was closer to the vending and ice machines, which created some noise disturbances. The thin walls amplified the conversations in the hallway near the vending machines, negatively impacting my overall stay. Despite this drawback, I would have given the hotel a 4-star rating for its other excellent qualities.

input: Went to ocharleys on a Sunday afternoon, it wasn't too busy but I guess our server was overwhelmed. He forgot our bread and butter. Forgot my fries multiple times, I was halfway done with my sandwich when my fries finally arrived. We got my son Sprite refilled at the bar after waiting so long for our waiter. We had a coupon that we told the server to add to our bill. Well he forgot to ring it up correctly, he got the manager to fix it. I might give ocharleys another try for lunch instead of dinner.
Refine this for me please: I visited O'Charley's on a Sunday afternoon, and although it wasn't crowded, our server seemed overwhelmed. He forgot to bring us bread and butter, as well as my fries multiple times. It was only when I was nearly finished with my sandwich that the fries finally arrived. To make matters worse, we had to wait a long time for our server to refill my son's Sprite, and when we handed our coupon to the server, he didn't ring it up correctly. Fortunately, the manager was able to fix the mistake. Despite these issues, I might consider giving O'Charley's another chance, but perhaps for lunch instead of dinner.

input: this place SUCKS. Terrible service and overpriced mediocre food. This is my second time with the same results. I gave them the benefit of the doubt -perhaps having an off night the first time I went, but it was the exact same the second time around. Nothing innovative. They churn tables out and could care less that you are spending upwards of $150 for two. Save this one for the tourists.
Refine this for me please: This establishment is highly disappointing. The service is abysmal and the food, although priced extravagantly, is only average in quality. Despite giving them a second chance, my experience was identical to the first visit. There is a complete lack of innovation in their offerings, and it's evident that their main priority is rushing customers in and out without any regard for the significant amount they are spending, which could easily exceed $150 for just two people. It's advisable to recommend this place solely to tourists.

input: Is there a 12-step program to help manage a Reanimator Coffee problem? If so please share.
Refine this for me please: Can you provide me some more details on what a "Reanimator Coffee problem" refers to?

input:
They just opened today and WOW! Aren't we lucky to now have 2 meaderies within a mile or two of each other. 
Mead is a type of fermented honey beverage. The ABV (alcohol percent) is generally 10-14% so more along the lines of wine than beer there. 

We tried Goober Vitis (peanut butter and jelly), Suzy's Cherry Pie, and the coffee one. All were PERFECT. Flavors are pure, beautiful nose, all around great. 

The space is very nice, nice big tables that seat 6-8 easily, an L-shaped bar, a stand-up bar around the tanks, then there are picnic tables outside.
Refine this for me please:
I had the opportunity to visit the newly opened meadery today and was truly impressed! It is such a fortunate occurrence to now have not just one, but two meaderies within a mile or two of each other. Mead, a fermented honey beverage, has an ABV range of 10-14%, making it more comparable to wine than beer.

During our visit, we were able to sample three fantastic flavors: Goober Vitis (peanut butter and jelly), Suzy's Cherry Pie, and the coffee-infused mead. Each one was exceptional, boasting pure, delightful flavors and an inviting aroma. Overall, the experience was simply outstanding.

The meadery itself boasts a lovely space with spacious tables accommodating 6-8 people comfortably. An L-shaped bar is available, along with a stand-up bar surrounding the fermentation tanks. Additionally, there are picnic tables outdoors for those who prefer to enjoy their mead in the fresh air.

input: I eat at Pina's or take-out about once a month. My favorites includes their dinner specials, cheesesteaks, calzones, and seafood dishes. The shrimp scampi appetizer (sans linguini) and steamed clams are excellent  inexpensive. Service is always flawless. For casual dining this place is very good.
Refine this for me please: I dine at Pina's or get take-out approximately once a month, and it has become one of my favorite places to eat. Their dinner specials, cheesesteaks, calzones, and seafood dishes are particularly enjoyable. Additionally, I highly recommend the shrimp scampi appetizer (without the linguini) and the flavorful steamed clams, which are not only delicious but also reasonably priced. The service at Pina's is consistently flawless, which adds to the overall dining experience. It's a fantastic spot for casual dining, and I highly recommend giving it a try.

input: Great place to watch footy.  I was visiting town for work and needed a place to watch my blues take on barfalona and came across Chatham.  It was a Tuesday so they had $4 Guiness and Black and Tans. Had their fish and chips which was new experience for me. Never had fish that was so soft after being fried, but I really enjoyed it, almost the texture of a donut. Saw my team win and had a great time at this pub.
Refine this for me please:
I highly recommend Chatham as a fantastic spot to watch football. During my recent work trip, I was looking for a place to catch my team, the blues, playing against barfalona. Chatham stood out as the perfect choice. Even though it was a Tuesday, they offered $4 Guinness and Black and Tans, creating an enjoyable atmosphere. 

To complement the beverages, I decided to try their fish and chips, which turned out to be a delightful novelty for me. The texture of the fish was incredibly tender, even after being fried. It reminded me of a donut, which added to the unique experience. 

Not only did I have a great meal, but I also witnessed my team's victory, making the evening even more memorable. Overall, Chatham exceeded my expectations and provided a brilliant pub experience for watching football.

input: This is the place we have been searching for! My friend and I have tried several nail salons in Tampa and nobody could do designs and stuff like how we wanted so we found this place on Instagram and we will never go anywhere else again! We drive almost an hour to get here but it is so worth it! I have had 2 different people who both did exactly what I wanted and are extremely talented! Thank you Pamela and Steven! You all do amazing work!!!
Refine this for me please: We have finally found the perfect place we have been searching for! After trying multiple nail salons in Tampa, my friend and I were disappointed with the lack of design options. However, we stumbled upon this amazing place on Instagram and we are absolutely thrilled with the results. Despite the almost hour-long drive, we are dedicated to coming here exclusively. The talent of the nail technicians is unparalleled, as both Pamela and Steven have flawlessly executed the designs we desired. We are sincerely grateful for their incredible work. Thank you for providing such an exceptional experience!

input:
I can't say enough about Belinda and Jerry! They were so helpful and kind. I am a travel nurse and was leaving my car in Boise for the winter. I came in on a snowy December evening and Balinda reassured me that she would stay and wait for me and Jerry even drove me to my storage shed and helped me with my luggage.
I am so happy with storage experiemce here and with the service I received. I highly recommend!!
Refine this for me please: I cannot express my gratitude enough towards Belinda and Jerry for their exceptional assistance and kindness. As a travel nurse, I needed to leave my car in Boise for the winter, and when I arrived on a snowy December evening, Belinda ensured me that she would stay and wait for me. Moreover, Jerry went above and beyond by driving me to my storage shed and lending a hand with my luggage. I am absolutely thrilled with the storage experience here and the outstanding service I received. I wholeheartedly recommend their services without hesitation.

input:
Unique  is very professional and, based on my experience, operates with the utmost of integrity.
Responsive, transparent, honest are a few words that come to mind .  There technicians were efficient, clean and pleasant. Their pricing was extremely fair. I can state all of this with the highest degree of confidence because it is based on direct experience, not conjecture or inference. The sales person I dealt with (Mike P) and manager Chris are both top notch. 
The house was left spotless, the work was performed to the highest standards. I recommend them highly.  I also encourage you to compare their prices to outfits of similar size and stature.
Refine this for me please: Unique is a highly professional company that operates with the utmost integrity, and I can confidently say this based on my direct experience with them. They are responsive, transparent, and honest in their dealings. Their technicians are efficient, clean, and pleasant to work with. Moreover, their pricing is extremely fair compared to similar companies. The salesperson I worked with, Mike P, and the manager, Chris, are both exceptional individuals. Not only did they leave my house spotless, but they also performed the work to the highest standards. I highly recommend Unique and encourage you to compare their prices with other companies of similar size and stature.

input: This is our go-to takeout place. It has great food and exceptionally fast service. I live at 2601 Parkway and they deliver right to the door of my condo which many delivery places don't do. Their staff is friendly, make great pizza, and generally run such a business as best you can.
Refine this for me please: This is our favorite takeout spot, as it consistently offers fantastic food and remarkably swift service. What sets it apart is that they provide doorstep delivery to my condo at 2601 Parkway, which is a rarity among other delivery establishments. Moreover, the staff is friendly and proficient, ensuring that they run the business to the best of their abilities. Not to mention, their pizza is absolutely amazing.

input: Top notch street tacos, great service and hand made horchata made this a top notch stop
Refine this for me please: With its top-notch street tacos, exceptional service, and handcrafted horchata, this place is an absolute gem.

input:
I went in for a mani and pedi. My student was a nice person and we chatted. However it took 3 hours and my hands just look terrible. The feet are fine and feel great. Hands, just terrible. No one came and checked in if the work was done properly. I'm fine that it takes longer, they are there to learn. However, I shouldn't have been charged for the manicure (pedicure yes) or at least have someone else redo my nails. See the pictures for yourselves, this is 15 minutes out!

Edit: just wanted to add that when I removed my shoes, my pedi was ruined. I asked if it was ready to put shoes on and I was told yes. 2 stars only because at least my student was nice but 0 for the service (34$!)
Refine this for me please:
I had an unsatisfactory experience during my recent mani and pedi appointment. Although my student nail technician was friendly and we had a nice chat, the overall service took an excessive 3 hours, and my hands turned out to look terrible. However, I am pleased with the pedicure as my feet feel great. Unfortunately, nobody checked if the work was done properly or offered to fix my nails. While I understand that the appointment may take longer due to the student learning, I believe I should not have been charged for the manicure and should have had the option for someone else to redo my nails. I have attached pictures taken only 15 minutes after the appointment, which clearly show the poor outcome.

Additionally, I want to emphasize that my pedicure was ruined when I removed my shoes. I specifically asked if it was safe to put my shoes back on and was assured it was, but this turned out to be untrue. I am rating this establishment 2 stars solely based on the student's nice demeanor, but the service itself deserves a 0 rating, especially considering the $34 charged for it.

input: Very nice, quiet and dark restaurant. Chinese and sushi offered. Had szechuan chicken, hot and sour soup, and steamed rice. Hubbie had the prime rib and shrimp hot pot. Just the right amount of food. Didn't have to take any home. Service was excellent.
Refine this for me please:
The restaurant we visited was a delightful combination of elegance and tranquility, with a subdued ambiance that added to its charm. Specializing in both Chinese cuisine and sushi, it catered to a variety of preferences. Among the dishes we savored were the delectable Szechuan chicken, flavorful hot and sour soup, and perfectly steamed rice.

Not to be outdone, my husband opted for the indulgent prime rib and shrimp hot pot, a dish that surpassed his expectations. The portion sizes were impeccably proportioned, leaving us feeling absolutely satisfied without the need to take any leftovers home.

Moreover, the service we received was truly outstanding. The attentive staff ensured our needs were met promptly and courteously. In summary, our dining experience was exceptional, characterized by a serene atmosphere, a diverse menu, and impeccable service.

input: Frank is a great dentist and a very nice guy. He has a gentle manner, takes a sincere interest in his patients and in general is a top quality dentist and person. If you are in the market for a dentist he is an excellent choice. I've gone to him for years and know many others who have as well.
Refine this for me please: Frank is a highly skilled dentist with a remarkable personality. His gentle demeanor and genuine concern for his patients make him an exceptional choice for dental care. Having been a loyal patient of Frank for several years, I can confidently attest to his outstanding qualities as a dentist and as an individual. Numerous others who have sought his services also share this sentiment. If you are in search of a dentist, choosing Frank would undoubtedly be an excellent decision.

input: This was a nice spot with sidewalk lounge seating. Even had a DJ outside Friday night. There was a walk up bar outside too. The decor inside was pretty sweet. We tried a few appetizers and they were both good! It is located in a trendy waterfront area.
Refine this for me please: This establishment was a pleasant spot featuring sidewalk lounge seating, creating an inviting atmosphere. Additionally, on Friday nights, there was the added enjoyment of an outside DJ. As an added convenience, there was also a walk-up bar available outside. The interior decor of the venue was tastefully done, showcasing an appealing ambiance. We had the opportunity to sample a few appetizers, and they were all quite enjoyable. Moreover, the location itself is situated in a trendy waterfront area.

input:
Our office went today for Friday's happy hour special.  Such a great deal, and it wasn't packed.  Didn't expect it, but the food and drinks on their specials-amazing!  Usually the happy hour offerings wouldn't be. Definitely try the pork sliders and the beignets for dessert.  Really fun time and great atmosphere.

Staff was very friendly too!
Refine this for me please: Today, our office decided to take advantage of the Friday's happy hour special. We were pleasantly surprised to find that it wasn't overcrowded, making it an even better experience. The food and drinks on their specials menu exceeded our expectations, which is not always the case with happy hour offerings. I highly recommend trying the pork sliders and indulging in the beignets for dessert. The atmosphere was lively and enjoyable, making it a truly fun time. Additionally, the staff was exceptionally friendly and accommodating throughout our visit.

input: Stopped in tonight for a light bite to eat. I was so impressed! Great service, great fresh, fresh food and beautiful atmosphere- we sat outside in the warm October evening air.  Lisa was a great host, explaining the menu and checked in with us frequently - we ended up chatting with her quite a bit and that only made the whole evening more enjoyable. What a wonderful place- we will certainly be back for more!
Refine this for me please: I had the pleasure of stopping by tonight for a light bite to eat and I must say, I was thoroughly impressed! The service was outstanding, and the food was incredibly fresh and delicious. The atmosphere was also stunning, especially as we chose to sit outside and enjoy the warm October evening. Lisa, our wonderful host, took the time to explain the menu and stayed attentive throughout our meal, leading to enjoyable conversations with her. Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and we certainly plan on returning for more.

input: I've been to Lush in Arizona, S.F., San Jose and Maui. The one in New Orleans is My favorite one. I love how you can smell a Lush store from a block away. :) I've been to this one a few times, Always on Halloween. Always a fun time :)
Refine this for me please: Out of all the Lush stores I've visited in Arizona, San Francisco, San Jose, and Maui, the one in New Orleans is by far my favorite. One thing I absolutely love about it is how its delightful aroma fills the air even a block away. I have had the pleasure of visiting this particular store on multiple occasions, and each time has always been during Halloween. Without fail, I can always count on having an incredibly enjoyable and fun experience while there.

input: Love love love this place for HH n dinner is good too! Its ok for brunch, not as great as what people praise it to be. The Asian Nachos are the dish to get for HH. Its an entree itself! The other HH dishes are great too. The creme brulee is amazing as with their other desserts. The blueberry mojito is awesome along with the mango sling. Great place to celebrate birthdays and such.  Nice feel to it. Bar area gets crowded as it gets later for HH. As usual around the mall, finding parking sux!
Refine this for me please: I absolutely love this place for happy hour and dinner! The brunch is decent, although it doesn't live up to the hype. However, the Asian Nachos are an absolute must-try for happy hour - they're practically an entire meal on their own! The other happy hour dishes are also fantastic. And don't get me started on their desserts - the creme brulee is to die for, and all the other options are equally amazing. The blueberry mojito and mango sling are my personal favorites from the drink menu. It's a wonderful spot to celebrate birthdays and special occasions, with a nice ambiance. Just keep in mind that the bar area tends to get crowded later during happy hour. And like any place near a mall, parking can be a real pain.

input: Delicious top shelf pastries. I am outraged at the poor ratings. If you're looking for cheapness over flavor then go to Panera. Service has always been exceedingly pleasent when I go, and I am an obnoxious needy customer. We are so excited to have them make macaroons for our wedding.
Refine this for me please: Indulge in delectable, premium-quality pastries that are simply irresistible. Despite the disappointing ratings, I must express my outrage as nothing can compare to the flavors offered here. If your preference veers towards affordability rather than taste, you may find Panera more suitable. It is worth mentioning that the service at this establishment has consistently been exceptional, even when catering to a demanding customer like myself. We couldn't be more thrilled to have entrusted them with creating our wedding macaroons.

input: I could be craving pizza and be walking by and STILL not go in again. I will say the ingredients are definitely fresh and service was great however the pizza is just plain not good. The crust is so thin that the pizza is cold within a few minutes and it was just a little floppy and bland. I wanted to love this place but with so many other pizzerias in the area I won't be going back.
Refine this for me please: Although I may find myself longing for pizza as I walk by, I resist the temptation to enter this establishment again. While I must acknowledge the freshness of the ingredients and the excellent service, the pizza itself simply does not meet my standards. Its wafer-thin crust cools down extraordinarily quickly, making for a disappointing experience. Additionally, the lackluster taste and flimsy texture leave much to be desired. Despite my initial hopes, I regret to say that I won't be returning to this place, especially with an abundance of superior pizzerias nearby.

input: Love the tap room, but I can't seem to get the hours of business right.  My first visit was a kinda a let down.  I had heard that bier was the place to go for great beers in Indianapolis, but I only found 2 that I liked and only 1 was memorable.  However, bier rotates their taps weekly and does not seem to have any regular taps, I like this because it means that they are constantly challenging themselves to create a better beer.   The tap room is a lot of fun too with people constantly revolving around the taps to taste and find their favorite for the week and then relaxing and talking in the lounge area.  I only gave them 3stars this time but I look forward to improving their score after future visits.
Refine this for me please: I really enjoy visiting the tap room, but I have been struggling to figure out their business hours. My first visit was a bit disappointing. I had been told that Bier was the ultimate destination for great beers in Indianapolis, but I only found two that I liked, and only one was truly memorable. One thing I appreciate about Bier is that they rotate their taps weekly, without any regular ones. This shows that they are constantly pushing themselves to create better beers. The tap room itself is quite lively, with people constantly trying out different beers and discussing their favorites in the lounge area. I have given them a three-star rating this time, but I am hopeful that my future visits will bring higher ratings.

input: Beautifully sweet ending to a sweet trip to NOLA with the girls. We stumbled upon this after a delicous savory lunch nearby at Cochon (review to follow). Sweet Confections is on Magazine St, around corner from the art gallery strip on Julia St.   We had a sampling of cupcake (chocolate with mocha filling) and truffles (raspberry, creme brulee, and orange).  Cupcake was good, mocha filling best part. Rasberry truffle was my fav, love the dark chocolate so it's not cloyingly sweet. The coffee was a wonderful chaser, not overly burnt, smoky, or acidic... I usually have coffee with milk n sugar, forgot this time, but I didn't even need it!  Seating was nice, with a few cafe tables inside. Enough for our 6-girl troop. And service was great, helpful with flavor suggestions and labelling.  Gave 4 of 5 stars because maybe they could benefit from one more equally gracious staff person.
Refine this for me please:
We had a beautifully sweet ending to our girls' trip to NOLA at Sweet Confections. After enjoying a delicious savory lunch at Cochon nearby (review to follow), we stumbled upon this charming bakery on Magazine St, just around the corner from the art gallery strip on Julia St.

At Sweet Confections, we indulged in a delightful sampling of cupcakes and truffles. The chocolate cupcake with mocha filling was good, but the mocha filling was the best part. Among the truffles, the raspberry flavor was my favorite. I appreciated that the dark chocolate was not overpoweringly sweet, allowing the raspberry to shine. We also enjoyed the creme brulee and orange truffles. 

To complement our treats, we ordered coffee, which turned out to be a pleasant surprise. The coffee had a wonderful flavor, without being overly burnt, smoky, or acidic. I typically add milk and sugar to my coffee, but this time, I didn't even need it!

The seating at Sweet Confections was comfortable, with a few cafe tables available inside. It was spacious enough for our group of six girls. The service we received was great, with the staff being helpful in suggesting flavors and clearly labeling each treat.

I would give Sweet Confections a rating of 4 out of 5 stars. The only suggestion I have is that perhaps having one more equally gracious staff person would enhance the overall experience.

input: Pulled pork sandwich was Delicious .. BUT! The lucky bun (Asian fusion style ) burger . Was a disappointment for the sole purpose of them using a frozen beef patty :/  the bread was good .. The toppings and sauces were great .. But just killed the flavors with a processed frozen beef patty .. If used a fresh ground meat .. It would have been a great gourmet burger ..
Refine this for me please: The pulled pork sandwich was absolutely delicious, no complaints there. However, I have to express my disappointment with the lucky bun (Asian fusion style) burger. The predominant reason for my dissatisfaction was the use of a frozen beef patty :/ The bread was good, and the toppings and sauces were fantastic, but the use of a processed frozen beef patty diminished the overall flavor. If they had used fresh ground meat instead, it would have elevated the burger to a fantastic gourmet level.

input: This is a great place to bring the kids to. They can have juice, a slice of cake, and homemade popsicles. They think it is a tea party. I have tried everything once and my favorites are the homemade doughnuts filled with read bean, the popsicles, the patbingsu, and even the good ol' coffee cream and sugar.
Refine this for me please: This is an excellent family-friendly place to visit, perfect for bringing the kids along. They can enjoy refreshing juice, a delicious slice of cake, and delightful homemade popsicles, creating a delightful tea party atmosphere. Having personally tried everything on the menu, I highly recommend the homemade doughnuts filled with red bean, the mouthwatering popsicles, the delightful patbingsu, and even the classic combination of coffee with cream and sugar.

input: Always awesome!  Best crust ever and super Fresh ingredients and nice staff.  Lots of yummy toppings that aren't offered at other pizza places.   Great salads too! Patio area is a cool place to kick back,have a beer or glass of wine and savor the best pizza in town.
Refine this for me please: This place is consistently amazing! They serve the best crust I have ever tasted and use fresh ingredients. The staff is friendly and accommodating. They have a wide selection of unique toppings that you won't find at other pizza places. Additionally, their salads are delicious. The patio area provides a relaxed atmosphere to enjoy a refreshing beer or glass of wine while indulging in the best pizza in town.

input: I love this gas station. I work at a hotel on the beach and send guests here just about every day. Also it's the only one on Clearwater Beach that's open 27/7
Refine this for me please: I have a strong appreciation for this gas station. As an employee at a beachfront hotel, I consistently recommend this particular establishment to our guests. Notably, it is the sole gas station available on Clearwater Beach that operates 24/7, providing unrivaled convenience.

input: Holy bat crap, this place is amazing. Go to place in St. Pete, anything on the menu was good. Food coma!
Refine this for me please: Wow, this place is absolutely incredible! A must-visit spot in St. Pete. Every item on the menu is just delicious. Prepare yourself for a food coma after indulging here!

input:
This Chipotle location was great! I wanted to thank Chipotle for recognizing teachers for Teacher Appreciation Week! 
The line was very small and they served quickly as a pose to another location that had the line wrapped around the store! 
Their food is always fresh, tasteful and fulfilling! 
My go to is always the bowl with white cilantro lime rice,black beans, steak and all the toppings! 
Must eat with a bag of fresh tortilla chips!!
Refine this for me please: I had an amazing experience at this Chipotle location and I wanted to express my gratitude to Chipotle for acknowledging teachers during Teacher Appreciation Week. Unlike another location where the line was wrapped around the store, this particular location had a small and quick-moving line. The food at this Chipotle is consistently fresh, flavorful, and satisfying. Personally, my favorite choice is the bowl with white cilantro lime rice, black beans, steak, and all the toppings. It pairs perfectly with a bag of their delicious tortilla chips.

input: Standard Jimmy Johns fare: nothing especially good or bad about this one. Restaurant was very clean.
Refine this for me please: Standard Jimmy Johns fare with no particularly exceptional or adverse qualities. However, it is worth noting that the restaurant maintained a high level of cleanliness.

input: I Recently vacationed in St. Petersburg with my family. Dooners was definitely my favorite meal of the trip. Great food and incredibly helpful and friendly staff. Would definitely recommend to anyone, and wouldn't hesitate to go again.
Refine this for me please: During my recent family vacation in St. Petersburg, I had the pleasure of dining at Dooners, which turned out to be my absolute favorite meal of the trip. Not only was the food delicious, but the staff was also incredibly helpful and friendly, adding to the overall fantastic dining experience. I highly recommend Dooners to anyone visiting St. Petersburg and I would personally go back without any hesitation.

input:
Very cool bar attached to the Alexander Hotel. Several vintage cocktails from pre-prohibition are on the menu. None cooler than "The Elephant in the Room" a bourbon cocktail which comes in its own decanter filled with cherrywood smoke. You decide how long to let it infuse. Lots of comfortable seating and when it warms up a touch a large beautiful deck with seating and heating overlooks the street life. As an added bonus you can relax and watch people work out through the glass of the new CityWay YMCA. 
And yes the truffle oil and sea salt popcorn that greets every patron is as good as it sounds. Get a beer and start collecting bags, once you start you can't stop.
Refine this for me please:
Refined version: Experience the ultimate vintage cocktail experience at the uniquely attached bar to the Alexander Hotel. Indulge in a selection of pre-prohibition cocktails, with the star of the menu being "The Elephant in the Room" - a mesmerizing bourbon cocktail served in a decanter infused with cherrywood smoke, allowing you to control the infusion time. 

The bar offers an inviting atmosphere with plenty of comfortable seating. As the weather warms up, enjoy the picturesque view of the bustling street life from the expansive deck, complete with cozy seating and heating. For added entertainment, marvel at the sight of people working out through the glass walls of the nearby CityWay YMCA. 

An extra treat awaits all patrons as they are greeted with a delectable serving of truffle oil and sea salt popcorn that lives up to its irresistible reputation. Quench your thirst with a beer and don't be surprised if you find yourself unable to resist collecting more bags of this addictive popcorn.

input:
This hotel is a gem in the heart of Philadelphia.

It's a cozy, quaint, and charming property. The rooms are spacious, modern and gorgeous. 
The decor is chic and attractive: big wooden desk, hardwood floors, couches and throw pillows: Looks more like a friend's apartment than a hotel. 

Free breakfast is always a plus for those of us with limited time. It's not a hot breakfast (I've had so many mass-produced bad ones, so I'm not complaining) but greek yogurt, a huge croissant, an orange and some cranberry juice hits the spot! They leave it at your door though, instead of ringing your bell to wake you. So if you ask for it to be delivered at 7 a.m., check outside your door; by 7:01 it WILL be there. 

Coffee, a variety of teas, cold and hot water, as well as ice and a bowl of assorted fruit are available 24/7 in the lobby. There are doorbells for each room, and the hotel can only be accessed after hours if you have a key card. Floors are acessible with a keycard as well, for extra protection. The staff is very polite: one of the few places in Philly where someone will actually say "good morning" to you (No, seriously. I lived there for 5 years, so trust me on that). They're also extremely helpful. When I checked in the night before, the gentleman at the reservation desk called to make sure I had a cab waiting for me at 8:15 the next morning so that I could make my speaking engagement on time. While I was getting my clothes ready, my iron was making more wrinkles than it was taking out, so I asked them for a new one and within 30 seconds, I had a brand new model with all the bells and whistles.

I've read a few reviews talking about the noise level of this place. My room was closest to the reception desk and I never heard a peep. There were people out and about, but I didn't hear a thing. And I'm a very light sleeper...

A few things to note:
Its location on a tight, one way street can cause a little difficulty if you're traveling solo, but if you have one person to unload the car while someone else parks, you should be fine. The parking garage they use is about half a block from the hotel, but you have to drive in a big rectangle to get there. 

There's a stand-up shower instead of the traditional bathtub/shower combo. It fits one comfortably enough... provided that you're not too far from average height and build. (My boyfriend is 6'2 with a football player build and he made out okay.)

Don't expect much of a view. The view from our room was of the side of another building. But that's what the city is for... go out there and see something!

Overall, this was an excellent trip and a great find. I highly recommend this hotel to anyone.
Refine this for me please:
This hotel is a hidden gem located in the heart of Philadelphia. The property exudes a cozy, quaint, and charming atmosphere that will make you feel right at home. The rooms are spacious, modern, and gorgeously decorated with chic and attractive furniture, such as a big wooden desk, hardwood floors, and comfortable couches adorned with decorative throw pillows. The atmosphere is more reminiscent of a friend's stylish apartment than a traditional hotel.

One of the standout features of this hotel is the complimentary breakfast, which is a big plus for those with limited time. While it may not be a hot breakfast, which is often disappointing in many hotels, the offerings of Greek yogurt, a huge croissant, an orange, and some refreshing cranberry juice are satisfying and hit the spot. The breakfast is conveniently delivered to your door at the specified time without any disturbance, ensuring a seamless start to your day.

Furthermore, the hotel provides 24/7 access to coffee, a variety of teas, cold and hot water, as well as ice and a bowl of assorted fruit in the lobby. The security measures are also commendable, with keycard access required to enter the hotel premises and to access each floor, ensuring extra protection for guests.

The staff at this hotel is exceptional, offering genuine politeness and helpfulness that is often lacking in many establishments. The gentleman at the reservation desk went above and beyond by arranging a cab for me the next morning to ensure I made it to my speaking engagement on time. Additionally, when I encountered a problem with my iron, they promptly provided me with a brand new model, showcasing their efficiency and commitment to guest satisfaction.

Regarding noise levels, despite being located close to the reception desk, I did not experience any disturbances in my room. The hotel ensures a peaceful environment, allowing light sleepers like myself to have a restful stay.

A few things to consider are the hotel's location on a tight, one-way street, which may pose a slight challenge for solo travelers. However, with a partner to assist in unloading and parking, this should not be an issue. Additionally, the parking garage, although conveniently located half a block away, requires navigating through a big rectangle, which may be a minor inconvenience for some.

The rooms feature stand-up showers instead of the traditional bathtub/shower combo, which may be a bit of a tight fit for individuals who are taller or broader in build. However, despite this limitation, my 6'2 boyfriend with a football player build managed to have a comfortable shower experience.

Lastly, it's important to note that the hotel does not offer breathtaking views, as my room overlooked the side of another building. However, with the vibrant city of Philadelphia waiting to be explored, this was not a significant drawback.

Overall, my experience at this hotel was excellent, and I highly recommend it to anyone visiting Philadelphia. It offers a rare combination of comfort, style, and excellent service that sets it apart from other hotels in the area.

input:
Was taken here today by a Colombian friend who needed to satisfy a craving for something cheap and delicious. This place reminds me of Nanzhou, a Yelp favorite, because of the heaping helpings you get for next to nothing. 

I got the oxtail soup (Sancocho) with extra rice and plantains to see how it would differ from the Korean-style stuff I was used to at home. Aside from a thicker, stew-like broth and beefier potatoes, it was just as delicious. My friend got a flat steak (Carne Asada) that I think he ate in just under 10 seconds. 

Remember Yelp, you're missing out on a lot if you don't visit NE philly once in a while, especially this place.
Refine this for me please:
I was brought here today by a Colombian friend who was craving something that was both affordable and delicious. This place reminded me of Nanzhou, a popular choice on Yelp, because it offers generous portions at very reasonable prices. 

For my meal, I decided to try the oxtail soup (Sancocho) with extra rice and plantains, to compare it to the Korean-style dishes I usually have at home. Besides having a thicker, stew-like broth and more flavorful potatoes, it was just as enjoyable. My friend opted for the flat steak (Carne Asada) and devoured it in under 10 seconds.

If you haven't visited NE Philly, especially this place, you're missing out on a great experience that Yelp can't fully capture.

input: My friends and I all got one of each that were available to try out. I love the many fun donut flavors they have there. The thing that stood out to me was their fried chicken. I got the chicken sandwich and it was SO GOOD. I highly recommend it.
Refine this for me please: My friends and I decided to each order a different item from the available options in order to try them all. Among the many enjoyable donut flavors at the place, I found the fried chicken to be the most outstanding. I opted for the chicken sandwich and I must say, it exceeded my expectations. It was incredibly delicious, and I strongly recommend trying it.

input: Pricey ( a ham and cheese croissant was $5.50)  as with anywhere in Santa Barbra but very delicious. Cute space ( a bit hard to find ). The green eggs and ham  breakfast biscuit is to die for.  ($10 I think) The Santa Barbra tri tip sandwich was excellent! Cold brew coffee was good. Lots of good choices in the grab and go section, and our salami and pesto sammy was also great. I'd go back!
Refine this for me please: Refined version: Despite being pricey, the ham and cheese croissant at this place in Santa Barbara is worth every penny as it is incredibly delicious. The space is cute, although a bit difficult to locate. The green eggs and ham breakfast biscuit, priced at around $10, is absolutely delightful. I highly recommend trying the Santa Barbara tri-tip sandwich, which is superb. The cold brew coffee is also quite satisfying. The grab and go section offers a wide variety of delectable options, and our salami and pesto sandwich was particularly delightful. Overall, I would definitely return to this establishment.

input: The food is delicious but the service has always been pretty slow if not bad which would be understandable if it was busy it's just usually it's not .
Refine this for me please: The food is savory and delectable, however, the service has consistently been slow and, at times, subpar. This could be somewhat understandable during busy periods, yet it is perplexing as the establishment is typically not crowded.

input:
One of my most favorite Indian restaurants. Nothing fancy but absolutely delicious meals.

Never an issue being seated promptly. A casual dining experience awaits. Service is pleasant. Ambience a bit blahh but still enjoyable.

Now onto the real reason to come here... the FOOD:
Naan is soft. Garlic is tasty but I usually like the original best.  Regardless of your entree of choice, you really cannot go wrong. And although it does not appeal to my level of spiciness preferred (I like it HOT HOT HOT), it has great flavor and is great for the average spicey food eater. My recommendations are the Masala or Vindaloo (Chicken, Shrimp, Lamb... option is yours). Room for dessert? Order the Rice Pudding  and Gulab Jaman, mix together and enjoy the creamy sugary treat.
Refine this for me please:
This is one of my absolute favorite Indian restaurants. While it may not be fancy, it serves incredibly delicious meals.

Seating is always prompt and hassle-free. The dining experience here is casual, perfect for a relaxed meal. The service is friendly and accommodating. The only downside is that the ambience could be better, but it is still enjoyable.

Now, let's talk about the real star of the show: the food. The naan bread is soft and mouthwatering. I personally prefer the original flavor over the garlic. Regardless of what you choose as your main dish, you can't go wrong. While it may not be as spicy as I like it (I prefer it really hot), it still packs great flavor and is perfect for those who enjoy a moderate level of spiciness. I highly recommend the Masala or Vindaloo, whether you prefer chicken, shrimp, or lamb.

And if you have room for dessert, you must try the Rice Pudding and Gulab Jaman. Mix them together for a delightful, creamy, and sugary treat.

input:
I can say this is the best burger of my life!

You sit outside and Goleta holester Ave is nothing special.   But the burger is the best
Refine this for me please: Refined: Although Goleta Hollister Ave may not have an extraordinary ambiance, I must admit that this burger is unparalleled and indisputably the best I've ever had in my life!

input:
To the other reviewers 
You are reviewing the god damn stadium, not that your a Philly fan, and OMG your team won the world series in 08. 

-The food sucks, they do not have enough vendors, So if your enjoying the game, you pretty much have to get up to buy yourself a pretzel or soda. 
-Point out the worst food, the "Hoagies" or whatever are Terrible. Aren't they suppose to be like really good (Believe I'm in Philly). The french fries are mad greasy and no crunch or anything. They were soggy, greasy fries!!!! 
- They have cheap small TVs, that are blurry as hell, so there goes the idea of watching the game while your on line waiting for your food. 
- I would love to understand how the game has just started (3rd inning), and I find empty beer containers everywhere.. 

This is not part of my judgement, but for other people to be aware and be careful 
Philly fans are the RUDEST and NASTIEST people. They are very drunk people, they get in your face, they will spill things on you. Even if your a girl, they have no respect. 

This stadium SUCKS, visit it, knock it off your list, see cheap home runs, since the stadium is built for hitters... 
but we advised...Bring your own food and beware of Philly fans. 
PS: There still are nasty even if you aren't a mets fan...they are just rude people.
Refine this for me please:
To the other reviewers,
I would like to address a few aspects of the stadium experience that I found disappointing. Firstly, the food options were limited and the available vendors were insufficient. This meant that if you wanted a snack or beverage during the game, you had to leave your seat and purchase it yourself. Additionally, I must mention the poor quality of the "Hoagies" or similar food items. As someone who expected great food in Philly, these fell far below expectations. The french fries were soggy, greasy, and lacked any crunch, which was quite disheartening.

Furthermore, the stadium's small and blurry TVs made it impossible to watch the game while waiting in line for food. This was a missed opportunity to keep fans engaged during any breaks. Additionally, I was surprised to find empty beer containers scattered throughout the stadium early on in the game (only the 3rd inning). It was disappointing to witness this lack of cleanliness.

Now, I'd like to make a brief note to others considering this stadium. Please be aware that the behavior of some Philly fans can be quite rude and disrespectful. They tend to be heavily intoxicated and may confront you or even spill things on you. Their behavior is not limited to rivalry situations, as they can be impolite regardless of team affiliation.

In conclusion, this stadium overall did not meet my expectations. While there may be the occasional exciting home run due to the stadium's design, I would caution others to bring their own food and be wary of the behavior of some Philly fans. Whether you're a Mets fan or not, it's important to note that rudeness seems to be more common than not amongst certain attendees.

input: I cannot say enough how much I loved this place!! It has a great old school diner vibe. The workers there were so so nice. I had never had gumbo and they make it to order but they made us 2 little tasters, and I usually don't even like shrimp but I ate every last bite!!! We also had the grits, fried chicken and the split pea soup was the best freaking split pea soup I have ever had in my life and I am not kidding. And the prices are insanely affordable, between the 2 of us we ordered a lot of food and beers for only $25. Great deal!
Refine this for me please: I cannot express enough how much I adored this place! The ambiance is wonderfully reminiscent of an old school diner. The staff members were incredibly kind and friendly. I had the opportunity to try their gumbo, which they made fresh upon order. Although I typically don't enjoy shrimp, they prepared two small samplers for us, and I savored every single bite! Additionally, their grits, fried chicken, and split pea soup were absolutely outstanding. In fact, I have never tasted split pea soup as exquisite as theirs in my entire life, and I am not exaggerating. Moreover, the prices are unbelievably reasonable. Despite ordering a substantial amount of food and beverages, my friend and I only paid $25 in total. What an exceptional deal!

input:
If you want stunning and unique pieces of jewelry, this is the place for it! The two marvelous owners, Ali and Albisia, are such sweet people. They create amazing jewelry that you really will have a hard time choosing from! I have a necklace, two bracelets, and a ring and am already hankering for more... There's also great music to add to the decor and general ambience of the store... and you get offered wine as you peruse! What can be better than that? 

Hope to visit Tampa again soon and see you guys soon!! :)
Refine this for me please: If you're in search of extraordinary and one-of-a-kind jewelry, look no further! This place is a haven for stunning pieces that will leave you in awe. The owners, Ali and Albisia, are not only incredibly talented but also incredibly kind. Their creations are so incredible that deciding on just one can be a challenge. Personally, I already own a necklace, two bracelets, and a ring, and I can't help but eagerly anticipate my next purchase. To add to the delightful shopping experience, the store has a fantastic selection of music that enhances the overall ambiance. Plus, as you browse, you are graciously offered a glass of wine. It doesn't get much better than that! I absolutely can't wait to return to Tampa and visit this shop again. See you soon!

input: Good menu, solid ingredients, but these folks are not sandwich artists.  I had a Turkey and Brie Wrap one day and the Spinach Florentine Wrap the next.  Both "wraps" could have more fittingly been called "crumples" because that's how they were assembled.  While watching the sandwich line I kept thinking, "Thank god they're not trying to fold burritos!"  Everyone in the sandwich line either looked befuddled by anything other than a plain bagel or like they were supposed to be somewhere else ten minutes ago.  Also, can we please hang a few signs like "order here", "pick-up here," "pay-here" to direct traffic instead of the east coast "If you don already know, then leave!" attitude?
Refine this for me please: The menu offers great options with quality ingredients, but the staff lacks expertise in sandwich making. I ordered a Turkey and Brie Wrap one day and a Spinach Florentine Wrap the next. Both wraps were poorly assembled and resembled crumples rather than wraps. Observing the sandwich line, I couldn't help but think how fortunate they weren't attempting to fold burritos. The individuals working at the sandwich station appeared either confused when faced with anything beyond a plain bagel or as if they were in a hurry to be somewhere else. Additionally, it would be helpful to have signs indicating where to place orders, pick up orders, and make payments, rather than adopting the unwelcoming attitude of "If you don't already know, then leave!" commonly found on the East Coast.

input:
This place is absolutely amazing. A cute little bakery and the employees are super attentive. I walked in and was bouncing around from one dessert to another deciding if I should make a purchase. The employee offered me a sample of the banana puddings - definitely try some! And you know how sometimes when they give you so small of a sample to taste, you can't really make a proper judgment because there isn't enough to judge from? Not the case here!

I got the salted caramel banana, the strawberry banana pudding and the upside pineapple cake.

Thoughts: OMG!! I never crave banana pudding and never really thought anything of the dessert. But man after this, I wanted to go home and make my own banana pudding (Although I highly doubt that I could make it half as good)! Their desserts are crafted perfect - three/four layers depending on what you get. The bottom layer the the pudding, second layer is the nilla wafers or they might even use some sort of pound cake(whatever it was - it was AMAZING), third layer, the strawberry and then the top layer is pudding with a nice whipped creme and topping. The creme has so much flavor and the texture is so smooth. Everything just comes together so nicely! 

The upside pineapple cake was BOMB. the cake wasn't too fluffy but was dense to the perfect amount to Taste like what it's suppose to. The pineapple flavor isn't overwhelming but just right. My only problem was that the pineapple bottom got a little too carameliZed with brown sugar and was a bit hard to chew.

Definitely go to this place! I was so sad that there was no option to leave them a tip. (They use an iPad to ring you up). The service/help was so great and I would have left a tip but I had no cash. Any ways, highly recommend this place for desserts!!
Refine this for me please:
This place is truly amazing. It's a charming little bakery with extremely attentive employees. When I entered, I couldn't help but be drawn to the enticing display of desserts. Luckily, one of the employees offered me a sample of their banana puddings, which I absolutely recommend trying. Unlike other places that give you a minuscule sample that doesn't allow for a proper judgment, this bakery was generous with their sample.

I ended up purchasing the salted caramel banana, strawberry banana pudding, and the upside pineapple cake. Let me just say, OMG!! I never had a craving for banana pudding and never really thought much of it before. But after trying their version, I wanted to go home and attempt to recreate it myself (although I highly doubt I could make it half as good). Their desserts are crafted perfectly, with three or four layers depending on your choice. The bottom layer is the pudding, followed by nilla wafers or possibly some sort of pound cake (whatever it was, it was AMAZING), then the strawberry, and finally topped with pudding and a delicious whipped cream. The cream is bursting with flavor and has a wonderfully smooth texture. Everything just harmonizes perfectly!

Now, let's talk about the upside pineapple cake. It was absolutely BOMB. The cake had the perfect density, not too fluffy but just right. The pineapple flavor wasn't overpowering but just the right amount. My only complaint was that the bottom part with pineapple got a little too caramelized with brown sugar, making it slightly tough to chew.

I highly recommend visiting this place for their desserts. I was disappointed to find that there was no option to leave a tip, as they use an iPad to process payments. The service and help I received were fantastic, and I would have gladly left a tip if I had cash on me. Anyway, don't miss out on this fantastic dessert spot!

input: I visited the new Paoli location. BIG selection of tasty donuts. It's about time--the cardboard impostors found at Dunkin are so lame compared to these beauties. Salted Caramel, Bacon Maple, Lemon--now you're talking my language. Breakfast sandwiches, muffins, and bagels, oh my.
Refine this for me please: I recently had the opportunity to visit the new Paoli location and was blown away by their extensive range of delicious donuts. I must say, it was about time for a change, as the donuts I usually find at Dunkin' pale in comparison to these delectable treats. Flavors like Salted Caramel, Bacon Maple, and Lemon truly spoke my language and left me craving for more. Moreover, aside from their impressive donut selection, they also offer a delightful variety of breakfast sandwiches, muffins, and bagels. It's safe to say that my experience there was simply delightful.

input: So our most recent visit earlier this month was very disappointing, however we received an email from the company's guest service, followed by a call from the Hermitage O'Charley's manager Chris who was very professional and apologetic about our experience and asked that we give his location another try on them. So I convinced my husband to do so. Here's how this 2nd chance went:: Absolutely wonderful. Chris asked that we let him know when we wanted to give the restaurant a second chance, but we decided not to. We didn't want any special attention. We wanted real unreviewed service.  We were seated in the bar because it was a very  busy night, regardless of that the server was very attentive and had a great personality. Our food came out in a timely manner, well prepared and delicious. We have since then been back several times and service continues to remain great.
Refine this for me please:
Despite our disappointing visit earlier this month, we were pleasantly surprised by the response from the company's guest service. We received an email followed by a call from the hermitage O'Charley's manager, Chris, who was extremely professional and apologetic about our experience. He asked us to give his location another try, which convinced me to convince my husband to do so. 

On our second visit, everything was absolutely wonderful. Although Chris had asked us to inform him when we wanted to return, we wanted to experience the restaurant without any special attention. Hence, we chose not to inform him. Despite a busy night, we were seated in the bar area. However, the server was incredibly attentive and had a great personality. The food arrived promptly, was well-prepared, and most importantly, delicious. 

Since then, we have frequented the restaurant several times, and each visit maintains the high level of service we initially experienced.

input: In love with my haircut! Very reasonable prices as well. This is my second time here. The first time the cut and style were amazing but the color was a little off from what I wanted but it still looked good. I will definitely continue to be a returning customer.
Refine this for me please: I'm absolutely in love with the result of my haircut! The prices are very reasonable too. This was my second time visiting this place, and once again, the cut and style came out amazing. Though the color didn't exactly match my desired preference the first time, it still looked great. I am definitely planning to continue coming back as a loyal customer.

input: So much care is given to healthy, delicious food (ex. Japanese squash rather than white potatoes in curry). Thay have nice touches like a welcome snack and straw wrappers twisted in a rose. The sauces are amazing, menu has so many options, they accomodate special dietary needs easily since everything is made from scratch; even the desserts have that extra touch using both white and black sticky rice. This is our go-to for Thai from now on!
Refine this for me please:
We appreciate the incredible attention to detail placed on serving healthy and flavorful food at this establishment. For instance, they opt for nutritious alternatives like Japanese squash instead of white potatoes in their curry. The thoughtfulness extends beyond just the food, as they even provide a welcoming snack and wrap their straws in the shape of a rose.

The menu boasts an impressive array of options, and the sauces are nothing short of amazing. What sets this place apart is their ability to easily accommodate special dietary needs, thanks to their commitment to making everything from scratch. Even their desserts demonstrate a dedication to excellence, incorporating the delightful combination of white and black sticky rice.

We have declared this establishment as our preferred destination for Thai cuisine from now on!

input:
Great grocery store in the Mid-city neighborhood. It had great deli, soup, hot bar, and salad bar options. It was like a waaaay less expensive Whole Foods. On the weekends they had crawfish or lobster boils by the lbs. This would be my go to store if I lived here for sure. Big plus it's LOCAL!!!

* Fried Chicken was BOMBlicious!!!!
Refine this for me please: Refined version: This grocery store in the Mid-city neighborhood offers a fantastic selection of deli, soup, hot bar, and salad bar options. It's like an affordable alternative to Whole Foods. On weekends, they even have crawfish or lobster boils available by the pound. It's definitely a top choice for residents, and the fact that it's a local establishment is a big plus. Oh, and their fried chicken is absolutely delicious!

input: I made my Yelp account for the soul purpose of reviewing this place; I think that very much speaks to how I enjoyed the experience. It's exactly what you would expect from a local cafe/coffee shop and then some. The food and coffee were great and the atmosphere was very friendly and casual. The architecture of the dining room was very cool as well - it had a very Victorian feel, which I personally love. The service was a bit slow, but the barista was the only person working behind the counter and she was also very personable, so for that we can forgive her. When I go to a coffee shop I usually go to stay and relax, often reading or sketching. It is the perfect place for that, with both indoor and outdoor tables, a booth, and a counter. I also appreciated the dog-friendly policy but that's definitely a personal preference and isn't right for everyone. The location is also great, being situated in the French quarter. My only complaint is that I could only visit once on my trip to New Orleans.
Refine this for me please: I created my Yelp account solely to review this place, which truly reflects how much I enjoyed my experience. This local cafe/coffee shop exceeded my expectations in every way. The food and coffee were excellent, and the atmosphere exuded a friendly and casual vibe. The dining room's architecture was particularly impressive, evoking a charming Victorian feel that I personally adore. Although the service was slightly slow, I understood that the barista was the only staff member behind the counter, and her personable nature made up for this minor inconvenience. When I visit coffee shops, I often intend to relax and indulge in activities like reading or sketching. This place provided the perfect ambiance for such pursuits, with a variety of seating options including indoor and outdoor tables, a booth, and a counter. Moreover, their dog-friendly policy was a bonus for me, although I recognize that it may not suit everyone's preferences. Additionally, the location in the French Quarter was fantastic. My only regret is that I could only visit this gem once during my trip to New Orleans.

input: High pressure tea sales!  Good teas but outrageously expensive.  Try Republic of Tea or even good old Twinings.
Refine this for me please: Welcome to the world of premium teas! Indulge in the rich flavors and exquisite aromas of our high-quality selection. While some may consider our offerings to be on the pricier side, we assure you that the value and experience they provide are well worth it. Embrace the elevated taste and unmatched quality of brands like Republic of Tea or the timeless classic, Twinings. Treat yourself to the finest teas available and discover a whole new level of tea enjoyment.

input:
oh Millers, how i wanted to like you.  You are close to my house, have ample parking, and large spacious tables.  you even have a fireplace in the back for a little ambiance. 

friends and i tried to come here 2 or 3 times for a quick/inexpensive* bite to eat and every time there was a 30-60 minute wait. we thought this must mean they are really good.  perhaps it just means that people in Springfield are willing to settle for a less than average dining experience.  *side note- this place is not inexpensive. 

hubby and i ordered apps- he got zinger boneless wings, and i got the guacamole. portion size was ENORMOUS on the guac - it could have served 8 people, seriously.  flavor was meh. apparently the wingz were good.  hard to tell what hubby enjoyed more, the wingz or the scantily dressed hostesses. 

our server was great, attentive and pleasant.  When something went wrong she did her best to fix it. That was much appreciated.   Side salad came out wilted and gross. management offered to take it off the check, would have rather had a decent salad in the first place but i digress.  Dinner was not very flavorful - at all - and portion sizes were okay. i got the quesadilla appetizer (which was plenty for an entree) but it was very sloppily put together and had no seasoning at all.  I have had food that is presented better and tastes better at fast food restaurants, where i am happy to pay $5 for a meal.  

At the end of the meal, i badly wanted dessert but didnt want to risk another poorly flavored dish.  Not to mention, all the dishes were like lunch tray plastic, and i felt that a $50-60 dinner for two was at least worth a nicer presentation. who knows, it may have even made up for the bland flavors. 

perhaps i was let down by the fact that there always seemed to be a wait and i had over hyped it in my head.  Never have i wanted to send back everything i ordered at a restaurant before this night.  i will never be back.  my husband says he will order the wings, but takeout only. no more dining in at this place.
Refine this for me please:
I had high hopes for Millers, but unfortunately, my experience was disappointing. On the positive side, the restaurant is conveniently located near my house, offers ample parking, and has spacious tables. The presence of a fireplace in the back adds a nice touch of ambiance.

My friends and I attempted to visit Millers on multiple occasions for a quick and affordable meal. However, each time we encountered a wait time of 30-60 minutes. Initially, we thought this indicated the restaurant's popularity, but in reality, it might just be a testament to the low dining standards in Springfield. It is worth noting that the prices at Millers are not inexpensive as advertised.

During my visit with my husband, we ordered appetizers. He enjoyed the zinger boneless wings, while I opted for the guacamole. The portion size of the guacamole was enormous, enough to serve eight people. However, the flavor left much to be desired. The wings were reportedly good, but it was difficult to determine whether my husband enjoyed them more or found the attire of the hostesses more appealing.

Our server was commendable, providing attentive and pleasant service. She went above and beyond to rectify any hiccups that occurred. Nonetheless, the side salad that accompanied our meal was wilted and unappetizing. Although management offered to remove it from our check, I would have preferred a decent salad in the first place. The main course lacked flavor altogether, and while the portion sizes were satisfactory, the overall presentation was lackluster. I ordered the quesadilla appetizer, which could have easily sufficed as an entree, but it was sloppily assembled and lacked seasoning. Even fast food restaurants manage to present and deliver more flavorful food at a fraction of the cost.

By the end of our meal, I had a craving for dessert but hesitated to risk another lackluster dish. Additionally, the use of plastic trays for all the dishes was disappointing considering the price range of $50-60 for a dinner for two. A more aesthetically pleasing presentation might have compensated for the bland flavors.

Perhaps my disappointment stemmed from the consistently long wait times, leading to an overhyped expectation. This was the first time I had ever wanted to send back everything I had ordered at a restaurant. I have no intention of returning, but my husband may opt for takeout if he chooses to indulge in the wings again. Dining in has proven to be a negative experience for us at this establishment.

Some of them on the vacuum side do not seem to speak English so it's even harder to have to explain I need it re-washed :( too bad... The location is perfect for me, if only the quality was
Refine this for me please:
Refined Version:
I returned once again because I am locked into a membership, but I am continually disappointed with the service here. Although the facilities are nice, they consistently fail to perform a satisfactory job. I have been visiting this place for six months solely because of the membership I purchased, but every time I have to request them to re-vacuum or wipe everything down again. input:
I am sort of a simple man, so I had never been to a liquor bar before. I have been to The Libertine twice and had a good experience both times. They use fresh ingredients all the way down to the crushed ice, which they crush with a mallet right at the bar. 

The biggest problem I ran into was figuring out which restroom was the men's. You have to look at the hair on the dimly lit pictures that indicate which is which, all the faces look the same.
Refine this for me please:
As someone who considers themselves quite unpretentious, I had never ventured into a liquor bar until recently. I decided to give The Libertine a try, and I was pleasantly surprised by my two visits. One of the aspects that stood out to me was their commitment to using fresh ingredients, even down to the finely crushed ice, which they prepare right behind the bar using a mallet.

However, I did encounter a minor inconvenience during my visits - determining which restroom was designated for men. The dimly lit pictures showcasing hairstyles were the indicators, but I found it challenging as all the faces portrayed looked remarkably similar.

input: Came with the family based on a recommendation and was not disappointed.  I consider myself to be a bit of a Pizza connoisseur and this was right up there.  The staff was friendly and the food came out quick.  Solid experience across the board.  I would come back and recommend it to others.
Refine this for me please: My family and I decided to visit this restaurant based on a recommendation, and I must say, we were not disappointed. As someone who considers themselves a bit of a Pizza connoisseur, I can confidently say that this place definitely met my high standards. The staff was incredibly friendly, and the food was served promptly. Overall, it was a solid experience in every aspect. I wouldn't hesitate to visit again and would highly recommend it to others.

input: We tried these at the Collingswood Art Festival this weekend. they are a bit pricey, but worth it. The flavor is perfect. they aren't greasy. I will be seeking them out. Once you try them... you will want to have them again. they are a light cheddar curd, battered and friend. You don't taste grease or batter. the flavor of the cheese is delicious, and so stringy and melty. The sauces are a delicate compliment to the curd. Well worth the splurge.
Refine this for me please:
I recently had the opportunity to try these delectable treats at the Collingswood Art Festival last weekend. While they may come with a slightly higher price tag, I assure you they are absolutely worth it. The flavor is simply perfect, and what sets them apart is the fact that they aren't greasy at all. I'm already planning on seeking them out again, as once you have a taste, you'll crave them time and time again.

These light cheddar curds are expertly battered and fried, resulting in a delightful combination that doesn't overpower the cheese itself. The cheese is incredibly flavorful, with its stringy and melty texture elevating the eating experience to a whole new level. The accompanying sauces are also thoughtfully selected, providing a delicate and complementary accompaniment to the curds.

Though they may be considered a splurge, I can confidently attest that they are well worth it. So, be sure to indulge yourself and give these incredible cheddar curds a try.

input:
Yats rocks. You walk in and they've got 4-6 cauldrons full of your choices...which are written in sidewalk chalk on a blackboard. There's always something vegetarian, and a plate full of any of it costs five fitty. Add a buck and you can get a split plate of 2 delectable cajun creations with rice. But the best part is the ridiculously awesome garlic bread...which you can get a bowl of for like a buck.

Not only is the food awesome, but the owner (Joe Vuskovich) is a local celebrity. He's a famed restaurateur from New Orleans that sells his secret spice to restaurants everywhere. Everybody in town knows him (despite the fact that there are two other locations) and he's highly supportive of local bands and kids that most older people stay away from.
Refine this for me please:
Yats is a truly exceptional dining experience. As you step inside, you are greeted by a delightful sight - 4-6 cauldrons brimming with your favorite choices, beautifully displayed on a blackboard adorned with sidewalk chalk. One of the remarkable features of Yats is that there is always a vegetarian option available, catering to diverse preferences. The best part? The entire plate, filled with any delectable item of your choice, costs only five fitty.

If you're feeling extra adventurous, for just an additional dollar, you can savor a split plate of two mouthwatering Cajun creations served with rice, a true culinary delight. However, what sets Yats apart from the rest is their ridiculously incredible garlic bread. For a mere buck, indulge in a bowl full of this heavenly garlic bread.

But Yats isn't just about the food. The owner, Joe Vuskovich, is a local celebrity known throughout the community. Hailing from New Orleans, he is a renowned restaurateur whose secret spice blend is a favorite among restaurants far and wide. Despite having two other locations, Joe is ingrained in the local scene. He wholeheartedly supports local bands and connects with young individuals who often get overlooked by older generations.

input:
Today after our Ethiopian food fiasco (see Selam review), we literally RAN into Pi after waiting hours to be served at the prior restaurant. We must have looked like a pack of hungry wolves so we told the hostess what had just happened. She seated us right away and sent us two orders of garlic bread (which we later found out were comped!). 

We ordered two pizzas and scarfed it all down. Pi has been consistently good on every visit I have made since I've moved to STL. Service is always excellent. Both the deep dish and thin crust are amazing every time.
Refine this for me please:
After our disappointing experience with Ethiopian food earlier today (as mentioned in our review of Selam), we had a stroke of luck when we coincidentally stumbled upon Pi after enduring a lengthy wait at the previous establishment. It must have been evident how famished we were, resembling a pack of ravenous wolves, so we promptly informed the hostess about our prior ordeal. Understanding our situation, she immediately seated us and kindly offered us two complimentary orders of garlic bread, which we later discovered were on the house.

Without hesitation, we ordered two pizzas and devoured them eagerly. I must admit that Pi has consistently exceeded my expectations ever since I relocated to STL. The service is consistently exceptional, and both their deep dish and thin crust varieties leave me in awe each time.

input: I went here to get my wisdom teeth out and they did a great job. The only complaint I have is that I never see the same dentist. I've been going here for 5 years.
Refine this for me please: I visited this place specifically to have my wisdom teeth removed, and overall, I am satisfied with the procedure they performed. However, one aspect that could be improved is the consistency in seeing the same dentist. Despite being a loyal customer for the past 5 years, I have yet to have the same dentist attend to me during my visits.

input:
After hearing about this place from a fellow Yelp Elite, my SO and I decided to try this place! We were warned of possible waiting times so came here on a Saturday around 10:45, and a line was already forming! 

For apps, we ordered the takoyaki and fried octopus. The takoyaki are delicious-an order comes with 5 balls that were perfectly cooked and topped with sauces. Takoyaki are little circular doughs with squid in the middle, topped with sauces and squid flakes (?). I definitely recommend this app. As for the fried octopus, it was just fried without sauces on top and came with mayo on the side, but it didn't come with enough mayo to dip the octopus in.

For ramen, I got the red spicy tonkotsu ramen and my SO got the black garlic tonkotsu ramen. For both ramen, the thin noodles were mushy/overcooked and just didn't quite fit with the ramen. That was the flaw with the dishes, and it tasted like the noodles were overcooked in a pot of flour-y water so it wasn't as clean (which explains the mushy feeling). They should use more bouncy noodles for this.

Now let's talk about the broth. The broth is flavorful, but the red chili broth was a bit too spicy for me and covered up the depth of the broth. I prefer the black garlic tonkotsu broth for that reason.

Overall, delicious food and pricing is reasonable. The decor is very nice as well, but screaming kids that were running around didn't make our meal pleasant.
Refine this for me please:
After receiving a recommendation from a Yelp Elite, my significant other and I decided to give this place a try. However, we were warned about potential wait times, so we arrived on a Saturday around 10:45 AM, only to find that a line was already forming.

For appetizers, we ordered the takoyaki and fried octopus. The takoyaki was delicious, with perfectly cooked dough balls topped with savory sauces. Each order came with 5 balls filled with squid, complemented by delightful toppings of sauces and squid flakes (?). I highly recommend this appetizer. On the other hand, the fried octopus was simply fried without any accompanying sauces, and while it did come with a side of mayo, there was not enough provided to fully enjoy dipping the octopus.

Moving on to the ramen, I opted for the red spicy tonkotsu ramen while my significant other chose the black garlic tonkotsu ramen. Unfortunately, the flaw in both dishes was the overcooked and mushy consistency of the thin noodles. They did not pair well with the ramen and seemed more like they had been cooked in a starchy water, resulting in a less-than-clean texture. It would be better if the restaurant used more springy noodles for these dishes.
