I was amazed at how close they let you get to the active equipment, I could've spit in the mash and no one would've been the wiser. The whole facility reminded me of St. Pete Catholic High, 50's cinderblock with a residue of toil clinging to the walls. 

The tasting, that's what you came for right? Fantastic. They were out of Lord Chesterfield, but who drinks that? I "tasted" the shit out of the lager, probably 6 times. It makes sense, the bar is next to the gift shop and I went a bit insane in there. 

The fact that Dick Yuengling made it a point to hire back the laid off workers after the last closure bumps it up a star. This is a family business, one that deserves support as Inbev has encroached upon everything else.
Refine this for me please:
I moved to Philadelphia from the Midwest as a wide-eyed 19-year-old, full of wonder. Yuengling Lager quickly became the first beer I truly enjoyed and remains one of my all-time favorites. Its smooth, sweet taste and affordability make it like a reflection of myself in a bottle. I even appreciate the rustic charm of the rusty bottlecaps and the variation in taste from batch to batch. Its relatively low alcohol content is also a bonus.

The tour experience was quite enjoyable, with a British tour guide who had a natural sense of humor. She took a liking to my grandpa and constantly tried to persuade him to sell her his hat, which had some kind of sports memorabilia I couldn't quite decipher. I was impressed by how close we could get to the active equipment; I could have easily spit in the mash without anyone noticing. The whole facility had a nostalgic feel, reminiscent of the 1950s with its cinderblock walls that seemed to bear the marks of hard work.

But let's talk about the highlight: the tasting. It was absolutely fantastic. Unfortunately, they were out of Lord Chesterfield, but who even drinks that? I indulged in sampling the lager multiple times, probably around six. It's no surprise considering the tasting bar was conveniently located next to the gift shop, and I may have gone a bit overboard with my purchases in there.

What truly impressed me and bumped up my admiration for Yuengling was learning that Dick Yuengling made it a priority to rehire the laid-off workers after the last closure. This family-run business deserves support, especially as Inbev continues to encroach upon everything else.

input:
Came here with some friends during Mardi Gras. Even though it was a busy weekend and lots of people everywhere a lot of places aren't over crowded. The bartenders were just awful. The service was lacking and the pizza sucked. 

PROS:
-They had Port-O-Potty (2) put back which made it easier for a bathroom break
-Outdoor seating area
-Near the parade route (convenient) 

CONS:
-Bartenders don't take drink orders properly: they skip people, ignore you at the bar when you walk up (it wasn't that busy), lots of standing around
-Bartenders didn't know what microbrew meant or IPA beers (no joke)
Refine this for me please:
Refined version:
I visited this place with some friends during Mardi Gras and despite the busy weekend and crowded streets, not all the establishments were overcrowded. However, I must say that the bartenders were quite disappointing. The service was lacking and the quality of the pizza was subpar.

Here are some pros of the place:
- The presence of two Port-O-Potties made it more convenient for bathroom breaks.
- They had an outdoor seating area.
- The location was close to the parade route, which made it convenient for enjoying the festivities.

On the other hand, there were some cons worth mentioning:
- The bartenders seemed to have issues with taking drink orders correctly. They would skip people, ignore customers when they approached the bar (despite it not being overly busy), and often appeared to be standing around.
- Surprisingly, the bartenders displayed a lack of knowledge when it came to microbrew and IPA beers. It was truly disappointing.

input: Really nice place to get a pedicure! People are very friendly and it is a relaxing environment. Definitely recommend if you are looking for a clean place to get your toes done!
Refine this for me please: This place is absolutely amazing for getting a pedicure! The staff here is incredibly friendly, and the atmosphere is so soothing and relaxing. If you're in search of a clean and hygienic place to pamper your toes, I highly recommend giving it a try!

input: Nice new burger spot downtown! They are apart of the harry & izzys chain. The burgers are pretty good. You do have to order a side separately which kinda sticks but seems to be a trend these days. They take reservations so that's always a plus. If you are looking for additional options besides a burger might not be your best spot to go. I'd like to see them do a lunch special during the week for those that go during the work day. I think it would help with costs and getting a bigger lunch crowd. Overall great experience and service. Check them out!
Refine this for me please: Come try the newly opened burger spot downtown, a part of the popular Harry & Izzy's chain! The burgers here are delicious, although it's worth noting that you do have to order your side separately, which seems to be a trend these days. The best part is that they accept reservations, adding to the convenience. However, if you're looking for more variety beyond burgers, this may not be your ideal spot. It would be great to see them offer a lunch special during the week, especially for the workday crowd to attract more customers and possibly help with costs. Nonetheless, the overall experience and service were excellent. Give them a try!

input: Salad was good.  Pizza is not good!  Boring, tasteless and just unsatisfying.  Very disappointed.  Also on a chilly night it is a cold interior.  This was my third try there.  Won't go back
Refine this for me please: The salad was enjoyable, but unfortunately, the pizza was not up to par. It was mundane, lacking in flavor, and ultimately dissatisfying. I was highly disappointed, especially considering it was my third visit to the establishment. Moreover, the ambiance inside was cold, which was quite uncomfortable on a chilly night. Regrettably, this experience has led me to the decision of not returning.

input: Not impressed at all. Sandwich bar was closed so I ordered a burrito. It was reheated in the microwave, cost 8 bucks, and nasty. Some sort of cream of chicken and old cheese on top. I'm amazed they can sell this and call it food. Could have had better at taco bell.
Refine this for me please: I was thoroughly unimpressed with my recent dining experience. The sandwich bar, unfortunately, was closed, forcing me to opt for a burrito instead. To my disappointment, the burrito was reheated in the microwave, lacked flavor, and was priced at a whopping 8 dollars. It was topped with an unappetizing mixture of cream of chicken and old cheese. Frankly, I find it astonishing that this can be categorized as food sold at an establishment. I would have been better off choosing a meal at Taco Bell instead.

input:
I have visited the brewpub several times now, and I'm finally ready to write up a review.  I really like the decor here.  It's old-school brewpub with lots of games for children.  The beer is pretty good.  I wish they would do some more adventurous offerings, but I can still get a good beer here.  
The food can be a mixed bag.  I had a small pizza that was a gooey mess (mushrooms and hearty toppings need a thick crust for stability).  I love all the scotch egg offerings (you can get it on a pizza or burger here), but they are so salty.  The burgers are good. The desserts are great (please get the frangipane).  It's also great to get the ploughman's plate and a beer, and just relax for a bit.
Refine this for me please:
After frequenting the brewpub several times, I am finally prepared to pen down my review. One aspect that I particularly appreciate about this place is the vintage-style decor which exudes a classic brewpub ambiance. Moreover, they provide an abundance of games that cater to children, adding an element of fun to the atmosphere. 

While the beer served here is generally commendable, I do yearn for more experimental offerings. Nevertheless, I can still find a satisfying brew among their current selections. 

Regarding the food, it can be a bit hit or miss. I must admit that the small pizza I ordered was disappointingly messy, lacking the necessary firmness to support the generous mushroom and hearty toppings. On the other hand, their assortment of scotch eggs, available both on pizzas and burgers, is a delightful addition to their menu. However, the saltiness of these eggs can be a tad overpowering. When it comes to burgers, they do not disappoint and offer a tasty option. Lastly, indulging in their delectable desserts, particularly the frangipane, is an absolute must. 

If you're seeking a laid-back experience, I highly recommend ordering the ploughman's plate and pairing it with a refreshing beer. It provides the perfect opportunity to unwind and relax for a while.

input:
I think if I could, I would give Zen Yai a 3.5 stars, but alas, c'est la vie. 

The prices for their curry are excellent, at less than $12. Zen Yai is a tiny place, which is both good and bad. Good if you don't have to wait, because it is nice and cozy, but bad if enough people eat here on a given evening -- because you may just have to wait a while.

I like the decor a lot, and the use of colors. The tables and plates are full of refreshingly bright colors. 

The service was fine, and the food was at our table in no time.

My Pineapple curry was excellent! And the rice is served in the shape of a pyramid, which is fun. 

All that being said, my girlfriend had a less than pleasurable experience. She is a seasoned green curry lover, and was disappointed with their green curry offering.
Refine this for me please:
I would give Zen Yai a rating of 3.5 stars if I could, however, unfortunately, that's life.

The prices for their curry are very reasonable, costing less than $12. Zen Yai is a small establishment, which has its pros and cons. It's great when there's no wait time as it creates a cozy atmosphere, but on busier occasions, you might have to wait for a while.

I particularly enjoy the vibrant decor and the creative use of colors. The tables and plates are adorned with bright and refreshing hues.

The service was satisfactory, and our food arrived promptly.

I had an incredible experience with their Pineapple curry! Additionally, the rice being served in the shape of a pyramid adds an element of fun.

However, I must mention that my girlfriend, who is a green curry connoisseur, had a disappointing encounter with their green curry.

input:
Having stayed here several times, it is my favorite hotel. The staff is excellent. Really exceptional. Everyone from housekeeping to front desk staff to valets.

Rooms are clean, heating and AC are quiet, beds are very comfortable and they make it feel special.

Special K is awesome. I cannot say enough about how wonderful and helpful he has been over all of our visits. One of the best reasons to visit this hotel. Did I mention the exceptional staff?

Turn-down service is Sucre chocolates on your pillow. Sweets for the sweet dreams.

The bathroom wasn't as slippery this time. 

This was the first time we used the valet service and it worked great. No more than a 10 minute wait for the car. You can text them from your phone and they text back with how long it will take.

They also hosted a Gold Status reception. We made a brief appearance on our way to a Mardi Gras ball.

Our only glitch was a mini-bar charge on our bill. We didn't consume any of their food or drink and they happily removed it from the bill.

We will be back. Note to hotel: please put Louis back in the elevator.
Refine this for me please:
This hotel has become my absolute favorite after staying here multiple times. The exceptional staff truly sets them apart, from the housekeeping team to the front desk staff and valets.

The rooms are always impeccably clean, and the heating and AC systems operate quietly. The beds are incredibly comfortable, making the stay feel truly special.

I must highlight Special K, who has been consistently wonderful and helpful throughout all of our visits. His exceptional service alone is a compelling reason to choose this hotel. And let me reiterate, the staff in general is truly outstanding.

The turn-down service is a delightful surprise, with Sucre chocolates placed on your pillow - a sweet touch to ensure sweet dreams.

I'm pleased to note that the bathroom was less slippery during my recent stay.

This time, we decided to take advantage of the valet service and it proved to be an excellent choice. The wait for the car was no longer than 10 minutes, and their convenient text messaging system allows you to stay updated on the arrival time.

Additionally, the hotel hosted a Gold Status reception, which we managed to attend briefly before heading to a Mardi Gras ball.

Our only minor issue was a charge for the mini-bar on our bill, despite not consuming any of their items. However, the staff promptly and happily removed it when brought to their attention.

We will definitely be returning to this fantastic hotel. One small request to the hotel: please bring back Louis to the elevator.

input: Great rolls and sake. We sat in the bamboo room, which definitely added to the experience, if you are able and agile.
Refine this for me please: Indulge in exquisite rolls and sake while basking in the captivating ambiance of our bamboo-themed room, perfectly elevating your dining experience, especially if you possess grace and dexterity.

input: First, I love that they offer food delivery! Second, THAT is a gyro! I got one delivered with fries, and actually I didn't need the fries! The gyro was so big I had to save half.  Both the fries and the gyro were very tasty. The tzaziki was spot on and the meat tender. I'll be back!
Refine this for me please: I absolutely love that they offer food delivery! And let me just say, their gyro is absolutely divine! I had it delivered along with some fries, although it turns out the fries were unnecessary. The gyro itself was so generously sized that I had to save half for later. Both the fries and the gyro were incredibly delicious. The tzaziki sauce was absolutely perfect and the meat was so tender. Needless to say, I will definitely be returning for more!

input: I stopped in to order take out and get a drink while I waited since it was happy hour. I am usually a beer drinker but I decided to step out of my comfort zone and ordered the dragonberry iced tea which was refreshing but not obnoxiously cocktail-ly, very pleasant. I had lemongrass chicken and crab rangoon, the lemon grass chicken and rice was fantastic. I do wish the crab rangoon had a little more filling but the dipping sauce was great. I've been here a few times and I have never been disappointed in the food or the service.
Refine this for me please: I visited the establishment to place a take-out order and decided to indulge in a drink while waiting, taking advantage of the happy hour. Typically a beer drinker, I ventured outside my usual preference and opted for the dragonberry iced tea, which proved to be a delightfully refreshing choice without overwhelming cocktail flavors. For my meal, I selected the lemongrass chicken and crab rangoon. The lemongrass chicken, served with rice, was exceptionally flavorful and enjoyable. While the crab rangoon could have benefitted from a slightly more generous filling, the accompanying dipping sauce was excellent. With previous visits to this place, I have consistently experienced both delightful food and exceptional service, leaving me never disappointed.

input: Consistent quality and service.  Love the #1 Deluxe.  Props to Amanda for excellent customer service, above and beyond!
Refine this for me please: Consistent quality and exceptional service make our experience unforgettable. We highly recommend the #1 Deluxe for an incredible experience. A special shoutout to Amanda for going above and beyond with her excellent customer service!

input:
*note* I wrote a similar review on tripadvisor.
I really wanted to like this hotel- it was charming and in a great location, with cute, unique rooms. It was just my style. Unfortunately, some blood-sucking insects ruined that.
Yup- bed bugs. We found them the morning we were leaving, because they normally come out very early in the morning (we were up at 530). Bleck! The management let us stay as long as necessary to take care of the issue (ie throwing away a bunch of our stuff and bagging the rest in ziplocks to be boiled) but it didn't change the fact that it was gross and a huge inconvenience. I threw away about $300 worth of clothing, shoes and luggage and I'm still worried that we brought the creatures back to our house with us. 
I would never stay here again, and I would urge you to think twice about it. Without seeing every carpet and mattress in the place replaced, there's no way I'd trust that the bugs were gone.
Refine this for me please:
I had high hopes for this hotel as it had a charming ambiance and an excellent location, perfectly suited to my taste. However, my experience was unfortunately marred by the presence of some blood-sucking insects.

Yes, bed bugs. We discovered them on the morning of our departure, as they tend to be most active in the early hours (we were up at 5:30 am). It was truly unpleasant. The management was understanding and allowed us to stay as long as needed to resolve the issue. This involved discarding a significant portion of our belongings and sealing the rest in ziplock bags to be thoroughly sanitized. Despite these efforts, it was still a repulsive encounter and a major inconvenience. I ended up having to dispose of clothing, shoes, and luggage worth around $300, and I still worry that we may have inadvertently brought these pests back to our home.

Given my experience, I have decided that I would never return to this hotel, and I strongly advise you to reconsider too. Unless there are comprehensive measures taken, such as replacing all carpets and mattresses, I would find it hard to trust that the bed bugs have been fully eradicated.

input: Still running on EST, we arrived @8:30 on a Saturday to find no wait to be seated OR helped, ordering up the sweet potato pancakes with cinnamon cream syrup (good topped with excellent) with some borderline awful hash browns (really, people??). Can't say I'd return even without a wait, though; would prefer to just buy a jar of the syrup and apply it at home. Ended up at $24.43 pre-tip; no paper towels in the restroom and the day had barely started, so that was probably a dogshow.
Refine this for me please: Despite still operating on EST, we arrived at the restaurant at 8:30 on a Saturday and were pleasantly surprised to discover that there was no wait to be seated or assisted. We decided to order the sweet potato pancakes topped with a delicious cinnamon cream syrup. However, we were disappointed by the quality of the hash browns, which were subpar. Overall, the experience was underwhelming and unlikely to prompt a return visit, even if there was no wait. Instead, I would prefer to purchase a jar of the syrup and enjoy it at home. The bill came to $24.43 before tipping. Additionally, we noticed the absence of paper towels in the restroom, which seemed like a poorly managed aspect of the day.

input:
There never seems to be a crowd at this Marsh store...getting in and out is always easy.  I agree with the other reviewer on the state of red baskets...ick.  Fix please!

I like that they opened up aisles so you don't have to walk all the way to one end to go to the next (prob happened a long time ago but I just noticed today).  And always seems like they are one cashier short here.

Very good selection of products (as always) from Marsh.
Refine this for me please:
I appreciate the convenience of this Marsh store as it is never crowded, making it easy to get in and out quickly. However, I agree with the previous reviewer regarding the poor state of the red baskets, which can be quite unappealing. It would be great if this issue could be addressed.

On a positive note, I recently noticed that the store has opened up the aisles, eliminating the need to walk all the way to one end to access the next. Although this change may have occurred a while ago, I only noticed it today. 

One minor issue that persists is the shortage of cashiers, as it often feels like there is always one register unstaffed. 

Overall, I find the product selection at this Marsh store to be excellent, just as expected.

input: Creative food and good. We get coffee or tea while we wait to be seated and even that is a cut above.  We love their Bloody Marys too.  Always interesting and an adventure.
Refine this for me please: Refined version: The dining experience at Creative Food and Good is truly exceptional. From the moment we arrive, we are treated to delicious coffee or tea while we wait to be seated, and even that simple gesture is impressive. One particular highlight for us is their delightful Bloody Marys, which never fail to surprise and excite our taste buds. Every visit to this establishment is an interesting and adventurous culinary journey.

input: Wonderful atmosphere, great selection of beers.  We ordered the Asian chicken salads and the Cajun pasta and both were excellent. We will return again.
Refine this for me please: The atmosphere was absolutely wonderful, creating the perfect ambiance. Moreover, they had an impressive selection of beers to choose from. We decided to try the Asian chicken salads and the Cajun pasta, and both dishes were outstanding. The flavors were superb and left us thoroughly satisfied. We are already looking forward to revisiting this place in the future.

input: Love this place introduced almost 25 years ago when I enrolled at the UD and have loved ever since. For longest time it was basically just a Delaware treat but so happy it is so many more places now. Just want to know when you are coming to the Huntsville AL area. Sorry this review is not about this specific location but if it is half as good as others I have been to it will be great!!! This location has plenty of seating was real clean and playing good tunes as I waited. About only negative is it doesn't have Herrs chips like the Delaware locations but that is not really a problem.
Refine this for me please: I fell in love with this place almost 25 years ago when I enrolled at the UD, and my love for it has only grown over time. Initially, it was a hidden gem exclusive to Delaware, but I am delighted to see it expanding to many other locations. I can't help but wonder when it will reach Huntsville, AL. Apologies for not discussing this specific location, but if it is even half as good as the others I have visited, it will undoubtedly be fantastic! This particular location offers ample seating, a clean environment, and pleasant music playing in the background while I waited. The only minor drawback I noticed is that it doesn't offer Herrs chips like the locations in Delaware, but that is hardly a significant issue.

input: At first I thought the prices here were pretty decent, but then I realized that they charge for every add on- chips/salsa, rice and beans, etc. I would be fine with this if the food was exceptional, but it is subpar. Both times I've been here, my side order of rice has been hard and dry, and burritos sad and limp. Additionally, the waitress we've had the two times going there had a horrible attitude. The only thing that saves this place is the guac, and the strong margaritas. Their strategy must be to get people drunk enough to not care about what they're eating and the rude service.
Refine this for me please: Initially, I had a favorable impression of the prices at this place. However, upon further reflection, I realized that they charge for every addition, such as chips/salsa, rice and beans, and more. I wouldn't mind this if the quality of the food was exceptional, but unfortunately, it is subpar. On both occasions that I have dined here, my side order of rice was hard and dry, and the burritos were disappointing and lacking in flavor. Furthermore, the waitress we encountered both times had an appalling attitude. The only redeeming factors at this establishment are the delicious guacamole and the strong margaritas they offer. It appears that their strategy may be to intoxicate their customers enough for them to overlook the mediocre food and rude service.

input: My boyfriend and I have lived in trolley square for about three months now and tend to stick to the same restaurants.  We went out the other night planning on El Diablo and decided to try this cute little Italian restaurant. We are so glad we did! First off, the waiter was awesome, so friendly and on top of it.  He told us the history of the restaurant and gave us some good suggestions. The food was some of the best Italian food I have had in a long time. You can tell everything is made fresh.  The bread was delicious and a new recipe the owner received from his brother who lives in Sicily. We started off with the prosciutto wrapped Shrimp with a yummy sauce. I ordered the Penne Alla Vodka and my boyfriend ordered the traditional spaghetti and meatballs. The sauce in both dishes was excellent! The portions were a decent size with plenty of leftovers for my lunch the next day.  Finally, the cannoli was the best I have ever had! My boyfriend has been to Italy and said it was just as awesome as the ones he tasted there. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a delicious Italian meal for a good price.  The special he night we went was order two entrees and get any appetizer for free! Check this place out!
Refine this for me please: My boyfriend and I recently moved to Trolley Square and have primarily frequented the same restaurants. However, we decided to step out of our comfort zone and try a charming little Italian restaurant the other night, El Diablo. We are incredibly grateful that we did! Firstly, our waiter was fabulous - very friendly and attentive. He took the time to share the restaurant's rich history with us and provided some excellent recommendations. The quality of the food was exceptional, some of the best Italian cuisine I have had in quite a while. It was evident that everything was made from scratch and fresh. Notably, the bread was simply delicious and hails from a new recipe passed on by the owner's Sicilian brother. As for our appetizer, we savored the prosciutto-wrapped Shrimp starring a delectable sauce. For our main courses, I selected the Penne Alla Vodka, while my boyfriend opted for the classic spaghetti and meatballs. The sauces in both dishes were superb! The portions were satisfactory, leaving plenty of leftovers for my lunch the next day. Lastly, the cannoli surpassed any I have tasted - even according to my boyfriend, who has had the pleasure of trying them in Italy. I enthusiastically recommend this restaurant to anyone searching for a delicious Italian meal offered at a reasonable price. On the night we dined, they had a special promotion: order two entrees and receive any appetizer for free! Don't miss out on the opportunity to dine at this establishment.

input: 3.5 stars because they don't serve alcohol (and I was in dire need of a drink after a veryyyy long week). Get the margherita pie - it is delicious and fresh. Also ordered the Greek salad for an appetizer which was filled with yummy veggies. Yum.
Refine this for me please: I would rate it 3.5 stars mainly due to the absence of alcohol, which was disappointing considering my desire for a drink after an incredibly long week. However, the redeeming factor was the delightful and fresh margherita pie that I highly recommend. Additionally, the Greek salad I ordered as an appetizer was packed with delicious veggies, making it a satisfying choice. Overall, the dining experience was enjoyable despite the initial setback.

input: I love Mr. Wizard's because they offer frozen yogurt which is a  lot healthier than frozen custard. I like that they offer some pre-select combinations or you can create your own. The only part that sucks is that there is only outside seating so if it's cold outside, plan to eat in your car.
Refine this for me please: I have a strong preference for Mr. Wizard's due to their extensive frozen yogurt options, which I find considerably healthier than frozen custard. One aspect I particularly appreciate is the choice they offer - you can either opt for pre-select combinations or create your own unique blend. However, a minor drawback of this establishment is the limited seating arrangement, restricted to outdoor spaces. This means that during colder weather, it may be necessary to eat your frozen treat inside your car.

input:
Not sure the significance behind the name and logo of the restaurant.  Unless it was three guys putting their money together to form this business 
The food was great/ staff friendly/ huge menu from breakfast /lunch/dinner to dessert.   Open 24 hours will definitely be back next time in town
Refine this for me please: I am unsure of the reasoning behind the choice of name and logo for the restaurant, unless it represents a collaboration between three individuals pooling their resources to establish the business. The restaurant offers exceptional food and boasts a friendly staff. Additionally, their extensive menu offers options for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and dessert. The fact that they are open 24 hours is a definite reason for me to return the next time I am in town.

input: I went to Spasso the other night with some friends. All four of us were SO pleased with our experience and our meals! We each had something different. I had the special for the evening, which was seafood (jumbo shrimp and jumbo lump crab) over pappardelle with tomato and asparagus. it was to die for, and my leftovers the next day were just as tasty :) service was amazing and wine was perfect. I live on state street and can't wait to visit again very soon!!
Refine this for me please: I had an incredible dining experience at Spasso the other night with my friends. All four of us were absolutely delighted with our meals and overall experience. We each ordered something different, and I personally decided to try the special for the evening. It was an exquisite dish comprised of succulent jumbo shrimp and delightful jumbo lump crab served over pappardelle with fresh tomatoes and asparagus. The flavors were simply divine, and the portion was so generous that I was able to enjoy the leftovers the following day, which were equally as delectable. The service provided by the staff was exceptional, and the wine selection was impeccable. Being a resident of State Street, I am eagerly looking forward to my next visit to Spasso!

input: Returned to get a fill and pedicure a week after getting a gel polish change, once I discovered the cost would be over $85 I canceled the pedicure and only wanted a fill. Originally the owner was very nice and attentive but when she sensed I refused to pay their ridiculous price, she turned her attention completely off of me and showed absolutely no regard. She no longer cared for my business and she had no problem showing it. She even reassigned the nail tech to someone else bc I refused to be over charged for service. I asked why the original nail tech was no longer doing my fill, I got no answer. I looked over and saw the owner catering to customers that had just walked in. I sensed flaky business so I ultimately walked out without being serviced. Horrible customer service from the owner. I understand they use quality products but not everyone is looking to spend hundreds of dollars in a nail salon regardless of how "high end" it's self proclaimed to be!
Refine this for me please: I went to the salon to get a gel polish change, but when I found out that the cost for a fill and pedicure would exceed $85, I decided to cancel the pedicure and just get a fill. Initially, the owner was friendly and attentive, but as soon as she realized I was unwilling to pay their exorbitant price, her attitude completely changed. She no longer paid any attention to me and showed no regard for my business. She even reassigned the nail technician to another customer because I refused to be overcharged. When I asked why the original technician was not doing my fill, I received no answer. Instead, I saw the owner immediately tending to new customers who had just arrived. Sensing the unreliable nature of their business, I left without receiving any service. This experience showcased terrible customer service from the owner. While I understand that they use high-quality products, not everyone is willing to spend a large sum of money at a nail salon, regardless of its self-proclaimed "high-end" status.

input:
Ice cream wasn't the best, and definitely not for the price. But it was there when I was passing through Belmawr, and it hit the spot when I needed to satisfy my sweet tooth! 

The service was friendly, albeit a little slow. And the place has a cute, quaint charm about it with the decor. If I lived in the area I'd probably return, but I wouldn't make any special trips to go back here.
Refine this for me please: While the ice cream fell short of expectations and didn't justify the price, it conveniently fulfilled my craving as I passed through Belmawr. The service, although friendly, could have been a bit faster. Nonetheless, the charming decor added to the overall appeal of the place. If I resided nearby, I might consider revisiting, but it wouldn't be worth making a special trip just for this experience.

input: Best auto body shop in Philadelphia in my opinion. My Honda Fit had accumulated all sorts of nicks, dents, scratches, and even some really ugly lime deposit stains on the hood of my car. I took it to Devlin's to get touched up, and what I got back was a car that looked like it just rolled off the assembly line. Honestly, if I told you my car was 3 years old and had gone through a few scrape-ups, I don't think you'd be able to tell. Ed Devlin is a miracle worker, and he does his magic at a super affordable price... I was shocked at how inexpensive the bill came out to be.
Refine this for me please: In my experience, Devlin's is the top auto body shop in Philadelphia. After my Honda Fit had accumulated numerous nicks, dents, scratches, and unsightly lime deposit stains on the hood, I decided to take it to Devlin's for touch-ups. The results were absolutely astonishing. Upon receiving my car back, it looked as though it had just rolled off the assembly line. Frankly, if I were to inform you that my car was three years old and had endured several scrape-ups, you would likely be unable to discern it. Ed Devlin's expertise is truly remarkable, and he performs his magic at an incredibly reasonable price. I was genuinely surprised by the affordability of the bill.

input:
Even though theres nothing ostensibly stand-out about 45, I spend quite a bit of time here. This is definitely a "Cheers" bar, where everybody knows your name. If you can make out their face through the haze of cigarette smoke, that is. Personally, the smoke doesn't bother me, though i have plenty of friends who refuse to go here for that reason. 

I just love the laid back, dive-y vibe. On game days, theres always a spread of food to help yourself to, which is such a nice tradition that you rarely see in bars now. During baseball season, well, I hope you're a Red Sox fan. If not, keep your allegiances quiet, lol. And theres often a food truck parked out front. Yum! A great pre or post show stop if you're seeing music at Tipitinas, which is just down the street.
Refine this for me please:
Although 45 may not appear extraordinary at first glance, I find myself spending a considerable amount of time here. It has the unmistakable atmosphere of a "Cheers" bar, where everyone knows your name, provided you can recognize their faces amidst the cigarette smoke. Personally, the smoke doesn't bother me, although I have friends who refuse to visit for that very reason.

What I truly enjoy is the relaxed and dive-like ambiance. On game days, there's always an array of food available, a delightful tradition that is increasingly rare in bars nowadays. And during baseball season, it's best to keep your team affiliations discreet unless you're a Red Sox fan. Adjacent to the bar, you can often find a food truck parked outside, which is a scrumptious bonus. It serves as a perfect spot to grab a bite before or after enjoying live music at Tipitinas, conveniently located just down the street.

input: Please note: the coffee is excellent! However, you have to ask for cream and sugar. I find this pretentious and intimidating. It's coffee. I want it how I want it. It shouldn't be such a big deal.
Refine this for me please: Please take note: the coffee offered here is truly exceptional! However, it's worth mentioning that if you'd like cream and sugar, you must specifically request them. I personally find this requirement somewhat pretentious and intimidating. After all, it's just coffee, and customers should be able to enjoy it exactly the way they prefer without any hassle. It would be much more pleasant if this request wasn't treated as such a significant matter.

input:
Is it okay to say this is my favorite brunch spot even though all I've ever had here is their grits? I would definitely try one of their other courses and I'm pretty sure they're amazing, but it is so hard to not get my favorite thing off their menu! Their portion is so huge, i usually share it with another person (if I'm not being greedy)! You can literally top anything onto your dish and they vary from .50 cents to 1.00 dollar.  I love to add on avocados, red bell peppers, bacon, cheddar, and mushrooms! Their grits are incredible, it is not grainy nor watery. It's just perfect. I can go on and on. but I'm pretty sure you get the point! 

Eventually, i will try their other dishes, but for now, it's all about their grits.
Refine this for me please: Is it acceptable for me to consider this my preferred brunch spot, even though I have only ever tried their grits? I do plan on sampling one of their other dishes, as I am confident they are outstanding. However, resisting the temptation to order my favorite item from their menu is a challenge! The serving size is so generous that I usually share it with someone else (unless I am feeling a bit selfish!). Additionally, you can customize your dish by adding various toppings, ranging in price from $0.50 to $1.00. Personally, I love to enhance my meal with avocados, red bell peppers, bacon, cheddar, and mushrooms! The grits themselves are truly exceptional, with a perfect texture that isn't grainy or watery. I could talk about them endlessly, but I'm sure you understand why I am so enamored with them. Eventually, I do plan on exploring their other menu options, but for now, my heart is set on their magnificent grits.

input:
Great staff.  Nothing is ever disappointing - chili cheese etoufee is the BOMB.  It's a 4 instead of 5 stars because it's CASH ONLY.  But I love that you can also sit outside on nice evening.  

Don't forget the garlic sauce!
Refine this for me please: The staff is exceptional and consistently delivers a great experience. One particular dish that stands out is the chili cheese etoufee - it's absolutely fantastic. The only drawback is that they only accept cash, hence the deduction of one star out of five. However, I do appreciate the option to sit outside on pleasant evenings. And let's not forget the must-try garlic sauce!

input: Nice view from outside tables. It has typical beach food and typical beach service, but nice place to grab a drink with a view.
Refine this for me please: The establishment offers a pleasant ambiance with its outside tables that provide a stunning view. While it primarily serves the usual beach food and offers typical beach service, it stands out as an ideal spot to unwind and enjoy a refreshing beverage while taking in the scenic surroundings.

input: Is there any way that I can give a sixth or even seventh star to this place? Perhaps I'll contact the Yelp! corporate offices in San Francisco to inquire about expanding the star system using Lou and All About Hair as the Exhibit A. I've been on a three year odyssey, which has included some of the worst haircuts and barbers this side of, well, anything, to find a place like All About Hair. It is simply fantastic. I was here early on a Friday morning and aside from doing an incredible to the follicles that rest atop my head, Lou provided fantastic conversation and an environment that was more than inviting. I haven't written a Yelp! review in a very long time, but after my experience at All About Hair, I felt compelled to fire off a five star review about this gem of a place. Needless to say, I've found my barber of choice and they've made a long-term customer out of me.
Refine this for me please: Is there any way I can give this place more than five stars? I am tempted to reach out to Yelp! corporate offices in San Francisco to suggest expanding the star system, using Lou and All About Hair as a perfect example. I have been on a three-year quest, enduring some of the worst haircuts and barbers imaginable, until I discovered All About Hair. It is absolutely extraordinary. I visited on a Friday morning and not only did Lou do an amazing job on my hair, but he also engaged me in wonderful conversation. The atmosphere was warm and inviting. Although it has been a while since I last wrote a Yelp! review, I felt compelled to leave a glowing five-star rating for this hidden gem. Needless to say, I have finally found my go-to barber and I am now a loyal, long-term customer.

input:
Updating previous trip- I still would take my kids there but the derma bond sucked. Poor buddy has a scar. Yea, yea...it's in a bad spot. And he's not quite two (read: squirmy.) 

I don't think it's too much to want it all. 

 :-/
Refine this for me please: Revised: Updating my previous trip, I would still choose to take my kids there despite the negative experience with the derma bond. Unfortunately, my poor buddy now has a scar, which is in a particularly bad spot. It's even more challenging because he's not even two years old yet and can be quite squirmy. It's disheartening to feel like asking for a perfect experience is asking for too much. :-/

input: This hotel has wonderful views of the airport, and it has the only revolving rooftop restaurant.  It's connected to the airport that has several restaurants and shops.  From the revolving rooftop restaurant, I could see the runways, and the control tower.
Refine this for me please: This hotel offers stunning airport views and is home to the exclusive revolving rooftop restaurant. Its prime location connects guests directly to the airport, providing easy access to a variety of restaurants and shops. From the captivating vantage point of the revolving rooftop restaurant, guests can enjoy panoramic views of the runways and the control tower.

input: Love this place! The turkey, beans, and biscuits are amazing. Have had better pecan pie but that won't stop me from coming back :)
Refine this for me please: I absolutely adore this place! The turkey, beans, and biscuits here are simply incredible. While I have tasted better pecan pie elsewhere, it certainly wouldn't deter me from returning for more tasty delights!

input: Large menu. Clean restaurant and restroom. Friendly staff. They were fairly busy in the middle of the day when we visited. This was my first time here and all we had was a sandwich so I can't give them 5 stars yet but for a family style restaurant and bar we enjoyed our meal. They had a decent draft beer selection and also serve wine and mixed drinks. There are crayons on every table and instead of a single place mat they put a large sheet of white paper on the tables for the kids to draw on.
Refine this for me please: The restaurant boasts a substantial menu offering diverse options. The premise is well-maintained, including both the restaurant and restroom, displaying cleanliness. The staff is amiable and accommodating. We visited during peak hours, and the restaurant was fairly bustling. Although it was my initial experience here, and we only ordered a sandwich, I am hesitant to award them a perfect rating. However, as a family style restaurant and bar, we thoroughly enjoyed our meal. Their draft beer selection is extensive, in addition to serving wine and mixed drinks. Furthermore, they provide crayons on each table and replace mundane place mats with large sheets of white paper for kids to freely draw on.

input:
Delicious crab cocktail and my husband loved his steamers. 

Only down fall is it is really humid in the restaurant itself. A fan would be nice.
Refine this for me please: The crab cocktail was absolutely delicious, and my husband thoroughly enjoyed his steamers. However, the only drawback was the excessive humidity in the restaurant. It would have been nice to have a fan to alleviate the discomfort.

input: Freddy's has the best fast-food style burgers I've ever had. Great toppings choices and fresh meat. Their fries are delicious with their "fry" sauce. Their custard is just as good as their food. It's rich and creamy, and did I mention how delicious it is.
Refine this for me please: Freddy's is renowned for offering the most exceptional fast-food style burgers I have ever tasted. The burgers are expertly prepared using fresh, high-quality meat and the toppings choices are exceptional. Additionally, their fries are simply delightful, especially when coupled with their delectable "fry" sauce. You simply cannot resist the temptation. And let's not forget about their custard, which is equally as delightful as their food. It boasts a rich and creamy texture that is absolutely divine. I cannot stress enough just how incredibly delicious it is.

input: This place had fantastic donuts! They were very well priced and so soft. We tried the blueberry cake donut and apple fritter. We will definitely be going back.
Refine this for me please: This place had amazing donuts! They were not only deliciously soft, but also reasonably priced. We couldn't resist trying the mouthwatering blueberry cake donut and the indulgent apple fritter. Needless to say, we're already looking forward to our next visit.

input:
I really had a wonderful experience at the Nashville location, and we found out that New Orleans had one now and should go to it. Last night we got there kinda late around 10pm. Sat there for 10min and not one person greeted us. Went to the bar to see about service and she informed that the kitchen was behind on completing orders. 
I had to apologize to my friends that we may not get any food after driving three hours down to enjoy the weekend. We did end up leaving the restaurant after 25 min wait for no service or an apology. 

I have to say this not what I expected from a big known place for adults to have fun along with kids also. Please do something about this. I hope this is not a reflection of how others could become.
Refine this for me please:
I had an amazing experience at the Nashville location and recently learned that they opened a new branch in New Orleans, which we were excited to visit. However, our visit to the New Orleans location last night left much to be desired. We arrived around 10pm, but unfortunately, we were not greeted by any staff members for a good 10 minutes. Frustratingly, when we approached the bar for assistance, the bartender informed us that the kitchen was falling behind on orders.

Having driven three hours to enjoy our weekend, I had to apologize to my friends for the possibility of not getting any food. After waiting for 25 minutes without service or even an apology, we made the decision to leave the restaurant.

I must admit, this experience was completely unexpected from a well-known establishment that prides itself on providing entertainment for adults and kids alike. I urge you to address this issue promptly and ensure that it does not become a reflection of the service others may receive.

input:
Allegro's is great. The pizza is really cheap, and lightning fast. My favorite was the sicilian, followed by the, uh, meaty kind, followed in a close third by anything stuffed (sometimes the centers were cold). They also sell beer, but I can't comment much on that because when I lived in Philadelphia I was under 21.
The only downside is the service (occasionally rude) and the constant crazies that hang out there talking to themselves.
Refine this for me please:
Allegro's is an excellent place to satisfy your pizza cravings. Not only is their pizza incredibly affordable, but it is also prepared with remarkable speed. Among their impressive menu options, the Sicilian pizza stands out as my personal favorite, closely followed by the mouthwatering meaty variety. Another noteworthy option is their stuffed pizza, although I must admit that sometimes the centers of these pizzas were not as warm as desired. Additionally, Allegro's offers a selection of beers; however, due to being under 21 during my time in Philadelphia, I cannot provide detailed insights on that front.

On the flip side, the service at Allegro's can be a bit hit or miss, with occasional instances of rudeness. Furthermore, one aspect that can detract from the overall experience is the presence of eccentric individuals who often frequent the establishment and engage in conversations with themselves.

input:
This place treats you right from the moment you walk through the doors. I stay here every time I come to Reno, and the service seems to be getting better and better every time I return. On my last visit I stayed for free for 3 out of the 4 nights, and on top of that they gave me $120.00 of free play. The Peppermill is rated the casino with the loosest slots in casino. The rooms were clean,  the bathroom smelled great, and there weren't any bed bugs in our bed. The casino reminds me of old casino, when they relied on millions of lights bulbs, neon signs, and the smell of argon in the air. Happy hour everyday from 4-6 , you get mini apps and 3 dollar martinis at the fireside lounge. Also the Fish bar is awesome to go and relax, since they have a 40 foot aquarium that wraps around two of the walls. They have some excellent restaurants in the casino, that you don't even have to leave to satisfy any food craving you might have. The staff is extremely friendly and that is the top reason I keep coming back to this casino in Reno.
The only thing about this place is that the lights in the casino can really discombobulate you! Just remember that they key sleeve they give you has a map, so keep that in your pocket !
Refine this for me please: This place offers exceptional service from the moment you step inside. I have been staying here every time I visit Reno, and the service keeps improving with each visit. During my last stay, I enjoyed three complimentary nights and received $120.00 of free play. The Peppermill is renowned for having the loosest slots in the casino. The rooms are clean, the bathroom smells fantastic, and there are no signs of bed bugs in the beds. The atmosphere of the casino takes me back to the classic, old-school casinos with their abundance of light bulbs, neon signs, and the aroma of argon in the air. They have a delightful happy hour from 4-6 every day, offering mini appetizers and $3 martinis at the inviting fireside lounge. The Fish bar is another amazing spot to relax, featuring a 40-foot aquarium that wraps around two walls. Moreover, the casino houses excellent restaurants where you can satisfy any food craving without leaving the premises. The staff is incredibly friendly, and their exceptional service is the main reason I keep returning to this casino in Reno. The only downside is that the bright lights in the casino can be overwhelming, but keeping the key sleeve they provide, which includes a map, in your pocket will help you navigate through it.

input: Two very good experiences.  Excellent burger and very good pulled pork.  Wife loved her egg white and goat cheese omlette.  Solid beer list and a good spicy bloody Mary.  Also had great service and an ecclectic play list.
Refine this for me please: Two exceptional experiences at this establishment. The burger was truly excellent and the pulled pork was very good. My wife thoroughly enjoyed her egg white and goat cheese omelette. The beer list was impressive, offering a wide selection, and the spicy bloody Mary was also quite enjoyable. Additionally, the service was great and the eclectic playlist added to the overall ambiance.

input:
One of their guests went on a rampage and started punching random people, knocking one to the ground.  I told the bartender to call security, then I restrained the assailant as efficiently as humanly possible, causing no injuries, no striking, basically a bear hug, until security finally arrived.  Instead of a thank you I was told to go to my room or I would be trespassing--- fine, Did they look at the video and figure it out? Make it right later?  No.  I was treated poorly, and when I called days later, I got no response.  Spoke with Art in Security, and no call back. 

Not  the way to treat someone who helped you out. 

I will not be going back to Peppermill.
Refine this for me please:
One of the guests at Peppermill went on a violent rampage, randomly attacking and knocking down people. Concerned for the safety of others, I immediately instructed the bartender to call security. In the meantime, I took swift action and efficiently restrained the assailant without causing harm – employing a non-violent bear hug technique. Eventually, the security team arrived, but instead of receiving gratitude for my assistance, I was instructed to go to my room under threat of trespassing. 

To my disappointment, there was no effort made by the management to review the security footage or rectify the situation. Despite my attempts to contact them days later, I received no response. Moreover, my conversation with Art from the Security department did not result in a promised call back.

This entire experience has left me feeling undervalued and disrespected. I have decided that I will not return to Peppermill in the future.

input:
IF YOU ARE ON A STUDENT BUDGET, READ ON:

This is a 5 mile wide/long convention center. It has up to 2,000 guestrooms.  The conference I went to had 6,000 attendants. Of course I booked late and I didn't want to spend $200+/night on these hotel rooms! Otherwise this place is ginormous. The service (shuttle), lunch/drinks were really well done.  This place is immaculate; I do not know how many workers they staff.  

The food of course is overpriced (I had lunch/dinner at Wasabi. My bento box was $25.  Overpriced right?)  I also had lunch at the pizza place Paisano (forgot the name).   

If you decide to stay at the hotels across the street from the convention center (it is only 1 mile away - across from the McGovick Pwky).  They have Cracker Barrel, Apple Bees, Chillis?, McDonalds there.  The hotel I stayed in (being on a student budget) was crappy but I can't complain for $55/night.  It was Days Inn. It was walkable to shuttle pick up stop at Marriott Hotel (walk ~0.3 miles).  

They have Finleys pub, FUSE (night/club), STAX burger, Jack Daniels and more restaurants inside this convention center.  

I posted some photos.
Refine this for me please:
IF YOU ARE ON A STUDENT BUDGET, READ ON:

This convention center spans 5 miles in width and length and boasts a whopping 2,000 guestrooms. When I attended a conference here, there were a staggering 6,000 attendees. Unfortunately, I had procrastinated and didn't want to shell out over $200 per night for the hotel rooms. However, aside from that, this place is enormous and impressive. The shuttle service and lunch/drink options were executed flawlessly. The cleanliness and upkeep of this venue is remarkable, and I can only imagine the sheer number of staff required to maintain it.

When it comes to food, be prepared for slightly inflated prices. I had lunch and dinner at Wasabi and found my bento box priced at an unjustified $25. I also dined at the pizza place Paisano, though I forget the exact name.

If you opt to stay at the hotels located just a mile away from the convention center, across from McGovick Parkway, you'll find Cracker Barrel, Applebee's, Chili's, and McDonald's for more affordable dining options. As a student on a tight budget, I chose to stay at the less desirable Days Inn for $55 per night. While it wasn't the most luxurious accommodation, I can't complain considering the price. It was conveniently within walking distance (approximately 0.3 miles) to the shuttle pick-up point at the Marriott Hotel.

Inside the convention center, you'll find various dining establishments such as Finley's Pub, FUSE nightclub, STAX Burger, and even a Jack Daniel's restaurant.

For a glimpse of my experience, I have posted some photos.

input: I took an 8 year old and a 14 year old for the lunch special pizza.  We have done this on several occasions, and the kids love that they each get their own personal pizza, made the way they like.   They both ordered their pizza with 2 items and wanted BBQ sauce as the base instead of tomato sauce.  (this is the only way they enjoy pizza).   I was told that they could only get tomato sauce, not BBQ sauce.   I explained that we have gotten it this way several times before.   We were told that they don't offer it this way any more.   I see that some of the pizzas offer BBQ sauce and pointed it out, but again was told that it couldn't be made this way for them.   I asked if I could pay additional to have it made with BBQ sauce, but once again told it was not possible.   Sadly, we left the restaurant and chose a different nearby restaurant for lunch.  I'm sorry to say I won't be able to take the kids here anymore.
Refine this for me please: I brought an 8-year-old and a 14-year-old to enjoy the lunch special pizza. We have done this before, and the kids love that they can each customize their own personal pizza to their liking. On this occasion, they both wanted their pizzas with 2 toppings and BBQ sauce as the base instead of tomato sauce, which is their preferred way of enjoying pizza. However, we were informed that BBQ sauce was no longer an option and only tomato sauce was available. I explained that we have been able to get it this way in the past, but unfortunately, we were told that it couldn't be done anymore. I even pointed out that some of the pizzas on the menu already had BBQ sauce, but we were still denied the option. I inquired if I could pay extra to have it made with BBQ sauce, but once again, I was informed that it was not possible. Regrettably, we decided to leave the restaurant and opted for another nearby establishment for our lunch. It is with disappointment that I must say we won't be able to bring the kids here anymore.

input: Super cute place! Employees are very nice! Cookie dough is delicious! This is a must & we are glad we found it (lost while in town).
Refine this for me please: This place is absolutely adorable! The employees here are incredibly friendly and helpful. And let's talk about their cookie dough - it is absolutely delicious! Visiting this place is an absolute must, and we are so grateful we stumbled upon it while exploring the town.

input:
Tacos.....
The chips and salsa were pretty lame.....and the tacos were ok.....nothing special.....
Refine this for me please: The chips and salsa were disappointingly ordinary, and while the tacos were decent, they didn't leave a lasting impression.

input: Excited to have this place in Reno! Delicious matcha and ube flavors! Like authentic. Friendly staff, looking to get better but what they have as a base is solid. Soft serve, cake and the sauces aren't overly sweet.  Hoping they add more flavors!
Refine this for me please: I am delighted to have discovered this place in Reno! The matcha and ube flavors they offer are absolutely delicious and incredibly authentic. The staff is friendly and attentive, although they could still improve. However, the foundation they have established is already solid. The soft serve, cake, and sauces they serve are perfect in terms of sweetness, not overly sugary. I am hopeful that they will introduce more exciting flavors in the future!

input: Delicious. So happy I Yelped for a restaurant closer to home and stumbled upon this. It's small and pleasant inside with some decent hip hop setting the mood. The menu is small, but packed a punch. We ordered the Duck Fries, which were heaven. Fries smothered in smoked gouda,  shredded duck, and scallions. For 8 bucks came a pretty large bowl that I couldn't stop picking at. I ordered one of the specials, the scallop and foie gras  tacos...wow...so good (then I read the origin of foie gras and hated myself, but aside that...). The person I was with ordered the pork roll burger, which I tried of course. It was incredibly juicy and cooked perfect. I will definitely come back here. Definitely.
Refine this for me please: I had a delightful dining experience after discovering this restaurant through Yelp. It is conveniently located closer to home and was a pleasant surprise. The cozy atmosphere was complemented by a hip hop soundtrack. Although the menu was compact, it certainly didn't disappoint in terms of flavor. The Duck Fries stole the show - thick-cut fries generously topped with rich smoked gouda, succulent shredded duck, and scallions. For just 8 bucks, I received a sizeable bowl that I couldn't resist nibbling on. As for my main course, I opted for one of the specials - the scallop and foie gras tacos. They were incredibly delicious and though I later learned about the controversial origin of foie gras, it didn't take away from their exceptional taste. The person I was dining with ordered the pork roll burger, and I couldn't resist taking a bite. It was a juicy masterpiece, cooked to perfection. Without a doubt, I will be returning to this establishment. Absolutely, without a doubt.

input: Went to Three Muses our first night in New Orleans. The plates are tapas style, small and meant for sharing. Between the four of us we got the blue cheese stuffed dates, the crawfish egg rolls, steak and cake, lamb sliders, feta fries and fish tacos. Everything was really good,i could have done without the tacos, but the lamb sliders and the steak and cake were AMAZING. The goat cheese paired with the lamb was to die for. And the crab cake was the best I have ever had.
Refine this for me please: On our first night in New Orleans, we visited Three Muses. The restaurant offers tapas-style plates, perfect for sharing among our group of four. Our order consisted of blue cheese stuffed dates, crawfish egg rolls, steak and cake, lamb sliders, feta fries, and fish tacos. Overall, the food was excellent, although I personally found the fish tacos to be less enjoyable. However, the lamb sliders and steak and cake were absolutely incredible. The combination of goat cheese with the lamb was exceptionally delicious, and the crab cake was undeniably the best I have ever had.

input: Great ambiance!  Loved the trendy and modern decor.  The presentation of the dishes was also great.  The food was just okay though.  The potatoes weren't cooked and the pancakes were a bit on the greasy side.  Would def. go back again and give it another try...french toast and omelette looked good!  I would also like to try their lunch. Service was excellent.
Refine this for me please: The ambiance was fantastic, setting a great vibe for the dining experience. The trendy and modern decor added to the overall appeal. Additionally, the presentation of the dishes was impressive and well-executed. However, the food itself was only average. The potatoes were undercooked and the pancakes were a little too greasy. Despite this, I would consider revisiting the restaurant to give it another chance, as the French toast and omelette caught my eye. I am also intrigued to try their lunch offerings. On a positive note, the service provided was excellent.

input: This place is awesome the food is dynamite . Super friendly service. And the. Coup de grace was the flan made in house fresh and believe me I've tried flan everywhere, there's is exceptional. The price was right on point. My only suggestion to make this place go into the stratosphere is if they had a liquor license.
Refine this for me please: This place is absolutely amazing! The food is absolutely dynamite and the service is super friendly. But you know what really blew me away? The homemade flan. I consider myself a flan connoisseur and I have tried it everywhere, but theirs is truly exceptional. Not only is the taste fresh and delicious, but the price is also spot on. The only thing that could take this place to the next level is if they obtained a liquor license.

input: Had breakfast with the family after a quick stopover. Great food and service (thanks Jonathan!), definaelty a good find that was busy but had no wait on a Saturday.
Refine this for me please:
Refined:

Enjoyed a delightful breakfast with the family after a brief stopover. The food was exceptional, and the service provided by Jonathan deserves special mention. We were lucky to discover this gem, as it was bustling with customers yet surprisingly no wait time on a busy Saturday.

input: During the parents' visit,  dad wanted some southern food. We tried Willie Maes, but the line was long and they weren't crazy about the area.  So we waited a bit and went down to The Praline Connection. Dad was in heaven. He's been talking about the food since we left. Dad got the taste of soul platter pictured below. He said the fried chicken was the best he's had and he had not tasted red beans and rice like that since he was a kid and my granny used to make em. Mom got the meatloaf with cabbage and lima beans. I got the ribs with potato salad and mac and cheese. My ribs were good but hard to cut the meat off the bone. I could've ate em with my hands but I didn't want a BBQ face. The potato salad was good but my mac & cheese was a little bland. The cornbread was great.  I'm going back next time for the fried chicken!
Refine this for me please: During our parents' visit, we decided to fulfill Dad's craving for southern food. Our first attempt at Willie Maes was unsuccessful due to the long line and their dissatisfaction with the area. However, after waiting for a while, we made our way to The Praline Connection. The moment Dad tasted his soul platter, he was in pure bliss. The flavor of the fried chicken transported him back to his childhood when my granny used to make it, and the red beans and rice left a similar nostalgic impression on him. Mom opted for the meatloaf with cabbage and lima beans, while I chose the ribs with potato salad and mac and cheese. Though I thoroughly enjoyed the ribs, the meat proved a bit difficult to separate from the bone, prompting me to avoid any potential BBQ face. While the potato salad was delicious, the mac and cheese lacked a bit of flavor. However, the cornbread exceeded our expectations. Needless to say, I'm already planning my return trip solely for the fried chicken - it's that good!

input:
Buddy Brew is a very trendy coffee shop based in Tampa. Their coffee is flavorful and their presentation is nice. I really liked the fact that their lattes and cappuccinos have beautiful latte art on top. The store has a beautiful modern design that reminds me of coffee shops in New York. 

This particular location is in Hyde Park Village. The benefit is that parking is free. The down side is that seating is limited. The store is also extremely cold, so it is uncomfortable to sit and socialize for very long. You may be better off getting your coffee to go and walking around Hyde Park Village instead.
Refine this for me please:
Buddy Brew, an exceedingly trendy coffee shop in Tampa, stands out for its delectable coffee and impeccable presentation. Notably, their lattes and cappuccinos boast awe-inspiring latte art, adding to the overall appeal. The establishment exudes a stunning modern design, reminiscent of chic New York coffee shops.

Situated within Hyde Park Village, this specific location offers the added advantage of free parking. However, the downside lies in the limited seating options available. Additionally, the store tends to be excessively cold, which can prove uncomfortable for extended periods of sitting and socializing. In light of this, it may be more enjoyable to opt for a to-go coffee and explore the vibrant surroundings of Hyde Park Village.

input:
A really nice place to get your hair did with as much of an edge as you want.  

In the East Loop, across from the Pageant, might be one of the most underrated salons in the city.  I first went into this place as a walk-in, and keep on going back.  Yes, I'm a guy, and since my hair is pretty coarse, grows weird, and I want a bit of style to it, I go to hair salons.  At V Vegaz I've never been dissatisfied with my cut. 

When you walk in you realize how spacious the place is, with a bit of a slightly modern, slightly baroque interior design.  There's a nice vibe there too amongst the employees, and you can see that the stylists are happy with the work situation.  Of course, happy stylists, to me, mean better haircuts.

I go to Callie, since that first walk-in, and keep on going back.  Yes, she's real friendly, which is a nice touch, but she's also a great stylist.  I'm a bit wishy washy when I look for a cut, usually changing what I want most of the time.  Callie's sensitive to that, and really understands how my hair grows and where it's going to move.   I think the biggest compliment to her is that, as I'm a once a month haircut kinda guy, my brother and sister told me they really my hair a full month after I had it cut with Callie.  So that's really a testament to her skills.

I've not gotten color there, but it is a full service salon, and not just a turn and burn place.  

I highly recommend this place.
Refine this for me please:
V Vegaz, located in the East Loop across from the Pageant, is an underrated salon that offers a uniquely edgy hair experience. As someone with coarse hair that grows in a peculiar manner and desires a stylish cut, I frequently visit hair salons, and V Vegaz has never disappointed me.

Upon entering the salon, you immediately notice its spaciousness and the intriguing blend of modern and baroque interior design. The atmosphere is pleasant, and the employees exude a genuine sense of contentment, which I believe contributes to better haircuts.

I have been going to Callie ever since my first impromptu visit, and I continue to choose her as my stylist. Not only is she exceptionally friendly, but she also possesses great skill in her craft. I tend to be indecisive when it comes to my desired haircut, often changing my mind. Nevertheless, Callie is adaptable and understands the growth patterns and movement of my hair. What truly speaks to her talent is that my brother and sister complimented my hair a full month after Callie cut it. This is a testament to her abilities.

While I have yet to try their color services, it is worth mentioning that V Vegaz is a full-service salon rather than a quick, impersonal establishment.

In conclusion, I highly recommend V Vegaz for its exceptional service and results.

input:
The lady who works here is a miracle worker! I came in with a couple pairs of pants that needed to be hemmed, and a suit jacket whose sleeves needed to be shortened (both of which are not quick and easy, since suits are normally lined and it's a lot of work). I also needed it to be done fast - I was leaving the country the next day. Not only did she do all of these alterations in a day, they were also excellently done - neat and professional - and now I have a beautiful suit that fits me brilliantly for my business trip! Plus, they take all credit cards - including Amex! - and have very reasonable hours. 

Definitely returning.
Refine this for me please: The lady working at this place is truly exceptional! I had a few pairs of pants that needed to be hemmed and a suit jacket with sleeves that needed to be shortened. These alterations are usually time-consuming and complex, especially considering that suits are often lined. Additionally, I needed the alterations to be done quickly as I was leaving the country the next day. Remarkably, she completed all of these alterations in just one day and the quality of her work was outstanding. The alterations were neat and professional, resulting in a beautifully fitting suit for my important business trip. Furthermore, they accept a wide range of credit cards, including American Express, and have convenient operating hours. I will definitely be returning to this place.

input:
Late one Saturday night, some friends and I made the mistake of trying to get drinks at Plough and the Stars and left very quickly. We were walking around trying to find somewhere else to go, noticed this unmarked bar and decided to check it out. We were so excited to see that there were so many great beers on tap, and there was a decent crowd there so we stuck around. It was a fun night! And after a few weeks of wondering where we had gone, we were able to find the Irish Pol on Yelp :D

I went back for happy hour recently and it wasn't exactly as I had remembered. It was pretty dark and dingy looking inside,  and the few people there were much much older. It just had a weird vibe. The beer was still great of course. The happy hour special was $3 drafts, but most of the beers I wanted weren't included. I won't be back for happy hour, but I would definitely stop in on a Saturday night!
Refine this for me please:
Late one Saturday night, my friends and I made the mistake of attempting to get drinks at Plough and the Stars, only to quickly realize our error and leave. As we aimlessly wandered around, we stumbled upon an unmarked bar that caught our interest. Excitement surged through us when we discovered an impressive selection of craft beers on tap, accompanied by a lively crowd. The night turned out to be quite enjoyable, leaving us curious about the place's identity. Luckily, after a few weeks of pondering, we managed to locate the hidden gem called the Irish Pol through Yelp.

Recently, I decided to revisit the Irish Pol during happy hour, only to find that it didn't quite live up to my expectations. The dim and shabby interior, along with the considerably older crowd, created a somewhat unsettling atmosphere. Nonetheless, the quality of the beer remained exceptional. Although disappointed that most of the beers I wanted were not included in the $3 draft special, I concluded that I would not return for happy hour. Nevertheless, I would still gladly make a stop on a Saturday night to relive the enjoyable experience I had before.

input: Hands down the best spaghetti & meatballs I've ever had. The atmosphere here is so nice and cozy. It has just won out as my favorite Italian restaurant.
Refine this for me please: Absolutely hands down, this is unequivocally the most delectable spaghetti & meatballs I have ever had the pleasure of indulging in. The ambience of this establishment is incredibly charming and comforting, enveloping me in a sense of warmth and relaxation. As a result, it has effortlessly secured its place as my ultimate favorite Italian restaurant.

input: We arrived at Happy Hour, 50 cent oysters and half price drinks, so we had both, the ordered the beet salad (divine), mussels, and flammenkuchen (an appetizer I used for my entree),  All were excellent.  I first had flammenkuchen (or tarte flambe) in Strasbourg at a street fair, this was far and above that experience, with caramelized onions resting atop the cheese and hunks of bacon strewn around.  So good!
Refine this for me please: We went to Happy Hour, where they had 50 cent oysters and half-priced drinks. We decided to take advantage of both deals and also ordered the beet salad, mussels, and flammenkuchen. All of the dishes were outstanding. I especially loved the flammenkuchen, which I used as my main course. I had first tried this delicious appetizer, also known as tarte flambe, in Strasbourg at a street fair. However, the version we had at Happy Hour was even better. It had perfectly caramelized onions on top of the cheese, with delectable chunks of bacon scattered throughout. It was truly a culinary delight.

input: Have eaten at this place 3 times. Every time was a good experience for me and the kids. No smoke No noise and good food good service. Maybe because it has always been on a late tuesday afternoon we have eaten there. I have always ordered something different and have been satisfied  and happy with what I got. Definitely will be back to eat there again.
Refine this for me please: I have dined at this place three times and each visit has been consistently enjoyable for both me and my children. The absence of smoke and noise creates a pleasant atmosphere, complemented by the delicious food and excellent service. It could be attributed to the fact that we have always visited on late Tuesday afternoons. Furthermore, I have tried a variety of dishes and have always been satisfied and delighted with my choices. Without a doubt, I will return to this place for another delightful dining experience.

input: Great pizza! The place is beautiful and the atmosphere is truly inviting. The service is very nice and fast.
Refine this for me please: The pizza at this place is absolutely amazing! Not only does it taste delicious, but the ambience of the restaurant itself is truly captivating. The inviting atmosphere adds to the overall dining experience. The service provided here is friendly and efficient, ensuring that your food arrives promptly.

input: Great dinner started with a wonderful fresh Caesar salad and bread followed by delicious cheese ravioli with pesto cream sauce. The pesto sauce was perfect, not overpowering the delicate pasta. I also enjoyed the Dunham cabernet. Delicious. Welcome to downtown, Richard's.
Refine this for me please: Indulge in an unforgettable dining experience at Richard's in downtown. Kick off your meal with a tantalizing Caesar salad bursting with freshness and served alongside warm, crusty bread. Next, savor the exquisite cheese ravioli paired with a velvety pesto cream sauce that harmonizes flawlessly with the delicate pasta. The pesto sauce has been expertly crafted, striking a perfect balance that enhances the dish without overshadowing its tender flavors. To complement your culinary journey, delight in the rich and flavorful Dunham cabernet, elevating the dining experience to new heights. Richard's warmly welcomes you to downtown, where memorable evenings and delectable cuisine await.

input:
Had a great breakfast here last weekend before we headed out. You order at the front and they will bring the food out. I had the French toast (fruit on the side)  with an a la carte fried egg on the side. They dropped my egg when they got to the table but promptly brought out another one. I also had a vanilla latte which was yummy....no extra sweeteners needed.
