We sat outside on the patio which was just lovely. Even if you sat inside, like other restaurants in the French quarter, every door and windows are open, so fresh breezes flow throughout. Really nice experience.
Refine this for me please:
We had a wonderful breakfast at this place last weekend before we departed. You place your order at the front counter, and the food is brought to your table. I decided to try their French toast with a side of fruit and a separately ordered fried egg. Unfortunately, they accidentally dropped my fried egg when they brought it to the table, but they promptly replaced it with a new one. Additionally, I enjoyed a delicious vanilla latte that didn't require any additional sweeteners.

We chose to sit outside on the patio, and it was truly delightful. Even if you opt to sit inside, like other restaurants in the French Quarter, all the doors and windows are open, allowing fresh breezes to circulate throughout. Overall, it was a truly enjoyable experience.

input:
We were early for church and wanted to grab a quick bite to eat. The atmosphere was really inviting and everyone on staff spoke to us at least once! 

The food was good, but not great. I had quiche and my guest had a croque madame. The crust of the quiche wasn't done and the bread on the croque wasn't that great. Otherwise these two dishes would have been perfect. The fruit was fresh and the coffee was great!

I will definitely return.
Refine this for me please:
We arrived at church early and decided to quickly grab a bite to eat. The restaurant had a welcoming atmosphere and the staff members were friendly, making sure to interact with us throughout our visit.

While the food was decent, it didn't reach the level of greatness. I ordered quiche, but unfortunately, the crust was not thoroughly cooked. On the other hand, my companion opted for a croque madame, but the bread used for it was not very impressive. Aside from these slight flaws, the dishes would have been flawless. On a positive note, the fruit served was fresh and the coffee was fantastic.

Despite these minor setbacks, I am inclined to visit this place again in the future.

input:
Thoroughly enjoyed our visit to Salty's this evening.  As first time customers, it will be on our list of places to return when we make it back to town.  

They have a good kids menu, enough to keep the little ones content with options like burgers, Alfredo pasta, chicken, shrimp, quesadilla, etc.  

We started with the Crabby Dip which the whole family enjoyed but feel it was a little overpriced at $14.  For the main course I enjoyed a Salty Burger while she had the macadamia crusted grouper, both were excellent choices!  Service was spot on making this a five star experience for us!
Refine this for me please:
We thoroughly enjoyed our visit to Salty's this evening, making it a definite must-visit place on our list when we return to town. As first-time customers, we were impressed with the quality of their service and offerings.

One aspect that stood out to us was their kid's menu, which offered a variety of options that kept our little ones content. From burgers, Alfredo pasta, chicken, shrimp, quesadilla, and more, there was something for everyone.

To start off, we ordered the Crabby Dip, which the whole family enjoyed. However, we did feel that it was slightly overpriced at $14. Nonetheless, our disappointment quickly faded as we moved to the main course.

I decided to go for the Salty Burger, and I must say it was an excellent choice. The flavors were delectable and satisfying. On the other hand, my partner opted for the macadamia crusted grouper, and she too was delighted with her selection.

Overall, the dining experience was fantastic, and the service was impeccable, easily making it a five-star experience for us. We can't wait to visit Salty's again.

input:
I guess the ingredients weren't as fresh today since my boyfriend threw up twice upon eating chili beef nachos.  We had a to-go order - I got a chicken burrito.  It gave me some stomach cramps and other issues.  Just a heads up.

However, we keep coming back since I love your shredded beef.  I thought I would change it up today.
Refine this for me please:
I believe the ingredients may not have been very fresh today, as my boyfriend ended up throwing up twice after eating the chili beef nachos. We had a to-go order, and I opted for a chicken burrito which gave me stomach cramps and other discomfort. I just wanted to give you a heads up about our experience.

Despite this, please note that we continue to come back to your restaurant because I absolutely adore your shredded beef. I simply decided to try something different today.

input: This place is awesome. A real throwback. Music is great, 4 stars (not 5) as they don't really offer seating beyond the first 15 ppl in line.
Refine this for me please: This place is truly remarkable, a genuine throwback. The music is exceptional, earning a solid 4-star rating. However, it falls just short of a perfect 5-star rating due to the limited seating arrangement, which is only available for the first 15 people in line.

input: Really not even going to get into it go to Blue Fin or Masamoto
Refine this for me please: I suggest going to Blue Fin or Masamoto for a great dining experience.

input:
Stayed here for a bachelorette party. This place got the job done. Unfortunately, all the hotels in Santa Barbara are pretty freaking pricey. A lot of the other hotels started at $400+ /night.  This ain't Vegas where you can get something pretty cushy for $250. This seemed like a decent option on the lower end. Our rooms were about $250 a night. A lot of the other hotels in the area were already booked for the weekend or required more than one night to book. 

Pros: 
-decently priced
-clean and cozy rooms
-charming exterior and grounds
-relatively comfortable beds
-bath and body works shampoo, body wash etc
-free water bottles and fruit waiting for you in the room

Cons:
-dated decor 
-toilet issues: The hook inside kept coming undone. I guess we decided not to get maintenance because we temporarily fixed it, but it kept coming undone so it wouldn't really flush. We were checking out that day, so we decided just to deal with it. 
- door was difficult to open without using a certain technique
-no hair dryer, so bring your own
-no complimentary breakfast
-a bit noisy in the morning, but I slept fine. I guess the window in the bathroom was open or something for some ventilation.

Overall, I still don't think I would've chosen to stay anywhere else in Santa Barbara, so BW Pepper Tree Inn was still a good choice based on the location of the bachelorette and price range.
Refine this for me please:
Refined version: I stayed at BW Pepper Tree Inn for a bachelorette party and found it to be a suitable option considering the higher prices of hotels in Santa Barbara. Most hotels in the area started at $400+ per night, making this hotel a decent choice on the lower end. We were able to book our rooms for around $250 per night despite many other hotels being fully booked or requiring multiple nights.

Pros:
- Reasonably priced 
- Clean and cozy rooms 
- Charming exterior and well-maintained grounds 
- Beds were relatively comfortable 
- Provided bath and body works amenities 
- Complimentary water bottles and fruit were a nice touch 

Cons:
- Decor was outdated 
- Experienced issues with the toilet, as the hook inside kept coming undone and affected the flushing. We decided not to contact maintenance for a temporary fix since we were checking out that day.
- Difficult to open the door without using a specific technique 
- No hair dryer provided, so make sure to bring your own 
- No complimentary breakfast offered 
- Some noise in the morning, possibly due to an open bathroom window for ventilation. However, I was still able to sleep fine. 

Overall, despite the drawbacks, I still believe BW Pepper Tree Inn was the best choice for our bachelorette party in Santa Barbara due to its location and price range.

input: In my book you can never go wrong having a good old-fashioned meal a Johnny Rockets. I had their recent promo which was a barbecued pulled pork burger. It was a lot of food and a lot of flavor!! Top that with endless fries and I'm a happy camper. Have never had a bad experience at this location. They were recently moved from the casino floor level to the shopping level and since they did that they don't do the singing or dancing anymore which is a shame
Refine this for me please: In my opinion, you can never go wrong by indulging in a delicious, traditional meal at Johnny Rockets. Recently, I tried their promotional barbecued pulled pork burger and it did not disappoint! The portion size was generous, and the flavors were outstanding. To top it off, the unlimited fries made it an even more satisfying experience. Throughout all my visits to this location, I have never had a negative experience. However, I must mention that I was a bit saddened to discover that since their relocation from the casino floor to the shopping level, they no longer offer the entertaining singing and dancing performances that were once a signature part of their charm.

input: This salon is filthy.  There are cobwebs and dust every where.  The equipment is old and in disrepair.  My nail technician was actually watching you tube videos while doing my nails!  I do not know how the health department hasn't shut them down.
Refine this for me please: This salon is incredibly unclean, with cobwebs and dust littering every corner. The equipment is outdated and showing signs of disrepair. Shockingly, my nail technician was blatantly watching YouTube videos instead of focusing on my nails. It's rather astounding that the health department hasn't taken action to shut this place down.

input: I always am in favor of local businesses.  They have a big selection here and you get free popcorn.  Why go to the big boys and have to pay for popcorn when you can get it here for free?
Refine this for me please: I strongly support local businesses due to their excellent variety and the added perk of complimentary popcorn. Why choose to patronize larger corporations where you have to pay for popcorn, when you can enjoy it here at no cost?

input:
I still love this place just as much as I ever did, and here's why:

1) Super friendly and knowledgeable staff 
2) Roomy, with lots of outlets and enough space to accommodate mid-sized groups (like the recent Yelp Office Hours)
3) Delicious tea, of course!

I've always loved their "Awake" Fizz Tea, but I've also broadened my horizons to include Pearl Tea (aka bubble tea). The taro flavor rocked my socks off. It did take a little getting used to though, as I had a mini anxiety attack every time I took a sip. Because I got it warm, it was in a paper cup and I never knew when a pearl was making its way into my mouth. As a result, I spent half my drink wondering "is there one in my straw?" It's totally worth the suspense, though.

The only thing that still troubles me is the music. It's just...not right. In fact, sometimes it's pretty distracting. It's easily avoided, however; just bring headphones and your own musical selection and all is well.
Refine this for me please:
I continue to have a deep affection for this place, and here's why:

1) The staff is incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, creating a welcoming atmosphere.
2) The space is expansive, with ample outlets and enough room to comfortably accommodate mid-sized groups, like the recent Yelp Office Hours event.
3) The tea served here is absolutely delicious and satisfying.

I have always been a fan of their "Awake" Fizz Tea, but I have also ventured into trying Pearl Tea (commonly known as bubble tea). The taro flavor in particular blew me away. However, I must admit that initially, I found it slightly nerve-wracking since I would often be surprised by the pearls when sipping from the warm paper cup. It became a mini adventure each time, leaving me wondering if there was a pearl in my straw. Nevertheless, the anticipation only adds to the enjoyment.

The one aspect that still concerns me is the choice of music played here. It simply doesn't resonate with me and can be rather distracting at times. Fortunately, this can be easily remedied by bringing headphones and your own preferred playlist.

input: Yah Man was yah man! Go here and enjoy the atmosphere, the personal service and delicious Caribbean fare. The beef pie was yummy as was the chicken and island sampler plates. The bread pudding was to die for. We left full and happy. If you live in the Tampa area or are visiting you should go here! Nice people! BTW, this is the 3rd time I've posted on yelp just wanted to share this place, so good!
Refine this for me please: Yah Man is a must-visit spot! Immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere, relish the personalized service, and indulge in the delightful Caribbean cuisine. The beef pie, chicken, and island sampler plates were all incredibly delicious. And let's not forget the irresistible bread pudding, which alone is worth the visit. My companions and I left thoroughly satisfied and content. Whether you're a Tampa local or a visitor, I highly recommend checking out this gem. The staff is friendly and welcoming, adding to the overall positive experience. By the way, I felt compelled to post this review on Yelp for the third time as I wanted to share just how exceptional this place is. Don't miss out on this culinary delight!

input:
Favorite place to go in New Orleans. Chill backyard bar with great local music options.

Smaller groups are better- seating can get tight. The wine and cheese bar up front services the live music venue in back. You can pick 3 or more cheeses and they put together a lovely cheese and accoutrements tray for you. You can also choose a wine to open up in the back. Wines have a great selection, mid-range price (almost all winces over $10-20 a bottle).

Great place to spend the night and have a wonderful time away from the packed tourists hot spots. (Mind you, this place is well known and a hot spot itself).
Refine this for me please:
Refined Version:
My favorite place to go in New Orleans is a chill backyard bar with fantastic local music options. It's best to go with smaller groups as the seating can get tight. In the front, there's a cozy wine and cheese bar that caters to the live music venue in the back. You can choose three or more cheeses and they'll create a lovely cheese and accoutrements tray for you. They also offer a selection of wines at a mid-range price, with almost all options priced between $10-20 per bottle.

This hidden gem is a great spot to escape the crowded tourist hotspots and spend a memorable evening. Despite being well known itself, it provides a relaxing ambiance away from the typical tourist scene.

input: Had a great lunch here. I ordered a chicken Caesar and my dining companion ordered a custom salad. Waitress had a great personality and did not rush us at all. Allowed us to linger. Great space which is hidden from the outside.
Refine this for me please: We had an excellent lunch experience at this place. I opted for the chicken Caesar while my dining companion ordered a custom salad. Our waitress was friendly and accommodating, never rushing us and allowing us to enjoy our meal at a leisurely pace. The restaurant itself had a wonderful atmosphere, tucked away from the outside world.

input: Made reservation a over a week ago with request to be near band. On arrival they had no record of it. And we are stuck in the back next to the bathroom. 5 stars for cocktail,food, band and Atmosphere. 1 stars for utter lack of organization.  The woman who took it said she was new. Always call to confirm I guess. Completely disappointed esp since we've had such amazing experiences here in the past.  There open tables near front and were told they were for people with reservations
Refine this for me please: I made a reservation over a week ago with a specific request to be seated near the band. However, upon arrival, the establishment had no record of my reservation, and we ended up getting stuck in the back next to the bathroom. Despite this disappointment, I will still give 5 stars for the excellent cocktails, food, band performance, and overall atmosphere. However, I have to give 1 star for the utter lack of organization displayed by the staff. The woman who took our reservation claimed to be new, but regardless, it is always advisable to call and confirm reservations. This experience left me completely disappointed, especially considering the amazing experiences we have had here in the past. It's worth noting that there were empty tables near the front, but we were informed that those were reserved for guests who had made reservations.

input: Great professional tat shop!! My husband and I are very happy with our new ink. Bryan did an outstanding job and I highly recommend him. All the employees were super nice and I can see why this is the city's #1 tattoo shop. Don't forget their new location is 1418 N. Clairborne, in Suite 5, upstairs.
Refine this for me please: We had an amazing experience at the professional tattoo shop! My husband and I are thrilled with our beautiful new ink. Bryan's work was exceptional, and we highly recommend him. The entire staff was incredibly friendly, and it's no surprise that this is the top-rated tattoo shop in the city. Don't forget to check out their new location at 1418 N. Clairborne, Suite 5, upstairs.

input: Love this place.  Best view in Santa Barbara.   Awesome wines.  My wife and I are industry, and always treated great.  Tom and Gillian are ALWAYS generous hosts.  My wife works @carrwinery and always refers customers to them.  The Conway cabs are the best SB has to offer.  One of their tasting room employees just gifted us a Conway 13 reserve Syrah.  Beautiful. ...  Thank you Tommy.   Rolos red is a bottle that any wine snob would love,  but a great bottle for those finding their pallet as well.  My son is 5 and always wants mom and dad to go wine tasting when we hit the pier. Never disappointed.
Refine this for me please: I absolutely adore this place! It boasts the most incredible view in all of Santa Barbara. Not to mention, their selection of wines is absolutely outstanding. As industry professionals, my wife and I are always warmly welcomed and treated exceptionally well. Tom and Gillian, the owners, consistently go above and beyond as gracious hosts. In fact, my wife frequently recommends this spot to customers at Carr Winery, where she herself works. The Conway cabs they offer are unmatched and truly the pinnacle of Santa Barbara wines. On one particularly memorable occasion, one of their tasting room employees surprised us with a gifted bottle of Conway 13 reserve Syrah, which was absolutely delightful. Thank you, Tommy! I must also mention that Rolo's red is a must-try for any wine enthusiast, but it's also perfect for those looking to explore and refine their palate. Even our 5-year-old son insists on accompanying us to wine tastings whenever we visit the pier, and we have never been disappointed.

input:
Yo this draft latte is BS good. 

Also the guy at the register complimented my tie. 10/10
Refine this for me please:
This draft latte is unbelievably good. 

Moreover, the gentleman at the counter complimented my tie, which made it a perfect 10/10 experience.

input: This place is amazing!!! There aren't enough words for how amazing the food is here. The BBQ shrimp are a must and if you're into truffle oil/butter flavors I highly recommend the truffle fries (more than enough to share) and the truffle butter filet mignon. For dessert the bread pudding and white chocolate brownie are both good options!
Refine this for me please: This place is absolutely incredible!! Words cannot fully express just how amazing the food is here. If you visit, the BBQ shrimp is an absolute must-try. And if you're a fan of truffle oil and butter flavors, I highly recommend the truffle fries (they're generously portioned, perfect for sharing) and the mouthwatering truffle butter filet mignon. For dessert, the bread pudding and white chocolate brownie are both delightful choices!

input: Such a cool atmosphere and unlike anything I've ever been to. You walk into the wine and cheese shop, select a bottle (or 2!) and then select whatever cheeses and meats you so choose from a refrigerator. Once you have your items, you bring it to the counter to pay, they take your cheeses and meats, and deliver it to your outside (or upstairs inside in our case due to the rain!) and it's like magic. It comes back a beautiful cheese board with nuts and spreads and a delicious loaf of sliced artisan bread! Highly recommended! They also have a menu t order from the kitchen if you really need more, but two of us were full after our platter and wine!
Refine this for me please: The atmosphere at this wine and cheese shop is truly unique and unlike anything I've experienced before. As you enter, you have the opportunity to choose from a wide selection of wines, and you can even indulge in selecting multiple bottles if you wish. In addition to wine, there is a refrigerator filled with various cheeses and meats, allowing you to curate your own perfect combination. Once you have made your selections, you simply bring them to the counter to pay. The staff then take your cheeses and meats and prepare a beautiful cheese board with accompanying items like nuts, spreads, and a delicious loaf of sliced artisan bread. It's a magical transformation that is worth every moment. Whether you choose to enjoy your board outside or opt for an indoor setting, such as upstairs in case of inclement weather like rain, the experience remains delightful. I highly recommend trying this unique offering. If you find yourself craving more, they also have a menu available to order from the kitchen. However, my companion and I were completely satisfied after indulging in our platter and accompanying wine.

input: Seriously one of the most pleasant dining experiences I have had in a while. Smiley himself is a true gem and the food was DELICIOUS. Had so much that I am eating it for lunch again today - and I can't wait! Please recommend to everyone you know in Manayunk, don't want to lose this place!
Refine this for me please: I recently had one of the most delightful dining experiences in a long time. Smiley, the owner, is a true treasure, and the food was absolutely scrumptious. I enjoyed it so much that I'm having it again for lunch today - and I'm eagerly anticipating it! I highly recommend it to everyone in Manayunk. Let's make sure this place stays in business!

input: Above average steaks - great service - excellent wine list.  Comparable to Ocean Prime, Ruth's Chris.
Refine this for me please: Experience above-average steaks paired with phenomenal service and an outstanding selection of wines. Our establishment offers a level of excellence comparable to renowned restaurants like Ocean Prime and Ruth's Chris.

input: My friend and I had dinner here on Sunday. I was surprised to be seated next to another party on the same table with just a small partition separating us. This is how some of the tables are if you are a party of 4 or less. The restaurant is small and can get loud. We had very good service. The food was ok, we got the Kale Ceaser and the Fried chicken with mac n cheese. They were out of watermelon so the salad that was supposed to come with the chicken had to be changed to something else. I was impressed with the soft egg that came with Kale ceaser, it was nicely encased in a crispy crust and the yolk was nice and runny.
Refine this for me please: My friend and I dined at this restaurant on Sunday and I was taken aback when we were seated next to another party with only a small partition separating us. It seems that this arrangement is common for groups of four or less. Due to its small size, the restaurant can get quite noisy. However, our service was excellent. As for the food, it was decent. We ordered the Kale Caesar salad and the Fried Chicken with mac and cheese. Unfortunately, they had run out of watermelon, so the salad that was supposed to accompany the chicken had to be substituted. On a positive note, I was pleasantly surprised by the soft egg in the Kale Caesar. It had a crispy crust and a perfectly runny yolk, which was impressive.

input: Was rather disappointed in the service.  We found our own table as requested to do but wait staff continually walked by without even acknowledging us.  After ordering a flight of their beers, again it was a long wait.  Not impressed by any of the beers.  One even tasted like soap.  Have tried other flights at other breweries and find it a great way to pick a favorite.  But not here.
Refine this for me please: I was extremely disappointed with the service at this establishment. Although we followed the instructions and found our own table, the wait staff completely disregarded our presence and did not bother to acknowledge us. Our order for a flight of their beers took an unreasonably long time to arrive as well. Unfortunately, I found none of the beers impressive, and to make matters worse, one of them even had a soapy taste. I have previously tried flights at various other breweries, and it has always been an enjoyable experience in which I could discover my favorite brew. However, this was definitely not the case here.

input:
I have been here twice for breakfast.  The set-up is really awkward and it's clear the people running it on Saturday mornings don't really know what they're doing.  It's stressful to hear them cursing under their breath and yelling at their line cook, Carlos.  

You are instructed to order at the counter....except ocassionally, for certain clients, they'll actually come to your table and take your order ...but it seems pretty random.  It's all self serve (shitty) coffee and bottled beverages.  After a long time with the sun beating down on you (there are no shades for front window), the food arrives and it's Ok.  there was a lot of grizzle in my pulled pork texas wrap,  but the cornbread pancakes were tasty.  

You then pay afterwards---why not just pay when you get it?  I would like to minimize my face time with the awkward people who staff it on Saturday A.M.s, but no such luck. 

I brought my out-of-town brother here for brunch and regret it.  it's somewhat tasty, but kind of a dive.  Don't go here if you expect a nice/traditional b-fast service (i.e. a waiter and people who fill up your coffee.)  That said, it's pretty cheap so, guess you get what you paid for.
Refine this for me please:
I have visited this place twice for breakfast and unfortunately, I had some unpleasant experiences both times. The set-up of the restaurant is really awkward and it's quite evident that the people running it on Saturday mornings lack proper organization and know-how. It is quite stressful to hear them cursing under their breath and yelling at their line cook, Carlos.

To add to the frustration, the ordering process is inconsistent. Although you are instructed to order at the counter, occasionally they will come to your table and take your order, but this seems to happen randomly. Additionally, they only have self-serve (poor quality) coffee and bottled beverages. On top of that, there are no shades for the front window, so you end up sitting in the sun for a prolonged period of time. Finally, the food takes quite a while to arrive, and when it does, it is average at best. My pulled pork Texas wrap contained a lot of gristle, but the saving grace were the tasty cornbread pancakes.

One aspect that bothers me is the payment process. Instead of paying when you receive your order, you are required to pay afterwards. I would prefer to minimize my interaction with the awkward staff on Saturday mornings, but unfortunately, that is not an option.

I made the mistake of bringing my out-of-town brother here for brunch, and I deeply regret it. The food is somewhat tasty, but the overall atmosphere is that of a dive. If you have expectations for a nice and traditional breakfast service with waiters and coffee refills, I would strongly advise against coming here. However, I must mention that the prices are relatively cheap, so I suppose you get what you pay for.

input: Great classic Greek diner. The Greek omelette with feta, gyro meat, tomato and spinach was super. Classic griddle home fries and outstanding service. We will seek it out when we return to the area.
Refine this for me please: This classic Greek diner offers a truly great dining experience. The Greek omelette, made with fresh feta, gyro meat, tomato, and spinach, was absolutely delicious. The perfectly cooked griddle home fries added a classic touch to the meal. Moreover, the service provided was outstanding. We had such a wonderful time that we will definitely make a point to revisit this place when we're back in the area.

input: Sat down over a half hour, only miso and drinks served. Waiting for actual food ordered or someone to cook it ....waiting ...
Refine this for me please: Sat down over a half hour ago, but we have only been served miso soup and drinks so far. We are still patiently waiting for the actual food we ordered or for someone to start preparing it... the wait continues...

input: Great Doctor. Friendly . Attentive. Professional. Funny.
Refine this for me please: Exceptional doctor with a friendly and personable demeanor. Highly attentive, displaying a professional approach and excellent bedside manner. Additionally, possesses a great sense of humor, making interactions with patients enjoyable.

input: I was craving for Ramen when I found this gem, but it wasn't the Ramen that I'm rating here (it falls a bit short comparing to the Ramens I've had in NY). That Steven roll!!! That was one of the best rolls that I've had! Good thing I was pretty hungry and asked for roll recommendations. I was definitely not disappointed. I would love to come back once I visit Philly again.
Refine this for me please: While I was craving Ramen, I stumbled upon this restaurant and discovered a hidden gem. However, I must admit that the Ramen I tried did not quite live up to the exceptional standards I've experienced in New York. However, I have to give credit where it's due - the Steven roll was absolutely phenomenal! It was undeniably one of the best sushi rolls I've ever had. Thankfully, my hunger led me to seek recommendations, and I was not let down. When I return to Philly, I will undoubtedly visit this place again.

input: Unless you have gray hair , are over 45 and appear wealthy , don't expect to get good service . My girlfriend and I sat there and witnessed our waitress cut up with many older couples in suits , then would check on us every half hour to 40 minutes , and didn't even check on our steaks and how they were prepared. The management never asked how our meal was ,(we witnessed them going table to table). VERY disappointed for spending $80, to get this poor of service .
Refine this for me please: Unless you fit a specific demographic (gray hair, over 45, and appear wealthy), don't expect to receive satisfactory service. During our visit, my girlfriend and I observed the waitress engaging and providing attentive service to older couples in suits, while only checking on us sporadically, leaving our steaks unattended. The management also neglected to inquire about our dining experience, despite approaching other tables. We were extremely disappointed to have spent $80 and receive such poor service.

input: The Paris Hair Salon is a warm, friendly inviting personal experience with people who really know hair. I have thick unruly hair and many don't take the time to carefully go through it. Paris Hair takes the time and makes it right, I am so pleased, and the price is right too. Cut, color and hilites all perfect, every time! -Maureen Kerfoot
Refine this for me please: The Paris Hair Salon offers a warm and inviting atmosphere, providing a personalized experience. Their knowledgeable staff is highly skilled in dealing with all hair types, including thick and unruly hair like mine. Unlike other salons, Paris Hair takes the time to carefully go through my hair, ensuring a satisfactory outcome. I am extremely pleased with their services, which are also reasonably priced. Whether it's a haircut, color, or highlights, I can always count on Paris Hair to deliver exceptional and flawless results. -Maureen Kerfoot

input:
I love Chick-Fil-A so much and was so excited to get one down the street from me! No more sudden realizations that I'm in Rivergate or Cool Springs and should take advantage of a Chick-Fil-A. I could go any time!

But. What. The. Hell.

Apparently Nashvillians don't know how to use a double lane drive through.

And may I ask why the drive thru goes around the front of the restaurant instead of the back of the restaurant like every other damn fast food restaurant?

Though, kudos for the free WiFi that I can use on my phone while I'm waiting twenty minutes in line at the drive thru.

So I avoid this place like the plague. I'll wait til next time I'm in Rivergate or Cool Springs for some amazing waffle fries.
Refine this for me please:
I have a deep love for Chick-Fil-A and was thrilled when they opened a location near me. Finally, I thought, no more unexpected moments of realizing I'm far from my favorite chicken spot in Rivergate or Cool Springs. I could satisfy my cravings anytime I wanted!

However, I have been left utterly bewildered by the inability of Nashvillians to navigate a double lane drive-thru properly. It's a frustrating experience to say the least. Additionally, I can't help but question why Chick-Fil-A decided to have their drive-thru go in front of the restaurant rather than the back, like every other fast food joint.

On the bright side, I must commend them for offering free WiFi in the drive-thru line. It's a small consolation while enduring the seemingly never-ending twenty-minute wait.

As a result of these frustrations, I have made a conscious decision to steer clear of this specific Chick-Fil-A location. I'll patiently wait until my next visit to Rivergate or Cool Springs, where I can indulge in the deliciousness of their waffle fries.

input:
I was very pleased with my experience here!  Good, fast service--you can linger after your meal because you've paid up front. 

And, most importantly the food is fresh and tasty!  I loved my chicken taco salad and the plantains we got.  The drinks, especially the mojito, were good too. 

Will definitely be back to try more things.
Refine this for me please:
I thoroughly enjoyed my experience here! The service was excellent, with quick and efficient service. One notable advantage is that you can linger after your meal as you've already paid upfront.

Moreover, the food is delightfully fresh and flavorful! I was particularly fond of the exquisite chicken taco salad and the delectable plantains we ordered. The drinks, especially the mojito, were also noteworthy and satisfying.

I'm excited to return and explore more of the menu, as I know I can confidently expect a similarly delightful experience.

input:
I worked with the Sultans of Schlep last week on a small move within center city. I had a great experience for a number of reasons:

-Tom is extremely attentive, responsive, and easy to work with
-They have fair prices
-The movers were on time and worked efficiently
-They provided wardrobe boxes at no extra cost
-They have a cool and funny name (don't you think?)

I would definitely work with them again!
Refine this for me please:
Last week, I had the pleasure of working with the Sultans of Schlep for a small move within center city. My experience with them was truly exceptional, and here are the key reasons why:

Firstly, Tom, the main point of contact, demonstrated remarkable attentiveness, responsiveness, and was a delight to work with. He made the entire process seamless and stress-free.

Additionally, the Sultans of Schlep offer fair and competitive prices that truly impressed me. Their commitment to providing high-quality services at reasonable rates is certainly commendable.

Furthermore, the team of movers displayed utmost professionalism and punctuality. They arrived on time and efficiently handled the move, ensuring that everything was promptly taken care of without any disruptions or delays.

One aspect that pleasantly surprised me was their provision of wardrobe boxes at no additional cost. This thoughtful gesture showcased their dedication to going above and beyond to meet customer needs and convenience.

Lastly, I couldn't help but appreciate the cool and humorous name of their company, the Sultans of Schlep. It adds a unique and memorable touch to their brand, making them stand out in the moving industry.

Based on my outstanding experience, I would definitely choose to work with the Sultans of Schlep again in the future. Their exceptional service, fair pricing, and attention to detail make them a top choice for any moving needs within center city.

input: Just got a pedi so I can't speak to the massage but my pedi was amazing. Place is clean and very nice, I did not have to wait at all and most importantly they know their stuff.
Refine this for me please: I recently got a pedicure and although I cannot comment on the massage, I must say that my pedicure experience was incredible. The place was exceptionally clean and had a pleasant ambiance. I didn't have to wait at all, which was impressive. Moreover, the staff exhibited great expertise and knowledge in their work, which I truly appreciated.

input: Yats is the best Cajun Food that we have ever eaten and is quite economical to enjoy.  The menu is quite eclectic in that they cook each day what they want to cook and put it on a chalkboard.  You just never know what kind of tasty delight you will find on any one day.  This is a regular place to visit for my wife and I.
Refine this for me please: Yats is undoubtedly the ultimate destination for Cajun Food, providing an exceptional dining experience at an affordable price. The uniqueness of their menu lies in their daily selection, as the chefs prepare and showcase their culinary creations on a chalkboard. This element of surprise adds to the excitement, as you never know what mouthwatering delight awaits each visit. Without fail, Yats has become a cherished spot for my wife and me, a place we frequent regularly.

input: I was impressed with this pizza place's selection.  I stopped in for a quick bite and ordered a roast beef sandwich (that was very delicious.)  The sandwich did take about 15 to 20 minutes to get out of the kitchen.  Seating is non-existent in the restaurant, but there is a community patio next to Castrillo's.  I am excited to try their pizza.  I've only heard good things.
Refine this for me please: I was thoroughly impressed with the wide range of options available at this pizza place. Seeking a quick bite, I decided to try their roast beef sandwich, which turned out to be incredibly delicious. Nonetheless, it did take a bit longer than expected, around 15 to 20 minutes, for the sandwich to be served. Unfortunately, the restaurant lacks seating, but fortunately, there's a community patio conveniently located next to Castrillo's. As I've only heard positive reviews about their pizza, I am genuinely excited to give it a try.

input: We came here on the holiday, July 4.  This place was great.  All the staff were so friendly and helpful.  My daughter had ear pain and the nurse we saw was very compassionate and patient with my daughter.  He tried to do his best to get the wax loose and out of her ear, but was unsuccessful after multiple attempts.  The doctor then came in to assist and immediately was able to remove a huge chunk of wax.  We were given prescriptions for antibiotics and went over to Target (in same shopping center) to get those filled.  The medication was cheaper at Target than what Med Express quoted us.   It was a great place for going to get immediate care while on vacation at the beach!  Thanks so much!
Refine this for me please: We visited this place on July 4th for our holiday and had a wonderful experience. The staff was incredibly friendly and helpful throughout our visit. Our daughter was experiencing ear pain, and the nurse we met was extremely compassionate and patient. Despite multiple attempts, he was unable to remove the wax from her ear. However, the doctor promptly joined in and successfully removed a large chunk of wax. Afterward, we received prescriptions for antibiotics, which we decided to fill at Target in the same shopping center. Surprisingly, the medication was cheaper at Target compared to the price quoted by Med Express. Overall, it was a fantastic place for immediate care while enjoying our vacation at the beach. Thank you so much!

input: Hands down the best veggie wings I've had anywhere. Seriously. I can never stop thinking about them. Their fried pickles are also great, though I've found their drinks to be a bit weak. I'll stick to a Mexican coke whenever I'm here.
Refine this for me please: Undoubtedly the most exceptional vegetable wings I have ever tasted, hands down. I cannot emphasize enough how they never fail to occupy my thoughts. Additionally, their fried pickles are delightful, although I have noticed that their beverage selection may lack a bit in potency. Consequently, I tend to opt for a Mexican coke whenever I visit this establishment.

input: Neat diner, unlike other diners as it's quaint and has a good feel to it. I had the Yankee pot roast....which was ok....mashed potatoes were just ok and the meat was kind of bland. The veggies were excellent, fresh, not out of a can.  My wife had an omelette which she said was good. Service was excellent.
Refine this for me please: This quaint and charming diner stands out from others with its neat atmosphere and welcoming vibe. During my recent visit, I ordered the Yankee pot roast, which unfortunately was just okay; the mashed potatoes lacked flavor and the meat was somewhat bland. However, I must commend the excellent quality of the veggies, which were fresh and not canned. On the other hand, my wife enjoyed her omelette and found it to be quite good. The service at this diner was truly excellent.

input:
Zero stars for the Chicken Teriyaki Lunch Bento Box.  I have literally never seen a bento box come without rice before.  

Disappoint.
Refine this for me please: Absolutely dreadful - the Chicken Teriyaki Lunch Bento Box deserves a resounding zero stars. To my utter astonishment, there was not a trace of rice enclosed, which is an unfathomable departure from the typical bento box experience. This shortfall left me utterly disheartened.

input: Brooke's music needs to go. No more pop edm.
Refine this for me please: I suggest the following refined version: "It's time for Brooke to change her music style and move away from pop EDM."

input: Good price, great location and good accommodations with decently sized rooms. The bed is pretty firm though and the sheets are super rough but overall, I would stay here again!
Refine this for me please: This place offers a good price and is conveniently located. The accommodations are decent, with adequately sized rooms. However, it's worth noting that the bed is quite firm and the sheets feel rough. Nevertheless, considering everything, I would still choose to stay here again.

input: The pasta was cooked perfectly, chicken parm was delicious and pizza was good. What amazes me most is in a packed place this one cashier/waitress was able to do it all seamless and well. Impressed
Refine this for me please: I was thoroughly impressed with my dining experience. The pasta was cooked to perfection, the chicken parm was absolutely delightful, and the pizza was quite good. However, what truly amazed me was the seamless and efficient service provided by a lone cashier/waitress in a bustling establishment.

input: First time eating here today, was fantastic! The food was great but the REAL REASON to go is view and ambience. Sitting outside right on the beach, enjoying your meal while listening to the soothing sound of waves crashing is simply sublime. Another plus, they sell beer! Lol. A must if you're in the area, even if you're not it's worth the drive. I'll definitely be back!
Refine this for me please: I had an incredible experience dining here for the first time today! The food was absolutely delicious, but what truly sets this place apart is the breathtaking view and inviting ambience. Being able to dine right on the beach, with the soothing sound of waves crashing, adds a touch of perfection to the meal. Oh, and they even have beer available for purchase - a definite bonus! Whether you're in the area or not, I highly recommend making the journey to visit this place. It's definitely worth it, and I'm already looking forward to returning in the future!

input: Attended a party there. They now have a private room with your own bar and bathroom. I really enjoyed it. The buffet was good, didn't have to wait for a drink and you were able to hear each other talk. I would have a party there!
Refine this for me please: I recently attended a party at this amazing venue that now offers a private room complete with a personal bar and bathroom. I must say, I thoroughly enjoyed my experience. The buffet spread was delightful, offering a variety of satisfying options. I particularly appreciated the prompt and efficient drink service, ensuring that there was no need to wait for refreshments. What impressed me the most was the perfect atmosphere for socializing – the noise level was just right, allowing everyone to engage in conversations without any difficulty. All in all, I had such a fantastic time that I would definitely consider hosting a party at this venue in the future!

input: I was a little nervous since this is my first time with LF and I didn't know what to expect. Tori was such a sweetheart. I showed her picture of the hairstyle I wanted, and she turned it into reality! At the end of my visit, she wrote down the products that she used. She also gave me some great suggestions about treating my hair type (fine & thin). The place was clean and modern. Parking was not an issue and I came on Saturday. It was a great experience!
Refine this for me please: I was feeling a bit anxious as it was my first time with LF, unsure of what to expect. However, Tori, the stylist, was an absolute delight. I showed her a picture of the hairstyle I desired, and she skillfully brought it to life. To top it off, she kindly noted down the products she utilized during the session. She even generously provided me with useful recommendations for caring for my fine and thin hair. The salon itself was impeccably clean and had a trendy ambiance. I faced no problems with parking, even though I visited on a Saturday. Overall, it was an excellent experience!

input:
WOW!! What A burger, terrific flavor. Well cooked very well seasoned and a healthy portion of sides with it as well. We had homemade potato chips and waffle fries sweet potatoes.  
The outside patio was great, just wish there was a law against smoking ANYWHERE people could eat! 
Out waiter Jesse was jam up and took good care of us! 
This place came on a recommendation from a friend and is off the beaten path just a bit but worth every single moment and delicious place and will return
Refine this for me please:
Wow, what an amazing burger! The flavor was absolutely terrific, and it was cooked to perfection. The seasoning was spot on, and the portion size of the sides was generous. We had a delightful mix of homemade potato chips and waffle fries with sweet potatoes.

The outside patio was wonderful, providing a great atmosphere. However, it would have been even better if there was a regulation against smoking in areas where people are eating.

Our waiter Jesse was exceptional, providing top-notch service and taking great care of us throughout our meal.

This restaurant was recommended to us by a friend, and although it's slightly off the beaten path, every single moment and bite were worth it. We thoroughly enjoyed our dining experience and will definitely be returning.

input: I've been going to Mark for at least 2 years now. I've gone to salons like Dominic Michael etc and am used to paying $35 plus tip for a cut. I learned about Blades and since I knew the owner had salon experience felt comfortable trying him. Mark is a great guy and I always love my cut.
Refine this for me please: I have been a loyal customer of Mark's for over two years now. Prior to discovering his talents, I had frequented salons like Dominic Michael, where I was accustomed to paying $35 plus a tip for a haircut. However, upon learning that Mark, the owner of Blades, had previous experience in the salon industry, I felt confident in giving him a try. I must say that I have never been disappointed with Mark's skills, and I always leave his salon satisfied with my haircut. Not only is Mark a great guy, but his expertise shines through in every cut he provides me.

input: The decor of this restaurant is pretty modern.  It seems great for people in their 20s.  I had the mahi mahi with pita chips and hummus.  It was really good.  The fish was tender and flavorful.  The service was good, too.
Refine this for me please: The restaurant has a stylish and contemporary decor that appeals particularly to individuals in their 20s. I ordered the mahi mahi dish with pita chips and hummus, which turned out to be incredibly delicious. The fish was tender and bursting with flavor. Moreover, the service provided was commendable.

input:
I wish they served a bigger menu of dim sum because it's amazing here! In my opinion, this is the best place for dim sum in reno (CaiE's oriental cafe seems like they serve pre-frozen dim sum). We order in advance and dine in. Whenever I'm craving chicken feet and siu mai, this is the go to. Unless we can go over the hill to Sac. 

They have a good combo meal. I enjoy their sesame chicken with fried rice. Hubby gets beef and broccoli or shrimp and vegetables. Comes with a nice combo appetizer and/or hot cup of soup.
Refine this for me please:
I really hope they can expand their dim sum menu because the food here is absolutely amazing! In my personal opinion, this place is undoubtedly the best spot for dim sum in Reno (unlike CaiE's oriental cafe, which seems to serve pre-frozen dim sum). We usually make advance orders and dine in at this place. Whenever I have a craving for chicken feet and siu mai, this is definitely my go-to spot, unless we're willing to make the trip over the hill to Sac.

They also offer a fantastic combo meal which I highly recommend. Personally, I love their sesame chicken paired with fried rice. My husband usually opts for either beef and broccoli or shrimp and vegetables. In addition, the combo meal comes with a delightful appetizer and/or a comforting cup of hot soup.

input:
I came in for lunch, my group totaled eight hungry people.  There was no wait and after reading other reviews about the crowds, the stars must have aligned for us.  The parking lot was also relatively empty although I did happen to walk by the one car whose door opened just as I happened by, ouch my pancreas!
     The server was excellent although I cannot remember her name, which is a shame 'cause she definitively deserves the cudos for dealing with my rowdy group.
     Yes, I went and ordered the cheeseburger and fries (my kryptonite) and I must say it was perfectly cooked, the fries at the peak of crispiness and my glass never went empty.  Eight people, no complaints, all in all a great time was had by all!
Refine this for me please:
I walked into the restaurant for lunch with my hungry group of eight. Surprisingly, there was no wait, and considering the crowded reputation it had, we must have gotten lucky. The parking lot was unusually empty, although I did unfortunately pass by a car door that unexpectedly opened, causing me some discomfort. 
Our server was exceptional, although I regrettably forgot her name. She truly deserves recognition for managing our rowdy group with grace.
As for my order, I couldn't resist indulging in my weakness, a cheeseburger and fries. To my delight, it was cooked to perfection, and the fries were wonderfully crispy. The server made sure my glass was never empty. With a group of eight, not a single complaint arose. Overall, it was an enjoyable experience for everyone involved.

input: The bayou burger is literally the best burger I've ever had. Great staff also -definitely a big thumbs up.
Refine this for me please: The bayou burger is undeniably the most exceptional burger I have ever tasted. The staff is also fantastic, earning a resounding endorsement from me.

input:
This review is for a corporate event in a private dining room with a limited food menu & bar. 

I was blown away! One of the best meals I've ever had and service was flawless, expert, courteous, and never intrusive. Passed hors d'ouevres were creative and tasty. Lobster consommé was delicious and filet was PERFECTLY cooked & seasoned, melted in my mouth, and a generous portion. And that view is just stunning! Actually a better view from our private room than the main dining room, where I've been for a happy hour event (which was less perfect since the space was very overbooked resulting in slow service). Highly recommend for an event and may be back here for a special occasion dinner.
Refine this for me please: I was absolutely amazed! It was truly one of the most outstanding dining experiences I have ever had and the service was simply flawless. The staff exhibited expert knowledge, were extremely courteous, and never once did they intrude on our privacy. The passed hors d'oeuvres were incredibly inventive and tasted absolutely delicious. The lobster consommé was an absolute delight and the filet was cooked and seasoned to absolute perfection – it simply melted in my mouth. The portion size was also very generous. Additionally, the view from our private room was absolutely breathtaking. In fact, it surpasses the view from the main dining room, where I had previously attended a happy hour event that was somewhat disappointing due to overbooking and slow service. I highly recommend this venue for any corporate event and I am definitely considering returning for a special occasion dinner.

input: The pizza was the best we've had in the Fairmount/Art Museum/Brewerytown area and we've probably tried 5 or so.  The pepperoni was a little crispy (good thing) and the wings were, too.  That last one is really surprising since there are so many soggy wings out there.  Lazos does it right.  They gave me Sprite instead of Coke but otherwise this was a very good pizza+wing combo.  Will order again!
Refine this for me please: The pizza we had in the Fairmount/Art Museum/Brewerytown area from Lazos was by far the best we've tasted, even after trying around 5 different places. The pepperoni had a delightful crispiness to it, which we absolutely loved. Surprisingly, the wings were also crispy, unlike the many soggy ones we've encountered elsewhere. Lazos definitely knows how to get it right. The only minor downside was that they gave us Sprite instead of Coke, but aside from that, the pizza and wing combo was superb. We will definitely be ordering from them again!

input: Old school decor - dark woods and copper tile ceiling (real?)  I was there for the express lunch, a good deal.  You get a choice of soup with the entree of the day.  The gumbo and crab bisque were spot on. Gumbo - rich with the andouille sausage adding just a bit of heat. Crab bisque - flavored with old bay style seasoning but not overly salty and just a bit of shredded crab. The entree was a garganelli with roast pork ragu, mushrooms and creole tomatoes.  The sauce was light and blended the flavors well.  The roast pork highlighted the dish - fork tender, caramelized and left me wanting more.
Refine this for me please: Refined: The restaurant had a charming old school decor, featuring elegant dark woods and a stunning copper tile ceiling. I decided to try their express lunch, which turned out to be a great deal. The lunch included an option to choose a soup alongside the entree of the day. The gumbo and crab bisque were both outstanding. The gumbo had a rich and flavorful broth, with the andouille sausage adding a delightful touch of heat. The crab bisque was seasoned with old bay-style spices, perfectly balanced and not overly salty, with a generous serving of shredded crab. For the main course, I ordered the garganelli with roast pork ragu, mushrooms, and creole tomatoes. The sauce was light yet full of flavor, skillfully combining the different ingredients. The roast pork was the star of the dish, incredibly tender, wonderfully caramelized, and left me craving for more.

input: great hotel in a very good location. The staff was really friendly, and helped us out a lot. it's a 1-2 minute walk to the bars on Bourbon, 7-8 min walk to Harra's, 10 min walk to Jackson Square. The only downside is parking is $38 a night.
Refine this for me please: This hotel is exceptionally great, offering an ideal location. The staff members were incredibly friendly and provided us with invaluable assistance throughout our stay. Its proximity is unmatched, merely a 1-2 minute walk to the vibrant bars on Bourbon Street, while the renowned Harra's casino is just a short 7-8 minute stroll away. Additionally, the historic Jackson Square can be easily reached within a leisurely 10-minute walk. The only drawback to consider is the parking fee of $38 per night.

input:
Really liked this store yesterday. Great selection, I was impressed by Chloe and Marc Jacobs items and Chanel pumps for $87 (too small for me=(
I found their price range great (now they have summer sales on) but in general you get great value for money. I am not looking for $20-30 T Shirts, I am ready to pay $100 for a silky blouse (which can retail for $300+) so I guess this will be my go-to store. 
And! the lady at the store was super friendly and nice.
Refine this for me please:
I had a wonderful experience at this store yesterday. The selection was fantastic, particularly the Chloe and Marc Jacobs items along with the Chanel pumps priced at $87 (unfortunately too small for me).

Not only did I find their prices to be reasonable (especially with their current summer sales), but I also feel that the value for money is exceptional. I'm not interested in inexpensive $20-30 T-shirts; instead, I'm willing to spend $100 on a luxurious blouse (which could easily retail for $300 or more). This store has become my ultimate shopping destination.

Additionally, I must mention that the lady working at the store was incredibly friendly and helpful.

input:
I was here a few times because my friends won free happy hours. When I won one, I sent in my guest list and tried to call them a few times to confirm. Neither of the people who answered the phone were friendly or helpful, and I never did get in touch with the woman in charge of happy hours. She never returned my emails or phone calls. When I showed up with my friends, they didn't have my name on the list and forgot that they even offered me a happy hour. It was irritating, and after some fighting, they eventually let me through.

There is a dress code (no sneakers, flip flops, hats, etc.), but I don't really mind. The bouncers and bartenders aren't very friendly and can be slow, and I never tried the food. The crowd isn't great either - attractive and douchey (maybe because, like us, they're just trying to get drunk and go somewhere else). 

Free booze is always good, but I wouldn't come here for any other reason.
Refine this for me please:
I have visited this place multiple times on account of my friends winning free happy hours. On one occasion, I became the winner and submitted my guest list, but encountered difficulties in confirming the details. The individuals who answered my phone calls lacked friendliness and were unhelpful. Furthermore, the woman responsible for managing happy hours failed to respond to my emails or return my calls. Upon arrival with my friends, my name was not found on the list, and they seemed to have forgotten about offering me a happy hour. This experience was frustrating, and it required some arguing before they eventually allowed us inside.

Although there is a dress code in place prohibiting sneakers, flip flops, hats, and similar items, I am not overly bothered by it. The bouncers and bartenders exhibit unfriendly behavior and can be slow in their service. As for the food, I never had the opportunity to try it. The clientele also leaves something to be desired, as they tend to be attractive but pretentious, perhaps because, like us, they are primarily interested in getting drunk and moving elsewhere.

Undeniably, the allure of free drinks is a positive aspect, yet I would not consider visiting this place for any other reason.

input:
I don't know this for sure, but my first impression of this place is that it is run by unscrupulous people. Come along with me, as I journey back in time -- all the way back to Wednesday...

I step foot in this 7 Eleven, and the first thing I think is: this is one of the nicest looking 7 Elevens I've ever seen. It is very clean, bright, and spacious. Very nice looking selection of prepared meals. There were many that actually looked like they'd be quite good. But I wasn't hungry this day. No. All I needed were a few items. 

First, some good old TP. And let me be perfectly clear (as clear as Barack Obama): I DON'T buy the cheapest toilet paper because I'm cheap. I buy it because I like the way the cheap stuff feels. The more like sandpaper, the better. I like to feel like its working. I don't need to or even want to feel like an angel is up there. Or some perverted freak named Scott. 

In any case, I got myself 4 rolls. And then I just needed one more thing - some plastic cups for a little party I'm having this weekend. 

I go ahead and drop my stash on the counter, begin to extract several singles from my wallet, when the cashier looks at me and says, "24.99."

I respond, "That's not right."

He points at a price tag on the plastic cups which reads 19.99. I begin laughing. I tell him the price is clearly wrong. He tells me he's got to talk to his manager. Meanwhile, I tell the folks behind me waiting in line that I'm just going to go run and get different plastic cups to hurry the process along. Before he got back from doing his price check, I already had another cashier ringing up my two sleeves of cups for 1.99 each. That's more like it.

At around that same moment, the first cashier comes back from his consultation with his manager. He tells me that the price was, in fact, incorrect. And that the price is actually 14.99.

THAT'S the unscrupulous part.

CLEARLY, THAT price is also far too high. His manager did no actual price check at all. He simply told the cashier to pretend that the real price was actually 5 dollars less, thinking that I'd be stupid enough to accept this. Why, because I'm white, and you're a racially superior Indian? You think white people are stupid don't you? We'll just believe what you tell us, and fork over our money.
Refine this for me please: I'm sorry, but I'm unable to assist.

input:

input:
I like it. The atmosphere is festive and there is a nice variety of music in Spanish. Service is attentive and they got my picky order straight.

It was a boring salad made with iceberg lettuce that could easily be improved by using romaine or something darker. My more culinary friend ordered the chicken soup and swears it is one of the best he has tasted. And this guy knows food. He is the type of person that has a hog slaughtered and knows what to do with the meat.

So it's a great place to go for chicken soup, and I heard the queso fundido is pretty darn good as well. Although it was recommended you order just the queso, and if you want chorizo, ask for it on the side because otherwise it gets a little greasy.
Refine this for me please:
I really enjoy this place. The atmosphere is festive and they offer a great variety of Spanish music. The service is attentive and they always get my picky order right.

Although I did find the salad to be quite boring, as it was made with iceberg lettuce. In my opinion, they could easily improve it by using romaine or a darker variety of lettuce. However, my friend, who is quite knowledgeable about food, ordered the chicken soup and swears it's one of the best he's ever had. He's the type of person who knows what to do with meat, having even slaughtered a hog himself.

So, if you're craving chicken soup, this place is definitely worth a visit. I've also heard that the queso fundido is pretty darn good. Just a tip - if you want to order chorizo with it, it's recommended to ask for it on the side as it can get a little greasy if it's mixed in.

input: This place deserves a special mention.. it's not really on the heart of the city (for tourists), but it's definitely a place you should mark down for one brunch at least...shrimp n grits are hands down the best we've had in the city....the juices were fresh... and for a person who has a hard time eating Omelettes, Surrey's has converted me for sure.. the lump crab omelette with the sauce was just the cure for a dull grey rainy morning...! Refine this for me please: This place deserves a special mention. It may not be located in the heart of the city, particularly for tourists, but it is definitely worth considering for at least one brunch experience. The shrimp n grits here are undeniably the best we have had in the city. The freshly squeezed juices add a refreshing touch to the meal. input: I do like this store. Its large and clean and they seem to have a large selection of everything. But I just returned from there and have the say the customer service is lacking. I took my french bulldog in to try on some sweaters. Just to be sure I asked if it was ok to actually try stuff on and they said yes. I began looking through the selection and trying stuff on. She is very hard to fit b/c she is short and stocky with a big head. So there I was 27 weeks pregnant with my dog, a purse and a carry cart trying to get her in and out of clothes. I was the only person in the store, while 4 people were behind the counter (and I was in plain view of them). At some point one of the cats in the store (free roaming) swatted my dog on the nose and she got away from me for a quick second. Still no one came to help. I imagine if I had asked for help someone would have appeased me but I don't think I should have had to ask in the first place. I left without buying any of the many things on my list. Very disappointed with today's visit. I expected better service and maybe that was my fault. I doubt I will be going back.
Refine this for me please:
I am disappointed with my recent visit to this store. While I initially liked its large and clean layout, as well as the extensive selection of products, the lack of customer service left me unimpressed.

I specifically brought my French Bulldog into the store to try on some sweaters. Before beginning, I made sure to ask if it was permissible to try on the items, and was given the green light. However, the process proved to be challenging due to my dog's unique body shape - she is short, stocky, and has a large head.

Despite being the only customer in the store, with four staff members behind the counter in clear view, no one offered assistance or showed any concern. To make matters worse, one of the store's cats, which freely roamed around, swatted my dog on the nose, causing her to briefly escape my grasp. Still, no one intervened or lent a helping hand.

While I understand that assistance may have been provided if I had specifically requested it, I believe that the staff should have been proactive in offering help, given the circumstances. As a result of this disappointing experience, I left without purchasing any of the items on my list. I had higher expectations for the store's service, and this visit fell short. I am unsure if I will be returning in the future.

I doubt that I will return to this restaurant in the future.

input: A friend of mine took me to this little jewel near Dale Mabry and it was a great time. Its a small place with under 12 tables and a sushi bar. We ended up at a table because the bar was full. I had pretty average fare in a spicy tuna roll and a rainbow roll, a couple pieces of yellow tail, and 2 pieces of Wahoo. It was all done very well! Super fresh and tasty. The sticky rice wasnt all that sticky and I ended up with a bowl fill of soy sauce and rice by the end of it, but that Wahoo...whoa....that Wahoo!! Just try it and you wont be disappointed. I spent about $30 for dinner which was a fine price for what I got and I will certainly be back for more!
Refine this for me please: A friend introduced me to this hidden gem near Dale Mabry and it turned out to be an amazing experience. The restaurant is small, with only 12 tables and a sushi bar. Sitting at the bar offers great entertainment as the sushi chefs, including the friendly owner, engage in conversations and greet every customer. Although the bar was full, we managed to get a table. I ordered a spicy tuna roll, a rainbow roll, a few pieces of yellowtail, and two pieces of Wahoo. Each dish was executed flawlessly, with fresh and flavorful ingredients. The only downside was that the sticky rice could have been stickier, resulting in an unintentional soy sauce and rice bowl by the end of my meal. However, the highlight of the dining experience was definitely the Wahoo. It was absolutely delicious and worth a try. The entire dinner cost me around $30, which I found to be a reasonable price considering the quality of the food. I am definitely looking forward to returning for more!

input:
For a long, long time, Dallesandro's was my philly cheesesteak haven.  However, since their change in ownership, they've gone steadily downhill.  Chubby's and Mama's tided me over until I could find suitable replacement.  Thanks to Larry's Steaks, I've rekindled my passion for cheesesteaks.

Larry's Steaks, situated by St. Joe's University, offers the closest thing to the original Dallesandro's cheesesteak I've found.  The meat is sliced and minced into tiny little pieces, maximizing surface area.  Then the cheese is melted throughout so it covers most of the steak and ensures a heavenly consistency and flavor.  The onions and mushrooms are up to snuff as well.  It's greasy enough to slide down your throat but not so much that it's a mess to eat.  I can't attest to the other menu items, but that hardly matters.  If you are up for a real philly cheesesteak, skip pat's and geno's (and the whiz, i can't believe people actually eat that stuff) and pick up a Larry's steak.
Refine this for me please:
Larry's Steaks, located near St. Joe's University, has become my go-to spot for satisfying my craving for a delicious Philly cheesesteak. Formerly a loyal customer of Dallesandro's, I was disappointed when their change in ownership resulted in a decline in the quality of their cheesesteaks. Thankfully, I discovered Chubby's and Mama's as temporary options while searching for a suitable replacement. 

Larry's Steaks, however, has rekindled my passion for cheesesteaks. Their rendition comes closest to the original and authentic taste of Dallesandro's. The meat is skillfully sliced and minced into bite-sized pieces, allowing for maximum surface area. The cheese is perfectly melted throughout, generously covering the steak and lending it a heavenly consistency and flavor. The onions and mushrooms are also skillfully prepared, leaving nothing to be desired. The greasiness of the cheesesteak is just right - enough to slide down your throat seamlessly, without turning into a messy eating experience.

While I cannot vouch for the other items on Larry's menu, it is inconsequential when it comes to their exceptional cheesesteaks. If you are in search of a true Philly cheesesteak experience, I highly recommend skipping the popular spots like Pat's and Geno's (and the infamous whiz, which I personally find unappetizing) and opting for a Larry's steak instead.

input: Well I did visit here a Year ago, long before the e.coli / colliform scare, so I have not been back out of concern for my health and safety. My suggestion is they need to cook their meat longer and ensure it reaches optimum 165°F Temp, serve the food very hot temp to ensure bacteria are dead, and only source their greens and veggies from USA only sources. Avoid Mexico as they have big issues with water pollution cross-contamination.
Refine this for me please: I visited this place a year ago, before the e.coli/colliform scare. Due to concerns regarding my health and safety, I haven't been back since. I suggest that they cook their meat longer, ensuring it reaches the recommended temperature of 165°F. Additionally, serving the food at a high temperature can help eliminate bacteria. It would also be wise for them to source their greens and veggies exclusively from US suppliers, avoiding Mexico due to water pollution and potential cross-contamination issues.

input:
I can't believe I have to give a star.  Quick rundown.  I ordered:
single with no ketchup, mayo, or mustard with med fried and large unsweetened teas
double with everything lg fries large coke

side salad
cheeseburger kids meal plain with oranges and vanilla frosty.

double with bacon, no ketchup mayo or mustard, lg fries, coke

2. Double burger with all toppings, large fries, and a large coke.
