input:
I've often passed this swanky little place in Downtown filled with good-looking professionals laughing over drinks, appetizers and spilling over the sidewalk

NOM NOMS
Although you probably won't get full on the sizes, the food is like little art works of flavor. My bowl of mussels and clams was HUGE and I sopped up the buttery, faintly spiced broth with the accompanying breadstick. Well done. The other appetizers like Tuna Tartare and Coconut Shrimp each had awesome flavor surprises - fresh, melty tuna and a wasabi and jam sauce respectively - both excellent and plated beautifully.

My cocktail "The Tryst" didn't impress. Watery and a strange alcohol after taste. I'll forget it tomorrow. 

SERVICE
Thanks Yelp for introducing me here. It's easy to get overlooked at the bar, but once seated, our server was quick and helpful and was great at lowering my inhibitions by telling me what to expect in a "vegetable" beer they offered--spot on. 

SUMMARY
I'll probably stick to the drinks only here because the food prices are above my range... or go during happy hours. Cool, hip place to bring the girlfriends or if you're looking for impressive, gutsy art dishes with good taste.... and if you have cash to blow (but I won't let that subtract a review star)
Refine this for me please:
Refined Version:

NOM NOMS
I have often noticed this trendy little spot in Downtown where attractive professionals gather, enjoying their drinks and appetizers, their laughter spilling onto the sidewalk.

The food at NOM NOMS may not fill you up entirely, but it is undeniably a work of culinary art. My dish of mussels and clams was massive, and I relished every bite of the buttery, subtly spiced broth along with the breadstick provided. It was excellently executed. The Tuna Tartare and Coconut Shrimp appetizers were equally impressive, surprising my taste buds with their fresh, delightful flavors. They were beautifully presented, too.

Unfortunately, my cocktail "The Tryst" left much to be desired. It was watery and had a peculiar aftertaste of alcohol. I won't remember it beyond tomorrow.

SERVICE
I am grateful to Yelp for recommending this place to me. Although I initially felt a bit overlooked at the bar, once seated, our server promptly attended to us. They were attentive, helpful, and even succeeded in easing my hesitations about trying a "vegetable" beer by providing an accurate description.

SUMMARY
For me personally, I might visit NOM NOMS solely for their drinks, as the prices of their food exceed my budget. Alternatively, I could opt to come during happy hours. Nevertheless, it is an excellent place to gather with friends or indulge in impressive, boldly artistic dishes that truly satisfy the palate... provided you have the funds to spare. However, I believe it's important to note that the prices will not affect my rating of this establishment.

input: The great customer service that you get here, you won't find in another to-go Asian/Thai restaurant. I enjoyed the food! The curry had great flavor and consistency. The shrimp fried rice does not look appealing but it is flavorful and fluffy. I dropped it down to 4 stars because I paid an additional $2.00 for extra egg and it was NOT extra egg. I also called in my order and received a 30 minute wait time. Total wait time was an hour. With all that being said, the ladies won me over with their passion to serve those waiting and making sure each customer was happy!
Refine this for me please: The customer service at this Asian/Thai restaurant stands out as exceptional. The staff demonstrates a genuine passion for serving their customers and ensuring their satisfaction. The food was enjoyable overall, particularly the flavorful and well-balanced curry. Despite its less appealing appearance, the shrimp fried rice pleasantly surprised with its delicious taste and fluffy texture. However, I deducted a star from my rating due to an issue with an additional charge for extra egg, which was not fulfilled. Furthermore, although I placed a phone order with an estimated 30-minute wait time, my total wait time extended to an hour. In spite of these drawbacks, the dedication of the staff to those waiting and their commitment to customer happiness truly won me over.

input: Ordered fresh made pie, not reheated slices.  Some of the best pizza I've had in philly, because of the tasteful and crunchy crust and good amount of toppings.  Had a Cowboy steak with no BBQ sauce and couldn't stop myself at two slices.  Got the same pizza again with bbq sauce and it was just as good so now I do half and half.
Refine this for me please: I ordered a freshly made pie, not reheated slices, and it turned out to be some of the best pizza I've ever had in Philly. What sets it apart is the deliciously tasteful and crunchy crust, topped generously with a good amount of toppings. One standout flavor was the Cowboy steak pizza without BBQ sauce— I couldn't resist indulging in more than just two slices. I enjoyed it so much that I decided to try the same pizza with BBQ sauce, and to my delight, it was just as delicious. Now, I make sure to order my pizza half with and half without BBQ sauce, because both versions are equally satisfying.

input:
It's just a place to get my mail. 
It's about $250.00 per year for a little box.  it makes sense for us because we travel so much.  I don't want any important mail being delivered to my house.  
I have a door key to the store so I can access my letter box after hours.
My larger parcels are kept in the back.  I get a phone call every time I receive one.  
I would rather ship out my parcels using Fed-ex because they are cheaper and more reliable.   
My husband has used their printing services and is happy with them. 
I see packaging materials and other stationary goods for sale, but I prefer to use Canada Post for that.
No problem with the staff.  They are cheerful and helpful.  They know me well.
The strip mall location can be a little sketchy.  Some druggies and homeless people like to hang out at the neighbouring store fronts.
Refine this for me please: This place serves as a convenient mail collection point for me. It costs approximately $250 per year for a small mailbox. This option works well for my situation as my frequent travels prevent me from receiving important mail at my residence. I possess a store key, allowing me to access my mailbox even outside of regular operating hours. The facility also accommodates larger packages, which are stored at the back. Upon receiving such packages, I receive a phone call notification. When it comes to shipping parcels, I prefer using FedEx due to their affordability and reliability. Additionally, my husband is satisfied with their printing services. Although I notice packaging materials and other stationary items available for purchase, I would rather rely on Canada Post for these needs. The staff at this location is excellent, displaying a cheery and helpful demeanor. They are familiar with me and my preferences. However, it is worth noting that the strip mall setting may be somewhat questionable, as neighboring storefronts tend to attract individuals involved in drug use or homelessness.

input: I just walked out of Heads and Tails and I can't  say enough about Jenne.  I was quite nervous to have a bikini wax and Jenne talked me though the whole process and it was not bad at all!  If you have sensitive skin and are looking for a clean place with an excellent staff - do not hesitate going here. Will be back!
Refine this for me please: I recently had a wonderful experience at Heads and Tails, and I specifically want to rave about Jenne. Despite my nerves about getting a bikini wax, Jenne guided me through the entire process and made it surprisingly comfortable. Her expertise and calming demeanor made a significant difference. I highly recommend this establishment for anyone with sensitive skin, as it is exceptionally clean and the staff is excellent. I will definitely be returning in the future!

input: Ordered some food at 11:47pm after not eating all day due to airline issues. I was starving. 2 and 1/2 hours later my food was delivered after I called twice looking for it.  When it arrived, there was no utensils or napkins.  I ate my salad with my fingers.  The food is good, the service is horrible.  Never again!
Refine this for me please: After enduring airline issues all day, I finally managed to order some food at 11:47pm as I had not eaten anything during the entire day. My hunger was insatiable. However, the delivery of my order was severely delayed by a whopping 2 and a half hours, despite my two persistent calls to locate it. To make matters worse, when it eventually arrived, it lacked essential utensils and napkins. Consequently, I resorted to eating my salad with my bare hands. While the quality of the food was satisfactory, the abysmal service overshadowed it completely. Needless to say, I will never subject myself to such an experience again.

input: Delicious and very nicely presented. We had J Sushi and Fire Roll and fantastic. Excellent service and great value.
Refine this for me please: The food at J Sushi was not only delicious but also beautifully presented. We thoroughly enjoyed the Fire Roll, it was fantastic. The service was excellent, and considering the quality of the food, the value was great.

input: My wife and I just moved to town and where saddened to have to move away from our local beloved Mexican restaurant.  We passed by this place several times knowing that once we moved in we would have to try it.  And OMG we where floored, the restaurant had great traditional ambiance and the service was top knotch.  They served glass bottle sodas which personally is something I love.  The food was amazing, my wife had the Taco Sombrero and I had the Chimichanga.  Both where amazing.  This place is 6 stars if I could give it.
Refine this for me please: My wife and I recently relocated to town and it was disheartening to leave our beloved local Mexican restaurant behind. However, as we drove past this new place numerous times, we eagerly anticipated trying it once we settled in. Our experience completely surpassed our expectations - we were absolutely blown away. The restaurant boasted a wonderful traditional ambiance, and the service was exceptional. We were delighted to see that they served glass bottle sodas, a personal favorite of mine. The food itself was simply incredible. My wife thoroughly enjoyed the Taco Sombrero, and I couldn't get enough of the Chimichanga. If I could, I would rate this place 6 stars without hesitation.

input:
As much as I adore food I am, typically, pretty easy when it comes to food and I forgive a lot. SO...one star means a lot! I haven't been as livid as I was leaving this fiasco of a restaurant in a long while. Reasons:  The server was on her cell phone from the minute we walked in to the minute we walked out (about 90 minutes). She literally had it on her shoulder the entire time except to say, "Please hold" to take our orders. She was also the chef and cooked while talking on her bloody phone, as well. Service:  FAIL.
My pork leg was tender and good which constitutes the lonely little star you see above. My husband ordered the shrimp, which cost $18.99. He received 7 shrimp that would be in a bag of 31-35 count...the size worthy of a salad shrimp. Again, $18.99...and the plantain portion of the meal consisted of 2 plantains the width of a postage stamp. Ridiculous. I then ordered tostones because I knew he would never be full with that quantity of food. I had to get up and find our server to add to my order as she was nowhere to be found.  They were also ridiculously thin, were over salted with an almost breaded and deep fried consistency. Food:  FAIL.
I was going to order a Cuban coffee but the server was so non-existent that I just gave up, finally.  In retrospect, I'm happy I didn't order it because I'm sure it would have been just wrong.
I would not frequent this restaurant again even if I had a free coupon. Don't waste your time or energy.
Refine this for me please:
As someone who loves food, I am usually quite forgiving and easy to please. However, this recent dining experience left me feeling extremely disappointed and outraged. Firstly, our server was constantly on her cell phone throughout our entire 90-minute visit. She had it glued to her shoulder, only occasionally putting it down to take our orders. To make matters worse, she was also the chef and cooked while talking on her phone. This level of service is simply unacceptable.

While my pork leg was satisfactory and enjoyable, it was the only redeeming aspect of our meal that earned this establishment a single star. On the other hand, my husband ordered the shrimp for $18.99 and received a measly portion of 7 shrimp, which resembled salad shrimp in size. Additionally, the portion of plantains included in his meal consisted of a mere 2 plantains, no bigger than a postage stamp. This level of skimpiness is absolutely ridiculous considering the price. 

To compensate for the lack of food, I decided to order tostones. However, our server was nowhere to be found, and I had to get up and search for her just to add to my order. To my disappointment, the tostones were incredibly thin, overly salted, and had a breaded and deep-fried consistency. The overall quality of the food was abysmal.

To top it all off, the service was so abysmal that I didn't even bother trying to order a Cuban coffee. In retrospect, I'm glad I didn't because I can't imagine it would have been any good.

Given the horrendous experience we had, I would never consider visiting this restaurant again, even if I had a free coupon. Save yourself the trouble and find somewhere else to dine.

input:
Excellent customer service. I wish I could rent from there more often! Had such a great experience verses other car rental services. 

Rent if you can!
Refine this for me please: Their customer service is truly excellent. I was extremely satisfied with my experience renting from there compared to other car rental services. I wish I could rent from them more frequently because of the great experience I had. I highly recommend renting from them if you have the opportunity.

input: Taking over in the spot of the original Benton Park  Cafe is Cafe Piazza.  The atmosphere is really nice and super ST. LOUIS.  The mural on the ceiling is a very eclectic work of art. Ask them how they did it and look under the bar. Great food. Different from your standard breakfast food.  Kinda fancy, but not intimidating.  I would highly recommend this restaurant for three reasons: decor, location, and good, creative food for the price.
Refine this for me please:
Taking over the former Benton Park Cafe location, Cafe Piazza offers a superb dining experience with its charming and quintessentially St. Louis atmosphere. Notably, the eclectic mural adorning the ceiling adds a unique touch to the ambiance. If you're curious about how this masterpiece was created, ask the staff and take a peek beneath the bar for an interesting insight. 

Moreover, Cafe Piazza's menu stands out with its delectable dishes, particularly during breakfast hours. While the cuisine leans towards the fancy side, it manages to avoid being overwhelming or intimidating. Consequently, this restaurant comes highly recommended for three compelling reasons: its stylish decor, convenient location, and exceptional value for the price – all enhanced by the restaurant's inventive and delightful culinary offerings.

input:
I am a groupie. He is amazing. I am sad that I got to have his dish only once. Now all construction on market I can't find him!!

His chicken is the most tender and smoky I've ever had. Side dishes are creative and awesome too. 
I hope he is back soon.
Refine this for me please:
I am an ardent admirer and frequent follower of his talent. He is truly remarkable. It saddens me that I have only had the privilege of tasting his incredible dish once. Now, with all the ongoing construction at the market, I am unable to locate him!

His chicken is an unparalleled delight, tender and infused with a mesmerizing smoky flavor. Moreover, his side dishes demonstrate an unparalleled creativity and are simply awesome. I anxiously await his return, hoping to have the honor of savoring his culinary creations once more.

input:
Enjoyed a company corporate holiday party with 2K+ people in the Tuscany Ballroom with an overnight stay in the Tuscan Tower.  By far the very best resort in the area delivering a cruise ship like first class experience.  I don't smoke and didn't notice the typical second hand casino smoke.    

Bonus was eating breakfast in the coffee shop with the Peppermill CEO/GM John Hanson pulling up a seat next to me at the counter engaging in friendly conversation about my stay while enjoying his breakfast.   Doesn't get much better than this folks.
Refine this for me please:
Had an amazing time at a company corporate holiday party in the Tuscany Ballroom, joined by over 2,000 people. The resort, particularly the Tuscan Tower, offered unparalleled luxury akin to a first-class cruise ship experience. What impressed me was the absence of the usual second-hand smoke in the casino area, which I greatly appreciated as a non-smoker.

To top it all off, I had the pleasure of having breakfast at the coffee shop, only to find the Peppermill CEO/GM John Hanson taking a seat beside me at the counter. He struck up a friendly conversation about my stay while enjoying his own meal. It truly doesn't get any better than this, folks.

input:
Wow.  I have to say incredible.  We've driven by the place several times and always had that "meh' attitude because of how the plaza looks.  Since the wife was craving some crispy duck it came up as having the best reviews for it.
  Walking in, was a great traditional indian/thai setting with a comfortable small raunt demeanor.  We tried the mussel appetizer, while the wife got the Tamarind Duck and I tried the Panang Curry with calamari.
  Service was prompt, quick and non invasive.  Mussels were tasty, but the Duck and Curry were to die for!  Portion sizes are definitely reflective of the prices so don't feel like you are going to get gyped.
  We will be back to at least try the sushi or get more duck seeing as they have at least 2 more styles of it.
  Happy tastebuds!
Refine this for me please:
I was blown away by this place. Despite driving by it multiple times and never being impressed by the plaza's appearance, I was pleasantly surprised by our experience. My wife had a craving for crispy duck, so we decided to give this restaurant a chance since it had the best reviews for it.

Walking in, we were greeted by a charming traditional Indian/Thai setting that exuded a cozy and comfortable atmosphere. We started with the mussel appetizer while my wife ordered the Tamarind Duck and I opted for the Panang Curry with calamari.

The service was exceptional - prompt, efficient, and unobtrusive. Although the mussels were tasty, the Duck and Curry stole the show! The flavors were absolutely divine. The portion sizes were fair and well worth the prices, so you won't feel cheated.

We will definitely be returning to either try their sushi or indulge in more of their delicious duck, as they offer at least two additional styles of it.

Our taste buds left happily satisfied!

input: Corropolese is a staples in these parts. If you're looking to get tomato pie, it's sacrilege to go anywhere else for it! Now I will admit, they do offer a variety of other items, but I couldn't tell you what they are. Whenever an event calls for a tomato pie, this is where my family goes. No one does it better!
Refine this for me please: Corropolese is an absolute staple in our area, particularly when it comes to tomato pie. It would be considered sacrilege to even consider going elsewhere for it! While they do have a diverse menu, I must confess that I am not well-versed in their other offerings. However, whenever there is an occasion that calls for a delicious tomato pie, my family's first choice is always Corropolese. They simply excel at it, and no one does it better!

input:
Went recently for a birthday party and it was certainly worth checking out.   Was my first time there and I was pleased for sure.  

Was nice and quiet as it was a Tuesday and the service was good because of that.  I'm sure it normally is though based on the size of the place.  

I had beef n lobster which both were cooked well and I was happy.  Also the mashed and asparagus that came with it were both very good.  

I wasn't to stoked with the appy we had which was these crab and cheese balls as they were very bland with little crab taste and no real seasoning it seemed.  Maybe just not for me but I wouldn't recommend those. 

Also had Creme Brule which was solid and is get it again for sure.  

Overall I'd say four due to a couple things like the appy and the shaky table, seriously so stupid to have that at a place that nice.  

But I'd gladly go again and would tell friends to try it.
Refine this for me please:
I recently went to a birthday party at a new restaurant and it definitely lived up to my expectations. It was my first time there and I was pleasantly surprised.

Since it was a Tuesday, the restaurant was nice and quiet, which made the service exceptional. I believe the service is typically great, given the size of the place.

I opted for the beef n lobster dish and both were cooked to perfection. I was thoroughly satisfied. Additionally, the mashed potatoes and asparagus that accompanied the dish were delicious.

However, I wasn't particularly impressed with the appetizer we ordered, which consisted of crab and cheese balls. They lacked flavor, had minimal crab taste, and seemed to lack seasoning. It might just be a personal preference, but I wouldn't recommend trying them.

On the other hand, the Creme Brule dessert was absolutely fantastic. It was solid and definitely something I would order again.

Overall, I would rate the restaurant a four out of five. The disappointing appetizer and the wobbly table, which seems out of place in such a nice establishment, were the only downsides. Nevertheless, I would happily return to the restaurant and recommend it to my friends.

input:
I don't give five star ratings very easily but my wife and I just had a fantastic experience. Debbie was our waitress and she was simply exceptional. Explained the menu and specials as well as answering all my questions. Food was very good, came out fast and hot. Prepared exactly how it was ordered. Will be back. 
Mac n cheese burger was dope fiend!  
Drinks were spot on as well. Whisky sour was great.
Refine this for me please:
I am extremely selective when it comes to giving five-star ratings, but my recent experience with my wife was absolutely outstanding. Our waitress, Debbie, went above and beyond to provide exceptional service. She took the time to explain the menu and specials, willingly answered all my inquiries, and demonstrated an impressive level of knowledge. The food surpassed our expectations - it was delicious, served promptly, and hot. Additionally, each dish was prepared exactly as ordered. We definitely plan on returning because our experience was truly memorable.

I must give a special shout-out to the Mac n cheese burger, which was absolutely incredible! It was a true delight for my taste buds. Even the drinks were top-notch. The whisky sour was particularly great.

input: Fun independent store for holiday gifts. Pleasant staff. Hooray.
Refine this for me please: Discover a delightful, whimsical independent store perfect for finding unique holiday gifts. Experience a cheerful atmosphere with friendly and helpful staff who are eager to assist. Spread some holiday cheer and make your shopping experience truly memorable. Hooray!

input:
Based this visit entirely upon previous Yelp reviews, which as usual we're spot on. Great atmosphere and feel to this place - Kind of an art house meets coffee house meets Animal House environment. Very unusual. In a good way. The service was relaxed, social and great. The beverages were delicious and the menu was quite interesting. 
I so wanted the food to be much better than it was. Tried the Bird and Pig, a specialty grilled cheese and a couple apps. Everything was good but not great. In truth, if I was judging on food alone, there would be three stars instead of four. But the atmosphere and the staff clearly deserved the extra star, and I'll head back to try some other items on the menu next visit.
Refine this for me please:
This visit was solely based on the positive Yelp reviews, which turned out to be accurate. The place had a great atmosphere, combining elements of an art house, coffee house, and Animal House, which made for a unique and enjoyable experience. The service was friendly and laid-back. The beverages were delicious, and the menu offered interesting options.

However, I was slightly disappointed with the food. Despite trying the Bird and Pig sandwich, a specialty grilled cheese, and a couple of appetizers, everything was just good, not outstanding. If I were solely judging based on the food, I would give three stars instead of four. Nevertheless, the exceptional atmosphere and staff warranted the extra star, and I plan on returning to sample other items from the menu during my next visit.

input: Joyce is awesome! Love that this does not hurt at all. We drive from palm harbor to her place, and it well worth the extra time. Her machine is high tech, and the horror stories my friends told me of their experience ,, makes me love this even more! Love it!
Refine this for me please: Joyce is absolutely amazing! I adore how painless this experience is. Despite the extra time it takes to drive from Palm Harbor to her place, it is completely worth it. Her cutting-edge machine elevates the entire process, and hearing the horror stories from my friends about their own experiences only further strengthens my adoration. I simply cannot get enough of it. Truly love it!

input: As an avid knitter, I try to find a local yarn store pretty much wherever I travel. I was delighted to discover that The Quarter Stitch was walking distance from my hotel AND they had a special Mardi Gras yarn in stock. I ended up visiting the store twice while I was in NOLA, once to grab the Mardi Gras yarn and a second time because their selection was just delectable. Added bonus, the staff was amazing and super helpful. I would definitely visit this store again.
Refine this for me please: As an enthusiastic knitter, I make it a point to seek out local yarn stores whenever I travel. To my sheer delight, The Quarter Stitch, located within walking distance of my hotel, not only had an exceptional selection of yarn but also a special Mardi Gras yarn in stock. During my stay in NOLA, I found myself visiting the store twice; once to get my hands on the unique Mardi Gras yarn and a second time due to their irresistibly delightful selection. On top of that, the staff at The Quarter Stitch were incredibly helpful and made my shopping experience even more enjoyable. Without a doubt, I will make it a priority to visit this store again in the future.

input: Great ice cream, absolutely terrible service. My son and I went in for ice cream on a Sunday afternoon, so maybe they have their worst staff working on a Sunday. We walked in and were ignored by both people behind the counter. The girl (who seemed drunk) was throwing screwed up napkins around and one of them flew over the counter and hit me. No big deal, but no apology, just more hysterically loud laughter and napkin throwing. The guy noticed my son eyeing the candy and yelled at him not to touch anything. I get it, no one wants sandy little hands in the candy. But he wasn't touching anything, so this was just rude. We stood at the counter and the girl begrudgingly served us, no smile, no greeting, she didn't even look at us. Perhaps she was annoyed we had interrupted her flirting. She ran my card and then turned her back to do some weird dance for her work mate while we stood and waited, more loud shouty laughter. I'm all about a great fun atmosphere and I know I sound like a bore. But when it comes hand-in-hand with a rude attitude towards paying customers, it crosses a line.
Refine this for me please:
Despite the great ice cream, the service at this establishment was incredibly disappointing. My son and I decided to get some ice cream on a Sunday afternoon, perhaps not anticipating that the staff on duty might be their least attentive. As soon as we walked in, both individuals behind the counter completely ignored us. To make matters worse, the girl working there seemed intoxicated, as she carelessly threw balled up napkins around. Unfortunately, one of them hit me, but instead of apologizing, she and her coworker burst into hysterical laughter. This lack of consideration was rather off-putting.

To add insult to injury, the male employee noticed my son glancing at the candy and angrily yelled at him to keep his hands away. While I understand the desire to keep the candy clean, my son wasn't even touching anything, so this interaction was simply rude. Despite the lack of hospitality we encountered, we patiently waited for our turn to be served. However, the girl reluctantly took our order without offering a smile, greeting, or even acknowledging our presence. It appeared as though we had inconvenienced her by interrupting her flirtatious behavior.

To make matters worse, after charging my card for the purchase, she turned her back on us and began performing some strange dance with her coworker while we stood there waiting. The volume of their obnoxious laughter filled the room. I appreciate a fun and lively atmosphere, but when it comes at the expense of treating paying customers with respect, it crosses a line.

In summary, while the ice cream at this establishment was enjoyable, the abysmal service we encountered tarnished the overall experience.

input: We visited this place because of its location on the wharf, and because my husband loves seafood. It's tiny, but we were there on a Tuesday evening, and only had to wait a few minutes. We ended up sitting at the bar; it would have been a longer wait for a table outside, since there are so few. Because of its size, it's a little noisy, but not bad. The service was very good. My husband had the crab sandwich, and wasn't impressed. It's served on very uninspiring white bread. I had the fried shrimp, and enjoyed it very much; it was not greasy or heavy, and the shrimp was moist and tasty. There is literally nothing but shellfish on the menu. So, the non-seafood enthusiast (me) was happily surprised to enjoy the shrimp so much (plus good onion rings), but the seafood enthusiast (my husband) didn't love the crab sandwich. If we tried this place again, he would order something else. The location is awesome, so if you like shellfish, definitely give this place a try.
Refine this for me please: We decided to visit this place primarily due to its prime location on the wharf and my husband's love for seafood. Despite its small size, we were fortunate to only wait a few minutes for a table, choosing to sit at the bar as outdoor seating was limited. Although the noise level was slightly high due to its size, it was still manageable. The service provided was excellent. However, my husband was not particularly impressed with his crab sandwich, which was disappointingly served on uninspiring white bread. On the other hand, I thoroughly enjoyed my fried shrimp, which had a pleasant texture and taste without being overly greasy or heavy. It was surprising for me, as a non-seafood enthusiast, to genuinely enjoy the shrimp, especially alongside the delicious onion rings. Conversely, my seafood enthusiast husband did not find the crab sandwich to his liking. If we were to revisit this place, he would opt for a different dish. Nevertheless, the location is undeniably fantastic, making it worth a visit for shellfish lovers.

input:
If I could give this place zero stars, I would. I had the worst experience when we went today for brunch that I've ever had in a restaurant since I moved to Tucson 7 years ago! First, before even going today, I called to find out what the brunch entailed and when Rosie answered the phone I told her that I had a few questions about brunch, she told me to hold and never came back to the phone. I stayed on hold for 8 minutes at which I called back and spoke to someone else who just seemed like "Oh Well." This brunch was organized by one of my friends, so choice in location was not something I had. We did have a reservation, but were pushed outside because apparently they only planned for one 8 person table and the other table got there a few moments before us and got to choose. The problem with this is that there were two people in our group that are allergic to bees, myself being one of them, and bees were flying all around our table, especially our food. At one point I had to get away from my seat and was not able to return to it for 5 minutes because the one been landed on my waffle and was not leaving. 

At this point my friend and I recognized the danger for the two of us and asked to be moved inside to which we were told "No." When I asked to speak with a manager, I was told "Well, what did you want?" That's when the manager came up, I explained the situation and he was going to put us at one table to which our waitress, gotten by the hostess came up and said to him "I already to her that they could not move in here." What employee talks like that to their boss! The waitress proceeded to run outside and tell the rest of the group that we were moving at which point they decided to stay outside, which was fine by my friend and I, but that meant having to be separated from our friends. This, to me, is deplorable behavior on the side of the the waitress and management. The waitress who was supposed to be our waitress inside as well, never arrived to the table and never checked up on us. Needless to say, I had to get another waiter and he was so appalled with the way that everything was handled he told my friend to not give him a tip. I was so appalled myself, that I did not eat because I just did not want to spend my hard earn money at this establishment any longer. I would never recommend this place to anyone even if they were starving!
Refine this for me please:
If I could give this place zero stars, I absolutely would. Today's brunch experience was by far the worst I've ever had in a restaurant since moving to Tucson 7 years ago. Before even going, I called to inquire about the brunch offerings and was put on hold by a person named Rosie, who never returned to the phone. After 8 minutes, I called back and spoke to someone else who seemed uncaring and dismissive. Despite not having a say in the location choice, as the brunch was organized by a friend, we arrived with a reservation only to be seated outside. Apparently, they had only prepared for one 8-person table and another group arrived just moments before us and took the table we were expecting. This became a major issue because two members of our group have bee allergies - myself included - and bees were swarming around our table, particularly around our food. At one point, a bee even landed on my waffle and refused to leave, causing me to vacate my seat for five minutes.

Realizing the danger we were in, my friend and I requested to be moved inside, but our request was denied. When I asked to speak with a manager, I was met with a disinterested attitude and dismissive response. Eventually, the manager did come over, but our supposed waitress, who was assigned by the hostess, rudely interjected and said that we were not allowed to move inside. It was shocking to witness an employee speak to their boss in such a disrespectful manner. The waitress then ran outside to inform the rest of our group about the situation, resulting in them deciding to stay outside. My friend and I accepted this, but it meant being separated from our friends. This behavior exhibited by both the waitress and management is absolutely deplorable.

To make matters worse, our designated waitress never appeared at our table nor checked in on us. I had to flag down another waiter who was visibly appalled by how everything was being handled. In fact, he even advised my friend not to tip him given the unacceptable service. I was so disgusted by the entire ordeal that I chose not to eat, as I did not want to spend my hard-earned money at this establishment any longer. I genuinely cannot recommend this place to anyone, even if they were desperately hungry.

input: I like this place.  Unique sandwiches, and it's definitely the best place to go if you want a healthy option or have vegan friends.
Refine this for me please: This place is fantastic! They offer a wide variety of unique sandwiches that you won't find anywhere else. Whether you're looking for a healthy option or catering to your vegan friends, this is definitely the best place to go.

input:
Tried the Brew Bros. Burger challenge as a dare from friends. What are friends for? Though I came close to finishing all 4lbs of burgers, fries, and fixings, I fell short on time. Our server was kind enough to issue me a shirt for attempting and "coming the closest to finishing." Whatever that meant. The food was good, staff was great, and the challenge left me with a stomach ache for 3-days. 

I did not get a chance to sample their beer selections but from what my friends said, it's good. I would not recommend the burger challenge if you're going to drink beer. Otherwise for $24, it's by far the best deal on the menu; especially if you split with friends! (splitting the meal violates the rules of the competition)

If I'm ever in the Reno area again, I will be back to conquer that elusive challenge!
Refine this for me please:
I accepted the dare from my friends to take on the Brew Bros. Burger challenge. After coming close to devouring the 4lbs of burgers, fries, and toppings, I unfortunately ran out of time. Luckily, our server was kind enough to reward me with a shirt for my valiant effort, even though I wasn't exactly sure what "coming the closest to finishing" meant. Despite ending with a stomach ache that lasted for three days, I have to admit that the food was delicious and the staff was exceptional.

Although I didn't have a chance to indulge in their beer selections, my friends assured me that they were top-notch. However, I would advise against attempting the burger challenge if you plan on enjoying some of their beer. Nevertheless, at just $24, it's without a doubt the best value on their menu, especially if you share it with friends (although technically against the competition rules).

If I ever find myself in the Reno area again, I am determined to return and conquer that elusive challenge!

input: Great Breakfast and service. Sunny side skillet (under $8) with a pancake was delicious! Atmosphere and store selections well above all other locations.
Refine this for me please: The breakfast and service were exceptional. I thoroughly enjoyed the delightful Sunny Side Skillet, which was surprisingly affordable at under $8. The addition of a pancake further enhanced my dining experience. The atmosphere of the establishment was remarkable, surpassing all other locations in terms of ambiance and store selections.

input: Good and fast service....meat is always very juice ....BBQ sauce is great...prices are reasonable...if you this truck around stop and try you won't be disappointed
Refine this for me please: I highly recommend this food truck for its exceptional service and speedy delivery. The meat served here is consistently juicy, and the BBQ sauce is absolutely fantastic. Additionally, the prices are reasonable, making it a great value for your money. If you come across this truck, make sure to stop and give it a try. You won't be disappointed.

input:
I really wanted to like this place and heard about it during lent when I had given up meat. I found myself in the area again and decided to give it a try. I usually don't write reviews until I've been to a place a few times but I think my experience was a complete one. I ordered the special and sampled each type of chicken, the modern BBQ sauce, mac&cheese (which the woman behind the counter was very proud of), 
a bananas foster pie, and the new hope birch beer. After finishing everything, I just wanted my $16.20 back. Individual reviews: 

The chicken: It was very average and that is being generous. It wasn't incredibly flavorful but it wasn't dry so it could have been worse. 

The sauce: It had the tang of a traditional North Carolina BBQ sauce, mustard and vinegar based. I can't eat mayo so I was limited with sauce choices but the mayo sauces were recommended. 

The mac&cheese: Salty and mediocre. It combines all of the things I like but makes a mess doing it. The pasta was well cooked but the cheese and bacon combo made it taste like I just licked salt off of my hand without the nice shot of tequila after. 

The bananas foster pie: The crust of the pie needs no improvement but the filling could use an overhaul. I use the term filling loosely because after biting into the flakey crust, I struggled to find the bananas. There was a thin layer of smashed bananas and cinnamon sugar at the bottom and 75% of the interior was empty space. 

The new hope soda: The birch beer (the actual name of the soda escapes me at the moment but it is birch beer) was the highlight of my meal. Everything you would expect from a Pennsylvania birch beer and very refreshing, which surprised me because I normally don't like fountain sodas and prefer root beer.

I gave this place 2 stars instead of 1 because nothing was horrible.  I think the concept works, the decor is nice, and the menu is good but they need to work on the quality of their food because it currently doesn't match the cost.
Refine this for me please:
I was really eager to like this place as I had heard about it during lent when I was abstaining from meat. Finding myself in the area again, I decided to give it a shot. While I typically wait to write reviews until I have been to a place multiple times, I feel that my experience was comprehensive enough to share. I opted for the special and indulged in the different types of chicken, along with the modern BBQ sauce, mac and cheese (which the woman behind the counter highly recommended), a bananas foster pie, and the new hope birch beer. Unfortunately, after finishing everything, I couldn't help but feel disappointed and wished I could get my $16.20 back. Here are my individual reviews:

The chicken: It was quite average, even being generous. While it wasn't overly dry, it lacked the remarkable flavor that I had hoped for.

The sauce: Tasting like a traditional tangy North Carolina BBQ sauce with a mustard and vinegar base, I was limited in my choices due to my aversion to mayo. However, the mayo sauces were suggested by the staff.

The mac and cheese: It was a salty and mediocre rendition. Although it incorporated all the elements I typically enjoy, it somehow fell short and made quite a mess in the process. The pasta was well cooked, but the combination of cheese and bacon gave it an excessive saltiness without the desired taste akin to taking a shot of tequila.

The bananas foster pie: The crust was outstanding, but the filling left much to be desired. After biting into the flaky crust, I struggled to find substantial amounts of bananas. The filling consisted mainly of a thin layer of mashed bananas and cinnamon sugar at the bottom, with about 75% of the interior being empty space.

The new hope soda: The birch beer (unfortunately, I cannot recall its specific name at the moment) was the highlight of my meal. It delivered everything I expected from a Pennsylvania birch beer, offering a refreshing taste that surprised me since I generally prefer root beer over fountain sodas.

Although I have given this place 2 stars instead of 1 because nothing was outright terrible, there is room for improvement. The concept itself is promising, the decor is pleasing, and the menu is decent. However, the restaurant needs to focus on enhancing the quality of their food as it doesn't currently justify the cost.

input:
The service is going to be slooooww. And the food okay. Do not come here if you are with a group more than 4 if you have to be anywhere because it will be slow. 

I came with a group and we were the only ones around and the service was still a mess. There were multiple servers around who watched one server struggle. I felt bad for her. She was making drinks, serving, and running food.
Refine this for me please:
The service at this place is incredibly slow, so I would not recommend coming here if you're in a hurry or need to be somewhere. The food is just okay. Additionally, if you're with a group larger than 4 people, you might want to reconsider dining here due to the sluggish service.

During my last visit with a group, we were the only customers present, yet the service was still chaotic. There were multiple servers, but it was evident that one server was overwhelmed and struggling to handle everything. It was quite unfortunate to witness her juggling tasks such as making drinks, serving, and bringing out food.

input: Expensive but great service & food. The ribeye melted in my mouth. The burger was huge & delicious w/ every bite. The bread pudding is everything it's hyped up to be. Definitely go at least once & share some meals w/ friends.
Refine this for me please: The restaurant offers a high-end dining experience with exceptional service and incredible cuisine. The ribeye steak was exceptionally tender and practically melted in my mouth. The burger was not only enormous but also incredibly delicious with each bite. Don't even get me started on the bread pudding – it truly lived up to its hype. I highly recommend visiting this place at least once and taking the opportunity to share some meals with friends.

input: Excellent menu with locally sourced food that constantly changes. A delight for your taste buds. Reservations can be hard to get, so plan in advance.
Refine this for me please: Indulge in an exceptional menu featuring constantly changing, locally sourced dishes that will undoubtedly delight your taste buds. However, securing a reservation may prove challenging, so we highly recommend planning ahead to guarantee your dining experience.

input:
Spot on!

I got "the veg" and the spicy fries.  "The veg" is a portabella burger, with grilled mozzarella, picked veg, arugula, and gauc.  Wholly non-cow is this thing spectacular for a bella burger!  The bella is on bottom, then the mozzarella is directly fused on top of that.  I actually thought the cheese was halloumi at first because it wasn't super melted (a good thing). The gauc and pickled veg are slightly citrusy and vinegary, but are contrasted by the bitterness of the arugula.  There's a nice bun to contents ratio, and for bonus points it's a potato bun.

Wasn't sure what to expect with the spicy fries going in - are they hot sauce fries, etc?  Turns out they are of the crab-fries variety with some subtle other spices added in.  Nice portion - not too big.

The atmosphere kind of reminds me of a dive bar - I think that's the best way to describe it.  It's pretty small, so I wouldn't choose to ever eat in most likely.
Refine this for me please:
I tried "the veg" and the spicy fries at the restaurant. "The veg" is a delicious portabella burger with grilled mozzarella, pickled vegetables, arugula, and guacamole. The burger is exceptionally good and is topped with mozzarella that's slightly melted, reminiscent of halloumi cheese. The guacamole and pickled vegetables add a citrusy and vinegary flavor, complemented by the bitterness of the arugula. The burger-to-bun ratio is just right, and the potato bun is a bonus. 

As for the spicy fries, I wasn't sure what to expect initially. However, they turned out to be similar to crab fries, with a hint of other spices. The portion size was satisfying without being too large.

The atmosphere of the restaurant reminds me of a dive bar, and it's rather small. Considering the limited space, I personally wouldn't choose to dine in.

input:
Being a vegetarian while visiting New Orleans is no easy feat.  However, when I have found eats, they are usually very good.  Tomasito's was below the standard I have gotten used to.  Not to say it was bad, not at all.  I had the chips and a bean and cheese burrito. I would have gotten rice in my burrito but it was not vegetarian (really?).  Service was ok, and the flan was excellent (although "with berries" seems to mean one raspberry).
That being said, at least there was food to eat on the menu, and that is not assumes in New Orleans.
Refine this for me please: Being a vegetarian while visiting New Orleans can be challenging, but I have managed to find some delicious options. Unfortunately, Tomasito's fell below the high standard I have come to expect. It wasn't necessarily bad, but it didn't meet my expectations. I opted for chips and a bean and cheese burrito, but was disappointed to learn that the rice wasn't vegetarian (which surprised me). The service was average, but the flan was outstanding (although the description of "with berries" turned out to be just one raspberry). At least the menu offered some food choices for vegetarians, which cannot be assumed in New Orleans.

input: Best Mexican restaurant I've been to in a long time food was great drinks were great and prices are reasonable
Refine this for me please: I recently had the pleasure of visiting an exceptional Mexican restaurant that exceeded my expectations. The food they offered was truly outstanding, leaving a lasting impression on my taste buds. Alongside their delectable cuisine, their drink selections were equally remarkable, perfectly complementing the flavorful dishes. What made the experience even more enjoyable was the reasonable pricing, ensuring that I received exceptional value for my money. Overall, this restaurant stood out as the best Mexican dining experience I've had in quite some time.

input: Really loud live music...but a much more subdued bar on the second floor where you can actually hold a conversation.
Refine this for me please: Experience the best of both worlds with our vibrant live music venue on the first floor, where the energy is electrifying. Step up to the second floor for a more intimate and relaxed atmosphere in our inviting bar, specially designed for engaging conversations without being overwhelmed by loud music.

input: Steve our Roto-Rooter tech saved us!! Thanks to Steve! We just moved into a new house and had sewer back-up a week later. It was coming out into the yard and not pretty. We are running free now and hopefully won't need to call back any time soon. If we do we will certainly call Roto- rooter again!!!
Refine this for me please: We are incredibly grateful to Steve, our Roto-Rooter technician, who came to our rescue in a time of need! After recently moving into our new house, we encountered a distressing sewer backup issue just a week later. The sight of sewage spilling into our yard was far from pleasant. However, thanks to Steve's expertise and prompt assistance, our problem has been completely resolved. We now have peace of mind and hope that we won't have to face any similar situation in the near future. Nevertheless, if further issues arise, we will undoubtedly reach out to Roto-Rooter once again, as they have proven to be reliable and trustworthy.

input:
All I needed was a written estimate.  A rather simple task one would think.  I needed my factory navigation unit in my Denali replaced, and needed to know costs and in writing.  Now this is a normal standard procedure for an auto repair shop.  Let's just assume its bad (it is), so tell me how much it is to remove bad part, and put the new one in.

Jay Fatimo or something like that, said he was very busy, as were the other service writers, so he handed me his card, and said to just email him with what I needed.  Sounded like a good plan, I wasn't in a big rush.  So I did just that, sent a picture of my vin, and the appropriate RPO codes to know what part I needed, and emailed it all to him.  I never got a response.  I tried again about a week or so later, still nothing.  Made sure it is his email at the dealership, etc.  

I guess I have a hard time with taking my car in or trusting a place to do such repairs (3000 dollar job according to Winkel GMC) if they can't even respond to an email.  He knew I would email that day, and I did.  

I guess the GMC dealer right next door gets my money instead.
Refine this for me please:
I only needed a written estimate for a simple task - replacing the factory navigation unit in my Denali. It's a standard procedure for auto repair shops to provide cost estimates in writing, right? I approached Jay Fatimo, who seemed quite busy along with other service writers. He gave me his card and suggested I email him my requirements, which I thought was a good idea since I wasn't in a hurry.

So, I promptly emailed Jay with a picture of my vehicle identification number (VIN) and the necessary RPO codes to identify the required part. Sadly, I never received a response from him. I even tried following up after a week, but still no reply. I ensured that I had the correct email address for him at the dealership and everything.

It's frustrating to consider entrusting my car to a repair shop (Winkel GMC) that couldn't even bother responding to a simple email. Especially when they estimated the job at $3000. Jay was well aware that I would be emailing him on that specific day, and yet, he failed to acknowledge my request.

Given the situation, I have decided to take my business to the GMC dealer next door.

input:
I've been a fan of this place for a long time! Their hazelnut cake is awesome, as are many of their other cakes. I was 'sent' there years ago by recommendation for this signature cake and it more than lived up to it's reputation.

Their butter cookies are awesome -  absolutely love them. I frequently stop in to get cookie gifts to give to family and friends for special occasions - always a huge hit!

I think their prices are right in line with their products. They are always consistently great.

The people that work there are wonderful - friendly and helpful!
Refine this for me please:
I have been a devoted fan of this place for an extended period of time! Their hazelnut cake is truly exceptional, and their other cake varieties are equally delightful. Years ago, I was recommended to try their signature cake, and it exceeded all expectations.

The butter cookies they offer are divine - I cannot emphasize enough how much I adore them. I frequently visit to purchase cookie gifts for special occasions, which are always very well-received by my family and friends.

In terms of pricing, I find them to be perfectly fair and in line with the quality of their products. They consistently deliver a superior experience.

I must also mention the outstanding staff members who work there - their friendliness and helpfulness truly enhance the overall experience.

input:
First time for lunch.  Extensive and flavorful gluten free menu.  

Good lunch and friendly service.
Refine this for me please: First Time Experience: Enjoy a Delightful Lunch with an Extensive and Flavorful Gluten-Free Menu, accompanied by exceptional service

input:
Service here was excellent. They hosted us for an event and were awesome. 

However, I felt that is where the awesome stopped. The food I had (brisket) was mediocre at best, maybe it had been sitting under lamps all day? The bread it was served on was tough. The mac and cheese was pretty good. My glassware for beer was dirty, chilled, and they were out of everything on draft.
Refine this for me please:
The service at this establishment was truly exceptional. We were hosted for a special event and the staff went above and beyond to ensure our satisfaction. 

Unfortunately, I cannot say the same about the food. The brisket I ordered was mediocre at best, leading me to suspect that it may have been left under heat lamps for an extended period. Additionally, the bread it was served on was disappointingly tough. On a positive note, the mac and cheese offered a pleasurable dining experience. 

However, my disappointment continued when I noticed that the beer glassware provided was dirty and improperly chilled. To make matters worse, their draft selection had run out, leaving me with limited beverage options.

input:
This tour is one to take when you want to have a lazy day, but you want to do a passive activity.  Me & my friends didn't wan the lunch, we just wanted to take a tour of the Mississippi.  The cost was average - around $28.00.  Con:  Remember it is a tour, so they have the typical tourist traps - photographer - me and friends declined that option.  

I would suggest if you aren't going to eat - to pull out your smartphone and research the Natchez Native American Tribe who inhibited the area prior to the colonization of the New Orleans area - interesting "tid bits of rituals", so that made the boat ride more fun because I became the secondary tour leader to my group.  If you are in the mood-go get a drink and this will comfort you as you learn more about the area on a steamboat.  Not a bad way to spend a few hours.
Refine this for me please:
This tour is perfect for a leisurely day of exploring, with a focus on passive activities. My friends and I opted out of the lunch option and instead chose to simply take a tour of the Mississippi. The cost was reasonable, around $28. However, it is important to note that it is still a touristy experience, complete with typical tourist traps like a photographer, which my friends and I declined.

If you decide to skip the lunch, I recommend taking out your smartphone and researching the Natchez Native American Tribe who lived in the area before New Orleans was colonized. We discovered interesting facts and rituals about them, which made the boat ride even more enjoyable as I became the unofficial tour guide for my group. If you're in the mood, grab a drink and relax as you soak in more information about the area on the steamboat. Overall, it's a great way to spend a few hours.

input: Just visited The Fat Ham with my girlfriend about an hour ago. The place is small, but the vibe is nice. Music isn't too loud, the staff welcomed us and the whiskey display is impressive. We couldn't get a table, so we took the two empty seats at the bar. The bartender, Dan, greeted us immediately. Dan was effecient, quick and friendly. Great service. My girlfriend ordered a margarita, which was reasonably priced and tasty. To eat, we ordered the pimento cheese, skillet cornbread, shrimp & grits and the hot chicken. Everything was delicious. The pimento cheese had some heat, and the country bread it is served with gives it a nice touch of salt. The mollases butter on the cornbread was "to die for". The shrimp & grits was my favorite dish. Creamy grits, perfectly cooked and seasoned shrimp. As for the chicken, they do not lie to you. It is hot. The brioche and ranch dressing compliment it well. For desert, we ordered the raspberry cobbler and a coffee. The cobbler was underwhelming. It wasn't bad - just not as great as the previous plates. Elixr coffee was spot on. Overall, I'll be back. Decent price point, high end comfort food and great service.
Refine this for me please:
I recently visited The Fat Ham with my girlfriend and had a great experience. Despite its small size, the atmosphere was enjoyable with pleasant music at a reasonable volume. Upon arrival, the staff warmly greeted us and we were impressed by their impressive whiskey display. Unfortunately, there were no available tables, so we opted for two empty seats at the bar. Luckily, the bartender, Dan, promptly welcomed us and provided efficient and friendly service. My girlfriend ordered a delicious and reasonably priced margarita. 

As for the food, we ordered a variety of items including pimento cheese, skillet cornbread, shrimp & grits, and the hot chicken. Each dish was incredibly tasty. The pimento cheese had a nice touch of heat, complemented by the savory country bread it was served with. The molasses butter on the cornbread was exceptionally delightful. My personal favorite was the shrimp & grits, which featured creamy and well-seasoned grits paired with perfectly cooked shrimp. As advertised, the hot chicken lived up to its spicy reputation and paired excellently with the brioche and ranch dressing. 

For dessert, we tried the raspberry cobbler and enjoyed a cup of Elixir coffee. Unfortunately, the cobbler was underwhelming compared to the exceptional main courses. It wasn't bad, but it didn't reach the same level of greatness. On the other hand, the Elixir coffee was spot on and satisfying. Overall, I am definitely planning on returning to The Fat Ham. The price point is reasonable, the menu offers high-end comfort food, and the service provided by Dan and the rest of the staff was excellent.

input: When this place first opened we went. We loved the Greek salad and gyros. It was very fresh tasting and the place was cute. We went back last night- the tables were all dirty, lamps full of dirt and dead bugs- so that was a turn off. We got our food and the quality has gone way down. My salad had one bite of potato salad and two items in the salad - tomato and pepper tasted off. I had to spit them out. My daughter got a fajita bowl with chicken. Her tomato was also gross and the chicken was cooked into charred rubber. We ordered baklava and it was stale. I hope they clean and go back to the quality it was when they first opened. It was yummy and clean.
Refine this for me please: When we first discovered this place, we were immediately drawn in by its charming atmosphere and delicious Greek salad and gyros. Everything tasted incredibly fresh, and we couldn't get enough. However, our recent visit left much to be desired. The tables were noticeably dirty, with lamps covered in dirt and dead bugs, which was quite off-putting. The decline in quality was evident when our food arrived. My salad only had a small bite of potato salad and two items - tomato and pepper - that tasted strange and unpleasant. I had no choice but to spit them out. My daughter ordered a fajita bowl with chicken, and she encountered a similar disappointment. The tomato was also unappetizing, and the chicken was overcooked to the point of resembling charred rubber. To top it all off, we decided to try their baklava, only to be met with disappointment once again. It was stale and far from the delightful treat we had expected. Our hope is that the management takes immediate action to address these issues, ensuring a return to the delicious and clean experience we initially fell in love with.

input: So I hear whispers of a reemergence of brunch I truly believe this is the best brunch spot in New Orleans.  And they only do it once a year. Great local favors. Great service Their so called biscuits and debris should be called the "life changing flavorgasm" at that moment when you realize simplicity and perfection collide; dazed and confused you will awaken your senses at Carrollton market. The oyster good enough French omelet is everything I wanted in life and more. Thank you @Carrolltonmarket I am speechless. And that does not happen often
Refine this for me please:
I've heard rumors of a resurgence in brunch, and I must say, I believe I have found the ultimate brunch spot in New Orleans. This hidden gem only opens its doors once a year, offering a unique and delightful local dining experience. The service is impeccable, and the flavors truly leave a lasting impression.

One dish in particular, the "biscuits and debris," is deserving of a profound name like "life changing flavorgasm." It's a mind-blowing combination of simplicity and perfection that will leave you in awe. Carrollton Market has truly mastered the art of awakening your senses, leaving you dazed and confused in the most delicious way possible.

Another dish that surpassed all expectations was the oyster-filled French omelet. It fulfilled every desire I had in life and left me wanting more. I am at a loss for words, which is a rarity for me, but I must express my gratitude to @Carrolltonmarket for this incredible culinary experience.

input: Great beer selection. Service at the bar was a little slow.
Refine this for me please: Excellent variety of beer options available. However, the service at the bar was slightly lacking in terms of speed.

input: Great food... Love the Fish tacos & Nachos are great  it's really a nice atmosphere for family settings and night or dates too.. Music beach bar, home made ice cream  & a little play ground - it's great
Refine this for me please: This place is amazing for delicious food. I highly recommend trying their Fish tacos – they are absolutely phenomenal! The Nachos are also great and definitely worth ordering. Not only is the food excellent, but the atmosphere is perfect for family settings as well as romantic nights or dates. They have a music beach bar that adds to the overall ambiance, and their homemade ice cream is a must-try. Additionally, they have a small playground for children, making it a great spot for families.

input:
O! Wings has the best wings!! Hot momma and the original for the win!! Oh! And the bulgogi wrap. My dad, who's very picky, even praised the wings and wrap! 

Their service and attitude is very very friendly and accommodating. 

I phoned in a to go order originally for 6 people. Later half an hour before the pick up time, I added 10 more entrees. They were very very accommodating and had me ready to go and out the door in 15 minutes! 

Yumm! Can't wait to go back for more!
Refine this for me please:
O! Wings is the ultimate destination for mouthwatering wings! Their Hot Momma and Original flavors are a definite winner! I highly recommend trying their Bulgogi wrap as well. Even my picky dad couldn't stop praising the wings and wrap!

Not only is the food exceptional, but the service and attitude of the staff are also top-notch. The staff members are incredibly friendly and accommodating.

I initially called in a to-go order for 6 people, but half an hour before the pick-up time, I decided to add 10 more entrees. Despite the last-minute changes, they were extremely accommodating and had my order ready in just 15 minutes!

I cannot express how delighted I am with their food and service. I am already counting down the days until I can visit O! Wings again for more deliciousness!

input: Wow!  I just wrote a scathing review about El Patron Pizza in Tampa for leaving unwanted and unwelcome fliers under the door of unsuspecting tourist here in Tampa.  I was going to use a lot of the same issues for this review of New York Pizza Grill, but now I'm not sure what to say, only to say it carefully.  I knew there was something not quite right about the greasy looking punk that was meandering in the hallway of the 4 star hotel where I am currently residing.  As soon as I saw the flier I grabbed my room key and went looking for this person.  In hindsight that was not smart, as soon as I got a look at the guy, I ran for the elevator.  Now, I am no shrinking violet, but this guy looked like he's slap his own mother.  After reading the other reviews on here, I guess I should be happy that this employee didn't turn around and attack! Wow! I recently had an unpleasant experience with El Patron Pizza in Tampa, as they left unwanted and unwelcome fliers under the door of unsuspecting tourists. I was considering highlighting similar issues in my review of New York Pizza Grill, but now I am unsure about how to proceed, except to approach the matter cautiously.

I had a gut feeling that something was off when I noticed a greasy-looking individual wandering the hallway of the four-star hotel where I am currently staying. As soon as I discovered the flier, I hastily grabbed my room key and went in search of this person. In hindsight, my actions were not wise, as the person appeared intimidating enough for me to quickly retreat to the elevator. While I consider myself brave, this individual seemed capable of anything. After reading other reviews, I am relieved that this employee did not respond aggressively.

My main complaint with this establishment is their habit of littering the halls and rooms with these fliers. They sneak into hotels, which are supposed to be safe havens, causing me to question my sense of security. It is disheartening to see this practice in both high-end hotel chains and family-operated businesses alike. Feeling uncomfortable about addressing this matter with the hotel staff, I decided to call every pizza place responsible for such actions. However, after my encounter with the unprofessional individual from New York Pizza Grill, I reached my breaking point.

I expressed my concerns to the management and they promptly contacted the police. I want to caution the employee of New York Pizza Grill that if they are caught distributing fliers where they are not welcome or authorized, they could face arrest. Hence, I urge them to consider if their employer will bail them out of jail when engaging in such behavior.
