While there are numerous reasons why I would discourage dining at New York Pizza Grill, I am emphasizing one compelling motive for prospective employees to reconsider working for them.

input:
This was our first time here. I had a coupon so I thought I would try it out. Pulling into the parking lot I noticed it was very busy. I was worried that I would have to wait a long time. I pulled up to the attendant and asked how long it would be for a reg wash. She said each wash takes about 15 minutes. I was surprised since they were busy. I left the car there and proceeded inside. 

The building is huge inside. One side is all windows so you can watch your vehicle move through. They even have a "soap gun" the kids can use to shoot their car. That was a huge hit. 

The cashier greeted me as I walked up to the counter. She took my coupon and handed me a receipt. I walked around while I was waiting. They have drinks she snacks for purchase. They sell lots of greeting cards for every occasion. They have gifts and accessories for your car. The building was cool inside which was great because it was hot the day we came in. I waited about 10 minutes and walked outside. They have a large covered area to wait under. It has some seating so you can sit and wait. After just a few minutes they yelled out my car make to say it was done. I handed the attendant my receipt and tip and I was on my way. Total time was 18 minutes which I think is fair considering they were packed when I arrived. 

The car was clean and vacuumed. Overall they did a great job. The only thing they missed was the front window. It had that haze on it that you notice when the sun hits its. I wiped it off myself. I'm sure they would have fixed it if I noticed before I left. Also, they don't offer free air freshener with the wash like most other places. 

This place was fast and they did a great job. The price was fair and the staff was friendly. I will be coming back soon.
Refine this for me please:
This was our first time visiting this establishment. I had a coupon, so I decided to give it a try. As I pulled into the parking lot, I immediately noticed that it was quite busy, causing some concerns about potential waiting times. However, upon approaching the attendant, I inquired about the duration of a regular car wash. Surprisingly, she informed me that each wash typically takes around 15 minutes, despite the high volume of customers. With this information in mind, I entrusted my car to them and proceeded inside.

Upon entering the building, I was struck by its size. One side consisted entirely of windows, allowing customers to observe their vehicles moving through the cleaning process. Additionally, there was an interactive feature for kids called the "soap gun," which proved to be a major hit. 

As I approached the counter, the cashier warmly greeted me and collected my coupon, providing me with a receipt in return. While waiting for my car, I explored the facility, where I discovered a range of refreshments and snacks available for purchase. They also offered an extensive assortment of greeting cards for various occasions, as well as car-related gifts and accessories. The building's pleasant coolness provided respite from the heat outside, which was greatly appreciated. After approximately 10 minutes, I headed outside to the large covered waiting area, equipped with seating options. Within just a few minutes of settling in, they called out my car's make to signal its completion. I handed the attendant my receipt and tip, and I departed. The entire process took a total of 18 minutes, which I find to be reasonable considering the busy state of the establishment when I arrived.

Upon receiving my car, I was pleased to find that it had been thoroughly cleaned and vacuumed. Overall, they did an excellent job. The only oversight was the front window, which had a hazy residue that becomes more apparent when the sunlight hits it. I took care of it myself by wiping it off, and I believe they would have rectified the issue if I had brought it to their attention before leaving. It's also worth noting that they do not provide complimentary air fresheners with the wash, contrary to what most other places offer.

In conclusion, this establishment provided fast and efficient service, meeting my expectations. The pricing was fair, and the staff exhibited a friendly demeanor throughout. I intend to return in the near future.

input: My go to place in IN when visiting family!  David does the most amazing pink and whites!  The shop is clean and the staff are professional and courteous.  The new management is outstanding (well three years ago but new to me).
Refine this for me please: When visiting family in Indiana, my absolute favorite place to go is David's. They specialize in creating the most stunning pink and white nails that I have ever seen! Not only is the shop immaculately clean, but the staff is also incredibly professional and courteous. Although the management changed three years ago, they are still relatively new to me, and their outstanding service and expertise are truly commendable.

input:
Ordered curried chicken, teriyaki, and some eggrolls with soup...I never got that order

This was my first and last time ordering food from here. Delivery was quick, I'll give them that, but the order was wrong. When I called in they said I can have a free meal on them for the mistake.

I said, okay "I want that free meal now" (they also offer free delivery for orders over 12.00$) my food came out to 14.87$, 18.87$ with tip.


They refused multiple times (like it'll make a difference if they bring it now or tomorrow, either way it was a lie to get me off the phone). I informed her that if she didn't send her delivery guy back I'll dispute the amount paid to them with my bank, and they'll lose a new customer. 

Normally if one thing in my order was wrong I wouldn't mind at all. It's because my entire order was Wong...
Refine this for me please:
I had ordered curried chicken, teriyaki, and some eggrolls with soup from this restaurant, but unfortunately, my order never arrived. It was my first time ordering from them, and needless to say, it will also be my last. While I appreciate that the delivery was fast, the fact that my order was completely incorrect was frustrating. I called the restaurant to inform them about the mistake and they offered to give me a free meal as compensation.

Expecting the free meal immediately, I asked for it right away. (They also advertised free delivery for orders over $12.) However, when my food finally arrived, the total came out to be $14.87, adding an additional $4 for tip, making it $18.87 in total. 

To my disappointment, the restaurant refused to provide me with the free meal despite their promise. I tried explaining that it wouldn't make a difference if they brought it now or tomorrow, as it seemed like they were using that as an excuse to get me off the phone. Frustrated, I informed the representative that if they didn't send their delivery driver back with the correct order, I would dispute the amount paid to them through my bank. I also made it clear that their refusal would result in them losing a potential new customer.

Normally, I wouldn't mind if only one item in my order was incorrect. However, the fact that my entire order was incorrect left me extremely dissatisfied.

input:
A perfect afternoon in the gulch for me would consist of a shopping spree at Blush, a beer at Hops and Crafts and lunch at Turnip Truck.

I mean sure it's an interesting grocery store, but have you tried their ever rotating hot buffet or their made to order sandwiches? 
Tasty!! Or how about some of their all natural beauty products and lip balms? Score!!

You could spend half a day perusing aisle upon aisle of organic fair. This place makes Whole Foods look like Walmart. 

My only complaint: I just wish they would bring back a rewards program of some sort. Guess it was fun while it lasted. 

My usual lunch order; chipotle chicken salad wrap on whole wheat with chipotle mayo.
Refine this for me please:
A perfect afternoon in the gulch for me would consist of a fun-filled shopping spree at the trendy boutique Blush. After picking out some stylish new additions to my wardrobe, I would head over to the cozy yet vibrant Hops and Crafts for a refreshing beer. The lively atmosphere and wide selection of brews always guarantee a great time.

But let's not forget about the culinary delights at Turnip Truck. This unique grocery store offers more than just your typical shopping experience. Their ever-rotating hot buffet and made-to-order sandwiches are simply mouthwatering. And if you're in the mood for some self-care, they also have a range of all-natural beauty products and lip balms to satisfy every beauty aficionado.

With aisles upon aisles of organic fair, this place puts Whole Foods to shame. The variety and quality of their products make it a haven for anyone seeking fresh and sustainable options. The only downside is the absence of a rewards program, which used to add a fun element to the shopping experience.

When it comes to lunch, my go-to order is their chipotle chicken salad wrap on whole wheat with a delicious spread of chipotle mayo. The combination of flavors and textures is simply irresistible.

So, if you're looking for an ideal afternoon in the gulch, join me for an indulgent shopping spree at Blush, followed by a relaxing beer at Hops and Crafts, and capped off with a scrumptious lunch at Turnip Truck. Trust me, it's a recipe for a memorable and enjoyable day.

input: Great happy hour.  And brunch.  Only had dinner there once and it was only OK- probably because I ordered something I don't typically eat.  It'll definitely try it again.
Refine this for me please: The happy hour and brunch at this place are fantastic. Although I only had dinner there once and it was just alright, I believe it might have been due to my choice of an unfamiliar dish. Nonetheless, I am definitely willing to give it another try.

input:
Two co-workers and I came here after flying in from Chicago for an afternoon snack. It was almost 3, so we asked if we could wait until happy hour to order. The place was completely empty while we were there, but the space was well decorated and very open. 

We all ordered cocktails (I got the Mint Julep, which was not great, but then a gin drink that was fantastic), and they were all pretty and tasty. We also ordered Mac and cheese, fries, Brussels sprouts, and a pretzel. I didn't try the sprouts (I really don't like them), but everything else was so good! And the prices during happy hour were a great deal. 

I'll definitely be back next time we go to Reno!
Refine this for me please:
A couple of colleagues and I arrived here in Reno after our flight from Chicago, seeking a mid-afternoon snack. Since it was nearly 3 o'clock, we inquired whether we could hold off ordering until happy hour. Surprisingly, the establishment was completely empty during our visit, yet we appreciated the tasteful decorations and spacious layout. 

All three of us opted for cocktails, and while the Mint Julep failed to impress me, the subsequent gin-based drink was simply fantastic. Moreover, both the presentation and flavor of the cocktails were delightful for all of us. In addition to the drinks, we ordered a delectable assortment of Mac and cheese, fries, Brussels sprouts, and a pretzel. Although I didn't try the sprouts due to my personal dislike for them, everything else exceeded my expectations with its exceptional taste. It was especially pleasing to discover that the prices during happy hour were incredibly reasonable.

Given my positive experience, I am certain to return to this place on our future trips to Reno!

input:
Trying to find a restaurant in The Big Easy that serves vegetarian is not an "Easy" feat

We've encountered many the restaurant who would tell us time & time again that they did not have or *would* not make something to accommodate veggie needs & it was such a letdown.....to this day I still remember 1 guy saying "Vegetarian?  Aww, you gotta get out earrrrrly for *that*".  We still laugh about it....

Well, over the last few years, we're noticing more & more places recognizing veggies like to eat Southern / Cajun comfort food & they are starting to open up their menus to us! ( YAY)

Seeing that Muriel's Jackson Square had such an offering, we made rezzies to ensure we veggies got fed - you'll want to do this too - veggie or not!  They were packed & quoting 2 hr waits & this was at 9pm!

Started w/ drinkys at the bar - Sazerac for the Mr & I had the uber-delish Honey Child cocktail: honey-infused vodka & muddled blackberries.  The Mr liked mine so well that he ordered 1 too, to go w/ dinner & just to be nice, I had another as well so he wouldn't have to drink alone

Their veggie appie had eggplant, of which I'm not a fan so we asked the waitress if they could make their Goat Cheese Crepe, veggie & she said sure.  Since the description said it was topped w/ crawfish, we thought, this would be easy..... but unfortunately, the roulade sauce was made seafood stock. ACK!  Wished you had told us this!  The Mr however, said the crepe was nice & plump, the goat cheese was creamy & smooth & he liked it, barring the sauce

Mains consisted of their Veggie Soiree - this was a sampling of little dollops of veggie tastes - some you'll find on their side dish offerings & some not

Divine beets & roasted acorn squash

Polenta topped w/ chickpeas & a basil sauce - flavorful though those beans were crunchy & could have used a bit more time in the cooker.... same w/ the crunchy wild rice

Yams were very flavorful & had lots of ginger - the Mr got to indulge in both our dollops of chard - I tried a bite & it triggered my dislike for cooked greens

Too full for dessert, we left w/ happy tummies & thankfulness for a nice veggie night out.  A-OK night!
Refine this for me please:
Finding a vegetarian-friendly restaurant in New Orleans, also known as The Big Easy, is not an easy task. We have encountered numerous restaurants that either did not have vegetarian options or refused to accommodate our veggie needs, which was disappointing. We still laugh about the time when a guy told us, "Vegetarian? Aww, you gotta get out early for that."

However, in recent years, we have noticed a positive change, with more and more places recognizing that vegetarians enjoy Southern and Cajun comfort food. These establishments are starting to include vegetarian options on their menus, which is fantastic news for all diners!

One such restaurant that embraced this trend was Muriel's Jackson Square. We made reservations in advance to ensure that we, as vegetarians, would be well-fed. We recommend doing the same, regardless of your dietary preferences, as they were packed and quoting 2-hour waits, even at 9 pm!

To kick off our evening, we started with drinks at the bar. My husband had a Sazerac, and I enjoyed a delicious cocktail called Honey Child, made with honey-infused vodka and muddled blackberries. The Honey Child was so good that my husband ordered one for himself to accompany dinner. Not wanting him to drink alone, I decided to have another as well.

Their vegetarian appetizer initially included eggplant, which I am not fond of. However, we asked our waitress if they could make a veggie version of their Goat Cheese Crepe, and she gladly agreed. We assumed it would be a simple request since the description mentioned crawfish, but unfortunately, the roulade sauce contained seafood stock. We wish they had informed us about this beforehand! Nevertheless, my husband enjoyed the crepe, praising its plumpness, creamy goat cheese, and smooth texture, excluding the sauce.

For our main course, we chose the Veggie Soiree, which featured various small portions of vegetarian dishes, some of which were available as side dishes and others that were unique to the tasting sampler.

The divine beets and roasted acorn squash were a delightful combination. The polenta topped with chickpeas and basil sauce was flavorful, although the beans were slightly crunchy and could have used more cooking time. The same can be said for the crunchy wild rice.

The yams were bursting with ginger flavor, and my husband happily devoured both our portions of chard, leaving me to stay true to my dislike for cooked greens.

Though we were too full for dessert, we left the restaurant with contented bellies and a deep sense of gratitude for a wonderful night out as vegetarians. It was an A-OK night indeed!

input:
I ate at Puckett's yesterday for lunch, and I have to say it was some mighty tasty food for an old-fashioned meat-and-three.  But I actually had a meat-and-two!  Definitely check out the squash casserole.  it was quite the tasty dish.  I'd also recommend their meatloaf, which is what I had.

My only complaint--and it's a minor one--is that they advertise cornbread.  Yes, it's cornbread, but not a slice of cornbread like you typically think of it.  People in the North would call it a corn fritter.  Being from KY, I'd call it a hoe cake.  It's cornbread but more like a cornbread pancake.
Refine this for me please:
Yesterday, I had lunch at Puckett's and to my surprise, their old-fashioned meat-and-three served some amazingly delicious food. Although I opted for a meat-and-two instead, I highly recommend trying their scrumptious squash casserole. Another dish worth mentioning is their mouthwatering meatloaf, which happened to be my choice for the day.

My only minor complaint revolves around their advertised cornbread. While it does resemble cornbread, it's not exactly what you would expect in terms of presentation. Those from the North might refer to it as a corn fritter, while us Kentuckians commonly call it a hoe cake. Essentially, it possesses the essence of cornbread but takes the form of a pancake-like cornbread.

input: I usually stay at The Grand Sierra.  It is where I taught my son to swim years ago, so I have been biased to that property.  However, with it under construction recently, and after they took the horse statues out of the Valet area, and began major construction, I decided to try the Peppermill by a friends suggestion.  The Operations Manager, David Fuller went above and beyond to make my stay unbelievably excellent.  We were met at the hotel and "double" upgraded to a Tuscany Balcony Suite at check-in.  Needless to say, it had a balcony.  Very cool!  The room upgrade started my trip off on a perfect note.  Thank you Peppermill!  I will be back.  My experience was better than expected thanks in part to the staff going the extra mile for us.
Refine this for me please: Typically, I always choose to stay at The Grand Sierra where I have sentimental memories of teaching my son to swim. However, due to recent construction and the removal of the horse statues in the Valet area, I decided to take my friend's suggestion and try out The Peppermill. I must say, thanks to the outstanding efforts of the Operations Manager, David Fuller, my stay there turned out to be incredibly exceptional. Upon arrival, we were pleasantly surprised to be upgraded to a Tuscany Balcony Suite. As a result, we enjoyed the added feature of a balcony which was absolutely delightful. This room upgrade set the stage for a perfect trip, and I extend my gratitude to the Peppermill staff for going above and beyond to exceed my expectations. Needless to say, this experience has convinced me that I will definitely return to The Peppermill in the future.

input:
Hilton properties are some of the oldest,  most dilapidated properties in the hotel business.  Additionally,  the customer service is the very worst overall with a few exceptions. 
Made a reservation here for 1 bedroom suite.  Suite wasn't ready.  Had a 12:30 lunch mtg  Needed to shower and change but suite booked wasn't ready.  What I thought was a courtesy extend turned out to be bait a D switch.  They gave e me a 'courtesy room' with the understanding that upon my return,  I would get the suite I booked. 
I  returned just to be to told that 'the room I booked had been sold.' Really,???? 
The suite was $250. The downside graded room was $235. I couldn't cancel the room and all of the rooms at a lower rate were 'sold out'  How is that possible so quickly? 
Fake apologies we're given,  but no satisfaction when more could have been done.   Never again.
Refine this for me please:
Refined: The Hilton properties have a reputation for being some of the oldest and most neglected hotels in the industry. Moreover, their overall customer service is consistently subpar, with only a few exceptions. 

During my recent stay, I made a reservation for a 1-bedroom suite. Unfortunately, when I arrived, the suite wasn't ready, causing inconvenience as I had a 12:30 lunch meeting and needed to shower and change beforehand. The hotel staff offered what seemed like a courtesy room, assuring me that upon my return, I would be given the suite I initially booked.

Upon my return, however, I was informed that the room I had reserved had been sold to someone else. I was surprised and frustrated by this turn of events. The suite I had booked cost $250, but the only available option was a downgraded room priced at $235. Despite my attempts, I was unable to cancel the reservation, and all the lower-priced rooms were conveniently claimed to be sold out. It seemed implausible for the availability to change so rapidly.

Although the staff provided fake apologies, they failed to offer any satisfactory resolution or compensation. This disappointing experience has left me with no desire to stay at any Hilton property again.

input: Burger was OK, but not at all worth the price. I felt cramped sitting at the long table surrounded by people I did not know. Service was OK. If they brought the prices way down, it would be better. As it is now, it's a really expensive, mediocre burger. There are much, much better places in St. Louis (both in terms of taste and value).
Refine this for me please: The burger was mediocre, failing to justify its high price. Additionally, I found the seating arrangement at the long table to be uncomfortable, as I was crammed among unfamiliar individuals. The service was satisfactory, but overall, the restaurant would greatly benefit from significantly reducing its prices. Presently, the burger is overpriced and lacks quality, especially when compared to the numerous superior options available in St. Louis, both in terms of taste and value.

input: We had several quotes, with Pete and Ron's being the best of those I considered reputable. When i told Arbour Bay I was going with Pete and Ron they told me I would be in good hands. Had 2 very large oaks, one inaccessible from the front yard, one less than 2 feet from my roof edge taken down with a crane. I left for work in the A.M. and when I got home at 4 the trees were gone. Minimal damage from the heavy equipment in my yard. Will definitely recommend to friends and neighbors.
Refine this for me please: After considering multiple quotes, I found that the ones provided by Pete and Ron were the most trustworthy. When I informed Arbour Bay of my decision to choose Pete and Ron, they assured me that I would be in capable hands. The task at hand involved removing two significantly large oaks, one of which was inaccessible from the front yard and another that was dangerously close to my roof edge. To handle this, a crane was utilized. On the day of the job, I departed for work in the morning and by the time I returned at 4 PM, both trees had been removed. The presence of heavy machinery in my yard resulted in minimal damage. I am certainly inclined to recommend them to my friends and neighbors.

input: I went back here and either I didn't remember the prices  (because someone else had paid last time) or their prices had gone up. It was almost $20 for 2 basic sushi rolls!! While the portions are big, they aren't filling enough to justify such a high price for 2 rolls for lunch. Will not be coming back at those prices.
Refine this for me please: Upon returning to this place, either my memory failed me regarding the prices (as someone else had covered the bill last time) or indeed the prices had increased. Shockingly, they were charging almost $20 for a mere 2 basic sushi rolls! Although the serving sizes were generous, they fell short in satisfying hunger to justify such exorbitant prices for a lunch consisting of only 2 rolls. Needless to say, I will not be returning to this establishment given their current pricing.

input: Great atmosphere and service! I don't know how often they have live music but the band playing the night we stopped in was very good. As for the food, it was good; I wont say it was the best burger I ever had but it wasn't bad; just not as great as I had hoped it would have been. All and all we had a good time and will be back!
Refine this for me please: The atmosphere and service were outstanding! Although I'm not sure about their frequency of live music, the band performing the night we visited was incredibly talented. As for the food, it was enjoyable; while I wouldn't classify it as the best burger I've ever had, it certainly wasn't disappointing. It simply didn't meet the high expectations I had. Nonetheless, we had a pleasant experience overall and definitely plan on returning.

input: We had a 2 1/2 day corporate conference here in the middle of June. The service was excellent, the facilities were very nice and I was fairly impressed with catering. Great spot for conferences or small conventions. Close to the airpor with a complimentary shuttle and complimentary parking.
Refine this for me please: During the middle of June, we hosted a remarkable 2 1/2-day corporate conference at our facility. The level of service we provided was truly exceptional, ensuring our guests had a seamless experience. The facilities at our venue were impeccably maintained and boasted an impressive ambiance, which left a lasting impression on our attendees. Additionally, our catering services surpassed expectations and received favourable praise from attendees. Our location is ideally suited for conferences and small conventions, offering convenient proximity to the airport. To further enhance our guests' experience, we provide a complimentary shuttle service as well as complimentary parking facilities.

input: Yum! This is a great place to go with a few friends to share their delicious and nicely portioned cheese while enjoying a beer from their extensive drink list. 5 stars purely because of how much I loved their cheese selection and appreciated the staff's knowledge of each cheese.  I'd happily go back although this is not a place I'd go to have inexpensive drinks.
Refine this for me please: Yum! This place is an excellent spot to visit with a few friends and indulge in their delectable and well-sized cheese offerings, paired with a refreshing beer from their extensive drink menu. I give it 5 stars solely based on my immense satisfaction with their cheese selection and the staff's impressive knowledge about each variety. I would gladly return; however, it should be noted that this is not a budget-friendly establishment for drinks.

input: This is not Middle Eastern food. Side dishes were awfully tasting, including a warmed up rice, which I am sure came from a frozen bag few minutes before it was served.
Refine this for me please: Please refine this for me: The food served here does not represent Middle Eastern cuisine. The side dishes were disappointingly unappetizing, particularly the reheated rice that seemed to have been taken straight from a frozen bag moments before being served.

input:
Loved this place, especially the Salmon. Only eaten here at Lunch and not a problem. Going to add this one to my Lunch rotation.
Spotless restrooms and the service is top notch.
Refine this for me please: I absolutely adore this place, particularly their delicious salmon. I've only had the pleasure of dining here for lunch, but it has never disappointed me. It has definitely earned a spot in my regular lunch rotation. The restrooms are pristine, and the service provided is truly exceptional.

input:
This place is top notch, with phenomenal service and such fantastic ambiance- how can you go elsewhere? All of the food looked and smelled amazing. I love how creative everything was.
I CANT STOP DAYDREAMING ABOUT THE FOOD. Hands down, best brunch experience of my life. I don't even like french toast usually and theres was by far the most delicious food thats ever entered my mouth. I am literally drooling while writing this.
The chicken and waffles were unreal and standout A++++. 
I love the "flinstones pushup-pop" drink so creative and clever.
Even the deviled eggs were the best I've personally ever had. They do everything right even when it comes to the music. It was super fun and such a great experience! Ignore any review thats not 4 stars because they must be delusional.
Refine this for me please:
This place is absolutely outstanding, offering exceptional service and an incredible ambiance that is hard to find elsewhere. The food not only looked and smelled amazing, but it also showcased remarkable creativity.

I am completely enamored with the food here, and I find myself constantly daydreaming about it. Without a doubt, this was the best brunch experience of my life. Even though I typically don't enjoy French toast, the one I had here surpassed all expectations and was the most delicious dish I have ever tasted. It is safe to say that I am literally drooling while writing this.

The chicken and waffles deserve special mention as they were out of this world and deserve the highest possible rating. The "flintstones pushup-pop" drink was delightfully inventive and clever, adding an extra layer of enjoyment to the overall experience. Even the deviled eggs stood out as the best I have personally ever had.

Furthermore, the attention to detail extends beyond the food. The music selection here contributes to a fun and vibrant atmosphere, enhancing the overall experience. Anyone who doesn't give this place a 4-star rating must surely be delusional. Trust me, this is a place that you cannot afford to miss.

input: I'm so happy we came upon this place randomly. They have a happy hour 3-8pm everyday:  Half off all beers, $3-$4 glasses of wine & $8 hookah! Their hookah on non-happy hour is $13. They have a wide selection of shisha flavors and even options of an ice chamber or smoking from a fruit bowl (extra charge). They do have a food menu, but I didn't try anything from it. But the plates I saw coming from the kitchen look pretty good. Overall, a really chill place to come and relax with friends. It was definitely an enjoyable experience.
Refine this for me please: I'm thrilled that we stumbled upon this place by chance! They offer a fantastic happy hour from 3-8pm every day, with half off on all beers, $3-$4 glasses of wine, and an $8 hookah. Normally, their hookah price is $13, but during happy hour, you can enjoy it at a great discount. They also have an extensive range of shisha flavors, and you can even opt for an ice chamber or a fruit bowl for an extra charge. Although I didn't sample anything from their food menu, the dishes I observed being served from the kitchen looked incredibly appetizing. In summary, this establishment provides a relaxed and laid-back ambiance, making it the perfect spot to unwind and hang out with friends. I had a truly enjoyable experience.

input:
I absolutely love this hotel. It is certainly one of my favorites. Upon walking into the building, to your right you will enter the lobby. The lobby is adorable with eclectic decorations and 1 million places to sit that are very comfortable. They serve wine every day from 5 to 6 PM, it's nice to relax down in the lobby with a glass of wine and friendly staff..

Speaking of the staff, they are amazing. Checking in is fantastic, Jasmine and Kayla are the ones I dealt with and they are both wonderful. The hotel concierge Roshid is a very friendly and knowledgeable concierge, they are very lucky to have him on staff. The housekeepers are great, the rooms are immaculate. What I love most about this hotel are the fantastic bathrooms, I'm not sure about the regular rooms, but if you get a king spa room, the bathrooms are absolutely amazing. You have a freestanding tub, and a large shower and you can jump in between the two should you be so inclined ha ha. The decor is so attractive, incredible wallpaper, beautiful rugs, everything seems brand new and they keep it in perfect condition. This hotel is a must for anyone visiting Philadelphia. They make you feel right at home at the moment you step in the door. The pictures that you can get from inside the rooms are enough to make up your whole trip to Philly LOL. But if you want to get out and explore Philly you're only steps away from the Liberty Bell and a historical museum. Right in Center City or the old downtown area, you'll find lots of historical information about Philadelphia.  Definitely stop in and stay at the Monaco, you won't regret it!
Refine this for me please:
I absolutely adore this hotel, as it has become one of my favorites. As you walk into the building, the lobby on your right is simply charming with its eclectic decor and numerous, comfortable seating options. It's a delightful experience to unwind with a glass of wine from 5 to 6 PM and enjoy the inviting ambiance of the lobby, accompanied by the friendly staff.

Speaking of the staff, they are truly remarkable. The check-in process was fantastic, with Jasmine and Kayla providing exceptional service. Additionally, the hotel's concierge, Roshid, is an invaluable asset with his extensive knowledge and warm demeanor. The housekeeping team is also fantastic, ensuring the rooms are impeccably clean. In particular, I am enamored with the stunning bathrooms in the king spa rooms. Equipped with a freestanding tub and a spacious shower, one can easily alternate between the two for a truly indulgent experience. The decor throughout the hotel is undeniably attractive, with exquisite wallpaper, beautiful rugs, and immaculate upkeep.

This hotel will undoubtedly make you feel right at home from the moment you step through the door. The captivating snapshots that can be taken inside the rooms alone make it worth the visit to Philadelphia. However, should you wish to explore the city, the hotel is conveniently located steps away from iconic landmarks such as the Liberty Bell and historical museums within Center City or the old downtown area. Whether you choose to stay in and enjoy the hotel's offerings or venture out to discover the rich history of Philadelphia, a stay at the Monaco Hotel is an absolute must. You won't regret it!

input: Love, Love, LOVE this store!!!  I admit, I'm an addict. But where else can you get a Bebe top, a Banana Republic skirt and a BCBG skirt for $4.13?????  The savings are ridiculous!
Refine this for me please: I absolutely adore this store! I must confess, I am completely addicted. Nowhere else can you find a Bebe top, a Banana Republic skirt, and a BCBG skirt all for just $4.13! The discounts available here are incredibly absurd.

input: So happy there is a family friendly place to watch football in Carp! Great atmosphere, fast service, delicious pizza.
Refine this for me please: I'm thrilled that Carp now has a family-friendly football-watching spot! The atmosphere is fantastic, the service is quick and efficient, and the pizza is absolutely delicious.

input: It is what you expect in an Acme, the only thing I found a little different with this one is that it seemed the aisles were a little narrower than in other stores. Store is a little smaller than others so not as wide of a variety, but was fine, looks like they've upgraded some areas like the frozen/refrigerated food sections. Service was fine.
Refine this for me please: In an Acme store, you would typically find what you expect. However, one notable difference in this particular store is that the aisles appeared to be slightly narrower compared to other stores. Despite being slightly smaller in size, the store still offered a decent variety of items. Additionally, it seems like they have made improvements to certain sections, such as the frozen and refrigerated food areas. Overall, the service provided was satisfactory.

input: We're new to the area, so we're exploring restaurants every weekend. My wife has already proclaimed The Roost her favorite, and that's based on many years of breakfast dining, not just in this area. They bake all their own breads and pastries. Try the raisin bread or sugar-cinnamon toast. Yum! The cornbread casserole is another dish my wife and I highly recommend. And the service was prompt, attentive and very friendly. Enjoy!
Refine this for me please: As newcomers to the area, we've been making it a point to try out different restaurants every weekend. After years of breakfast dining experiences, my wife has already declared The Roost as her favorite, not just in this area but overall. One of the reasons behind this is that they bake their own breads and pastries, which adds a unique touch to their menu. If you happen to visit, I suggest giving their raisin bread or sugar-cinnamon toast a try - they are absolutely delicious! Another dish that both my wife and I highly endorse is their cornbread casserole. Additionally, the service at The Roost was remarkable - prompt, attentive, and filled with warmth. We hope you have a wonderful time dining there!

input: Small, crowded and hectic but boy the food was good and plentiful. Wait staff was right on top of the chaos. Great breakfast place.
Refine this for me please: Despite its small size and crowded atmosphere, this bustling restaurant impresses with its delicious and abundant food offerings. The wait staff efficiently manages the chaos, ensuring a pleasant dining experience. Overall, this is an excellent choice for a satisfying and hearty breakfast.

input: Finally went in after walking by so many times. Glad we did. Small place but IR is pleasing to the eye. One wall cover with wood palates and subtle two tone gray walls. Started with the prosciutto fig arugula Parmesan flatbread appetites. Enough for two people and delicious. Nice mix of flavors. Main dishes were a burger grass fed beef with fries coated with truffles dusting. Burger was humongous!  Looked good smelled good and tasted good. I had a seafood soup with fish ( not sure what it was) shrimp and mollusks in a  coconut/ curry broth. Deliciously spicy but not enough to kill your taste buds. Overall I would recommend this place. We went early as we heard it gets crowded and they do not take reservations.  BYW great wine and craft beer selections
Refine this for me please: Finally, after passing by numerous times, we decided to give it a try, and we were certainly glad we did. The restaurant may be small, but the interior decor is visually appealing. One of the walls is covered with wooden palettes, and the two-tone gray walls subtly add to the ambiance. For appetizers, we indulged in the prosciutto fig arugula Parmesan flatbread, a generously sized and mouthwatering dish, perfect for sharing between two people. The flavors were nicely balanced and harmonious. Moving on to the main course, we ordered the grass-fed beef burger with truffle-dusted fries. The burger was impressively enormous and presented beautifully. Beyond its attractive appearance, it also packed a delightful taste. As for my choice, I opted for the seafood soup, containing a variety of fish, shrimp, and mollusks in a tantalizing coconut curry broth. The spiciness of the soup was deliciously enjoyable without overpowering the taste buds. Overall, I highly recommend this place; however, I suggest arriving early due to the reported crowding and the lack of reservation availability. Additionally, the wine and craft beer selections were exceptional.

input:
Reading the reviews, I cannot agree with the others which tout the quality of the food. I had the dinner buffet and the food was mediocre at best. The selection was fine, though they do charge a higher price if you want crab legs. BTW- neither Easy Buffet nor Ginger Buffet charge extra for crab legs. The flavors were there, but the meats were dried out, concentrated, and fried foods soggy and tough as if the they hadn't been turned over in hours and were just sitting on the steam table.  

Service was very nice but slow, especially since there were only 3 tables going the whole time we were there.  I think they had him responsible for too many things other that waiting tables.  

There is a slim chance I'll come back since there are 3 other Chinese buffets in the area that I prefer over Dragon.  Perhaps if I do, there will be more guests to turn over the food and I can update my ratings.
Refine this for me please:
After reading the reviews, I strongly disagree with those praising the food quality. My experience with the dinner buffet at Dragon was nothing more than average. While the variety of food options was satisfactory, it is worth noting that they charge an additional fee for crab legs. However, it should be mentioned that neither Easy Buffet nor Ginger Buffet charge extra for crab legs.

Although the flavors were present, the meats were disappointingly dry and the fried foods were unpleasantly soggy and tough. It seemed as though the dishes had been left untouched on the steam table for hours, lacking the necessary attention.

The service, although pleasant, was quite slow, even though there were only three occupied tables throughout our entire time there. It appeared that the waiter was burdened with additional responsibilities that hindered their ability to attend to the tables promptly.

Given the presence of three other Chinese buffets in the area that I personally prefer over Dragon, the likelihood of me returning is slim. However, if I do decide to give it another chance, I hope to see potential improvements in the turnover of food and may revise my ratings accordingly.

input: This is our "go to" place! The food is consistently good and we always have friendly attentive waiters to sometimes help with our decisions. One of our favorites is the pasta pockets with pear filling. Really delicious! It's also byob which is always a plus. This is a great restaurant with a real cozy, family atmosphere. Highly recommend.
Refine this for me please: This place is definitely our top choice! The food is consistently excellent, and the waitstaff is always attentive and friendly, often assisting us in making our selections. One of our absolute favorites is the pasta pockets filled with pear - it's incredibly delicious! Another plus is that it's a BYOB establishment, which adds to the overall experience. The restaurant has a cozy, family-friendly atmosphere that we absolutely love. We highly recommend dining here.

input: To sum it up, it's an average bar with ties to a very well-known TV show - but that fact doesn't make the food or much else better. When I went they had $4 White Rascal's and on top of that I had the normal gravy fries. $11 for fries, steep to say the least. They were steak fries, covered in gravy and mozzarella cheese and while pretty damn good, I would be hesitant to say that they're worth the price. Service was good, sometimes a little slow, but still friendly.
Refine this for me please: In summary, this bar has a connection to a popular TV show, but unfortunately, that does not enhance the quality of the food or overall experience. During my visit, they were offering $4 White Rascal beers, and I decided to try their regular gravy fries, which cost a steep $11. These fries were steak fries smothered in gravy and mozzarella cheese and, although they were enjoyable, I'm unsure if they justified the high price. The service was generally good, although occasionally a bit slow, but the staff remained friendly.

input: I went here based on the Yelp reviews and found everything to be true. The staff is extremely helpful and willing to answer all questions. I will continue to bring my bike repair/maintenance needs here.
Refine this for me please: After relying on Yelp reviews, I visited this place and can confirm their accuracy in every aspect. The staff proved to be exceptionally supportive and eager to address any queries I had. Without a doubt, I will remain loyal to this establishment for all my bike repair and maintenance requirements.

input: A very nice hotel and a good value. ($175/night) The king bed was primo, the room tastefully furnished. The  rotating Carousel bar is fun and the pool at the top of the building is a great way to cool off on a 95 degree day.We stay there given the great location in the French  Quarter, but our room facing Royal St. was very loud, especially on Friday night. Try for a room not facing the street if you are there over a weekend. Make sure they remove the extra $60 per night they tack on to your room charge for incidentals.
Refine this for me please:
The hotel offers a pleasant stay at a reasonable price of $175 per night. The king bed in our room was exceptionally comfortable, and the furnishings were tasteful. The highlight of the hotel is the Carousel bar, which adds an element of fun. On top of that, the rooftop pool provides a refreshing escape from the heat, particularly on scorching 95-degree days.

We chose this hotel mainly for its excellent location in the French Quarter. However, our experience is dampened by the excessive noise from our room facing Royal St., especially on Friday nights. If you are planning to stay over a weekend, it's advisable to request a room that doesn't face the street. Additionally, be sure to double-check your final bill and have them remove the additional $60 per night charged for incidentals.

input: the handmade orangina is delicious-better than the bottled version! and the croissant sandwiches are amazing!
Refine this for me please: The homemade orangina is simply divine - far superior to its bottled counterpart! Additionally, you must try the croissant sandwiches - they are absolutely phenomenal!

input: We have great food every time we are here. Great milkshakes, ice cream, Chicago dogs, and cheese fries. Super affordable and delicious!
Refine this for me please: We consistently enjoy exceptional food every visit, boasting an incredible selection of milkshakes, ice cream, Chicago dogs, and cheese fries. Notably, the prices are incredibly reasonable, making it an excellent combination of affordability and mouthwatering taste!

input: the foods great, but no buflight on tap.i love the servers there , especially Jamie White, whose the best server. But again. Lack of Bud light is a big negative
Refine this for me please: The food is excellent, although it's unfortunate that they don't have Bud Light on tap. One thing that really stands out about this place is the exceptional service provided by servers like Jamie White, who is undoubtedly the best server. However, the absence of Bud Light is a significant drawback.

input: If I'm basing my rating on the taste and quality of the food, then I must give it a five star rating! I did not mind the atmosphere, which admittedly leaves a bit to be desired. I was too busy eating our delicious dinners. My companion had Chicken Tikka and I had Malai Kofta. Definitely loved both of them and their prices were exactly what I would expect to pay. We are already planning our return trip.
Refine this for me please: Based on the excellent taste and quality of the food, I wholeheartedly give it a five-star rating. While the atmosphere may not be top-notch, it didn't bother me as I was too engrossed in enjoying our delectable dinners. Both the Chicken Tikka and Malai Kofta were truly delightful, and their prices perfectly aligned with my expectations. Needless to say, my companion and I are already eagerly planning our next visit.

input:
I have been coming here for about a year now and this last week was my 5th visit. I live in the Bay Area. I'm a player card member so they send me free room or discounted room offers all the time. This is a very nice hotel/ casino. Never had a bad experience. Love that I can check in online before getting to to hotel and just use the express kiosk when I get there to get my room keys and avoid the long line,  LOVE THAT! The rooms are always nice and clean and comfortable. The last 2 rooms I have stayed in had views of the pool which was nice! 
The pool is very nice and relaxing and never too crowded. The spa Toscana is very nice but a bit pricey. None of the restaurants I have tried there so far have been great but I haven't tried to steakhouse or Chi yet, so I haven't had the full experience yet. The slots are never too crowded when I go and can usually get on the machines I like to play with little to no delay. 
I enjoy visiting here. I will keep returning as long as they keep sending me sweet offers!!
Refine this for me please:
I have been a regular visitor of this hotel/casino for a year now, and I recently completed my fifth visit. As a player card member, I frequently receive complimentary or discounted room offers, which is one of the highlights of being a member. Throughout all my visits, I've always had a positive experience at this establishment. 

One feature that I particularly appreciate is the ability to check-in online before arriving at the hotel. Upon arrival, I can simply use the express kiosk to pick up my room keys, bypassing the long lines. This convenience is a major plus for me. Moreover, the rooms are consistently well-maintained, clean, and comfortable. In my last two stays, I had the pleasure of enjoying scenic views of the pool. It added an extra touch of enjoyment to my overall experience.

Speaking of the pool, it is a delightful and peaceful area that never seems to be too crowded. I find it to be a relaxing environment. Additionally, there is a spa called Toscana, which I have tried. Although it is on the pricier side, the quality of service and amenities makes it worthwhile.

Regarding the dining options, I must admit that none of the restaurants I have tried so far have impressed me. However, I have yet to try the steakhouse or Chi, so I still have more to explore. I remain optimistic that they will offer an exceptional dining experience.

When it comes to the casino, I have had no issues finding the slot machines I enjoy playing. I have never encountered significant delays or overcrowding in this area during my visits. This makes it a pleasant and hassle-free experience.

Overall, I'm highly satisfied with my visits to this hotel/casino. As long as they continue sending me attractive offers, I will happily keep returning for more unforgettable experiences.

input: I had a most-delicious bagel sandwich this morning - pork roll, egg and cheese on an everything bagel. The price was very fair - $4.23 - and the bagels are made on site each day. They seem understaffed so hopefully they get some more staff to keep up with the crowds.
Refine this for me please:
This morning, I had an incredibly tasty bagel sandwich consisting of pork roll, egg, and cheese on an everything bagel. The price of this delectable treat was exceptionally reasonable, totaling just $4.23. Moreover, the bagels themselves are freshly made on-site every single day, ensuring their unparalleled freshness.

However, it appears that the establishment is currently understaffed, struggling to accommodate the high volume of patrons. It is my sincere hope that they rectify this issue by swiftly recruiting additional personnel to keep pace with the bustling crowds.

input: Warning, if you come here on a Sunday there is a set tasting menu.  We were a party of two, they served us with one plate, "family style".  The only problem is the woman next to us was a party of one and had the same size servings.  They are claiming family style but giving the same portions they give to one person to multiple people. My advice, make sure you request being served as one person with separate plates.  The food was delicious but the business aspect was unacceptable.  Will not come back.
Refine this for me please:
Attention: Warning! If you plan to visit us on a Sunday, please be aware that we offer a fixed tasting menu. During our recent visit as a party of two, we were served our meals "family style" on a single plate. The issue arose when we noticed that the lady seated next to us, dining alone, received the same size portions as us. Despite claiming to offer a family-style experience, the portions provided were equivalent to those meant for one person. 

To ensure a better dining experience, we recommend requesting separate plates if you prefer to be served individually. Although the food itself was delicious, we found the approach to the business aspect unacceptable. Consequently, we have decided not to return.

input: Wonderful place, if you haven't checked it out!  Went there for a pizza making class.  Had a great time, learned some great techniques (thanks to John from Ornesto), and met some really great people.  This place is the Disneyland for bakers, chefs and wanna be chefs.  I already signed up for another class in January and I purchased several of their store goods.  Check it out.  It's a little hard to find, as the lighting is a little dim - or maybe it's me.  :-)
Refine this for me please:
This place is absolutely amazing! If you haven't visited yet, I highly recommend it. I recently went there to attend a pizza making class, and it was such a wonderful experience. Thanks to John from Ornesto, I learned some fantastic techniques and had a blast meeting new people. It truly feels like a magical Disneyland for bakers, chefs, and anyone who aspires to be one.

I enjoyed the class so much that I immediately signed up for another one in January. Additionally, I couldn't resist purchasing several of their incredible store goods. Trust me, you won't be disappointed if you pay them a visit. Just a heads up, the location might be a bit tricky to find due to the slightly dim lighting, but it only adds to the charm. Or perhaps it was just me who found it slightly dim - haha!

input: Great vegetarian and organic menu, friendly and helpful staff and delicious coffee! I'm definitely coming back
Refine this for me please: The vegetarian and organic menu at this place is exceptional, accompanied by a friendly and attentive staff. Moreover, their coffee is absolutely delicious! Suffice to say, I am eagerly looking forward to my next visit.

input: I LOVE this place. Best veggie burger in town (handmade patty!!)! And the pretzel buns?? YUM.
Refine this for me please: I absolutely adore this place! It hands down serves the finest veggie burger in town, complete with a delightful handmade patty. And let's not forget about those mouthwatering pretzel buns - they are simply divine!

input: Went there for lunch and was pleasantly surprised, as having recently moved to Tampa from Los Angeles, I have been disappointed by the food.  However, I give Ploy Thai 4 stars, not just by Tampa standards, but by good food standards.  The food was very flavorful and the ingredients very fresh.
Refine this for me please: I was pleasantly surprised when I went to Ploy Thai for lunch. As someone who recently relocated from Los Angeles to Tampa, I have been disappointed with the local food options. However, Ploy Thai truly exceeded my expectations, earning a well-deserved 4-star rating not just by Tampa standards, but by the standards of good food in general. Their dishes were bursting with flavor, and the use of fresh ingredients was noticeable.

input: Eh, crust was dry and we got the Delmar which instead of pizza sauce they use bbq sauce however they barely put any on the pizza which caused it to be dry. The server was good. The pizza took forrrevvverrr to come out though we had been done with our salads for 20-30 minutes.
Refine this for me please: The crust was dry, and unfortunately, the Delmar pizza we ordered had BBQ sauce instead of pizza sauce. However, there was hardly any sauce on the pizza, resulting in a dry texture. On the bright side, the server provided good service. However, a downside was that the pizza took an excessively long time to be served, even though we had finished our salads 20-30 minutes prior.

input:
Food and coffee are great. Just have 30
Minutes to stand in line and wait for the ONE cashier to make change. Either they fix this and add another cashier or they will be dead. Shouldn't have to wait for one cashier while 5 other folks stand behind the one cashier watching the line grow. Adds other till!
Refine this for me please: Food and coffee are enjoyable, but it becomes frustrating when there is only one cashier available, resulting in a 30-minute wait. It would greatly improve the overall experience if the management could address this issue by either hiring an additional cashier or face losing customers. It is unfair to expect customers to endure long waits while others simply observe the line getting longer. Please consider adding another till to alleviate this inconvenience.

input: Peppermill has done it again with service and accommodations that are second to none.  Gaming at the mill (i only play 1 dollar or 25 cent slots) seems to provide better outcomes and I know reno. Spent a lot here and found the peppermill is the best. Food is some of the best and reasonably priced.
Refine this for me please: Peppermill continues to excel in providing exceptional service and top-notch accommodations. As an avid gambler at the mill, particularly on 1 dollar or 25 cent slots, I've consistently experienced more favorable outcomes compared to other casinos in Reno. Having spent a considerable amount of time here, I confidently assert that Peppermill stands out as the finest establishment. Additionally, the dining options at Peppermill offer delectable cuisine of remarkable quality at reasonable prices.

input: Overpriced and underwhelming.  Had the sausage/egg:cheese sandwich this morning on whole grain $4.89. Sausage was cold and the sandwich was about 1/2 the size of the picture on the menu. It comes on these large plates and it's just a embarrassing.  Husband had bacon/egg/cheese on brioche, $4.89 and his egg was cold and the entire sandwich was greasy.   I can get this kind of food at McDonalds for a fraction of the price.
Refine this for me please: The breakfast sandwiches at this place are both overpriced and underwhelming. This morning, I ordered the sausage, egg, and cheese sandwich on whole grain for $4.89. Unfortunately, the sausage was cold and the sandwich was much smaller than what was depicted on the menu. Moreover, the presentation on these large plates was embarrassing. On the other hand, my husband opted for the bacon, egg, and cheese on brioche, also priced at $4.89. However, his experience was no better as the egg was cold and the entire sandwich was greasy. At a fraction of the price, I can easily get similar food at McDonald's.

input:
I came here because of the higher rating and they accepted my insurance. My initial visit went well, no complaints on the staff or the doctor at that time. 

They switched my brand from Acuvue to Air Optix and about 2 weeks after using the contact I started to experience pain, redness and irritation. I took my contacts out that evening and had red rings around both of my eyes. I tried contacting them via telephone and left a message as well as email, I failed to hear back from them in a timely manner so I reached out to them again and got ahold of them. I simply wanted my contacts switched back to Acuvue and they tried to tell me that it was allergies causing my problems and were insisiting on me keeping Air Optix. Eventually I did get them to agree to switch my contacts back to acuvue. 

In march I had another eye irritation and I went to Vanderbilt Eye Institue, they told me it was a continued reaction to the Air Optix lenses because I did not give my eyes enough time to heal before applying my new contacts - which was I was not educated on by Music City Optical when I got my new set of contacts. I then reviewed them on facebook at that time. 

Today (8/30/16) I recieved a response to my review on facebook and a corresponding email stating that I was being slanderous and lying, which was not the case at all. I was simply explaining my experience with Music City Optical.
Refine this for me please:
I chose to visit Music City Optical due to its higher rating and acceptance of my insurance. During my initial visit, I had no complaints about the staff or the doctor. However, they switched my contact brand from Acuvue to Air Optix, and after about two weeks of using the new contacts, I began to experience pain, redness, and irritation in my eyes. Upon removing the contacts, I noticed red rings around both eyes. I tried reaching out to them via phone and email but did not receive a timely response. After persisting, I finally managed to contact them and requested to switch back to Acuvue. Initially, they insisted that my problems were due to allergies and encouraged me to continue using Air Optix. Eventually, they agreed to switch my contacts back.

In March, I visited Vanderbilt Eye Institute for another eye irritation. They informed me that the ongoing reaction was due to not allowing enough time for my eyes to heal before using the new contacts - something I was not informed about by Music City Optical. As a result, I posted a review on Facebook to share my experience.

Today (8/30/16), I received a response to my Facebook review and an email accusing me of slander and lying, which was not the case. I was simply recounting my experience with Music City Optical.

input:
This wasn't my first visit to the Italian Centre, but my last visit was many years ago and all I could remember was the huge selection of charcuterie and cheeses. Slightly overwhelming to say the least, meats and cheeses (at the time) I had never even heard of. With some guidance from the staff I was able to select some delights. 

Fast forward a few years... 

My most recent visit was only for some pastries and a quick lunch, so I didn't have time to browse the huge selection of Italian delights. 

I decided to go with the Mossimo pizza. The toppings were fresh the cheese was bubbly! The crust was thin and baked to perfection. I wasn't expecting such a huge pizza- definitely big enough to share! And priced at just $14? A steal if you ask me!

For pastries we chose the Cream Horns; while they were quite pricy, they were certainly delicious. Likely made that day, they were fresh, creamy and flakey! Impossible not to over indulge! 

While visiting the Italian Centre I suggest enjoying a freshly crafted coffee beverage and a pastry. The perfect treat before or after shopping.
Refine this for me please:
This wasn't my first visit to the Italian Centre, but it had been many years since my last visit. All that stuck in my memory was the overwhelming selection of charcuterie and cheeses. I was introduced to meats and cheeses I had never even heard of back then, with the help of the staff.

Fast forward a few years...

On my most recent visit, I had limited time and only stopped by for some pastries and a quick lunch. So, I didn't have the opportunity to browse through the extensive range of Italian delights.

For lunch, I decided to go with the Mossimo pizza. It was absolutely delightful! The toppings were fresh and the cheese was perfectly melted and bubbly. The thin crust was baked to perfection, and to my surprise, the size of the pizza was huge! It was definitely big enough for sharing. Plus, priced at just $14, it was a steal!

As for the pastries, we chose the Cream Horns. Although they were a bit pricy, they were worth every penny. It was evident that they were made that day, as they were incredibly fresh, creamy, and flakey. It was impossible to resist indulging in more than one!

While visiting the Italian Centre, I highly recommend treating yourself to a freshly crafted coffee beverage and a pastry. It's the perfect way to start or end your shopping experience.

input:
It saddens me to say this but I think I need a new nail salon. I have consistently come here for a few years now and the service has never been as bad as it has been the last few times I've been here. Here are my issues:

1) the girl at the front desk never once looked up from her papers while "greeting" me and asking me what I want. She mumbled under her breath to go pick out a color then yelled across the salon that I was getting a mani and pedi. 
2) once I picked out my color I went back to the front and someone who came in after me was seated in a pedi chair, water turned on etc. to get service. Once she saw that I was standing in the front she got a chair going for me. The problem with that is there were no more nail technicians available to work on me.
3) so now I'm sitting in cold water waiting for someone to come and do my feet. 
4) the pedicure started, she painstakingly dug into my toes (which I absolutely hate) and rushed through the Massage part of the pedi
5) after it was all said and done, I find out that their prices have gone up! 

I used to come here because they have later hours and are open on Sunday's but after a 3rd terrible experience here I am not coming back. In the last 3 months, almost the whole staff has changed and these folks are not meeting my needs.
Refine this for me please:
I am disappointed to admit that I believe it is necessary for me to find a new nail salon. Despite being a loyal customer for several years, the service has progressively declined during my recent visits. Allow me to outline the specific issues I have encountered:

1) The receptionist barely acknowledged me, engrossed in her papers instead of making eye contact when greeting me and taking my order. She mumbled instructions for me to select a color and proceeded to loudly announce across the salon that I requested a manicure and pedicure.

2) Upon returning to the front desk with my chosen color, I noticed that a customer who arrived after me had already been seated in a pedicure chair, with water running, receiving service. Only when the receptionist saw me waiting did she arrange for a chair to be prepared. However, this resulted in no available nail technicians to attend to my needs.

3) Consequently, I found myself waiting in uncomfortably cold water for an extended period, hoping for a nail technician to become available.

4) The pedicure itself was unsatisfactory as the technician forcibly dug into my toes, a practice I detest, and hurriedly rushed through the massage portion of the service.

5) To add further disappointment, I discovered that the salon has raised their prices, unbeknownst to me until after the service was completed.

Previously, I chose this salon due to its convenient extended hours and Sunday availability. However, after enduring three consecutive dreadful experiences within the past three months, I have made the decision to refrain from continuing my patronage. With the frequent turnover of staff, the current employees fail to meet my expectations and provide the level of service I desire.

input: Boulevard Pizza is our go to place in the Sparks/Reno area. It looks like the decor has not changed since 1985, but who cares when they serve you a pizza this delicious! They have some fun arcade games for the kids.
Refine this for me please: Boulevard Pizza is unquestionably our favorite spot in the Sparks/Reno area. Despite its unchanged decor since 1985, the taste of their pizza makes it utterly irrelevant. Additionally, their inclusion of enjoyable arcade games makes it the perfect place for families with children.

input:
Probably the best coffee shop I've ever been to. Everything they make is great. Their pure black and draft latte are the best iced coffee drinks I've ever had, full stop. Their drip and espresso are also very tasty and strong. If you are in the area and love coffee you need to stop by this spot. 

Only complaint: the line can get absurdly long. However, the staff here is some of the best around and the line moves very quickly. On that note, service here is also very friendly.
Refine this for me please:
This coffee shop is, hands down, the best I've ever visited. Every drink they create is exceptional. Their pure black and draft latte iced coffee drinks are unparalleled, no question about it. Moreover, their drip and espresso options are incredibly flavorful and robust. If you happen to be in the area and share a passion for coffee, you simply must pay them a visit.

The only downside, albeit a minor one, is that the line can occasionally become unusually long. However, the exceptional staff here swiftly manages the queue, ensuring that it moves with astonishing speed. Additionally, the service provided by the staff is exceptionally friendly and welcoming.

input: I was very impressed! I had a plain glazed and a glazed with a lemon filling. I would go back again if I ever find myself in Indy.
Refine this for me please: I was thoroughly impressed by my experience! I indulged in a plain glazed donut as well as a glazed donut with a refreshing lemon filling. If I ever find myself in Indy again, I would definitely revisit.

input: The Food here is bomb.com on Wednesday they have 1.00 jumbo wings and they are really good and seasoned just right. The drink i fell in love with is the Dirty Lemonade, If you're in Indianapolis come visit this place.
Refine this for me please: The food at this place is absolutely amazing. Specifically, on Wednesdays, they serve superb jumbo wings for only $1.00 each. The wings are perfectly seasoned and incredibly delicious. Moreover, the Dirty Lemonade is a drink that stole my heart. If you ever find yourself in Indianapolis, I highly recommend visiting this place.

input: This may look like just a hole in the wall food establishment but if you judge on that alone, you'd be missing out. The food here is fantastic from the way it's prepared to the seasoning they use. Amazing gyros, fish and chicken in a variety of ways. Whatever you do, please try some dessert when you go.
Refine this for me please: Don't be fooled by its unassuming appearance, because this seemingly ordinary hole-in-the-wall food joint offers a dining experience that should not be overlooked. The exceptional quality of their food, from the meticulous preparation to the exquisite seasoning choices, will leave you in awe. Indulge in their mouthwatering gyros, delightful fish dishes, and delectable chicken options that are prepared with incredible versatility. And whatever you do, make sure not to miss out on their irresistible desserts when you visit.

input: Great job first day open packed but well organized me and my family will be back multiple times a week. Thanks for coming to reno.
Refine this for me please: Great job on your first day of being open! The place was packed, but it was well organized. My family and I had a fantastic time and we will definitely be coming back several times a week. Thank you for bringing your business to Reno!

input: This are awesome and so good! I love the BBQ pork one the best. The staff is so friendly. This is my first dive into Vietnamese cuisine and now I def. want to try more! The bubble tea is so good. I am glad there is another place in town to get the bubble tea. I never tried it before and I love it! They have fresh rolls that taste just as good as sit down Thai restaurants. I love that they will add extra jalapenos and usually not charge extra. They are fresh not pickled and sometimes has seeds which makes it even spicier which is good!! GO NOW! TO BAGUETTE DELI!!
Refine this for me please: This place is absolutely awesome! The BBQ pork is my favorite dish, and the staff is incredibly friendly. This was my first experience with Vietnamese cuisine, and now I'm definitely eager to try more! The bubble tea here is fantastic, and I'm glad to have found another spot in town that serves it. The fresh rolls are just as delicious as the ones you'll find at sit-down Thai restaurants. I love that they'll add extra jalapenos without charging extra. The jalapenos are fresh and not pickled, sometimes even having seeds which adds an extra kick of spiciness - which is great! Don't wait, go try Baguette Deli now!

input: I eat here at least once a month, and more often when possible.  The brisket tacos and brisket quesadillas are fantastic.  Happy hour starts at 3 if you're interested in a late lunch for 2-for-1 drinks.
Refine this for me please: I dine at this establishment at least once a month, and whenever possible, even more frequently. The brisket tacos and brisket quesadillas offered here are absolutely delightful. Additionally, if you happen to be interested, their happy hour begins promptly at 3 o'clock, providing an opportunity to enjoy a late lunch accompanied by 2-for-1 drinks.

input:
Xtreme Tacos has become one of my favorite places. Everything I have ever ordered has been DELICIOUS! We have probably gotten food between 8-10 times. I have e joyed everything! For sure, always have to get chips. Their homemade chips are to die for!! The salsa and quest are both excellent for dipping. 
Besides the delicious food, the people who work there are Xtremely friendly and helpful. The guy who is usually at the counter is so warm and welcoming!
Refine this for me please:
Xtreme Tacos has quickly become one of my absolute favorite dining destinations. In all my visits, I have never been disappointed with the delightful flavors that dance on my taste buds. I estimate that I have indulged in their delectable offerings approximately 8 to 10 times, and each experience has left me thoroughly satisfied. One item that I always make sure to order without fail is their divine homemade chips; they are simply irresistible! The accompanying salsa and queso add an extra layer of indulgence, making every bite a true pleasure.

What sets Xtreme Tacos apart from other establishments is not just their mouth-watering cuisine, but also the exceptional staff who make the experience truly remarkable. The gentleman who usually mans the counter greets patrons with a genuine warmth and hospitality that instantly puts one at ease. The level of friendliness and helpfulness exhibited by the entire team is simply outstanding.

In short, Xtreme Tacos has secured its place as a personal favorite due to their consistently delicious offerings and incredibly welcoming staff. It is a culinary haven that I wholeheartedly recommend to anyone seeking an exceptional dining experience.
