The highlight of my visit was undoubtedly the mouthwatering chocolate chip pancakes. However, the sausage side dish didn't quite impress me, although it's not their specialty. Interestingly, instead of paying at the table, they handle the payment at the door to ensure quick turnover, and it seems to be working as the line keeps moving pretty swiftly.

Rip: Since I drive by it every morning, I've discovered a helpful tip. If you want to avoid the queue, go right when they open or around 7:15.

input:
Came here for Sunday brunch and walked away with a very full belly and a good buzz! 

Their brunch buffet includes tons of seafood, an omelet station, pasta bar, carving station, custom sushi rolls, fresh fruit, salads, and the usually breakfast foods you'd expect at a buffet. I almost forgot dessert...an entire side of the room is dedicated to a table full of desserts AND a chocolate fountain. The brunch price also include bottomless mimosas which were literally bottomless. Our server never let us empty our glasses and  the mimosas were very heavy on the champagne, so we all got a bit tipsy. At least the alcohol let us forget how much weight we gained during this meal.

As if the buffet spread wasn't enough, they also have an a la carte menu with small dishes. The choices included Belgian waffles, french toast, blintzes, Mahi, and a few other savory dishes.  You can order as many of these items as you want, as many times as you want. Our server was sure to remind us of this, she seemed to enjoy watching how gluttonous our table was! 

Unfortunately we were here during Tropical Storm Debby, so we didn't get to enjoy a beautiful view of the bay, Although, being here while the weather was so awful was very cozy with the fireplace and wood interior. Thanks to the weather it wasn't crowded either, so don't write this place off on account of bad weather. 

At $35 a person, the Sunday brunch seems pricey, but if you have no qualms about overeating and overdrinking, you'll definitely get your money's worth.
Refine this for me please:
I had an amazing experience at this establishment for Sunday brunch. The buffet offered a wide selection of delicious seafood, an omelet station, a pasta bar, a carving station, custom sushi rolls, fresh fruit, salads, and all the classic breakfast dishes you would expect. The dessert section was also impressive, with a table filled with delectable treats and even a chocolate fountain. What made the experience even better was the fact that bottomless mimosas were included in the brunch price. The mimosas were generously poured and the champagne was quite strong, leaving us feeling a little tipsy. This was a good distraction from the guilt of indulging in such a feast.

In addition to the buffet, they also offered an à la carte menu with various small dishes to choose from, including Belgian waffles, French toast, blintzes, Mahi, and other savory options. Our server was quite accommodating, making sure we knew that we could order as many items as we wanted, as many times as we wanted. It was evident that she found our table's enthusiasm for food amusing.

Despite the unfortunate timing during Tropical Storm Debby, we were still able to enjoy the cozy ambiance of the restaurant with its fireplace and wood interior. The lack of crowds due to the bad weather was actually a pleasant surprise. So, even if the weather isn't ideal, don't dismiss this place.

At $35 per person, the Sunday brunch may seem a bit pricey, but if you have no reservations about indulging in a substantial meal and plenty of drinks, the experience is definitely worth the money.

input: We were on our way home from a camping trip and decided to stop in Santa Barbara for some fish taco's last Tuesday! We were trying to find a good place and found out that this was #2 on the list for Baja fish taco's. We were pleasantly surprised at our delicious our taco's turned out to be. We did want to try the shrimp fish taco's and asked if we could get 2 on the side. The kitchen was more than accommodating and gave us a whole platter of delicious battered shrimp. We sat outside on the veranda, enjoying our yummy food and the lovely December weather. The next time we are in Santa Barbara, we will definitely be making a pitstop here again.  The staff is also very friendly.
Refine this for me please: On our way back home from a camping trip, we made a spontaneous decision to stop by Santa Barbara last Tuesday for some mouthwatering fish tacos. After researching the top-rated spots, we discovered that this particular joint was highly recommended for its authentic Baja fish tacos, ranking second on the list. Much to our delight, the tacos surpassed our expectations in terms of taste and quality. Intrigued by the shrimp fish tacos, we inquired if it were possible to have two on the side. The kitchen staff was incredibly accommodating, generously serving us a platter full of delectable battered shrimp. Finding a spot on the veranda, we relished our scrumptious meal while basking in the pleasant December weather. Needless to say, when we inevitably find ourselves in Santa Barbara again, we'll definitely be revisiting this place. Not only is the food excellent, but the staff is also exceptionally friendly.

input:
I've been to Mount Laurel's On the Border over 50 times. I used to go to Don Pablo's but I fell in love with On the Border's chips and salsa (their chips are nice and salty, and their salsa is a little spicier).

When I go, 90% of the time I just sit at the bar and drink beer and snack on their chips and salsa. The beer specials are pretty good but could be a little better- weekdays has a happy hour as well as a late night happy hour too.

When I do dine, I often just enjoy a variety of vegetarian sides. Lately, I've grown to enjoy their cheese enchiladas, which I find delicious. Service when dining is usually great.

As for the bartenders, it's really hit-or-miss. Joann is probably my favorite- she's friendly, attentive, funny, and I've really gotten to know her, and I'd give them 5 stars if my experience was with her alone. There is a bartender named Nikki though, and if she's there, I always get the worst service. She barely checks on me/us to see how we're doing, she seems unfriendly, if she actually comes to refill your chips then she will not refill your salsa, she has taken my beer and refilled it without asking (when I was done and trying to leave), and I've had to wait forever to ask her for my check. At least twice, I've had to ask other bartenders to bring my check so that I could finally close out and leave. I'd give them 1 star if my experience was based on her alone.

Overall, good appetizers, cold beer, moderate prices, and usually good service.
Refine this for me please:
I have visited Mount Laurel's On the Border restaurant more than 50 times and prefer it over Don Pablo's due to their exceptional chips and salsa. The chips have a delightful saltiness, while the salsa offers a satisfying level of spiciness.

During most of my visits, I typically choose to sit at the bar and enjoy their beer selection along with the chips and salsa. While the beer specials are decent, they have room for improvement. On weekdays, they offer a happy hour as well as a late night happy hour option.

When I decide to dine in, I usually opt for a variety of vegetarian side dishes. Recently, I have discovered my love for their cheese enchiladas, which I find absolutely delicious. The service is usually great during my dining experiences.

However, the bar service can be inconsistent. Joann stands out as my favorite bartender; she is friendly, attentive, and has a great sense of humor. I have built a good rapport with her, and if my experience was solely based on her service, I would give the restaurant a five-star rating. On the other hand, Nikki, another bartender, consistently provides the worst service. She rarely checks on me or my table, appears unfriendly, neglects to refill the salsa when bringing more chips, takes away my empty beer without asking, and takes an excessively long time to bring the check. I have had to ask other bartenders on multiple occasions to retrieve my check so that I can finally settle the bill and leave. If my experience was solely influenced by Nikki's service, I would only give the restaurant a one-star rating.

In conclusion, On the Border offers delicious appetizers, a great selection of cold beers, reasonable prices, and generally good service, albeit with occasional inconsistencies.

input: This was a very busy place. Was told I had to try this place while I was in St Louis.  I was not disappointed. I got a peach shake that was amazing. The rest of my group tried a number of different options that they all enjoyed.  The wait was a little long especially on a very hot date. The prices were very reasonable.  The ordering at the window was confusing. Multiple windows with not a lot of direction of which line to get in and where to wait for the food. It's a great place to stop if you are in the area.
Refine this for me please: This place in St. Louis was recommended to me and it lived up to the hype. Despite being extremely busy, the service was impressive and the overall experience was enjoyable. Personally, I tried their incredible peach shake and it did not disappoint. The rest of my group also ordered various menu items and thoroughly enjoyed their choices. However, due to the high demand, the wait time was longer than expected, which was particularly challenging on a hot day. Nevertheless, the prices were reasonable and worth it. The only issue we encountered was the confusing ordering process at the window. With multiple windows and limited guidance, it was unclear which line to join and where to wait for the food. Nonetheless, if you happen to be in the area, it's definitely a great place to visit.

input: Delicious food, sub-par service. I stopped into this dessert bar today to grab some dessert and a coffee to-go. While everyone seemed to be very helpful, or at least wanting to be, I'm not sure I received the best possible service. I ordered two slices of cake, one marshmallow chocolate and one cheesecake. Both were DELICIOUS, but it seemed like I waited forever to receive these, and when i did, it was in a cute but inefficient manner. The to-go boxes were stacked one on top of the other, with a loosely tied string around them. While I admire the aesthetics here, I would have much preferred a bag. Though, the worst part of my experience was the barista. I ordered an iced coffee with milk and sugar. First, he put ice in the cup and filled it halfway with coffee. He then asked me to pick and put in my own sugars from a cup of packets as he stated "I wouldn't know what and how much you want, I only drink my coffee black." As I considered this incompetent statement, i expected him to then put more hot coffee in to help the sugar dissolve. But no, he proceeded to fill the rest of the HALF OF THE CUP with milk. And then handing me the drink he told me I'd better stir it to mix the cream and sugar in. Not sure why I'd paid such a high price to practically make my own half-coffee half-mild beverage, I simply smiled and walked away. I ended up throwing out the drink as I could hardly even taste the coffee and I'm not too fond of a lot of milk in my coffee. Nonetheless, the cakes were delicious, and I will be coming back with the hopes that this new business is still in the process of improving itself.
Refine this for me please:
I visited a dessert bar today to get some dessert and a coffee to-go. While the staff seemed willing to assist, the service left something to be desired. I ordered two slices of cake - marshmallow chocolate and cheesecake. Both cakes were absolutely delicious, but it took an unnecessarily long time to receive them, and when I finally did, they were presented in a charming yet inconvenient way. The to-go boxes were stacked with a loosely tied string, which was visually appealing but not practical. I would have preferred a bag for convenience. 

However, the biggest disappointment came from the barista. I ordered an iced coffee with milk and sugar. Initially, he put ice in the cup and filled it halfway with coffee. He then handed me a cup of sugar packets and asked me to add them myself, claiming he didn't know my preferences. I found this explanation to be inadequate as it is common for baristas to add sugar for customers. Instead of helping the sugar dissolve, he filled the remaining half of the cup with milk. He then told me to stir it myself to mix the cream and sugar. It was frustrating to pay a considerable amount for a beverage I had to practically make myself. Disappointed, I decided to throw away the drink as it had an overwhelming amount of milk and lacked the coffee flavor I desired.

Despite the sub-par service, the cakes were truly enjoyable. I remain hopeful that this new business will continue to improve itself, and I will give it another chance in the future.

input: I cannot say enough about the accommodations at the JW. I was working a trade show in the Grand Ballroom today and needed to pump as I am a new mom. Nathan was so quick to help as I was searching for a location that I could use. He opened up a boardroom for me to use and locked it behind me so I would not be disturbed. I know there was at least one other mom that was accommodated at the same time I was. All of the facilities, as well as the boardroom, were impeccably clean. I am so grateful for how kind and wonderful the staff was. Big kudos to the JW and the staff for making such awesome arrangements to support working moms- totally made my day!
Refine this for me please:
I can't emphasize enough how incredible my experience was with the accommodations at the JW. Today, while working at a trade show in the Grand Ballroom, I had an urgent need to pump as a new mom. Thankfully, Nathan, one of the staff members, went above and beyond to assist me. He promptly found a suitable location for me to use—a boardroom—and ensured my privacy by locking it behind me.

I was pleasantly surprised to learn that I wasn't alone in being accommodated during this time. Another mother was also provided with a space to meet her needs. Moreover, not only was the boardroom offered to us, but all the facilities at the JW were exceptionally clean and well-maintained.

I cannot express enough gratitude for the kindness and professionalism displayed by the entire staff. Their efforts truly made my day, and I was so grateful for their support. I want to give a special shoutout to the JW and their staff for going above and beyond to support working moms. It was an incredible experience that I won't soon forget.

input:
I visited Joe's on consecutive nights, one with a Living Social coupon.  The beef tacos on the appetizer menu were outstanding, and a great price which will ensure I order them every time I come.  Meatloaf and mashed potatoes were just as I expected; thankfully, no attempt to "fancy them up"; just tasty comfort food.  I asked for French dressing and bleu cheese crumbles on my salad, and they were generous with the cheese.  The salad was cold and fresh and crisp.

The reason I did not give five stars was the service. The first night, we weren't told of specials (ugh, saw them on the way out and would have ordered them!), and my friend's appetizer order was wrong. Drinks were not refilled often enough, and the waitress seemed uninformed about some of the items.  The next night, different waitress. We were one of only two tables, and still waited too long for her to return. She was unable to answer a question about a menu item, as well.

The place is beautiful, and the bathroom was clean and bright.  The menu offers many thoughtfully composed choices. Some of your servers are not up to par.
Refine this for me please:
During my recent visits to Joe's on consecutive nights, I had mixed experiences. On the positive side, I was delighted to find that the beef tacos on the appetizer menu were exceptional both in taste and value. They have become a definite go-to for me during future visits. Additionally, the meatloaf and mashed potatoes lived up to my expectations of comforting and delicious food, without any unnecessary embellishments.

However, I must mention that the service fell short of my expectations. On the first night, our server failed to inform us about the specials, which we discovered upon leaving and would have liked to try. Furthermore, my friend's appetizer order was incorrect. We also experienced a lack of attention to drink refills and our server seemed uninformed about certain menu items. On the second night, with a different server, we still encountered a prolonged wait for her return despite being one of only two occupied tables. Additionally, she was unable to answer a question regarding a specific menu item.

Despite these service issues, I must commend the beautiful ambiance of the restaurant and the cleanliness of the bathroom. The menu itself offers a variety of thoughtfully composed choices. However, it is evident that some of your servers are not meeting the expected standard.

input:
Food is excellent!
People are welcoming, choices are long list. Sandwiches have great meat in them. Hand made toasted ravioli is some of the best in town.
Refine this for me please: The food here is truly exceptional! Not only is the menu extensive, but the warm and inviting atmosphere created by the friendly staff adds to the overall experience. The sandwiches, in particular, are crafted with high-quality meats that are truly satisfying. Lastly, the hand-made toasted ravioli is undoubtedly one of the finest in town, leaving your tastebuds craving for more.

input: With all the talk of bbq tips, sweetie pie, etc of St. Louis...I decided to try this place after flying in. The customer service was great, they make their own BBQ sauce which is between a sweet, tangy with pinch of spice. It could be considered overpowering if not used to it. The pull pork sandwich was recommended along with beans and Cole slaw. Again, this could be too much for one who has never tried it and/or intake this type of food on a daily basis.
Refine this for me please:
After hearing so much about St. Louis' famous BBQ tips and sweetie pie, I finally decided to give it a try when I flew into the city. I must say, I was impressed by the excellent customer service at this place. They prided themselves on making their own BBQ sauce, which had a delightful blend of sweetness, tanginess, and just a hint of spice. However, I should note that the sauce might be overwhelming for those unaccustomed to such flavors.

One of the recommended items on the menu was the pulled pork sandwich, which was served alongside their deliciously smoky beans and creamy coleslaw. But I must caution that this combination might be a bit overwhelming for someone who has never tried this style of cuisine before or isn't accustomed to consuming it regularly in their diet.

input: They call a chicken salad sandwich two cubes of chicken with mayo in it and a salad with a salad that is a bowl Of lettuce a salad? Hmm left here hungry....
Refine this for me please: They label a chicken salad sandwich as two chunks of chicken mixed with mayo, served alongside a bowl of lettuce as a salad. It's rather puzzling—the lack of substantial flavor left me feeling unsatisfied and hungry.

input:
We had a very nice brunch here. The food was consistently quite good and the service was pretty efficient and courteous. The omelets were sumptuous, the beverages fun (including a bloody mary bar.. we did have to ask for fresh bacon as it had run out). 

I did the budget breakfast which hit the spot with scrambled eggs, roaster taters, and a sweet muffin. The fish tacos were also good. Nice al fresco dining on the patio.
Refine this for me please:
The brunch experience at this place was delightful. The quality of the food remained consistently high, and the service was efficient and polite. The omelets were exceptionally delicious, and the beverage selection, including a bloody mary bar, added a fun twist (although we had to request fresh bacon since it had run out). 

For a more budget-friendly option, I opted for the breakfast combo, which included scrambled eggs, roasted potatoes, and a tasty sweet muffin – it definitely hit the spot. Additionally, the fish tacos were quite enjoyable. Overall, the patio offered a lovely outdoor dining experience.

input: I would eat anything they served me. I haven't even had the pancakes yet and I'm sold. The line out the front door and down the sidewalk should be an indication that this place is awesome. I just had basic hashbrowns eggs and bacon, but it was so fab and the service was great! I will definitely go back and sit down to eat. Parking is a little difficult around there, but that's to be expected.
Refine this for me please: Please refine this for me: I am willing to try any dish they offer. I haven't even tasted their pancakes yet, but I am already convinced of their excellence. The long line extending outside the front door and onto the sidewalk is a clear indication of the awesomeness of this place. Despite only ordering basic hash browns, eggs, and bacon, the meal was incredibly delicious and the service was outstanding. I am definitely planning to return and enjoy a sit-down meal. Finding parking in that area might be a bit challenging, but it is to be expected.

input: I just got C & B's via Order Up Delivery Svc and what a perfect wintry in home dinner. I ordered the Swanky Frank w/ fries and completely enjoyed my loaded up frank. The fries had a little seasoning on them which added a nice touch. I also ordered a lg bowl of beef chili just because I had to have some chili from a chili house. It was nicely pkg'd and I plan on having a late night snack w/some chili later. I requested the sour cream and crackers on the side for warming. I would 100% suggest using Order Up for some cozy chili at home this winter!
Refine this for me please: I recently tried C & B's through Order Up delivery service, and it was the perfect winter dinner. I ordered the Swanky Frank with a side of fries and thoroughly enjoyed the delicious loaded frank. The fries had a hint of seasoning, which added to the overall experience. Additionally, I couldn't resist ordering a large bowl of their beef chili, considering they are renowned for their chili. It was well-packaged, and I plan on enjoying a late-night snack with some chili later. I specifically requested the sour cream and crackers on the side to warm them up. I highly recommend using Order Up to enjoy some cozy chili at home this winter.

input: Great rich food,  but a lil bit pricey.  Everything tastes wonderful but nothing stays the same the menu is always changing.  The most unique donuts you will find.
Refine this for me please: Experience a delectable array of rich and tantalizing cuisine, though with a slightly higher price point. Indulge in the delightful flavors that will excite your taste buds, yet be prepared for a perpetually evolving menu. Discover the unparalleled delight of the most distinctive and innovative donuts available.

input:
After visiting with friends and indulging in lots of tastes, consider this my next order at Livery:

(01) Carriage House Margarita with its brandy twist
(02) All of the empanadas because I have no shame
(03) The Red Drum - it's a lovely fish dish, and it's a way to get a taste of the yuca fries.
(04) Churros (Take my advice and don't split 'em with anyone.)

Feel free to copy my order on your visit.
Refine this for me please:
Here's a refined version:

After a delightful time spent with friends, exploring a variety of flavors, I present my recommended order for your visit to Livery:

1. Start your culinary journey with the Carriage House Margarita, which boasts a delightful brandy twist.
2. Embrace your indulgent side and delight in the assortment of empanadas. Don't hold back; there's no shame in savoring every single one.
3. For a delectable seafood experience, treat yourself to The Red Drum, a delightful fish dish. This choice also offers a wonderful opportunity to savor the scrumptious yuca fries.
4. Conclude your meal on a sweet note with the irresistible churros. Trust me, it's best not to share them; you'll want them all to yourself.

Please feel free to replicate my order during your visit. Enjoy!

input:
My son and I went in for burgers after a long day's drive returning him to Nashville for the upcoming semester. We were in need of immediate sustenance after a long fast. What we found was a busy place that actually knew how to operate with a full house. Our need were quickly satisfied with courteous and reasonably priced service. 

Since we were just two, we were quickly seated. We started off with a couple Highland stouts. It was a nice drink and at a reasonable price. Before our entree, we shared a large garden salad. It was fresh and flavorful. The dressing was a bit on the heavy side for a vinaigrette. 

For entrees, I had the Black and Blue burger with fries. The burger was just incredible. It was perfectly cooked. The blue cheese was not overpowering. The bun was soft and fresh. The side of regular fries were crisp and lightly salted. Even better, they went perfectly with the homemade ketchup. I'm not a fan of ketchup, but theirs is very nice since they seem to avoid adding too much sweetness. My son had a basic burger with sweet potato fries. I tried the sweet potato fries and think they might be some of the best I've ever eaten. The burger looked as good as mine and my son concurred. 

The burger was well made and consumed within minutes. No words were spoken as we ate. Always a good sign. We shall return.
Refine this for me please:
Refined version: 
After a tiring day of driving my son back to Nashville for the new semester, we decided to grab burgers for a quick and satisfying meal. We stumbled upon a bustling restaurant that efficiently managed to serve a full house. Our needs were promptly met with friendly service at reasonable prices. 

As there were only two of us, we were promptly seated. To start, we ordered a couple of Highland stouts, which were enjoyable and reasonably priced. Before our main course, we shared a generous portion of fresh and flavorsome garden salad. The vinaigrette dressing was on the heavier side, however.

For our entrees, I opted for the Black and Blue burger with fries. The burger was absolutely incredible, perfectly cooked with just the right amount of blue cheese that didn't overpower the flavors. The bun was soft and fresh. The regular fries served on the side were crispy and lightly salted, complemented by their homemade ketchup that had just the right balance of sweetness. I'm usually not a fan of ketchup, but theirs was quite impressive. My son chose a classic burger with sweet potato fries. I tried the sweet potato fries and found them to be some of the best I've ever had. The burger looked equally delicious and my son agreed. 

The burgers were expertly crafted and devoured within minutes. The fact that we didn't exchange a single word while eating speaks volumes about our satisfaction. We definitely plan on returning.

input: Nothing more to say than this is the BEST donut place ever. I literally wished they shipped their products. When I moved to Florida, I missed it so much. It's only in New Orleans... sad face!
Refine this for me please: There's simply no denying it - this is hands down the ultimate donut destination. I genuinely yearned for their delectable treats to be available nationwide. Ever since my relocation to Florida, I've been incredibly nostalgic for this place. Unfortunately, it's exclusively situated in New Orleans... a major disappointment!

input: Katie's is a neighborhood restaurant that has existed in one form or another for a few generation.  It's classic New Orleans fare with an Italian-American slant.  Great meatballs.  You'll see all types of classic New Orleans old people dinging before 8pm.   You won't be disappointed if your expectations aren't too high.
Refine this for me please: Katie's is a beloved neighborhood restaurant that has been passed down through generations. It specializes in serving classic New Orleans cuisine with an Italian-American twist, showcasing exceptional meatballs. The delightful ambiance encompasses a charming mix of old-fashioned New Orleans charm, with earlier diners being mainly local seniors who typically come in before 8pm. Although it's important to set reasonable expectations, you are unlikely to leave disappointed.

input: Excellent service! They were super fast, friendly and professional.  This is now my go to place for oil changes
Refine this for me please: Their service was exceptional! The staff was not only incredibly efficient and quick, but also extremely friendly and professional. I now consider this place my top choice for oil changes.

input:
If you're a Latino, you're best staying away from this place.
The lady that cut my hair was rude and very unprofessional.
Refine this for me please: It would be preferable for Latinos to avoid this establishment as my personal experience encountered a discourteous and highly unprofessional hair stylist.

input: This place should be on Restaurant Impossible. It's run down, the decor is tacky, beaten up, miss-matched and cheap. It's really dark...probably to hide how dingy it is. Everything was sticky. I ordered a burger medium and got a charred, tasteless hockey puck. My mom and aunt got the baked crab soup, which before we ordered, we misheard each other and called it baked crap soup. It turned out to be a better description. The crab stuffed mushrooms were heavy on the stuff and light on the crab.  The servers were super nice though.
Refine this for me please:
This place is desperately in need of a Restaurant Impossible makeover. The interior is in shambles, with tacky, worn-out, and mismatched decor that only adds to the cheap atmosphere. The dim lighting seems more like an attempt to disguise the dinginess rather than create ambiance. To make matters worse, everything felt sticky, further adding to the overall unappealing experience.

When I ordered a burger cooked medium, I received a charred, flavorless hockey puck instead. It was a major disappointment. As for my mom and aunt, they made a funny miscommunication when referring to the baked crab soup as "baked crap soup" before ordering. It turns out that this description was actually quite accurate, as the soup failed to impress.

To add insult to injury, the crab stuffed mushrooms were disappointingly lacking in crab and overloaded with filler. However, despite the shortcomings in the food, the servers were surprisingly pleasant and accommodating.

input:
What can I say?  I'm a sucker for new american.  The owner is a very nice gentleman who really enjoys food.  

The service was impeccable and the food was Ridiculously good.  We ordered a mixed berry waffle, huevo rancho, traditional breakfast bagel with grits, and best sandwich with fresh fruits.  

I highly recommend the huevo rancho and best sandwich.  The grits was very good as well. 

If you decide to visit this restaurant, say hi to the owner.  He's a great guy.
Refine this for me please:
I have a weakness for new American cuisine, so it's no surprise that I loved this place. The owner, a genuinely nice gentleman, is clearly passionate about food.

The service was flawless, and the food was beyond amazing. We indulged in a mixed berry waffle, huevo rancho, a traditional breakfast bagel with a side of grits, and their signature best sandwich accompanied by fresh fruits.

I highly recommend trying the huevo rancho and their best sandwich, which were both outstanding. The grits were also a delight.

If you have the chance to dine at this restaurant, be sure to say hello to the owner, as he is an exceptional individual.

input: Great place for happy hour. Oysters were deLISH! My friend and I had 2 dozen and we had some cocktails! The riverbend and champagne au poir we quite tasty. I had a side of fries and she had a side a grits. Best grits I've eaten. Definitely coming back. The server was great too. Just the right amount of attention!
Refine this for me please: This place is a fantastic choice for happy hour! The oysters were absolutely delicious, and my friend and I couldn't resist ordering two dozen. We complemented our meal with some delightful cocktails, particularly enjoying The Riverbend and Champagne au Poir. As for our sides, I had the fries while my friend opted for the grits. I must say, those were the best grits I've ever had! Needless to say, we will definitely be returning. Additionally, our server provided outstanding service, striking the perfect balance of attentiveness.

input:
The crew at Bella Vista Designs are FABULOUS.  From start to finish, they are professional, conscientious, and innovative (and affordable!).  They never cease to amaze me with their can-do attitude and absolutely gorgeous and creative design. 

The events at Santa Barbara Historical Museum and Goleta Valley Historical Society that I produce attract generous donors and they always say the same thing when they see their work, "Wow!!"  

I can't thank them enough for the hundreds of successful events (and the many magical moments we've seen)!
Refine this for me please:
The crew at Bella Vista Designs is absolutely exceptional. Throughout every step of the process, they exhibit an unwavering commitment to professionalism, attentiveness, and ingenuity (all at an affordable price!). Their can-do attitude and consistently stunning and imaginative designs never fail to impress me.

The events I produce at Santa Barbara Historical Museum and Goleta Valley Historical Society consistently draw in generous donors, who are consistently left in awe by Bella Vista Design's work, often exclaiming, "Wow!"

I cannot express enough gratitude to Bella Vista Designs for their countless contributions to our success, having orchestrated hundreds of flawless events and creating countless magical moments.

input: Moved to Tucson and needed a new dentist, everything went great here!
Refine this for me please: After relocating to Tucson, I was in search of a new dentist, and I'm pleased to say that my experience here has been exceptional!

input: Highly, highly overrated.  The food was a C minus at best.  And the service was so bad that I may never go back.  They screwed up my order completely and my no apologies.  There are a lot of other options around State Street.  Avoid this place like the plague.
Refine this for me please: This place is extremely overrated. The quality of the food was questionable at best, earning a C minus grade. Moreover, the service was abysmal, to say the least. They completely messed up my order without a single apology. Considering the abundance of other options available on State Street, I strongly advise avoiding this place altogether.

input:
Couldn't say it better than the below poster. Excellent food, service and prices.

Located where Mugshots used to be (RIP), one of my coworkers had been raving about this place, in particular the falafel and of course the very kind owner.

Went with my pre-wife and we shared beef gyro (carved) pita, falafel pita and hummus plate. Everything was extremely fresh (I concur on the crisp lettuce) well seasoned and just plain delicious.  A lot of food as well and complimentary baklava. We took our leftovers home (I wrapped the two remaining bites of my gyro - it's that good)

I highly recommend this place and you'll definitely walk out with a smile. I think this spot is still relatively unknown and I very rarely post reviews. This is a unique spot to Manayunk and I will be referring all of my friends as I really want the restaurant to succeed - because the owner deserves it and of course for my selfish appetite!
Refine this for me please:
Here's a refined version of the text:

Located in the former space of Mugshots, this place comes highly recommended by a coworker of mine. The food here is excellent, with a special mention for the falafel and the friendly owner.

On my visit with my partner, we tried the beef gyro (carved) pita, falafel pita, and hummus plate. Everything was incredibly fresh, well-seasoned, and simply delicious. The portions were generous, and we even received complimentary baklava. We were so impressed with the food that we took our leftovers home (I couldn't resist saving the last two bites of my gyro).

I wholeheartedly suggest giving this place a try. It's not very well-known yet, and I rarely write reviews, but I believe this spot is something special in Manayunk. I'll be recommending it to all of my friends because the owner truly deserves success, and, selfishly, I want more opportunities to indulge my appetite here!

input: Great food and excellent service. Only knock I would give them was they brought out our entrees about 10 minutes after our apps came so we were still eating that, otherwise great experience
Refine this for me please: The overall experience was great, thanks to the excellent service and delicious food. The only minor issue we encountered was that our entrees arrived around 10 minutes after we had already started our appetizers. However, this didn't detract from an otherwise fantastic dining experience.

input:
This is a very mediocre place.  The location itself is in the same dirty strip mall as Mozzarella Pizza. The inside has that "we don't really care about the looks" feel to it.  It's not dirty, per se.  It just doesn't look very clean.  Everything looks like its falling apart.  It probably gets its business from suburbanites like me craving what we think of as Chinese food.

All that said, the food I had was palatable.  Nothing outstanding or amazing: it was just all right.  I won't recommend against it, but it's nothing that you would think of as that great either.
Refine this for me please:
This place is rather average, located within a not-so-clean strip mall alongside Mozzarella Pizza. The interior has an overall neglected appearance, giving off the impression that aesthetics are not a priority. While not necessarily dirty, it lacks cleanliness and many items seem to be deteriorating. It likely attracts customers like myself, suburbanites craving what we perceive as Chinese cuisine.

Having said that, the food I tried was decent. It wasn't exceptional or remarkable; it simply met expectations. I wouldn't discourage trying it, but it's not something you would consider truly outstanding either.

input: Phenomenal place to eat. I has the Hickory burger, that was so damn delicious!! Will be coming back for sure!!!
Refine this for me please: Absolutely phenomenal place to eat! I had the mouthwatering Hickory burger and I cannot stress enough how incredibly delicious it was. The flavors were impeccable! Needless to say, I will definitely be coming back for more.

input: After having been here, I would say that the food had great flavors for the taste buds and it was a unique experience.  Our server, Brian was no doubt a foodie... I've never seen anyone get so excited about food and discuss the ingredients in such detail with so much passion.  The food really was different and had unbelievable flavor.  Anyone who calls themselves a foodie should try this place.  I'm thinking they would be pleased with this place.  But, the portions were small.  And I really didn't like the interior of the restaurant.  I'm more of a booths girl.  Booths can be classy, you know?  All in all, I would say this was an interesting place and I would come back, but the dishes were too complicated for me to want to come back beyond once a year.  Speaking of timing, the chefs change the menu every year.  And these guys really are good at what they do.  The owners actually own the Red Pony and two other restaurants all on the same street!  And they're all doing well.
Refine this for me please:
After visiting this establishment, I must say that the food offered a delightful array of flavors that truly tantalized the taste buds, creating a truly unique dining experience. Our server, Brian, was undeniably a food enthusiast, displaying an unparalleled level of excitement and passion while discussing the intricate details of each dish. The food itself was distinct, boasting an unimaginably rich flavor profile. In my opinion, any self-proclaimed food connoisseur should make it a point to experience this remarkable place; they are bound to be thoroughly impressed.

However, it is worth noting that the portion sizes were rather small, and the interior design of the restaurant failed to appeal to my personal preferences. As someone who leans towards more traditional booth-style seating, I find that booths can exude a certain elegance. Despite these drawbacks, I still find this establishment interesting and would consider returning. However, I must admit that the complexity of the dishes may deter me from visiting more than once a year.

Furthermore, I discovered that the menu at this establishment undergoes an annual change, showcasing the impressive talent and skill of their chefs. Interestingly, the owners also possess the Red Pony and two other successful restaurants located along the same street, a testament to their culinary prowess and business acumen.

input:
Solid improvement since last visit.  

Service- much improved.  Kid named Dillon gave a great service.  

Ambiance is very casual.  Order and sit, they bring food to you. 

Food- tasty and lots of options.  Not fancy.  Very affordable.  

Family of four for about 30$.  That's a great deal w today's prices. 

If you are looking for a fast, casual Asian option, give this place a try.
Refine this for me please:
There has been a significant improvement since my last visit to this establishment. The service has greatly improved, with one particular staff member named Dillon providing excellent service. The ambiance is notably casual, where patrons can simply order and sit, and have their food brought to them.

The food offered here is both delicious and diverse, with plenty of options to choose from. It is important to note that the food is not overly fancy, but it is incredibly affordable. In fact, a family of four can enjoy a meal for approximately $30, which is an exceptional deal considering today's prices.

If you are in search of a swift and informal Asian dining experience, I highly recommend giving this place a try.

input: Use the yelp app to get on the waiting list, we went on a Saturday morning and it was very busy, but the waiting list was cut down significantly by using the app. The menu is expansive, a lot of options. The cinnamon French toast was very good. The traditional breakfast foods were on par with most breakfast joints, but the extras on the menu can keep you busy for many visits trying new things. The strawberry orange juice was excellent so I recommend trying it. It was a little hot in the restaurant, could have been cooled down a lot for a more comfortable experience. The service was very good. There were two places to pay at the counter which I thought was a nice way to speed up the leaving process.
Refine this for me please:
Here's the refined version:

To reduce wait times, I highly recommend using the Yelp app to get on the waiting list. We visited on a busy Saturday morning, but the app significantly shortened our wait time. The menu offers a wide variety of options, and the cinnamon French toast was particularly delicious. While the traditional breakfast dishes were on par with other breakfast joints, the additional items on the menu provide plenty of variety for future visits. Make sure to try the strawberry orange juice as it was excellent. However, it was a bit warm inside the restaurant, and it would have been more comfortable if the temperature was lowered. The service provided was excellent, and I appreciated the convenience of having two payment areas at the counter, which expedited the checkout process.

input:
Visited Shaving Grace on Friday for a hair cut.

Same vibe as my old Barber Shop in Philly. 
Big TV in the waiting area. Plush couch to relax in. Young lady checking me in asked if I wanted water, soda or a beer.
Beer? Need I say more. 

Great cut. Great bunch of guys discussing current events, sports, and what's happening around town.
Found my new spot. 

Will be back.
Refine this for me please:
I had an amazing experience at Shaving Grace on Friday when I went in for a haircut. It reminded me of the same cozy atmosphere that my old Barber Shop in Philly had. The waiting area had a big TV and a comfy plush couch, perfect for relaxation. As I checked in, a friendly young lady offered me a choice of water, soda, or even a beer to enjoy during my visit. I couldn't resist the temptation of a beer!

Not only did I leave with a great haircut, but the camaraderie among the guys at Shaving Grace was fantastic. They engaged in lively conversations about current events, sports, and everything happening around town. It truly felt like a welcoming and inclusive place.

Needless to say, I have found my new go-to spot for haircuts. I am definitely looking forward to coming back in the future.

input: Not only was the food excellent, but the people here are beyond nice-and genuine. I had eggs Benedict. The poached eggs were good but the toast they were sitting on was excellent. We were given a cream pancakes to taste test by our awesome server, Tina. I can honestly say it was the best pancake I've ever tasted. So full of flavour-vanilla, and soft aa pillow.  They melted in my mouth. I didn't even use syrup. Stellar!
Refine this for me please: The food here is not only excellent, but the people are incredibly kind and genuine. I ordered eggs Benedict, which featured perfectly poached eggs on top of incredibly delicious toast. Our amazing server, Tina, even treated us to a sample of their exceptional cream pancakes. I can confidently say that it was the best pancake I have ever had. Bursting with flavor, especially vanilla, and incredibly soft like a pillow, they practically melted in my mouth. I didn't even need syrup to enhance their stellar taste.

input: Great service. My husband ordered a cheese and bacon burger and I got the crawfish sausage por bo both well made and great tasting.
Refine this for me please: The service was exceptional. My husband ordered a delectable cheese and bacon burger, while I opted for the flavorful crawfish sausage por bo. Both dishes were meticulously prepared and bursting with delightful flavors.

input: Had a wonderful experience with JT and Ashley Furniture store!! He was helpful even when I had to change my order.
Refine this for me please: Had an exceptional experience with JT at Ashley Furniture store! He went above and beyond to assist me, even when I needed to make changes to my order.

input:
While at Drexel University, I decided to try a new food truck and go for something that wasn't the typical food truck.  My girlfriend and I always noticed this place was crowded around lunch but never knew why.  After being recommended to try it by a friend, we decided to go ahead and order lunch here.  Cucina Zapata is at the end of the food truck row at the center of Drexel University's campus.  The truck has a graffiti style design which can be easily distinguished from the other food trucks here.

I decided to order (2) thai short rib tacos while my girlfriend got the cap'n crunch tilapia burrito.  The food has a good visual appearance which made us more eager to eat it once we got inside the building.  I really enjoyed the thai short rib tacos even though they put hot sauce on it.  They were definitely better than the typical taco bell food and left me with a 5 star review feeling inside.  My girlfriend also really enjoyed her burrito.

Overall, this food truck provides very good food at a good price.  I recommend this place to anyone looking for a good lunch.
Refine this for me please:
During my time at Drexel University, I decided to venture outside my comfort zone and try something different from the typical food trucks on campus. One food truck that caught my attention was Cucina Zapata, always bustling with customers during lunchtime. Intrigued by the crowd, my girlfriend and I finally took the plunge and decided to give it a try. Nestled at the end of the food truck row, Cucina Zapata stood out with its distinctive graffiti-style design, setting it apart from its counterparts.

I opted for the Thai short rib tacos, while my girlfriend went for the adventurous choice of the Cap'n Crunch tilapia burrito. As our meals arrived, their visually appealing presentation only heightened our anticipation. Despite my initial concern about the hot sauce on the tacos, I found them to be a delightful surprise, surpassing the standard fare offered by chains like Taco Bell. The flavors were well-balanced and left me with a sense of satisfaction deserving of a five-star review. My girlfriend, too, thoroughly enjoyed her burrito.

All in all, Cucina Zapata offers delectable food at a reasonable price point. If you're searching for a fulfilling lunchtime experience, I highly recommend giving this food truck a visit.

input: got my haircut here for the first time Jessie Becker took the damaged ends off. She's so sweet and does only what you ask of her. She's also great with kids. come see this place and come see her.
Refine this for me please: I recently had my first haircut at this place, where Jessie Becker skillfully removed my damaged ends. Jessie is not only sweet but also attentive to your preferences, ensuring she only does what you ask of her. I was impressed by her skill in working with children too. I highly recommend visiting this place to experience Jessie's excellent service.

input: Great ramen! I'm really happy to have found this place! The service and food are both wonderful!
Refine this for me please: This place serves amazing ramen! I am absolutely thrilled to have discovered it. The stellar service and delectable food make for a truly delightful experience.

input: Cute place, nice servers and good food but dish sizes are waaaaay too small. I left unsatisfied. I don't like it when restaurants are cheap with portions, especially neighborly ones!
Refine this for me please: This place is really cute, with friendly servers and delicious food. However, I have to say that the dish sizes were disappointingly small. I left feeling unsatisfied, which is always frustrating. I personally don't appreciate it when restaurants skimp on portions, especially ones in the neighborhood that you expect to be generous.

input: Just recently ate here for the first time. The hype was real. My girlfriend had the Greek Salad while I ordered the Chickpea Vegetarian Pita and they were kind enough to allow for some substitutions. The food was on point and portions were very filling and satisfying. Great staff and environment. Will definitely be back again!
Refine this for me please: I recently had the opportunity to dine at this restaurant for the first time, and let me tell you, it definitely lived up to the hype. My girlfriend opted for the Greek Salad, while I decided to try the Chickpea Vegetarian Pita. The staff was incredibly accommodating, allowing us to make some substitutions to our dishes. Not only was the food delicious, but the portions were generous and left us feeling completely satisfied. The friendly and attentive staff only enhanced the dining experience, and the overall environment was fantastic. Needless to say, we will definitely be returning in the future.

input: First time here. Great bar and restaurant area. Open floor plan with plenty of TV's to watch the game. Attached to their O'Fallon brewery (in Maryland Heights, Missouri, a suburb of St. Louis). They ranked 2nd in the St Louis area last year for volume of beer sold by a micro brewery. Today, I tried the House Special IPA...a wonderful IPA, not too bitter, just right. Look for Troy behind the bar! (The only reason for 4 stars is no desserts....)
Refine this for me please:
This was my first time visiting this fantastic bar and restaurant. The open floor plan and multitude of TVs make it an ideal spot to enjoy the game. What sets this place apart is its connection to the renowned O'Fallon brewery, conveniently located in Maryland Heights, Missouri, a suburb of St. Louis. It's worth noting that they achieved an impressive 2nd place ranking for the volume of beer sold by a microbrewery in the St. Louis area last year.

During my visit, I had the pleasure of trying their House Special IPA, and it truly exceeded my expectations. This IPA strikes a perfect balance, offering a delightful flavor without overpowering bitterness. If you stop by, I highly recommend seeking out Troy behind the bar for exceptional service.

The only reason I couldn't give this place a full 5-star rating is the absence of desserts.

input: This is a neighbourhood dive bar on the eastern part of Whyte Avenue.  It's in a strip mall on a one way eastbound side street.  I was there on a Saturday night to check it out. Very average decor with a couple pool tables and a foosball table. It's definitely a younger crowd here.  They had a band and a doorman.  Drinks were reasonable.  A few tv screens.  The wings are always really cheap and come with a carrot and celery stick.  They make pizzas which looked good and cheesy but I did not try. Servers were quite young and pleasant.  The owner gal behind the bar was fine.  I gave it an extra star because I found the previous review a little harsh.
Refine this for me please:
Located on the eastern part of Whyte Avenue, this neighborhood dive bar can be found in a strip mall along a one-way eastbound side street. As I visited on a Saturday night, I noticed the decor to be quite average, featuring a couple of pool tables and a foosball table. The establishment tends to attract a younger crowd and even had a band performing that evening, with a doorman present.

Drinks were reasonably priced, and there were a few TV screens scattered around for entertainment. One particular highlight was the irresistibly cheap wings, always served with a side of carrot and celery sticks. Although I didn't try it myself, I couldn't help but notice the delicious-looking, cheesy pizzas they make.

Servers were young but pleasant, while the owner gal behind the bar seemed fine. I felt the need to give this place an extra star as I found the previous review somewhat harsh.

input:
Came here tired of going to buffets and other buffets like locations. This was a few minutes walk from the Peppermill too.

The place was next to a few auto repair places and most likely are patronized by them. The food is but a low-quality Chinese food. They couldn't get our orders right the 1st time around and the 2nd time ordered a simple dish that tasted completely nasty.
Refine this for me please:
I was exhausted from continually going to buffets and buffet-style establishments, so I decided to try something different. Luckily, this place was just a short stroll away from the Peppermill.

Located in close proximity to a few auto repair shops, it seemed apparent that the local mechanics frequented this place. However, the quality of the Chinese cuisine turned out to be disappointingly subpar. To make matters worse, they managed to mess up our orders on the first attempt, and when we tried again, the dish we received tasted absolutely dreadful.

input: I had a small snafu with the Yelp coupon but after that? Food....and it was excellent.  The chicken caeser salad was great and heavy on the chicken.  The subs were fresh and tasty.   And, yes, they have beer!   But I had an old-fashioned Dr. Brown's cream soda because they have all their flavors.   Nicely located.   Just a mile from the Wagon Wheel flea market.
Refine this for me please: Despite a small issue with the Yelp coupon, everything turned out well. The food at this place was absolutely excellent. The chicken caesar salad was particularly impressive, generously packed with chicken. The subs were fresh and flavorful, and to top it off, they even offer a variety of beer options. However, I decided to go for an old-fashioned Dr. Brown's cream soda, as they have an extensive selection of flavors. The location is convenient, situated just a mile away from the Wagon Wheel flea market.

input: I had an amazingly positive experience here. Dr. Neel and Robin were friendly, knowledgable and exceptionally helpful. They were patient in answering all my questions, helped me pick out some cool Lucky Brand frames and fitted me for contact lenses. The best optometrist I've seen. I highly recommend them.
Refine this for me please: I had an exceptionally positive experience at this place. Dr. Neel and Robin were not only friendly but also very knowledgeable and extremely helpful. They patiently addressed all my questions, assisted me in selecting some amazing Lucky Brand frames, and successfully fitted me for contact lenses. In my opinion, they are the best optometrists I have encountered. I highly recommend them.

input: By far the best breakfast I have had in a while. Huge pancakes. Simple home fries with not all the extras. The owner is super sweet and really generous. Deffinetly a new favorite.
Refine this for me please: I recently had the best breakfast in a long time and it was truly outstanding. The highlight was definitely the huge pancakes that were absolutely delicious. Alongside, I enjoyed simple yet flavorful home fries without any unnecessary extras. What made the experience even more enjoyable was the owner's delightful personality and his unparalleled generosity. This breakfast spot has quickly become my new favorite.

input:
Stayed here with the family for six nights on a trip to the Big Easy. A beautiful and charming place to stay. The staff from the doorman to the wait staff for brunch were  friendly and helpful.  The Carousel Bar is a must. 

Great location, will be going back there for sure next time we are in New Orleans.
Refine this for me please: During our family trip to the Big Easy, we had the pleasure of staying at this charming and beautiful establishment for six nights. From the doorman to the wait staff for brunch, the entire staff was exceedingly friendly and helpful. One cannot miss experiencing the Carousel Bar during their stay. The location is fantastic, and we definitely plan on returning here on our next visit to New Orleans.

input: I ordered the chicken stew, it was Tasteless chicken, it was a fried chicken possibly a leftover, that was thrown into a pot and made it into a stew.  If I wanted leftovers, I would have eaten at home.  Gross, still feel like I have to throw up.
Refine this for me please: I was disappointed with the chicken stew I ordered. The chicken lacked flavor and seemed to be fried, possibly a leftover piece that was thrown into the pot to create a stew. If my intention was to consume leftovers, I would have preferred to eat at home. The overall experience was unpleasant, and it still makes me feel nauseous.

input:
I've been having a terrible time in St Louis finding a decent Chinese place that is within delivery or easy take out range of our house. This time I tried Wei Hong. I told my partner it can't be any worse than the other mediocre places we have been going. I was wrong.
The take out service was fast for a Sat night. We were there within 20 minutes of ordering and it was ready. But the dining room was empty. For a Sat night that should have been a big clue. The rest of the places in the neighborhood were busy.
The steamed dumplings could have been great. The tasted homemade and the filling was good. However, they were so doughy with a really thick wrapper too thick that it detracted from the good filling. Everything else went downhill from there. 
The beef and broccoli was inedible. The beef had an awful weird texture. Like it was boiled and was gelatinous.  The sauce on it had off flavors. We literally scraped it off our plates and threw the whole thing out.  The meat in both the general Tao's chicken and the orange beef also had weird textures. It was mushy and the coating was thick on those as well. The flavors in the sauces would have been fine, but they were gloopy.  The fried rice was fair but nothing memorable.
We won't be going back.
Refine this for me please:
I had a terrible experience in St. Louis trying to find a decent Chinese restaurant that offers delivery or easy take-out near our house. Out of desperation, I decided to give Wei Hong a chance, thinking it couldn't be worse than the mediocre places we've previously tried. Unfortunately, I was proven wrong.

Although the take-out service was quite fast for a Saturday night, it was alarming to see an empty dining room. This should have been a clear indication of the restaurant's quality compared to the neighboring establishments.

Initially, the steamed dumplings seemed promising. They had a homemade taste and the filling was flavorful. However, they were disappointingly doughy with an excessively thick wrapper, which distracted from the positive aspects. From there, every other dish went downhill.

The beef and broccoli dish was virtually inedible. The beef had an odd and unpleasant texture, resembling gelatinous boiled meat. In addition, the sauce had off-flavors that further contributed to the unappetizing experience. We ended up scraping the dish off our plates and throwing it away. Both the general Tao's chicken and orange beef suffered from similar issues with the meat's texture, as it was mushy, and the coating was overly thick. Although the sauces themselves had potential, they were excessively gloopy. The fried rice, on the other hand, was mediocre and failed to leave a lasting impression.

Considering our dismal experience, we have no intention of ever returning to Wei Hong.

input: Big shout out to Cecile for helping us load our plywood as we got ready for IRMA. Thanks so much!
Refine this for me please: A huge thank you to Cecile for her tremendous assistance in helping us load our plywood as we prepared for the arrival of Hurricane IRMA. We are incredibly grateful for her support.

input: The food was outstanding.  I got chicken tagine, with the delicious tender meat falling off the bone, and carrot salad, flavored with mint and cumin.  Service was good, and the inside of the restaurant is cheerful and well-lit.  Total cost was around $13.
Refine this for me please: The food at the restaurant was exceptional. I ordered the chicken tagine, which consisted of incredibly tender meat that practically melted off the bone. The dish was accompanied by a delightful carrot salad infused with refreshing hints of mint and cumin. The service provided was also commendable, ensuring a pleasant dining experience. Additionally, the restaurant's interior exuded a cheerful and well-lit ambiance. Remarkably, despite the high quality of the meal, the total cost amounted to approximately $13.

input:
After reading a lot of positive reviews, we were really excited to try this place. We were extremely disappointed in the food. I'm going to give the place the benefit of the doubt that it is not always like this as we came in at 10 PM, but if you cannot offer quality food at that hour then don't have your kitchen open. 
All of our food came out within 5 to 10 minutes of ordering which leads me to believe it was not made fresh. The Caesar salad was room temperature and overdressed. The hush puppies were flavorless, and the chicken wings (3 full wings is a serving) were undercooked and barely warm. The only redeeming food item was the chicken and biscuits, which had a nice flavor profile- the biscuit was again, cold in spots. 

On the positive side the place has a nice hip atmosphere and the service is friendly. 

Unfortunately, the food was so sub par we would not consider dining here again.
Refine this for me please:
After reading numerous positive reviews, our anticipation to try this place was high. However, our experience with the food left us extremely disappointed. While we understand that our visit at 10 PM may not reflect the restaurant's usual standards, if the kitchen cannot maintain the quality of their food at that hour, they should consider closing it.

One major concern was the speed at which our food arrived after ordering, as it indicated that the dishes were not prepared fresh. The Caesar salad was served at room temperature and overly dressed, while the hush puppies lacked any distinct flavor. Furthermore, the chicken wings, which were served as a portion of three full wings, were undercooked and barely warm. The only redeeming dish was the chicken and biscuits, which had a pleasing flavor profile, although again the biscuit was cold in some areas.

On the positive side, the establishment boasted a stylish and vibrant atmosphere, and the service provided was friendly.

Regrettably, due to the subpar quality of the food, we will not consider dining at this place again.

input: For the time and effort I put into ordering online 30 minutes before my pickup, I was pretty disappointed to skip the long line only to be told they 'didn't have anything' in their system. Thanks for nothing.
Refine this for me please: I was extremely disappointed when, despite my efforts to order online 30 minutes in advance of my pickup, I found myself skipping the long line, only to be informed by the staff that they had no record of my order in their system. This experience left me feeling frustrated and unappreciated.

input: If you have not had their cream filled donuts then you simply have not lived, my friend! Incredible! I came to Philly to visit my sister and she brought us here on our second to last day. The cream filled doughnut was so incredible that I drove all the way back here on our way home to get a half dozen of them for the drive back to Michigan! And if you're wondering...yes, yes I crushed all 6 of those delicious pieces of heaven and I won't apologize for it!
Refine this for me please: You haven't truly lived until you've tried their cream-filled donuts, my friend! They are absolutely incredible. During a visit to Philadelphia to see my sister, she brought us to this place on our second-to-last day. The moment I tasted their cream-filled donut, I was blown away. It was so amazing that I couldn't resist driving all the way back there on our way home to Michigan just to get a half dozen for the road! And let me tell you, I devoured all six of those heavenly, delicious pieces without a hint of remorse.

input:
STAY AWAY from this place unless you want to possibly be hit by a "drunk gambler "coming from there.  It's no wander this Joe Bob's is never busy.  The only thing that the owners and bartenders care about are the gamblers that get over-served and gamble there daily.   I'm definitely gonna stay away from that part of town after 4ish as that's when the "heavy hitters" come in to support the greasy, dirty, place that really only cares about their gamblers.  The kitchen has some kinda mold issues that literally smells like a sewer plant.  The 2 gals that have made a career outta this dump rely on the drunkards to tip them "big" if they win on the slots.  This is a very sad version of any kinda chicken joint or sports bar.  The greed that the owners share is obvious as flat screens are cheap these days and these guys can't even loosen their hands on the "gambling profit" to invest in to this dump.   Is sad as the original owners did a great job and these new guys don't care about anything except the profit from the slot machines, including the nasty food they serve.  The bartenders are high-strung and anything but friendly, unless of course, you are gambling big and they have a chance at a big tip.  
Your better off going to the fast food chicken joint across the stree t"El Pollo Loco" and guessing the kitchen is cleaner and the staff is friendlier and you won't be subjected to the daily drunks that drive to and from this place daily.  VERY SCARY!!!
Refine this for me please: I would advise avoiding this establishment due to potential safety concerns with intoxicated gamblers. It is not surprising that Joe Bob's is consistently empty, as the owners and bartenders prioritize serving and serving alcohol to gamblers. It is wise to avoid this area after 4 pm when the "heavy hitters" arrive to support this unsanitary establishment. The kitchen has evident mold issues that emit an unpleasant odor similar to a sewer plant. The two employees seem to rely on intoxicated individuals to receive substantial tips if they win at the slot machines. This place falls short in comparison to typical chicken joints or sports bars and it is disheartening to see the owners prioritize profits over the overall quality of the establishment. It is sad to observe the decline from the previous owners' successful management to the present lack of care from the current owners, who prioritize gambling profits over the quality of food they serve. The bartenders tend to be on edge and unfriendly, unless there is potential for a substantial tip from high-stakes gambling. It would be better to opt for the fast food chicken joint, El Pollo Loco, located across the street, as it is likely to have a cleaner kitchen and friendlier staff, without exposure to daily drunk drivers. It is a concerning and potentially unsafe environment.

input:
1st time here. We were headed to Terakawa with the family on a cold Friday night, but they had a line out the door so we went here. Glad we did...

Excellent service & friendly staff. Waitress helped my wife take off her jacket as her hands were full with our baby, as I was tied up with the 3yr old.

I had Chicken Katsu Curry Ramen, Sister had Shrimp Katsu Ramen & Wife had Shoyu Ramen. Everything was excellent, I loved mine. Curry soup was tasty &I the fried chicken was done just right. Same for my sisters shrimp, fried just right with good quality shrimp. My wife lived her Shoyu Ramen.

We also got the pork buns which were excellent, but not your traditional porkbun. 

Great, great experience.
Refine this for me please:
First time here and we had initially planned to go to Terakawa with the family on a cold Friday night. However, Terakawa had a long line out the door, so we decided to try this place instead. And we're glad we did!

The service here was excellent, and the staff was very friendly. Our waitress went above and beyond by helping my wife take off her jacket since her hands were full with our baby, while I was occupied with our 3-year-old.

For our orders, I had the Chicken Katsu Curry Ramen, my sister had the Shrimp Katsu Ramen, and my wife had the Shoyu Ramen. Everything was fantastic, and I especially loved my choice. The curry soup had a delicious taste, and the fried chicken was perfectly cooked. My sister's shrimp was also fried just right, and the quality of the shrimp was top-notch. My wife thoroughly enjoyed her Shoyu Ramen.

Additionally, we decided to try the pork buns, which were excellent. Although they weren't your traditional pork buns, they were still very tasty.

Overall, it was a great experience and we would highly recommend it.

input: Where do I start? Brew D Licious has the very best coffee in town. Hands down. I have tried them all and can say that there isn't another coffee house that even comes close. The minute I met the owner, I knew she was not only very well informed about how to brew a great cup of coffee, but also knows how to make the toughest of customer a repeat patron. This coffee is so good that I buy 5#s at a time from Brigitte. It is always fresh and she has even delivered coffee to me while she is under construction of her new place. Personally, I cannot wait until she opens her new location. I never did care much for the Hollander Hotel and I often felt that she was being stifled by the cramped space she worked in. Also, the hotel has a funky smell (sort of like old socks) so I will be glad when she is at her new location and I can sit and enjoy a good cup of coffee without trying to filter out the bad smell from the hotel. I know it will be a long line at the new location but it will be worth the wait.... Thanks Brigitte for showing St. Petersburg what real coffee tastes and smells like!
Refine this for me please:
I highly recommend Brew D Licious as the ultimate coffee destination in town. Having personally tried all the coffee houses in the area, I can confidently say that none even come close to the exceptional quality and flavor offered by Brew D Licious. From the moment I met the owner, I was impressed by her extensive knowledge and expertise in brewing a perfect cup of coffee. Moreover, she possesses the remarkable ability to turn even the toughest customer into a loyal and satisfied patron.

The coffee at Brew D Licious is so outstanding that I find myself purchasing 5-pound bags from Brigitte at a time. Not only is the coffee always fresh, but Brigitte has even gone out of her way to deliver it to me while she was in the midst of constructing her new location. I am personally excited for the opening of her new place, as I have never been particularly fond of the Hollander Hotel where Brew D Licious is currently situated. The cramped space often feels stifling, and the hotel itself emits an unpleasant odor reminiscent of old socks. Thus, I eagerly anticipate the move to the new location, where I can savor a delicious cup of coffee in a pleasant environment without having to contend with the hotel's undesirable smell.

Although I anticipate there will be a long line at the new location, I am certain it will be well worth the wait. Brigitte, thank you for enlightening the residents of St. Petersburg with the true taste and aroma of exceptional coffee.

input: Finally! Great pizza & knots at the beach!!! Excellent location with a cool street presence. These guys know what they're doing.
Refine this for me please: Finally, we discovered an amazing combination of great pizza and knots at the beach! The location is excellent, boasting a trendy street presence. It's evident that these guys are masters of their craft and truly know what they're doing.

input: This is only a review on their oysters because that's all I ever eat from here. They have the freshest, best tasting oysters ever! I asked our server what type of oysters they were and she didn't know but said she would ask someone. She never came back with the answer but that was ok. Oysters, D-E-L-I-C-I-O-U-S! I promise you you will not be disappointed!
Refine this for me please: This is a review specifically focused on the oysters at this establishment, as they happen to be the only item I have tried here. Let me begin by saying that these oysters are simply outstanding. In terms of freshness and taste, they are unparalleled. During my visit, I inquired about the specific type of oysters, but our server was unsure. Although she did not return with an answer, it did not detract from the overall experience. I cannot emphasize enough how delicious these oysters are - they are an absolute treat. I can confidently assure you that trying them will not lead to disappointment.

input: Just tried the food. It was excellent, the best  I have had in the area. Had kung pao beef and basil shrimp with the pork fried rice all very good. Delivery was fast as well
Refine this for me please: I recently tried the food, and I must say, it was absolutely excellent! It is, without a doubt, the best food I have ever had in this area. I ordered the kung pao beef along with the basil shrimp, both of which were incredibly delicious. To complete my meal, I had the pork fried rice, which was equally as satisfying. Additionally, the delivery service was impressively fast.

input: Much more than a deli! Wife and I had the Philly and the club. Both were tasty and a good deal. As our total check for four bags of chips (2 kids) and two sandwiches were just over $20. Also, come hungry. It's yuge
Refine this for me please: This place is much more than your average deli! My wife and I tried their Philly and club sandwiches and both were delicious and reasonably priced. In fact, for four bags of chips (since we have two kids) and two sandwiches, our total check came to just over $20. Trust me, you won't leave here feeling unsatisfied. The portions are huge, so make sure to come hungry!

input:
I don't know what some of these peoples problems are with this place (other than veiled racism) but taking a wedding dress in to be fitted 7 months out is idiotic, regardless of how secure you are in your sizing.

Anyway, I've never had a problem here whatsoever. They aren't all warm and fuzzy, but I'm paying for competence, not smiles, and competent they assuredly are. They got out decade old blood stains out of a ball hockey jersey and have an average turnaround of 2-3 days, even during the holidays and wedding season. 

I can't recommend them enough. When we move, we will most certainly still be taking our clothes in here for dry cleaning and alterations.
Refine this for me please:
I don't understand why some people have issues with this place (possibly due to underlying racism), but it is foolish to bring a wedding dress for alterations seven months in advance, regardless of one's confidence in sizing.

In any case, I have never encountered any problems here. While the staff might not be the friendliest, I prioritize competence over smiles, and they certainly deliver in that aspect. They managed to remove decade-old blood stains from a ball hockey jersey and consistently provide a turnaround time of 2-3 days, even during peak periods like holidays and wedding season.

I highly recommend their services. Even when we relocate, we will continue bringing our clothes here for dry cleaning and alterations.

input: Bigger than the Rittenhouse location & there's actually street parking! Server was super friendly and happy to tell me her favorites. Got a taste of the Groothie and I'm glad I did because it was too sweet for me. The Udon Noodle Salad was great.
Refine this for me please: The location of this place is larger than the Rittenhouse one, and the convenience of street parking is a plus. The server was incredibly friendly and enthusiastic about sharing her favorite dishes with me. I decided to try the Groothie and, although it was too sweet for my liking, I appreciated the opportunity to taste it. However, the Udon Noodle Salad truly impressed me; it was delicious.

input: Came for the first time today with family and Bailey was excellent, she was friendly and attentive and THE FOOD was incredible. We had the hummus plate (which was very generous portion), the pretzels, mozzarella sticks and caprese salad. Everything was fresh and I was impressed with the food as I had never been here before. We will be back!!
Refine this for me please: Today was our first visit as a family, and I must say that Bailey, our server, was excellent. She was friendly, attentive, and truly made our experience memorable. The food, without a doubt, exceeded our expectations; it was absolutely incredible. We indulged in the hummus plate, which was impressively generous in portion size. Additionally, the pretzels, mozzarella sticks, and caprese salad were all exceptionally fresh and flavorful. This was our first time trying this restaurant, and we were thoroughly impressed. Needless to say, we will definitely be returning in the future.

input:
I think I would've given this place a 4/5 star rating if not for the lackluster service and attitude. The entrees were good, the prices were spot on, and the breadsticks were delicious.
