Ahh, the breadsticks. This is where the attitude part kicks in. These things are advertised as "as much as you want for free." However, my buddy heads up to the front counter to request enough for our table of three only to be given a hard time from the manager that we're eating more breadsticks than what we ordered. Give me a break. Don't advertise what you don't want to deliver.

Even ordering was a chore. It seemed as if they had a new hire manning the register during the lunch hour rush. She was placing orders as to-go for people looking to dine-in and had to have the manager place orders for her. Not a good idea for a Friday lunch rush.

If this Fazoli's location can improve upon these things minor inconveniences, it'd be a great place to grab a quick bite.
Refine this for me please: Despite the positive aspects such as the good entrees and reasonable prices, I would have given this place a 4/5 star rating if it weren't for the lackluster service and attitude. The breadsticks, which are advertised as "as much as you want for free," became a source of frustration due to the manager's refusal to provide us with an adequate amount for our table of three. It is disappointing when a restaurant promises something but fails to deliver. Additionally, the ordering process was difficult, particularly during the lunch hour rush, as it seemed that a new, inexperienced employee was in charge of taking orders and had to rely on the manager for assistance. This was not ideal for a busy Friday lunchtime. If the Fazoli's location addressed and improved these minor inconveniences, it would be an excellent place to enjoy a quick meal.

input:
was on an errand-running run and remembered how ashamed i was at the state of my car the last time i looked at it - five minutes earlier, as i entered said vehicle.

saw the sign as i was about to turn into riverside plaza to make my groceries and decided it was time.  got the basic $12 tchoup and even though there were about 5 cars in the vacuum line ahead of me, my car was ready before i was done checking out the waiting area.  iguanas, parrots, ms. pac man ($1 a game?  the price of nostalgia, i guess).  not to mention the windows that look out into the auto wash system - which is really entertainment enough for me.  i'm not picky.

but then my number was up and i went out and inspected the results.  still some bird poop remnants on the hood and a few bugs didn't give up the ghost on the grill...maybe i am picky after all.  

don't get me wrong - it was better than nothing (which was what my car got in terms of washings since mid-january), but i'm missing my favorite car wash right about now.  their regular automatic wash with vacuum and window cleaning (i.e. the tchoup treatment) is $14, true, but those dudes are much more thorough with the elbow grease post-assembly line washing.

but that place is in los angeles, alas.  which is perhaps the best gauge of how pricey this place is: 85% as expensive as l.a., but 66.67% the quality.  worth it?  you do the math.  i'ma try a completely touchless system next time.  i reckon i'll get about the same results, but with no parrots or ms. pac-man.
Refine this for me please:
I was running errands when I suddenly felt ashamed of the sorry state of my car. It had only been five minutes since I last looked at it, as I was getting into the vehicle. As I was about to turn into Riverside Plaza to do my grocery shopping, I noticed a sign and decided it was time for a car wash.

I opted for the basic $12 wash package, called "tchoup." Despite there being five cars in line ahead of me for the vacuum service, my car was ready before I finished checking out the waiting area. While waiting, I was entertained by the sight of iguanas, parrots, and even an old-school Ms. Pac-Man arcade game (which cost $1 per play – quite expensive for a wave of nostalgia). The windows provided a view of the auto wash system, which itself was entertaining enough for me. I'm not too picky when it comes to these things.

Once my turn came, I went outside to inspect the results. There were still a few remnants of bird poop on the hood, and some bugs had stubbornly remained on the grill. Maybe I am pickier than I thought.

Don't get me wrong – the car wash was an improvement compared to my car's unwashed state since mid-January. However, I'm longing for my favorite car wash right now. They offer a regular automatic wash that includes vacuuming and window cleaning (essentially the same as the tchoup treatment), but it costs $14. The best part is that their car washers are much more thorough, putting in extra effort after the assembly line process.

Unfortunately, that preferred car wash is located in Los Angeles. This fact probably speaks to how expensive the current place I went to is: it's 85% as costly as the Los Angeles car wash, but only 66.67% as good in terms of quality. Is it worth it? You do the math. Next time, I think I'll try a completely touchless system. I assume the results will be similar, but at least I won't have parrots or Ms. Pac-Man to keep me company.

input: Update. The large, live turtle tank has been replaced with a colorful fish aquarium. I don't know what happened to the turtle. Still recommended. Highly.
Refine this for me please: Revised: Exciting news! We have recently replaced the large, live turtle tank with a vibrant and captivating fish aquarium. Although we are uncertain about the whereabouts of the turtle, we highly recommend this new addition.

input:
Most of the time I go through the drive thru here.  While sometimes the line is a bit long I have to say these guys move in record time.  The line moves fast and my coffee is waiting for me when I get to the window.  How much more can you ask for? 

Inside there is a decent amount of seating and there is quite a bit of outdoor seating too.  Overall this is a great Starbucks.
Refine this for me please:
Most of the time, I prefer using the drive thru at this Starbucks location due to their impressive speed and efficiency. Despite occasional long lines, their staff moves quickly, ensuring a swift line progression and providing me with a ready coffee by the time I reach the window. It's hard to ask for more in terms of service.

Moreover, the Starbucks offers a generous amount of indoor seating along with ample outdoor seating options. Overall, I find this Starbucks to be excellent.

input: I have straight hair and it turns out best if it's done with scissors . I said I want my hair to be cut with scissors down the side and blended and and she said no clippers and I said now I can go somewhere else and get a scissor cut it's fine no I do a good job was the response I got I can do it with scissors and what are you now she grabbed the clippers and cut 90% of my hair with clippers I get one and ethene clipper cut I told her specifically I get not want my hair cut with clippers I would go somewhere else if I were you to get your haircut unless you want it high and tight whether fade with clippers
Refine this for me please: I prefer my hair to be cut with scissors as it tends to turn out the best. During my recent haircut, I requested to have my hair cut down the side with scissors and blended. However, the stylist insisted on using clippers, to which I expressed my preference for scissors and even mentioned I could go elsewhere for that. Disregarding my request, she proceeded to use clippers and cut 90% of my hair with them. I did not want a clipper cut and I specifically mentioned this. If you are looking to get your hair cut, I would advise going to another salon unless you desire a high and tight fade with clippers.

input: Excellent food, ambiance and location! I ate there for lunch during this trip to NOLA with my friend. I had the artichoke and crab salad - it was SO good! My mouth waters thinking of it now. My friend ate the grilled and roasted vegetable platter and everyhing was excellent! I highly recommend!
Refine this for me please: The food, ambiance, and location of this restaurant are absolutely outstanding! I had the pleasure of dining there for lunch during my recent trip to NOLA with a friend. I opted for the artichoke and crab salad, and it was simply divine! Reflecting back on it now, my mouth starts to water. Meanwhile, my friend enjoyed the grilled and roasted vegetable platter, which was equally impressive. I cannot recommend this place enough!

input: Great lunch recommended by someone at Nashville airport.  Funky eclectic atmosphere. Great and healthy food choices. Sweet potato casserole with coconut and dried cranberry was fantastic.
Refine this for me please: I highly recommend checking out this amazing lunch spot at the Nashville airport, as suggested by a knowledgeable individual. The restaurant offers a unique and eclectic atmosphere that is sure to captivate your senses. What sets this place apart is its wide selection of both delectable and nutritious food options. Notably, their sweet potato casserole infused with coconut and dried cranberry was an absolute standout, delivering an exceptional culinary experience.

input: Whenever we make the trip over from Orlando.. We usually end up here.  I am a big fan of smaller intimate venues and this one does the trick.  Staff is great and the service is on point.  If you get a table.. request #4.
Refine this for me please: Whenever we visit from Orlando, we always find ourselves ending up at this place. I absolutely love the cozy atmosphere of smaller intimate venues, and this one truly hits the mark. The staff is friendly and the service is top-notch. If you're able to secure a table, I highly recommend requesting table #4.

input: Great food, great atmosphere, great service. I've been here twice, and neither was a disappointment. The food is always fantastic (if a bit on the pricey side) - maybe it's because I'm a sucker for Nutella, but the Belgian Waffle topped with Nutella is Heaven for your mouth.
Refine this for me please: The dining experience at this place is truly exceptional. From the delectable cuisine to the inviting ambiance and impeccable service, everything about it is top-notch. I have had the pleasure of visiting this establishment twice, and both times have been nothing short of amazing. Though the prices may be slightly higher, the quality of the food more than justifies it. As a self-professed Nutella enthusiast, the Belgian Waffle drizzled with Nutella is an absolute delight that transports your taste buds to paradise.

input:
This is a great late brunch option during the weekends when the big morning rush dies down after 1 pm. Usually there is no wait or 5 minute wait at this time. One big complaint is that they don't have an organized system for seating guests. The servers don't always greet incoming patrons (which should be required Waffle House-style) and they sometimes tell you to seat yourself (which can lead to one or two people taking up tables for 4) or they'll seat you (whenever they get around to talking to you). 

I've ordered a several different dishes at this point and they have varies from ok to awesome. The chicken wings and onion rings are just ok. The wings are either lightly dredged in flour or not at and then fried whole. They aren't really seasoned so the wings are pretty bland. The "onion rings" made of formed, chopped onions that are breaded. The chicken fingers were a bit over battered and dry. The smashwich (or whatever it's called) was pretty good: your choice of breakfast meat with hash browns and eggs in a hoagie roll, but unspectacular. The club sandwich is classic diner fare that is very well executed. The egg and omelette platters are a very good deal and dang tasty. The best thing on the menu is definitely the waffle. It's gently sweet, very crispy and covered in butter. So good!

The service is generally pretty attentive (once you're seated), the restaurant and bathrooms are very clean, the food is a good, tasty value
Refine this for me please:
This is a great option for a late brunch on weekends when the morning rush subsides after 1 pm. During this time, there is usually no wait or a short wait of around 5 minutes. However, one major complaint is the lack of an organized seating system for guests. The servers may not always greet incoming customers promptly, akin to the Waffle House style, and they may instruct you to seat yourself or seat you whenever they get the chance. 

As for the food, my experience ordering various dishes has ranged from okay to awesome. The chicken wings and onion rings were just okay. The wings are either lightly coated in flour or not coated at all before being fried whole, resulting in a lack of seasoning and blandness. The "onion rings" are made from formed and chopped onions that are breaded. The chicken fingers were a tad over battered and dry. On the other hand, the smashwich (or whatever it's called) was quite good - it includes your choice of breakfast meat with hash browns and eggs in a hoagie roll, though it may not be extraordinary. The club sandwich, a classic diner option, is excellently executed. The egg and omelette platters are also quite delicious and reasonably priced. However, the highlight of the menu is undoubtedly the waffle, which is delicately sweet, incredibly crispy, and generously topped with butter. It is simply amazing!

Overall, the service is usually attentive once you are seated. The restaurant and bathrooms are consistently very clean. In terms of value, the food is good, tasty, and reasonably priced.

input:
I would give them 5 but I was disappointed by their reuben.  
For some reason, I have to order reuben if it is a new place and the place has a reuben on their menu. 
but the reuben's rye bread was disappointing considering that companion is all about the bread.  

However, my fiancee's sandwich(forgot the name) with chicken, bacon, avocado on french bread was amazing!

had their spice chicken soup with their corn bread.  It was great! the soup had tons of vegetables and chicken, just the right amount of heat and the corn bread is pretty big and delicious.  

their chi latte was not impressive.. do not get it. lol 

little pricey but, it's a great place to have a wonderful breakfast/lunch and the workers are nice and friendly. 

check this place out, let me know what you guys think.
Refine this for me please:
I would rate this place as a 5, but my disappointment with their reuben sandwich brings it down a bit. Whenever I visit a new place and they have a reuben on their menu, I feel compelled to try it. However, the rye bread in their reuben was quite underwhelming, especially considering that the establishment prides itself on their bread.

On the other hand, my fiancée's sandwich, which I unfortunately forgot the name of, was outstanding. It contained chicken, bacon, and avocado on French bread, and it was truly delicious.

Additionally, I had the pleasure of trying their spice chicken soup served with corn bread, which was fantastic. The soup was packed with flavorful vegetables and chicken, had just the right amount of heat, and the corn bread was both sizable and delicious.

Unfortunately, I cannot speak highly of their chi latte. It did not impress me, so I would advise against ordering it. 

Although the prices are a bit high, this place is wonderful for a delightful breakfast or lunch. The staff members are friendly and attentive as well.

I highly recommend checking this place out and I would love to hear your thoughts on it.

input:
Probably the best thing about Target is that it isn't Wal Mart.

Target is awesome because it has everything from clothes to toys to electronics to makeup. 

I usually stop in here (if I remember) to pick up my makeup, because it's at least $2-3 cheaper than other stores.  They have a great grocery section and their selection of household items (microwaves, etc.) is fantastic.

They are always good about having enough registers open for the number of shoppers in the place, and I rarely have to wait in a line.
Refine this for me please: One of the standout features of Target is its diverse range of products, encompassing clothing, toys, electronics, and makeup. Personally, I find it particularly convenient to stop by the store for my makeup needs, as they offer competitive prices, typically $2-3 cheaper compared to other retailers. Moreover, Target excels in its grocery section, boasting an impressive array of household items, including microwaves. Another commendable aspect is their efficient customer service – they consistently ensure an adequate number of registers are open, minimizing the need for customers to wait in long lines.

input:

input:
This is the biggest and best location for HMV in the city. The prices aren't any different from other stores but they do have a larger selection of gifting (figurines,mugs,blankets etc) as well as the largest collection of titles that don't fit into what is new and hot at the moment. Anything that they don't carry can actually be ordered in for you but I have to say staff here are not always the best at phoning customers to let them know when their titles are in so one should definitely keep their number by the phone to check in with them after a week or so.

The biggest selling point for me here besides the selection has to be the staff at the tills. It can get a little busy here but lines are always dealt with quickly and I appreciate that they don't push as hard as other locations to try and sign you up for a pure card. F.Y.I to anybody considering the pure rewards program the redemption items are not that great. It took me about a year of collecting just to accumulate enough points for a true blood key chain and when I got it it was placed in a bubble mailer and not even in it's original packaging. Needless to say when it came time to renew the card I opted out.

Anyways to sum it all up I will say for selection and speedy service these guys get five stars but the prices as well as the sometimes slow ordering process drop it down to a 3. Still worth checking out though if you have been on the hunt at smaller stores for a particular movie or cd.
Refine this for me please:
This location of HMV in the city is undoubtedly the biggest and best. While the prices may not differ from other stores, they have an extensive collection of gifting options such as figurines, mugs, blankets, etc. Additionally, they offer the largest assortment of titles that may not be currently trending. If they don't have something in stock, they can order it for you. However, it's worth mentioning that the staff at this location may not always inform customers promptly when their ordered titles are in, so it's advisable to keep their contact number and follow up after a week or so.

The standout feature here, aside from the selection, is the efficient staff at the tills. Despite potential busyness, they manage lines swiftly and unlike other locations, they don't aggressively push customers to sign up for a pure card. It's worth noting that the redemption items in the pure rewards program are not particularly impressive. It took me a year to accumulate enough points for a true blood key chain, and when it arrived, it was poorly packaged in a bubble mailer without its original packaging. Consequently, I chose not to renew my card.

In conclusion, I would rate this location five stars for its selection and speedy service. However, the prices and occasional sluggishness of the ordering process bring it down to a three. Nonetheless, it's still worth visiting if you've been searching for a specific movie or CD at smaller stores.

input: Wow is all I have to say. Must try the friend oysters!we ordered that and crawfish bisque and shrimp with grits. All the dishes were delicious. Make sure to make reservation.
Refine this for me please: Wow, that's all I can say! You must try the fried oysters at this place. We also ordered the crawfish bisque and shrimp with grits, and all of the dishes were absolutely delicious. I highly recommend making a reservation beforehand to secure your spot.

input: Was on a mission trying to find the perfect coat for the Holidays. Found my idea of the perfect coat at Burlington but they did not have my size. Went to Target, bought a coat but ended up taking it bath. Was not my dream coat. Next stop Ross. The only coat in my size was a beautiful Bomber style jacket made of pleather. Bought it right before Christmas. Now it's a few days after Christmas and my husband Guy points out to me that the coat is really wrinkled. I go on line and look up every possible hack to get wrinkles out of pleather. They all fail miserably. I just went back to Ross with that coat, no receipt, no tags and asked to speak to the manager. The manager is a young male with dark hair and black framed glasses. I tell him of my plight. He literally says go find what you need, no problem. WOW! You won't believe it, but there was my Camouflage coat, in my size, hanging there waiting for me. Oh the irony! They exchanged my coat and after all that I ended up with my Dream coat after all. Thank you Ross Dress for Less. You will forever be my first choice for now on!
Refine this for me please:
I went on a mission to find the perfect coat for the Holidays. I found my ideal coat at Burlington, but unfortunately, they didn't have it in my size. I then decided to check out Target, where I bought a coat, but it turned out to be a disappointment and didn't meet my expectations. Determined to find my dream coat, I headed to Ross as my next stop.

To my luck, they had only one coat in my size, a beautiful Bomber style jacket made of pleather. I purchased it just before Christmas. However, a few days after Christmas, my husband, Guy, pointed out that the coat was incredibly wrinkled. Desperate to fix it, I searched online for every possible hack to remove wrinkles from pleather, but all my attempts failed miserably.

In my frustration, I decided to return to Ross with the coat, even though I had no receipt or tags. I approached the manager, who happened to be a young man with dark hair and black-framed glasses. I explained my situation, hoping for a solution. Surprisingly, he simply told me to go find the coat I needed without any hassle. I was amazed by his response.

To my utter disbelief, I found my desired Camouflage coat, hanging there in my size, waiting for me. The irony was not lost on me. They kindly exchanged my coat, and after all the trouble, I finally ended up with my Dream coat. I couldn't be more grateful to Ross Dress for Less. From now on, they will always be my first choice!

input: You honestly can't go wrong here. My favorites are the Udon Noodle Salad (a-ma-zing) and the Crispy Hipcity Ranch (so, so good). Friendly staff, fast service. Oh, they deliver too!
Refine this for me please: You really can't go wrong with this place. Personally, my absolute favorites are the Udon Noodle Salad (incredible) and the Crispy Hipcity Ranch (absolutely delicious). The staff is friendly and the service is always fast. Plus, they even offer delivery!

input: Philadelphia, I love you.  Places like this remind me why.  We sat at the counter and watched the guys make the pizzas.  Our son hates cheese on a pizza and they had one already on the menu for him: The Marinara (oregano, crushed san marzano tomatoes, garlic, olive oil).  It was simple... but delicious. If you like real wood-fired pizzas that char the crust (a little blackened... in a good way), this is the place to go to.  Our other favorite pizza joints that rival this place are Lombardi's (NYC) and Grimaldi's (Brooklyn).  We all had a slice and were shocked at the lovely simplicity of it. Razor thin slices of garlic dotted the fresh tomato sauce.  My husband and I shared the Salsiccia (fennel sausage, roasted fennel, tomato sauce, mozzarella).  Roasted fennel on a pizza?  Brilliant. I cried a little.  No wait... I REALLY cried when we shared this cocktail: The Brooklyn (Dad's Hat rye, Luxardo cherry, white vermouth).  It says it serves one, but they brought it out in a cute little bottle and gave us each a glass...each with a hand- crafted giant square ice cube (hipster-cool) and Luxardo cherries.  Perfection.  We also shared a Rotolo (pizza dough, mortadella, ricotta, pistacchio pesto).  Those are crazy amazing.  I kept saying my husband could eat the rest... then freaking out and going back for another bite. He's lucky I didn't stab him in the hand with a fork to fight over the last bite (to be fair, he was the smart one who ordered it).  I could've eaten several of those and forgotten the pizza (although that was wonderful too!).  We finished with a little dessert... perfect little Italian cookies ("Cookie Jar" - pignoli, almond cookies, chocolate biscotti, pistacchio gnocchi) and I got an Affogato (fiordilatte soft serve with a shot of espresso).  The soft serve is Italian sweet cream... decadent and lovely... with rich espresso in a pretty little Italian mug.  I'm in Heaven here.  I know nothing about Vetri's other restaurants, but I'm checking them out next time I'm in Philadelphia!  By the way... service was great and friendly.  5 stars all around!
Refine this for me please:
Philadelphia, I have a deep affection for you, and experiences like this remind me why. We had the opportunity to sit at the counter and witness the skilled pizza-making process. A delightful surprise awaited us when we discovered a pizza on the menu specifically tailored to our son's preference - The Marinara (a blend of oregano, crushed san marzano tomatoes, garlic, and olive oil). Its simplicity was its strength, delivering a delicious taste. If you have a fondness for wood-fired pizzas with a slightly charred, yet delectable crust, this establishment is where you must go. Though Lombardi's (NYC) and Grimaldi's (Brooklyn) provide stiff competition, this place truly deserves a spot among our favorites.

As we savored a slice, we were taken aback by the delightful simplicity of the dish. Thin slices of garlic adorned the fresh tomato sauce, creating an exquisite flavor combination. My husband and I decided to share the Salsiccia, which showcased the brilliance of incorporating roasted fennel and fennel sausage into a pizza. It was so incredible that I couldn't help shedding a few tears of joy. Our dining experience reached new levels of delight when we ordered The Brooklyn cocktail (featuring Dad's Hat rye, Luxardo cherry, and white vermouth). While it was meant for one, the staff presented it in an adorable bottle, serving us each a glass adorned with a hand-crafted, trendy giant square ice cube and luxurious Luxardo cherries. It was pure perfection.

We couldn't resist experiencing the Rotolo, a creation made with pizza dough, mortadella, ricotta, and pistacchio pesto. This dish left us in awe, and though I initially claimed my husband could have the rest, I couldn't resist going back for more. I was tempted to fight him for the last bite, but I managed to show some restraint (luckily, he was the clever one who ordered it). The Rotolo was so mind-blowing that I contemplated indulging in several of them and ignoring the pizza altogether (though the pizza was exceptional as well!). As a sweet conclusion, we treated ourselves to a delightful selection of Italian cookies ("Cookie Jar" - pignoli, almond cookies, chocolate biscotti, and pistacchio gnocchi) and an Affogato (featuring a velvety fiordilatte soft serve drizzled with a shot of espresso). The Italian sweet cream within the soft serve was deeply indulgent and paired flawlessly with the rich espresso served in a charming Italian mug. I truly felt like I had reached culinary heaven.

Although I know little about Vetri's other restaurants, I am eagerly looking forward to exploring them during my next visit to Philadelphia. Moreover, I must mention that the service we received was exceptional and friendly. I wholeheartedly give this establishment a well-deserved five-star rating across the board.

input:
This a really price store with great clothes. Mostly high end stuff, everything here is designer. 

The workers here are really friendly and not pushy. They will leave you alone if you just want to be left alone, they are never breathing down your neck trying to make a sale. They carry casual clothing but I think it's much better place for suits and dress shirts and fancy clothing. I think this place stands out in West Edmonton Mall in terms of service and dressy clothing for men. They really do everything to make your shopping experience better. 

Be prepared to spend some coin here, although you won't be disappointed.
Refine this for me please: This store is known for its great selection of high-end, designer clothing. The staff are friendly and respectful, never pressuring customers into making a purchase. Whether you're looking for casual wear or something more formal like suits and dress shirts, this store excels in providing excellent service and a wide range of dressy options for men. While prices may be a bit higher, the quality and overall shopping experience make it worth it.

input:
The food was pretty tasty. Nothing outstanding though. It reminds me of any Mediterranean food truck that I've been to. It's a nice late night spot. Definitely hits the spot at the end of the night. To me, the amount of food you get for the price could be improved but I would not say that I feel ripped off. The amount of food you get is fair but I think it'd be easier to justify if you got a little more. 

There's plenty of seating. Despite being near a whole bunch of bar/club scenes, once you're inside it's easy to take a break and have a nice conversation. It is all very clean and well kept. The servers are quick and friendly. When I went there were only two guys working but they weren't busy so it didn't take too long. The entire restaurant is very dimly lit and the atmosphere is a bit of a hodgepodge of things. On one wall there is a mural of outer space and the music that plays seems to have no rhyme or reason to it. 

It's a bit of a strange place but I would definitely go back.
Refine this for me please:
The food at this place is quite tasty, although not particularly exceptional. It reminds me of the Mediterranean food trucks I've encountered before. The late-night spot is a pleasant option and satisfies the cravings after a long night. The quantity of food served for the price could use some improvement, but it does not make me feel deceived. While the portion is fair, an increase in quantity would be more justifiable.

The abundance of available seating is a positive attribute. Despite its proximity to various bar and club scenes, once inside, it's easy to retreat and engage in a pleasant conversation. The restaurant is well-maintained and spotless. The servers are prompt and friendly. During my visit, there were only two staff members on duty, but as they weren't overwhelmed, the service was efficient. The entire establishment is dimly lit, creating an unusual ambiance with a mishmash of elements. One wall boasts a mural of outer space, and the music played seems to lack a discernible pattern.

Although it may be considered an eccentric establishment, I would definitely be willing to revisit.

input:
Awesome shop. Everyone is really nice an freely offers suggestions on areas to hit that have been very productive ! The bait is always TOP Notch too. Great supply of tackle an honestly some of the best prices I've seen. I used to buy a lot
Of my tackle at Walmart ( yes I've regretted that ) or dicks. After learning the error of my ways, an seeing the really great prices I've been buying all of my tackle from this shop. You can't go wrong with this bait shop ! The only issue I have is there isn't more of them around town !!!
Refine this for me please: Exceptional shop with incredibly friendly staff who freely offer valuable suggestions on highly productive fishing spots! The quality of bait is consistently excellent, and their tackle supply is extensive, offering some of the best prices I have ever come across. Previously, I used to purchase most of my tackle from Walmart or Dicks, but I regret that decision now after realizing the exceptional value and affordability offered by this shop. Without a doubt, this bait shop is a foolproof choice! My only gripe is that there should be more branches of this shop available throughout the town!
