input: Delicious! We had the warm and cold lobster rolls and both were great.  Bread was amazing too!  A little on the expensive side but you get what you pay for and it was quality food.
Refine this for me please: Delightful! We indulged in both the warm and cold lobster rolls, which were both exceptional. The bread was equally impressive, with its remarkable taste and texture. Admittedly, the prices were slightly high, but this was justified by the exceptional quality of the food.

input:
The Habit Burger is a straight up legit burger place.  It's always been a toss up for me between in n out and habit burger.  I got me a double char and choco shake at the goleta habit and it was as usual, delicious.

The onion rings are very good also.
Refine this for me please:
The Habit Burger is undeniably an authentic and exceptional burger joint. For the longest time, I've found myself torn between In-N-Out and The Habit Burger. However, during my recent visit to the Goleta location, I indulged in a mouthwatering double charburger alongside a delectable chocolate shake, and it didn't disappoint, just like always.

input: My husband and I practically live here, and have through the past 8 years or so.  They have great food, prepared fast, great drink specials.
Refine this for me please: My husband and I practically consider this place our second home for the past 8 years or so. The food here is consistently excellent, prepared quickly, and we always enjoy the enticing drink specials they offer.

input:
It is typical Broad Ripple charming spot. Small, trendy and bustling with activity. They do not take reservations. Which is somewhat annoying when you are traveling from another part of town. Whatever, we just had to arrange to arrive earlier than we would have liked to hopefully secure a table, which we did. When we arrived it was quiet and only several tables had guests seated. As our dinner progressed it became more crowded until every seat was filled. Nice lively scene except then you can not hear squat! It made dinner conversation difficult. Boo!!!! I think this could be an easy fix for them. 

Meal/Drinks:  The cocktails were creative and tasted wonderful. Our servers suggestions were pretty spot on as we enjoyed most of her suggestions. 

The guacamole was very good with the exception of the fact that my friend has a nut allergy and we asked to have them left off and of coarse they arrived with them on! They really weren't necessary in my opinion either as I don't think they add much to the dish. The reason I wanted to try this restaurant- The Harvest salad! We all split this as well and it was good. The combination of fruit and root vegetables was delish! The figs were so good and the herbed goat cheese mouse was a highlight on this plate!

Two of us ordered the Veracruz Trigger fish and the other ordered the Serrano Scallops and all of it was wonderful. The white sweet mashed potatoes were interesting! I am glad we tried them. The Veracruz sauce was wonderful and full of flavor. It was a lot of food though. Had we known we would have probably skipped one of the first course selections or split an entree. That'a ok though- lunch for today :)

We also tried the Tostones and Stewed Black Beans. Beans were very good, full of flavor! Tostones seemed very dry but maybe that is what they are supposed to be- this is the first time I have had them. BUT, dipped in the Stewed Black Beans they tasted great!

We passed on dessert as they had no gluten free, dairy free options. Delicia offers many options for restricted diets, which we loved. Just no dessert, which is probably better anyway-we were so full! 

Go, you will not be disappointed. Just go before 7pm on a Friday night to ensure a table.
Refine this for me please:
Refined version:

The restaurant in Broad Ripple is a typical charming spot, small, trendy, and always bustling with activity. Unfortunately, they don't take reservations, which can be quite annoying when you're traveling from another part of town. However, we managed to secure a table by arriving earlier than we would have liked. At first, it was quiet with only a few tables occupied, but as the night progressed, it became crowded, making conversation difficult due to the noise. This is something they should consider fixing.

The cocktails were creative and tasted wonderful, and the server's recommendations were mostly on point. The guacamole was delicious, although they mistakenly included nuts despite our request to leave them out. Personally, I don't think the nuts add much to the dish anyway. We also tried the Harvest salad, which was good, with a delightful combination of fruits, root vegetables, and excellent figs. The herbed goat cheese mousse on the salad was a highlight.

For our main course, two of us had the Veracruz Trigger fish, while the other ordered the Serrano Scallops. All of it was wonderful, especially the Veracruz sauce which was flavorful. The mashed white sweet potatoes were interesting, and we were glad we gave them a try. However, we found the portion sizes to be quite large, and in hindsight, we would have either skipped one of the first course selections or split an entree. Nonetheless, we had leftovers for lunch the next day.

We sampled the Tostones and Stewed Black Beans as well. The beans were full of flavor and delicious, while the tostones seemed a bit dry, although that might be the intended texture. They tasted great when dipped in the stewed black beans.

Unfortunately, we had to pass on dessert as they didn't offer any options for those with gluten or dairy restrictions. However, Delicia, another restaurant, offers a wide variety of options for restricted diets. In the end, it was probably better that we skipped dessert since we were already quite full.

Overall, it's definitely worth visiting this restaurant. Just make sure to arrive before 7pm on a Friday night to secure a table and avoid disappointment.

input:
This makes my 6th or 7th time to Jackson's in the last 2 years and I thought that after tonight's visit they deserved a review. 

I had the panini Reuben.  Panini was amazing. Great use of garlic. Loved the cut of the meat. Not stringy but nicely chinked in thin slices. Cheese was well melted throughout the mix of kraut and meat. Rye Bread was wonderful. Would love to have it as a staple in my house. 

Salad came out same time as sandwich which was not good.

Presentation was a little sloppy. 

Like every other place I have had a panini (except Panera where they do it right), the sandwich was served directly on a plate. Why don't they serve on a napkin? Particularly when they bring the salad out at the same time as the sandwich?  If the sandwich sits for more than a few moments, the bread gets soggy from the steam.  Nothing serious, but for the price, which is a little high, it seems lacking.  While the price is a little high, i think it is justified considering the food and drink quality. 

They have a great selection of wines and beers that are likely to fit any palette.  

Wait staff have always been friendly. But you can tell this is a place where people are expected to hustle. Sometimes short or even distracted the service can be lacking. 

The second time I visited was during a medium lunch rush and the wait time was 15 min to get drinks. My trip tonight it was about 8 min. For a sat night this is not bad. But not great either. My bartenders were awesome and never left me wanting (except for getting my salad with the main course).

Overall a good experience and I will be back.
Refine this for me please:
This is my 6th or 7th time visiting Jackson's in the last 2 years, and I wanted to share my thoughts after tonight's visit. 

I ordered the panini Reuben and it was absolutely amazing. The use of garlic in the panini was fantastic, and I loved how the meat was cut into thin, non-stringy slices. The cheese was perfectly melted and mixed with the kraut and meat. The rye bread was also wonderful and I wish I could have it as a regular staple at home. 

However, the timing of the salad being served at the same time as the sandwich was not ideal. The presentation of the food was a bit sloppy, especially considering they served the sandwich directly on a plate instead of a napkin. This caused the bread to become soggy from the steam if it sat for too long. It's not a major issue, but for the slightly higher price, I feel like it could have been better. That being said, considering the quality of the food and drinks, the price is justified. 

Jackson's has an excellent selection of wines and beers that would suit any palate. 

The wait staff has always been friendly, but it's evident that they are expected to hustle. Sometimes, the service can be a bit short or distracted. During my second visit, which was during a medium lunch rush, it took 15 minutes to get our drinks. However, on my recent visit, it only took about 8 minutes. While this is not bad for a Saturday night, it's also not great. That being said, the bartenders were awesome and never left me wanting, except for getting my salad with the main course. 

Overall, it was a good experience and I definitely plan on returning.

input:
I went there for a pedicure and gel manicure.  It was my first time and the reviews was what enticed me. I loved loved Young, who did my pedicure.  She was very friendly and has a very positive attitude.  She took her time with my pedicure and was very thorough with the massaging (which was the best part). 

Unfortunately Young didn't do my manicure.   I had a gel manicure that needed to be soaked off.  The owner did my nails.  She first scraped my nails with the cuticle pusher, but when it wasn't coming off fast enough, she used the drill.  I was really worried as I didn't want my nails to be thin.  But I just let her do her thing.  I'm usually not picky so when she was working on my nails I didn't watch what she was doing until I realized after close examination she didn't fully take the old gel polish off.  
Not only that, the polish didn't go on smoothly, there's are noticeable bumps on my nail bed and the sides of my nails weren't even fully covered.  

I am so disappointed.  I love Young, but I don't know if I'll be going back due to my experience with my gel manicure.
Refine this for me please:
I went to the salon specifically for a pedicure and a gel manicure, as the reviews had piqued my interest. The pedicure experience with Young was exceptional - she was remarkably friendly, had a positive attitude, and took her time to ensure thorough massaging, which was the most enjoyable part.

However, I was disappointed with my gel manicure as it was not done by Young but by the owner herself. She began by scraping my nails with a cuticle pusher, but decided to use a drill when the removal process wasn't progressing fast enough. I became concerned about potential damage to my nails, but decided to trust her expertise. Unfortunately, I didn't closely observe her work at the time, only realizing later, upon closer examination, that she hadn't fully removed the old gel polish.

Moreover, the application of the new gel polish was subpar. The polish didn't glide on smoothly, resulting in noticeable bumps on my nail bed. Additionally, the sides of my nails were not fully covered.

Overall, I feel incredibly disappointed. Although I adore Young, I'm unsure if I'll return to the salon due to my unsatisfactory experience with the gel manicure.

input: I just had the trio that was an appetizer that was amazing. Also I try there pizza it all really good.

input: They don't just have great cookies, cupcakes, and puddings! I ordered a salted caramel cake for a birthday party, and it was amazing - four layers of moist cake with caramel buttercream between each layer. Refine this for me please: Not only do they offer a delightful assortment of cookies, cupcakes, and puddings, but their selection goes beyond expectations. I recently ordered a salted caramel cake for a birthday celebration, and it left me in awe. This four-layered masterpiece featured moist cake layers with luscious caramel buttercream delicately placed between each one. The cake itself was not only a treat for the taste buds but also a feast for the eyes - an elegant and irresistible creation, embodying a rare combination of elegance and scrumptiousness.

input: Skip the fancy desert after dinner to go here, it's an excuse to walk around Broadway.  The homemade ice cream is really good.  Cake Mix is my favorite.   Great place to top off a date.

input: So happy I found a bomb local sushi place!! Always ignored this shop going to domino's but I'm so glad I popped in. Will be coming here more than I should from now on. I got this sushiya roll and I was more than pleased! The salmon tasted fresh and the miso was on point. 10/10 recommend this spot.
Refine this for me please: I'm really thrilled that I discovered an amazing local sushi place!! I used to overlook this gem while heading to Domino's, but I'm grateful that I decided to try it out. I can already tell that I'll be frequenting this place more often than necessary. I ordered their signature sushiya roll and it surpassed my expectations! input: The best thai food I've tried in the area. I live about 30min away and wish I lived closer. The red curry and the pad thai and the chicken satay with peanut sauce is so so good! Lunch specials are great!
Refine this for me please: I highly recommend the Thai food at this place. It is by far the best I've tried in the area. Even though I live about 30 minutes away, I wish I lived closer so I could enjoy it more often. The red curry, pad thai, and chicken satay with peanut sauce are absolutely delicious! Additionally, they offer great lunch specials.

input: I took my family and my daughter today for the very first time. There was a lot of things to do for my daughter and she loved it! I would've given this place 5 stars but I'm only giving it 2 stars because this place is filthy. For the price that we paid for each admission including my 15 month old daughter, management should do a way better job maintaining the cleanliness of this place!!! I sincerely hope that the management takes this feedback into account and works towards improving the cleanliness of their establishment. Normally, I wouldn't bother writing reviews, but I felt compelled to share this experience.

input: I was a walk in and absolutely loved the clean location and the friendly staff. Tammy did an amazing job on my eyebrows and being a first time guest the service was free! They also have great packages for all kinds of waxing services. Will definitely be back!

Additionally, they offer excellent waxing service packages for various needs. I am definitely going to return!

input: There is nothing like the other pics showed!!! I never give out review on Yelp, but I had to comment on this restaurant! input: So far I've been sitting here wanting to dine in for about 30 minutes and have yet to see a waitress. input:
This is the best Caribbean food in town, hands down. Everything was so fresh, not too heavy, cooked to perfection. My fiancé had stewed chicken and I had the curried chicken- both were excellent. I also had an order of plantains that were the best I've ever had. The owner came out to chat and made sure we'd gotten enough food and liked everything. 

The prices are incredible, and evidently there are some things not on the menu, such as oxtails, that are available. 

Also- it's a BYOB!

Will definitely return and tell everyone I know to try this place out. Worth every 5-star review- they're real, folks.
Refine this for me please:
This is hands down the best Caribbean food in town. Everything was incredibly fresh, cooked to perfection, and not too heavy. Both the stewed chicken and the curried chicken were excellent, and the plantains were the best I've ever had. The owner even came out to chat with us and made sure we were enjoying our food. 

What's more, the prices are incredibly affordable, and there are even some off-menu items available, like oxtails. And to top it off, it's a BYOB!

I will definitely be returning to this place and recommending it to everyone I know. It truly deserves every 5-star review it receives.

input:
This is a cool place.  I wonder how many people know that an Ouzaria is?  The ambience here is definitely upbeat - I'd rate it a great place for a group or first date.  They have a couple of semi-secluded tables in the back room that keeps it from getting too loud, but it's not a quiet romantic place.  

We brought my Mother-in-Law, who enjoys good food as long as it's not too weird.  I guess my wife is about the same, now that I think about it.  We tried three tapas plates; a three-cheese sampler, featuring feta, goat cheese and kasseri cheese, greek meatballs and pan-seared scallops.  We liked all three of these dishes.  The scallops were especially good - big and tender.   For tapas, they were pretty big portions, so keep this in mind.  The waitress suggested ordering one thing at a time, but we didn't heed her advice and ordered it all up front.   Two at a time would probably be a good idea.  Along with the tapas, we ordered a traditional Greek salad, which ended up being the lone clunker, surprisingly.  We just didn't like the dressing - too sweet for our tastes.  The gyro meat was fine, though, so maybe we'll just get a gyro next time.   One more thing:  The Spanish granacha (can't remember the label) was excellent for just $6 and a nice pour. 

Okay, now for the belly dancer:  She was cute and a good dancer, but I think this is just something that requires more alcohol on my part.  We did have a few laughs about it, though.  I opted not to get a dollar out to stuff in her skirt or whatever.   Fun but a little awkward. 

I've been to a few other Greek places in town that had better food, but for a night out, Momo's is definitely the choice.  We'll be back.
Refine this for me please:
This place is really cool. I wonder how many people know what an Ouzaria is? The ambience here is lively and energetic, making it a great place for a group gathering or a first date. They have a few semi-secluded tables in the back room that add some privacy and keep the noise level down, although it's not exactly a quiet, romantic spot.

We brought my Mother-in-Law, who enjoys good food as long as it's not too outlandish. I guess my wife has similar tastes. We tried three tapas plates - a three-cheese sampler with feta, goat cheese, and kasseri cheese, Greek meatballs, and pan-seared scallops. We enjoyed all three dishes, with the scallops being the standout - large and tender. The tapas portions were quite generous, so keep that in mind. The waitress advised ordering one dish at a time, but we didn't follow her suggestion and ordered everything at once. In hindsight, it would've been better to order two at a time. Alongside the tapas, we also ordered a traditional Greek salad, which unfortunately wasn't up to par. The dressing was too sweet for our liking. However, the gyro meat was enjoyable, so perhaps we'll opt for a gyro next time. Oh, and we must mention that the Spanish granacha (can't recall the label) was an excellent choice at just $6 and a generous pour.

Now, let's talk about the belly dancer. She was cute and skillful, but I feel like I would've enjoyed it more with a few more drinks in me. We did have a good laugh about it, though. I chose not to get a dollar out to put in her skirt or whatever that tradition is. It was fun, but slightly awkward.

I've been to a few other Greek restaurants in town that had better food, but for a night out, Momo's is definitely the place to go. We'll definitely be returning.

input:
This hotel was so terrible and I can narrow it down to 4 things:

1. The price: Expect to pay a lot of money from the second you arrive. They charge $35 per person for a round trip shuttle ride to the airport. Our room was roughly $275 a night. It's an incredibly large hotel that offers a nail salon, a Godiva Chocolate store, about 9 restaurants and a few bars. But you'll pay dearly for any of those things - like $2.50 for a small bottle of soda. The hotel is designed to keep you in there and they charge you $15 for a round trip shuttle ride to the downtown Nashville area. 

2. The service: We called the front desk and were on hold for 20 minutes. We went to the front desk and waited in line for an hour. We waited around to ask the concierge questions. And each time we got, "I don't know" as the usual response. The cleaning staff was extraordinarily loud and they actually shouted as they went down the hall at 6:30 a.m.

3. The name: They call this place a resort but that is, by far, a misnomer. This place is a convention hotel, period. It's horrifically loud at all hours of the day because they host about 3 conventions at one time. Our windows faced one of the courtyards and there is music pumping there 24 hours a day. The walls are thin and you can hear *everything* happening in the neighboring rooms. (eww!) If you want to relax at a resort, don't stay here because with all those convention people, loud cleaning staff, 24 hour music and thin walls you will only end up with more stress.

4. The size: It's no joke that you will get lost in this hotel. It's inexplicably large. And when it hits noon, you should already be in one of the few restaurants because they fill up FAST. With several conventions happening at one time, getting a "quick bite" is not possible here. And there's not really any place close by, either. You can walk over to the mall for some fast food but plan enough time for your walk - getting out of the hotel takes at least 5 minutes.

I'm sure glad I was there for a convention and didn't pay out of my own pocket for this ridiculous hotel.

I am grateful that I attended the convention and did not have to pay for this outrageously priced and poorly managed hotel out of my own pocket.

input:
I waited a long time to finally try this place and I have to say I was let down a bit. I tried the mandatory Dan Dan noodles. They were very flavorful and not too spicy. Nothing mind blowing here just a really good lo mein or spicy pasta dish with virtually no protein more or less. Also had the scallion pancakes. I was just in Chinatown recently at a place I also reviewed (first person from Yelp to do so) and they were way better there. ( I highly recommend you try that place) These were more like quesadillas laying flat where as the other ones jumped off the plate and were so much more crispy and substantial. The last appetizer I had was the Wontons in Chilli oil. These were just not good to me at all and one bite was all I needed. Basically it is steamed Wontons in a bowl with the soup being the chilli oil. Just heavy heavy choking heat with very little substance or taste. Take those same homemade wontons and pan fry them with some chilli peppers and a nice light sauce and you have could a real winner but I digress. Finally we tried the Talapia Medallions . These were fried to perfection but there were some greens mixed in that I could not chew through and had to discard via the old napkin trick which to me is a bit of a deal/star breaker.

The service was very good and the atmosphere very nice but I wouldn't go out of my way to eat here again. All I could think about was how much more I prefer Cantonese style where its all about flavors and you can add heat as you like it. I'm sure I could find better authentic Szechuan cuisine that better suits my taste just not here. It feels very commercialized and Americanized. I prefer the hole in the wall places where I am the only caucasian in the place a heck of a lot more.
Refine this for me please:
After eagerly anticipating a visit to this place, I have to admit I was slightly disappointed. I decided to try the famous Dan Dan noodles, which were indeed flavorful but not mind-blowing. They resembled more of a well-prepared lo mein or spicy pasta dish rather than an exceptional Szechuan specialty, lacking in protein. Additionally, I recently visited another Chinatown establishment (which I highly recommend) that served much better scallion pancakes. Unlike those, the ones here were flat and lacked the crispy texture and substantiality that made the others stand out.

Next, I tried the Wontons in Chilli oil as an appetizer, but they did not appeal to me in the slightest. One bite was enough to realize that the steamed wontons floating in a bowl of soup-like chili oil lacked substance and flavor. In my opinion, it would be far more satisfying to take those same homemade wontons, pan-fry them with chili peppers and a light sauce, creating a truly winning dish. However, my disappointment did not end there.

We also sampled the Talapia Medallions, which were perfectly fried. Unfortunately, there were some greens mixed in that were impossible to chew. I had to resort to discreetly discarding them using the old napkin trick, which dampened my dining experience. 

On a positive note, the service was commendable and the atmosphere pleasant, but I would not go out of my way to dine here again. My mind kept wandering to the Cantonese style cuisine that suits my taste buds more, where flavors are the priority and adding heat is customizable. I am confident that I can find better and more authentic Szechuan cuisine elsewhere, as this establishment seems to have been overly commercialized and Americanized. Personally, I find greater satisfaction in discovering those hidden gem "hole in the wall" places where I am the lone Caucasian amidst a sea of locals.

I also took the Jewish Apple Cake to go and despite being a little too brown on the bottom, it was delicious even 3 hours later on my flight back to LA.
Refine this for me please: Combining the best features of a Jewish deli, southern comfort joint, and a Mexican dive, this unique eatery offers a delightful fusion of flavors. While their brisket is fantastic, it's worth noting that their sauce is not tomato-based. Don't expect the usual round-shaped latke, but prepare to be blown away by its exceptional taste. On my return flight to LA, I took their Jewish Apple Cake to go, despite minor browning on the bottom, it remained delicious even after three hours.

input: The food is probably one of the more mediocre Chinese food I've had, but the main appeal of this place is renting a karaoke room for a large group of people and BYOing. The restaurant is exceptionally capable of dealing with huge and rowdy groups, and the food comes out to be a decent price and comes out quickly. The karaoke machines all have pretty up to date songs in a variety of languages.
Refine this for me please: The food at this Chinese restaurant is rather average compared to other options I've tried. However, the real highlight of this place is the opportunity to rent a karaoke room for a large group and bring your own drinks. The restaurant excels in accommodating big and lively groups, offering reasonably priced meals that are served promptly. Furthermore, the karaoke machines feature an extensive selection of up-to-date songs in various languages.

input:
This update (and upgrade) to my review of Khyber is long overdue!

I think the most ringing summary is that I have since moved ~1 mile further away from the Khyber, and I still go there just as often.  I have now sampled most of the menu, but the truly excellent Southern barbecue is what usually calls to me.  You can't go wrong whether you pick the brisket, the ribs, the chicken, the pulled pork or a combo of the above.  Their mac and cheese remains my favorite side, and the addition of the very good coleslaw rounds out the experience.

I love the vibe of Kyber.  It usually pretty full, but they usually seem to have a table available for me (Yay!).  It is often loud, but never quite so loud that I wish it were quieter.  The staff is very knowledgeable, and happy to provide beer recommendations and taste tests of drafts.  They Khyber also manages to hit that sweet spot where I never end up being the most or least intoxicated person there!
Refine this for me please:
This update is long overdue, but I'll refine it for you:

I can confidently say that despite moving further away from Khyber by about a mile, I still frequent the place just as often. Having tried out most of their menu, I can attest that their Southern barbecue is truly exceptional and consistently draws me in. Whether it's the brisket, ribs, chicken, pulled pork, or a combination of them all, you can't go wrong with any choice.

As for the sides, their mac and cheese remains my all-time favorite, perfectly complemented by their delicious coleslaw. The overall experience at Khyber has an incredible vibe. While it tends to be busy, I always manage to find a table without much trouble, which is definitely a plus. The noise level can get high, but it never reaches the point where I wish it were quieter.

The staff at Khyber is exceptional, possessing extensive knowledge about their beer selection. They're always ready to provide recommendations and even offer taste tests of their draft beers. What impresses me most is the perfect balance they maintain at Khyber—I never feel like I'm the most or least intoxicated person in the room.

Overall, Khyber continues to be a top-notch spot for me, even after my move.

input: Great  breads especially the German rye. My favorite breakfast is the poached eggs, cooked perfectly. For lunch, I go for the eggplant panini or  Laurie's salad.
Refine this for me please: I absolutely love the delicious bread selection, especially the German rye at this place. It's the perfect spot for my favorite breakfast, poached eggs cooked to perfection. When it comes to lunch, I can never resist the tempting eggplant panini or the flavorful Laurie's salad.

input: Tony's really has surprisingly good Mexican food, which you wouldn't expect to find out here in Chalmette.  It's actually the best Mexican food I've had in Louisiana.  Everything I've tried there is good.  My favorite so far is the chiles rellenos, which are large and excellent.  They also have Mexican Coca-Cola, which is sweetened with actual sugar, rather than the high-fructose corn syrup in the American version.
Refine this for me please: Tony's in Chalmette offers unexpectedly excellent Mexican cuisine, surpassing all expectations for a local establishment. Undoubtedly, it stands out as the ultimate destination for authentic Mexican food in Louisiana. Every dish I've sampled at Tony's has been exceptional, making it quite a challenge to choose a favorite. However, the chiles rellenos truly stand out among the rest; they are substantial in size and undeniably delicious. Additionally, Tony's offers Mexican Coca-Cola, a delightful alternative to its American counterpart, as it is sweetened with pure sugar rather than high-fructose corn syrup.

input: Awful business model it took forever to even figure out where to order. on top of that the workers actually are not professional at all. on top of THAT my other half sandwhich didn't even have sausage covering even half of the bread. easily worst place i've been in a while
Refine this for me please: The business model was extremely disappointing as it was difficult to locate the ordering process. Additionally, the employees lacked professionalism. Moreover, my half sandwich was poorly made, with insufficient sausage to cover even half of the bread. Overall, it was one of the worst experiences I've had recently.

input: The staff are friendly and attentive.  They offer a wide variety of quality dancewear products at a decent price, but don't have many options for any one kind of product, at least not for men's dancewear.  The location's convenient if you live in the city, and I always stop by here first if I need something new, but three out of four times I don't find what I'm looking for.
Refine this for me please: The staff at this store is friendly and attentive, providing excellent customer service. They offer a diverse selection of high-quality dancewear products at a reasonable price. However, their stock is somewhat limited, especially when it comes to men's dancewear. Despite that, this store's convenient city location makes it my go-to option whenever I need new dancewear. Although I usually find what I need here, there have been a few instances where I couldn't find exactly what I was looking for, about three out of four times.

input: I went here off of a referral. It was great I was done in five hours. I had individuals done, medium size and they cost 150 the hair included. There were three women that are on your head at one time. I will go there again! There very nice as well.
Refine this for me please: I visited this place based on a referral and had a great experience. The whole process took only five hours, and I had individual, medium-sized extensions done, including the cost of hair which came to $150. They had three women working on my hair simultaneously, which was impressive. The staff was very friendly, and overall I had a pleasant experience. I would definitely consider going back again.

input: Love the lamb gyros plate. It's a distance for me to drive, so sometimes I get an extra order to take back home.  The tiramisu is very good too. The dolmas are good but more vinegary than I prefer.  The Greek salad that comes with the entree' is good also.
Refine this for me please: I absolutely adore the lamb gyros plate at this place. However, since it's quite far for me to drive, I occasionally opt for an additional order to enjoy at home. The tiramisu is also fantastic, a must-try. While the dolmas are decent, they do tend to have a stronger vinegar flavor than what I personally prefer. On the bright side, the Greek salad that accompanies the entree is really good as well.

input: Love the yum yum club and macaroni salad is awesome too!! Sometimes service could be a little more friendly but besides that I continue to go back because price is right and good tastes great
Refine this for me please: I am a fan of the yum yum club, and their macaroni salad is particularly awesome. Occasionally, the service could benefit from being a little friendlier. However, despite that, I consistently return to the place because their prices and flavors are exceptional.

input:
This is my husbands and my first time here in Reno. Wow what a great hotel to stay in for your first time. We had a great room with a spa and the shower had a steam room feature. The hotel also offered many places to eat and relax. The casino was very clean and a joy to be in even if you don't gamble like myself. However I did win 41.00 with a 1.00 slot machine :)  we decided to venture out finally to see Reno. However, we weren't impressed with anything else but our great hotel.  Easy checkout right from the room was a time saver. Well now off to explore Reno some more.
If your considering a hotel that is nice, clean, up to date this is the one.
Refine this for me please: My husband and I were first-time visitors to Reno and we had an amazing experience at this hotel. It was truly a great choice for our first stay. Our room was fantastic, equipped with a spa and a shower that even had a steam room feature. The hotel also had a variety of excellent dining options and relaxing areas. Even though I'm not a gambler, I found the casino to be spotlessly clean and enjoyable. Surprisingly, I even won $41.00 from a $1.00 slot machine! However, when we explored the rest of Reno, we weren't as impressed as we were with our hotel. The easy checkout process from our room was a convenient time-saver. Overall, if you're looking for a nice, clean, and modern hotel, this is definitely the one to consider. Now, we're off to explore more of Reno!

input: Studying previous  yelp reviews, we decided to take the kids to hibachi and sushi.  This place did not disappoint. The sushi was amazing and the hibachi was awesome. The dessert of fried bananas and ice cream ended a great experience. The service was great and attentive.  Will definitely return for more!
Refine this for me please: After carefully studying previous Yelp reviews, we made the decision to take our kids to a hibachi and sushi restaurant. And boy, were we not disappointed! The quality of the sushi was simply outstanding, and the hibachi experience was truly awesome. To top it all off, the fried bananas and ice cream dessert was the perfect ending to an overall fantastic dining experience. The service provided by the staff was exceptional and attentive. Needless to say, we are definitely planning to return for more amazing meals in the future!

input: I Love it here. The pizza is fantastic,  and the staff is very friendly. It's a great place to hang out with friends and family.
Refine this for me please: I absolutely adore this place! The pizza is absolutely fantastic, and the staff is incredibly friendly. It's the perfect spot for spending time with friends and family.

input: Went here the other day with some friends for a bite and a drink. Service was great as where the drinks ;) Will definitely be back!
Refine this for me please: I recently visited this place with a group of friends for some food and drinks. The service was excellent, and we thoroughly enjoyed the drinks. I had a great time, and I am definitely planning to return in the future!

input: This place was on my list for all of the great reviews. The lamb was very flavorful, but the garlic Naan is just frozen from Trader Joe's. Also, the lamb was fairly expensive for the amount you get. Lastly, despite saying they take American Express at the door, the owner would not accept Amex. I will likely not return.
Refine this for me please: After hearing great reviews about this place, I was excited to visit. The lamb dish definitely lived up to its reputation with its flavorful taste. However, I was disappointed to discover that the garlic Naan seemed to be nothing more than frozen bread from Trader Joe's. Additionally, the lamb dish was quite pricey considering the portion size. To add to the disappointment, despite the entrance stating that they accept American Express, the owner refused to accept my Amex card. Given these factors, it is unlikely that I will be returning to this establishment.

input:
This little unassuming shop is tucked away in a strip mall full of furniture stores. Had it not been for Yelp, I would never have known it was here. Now, I won't be taking a trip to Brentwood without stopping for a scoop!

The flavors are quite varied and innovative. I had pumpkin and some sort of whipped cream cheese flavor--both were divine--which when mixed tasted just like pumpkin pie! The owner, Michael, is absolutely a sweetheart and is generous with the samples and the recommendations, and he's always coming up with new flavors to whip up. I can't wait to see what he concocts next!
Refine this for me please:
This quaint little shop is discreetly hidden in a strip mall bustling with furniture stores. Without the assistance of Yelp, it would have remained unknown to me. Now, no visit to Brentwood is complete without indulging in a delectable treat from here!

The assortment of flavors available is incredibly diverse and inventive. I had the pleasure of savoring the pumpkin and whipped cream cheese flavors, both of which were absolutely delightful. When combined, they resembled the heavenly taste of a freshly baked pumpkin pie! The owner, Michael, is an absolute gem, graciously offering samples and helpful suggestions. His creative mind constantly concocts exciting new flavors that I am eagerly anticipating trying.

input: Great food and good coffee. Wish they had more of an espresso bar with coffee options, but food and baked goods are spectacular!
Refine this for me please: The food and coffee here are fantastic, although I wish they had an espresso bar with a wider range of coffee choices. Nonetheless, the baked goods and overall menu are absolutely spectacular!

input:
holly grove is the best. I'm consistently impressed with their selection of produce. you can basically get everything (plus more stuff they don't have at the normal grocery store) except it's all local. we are so lucky to live in a place with a year round growing season, and we should really take advantage of that! (I will get off my high horse now lol). 

they also have locally raised meats, bread from local bakeries...it's just a great place to support local growers and makers. also there are always people wandering outside tending to the garden. it's a nice atmosphere. the only thing I dislike is the location - because I'm allll the way across town. that's not their fault, though.
Refine this for me please:
Holly Grove is undeniably the best place to shop for produce. Their selection consistently leaves me impressed, offering a wide range of items that you wouldn't normally find at a typical grocery store. The best part is that everything they offer is locally sourced, allowing us to support local growers and makers. Living in a place with a year-round growing season is a true blessing, and we should definitely make the most of it. (Sorry for the passionate rant!)

Not only do they offer an abundance of produce, but they also have locally raised meats and bread from local bakeries. It's a one-stop-shop for supporting the community. The atmosphere at Holly Grove is delightful, with people wandering outside, actively tending to the garden. The only downside, which isn't their fault, is the location being all the way across town. Despite that, it's still worth the effort to support such a fantastic establishment.

input:
We tried this place for the first time last night. Being a Saturday night during March Madness the service was a bit slow. The complimentary chips took longer to get to the table than my husband's salad did. Thankfully they had one of the nearby televisions playing a kid's movie to keep my 3 year old happy. Back to the chips, they are home made and were fantastic. I went the safe route and ordered a burger with seasoned fries. It was wonderful. My husband ordered the blackened chicken and while it was good it was a little over seasoned making it a tad too spicy. My daughter had the kid's macaroni and cheese. It looked wonderful but she couldn't stop eating the chips, LoL. The seating inside was a bit weird. There is a table about 2ft from the door to the women's bathroom. Maybe I'm weird for thinking it's weird but I ended up waiting until I got home to go. They offer a 15% military discount which was great. 

Overall I'd definitely recommend this place. I would have given it 5 stars if the service had been a little better.
Refine this for me please:
We recently tried this place for the first time on a Saturday night during March Madness. Unfortunately, the service was a bit slow due to the crowded atmosphere. Surprisingly, the complimentary chips took longer to arrive at our table compared to my husband's salad. However, they were worth the wait as they were homemade and absolutely fantastic. Thankfully, they had a television playing a kid's movie nearby which kept my 3-year-old entertained.

Regarding the food, I decided to go with the safe option and ordered a burger with seasoned fries, which turned out to be wonderful. On the other hand, my husband ordered the blackened chicken which, while good, was slightly over-seasoned, making it a bit too spicy. As for my daughter, she had the kid's macaroni and cheese, which looked amazing, but she couldn't resist eating the chips instead!

The seating arrangement inside the restaurant was a bit peculiar, with a table located only 2ft away from the women's bathroom door. It may just be my personal opinion, but I found it odd and opted to wait until I got home to use the facilities.

One positive aspect worth mentioning is that they offer a 15% military discount, which we greatly appreciated.

Overall, I would definitely recommend this place, although I would have given it a perfect rating if the service had been slightly better.

input: Decent hotel in downtown Tampa. Stayed in the suite with the fold out couch.  This place has a happy hour with FREE drinks, which we missed, but how cool. The complimentary breakfast was awesome.  Made to order omelets, fresh fruit, cereal, toast, bacon, sausage, home fries, juice and pastries.  Did I mention it was complimentary?   Easiest the best free breakfast I've ever had.  Room was nice and modern with two TV's etc.  Clean and a strong shower.
Refine this for me please: I had a pleasant stay at a decent hotel located in downtown Tampa. In particular, I stayed in the suite with a fold-out couch. I regret missing their happy hour, where they offer free drinks, but it sounded like a cool feature. One highlight of my stay was the complimentary breakfast, which was absolutely fantastic. They served made-to-order omelets, fresh fruit, cereal, toast, bacon, sausage, home fries, juice, and pastries - all for free. I must say, it was the best complimentary breakfast I've ever had. The room itself was modern and nicely furnished, with the added convenience of two TVs. It was also clean and had a powerful shower, which was a plus.

input: Very nice restaurant in the heart of downtown St. Petersburg with a nice homey feel to it. The burgers full of flavor and the arugula is a fine touch to the chicken and potato gratin meal.  I was not a fan of the cheese used in the potatoes gratin but will definitely be. Ack for the burger. Wine was a little high priced so I didn't get any. The atmosphere is very nice and so was our waitress.
Refine this for me please: This restaurant is a hidden gem in downtown St. Petersburg, offering a cozy and inviting atmosphere. The burgers are bursting with flavor, and the arugula adds a delightful touch to the chicken and potato gratin dish. While the cheese used in the gratin was not to my liking, I will certainly be coming back for their mouthwatering burgers. The only downside was the slightly steep prices of the wine selection, which discouraged me from ordering any. Nevertheless, the overall experience was enhanced by the pleasant ambiance and attentive service from our waitress.

input: I have been coming to Cd Roma's for over 10 years. I love this place! The old locations was a bit more home style feeling and cozy and the new spot has a more modern vibe to it. I applaud the change in style with the change in times. Too many places get stuck doing the same thing over and over again. I am glad to see that the food is still delicious. The Chicken Parm, Eggplant Parm, house salad and Alfredo are some of my favorites and they have great pizza. The alfredo sauce is made to order and taste amazing with their breadsticks. Some appetizer items leave something to be desired like the frozen cheesesticks or calimari. I would love to see these replaced with better quality items. Overall, I still love this place and would choose it over Olive Garden any day. I do miss the homey old school vibe from the old location but I also miss the good old days when people talked to each other, fragglerock ruled and hip hop was Wu Tang Clan. Oh well....
Refine this for me please: I have been a loyal customer of Cd Roma's for more than a decade, and I genuinely adore this place. The previous location had a cozy and homely ambiance, while the new spot carries a more contemporary and trendy vibe. I truly appreciate their willingness to adapt and evolve with the changing times, as many establishments tend to become stagnant. Fortunately, the quality of the food remains outstanding, with Chicken Parm, Eggplant Parm, house salad, Alfredo, and their delicious pizza being some of my personal favorites. The made-to-order Alfredo sauce is a perfect complement to their delectable breadsticks. However, there are a few appetizer options, like the frozen cheesesticks or calimari, which leave much to be desired in terms of quality. I would love to see these items replaced with higher-quality alternatives. Despite these minor flaws, I still have a deep affection for this restaurant and would choose it over Olive Garden any day. Nostalgically, I do miss the cozy and warm atmosphere of the old location, as well as the good old days when people engaged in conversations, Fraggle Rock reigned supreme, and Wu Tang Clan dominated the hip-hop scene. Alas, times change.

input:
The Waffle House has consistent quality wherever you go. I'm not really fond of their business model with their yelling and very small dining area, but I get it. 
I still look forward to going for breakfast.
Refine this for me please: Despite my reservations about their business model, with the yelling and cramped dining area, I have to acknowledge that the Waffle House consistently maintains high-quality food and service. Despite these drawbacks, I still eagerly anticipate visiting the restaurant for breakfast.

input:
Henry was a rock star  getting us into a storage locker. He was knowledge, professional, courteous and extremely personable. They were gracious to our four legged girl "Marley" who had to check them out, too.
Great experience in obtaining a storage locker!
We recommend!!!
Refine this for me please: Henry, the rock star, effortlessly guided us into a storage locker, showcasing his extensive knowledge and professionalism. Not only was he courteous, but he also had an outstanding ability to connect with people on a personal level. He even extended his warmth to our beloved four-legged companion, Marley. Overall, our experience in obtaining a storage locker was exceptional, and we highly recommend Henry's services.

input: Phenomenal restaurant. Great location. Great ambience.  Great food and most of all great drinks. If you go, grab a seat at the  bar. Jared is a true mixologist and has created all of the cocktails on the menu. Don't be afraid to challenge him. As for food, I have never had a bad meal and I have had 100's at this point and pretty much everything on the menu. You won't go wrong with anything on the menu. Listen for the specials...they are always wonderful.
Refine this for me please: This restaurant is absolutely phenomenal. Located in a prime spot, it boasts a fantastic ambience that sets the perfect tone for an unforgettable dining experience. The food here is truly exceptional, but what truly sets this place apart are the phenomenal drinks. If you visit, be sure to snag a seat at the bar, where you'll find Jared, an incredible mixologist who has crafted every cocktail on the menu. Don't hesitate to challenge him with your drink preferences, as he always rises to the occasion. When it comes to the food, I can confidently say that I've never had a disappointing meal here. Having tried countless dishes from their extensive menu, I can assure you that you cannot go wrong with any selection. Furthermore, be sure to keep an ear out for the daily specials, as they are always a delightful surprise.

input:
I know people RAVE about this place, but frankly I find it A-OK. 

It is a great location, the food is fresh, and they have a great variety of vegan options. But I find it pretty blah otherwise. I've had the crispy ranch and the curry tofu and enjoyed both of them, but I feel like I expect more out of a specialty vegan place. I did really like chick'n in the crispy ranch. The fries are pretty good too. My green lemonade was way too sweet and lemonade-y for me. 

If I were you, I would try it because people love it so much and you get some unique items. But for the $10 range for a lunch item, I wouldn't  say it's nothing AMAZING.
Refine this for me please:
While many people rave about this place, I personally find it to be just satisfactory. The location is ideal, the food is fresh, and they do offer a great variety of vegan options. However, I find it lacking in terms of overall excitement. Although I have enjoyed the crispy ranch and curry tofu dishes, I can't help but feel like I expect more from a specialty vegan establishment. I must admit that the chick'n in the crispy ranch and the fries are quite good. On the other hand, my experience with the green lemonade was a bit disappointing as it was overly sweet and lemonade-like.

If you're curious, I would recommend giving it a try, considering the high praise it receives and the unique items they offer. However, I do think that for the price range of around $10 for a lunch item, it falls short of being truly amazing.

input: Guy at the counter was rude, the place was filthy, and all around horrible! Would/will not recommend this place at all!
Refine this for me please: The service at the counter was extremely rude, the cleanliness of the place was unacceptable, and the overall experience was absolutely horrible. I would strongly advise against recommending this place to anyone.

input: My last full day in New Orleans and I HAD to come here!! Came in the pouring rain too!! I really wanted some authentic New Orleans style food (yes... it's still authentic if it's vegan, I don't care what you say! Lol!) Jamone was nice enough to give me a little taste of everything, so I could pick. That just made it harder, because I wanted it ALL!!. I'm telling you,  there is no bad choice here. Everything was SO good and flavorful!! And the bread pudding was the topper for me! I would be a regular if I lived out here! Do yourself a favor and come try this place. Come hungry too, so you can have it all, like me!  Oh...and the other great thing.  This is one vegan place where they give you a TON of food without emptying your wallet!!! Amazing food and service!!
Refine this for me please: My last full day in New Orleans was a must for me, despite the pouring rain! I had been craving some authentic New Orleans style food, and yes, it's still authentic even if it's vegan (don't argue with me on this one, haha!). Luckily, Jamone, the kind staff member, offered me a sample of everything, making my decision even harder because I wanted to try it all! Let me tell you, any choice you make here is a good one. The food is incredibly tasty and flavorful! The cherry on top was the amazing bread pudding. If I lived here, I would be a regular customer without a doubt! I highly recommend trying this place for yourself and make sure to come with a big appetite, just like me. Oh, and the best part? This vegan spot doesn't break the bank! Incredible food and exceptional service all around.

input:
Magical vegan heaven. My wife and I stopped here on a detour from our route back home to Boston and she (a non-vegan) devoured their Philly steak. I literally had to pry her away from ordering more; I don't blame her at all though because the food was damn good. I had the curry tofu wrap and it was delicious. The place is pretty small with limited seating so a lot of people were taking (and I'm assuming regularly take) their food to go, so I'd be wary of this if you're wanting to sit in. 

But yeah this place rocks. Their kale lemonade alone is worth the 5 stars. Next time we're in Philly this place will be among the first in which we stuff our faces.
Refine this for me please: Magical Vegan Heaven exceeded our expectations during a detour from our trip back to Boston. Even as a non-vegan, my wife couldn't resist devouring their mouthwatering Philly steak. I couldn't blame her though, considering how incredibly delicious the food was. Personally, I opted for the curry tofu wrap which was an absolute delight. While the seating area is limited and the place is small, many customers choose to grab their food to-go, so keep that in mind if you prefer dining in. Nevertheless, this place is truly amazing. Their kale lemonade alone is reason enough to award them 5 stars. Without a doubt, the next time we visit Philly, Magical Vegan Heaven will be at the top of our list for indulging in some mouthwatering vegan cuisine.

input: My wife and I LOVE this place. The management is always very attentive and the service is excellent! Things to try: Tiger Roll, Pink Lady Roll, Tornado Roll. Ask for Billy he's our favorite. I highly recommend this place of others in the same area. Enjoy!
Refine this for me please: My wife and I absolutely adore this place. The management consistently provides outstanding attention to detail, and the service is top-notch. If you visit, we highly recommend trying their must-have dishes: the Tiger Roll, Pink Lady Roll, and Tornado Roll. When you go, make sure to ask for Billy - he's our favorite staff member. We enthusiastically recommend this restaurant to anyone in the same area. Enjoy your experience!

input: Great place for lunch in NOLA. Love their fried chicken, and the red beans and rice is yummy too. It's a staple on our trips to town. Staff is friendly and attentitve and prices are great.
Refine this for me please: Looking for a great lunch spot in NOLA? Look no further! This place is a must-visit for their mouthwatering fried chicken, which is simply irresistible. And don't miss out on their tasty red beans and rice, a dish that never disappoints. Whether you're a local or a visitor, this spot has become a staple in our trips to town. The staff here is exceptionally friendly and attentive, making your dining experience all the more enjoyable. Plus, you'll be pleasantly surprised by their reasonable prices. Don't miss out on this gem for a satisfying and budget-friendly meal in NOLA.

input: I live in the neighborhood so I try to frequent Mint as much as I can. No choice is a bad choice! Also the Taro Tapioca Smoothie is the perfect cure for a sweet tooth.
Refine this for me please: As a resident of the neighborhood, I make it a point to visit Mint as often as possible. Whether I'm spoilt for choice or not, every option I select turns out to be great! Additionally, the Taro Tapioca Smoothie is my go-to remedy for satisfying my sweet cravings.

input: The salsa and guacamole is. Made fresh daily. The chips are home made as well. The shrimp burrito was huge but was tasty and fresh. The wait staff was just average.
Refine this for me please:
Please find below the refined version:

The salsa and guacamole are made fresh daily, and the chips are homemade. The shrimp burrito, though huge, was delicious and freshly prepared. However, the wait staff provided average service.

input:
To be honest, I was kind of disappointed with this place. I really wanted to like it, and it has gotten so many positive reviews, so I thought it was a sure thing, but it was just a little underwhelming. Not bad, just not amazing. I had the costanza, and the fillings were tasty, but the crust was disappointing. It was way too bread-y, as opposed to doughy, and when I think of a calzone, I think of dough like pizza dough- this was not that. The calzones are a good size, but they were a little skimpy with the meat fillings. Probably the most disappointing part was the dessert- we got the apple pie calzone, and it just had a really weird spice to it- something other than cinnamon that I couldn't put my finger on. It also didn't have that many chunks of apples inside- it was almost pureed apple. Meh. 

I like the vibe of this place and it's close and convenient to where i live, so I really want to like it, but I just wasn't thrilled with it the first time. Perhaps I'll give it one more shot, but it seems a little overhyped!
Refine this for me please: Honestly, I was rather disappointed with this place. Despite the numerous positive reviews it has received, I found it to be underwhelming. It wasn't necessarily bad, just not as amazing as I had hoped. I ordered the costanza, and while the fillings were tasty, the crust was quite disappointing. It had a bread-like texture instead of the doughy consistency I associate with calzones. The calzones were decently sized, but they lacked sufficient meat fillings. The dessert, an apple pie calzone, was the most disappointing part. It had an odd spice flavor that I couldn't quite identify, and there were very few chunks of apple inside, almost like pureed apple. Overall, I appreciate the ambiance of the place and its proximity to my home, so I really wanted to enjoy it. However, my initial experience left me unimpressed. I may give it another chance, but it seems to be somewhat overhyped.

input:

input: The food is very good but the ability to turnover the tables is a huge problem on busy days. Waited over an hour to be seated today and about an hour to get food. I just do not have 2 hours available to get breakfast. They do not have the proper staffing to quickly get the food out and clear tables in a timely fashion. There were many upset people there due to the time to wait. While we were eating there were 2 empty tables for at least 15 minutes that they did not seat anyone at yet when we left there was a longer line than when I arrived which we waited an hour to be seated. The workers were trying but were simply overwhelmed. Management needs to do a better job handling the staffing schedules. I will not be coming back due to this experience.
Refine this for me please: The food at this restaurant is excellent, however, the issue of slow table turnover on busy days poses a significant problem. Today, I waited for over an hour to be seated and another hour to receive my food. Unfortunately, I do not have the luxury of dedicating two hours solely for breakfast. The lack of appropriate staffing greatly hinders the restaurant's ability to efficiently serve its customers and clear tables in a timely manner. This resulted in a lot of frustrated individuals experiencing lengthy wait times. Even while dining, I noticed two empty tables that remained unoccupied for at least 15 minutes. Despite this, when I left, there was a longer line than when I initially arrived, despite waiting an hour to be seated. The workers appeared to be doing their best, but they were clearly overwhelmed. It is crucial for the management to address these issues by improving their staffing schedules. Regrettably, I will not be returning due to this unsatisfactory experience.

input:
Aside from the occasional Eggs Benny, whenever I go out for breakfast, I always order the same...eggs, bacon, hashbrowns and wheat toast with a side of salsa if they have it. 
And that's exactly what I ordered today.
The hashbrowns were undercooked for my taste, so next time I'll ask for them to be crispy/well done. Everything else was quite good. Better than the Cajun Kitchen on Chapala, but not as good as the CK in Goleta.

Thankfully all of the special requests that I DID make were taken care of.

I'm super picky about my breakfast. 
Who am I kidding...I'm super picky about everything, lol.

Large portions(leftovers for tomorrow), super affordable(more so than CK), and loved sitting on their well shaded patio(no patio at CK).
There was one server taking care of 5 tables, she was great and very cheerful. No complaints about the service.

Terraza means balcony/terrace in Spanish and that's exactly why I would come here instead of other breakfast places that don't have one.

Next on the agenda...
Check out their lunch items.
Refine this for me please:
When it comes to breakfast, I usually stick to my usual order of eggs, bacon, hashbrowns, and wheat toast with a side of salsa if available, excluding the occasional Eggs Benedict. Today, I once again ordered my go-to meal. While everything else was quite enjoyable, the hashbrowns were undercooked to my liking. In the future, I will request them to be crispy or well done. Overall, the meal was better than the Cajun Kitchen on Chapala, but not as good as the one in Goleta.

Luckily, all the special requests I made were accommodated. I must admit, I am extremely particular about my breakfast, but hey, I have high standards for everything, haha.

Terraza, which means balcony or terrace in Spanish, is the reason why I prefer this breakfast spot over others that lack outdoor seating. The large portions of food provided ensured leftovers for tomorrow, and the prices were more affordable compared to the Cajun Kitchen. Additionally, I thoroughly enjoyed sitting on their well-shaded patio, as the CK in Goleta lacks this feature.

The service was excellent, despite one server handling five tables. She was friendly and cheerful, leaving no room for complaints. 

Moving forward, I am eager to explore their lunch menu.

input:
This is an all you can eat place that at $27/adult isn't bad.  But if you ordered from the regular menu, you come to realize just how mediocre the quality is.  Maki rolls are OK, but mine were so cold they had clearly been premade and sat in the fridge.  Oyster ponzu was missing the ponzu and the coating was really heavy - like an A+W onion ring. 

So if you are really hungry and want to eat several plates of rolls and greasy tempura then this is for you. Granted sometimes that is just what you're craving. But avoid the squid.
Refine this for me please:
This is an all-you-can-eat place that, at $27/adult, offers reasonable value. However, upon ordering from the regular menu, the mediocre quality becomes evident. The maki rolls are acceptable, but unfortunately, my experience was tainted by them being chilled, indicating they were pre-made and refrigerated. Furthermore, the oyster ponzu lacked the ponzu flavor and had a heavy, A+W onion ring-like coating.

This place is suitable if you have a big appetite and enjoy multiple plates of rolls and greasy tempura. There are times when such cravings arise. Nevertheless, it is advisable to steer clear of the squid dish.

input: I called them after calling another locksmith who was rude to me on the phone. Anyway I called them in the morning and they sent someone out in 20 min. they were done in less than one hour and I received 4 free keys too. their service can't be beat.
Refine this for me please: After being treated rudely by another locksmith on the phone, I decided to contact this company. Surprisingly, they promptly sent someone over within 20 minutes of my morning call. Not only did they complete the job in under an hour, but they also went above and beyond by providing me with four complimentary keys. Their exceptional service truly stands unrivaled.

input:
This place is VERY crowded and not in a good way - unless you enjoy smelling other people's BO while you eat and drink. Gag! I guess the smell of the patrons matches the smell of the bathrooms which are also gag worthy and dirty. 

The prices aren't really great for the meh food available. Service was also meh. A few times we wondered if our server was every coming back. There are so many better options in Philly as a foodie city to try, so why waste your time and money here? Pass and head somewhere else.
Refine this for me please:
This place is incredibly overcrowded, and not in a pleasant way. Unless you enjoy dining with the unpleasant scent of other people's body odor, it's a definite turn-off. To add to the disappointment, the bathrooms are equally repulsive and unhygienic. 

Moreover, the prices don't align with the mediocre quality of the food offered. The service is subpar as well, leaving us wondering if our server would ever return on multiple occasions. Considering that Philadelphia is known for its culinary scene, there are countless better options to explore. Don't waste your time and money here; it's best to venture elsewhere.

input: Good beer selection, knowledgeable staff. Had I not ordered food here it would have an enjoyable experience. Some how received undercooked inedible Fries, one well done burger and one burger medium rare.... both burgers were served on buns that felt straight out of the refrigerator, slightly hard and cold. If you're drunk the foods good, don't eat it sober, plus add in service that was lackluster at best. We couldn't even eat the food and left it untouched. We told the the bartender no we didn't want it and what was wrong with it. Charged us full price.
Refine this for me please: The beer selection was impressive and the staff was knowledgeable. However, our experience would have been enjoyable if we hadn't ordered food. Unfortunately, we received undercooked and inedible fries, a well-done burger and a medium-rare burger. Both burgers were served on buns that felt cold and slightly hard, as if they had just come out of the refrigerator. The quality of the food seemed suitable only for someone who is intoxicated. Additionally, the service was lackluster at best. We couldn't even eat the food and left it untouched. Despite informing the bartender about our dissatisfaction and declining the food, we were charged full price.

input:
My first experience did mot go well due to the heavy accents of the employees. I called ahead so my order would be ready for me to pick up and it was, it just was not what I ordered. They are nice people and corrected my order but instead of simply picking up my food I had to wait 20 minutes To get my original order. When all was said and done, the food was good.

I was nearby and decided to give them a second chance. This time I ordered a pizza steak and I was really impressed! I need to have a couple more before I can declare them my new favorite pizza steak. Plenty of mozzarella cheese and the roll is stuffed with meat and just enough sauce. It's looking like this place is a lot better than my first impression.
Refine this for me please:
After a disappointing initial experience due to the heavy accents of the employees, my order was prepared correctly, but there was a delay of 20 minutes before I could pick up the original order. However, the food turned out to be quite enjoyable.

Despite this, I decided to give the restaurant another chance, and I was pleasantly surprised. The pizza steak I ordered was truly impressive! It had a generous amount of mozzarella cheese and the roll was filled with savory meat and just the right amount of sauce. I feel like I need to try a couple more before confidently declaring this place as my new favorite for pizza steaks. It seems that my first impression was not entirely accurate, as this place appears to be much better than initially thought.

input:
The longest bar in the City!  For as crazy busy as the Happy Hours are, the Friday and Saturday late night crowds are really relaxed and there's always a place to sit.  This is the perfect place on a Saturday night after a show at the Troc if you don't want to go to Chinatown or a Dive bar.   I've been walking over after shows at the Electric Factory lately and it's THE place to unwind after standing up for 3 hours.  

IBP has all kinds of sports packages so it's a great place to go to watch that out of town football or baseball game.  The upstairs bar has pool tables and a separate jukebox.

edit:  RIP IBP
Refine this for me please:
Introducing the City's Ultimate Hangout Spot! Despite the buzzing atmosphere during Happy Hours, the relaxed Friday and Saturday late night crowds at the longest bar in town guarantee a comfortable seat for everyone. If you're looking for the ideal Saturday night destination after catching a show at the Troc, instead of heading to Chinatown or a Dive bar, this is the place to be. Personally, I've recently started walking over from the Electric Factory after standing for three hours, and it's been the perfect spot to unwind.

IBP boasts a wide range of sports packages, making it a go-to destination for catching out-of-town football or baseball games. Additionally, the upstairs section features pool tables and a separate jukebox, adding to the overall entertainment experience.

On a more somber note, it is with heavy hearts that we bid farewell to IBP. May it rest in peace.

input:
Four stars for the beer, atmosphere and usually service. There is a reason this place is always packed! Half price beer during a generous happy hour, a huge deck that welcomes dogs, and delicious key lime pie.   Sadly, said deck allows smoking, and there is usually lots of it. I wish they at least had a nonsmoking side. 

If giving a review just based on the food, I would give it a two. The pretzels are ok, but the cheese dip is Velveeta nastiest. As a native Wisconsinite, I take offense at plastic cheese. Then, there's the pretzel bun sandwiches. I've sampled the chicken, brat and Italian sausage. It's pricey, considering it comes with potato chips (seriously guys?! Get a fryer!) and just ok. The buns were kind of soggy and the overall experience underwhelming, especially knowing the epic sandwiches for sale next door. I wish the Village pub would focus on what it's best that, serving beer, and let us bring Mitchell's sandwiches over.
Refine this for me please:
This place deserves a four-star rating for its excellent beer selection, enjoyable atmosphere, and usually good service. It's always incredibly busy for a reason! The generous happy hour offers half-price beer, and the spacious deck is dog-friendly. Moreover, their key lime pie is absolutely delicious. However, it's disappointing that smoking is permitted on the deck without a separate, non-smoking area.

In terms of the food alone, I would only give it a two-star rating. The pretzels are mediocre, and their cheese dip made with Velveeta is unappetizing. As a native Wisconsinite, I find it offensive to serve fake cheese. Additionally, the pretzel bun sandwiches, including the chicken, brat, and Italian sausage options, are overpriced since they are accompanied by plain potato chips instead of fries (seriously, can they get a fryer?). The buns were also soggy, and overall, the experience was underwhelming, especially when you can find much better sandwiches for sale next door at Mitchell's. It would be great if the Village pub focused on what it does best - serving beer - and allowed customers to bring Mitchell's sandwiches over.

input: Could not be more pleased with this establishment. Always clean and has a good feel, like the employees there actually enjoy their job. I didn't think I could like this place anymore and then I tried their fluff and fold service. Immaculate, absolutely perfect. All my clothes were returned perfectly folded and clean like I had just bought them. They even use environmentally friendly detergent! I'm sold! Thanks Modern Laundry now laundry is just one more quick stop on my laundry list of errands.
Refine this for me please: I am extremely satisfied with this establishment. It is consistently clean and has a positive atmosphere, indicating that the employees genuinely enjoy their jobs. Initially, I was already delighted with this place, but my experience with their fluff and fold service exceeded my expectations. The service was impeccable and flawless. My clothes were returned neatly folded and impeccably clean, as if they were brand new. Additionally, I appreciate their use of environmentally friendly detergent. I am now a loyal customer and grateful to Modern Laundry for making laundry an efficient and hassle-free task on my to-do list.

input: Food and atmosphere is nice. As one should expect in the CBD. Sometimes the back room can be stuffy on a busy day. I recommend the raw oysters and burgers. A few dollars on the high side for lunch.
Refine this for me please: The food and atmosphere at this place are excellent, as one would expect in the CBD. However, I should mention that on busy days, the back room can feel a bit stuffy. Despite that, I highly recommend trying their raw oysters and burgers. It's worth noting that the prices can be slightly higher than average for lunch, but the quality justifies it.

input: Great choice in a small shop. Worth the drive. The wine cakes are excellent! Just went here for first time based on yelp reviews and will definitely be going back
Refine this for me please: This small shop is a fantastic choice worth driving to. I highly recommend their delicious wine cakes. I recently visited for the first time after reading positive Yelp reviews, and I am already looking forward to returning.

input:
I am not known for favorable restaurant reviews.  Most of them below my radar.
The Love is different.  
  We had a Father's Day lunch that was exceptional.
There is little left off the menu and we were hard pressed to make a choice from the wonderful selections listed.  Our waiter was professional and accommodating.  Lovely atmosphere, light and bright.  I was amazed that the inside of my omelet was HOT. A little surprise thrown in with my Potatos..........roasted peppers, and onions.
Greens on every plate. Mine had warm spinach salad as well. My husband had the Belgium waffles made with corn meal and garnished with Blueberry butter.  They use our favorite La Columbe coffee.
Nothing left to wish for.
Refine this for me please:
I am not typically known for giving favorable restaurant reviews, as most of them go unnoticed by me. However, The Love is an exception. Our Father's Day lunch at The Love was absolutely exceptional.

The menu at The Love is so extensive and filled with wonderful options that it was difficult for us to decide what to order. Thankfully, our waiter was professional and accommodating throughout our dining experience. The atmosphere of the restaurant was lovely, with a bright and airy feel.

I was pleasantly surprised to find that the inside of my omelet was piping hot, which added an extra element of delight to my meal. Additionally, my potatoes were accompanied by roasted peppers and onions, providing a delightful and unexpected surprise. Greens were present on every plate, and my mine even included a warm spinach salad.

My husband opted for the Belgium waffles, which were made with cornmeal and topped with blueberry butter. To our delight, they even served our favorite La Columbe coffee.

Overall, there was nothing left for us to wish for during our dining experience at The Love.

input:
Not bad. Sushi roll was good but options were limited. Hibachi grill: i got steak...chef asked me 2x how i like mine-medium...Still ended up with well done. Rest of my group had chicken which all voiced lacked seasoning. 

Beware they DO NOT have a late happy hour 8-11 as advertised on their website. We asked the staff about it and they claimed 8-11 was for a different location. Their website nowhere indicates the happy hour is for a specific location nor does the website indicate they have multiple locations at all.
