I am really sorry for writing this, but I have been to this place a couple times in which I had ok experiences. It rarely gives you a good-looking manicure. 
However, today's experience was awful. She gave me 10 different nail shapes, no hand lotion, nothing. I still have my cuticles, and am very upset. I'll stop going to this place. Although it is a beautiful salon with lots of polish options, I don't think they have many professionals.
Refine this for me please: I apologize for the inconvenience caused, but I've had multiple visits to this place and my experiences have been subpar. The manicures I received were rarely satisfactory in terms of appearance. However, today's experience was particularly terrible. The technician provided me with 10 different nail shapes, without offering any hand lotion or additional services. I am quite disappointed as my cuticles were left unattended. Consequently, I have made the decision to discontinue visiting this establishment. Despite its visually appealing salon and a wide range of nail polish options, it appears that they lack sufficient skilled professionals.

input: Good food excellent service, everything was delicious. We ordered firecracker shrimp which came to us quickly we sat at the bar because it was a 3 hour wait to the formal side of the restaurant. They told us you can eat the full menu in the bar area which was true. There was a really good band playing live music, the servers were attentive and we would definitely go back. We ordered alcohol, appetizer, entree, salad, and dessert. We had the salmon and swordfish both were great! Also had HUGE fish tank from famous tv show tanked. Nice views.
Refine this for me please: The restaurant provided us with an amazing dining experience - not only was the food excellent, but the service was exceptional as well. We opted for the firecracker shrimp and it was promptly served to us in the bar area, as the wait time for the formal side of the restaurant was 3 hours. True to their word, we were able to enjoy the full menu in the bar area. The live band playing in the background added to the lively atmosphere, and the attentive servers ensured we felt well taken care of throughout our meal. We indulged in a selection of alcohol, appetizers, entrees, salad, and dessert. The salmon and swordfish dishes stood out as particularly delicious. Additionally, the restaurant had a notable fish tank designed by the famous TV show "Tanked," adding to the pleasant ambiance. The views from our table were also quite lovely. Overall, we thoroughly enjoyed our experience and would certainly return.

input: The atmosphere was nice and small. Very busy for brunch, expect at least a 30-45 minute wait. I recommend the spinach, caramelized onion and goat cheese omelet, but request a little less goat cheese. (this one was way too much, would have been better with 1/2 the amount).  Oh and the fruit was served perfectly ripe. Cash only.
Refine this for me please: The atmosphere was cozy and intimate. It was bustling with customers during brunch hours, so be prepared for a wait of at least 30-45 minutes. I highly recommend trying the spinach, caramelized onion, and goat cheese omelet, but I suggest asking for a reduced amount of goat cheese. The original serving had an overwhelming quantity, and I believe it would have been more enjoyable with half the amount. Additionally, the fruit served was perfectly ripe and satisfying. Keep in mind that this establishment accepts cash only.

input:
I was just passing through Tuscon. Native American inspired breakfast food? I just had to have some :-).  Basically I ended up with amazing and unique food that I wish I could have everyday! Five stars!

It took me while to decide what I wanted because there was so many things I wanted. 

Finally, I ended up with the pueblo, which basically is the green corn waffle with eggs the way you want it and a choice of a side (I got chorizo). The waiter told me how to eat it: put the syrup + hot sauce on the waffle and enjoy. But, instead, I ended up making an awesome syrup, hot sauce, egg, chorizo and red sauce tower on my waffle for each bite. It was delicious - try it!!!
Refine this for me please:
During my visit to Tuscon, I had the opportunity to try some delightful Native American-inspired breakfast dishes that left me craving for more. I cannot express how much I enjoyed indulging in these unique flavors, and I would give them a five-star rating without hesitation!

Choosing what to order was a bit of a challenge, as there were so many appealing options available. After much deliberation, I ultimately decided to go with the pueblo, a green corn waffle served with eggs of your choice and a side of your choosing (I opted for chorizo). The waiter kindly suggested a recommended way to enjoy it: by drizzling syrup and hot sauce over the waffle. However, I took it a step further and created a delectable tower of syrup, hot sauce, eggs, chorizo, and red sauce on top of each bite. Trust me, this combination was phenomenal - I strongly encourage you to give it a try!

input:
Another wonderful stip mall ethnic restruarant!!! This was my first time at a Veitnamese restuarant and I will say that pho is a little bowl of heaven. It was warm and fragrant and with all the condements they bring on the side, easy to customize. We also got BBQ pork sandwiches and they were very tasty. The meat was tender and flavorful and they had fresh herbs on them and some kind of yummy sauce. They only take cash, so make sure you hit the ATM before you go. The food is very reasonably priced though.

This restuarant started my love affair with pho, but I haven't had any as good anywhere else in Nashville.
Refine this for me please:
Refined version:

I recently discovered a delightful Vietnamese restaurant in a stip mall, and it was truly a wonderful experience! As a first-timer to Vietnamese cuisine, I was immediately captivated by the exquisite taste of pho. This warm and fragrant soup, served in a small bowl, felt like a heavenly delight. What made it even better was the wide range of condiments provided on the side, allowing me to customize the flavor to my liking.

Aside from pho, we also tried their BBQ pork sandwiches, which were incredibly tasty. The meat was tender and bursting with flavor, complemented perfectly by the fresh herbs and a delectable sauce. However, it is worth noting that this restaurant only accepts cash, so remember to visit the ATM before your visit. Nevertheless, the prices are very reasonable, making it worth the inconvenience of having to pay in cash.

Although this restaurant sparked my love affair with pho, I must confess that I haven't come across any other place in Nashville that serves pho as good as this one.

input:
This shop is a slice of Disney beauty and magic hiding on the edge of Broad Ripple, and a MUST stop of sweets, treats, and dreaminess. Your Instagram needs this place. Hands down the ~best~ red velvet cake of my life.

Appearance: The Cake Bake Shop is a beautifully decorated, small white house with a captivating design. The flowers around the sign make it an #instaworthy post for sure, and when the weather is nice, the outdoor seating must be gorgeous.

Inside the Cake Shop will take your breath away, light airy colors and flowers and twinkling lights. This isn't the kind of cake shop you do take-out at, you'll want to sit and enjoy. 

Food: I wanted to try the Raspberry Champagne cake, unfortunately one wouldn't be ready for a little while, so I ordered a slice of the Red Velvet  Cake. The floral icing work was so perfect I didn't want to touch it, but I had to because come on it's cake. What I assume must have been cream cheese filling in the middle was decadent and I never wanted the cake to end. ***I felt one slice was plenty for two people, it's HUGE

I was torn between the Rose Cappuccino and the Lavender Latte. I went with the Lavender Latte, hot, and it was stunning, it was a creamy, smooth, not-at-all bitter latte and the hint of lavender was enough to taste but not over powering, it was probably the most perfect coffee I've ever had in my life. 

Price: the coffee is pricy, $6, so not a regular coffee stop for me, but for #treatyoself it's the way to go. The slice of cake was $12 but like I mentioned, it was enough for two people and for how amazing it was, I think it's so worth it.

Customer Service: I mentioned Disney initially because the friendliness, care, and attention of the staff felt just like Disney. They were kind, they helped me decide what to try, and the barista even offered to make me the rose cappuccino if I didn't like the lavender latte after trying it - how sweet! 

I will most definitely think to come here if anyone visits and wants something sweet. This place has my heart and is a hidden gem to anyone who has a sweet tooth!

Check out my #FirstTimeFriday highlight of my visit to The Cake Bake Shop on my Instagram @jordanqjordanq for pictures of everything mentioned above!
Refine this for me please:
Refined Version:

Located on the edge of Broad Ripple, the Cake Bake Shop is a magical slice of Disney beauty that is an absolute must-visit for anyone seeking an Instagram-worthy experience filled with sweets, treats, and dreaminess. This shop is a hidden gem that will steal your heart.

The appearance of the Cake Bake Shop is enchanting, with its beautifully decorated small white house and captivating design. The flowers surrounding the sign make it a perfect spot for an Instagram post, and the outdoor seating is particularly stunning when the weather is nice.

As you step inside the shop, you'll be amazed by the light, airy colors, delicate flowers, and twinkling lights that create a breathtaking and whimsical ambiance. It's a place where you'll want to sit and savor the experience, rather than just grabbing a take-out.

When it comes to the food, I initially wanted to try the Raspberry Champagne cake, but unfortunately, it wasn't available at the time. However, the slice of Red Velvet Cake I ordered more than made up for it. The floral icing work was so perfect that I hesitated to touch it, but the temptation of cake was too strong. The cream cheese filling in the middle was incredibly decadent, and I wished the cake would never end. One slice was more than enough for two people - it was HUGE.

Choosing between the Rose Cappuccino and the Lavender Latte was a tough decision, but I went with the Lavender Latte, served hot. It was utterly stunning - a creamy and smooth latte without any hint of bitterness. The subtle hint of lavender added a delightful twist without overpowering the entire experience. It was, without a doubt, the most perfect coffee I've ever had in my life.

In terms of price, the coffee is a bit on the expensive side at $6, so it may not be my regular coffee stop. However, for a special "treat yo self" moment, it's absolutely worth it. The slice of cake was priced at $12, but given its size and how incredible it tasted, I believe it's worth every penny.

The customer service at the Cake Bake Shop is reminiscent of the friendliness, care, and attention you would expect at Disney. The staff were exceptionally kind, helping me decide what to try, and even offering to make me a rose cappuccino if I didn't enjoy the lavender latte after giving it a try. Such thoughtfulness and generosity!

I will definitely recommend this hidden gem to anyone with a sweet tooth, and it will be on the top of my list if anyone visits and is craving something delightful. The Cake Bake Shop has captured my heart and I am already planning my next visit.

For a visual delight of my visit to The Cake Bake Shop, check out the #FirstTimeFriday highlight on my Instagram account @jordanqjordanq, where you'll find pictures of everything mentioned above!

input:
If you like lobster this is the place. Great prices great service and great food. Very casual dining.

Back again to enjoy the Lobster special w 1  1/4 lb lobster,1 # mussels and 1-2# steamers with corn and potatoes for $19.99. See photo. 
Clam chowder so good as is the Ucon lobster roll covered in melted butter.
Refine this for me please:
For lobster lovers, this is the ultimate destination. With unbeatable prices, exceptional service, and delectable cuisine, you won't be disappointed. The atmosphere is delightfully laid-back, perfect for a casual dining experience.

We're excited to share that our Lobster special is back! Indulge in 1 1/4 lb lobster, 1# mussels, and 1-2# steamers, along with corn and potatoes, all for an incredible price of just $19.99. Check out the appetizing photo below to whet your appetite. Additionally, our clam chowder is simply divine, and our Ucon lobster roll smothered in melted butter is an absolute delight. Join us and savor every bite.

input: I've only been here to pick up an outpatient, my father.  I was greeted warmly, right away, and though he has a difficult last name, the receptionist had no problem finding him.  She even told me that he was a great patient- funny and cheerful.  She told me to have a seat and that he'd be out soon.  He was out in approximately 5 minutes happy and mostly pain-free from the injection he received.  I wouldn't be able to give this facility a full review, but they treated me well while I waited.
Refine this for me please: I had a brief visit to this facility to pick up my father, who was an outpatient. Upon arrival, I was warmly greeted and the receptionist successfully located my father despite his challenging last name. To my surprise, she even complimented him, mentioning that he was an enjoyable patient with a positive attitude. She kindly instructed me to take a seat and assured me that he would be out shortly. True to her words, my father emerged within approximately 5 minutes, in good spirits, and largely relieved from the injection he had received. Although I have limited exposure to the facility, the treatment I received while waiting was commendable.

input: Their mojo chicken sandwich is the best! It's an intimate restaurant with a hint of carribean and spanish flair. It has a laid back atmosphere and great service. The food is affordable and the staff are super friendly.
Refine this for me please: Their mojo chicken sandwich is absolutely the best you can find! This hidden gem of a restaurant exudes an inviting ambiance, blending the vibrant flavors of the Caribbean and Spanish cuisines flawlessly. With its laid-back atmosphere and exceptional customer service, you'll feel right at home. And the best part? The prices are extremely reasonable, making it a budget-friendly option. The staff are incredibly amiable, always there to make your experience unforgettable.

input: Not really sure what all the hype is about...wasn't overly impressed with the food. I suppose if you are a beer snob, one may appreciate this place. However, most bars are catering to beer snobs now and nothing about this place truly stands out from the other local bars...
Refine this for me please: I fail to understand the widespread enthusiasm for this place as I found the food rather underwhelming. Perhaps those with a refined taste for beer may find it more appealing. However, in today's bar scene, where many venues appeal to beer connoisseurs, this particular establishment fails to distinguish itself from the rest.

input:
Great brewery, friendly staff, nice area outside to sit
My favorite IPA around
Priced the same as other breweries in the area, $6-$7 for pint
Refine this for me please: This brewery is exceptional, with a fantastic selection of beers and a warm, welcoming staff. Their outdoor seating area is also a highlight, providing a pleasant environment to relax and enjoy your drinks. Personally, their IPA is my absolute favorite - it truly stands out among the competition. Additionally, the prices are very reasonable compared to other breweries in the area, typically ranging from $6 to $7 for a pint.

input: Delivery issues caused our pizza to be over 30 minutes later than the estimated delivery date.  Pizza finally arrived and was warm at best.  Won't be ordering from this location again.
Refine this for me please: Our pizza delivery was significantly delayed, arriving more than 30 minutes later than the estimated delivery time. Unfortunately, upon its arrival, the pizza was barely warm. Based on this experience, we have decided not to order from this location in the future.

input:
This is some good motherfuckin ice cream.

Positive:
+Tell me you're serving bananas foster today!
+Freshly made waffle cones
+Establishment doesn't look like a fucking kindergarden.  I can eat ice cream and still feel like an adult
+Owner is a Harvard grad, but isn't a stuck up asshole.  Actually seems pretty down to earth and can hold a conversation with the layman.

Negative:
-I'm reaching, but I kinda wish this place was located by the movie theater.  Would be nice to park once and make this part of an evening out.  The only time I really think about this place is after rolling out of Publix and by then I've already got bags of frozen food thawing out and dont have time for ice cream.  Not even some bad ass ice cream.

Hey... even 5 star joints could use some constructive criticism
Refine this for me please:
Refined:

Positive:
+The menu includes delightful flavors like bananas foster.
+They serve freshly made waffle cones.
+The atmosphere of the establishment is sophisticated and adult-oriented.
+The owner, a Harvard graduate, is down-to-earth and easy to have conversations with.

Negative:
-Although a minor suggestion, it would be more convenient if the ice cream shop were located near the movie theater for those wanting to combine their visit with an evening out.
-Only having the thought of visiting after leaving Publix often leads to not having enough time to enjoy the delicious ice cream, which is a shame even for such amazing treats.

Constructive criticism is always beneficial, even for top-rated establishments.

input:
Western cycle is a huge store and sells everything to do with bikes. They've got your $150 kids' bikes with training wheels and your $5,000 racing bikes for triathletes. The staff are knowledgeable, and they've got a mixture of older, more mature and younger people, all of whom seem into biking. 

The one aspect I've enjoyed most about coming here over the years is how they keep returned, out-of-package stuff in a drawer and will sell it to you on discount. I once got $200 pedals for $60 just 'cause they were sitting in a drawer without their proper package. The guys work really hard here to keep their customers loyal, and it works. They're honest and well-trained. You're never left wandering without help. This and United Cycle are pretty much the only two bike places I'll shop.
Refine this for me please:
Western Cycle is an expansive store that caters to all things bike-related. Their inventory ranges from affordable $150 kids' bikes equipped with training wheels to top-of-the-line $5,000 racing bikes designed for triathletes. The store employs a knowledgeable staff consisting of both seasoned and younger individuals, all of whom exhibit a genuine passion for biking.

One exceptional aspect that has consistently drawn me to Western Cycle is their practice of keeping returned items that are out of their original packaging in a designated drawer, which they offer for sale at discounted prices. This approach once allowed me to purchase pedals worth $200 for a mere $60, simply because they were stored without their proper packaging. The staff at Western Cycle exert considerable effort in nurturing customer loyalty, a strategy that undeniably succeeds in its purpose. They demonstrate unwavering honesty and possess extensive training, ensuring that no customer is left without assistance. Consequently, Western Cycle and United Cycle are the sole establishments where I choose to shop for my biking needs.

input: My husband and I go here often and we have yet to have a bad meal.  Love this place! Wonderful service, wonderful food, wonderful everything! Worth your time!!
Refine this for me please: My husband and I are frequent visitors of this place, and we have never had a disappointing meal. We absolutely love it! The service is outstanding, the food is fantastic, and overall, everything is truly wonderful. It is definitely worth your time!

input: It really upsets me that Five Star pizza does NOT have five stars. Really great pizza. Do not get the cinnamon bite things. The pepperoni bites are super yummy. Their pizzas are very large and nicely priced. Always coupons/deals on their website when you order. Food is usually ready to be picked up in 20-30 minutes. Their staff sucks but just I ignore it.
Refine this for me please: I am disappointed that Five Star pizza does not live up to its name with a five-star rating. However, their pizza is truly outstanding. I advise against ordering the cinnamon bite things, but the pepperoni bites are absolutely delicious. The pizzas are generously portioned and reasonably priced. Their website always features enticing coupons and deals for online orders. The food is typically ready for pickup within 20-30 minutes. Unfortunately, the staff's quality of service leaves much to be desired, but I try my best to overlook this flaw.

input: Place is okay. They were the only restaurant that was able to accommodate a large party on such short notice. I ordered the black spaghetti that other patrons raved about. It was pretty disgusting. I'm not sure why he had some a weird texture and almost tasted like plastic. I've tried many different types of spaghetti and this by far was the worst plate I've tried. My co-workers said their food was okay though. Maybe it was just what I ordered that sucked. If I'm ever in Nashville again, I'd give them another go. The drinks were on point as expected.
Refine this for me please: The restaurant was decent overall. We chose it because it was the only place that could accommodate our large party at short notice. I decided to try the highly praised black spaghetti, but unfortunately, it turned out to be quite unpleasant. I couldn't understand why it had such a strange texture and a plastic-like taste. I have had various types of spaghetti before, but this was definitely the worst I've ever tried. However, my co-workers didn't seem to have any issues with their meals. Perhaps it was just my choice that was disappointing. Despite this, I would still be willing to give this place another chance if I find myself in Nashville again. On a positive note, the drinks were excellent, just as I expected.

input: Fast service. Quality ingredients. Pleasant staff. And probably the healthiest meal in the whole mall.
Refine this for me please: Experience speedy service, combined with fresh and high-quality ingredients, delivered by our friendly and attentive staff. Indulge in what is perhaps the most nutritious meal option available throughout the entire mall.

input: Amazing friendly service, approachable atmosphere, and food is so delicious! Try the sweet potatoes and the gnocchi with blue cheese - seriously can't beat this place. Almost don't want to share because it is that good...!
Refine this for me please: This place offers an incredible and welcoming dining experience. The service is top-notch, ensuring that you feel like a valued guest. The atmosphere is approachable, making it a comfortable place to relax and enjoy your meal. Speaking of the food, it is absolutely delicious! The sweet potatoes and the gnocchi with blue cheese are particularly outstanding options that you must try. It's difficult to find a place that can match the quality of this restaurant. It's so good that you almost hesitate to share this hidden gem with others because you want to keep it all to yourself!

input: Just wanted to drop a quick review and say if you haven't gotten ice cream from here yet, you are missing out! It's all homemade, he has different flavor selections based on the seasons, and he let's you try lots of different flavors till you get just the right one! Love the customer service and quality of the ice cream!
Refine this for me please: I highly recommend trying the ice cream from this place if you haven't already! They offer a delightful variety of homemade flavors that change with the seasons. The owner is extremely generous in allowing customers to sample various flavors until they find the perfect one. I'm particularly impressed by the exceptional customer service and the outstanding quality of the ice cream. Don't miss out on this wonderful experience!

input:
Ask for Phil...I have read some reviews that have called him a bit of a Chatty Kathy and it's true. However, the service he provides is stellar. His reccomendations are good...I enjoy the octopusm but last time it was a bit overdone. You can eat here cheaply if you want just a little something. I tend to spend about a hundred bucks for 2 people, but have a bottle of wine and desert, not to mention numerous tapas. Try it, you'll like it.

I gave 4 stars because it has no private space for parties. That is a big negative
Refine this for me please:
Please meet Phil, the talkative server at this establishment. Despite some reviews labeling him as a bit of a Chatty Kathy, I can confirm that his service is outstanding. He offers excellent recommendations, although I must admit that the octopus I enjoyed on my last visit was slightly overdone. The prices here are reasonable if you're looking for a light meal, but personally, I tend to spend around a hundred dollars for two people, including a bottle of wine, dessert, and numerous tapas. I highly recommend giving this place a try.

One aspect that led me to give it four stars is the lack of private space for parties. Unfortunately, this is a major drawback.

input: Being from Cincinnati we know ipas and urban south has the best ones we've found in Nola. Brewery is casual and low key.
Refine this for me please: As residents of Cincinnati, we have developed a taste for IPAs, and among all the breweries in New Orleans, Urban South has truly impressed us with their exceptional IPAs. What makes this brewery even more appealing is its casual and low-key atmosphere.

input: The restaurant looks nice. We order two sushi rolls and one tuna tartare.  tuna tartare was ok but the other rolls were really...bad .the taste are just not right! They gave a discount coupon for us but not sure we want to go back again
Refine this for me please: The restaurant had a nice appearance, however, our dining experience was mixed. We decided to order two sushi rolls and one tuna tartare. While the tuna tartare was decent, we were greatly disappointed with the other rolls as they tasted really bad and the flavors were off. The saving grace was that they offered us a discount coupon, but we are uncertain if we would be inclined to return after this experience.

input: Went here 3 times one weekend while in town for a baseball tournament! Great food and service every time. From breakfast meals to sandwiches, every one was pleased with their choices. It's a good option for groups and files
Refine this for me please: I visited this place three times over the weekend while I was in town for a baseball tournament. I was consistently impressed with the great food and service each time. They offer a wide range of options, from delicious breakfast meals to satisfying sandwiches, and everyone in our group was pleased with their choices. It's a fantastic choice for groups and also works well for individuals.

input:
I love just going and walking around the store. It's got to be my favorite store ever! And the prices are not inflated like you would expect a big store like this to be. I feel comfortable with every purchase I make that I am not getting ripped off...
Staff is always friendly and helpful. This past winter I was looking for a tree stand and one employee explained all his experience and gave me his best opinion on which one I should get, and I'm glad I got it. Without him Explaining it all to me I was lost and I would've purchased the wrong thing.
Refine this for me please:
I thoroughly enjoy leisurely strolling through this store, which happens to be my all-time favorite. Surprisingly, despite its grandeur, the prices here are not inflated as one might expect. Consequently, each purchase instills in me a sense of confidence that I am receiving fair deals and not being taken advantage of.

Moreover, the staff consistently exudes warmth and helpfulness. During the winter season, while in search of a tree stand, I encountered an employee who generously shared his wealth of experience and expertly advised me on the most suitable option. I am grateful that I followed his recommendation, as I would have been lost and made an erroneous purchase without his detailed explanation.

input: I was very disappointed with my recent stay here. I've been quite happy with SPG/Aloft hotels normally but this Aloft was just awful. The entire facility was poorly kept and generally dirty. The occupants of the neighboring room were up until the early morning (3am) smoking & drinking inside/outside their room. The staff conveyed overall apathy and did little to nothing as a result. Save yourself a headache and look for a better option if staying around here.
Refine this for me please: I was extremely disappointed with my recent experience at this Aloft hotel. As someone who has generally had positive experiences with SPG/Aloft hotels in the past, I was shocked by the poor condition and overall cleanliness of this particular property. Throughout my stay, I encountered numerous maintenance issues and witnessed a general lack of cleanliness throughout the entire facility. Additionally, my neighbors in the adjacent room were consistently disruptive, engaging in loud smoking and drinking activities both inside and outside their room until the early hours of the morning, with no intervention from the hotel staff. Speaking of the staff, their apathetic attitude towards these issues was incredibly disheartening. It seems they made little to no effort in addressing my concerns or taking any meaningful action to rectify the situation. I strongly urge anyone considering a stay in this area to explore alternative accommodation options in order to avoid the frustrations and headaches that I experienced here.

input: Just moved to Nashville and was dreading finding a new vet that I loved and had reasonable prices.. With that said, we LOVE Dr. K! She is so personable and was really great with my dog, he was so comfortable the whole time. She also is very honest about pricing and tries the least expensive treatment first and discusses all the options with you! Would 100% recommend Parker's Paws!
Refine this for me please: I recently relocated to Nashville and was concerned about finding a reliable and affordable veterinarian. However, my worries were put to rest after discovering Dr. K at Parker's Paws. Not only is she incredibly personable, but she also formed an instant connection with my dog, making him feel at ease throughout the entire visit. I appreciate Dr. K's transparency when it comes to pricing, as she always tries the most cost-effective treatment options first while ensuring all available alternatives are discussed thoroughly. Without a doubt, I wholeheartedly recommend Parker's Paws.

input: DO NOT GO HERE IF YOU DO NOT HAVE A CALIFORNIA LICENSE! I would literally give this place 0 stars if I could. I've never felt the urge to write a review before but I'm just so dumbfounded with how I was treated this evening. The bouncer was the rudest person I've ever met. input: I absolutely love this Market! I live in Southwest Philly, and I do not mind traveling to get what I love from this Market. The ground beef and babyback ribs are the freshest ever!!! Yes, it maybe a little pricy, but it's worth it! If I lived in Center City, I would shop there everyday! Literally! I highly recommend this for your grocery shopping!
Refine this for me please: I am absolutely in love with this Market! I reside in Southwest Philly, and I have no qualms about traveling to obtain my favorite items from this Market. The ground beef and baby back ribs are exceptionally fresh! Though it may come with a slightly higher price tag, the quality makes it totally worth it! If I were to reside in Center City, I would visit this Market on a daily basis without a doubt! I highly recommend it for all your grocery shopping needs!

input: I love restaurants that you underestimate. If dining at a restaurant four times in one week isn't enough of an endorsement, El Limon uses the freshest ingredients but more importantly it's the spices. Plus, the little market next door has the spices for sale at almost free prices! You must dine here ASAP!
Refine this for me please: I have a deep appreciation for restaurants that exceed your expectations. input:
I eat at Sukho Thai quite a bit, and I don't really get the negative ratings. Is it the most authentic thai place in the area? No. Sometimes I would say they sometimes substitute certain ingredients. It is however usually pretty consistent as far as quality of food and service. 

I usually get the red or green curry, and almost always get it "native thai hot". I have tried other things on the menu, but they are not quite as good. So I stick with what tastes good and works for me. 

The lady that owns the place is very kind and always very gracious to my wife and I. She always recognizes us and serves us promptly. She not only owns the place, but she waits all of the tables most of the time(which I think is pretty impressive). 
The place is beside a go-cart track, so that makes it a little quirky, but it's something I have grown accustomed to. 

The only thing negative I would say is that I wish they had Kee Mao on the menu, because that's my favorite. I usually go to Siam Cafe or Thai Star for that.
Refine this for me please:
I frequently dine at Sukho Thai and am puzzled by the negative ratings it receives. While I acknowledge that it may not be the most authentic Thai restaurant in the area, I believe it offers consistent quality of food and service. 

My personal favorite dishes are the red and green curry, which I often order with a "native Thai hot" spice level. Although I have explored other options on the menu, I find these to be the most satisfying. 

The owner of the establishment is incredibly kind and always makes us feel welcome. She goes above and beyond by not only owning the place but also personally waiting tables, which I find impressive. Despite its location next to a go-cart track, which adds a quirky element, I have grown accustomed to it. 

My only complaint is the absence of Kee Mao on the menu, as it is my favorite dish. For that particular dish, I tend to visit Siam Cafe or Thai Star instead.

input:
When you dine at Muriel's, check to see if the 2nd level is open for visitors. If so, you can briefly tour the lounge area upstairs (red couches, decorative pieces). There's a wrap-around balcony where you can get a great view of Jackson Square. 

If you're curious, learn why Muriel's is haunted and find out the story behind why there's a table that is always set for two located near the stairs. 

There are two main dining rooms, a middle section (indoor patio dining area) that I personally prefer because it is quieter, and a bar area located at the back near the restrooms. I love the indoor patio dining area because it brings a bit of the outdoors in a quiet indoor setting. 

On my first visit, I ordered from the dinner pre-fix menu which is a great deal (appetizer or soup + entrée + dessert = $40). The seafood gumbo soup was hearty and delicious. The dijon mustard encrusted salmon was cooked perfectly. The bread pudding was a great way to end a delicious meal.

I returned to Muriel's for lunch on another NOLA trip and tried the wood grilled pork chop. The pork chop was flavorful, tender, and moist. I was not too crazy about the red beans and rice it was served with as I found it a bit bland. The entrée was served in a bowl but should perhaps be served on a plate since it was difficult to slice the pork chop since it kept sinking into the bed of red beans and rice. 

Muriel's is one of the places I would love to return to because of the ambiance and the great food.
Refine this for me please:
When dining at Muriel's, be sure to check if the second level is open to visitors. If it is, take a brief tour of the lounge area upstairs, which features red couches and decorative pieces. Don't forget to enjoy the wrap-around balcony, offering a stunning view of Jackson Square.

For those curious souls, explore the haunted history of Muriel's and discover the intriguing story behind the always-set table for two located near the stairs.

The restaurant offers two main dining rooms, along with a middle section known as the indoor patio dining area, which I personally prefer due to its quieter atmosphere. The bar area is located towards the back, near the restrooms. The indoor patio dining area beautifully combines the outdoor ambiance with an intimate indoor setting.

During my first visit, I opted for the dinner pre-fix menu, which proved to be a fantastic value at $40 (includes appetizer or soup, entrée, and dessert). The seafood gumbo soup was hearty and flavorful, while the dijon mustard encrusted salmon was cooked perfectly. To end the meal, the bread pudding proved to be a delightful choice.

On another visit to Muriel's for lunch, I decided to try the wood-grilled pork chop. The pork chop impressed with its rich flavor, tenderness, and moist texture. However, I found the accompanying red beans and rice to be slightly bland. Additionally, the entrée being served in a bowl made it challenging to slice the pork chop as it kept sinking into the bed of red beans and rice. Perhaps serving it on a plate would enhance the dining experience.

Overall, Muriel's is a place I would eagerly revisit due to its enchanting ambiance and delightful cuisine.

input:
I like to make a stop at this Walmart since it's located in Meadowlark where my doctor's office is.  It's smaller than  the supercentre but I find it has a decent selection of items in the food section where the prices are cheaper than the nearby stores.  The produce section can have limited items though with just the basics in stock.  I find the snacks and canned food section are fine with good prices.

As for the rest of the store and items, well it's hit or miss.  I was looking for lightbulbs and they only had one brand of the type I was looking for and it was a energy efficient so pricier than others if they had in stock.  However, the price I paid for the item was probably cheaper than other stores.  

Don't expect much help if you need help finding an item.  Associates seem to be difficult to find unless you count some of the younger staff who like racing shopping carts in the store as they were on my last visit.  

The check outs can have at most 5 cashiers working but I find the time in the line ups is never too long so that's good.
Refine this for me please:
I prefer to make a stop at this Walmart in Meadowlark because it conveniently sits near my doctor's office. While it may be smaller than the supercentre, I am satisfied with its decent selection in the food section, which offers cheaper prices compared to nearby stores. However, the produce section can be limited to basics. On the other hand, the snacks and canned food section provide satisfactory options with good prices.

Regarding the other areas of the store and its items, it can be hit or miss. For instance, when I was looking for lightbulbs, they only had one brand of the specific type I needed, and it happened to be an energy-efficient one, which was pricier compared to others if they were in stock. However, I paid a reasonable price for the item.

If you require assistance finding an item, it is advisable not to expect much help. The associates are often difficult to locate, unless you count some of the younger staff who seem to enjoy racing shopping carts during my last visit.

The checkout experience is usually smooth, with up to 5 cashiers working at most. Despite this, the waiting time in line is never too long, which is a positive aspect.
